lines.textCh: 你知道那架在森林里坠毁的飞机是什么情况吗？
lines.textEn: You know anything about that plane that crashed in the forest?

lines.textCh: 你知道那架在森林里坠毁的飞机是什么情况吗？
lines.textEn: You know anything about that plane that crashed in the forest?

lines.textCh: 你知道那架在森林里坠毁的飞机是什么情况吗？
lines.textEn: You know anything about that plane that crashed in the forest?

lines.textCh: 你知道那架在森林里坠毁的飞机是什么情况吗？
lines.textEn: You know anything about that plane that crashed in the forest?

lines.textCh: 你知道那架在森林里坠毁的飞机是什么情况吗？
lines.textEn: You know anything about that plane that crashed in the forest?

lines.textCh: 你知道那架在森林里坠毁的飞机是什么情况吗？
lines.textEn: You know anything about that plane that crashed in the forest?

lines.textCh: 我发现最先离开这座城市的是TerraGroup的大人物。
lines.textEn: I found out that the first ones to leave the city were big shots from TerraGroup.

lines.textCh: 一两个人离开可能是巧合，但这一次是一大群人同时撤走。 看起来这些混蛋早就知道了。
lines.textEn: One or two people leaving could be a coincidence, but this was a massive crowd all at once. Like those bastards knew everything beforehand!

lines.textCh: 那些TerraGroup的人一向都是坐着黑色的大G四处行动的，这次他们试图离开城市时也是用的同样的车。
lines.textEn: The TerraGroup people always rode around in black G-Wagons, and that’s how they were trying to leave the city.

lines.textCh: 所以我得到消息，其中有个人随身带着一个非常重要的U盘。
lines.textEn: So I’ve got a tip that one of them was carrying a very important thumb drive with him.

lines.textCh: 那这和那架飞机有什么关系？
lines.textEn: And what does that have to do with the plane?

lines.textCh: 传闻说那个U盘里有关于那架飞机的情报，非常重要的东西。
lines.textEn: Rumor has it, the thumb drive has info about that plane. Something very important.

lines.textCh: 这事里头肯定有大秘密！有秘密的地方，就有大钱能赚。
lines.textEn: I smell one hell of a secret here! Where there’s secrets, there’s big money.

lines.textCh: 想想看——记者为这种爆料能付多少钱？或者说，TerraGroup 为了守住他们那些小秘密……又会愿意砸下多少？
lines.textEn: Think about it — how much would journalists pay for a scoop like that? Or TerraGroup, just to protect their little secrets…

lines.textCh: 哪辆车？我这就去拿。
lines.textEn: Which car? I’ll go take it.

lines.textCh: 我喜欢你的干劲，大兵，不过我没法告诉你那辆车的确切位置。
lines.textEn: I like your eagerness, soldier, but I can’t say exactly where the car is.

lines.textCh: 这事儿 Elvira 医生女士知道，她手上好像还有个线人。你去找她，也许她能给你指条明路。
lines.textEn: Elvira knows about this, she’s got some informant, apparently. Go to her, maybe she can point you in the right direction.

lines.textCh: 我找到U盘了。（上交越野车里的 U 盘）
lines.textEn: I found the flash drive. (Hand over the SUV flash drive)

lines.textCh: 我们已经合作有一阵子了。那么现在可以谈谈那架坠毁的飞机了。
lines.textEn: We've worked together for a while now. So let's talk about the crashed plane.

lines.textCh: 你知道坠毁在森林里的那架飞机的情况吗？
lines.textEn: You know anything about that plane that crashed in the forest?

lines.textCh: 就这么简单？你怎么这么大方？
lines.textEn: Just like that? Why so generous?

lines.textCh: 你和我啊，新兵，有一点是一样的：我也决定把这件事查个清楚。
lines.textEn: You and I, rookie, we’re alike in one thing: I decided to figure this out too.

lines.textCh: 你和我啊，新兵，有一点是一样的：我也下定决心要把这事弄清楚。咱们可以互相帮个忙。
lines.textEn: You and I, rookie, we’re alike in one thing: I decided to figure this out too. We can help each other.

lines.textCh: 好吧。把你知道的都告诉我。
lines.textEn: Alright. Tell me what you know.

lines.textCh: 就当是我给你的一个善意的表示。咱俩的利益一致，所以我才把你拉进来。别太嚣张，不然我随时会改变主意。
lines.textEn: Consider it a gesture of goodwill. Our interests overlap, so I’m taking you in on this. Don’t get cocky, or I’ll change my mind.

lines.textCh: 好，所以！我找到了线索。
lines.textEn: Alright, so! I’ve got a lead.

lines.textCh: 我刚说到哪儿来着……？哦，对了。那个带着U盘的大人物被干掉了。 我不知道是拾荒者把他干掉了，还是军方截了他，或者是别的人……不管怎样，看起来那家伙把U盘落在他的车里了。
lines.textEn: Where was I…? Oh, right. That big shot with the flash drive got taken out. I don’t know if the Scavs shot him, or the military intercepted him, or someone else… In any case, looks like the guy left the flash drive in his car.

lines.textCh: 啊，你碰到那东西了，是吧？它在那里已经有一阵子了，但真正了解情况的人可不多！
lines.textEn: Ah, you ran into it, huh? It’s been there a while, but nobody really knows much!

lines.textCh: 我们可以互相帮忙，但我对你还不够了解。这活儿太重要了，不能随便交给哪个雇佣兵。
lines.textEn: We could help each other, but I barely know you. This job's a bit too important to just give it to random mercs.

lines.textCh: 先证明你自己，然后我们再谈那架飞机的事。
lines.textEn: Prove yourself to me, and then we can talk about the plane.

lines.textCh: 哦，你还记得啊！很好，你已经证明了自己。现在我们可以开始干正事了。
lines.textEn: Oh, you remember! Well, you've proven yourself. Now we can start working on this thing.

lines.textCh: 怎么样，塔科夫还好混吗？
lines.textEn: So, how’s Tarkov treating you?

lines.textCh: 哟，大兵，你来了！
lines.textEn: There you are, soldier!

lines.textCh: 我手下的人送你进来的时候没把你折腾得太狠吧？
lines.textEn: My guys didn’t rough you up too much on the way here, did they?

lines.textCh: 嗨，战士，进来吧！
lines.textEn: Hey there warrior, come on in!

lines.textCh: 进来，别拘束。
lines.textEn: Come in, don’t be shy.

lines.textCh: 你是不是把什么东西落这儿了？
lines.textEn: You forget something here, huh?

lines.textCh: 快点说。
lines.textEn: Make it quick.

lines.textCh: 我今天心情好才让你进来的。说吧，要什么？
lines.textEn: I only let you in because I’m feeling generous today. What do you want?

lines.textCh: 你又想干啥？
lines.textEn: The hell you want?

lines.textCh: 别指望我白给你好处，新兵。
lines.textEn: Don’t expect me to do favors for free, rookie.

lines.textCh: 啊，是你啊。
lines.textEn: Ah, it’s you.

lines.textCh: 怎么样，塔科夫还好混吗？
lines.textEn: So, how’s Tarkov treating you?

lines.textCh: 你是来办事的，还是来喝一杯的？
lines.textEn: You here on business, or are we grabbing a quick drink?

lines.textCh: 哟，大兵，你来了！
lines.textEn: There you are, soldier!

lines.textCh: 嗨，战士，进来吧！
lines.textEn: Hey there warrior, come on in!

lines.textCh: 哟，这不是贵客光临嘛！
lines.textEn: Well look who showed up!

lines.textCh: 进来，别害羞。
lines.textEn: Come in, don’t be shy.

lines.textCh: 又是你。任务情况？
lines.textEn: You again. Task sitrep?

lines.textCh: 还以为一阵子见不到你呢。都准备好了?
lines.textEn: Thought I wouldn’t see your face for a while. Everything ready?

lines.textCh: 不。暂时什么都没有。
lines.textEn: Nope, nothing so far.

lines.textCh: 你是来汇报进度的？全搞定了？
lines.textEn: You here with updates? Everything completed?

lines.textCh: 我正准备把你赶出去呢。保重！
lines.textEn: I was just about to kick you out. Take care!

lines.textCh: 你简直像是知道我刚补了货一样！
lines.textEn: Almost like you knew I just got a fresh restock in!

lines.textCh: 我去找找看。
lines.textEn: I’ll dig around.

lines.textCh: 真难以相信你这么快就干完了。都完成了？
lines.textEn: Hard to believe you finished that so quickly. Everything done?

lines.textCh: 会讲笑话吗？
lines.textEn: Know any jokes?

lines.textCh: 拜啦，木偶仔（Buratino）！记得再来。
lines.textEn: Ciao, Buratino! Drop by again.

lines.textCh: 有特别要找的东西吗？
lines.textEn: Looking for something in particular?

lines.textCh: 既然你亲自拖着你那小身板来了，我就给你找点活干。
lines.textEn: Since you dragged your ass here personally, I’ll find something for you.

lines.textCh: 啊，是你，士兵。任务完成了吧？
lines.textEn: Ah, it’s you, soldier. Task done, I presume?

lines.textCh: 有任务给我吗？
lines.textEn: Got any jobs for me?

lines.textCh: 行了，你在这儿待够久了。
lines.textEn: Right, you’ve been hanging around long enough.

lines.textCh: 没有折扣，心理准备好点。
lines.textEn: No discounts, so be ready.

lines.textCh: 让我想想有什么给你做。
lines.textEn: Let me think of something.

lines.textCh: 靠，这么快？都准备好了？
lines.textEn: Damn, that was quick. Everything ready?

lines.textCh: 要交易吗？
lines.textEn: Want to trade?

lines.textCh: 回头见。
lines.textEn: See you later.

lines.textCh: 我就等你开口呢！
lines.textEn: I’ve been waiting for you to ask!

lines.textCh: 行，说吧。但快点！我还有事。
lines.textEn: Alright, let’s hear it. Just make it quick! I’ve got things to do.

lines.textCh: 拖延是最蠢的。现在就去做，完事再回来。
lines.textEn: Putting things off forever is a dumb move. Do it now, then come back.

lines.textCh: 我永远缺人手。
lines.textEn: I’m always in need of spare hands.

lines.textCh: 怎么样，战士？都搞定了吗？
lines.textEn: So, how’s it going, warrior? Everything done?

lines.textCh: 我手下的人会送你出去。
lines.textEn: My guys will see you out.

lines.textCh: 希望你带够钱了吧？
lines.textEn: You got cash on you, I hope?

lines.textCh: 既然你觉得事情重要到能丢下任务……说吧，发生什么了？
lines.textEn: Well, since it's so important you decided to ditch the job… What's happening?

lines.textCh: 是要我夸你才肯动身吗？赶紧去干！
lines.textEn: Am I supposed to praise you for that? Go do it!

lines.textCh: 行，我看看，也许有点活。
lines.textEn: Alright, lemme check, maybe there is something.

lines.textCh: 我就是为了这事儿来的。
lines.textEn: I'm here exactly about this.

lines.textCh: 什么都还没做完。我是来问你点事的。
lines.textEn: Nothing's done yet. I wanted to ask you something.

lines.textCh: 行，那我就不耽误你了。
lines.textEn: Alright then, don’t let me keep you.

lines.textCh: 随便挑，战士。
lines.textEn: Take your pick, warrior.

lines.textCh: 你知道任务没完成我什么都不会给你……？行吧，你想问啥？
lines.textEn: You realize you’re not getting anything from me until the task is complete…? Alright, what do you want?

lines.textCh: 最好动作快点，战士！没干完别回来！
lines.textEn: You’ve gotta be faster, warrior! Don’t come back until you’ve got it all done.

lines.textCh: 这儿总有活给你的，战士。
lines.textEn: There’s always something for you, warrior.

lines.textCh: 还没完成。我想问你点事。
lines.textEn: It's not done yet. I wanted to ask you something.

lines.textCh: 哟，瞧瞧这是谁啊——“我数不到三”的先生！别摆出那张臭脸了，我什么都知道。来，说说看，这事咱怎么处理？
lines.textEn: Oh, look who it is, mister “I can’t count to three”! Don’t pull that face, I know everything. So, what do we do with all this, huh?

lines.textCh: 还没完成。我这就去做。
lines.textEn: Not done yet. I'll go do it.

lines.textCh: 还没，但我现在就去做完。
lines.textEn: Not yet, but I'll go finish it right now.

lines.textCh: 放松点，大兵！我看塔科夫已经把你折腾得不轻了。早点习惯吧，这地方只会越来越难。
lines.textEn: At ease, soldier! I can see Tarkov’s already roughed you up a bit. Better get used to it now, since it’s not gonna get any easier.

lines.textCh: 我得走了。
lines.textEn: I’ve got to go.

lines.textCh: 看看你，一副正事儿样！去吧，忙你的。
lines.textEn: Look at you, all business! Go on, get moving.

lines.textCh: 行，为什么不呢。
lines.textEn: Sure, why not.

lines.textCh: 哎哟，这就搞砸了，战士。赶紧补救，把活干完！
lines.textEn: Well-well, that’s a fuck-up, warrior. Go fix it and finish the job!

lines.textCh: 那你还杵在这儿干嘛？去干你的活，大兵！
lines.textEn: Then what are you still doing here? Go do your job, soldier!

lines.textCh: 让我看看有什么活，大兵。
lines.textEn: Let’s see what we’ve got, soldier.

lines.textCh: 我最近听到的一个，笑得我连腰都直不起来了： 他们的伪装实在是太好了，一次演习的时候一头牛差点把士兵给嚼了。
lines.textEn: Here’s a recent knee-slapper: The camouflage was so good during army exercises that a cow accidentally ate a soldier.

lines.textCh: 伞兵在训练的时候，能跑多快就跑多快；等上了飞机，能甩多远就被甩多远。
lines.textEn: A paratrooper first runs as far as he can, then as far as needed.

lines.textCh: 有个笑话，但我们实在是笑不出来：服役是完全自愿的。你愿意为俄罗斯服役，就来参军。不想当兵？没关系，等到了军队也容不得你想不想了。
lines.textEn: Here’s a joke, but not really a joke: Army service is voluntary. You want in, you go. Don’t want in — they’ll take you anyway.

lines.textCh: 炮兵和工兵有什么共同点？他们打电话的时候都特别小心，生怕拨错号码：工兵最怕听到“你弄错地方了”，炮兵最怕“你他妈打错了”，哈哈！
lines.textEn: What do artillerymen and sappers have in common? Both always dial the phone correctly: sapper fears “you got it wrong”, artilleryman fears “wrong number”.

lines.textCh: 我想到一个：士官对编队命令道： – 在营房里喝伏特加？你把军队当什么了？你家幼儿园？少干些幼稚的事情吧！
lines.textEn: Here's one… Sergeant to formation: – You’re not allowed to drink vodka in the barracks, this isn’t kindergarten!

lines.textCh: – 嘿,老兄,当个召唤师是不是很酷啊？ – 在征兵官面前你最好规矩点，年轻人！
lines.textEn: – Hey dude, is it cool being a spirit caller? – Watch your language in front of a draft officer, young man!

lines.textCh: 少尉想考考手下的士兵对上一次课程掌握得怎么样： – 战争时期该怎么破坏铁路，防止被敌人利用？ – 把售票厅给烧了，防止敌人恶意买票坐火车推进……
lines.textEn: Lieutenant checks how well the soldiers remembered the last lesson: – What would you do in wartime to keep our railroads out of enemy hands? – Burn all the train tickets…

lines.textCh: 士官对手下的士兵说： – 我有个好消息和一个坏消息。 坏消息是，你们必须把这些沙袋给填满。 好消息是：附近的采石场里有的是沙子！条件都这么好了，快点行动！
lines.textEn: Sergeant to his soldiers: – I’ve got good and bad news. Bad: you have to fill these bags with sand. Good: there’s plenty of sand in the nearby quarry!

lines.textCh: 空军一次夜间训练的时候，轰炸机飞行员问指挥官： – 八号，报告飞行能见度。 – 三十三万公里。 – 你他妈是怎么得出这个数的？！ – 我看见月亮了。
lines.textEn: An air force night training. Flight officer asks the bomber commander: – Eight, report flight visibility. – 330,000 kilometers. – How’d you figure that?! – I can see the moon.

lines.textCh: 一帮军校生被派去厨房帮忙，他们问准尉： – 我们有土豆皮刨子吗？ – 当然！张开手——看，这不就五个刨子了吗？
lines.textEn: A bunch of students are sent to kitchen duty. They ask the warrant officer: – Do we have a potato peeler? – Of course we do! A crew of five…

lines.textCh: 三个特种部队的狠哥们被派去和师长执行绝密任务，其中两个是大块头，还有一个小个子…… 三个人自我介绍道： – 伊万诺夫！拳击冠军，全联盟铃壶举重健将！ – 彼得罗夫！桑博格斗冠军，全联盟踢拳健将！ – 西多罗夫！象棋冠军……管这俩傻瓜健将的健将！
lines.textEn: Three spetsnaz guys are sent to the divisional commander for a top-secret mission. Two huge guys and one small modest guy… They introduce themselves: – Ivanov! Boxing champion, CMS in kettlebell lifting! – Petrov! Sambo champion, CMS in kickboxing! – Sidorov! Chess champion… In charge of these two idiots!

lines.textCh: 我最喜欢的一个笑话：特种部队训练的时候，伪装课程要么人人缺席，要么人人满分。
lines.textEn: One of my favorites: during spetsnaz drills, either no one shows up for camouflage class, or everyone aces it.

lines.textCh: 一天早上，有个上尉醉醺醺地回到船上。这时候海军上将来视察了： – 你难道对上级没有半点敬畏之心吗，上尉同志？ – 我当然有，上将同志！ – 那你为什么喝酒？ – 为了压压惊，上将同志！
lines.textEn: One morning, a lieutenant arrives at the ship drunk. The admiral comes with inspection: – Why aren’t you afraid of me, Lieutenant? – I am, comrade Admiral! – Then why are you drinking? – Out of fear, comrade Admiral!

lines.textCh: 在征兵办公室里： – 这个笑话是边防军的。 – 为什么？ – 他的脑袋就像个树冠一样！
lines.textEn: At the draft office: – This one goes to the border troops. – Why? – His head looks like a tree stump.

lines.textCh: 新兵手册第一条：“至少把手榴弹扔出去，好歹能拉人和你一起上路。”
lines.textEn: From the rookie manual: “Throw the grenade so that someone else dies with you”.

lines.textCh: 士兵无非分成两种类型：要么误打误撞被卷进战斗；要么跌跌撞撞逃出来！
lines.textEn: Soldiers fall into two types: those who run into a fight, and those who run the hell out!

lines.textCh: 军队里的万圣节是怎么回事？就是两年兵假装被第一年的菜鸟给吓到！该死的伊万诺夫，你的智商肯定有他妈的一百六！你真是个他妈的天才！
lines.textEn: What’s Halloween in the army? When the second-years pretend to be scared of the first-years.

lines.textCh: 营长正在给士兵们训话： – 四面八方都是敌人，前面，后方，侧翼都是……这种情况下怎么办？ – 好吧，起码不是敌暗我明，对吧？
lines.textEn: Battalion commander is briefing soldiers: – The enemy is behind us, to the left, right, and ahead… What do you think about that? – Well, now they won’t hide from us!

lines.textCh: 正如连长在强行军时候会说的：“怎么？这就倒下了？做个俯卧撑休息一下，继续跑！”
lines.textEn: As the company commander said on a forced march: “What falls, does a push-up and keeps running”.

lines.textCh: 这是我最近听来的里面最喜欢的一个。 准尉说： – 要是还没有志愿者自愿去办这件事，就别怪我帮你们“自愿”一下了！
lines.textEn: A favorite I remembered recently. Warrant officer: – If we don’t get volunteers, I’ll have to volunteer them myself.

lines.textCh: 哦，我想到一个！ – 列兵库兹金！为什么队列里就你没在跟着拉歌？ – 我牙疼。 – 呵，那就跟着哼哼吧！
lines.textEn: Oh, I know one! – Private Kuzkin! Why aren’t you singing in formation? – My teeth hurt. – Well, hum then!

lines.textCh: 当然可以！我给你讲个好玩的，这可是我今早才听来的： – 现在趴下，滋滋形爬到路标那里。 – 准尉同志，是之字形。 – 我说滋滋，你就得给我滋滋！
lines.textEn: Of course! He’s a good one from this morning: – Crawl to that mark in a zugzug. – It’s zigzag, comrade warrant officer. – I said zugzug, so zugzug you will!

lines.textCh: 那就听好了吧，勇士！我最近刚和手下讲过这个，他们可是乐疯了！你肯定会喜欢的。 - 房子里有蟑螂吗？ - 没有，蜘蛛把他们全吃了。 – 这儿有蜘蛛？！ – 没有，都被老鼠吃了。 – 还有老鼠？！ – 没，米哈伊尔·尤里耶维奇·奥列涅夫把老鼠吃干抹净了。 – 谁……？ – 哦，真不好意思，忘了自我介绍了。
lines.textEn: Listen up then, warrior! I told this one to my guys recently, they were really cracking up. You’ll like it. – Are there cockroaches in the house? – No, the spiders ate them. – You have spiders? – No, the rats ate them. – There are rats too?! – No, Mikhail Yuryevich Olenyev ate them. – Who…? – Forgot to introduce himself.

lines.textCh: 那些经典的都在学校里读到过吧？来听听这个！ 拉斯科利尼科夫走进了当铺，当铺里的地主婆问道： – 罗季翁，你上这儿来是先砍自己一刀呢，还是我来砍你？
lines.textEn: Ever read the classics in school? Check this one out! Raskolnikov walks into the pawnbroker’s, and she asks: – Rodion, are you here to AXE ME A QUESTION?

lines.textCh: 你认真的吗？我当然会了。听好了，新兵：一个士兵无所事事地就这么站着，少校看到了他，走了过来。 – 士兵！你在干什么？！ 士兵啪的一下立正了，响亮地回话： – 执行您的命令，少校同志！ – 但我没下任何命令！ – 所以我没在做任何事情，少校同志！ 不错的笑话，对吧？
lines.textEn: You serious? Of course I do. Listen up, rookie. A soldier stands around, doing nothing. The major sees him and walks over. – Soldier! What are you doing?! The soldier snaps to attention and replies cheerfully: – Carrying out your order, comrade Major! – I ordered nothing! – That’s why I’m doing nothing, sir! Good one, yeah?

lines.textCh:
听听这个：
 - 为什么将军一言不发？ 说明他居然在思考！在我们的军队里，要是哪个将军没有在喋喋不休或者高声叫骂，要么是他突然想起来自己还长了个脑子……要么就只是墙上的画像，哈！
lines.textEn:
Listen to this:
– Why is the general so quiet? He’s thinking. In our army, if a general is quiet, he’s either thinking… or a portrait.

lines.textCh: 是你吗？也是，还能是谁呢。所以，你已经通过了我所有的考验？ 我就是 Lightkeeper。你多半听说过我的名字。人人都想和我做生意，但不是所有人都有那个资格。
lines.textEn: Is that you? Right, who else would it be. So, you’ve passed all my tests? I am Lightkeeper. Guess you’ve heard about me. Everyone wants to do business with me, but not everyone can.

lines.textCh: 我经历了那么多困难，就为了能见你一面。为什么要设下这么多考验？为什么不让任何人靠近你？
lines.textEn: I’ve been through a lot to get to you. Why all the trials? Why won’t you let anyone get close to you?

lines.textCh: 你又来了。
lines.textEn: I see you’re back.

lines.textCh: 既然你都来了，那就开口吧。
lines.textEn: Since you’re here, speak.

lines.textCh: 祝你好运。别让 Zryachiy 失望。
lines.textEn: Good luck. Don’t make Zryachiy upset.

lines.textCh: 你想要什么？
lines.textEn: You wanted something?

lines.textCh: 有空记得过来坐坐。
lines.textEn: Stop by when you get a minute.

lines.textCh: 熟悉的面孔…你好。
lines.textEn: A familiar face… Greetings.

lines.textCh: 有需要就来找我。
lines.textEn: I’ll be here if you need anything.

lines.textCh: 你可能认为大家互相合作就能在塔科夫活下去。但那太天真了。 当周围整片森林都陷入火海的时候，蜂巢里蜜蜂的团结又能有什么用？ 只有抛弃了往日旧习的人，才能在新世界诞生的烈火中生存下来。
lines.textEn: You may think that cooperation between everyone will help people survive in Tarkov. But that’s naive. What good is the cooperation of bees in a hive when the forest around them is burning? Only those who can abandon their old ways will survive in the fire of the new world.

lines.textCh: 我听着呢。
lines.textEn: I’m listening.

lines.textCh: 祝你好运。
lines.textEn: Good luck.

lines.textCh: 我只关注真正重要的东西。 大多数商人、PMC和匪帮终将无声无息地消失。 只有那些能够崛起并接受新现实的人，塔科夫才会放过他们。 其他都不重要。
lines.textEn: I concern myself only with what truly matters. Most traders, PMCs, and bandits will disappear without leaving a trace. Tarkov will spare only those who rise anew and accept the new reality. Nothing else matters.

lines.textCh: 我希望你是有要紧事儿。
lines.textEn: I hope it’s important.

lines.textCh: 就这样了。祝好。
lines.textEn: That's all for now. Have a good one.

lines.textCh: 塔科夫只是更大变革的开端。 在我所掌握的全局之中，那些商人的争斗与野心毫无意义。 你能走到这里，说明你已准备好成为比其他人更强大的存在。 而我能让那愿景成为现实。
lines.textEn: Tarkov is only the beginning of greater changes. On the scale of what I know, the traders’ quarrels and ambitions mean nothing. If you’ve made it here, it means you’re ready to become something greater than the rest. And I can make that happen.

lines.textCh: 再见。
lines.textEn: Farewell.

lines.textCh: 啊…又是你。
lines.textEn: Ah… You again.

lines.textCh: 你能帮我做点事吗？
lines.textEn: Can you help me with something?

lines.textCh: 大多数人永远触及不到我，更永远不会明白塔科夫真正发生了什么。 把资源投在弱者身上毫无意义。我需要的只有能战之人。 也许，将来你会证明自己是其中之一。
lines.textEn: Most will never reach me, and they will never understand what’s really happening in Tarkov. There’s no point investing in the weak. I only need capable fighters. Maybe, in time, you’ll prove to be one of them.

lines.textCh: 你好。
lines.textEn: Greetings.

lines.textCh: 离开
lines.textEn: Leave

lines.textCh: 回见。
lines.textEn: See you soon.

lines.textCh: 只有从远处观察，才能纵观全局……而要想掌控局面，就必须置身事外。 商人、PMC、Boss——他们都不过是蚁丘里的蚂蚁。 他们忙前忙后，却几乎一无所知。
lines.textEn: The greater picture become clear only from a distance… To control the situation, you must stand above it. Traders, PMCs, gang leaders — they’re all like ants in an anthill. They do a lot, but understand very little.

lines.textCh: 你好，年轻人。
lines.textEn: Hello, young man.

lines.textCh: 这批货又延误了……啊，你好，我刚刚没注意到你。
lines.textEn: This shipment is delayed… Ah, greetings, I didn’t notice you.

lines.textCh: 你好。
lines.textEn: Greetings.

lines.textCh: 你好，年轻人。
lines.textEn: Greetings, young man.

lines.textCh: 我希望你穿了鞋套？
lines.textEn: You are wearing shoe covers, I hope?

lines.textCh: 啊，是你啊，年轻人。
lines.textEn: Ah, it’s you, young man.

lines.textCh: 我希望你穿了鞋套？
lines.textEn: You are wearing shoe covers, I hope?

lines.textCh: 再见。
lines.textEn: Goodbye.

lines.textCh: 你好。
lines.textEn: Greetings.

lines.textCh: 会有人送你出去的，不用担心。
lines.textEn: You’ll be escorted, do not worry.

lines.textCh: 你好。有什么要紧的事吗？
lines.textEn: Hello. Is it something urgent?

lines.textCh: 出门时别忘了把鞋套脱掉。
lines.textEn: Don’t forget to remove your shoe covers on your way out.

lines.textCh: 这批货又延误了……啊，你好，我没注意到你。
lines.textEn: This shipment is delayed… Ah, greetings, I didn’t notice you.

lines.textCh: 很高兴与你交易。欢迎再来。
lines.textEn: It has been a pleasure. Come again.

lines.textCh: 你好，年轻人。
lines.textEn: Hello, young man.

lines.textCh: 你具体是对什么感兴趣？
lines.textEn: What exactly are you interested in?

lines.textCh: 下次见。
lines.textEn: Until next time.

lines.textCh: 很遗憾，我现在没有什么能给你的。下次吧。
lines.textEn: Unfortunately, I have nothing to offer you. Another time.

lines.textCh: 随便挑。但请注意，药品不能退换。
lines.textEn: Take your pick. But please note that medicines are non-returnable.

lines.textCh: 下次见到你我会很高兴。
lines.textEn: I will be happy to see you next time.

lines.textCh: 想赚点外快？想法不错。让我看看能给你安排什么事情做。
lines.textEn: Decided to earn a little extra? That is a good endeavor. Let us see what we can arrange.

lines.textCh: 我听说你以前是个普通医生。你是怎么建立起这些人脉的？
lines.textEn: I heard you used to be a regular doctor before. How did you make all these connections?

lines.textCh: 再见，年轻人。
lines.textEn: Goodbye, young man.

lines.textCh: 这里都是目前平民不需要的物资。
lines.textEn: Here is everything not currently needed by civilians.

lines.textCh: 我来查一下记录。看来是有一些新的任务。
lines.textEn: I will check my records. There seemed to be some new assignments.

lines.textCh: 有什么任务给我吗？
lines.textEn: Got any jobs for me?

lines.textCh: 我有一些多余的物资。
lines.textEn: I have some spare supplies.

lines.textCh: 让我看看，也许能给你找点事做。
lines.textEn: Let us see, perhaps I can find something for you.

lines.textCh: 我的医院一直与最好的机构合作： 商业的、非营利的、政府的…… 甚至包括我们的一些外国同行。 想想看，我是在许多慈善活动中认识了不少客—— 不管怎样，这对你有什么意义呢，年轻人？这些都是过去的事了。
lines.textEn: My hospital has always collaborated with the best foundations: commercial, non-profit, governmental… Even with our foreign colleagues. Consider that it was at charitable events that I met many of my cli– In any case, what difference does it make to you, young man? These are matters of a past life.

lines.textCh: 我希望你之后能尽快完成任务。
lines.textEn: I am hoping you will finish the assignment quick after this.

lines.textCh: 这让我很不满意。我期待的是你带着任务成果回来。
lines.textEn: That is unpleasant to hear. I am awaiting you with the completed task.

lines.textCh: 你有什么东西要卖吗？
lines.textEn: Do you have anything for sale?

lines.textCh: 你回来得很快。
lines.textEn: You returned very quickly.

lines.textCh: 你是个可靠的人，我会给你安排一些工作。
lines.textEn: You are a reliable person, so I will find some work for you.

lines.textCh: 人脉，年轻人，不是只靠工作就能得到的。 更准确地说，不止如此。要知道，我为了达到这个位置可是花了多长时间、付出了多少努力！ 不过，这依然与你无关。你是个可靠的人，但这还不足以让我向你讲述我的过去。
lines.textEn: Connections, young man, are not acquired solely at work. More precisely, not only there. If you knew how much effort and time I expended to reach this position! Nevertheless, it is none of your concern. You are reliable, but that is not sufficient for me to recount my past to you.

lines.textCh: 我明白了。好吧，我们来谈谈你需要什么。
lines.textEn: I see. Well, let's discuss what you need.

lines.textCh: 年轻人，我们这里办事是认真的。没有完成任务前不要来见我。
lines.textEn: Young man, we are serious people here. Do not come to me without the completed task.

lines.textCh: 我正想问这件事……
lines.textEn: I was just about to ask about this…

lines.textCh: 我需要你帮我做件事……
lines.textEn: I need something from you…

lines.textCh: 一切都完成了吗？
lines.textEn: Is everything completed?

lines.textCh: 随便看看吧。
lines.textEn: Take a look.

lines.textCh: 我会试着为你安排些新任务。
lines.textEn: I will try to connect you with the new assignments.

lines.textCh: 年轻人，你没听过“好奇害死猫”这句话吗？ 是的，我以前只是个普通医生，甚至还跑过外勤。 可以说，正是通过那些外勤，我认识了一些重要人物。 也许不是。总之，这不关你的事，年轻人。
lines.textEn: Young man, have you not heard that curiosity killed the cat? Yes, I was an ordinary doctor, and even went on calls for some time. One could say that it was through those calls that I became acquainted with important people. Or perhaps not. That is none of your concern, young man.

lines.textCh: 我需要你帮个忙……
lines.textEn: I need something from you…

lines.textCh: 很好，不过我仍在等待结果。
lines.textEn: Good, however I am still awaiting the results.

lines.textCh: 这不是我想听到的。我在等结果。
lines.textEn: That is not what I wish to hear. I am awaiting the results.

lines.textCh: 我还没办完，需要更多时间。
lines.textEn: I'm not finished with it yet. I need more time.

lines.textCh: 我得走了。
lines.textEn: I’ve got to go.

lines.textCh: 我可能有些东西给你。
lines.textEn: I may have something for you.

lines.textCh: 总有你需要的东西，年轻人。
lines.textEn: There is always something for you, young man.

lines.textCh: 作为医生，总会接触到形形色色的人。这是第一点。 其次，塔科夫发生那些……变化之前的事情，现在已经不重要了。 我相信你完全明白我的意思。 Therapist 现在只是一个外号，之前的那个医生已经不存在了。不要问我关于她的事情。
lines.textEn: Being a doctor always entails numerous contacts with various people. That is the first point. Secondly, what occurred before the… changes in Tarkov, no longer matters. I believe you understand exactly what I mean. That therapist no longer exists. Do not ask me about her.

lines.textCh: 我现在就去完成。
lines.textEn: I'll go finish it now.

lines.textCh: 我还以为……算了，你需要什么？我们快点解决吧。
lines.textEn: And here I thought… What do you need? Let's get this over with.

lines.textCh: 你这样非常不专业。等全部完成后再来见我。
lines.textEn: This is very unprofessional on your part. Return once all is completed.

lines.textCh: 可别提了！就为了当初在灯塔跑业务的这个念头，我最近可是惹上了不少麻烦，真是要把人逼疯了……但话说回来，我还是会感到骄傲，毕竟生意越做越大了嘛！
lines.textEn: Don't even ask! There's so much shit piling up because of my idea to start working around the Lighthouse area, it's fucking insane... On the other hand, I can't help but feel proud. We're expanding, after all!

lines.textCh: 附近有什么新动静吗？
lines.textEn: Anything new around here?

lines.textCh: 街头的熟面孔消失了几乎一半，有点瘆人。甚至有人说塔科夫新来了一群穿黑衣服的雇佣兵，特种部队之类的，在城里搞出了大阵仗……我在想，塔科夫一下子变得这么安静，会不会和他们有关系。
lines.textEn: Half the people have disappeared lately. Someone even said there was some major operation by a bunch of black uniform spec-ops guys... And here I was wondering why Tarkov suddenly felt so damn quiet.

lines.textCh: 回头见！
lines.textEn: See ya!

lines.textCh: 你还记得城市里偶尔能看见的那些小玩偶吗？他们终于也给我做了一个！虽然是按照 BTR 做的，但我就当是为我定制的了！
lines.textEn: You remember those little figures scattered all over the city? They finally made one for me! Or at least I’m gonna pretend it’s for me.

lines.textCh: 别光坐在那里一声不吭，多瘆得慌。你需要我载你去哪里吗？
lines.textEn: Don't just sit there silently, you're creeping me out. You need a ride somewhere?

lines.textCh: 塔科夫来了一大批新武器，都是上等的尖货。你要是有机会弄到这些新枪，可一定要上手玩玩。我听说有好几种枪放在以前都是硬核佣兵们的最爱。
lines.textEn: A fresh batch of weapons just landed in Tarkov. Top-notch stuff. Try them out when you get the chance. A couple of them were even used by some real hardcore mercs back in the day.

lines.textCh: 你都能做些什么？
lines.textEn: So what can you do?

lines.textCh: 上车，找个位子坐下。要去什么地方吗？
lines.textEn: Come on in, have a seat. Need a ride?

lines.textCh: 裁判那个老小子又给自己的竞技场张罗上了！新东西还真不少，那些什么“战术地图”，就像是军队里一样，你从他那买这些地图还能捞上不少奖励呢。要不是整天忙着开 BTR 跑活，我都想自己去买点试试了。
lines.textEn: Ref’s cooked up another upgrade for his arena! Added a tactical map like the ones real fighters use, and stacked it with some fat rewards. If I wasn’t busy cruising the BTR, I’d check it out myself.

lines.textCh: 你咬着舌头了？说说你的事情吧。
lines.textEn: You bit your tongue? Tell me what's up.

lines.textCh: 我想这就是我知道的所有消息了。
lines.textEn: I think that's all the news I have.

lines.textCh: 结束对话
lines.textEn: End conversation

lines.textCh: 你是过来聊天的，还是想让我捎你一程？
lines.textEn: You here for a chat, or are we going somewhere?

lines.textCh: 你是谁？
lines.textEn: Who are you?

lines.textCh: 机会？
lines.textEn: Opportunities?

lines.textCh: 这听起来也太有野心了……
lines.textEn: It all sounds too ambitious...

lines.textCh: 所以，你为啥需要我？
lines.textEn: So why do you need me?

lines.textCh: 我不知道……我觉得结交你这样的人能对我有帮助。
lines.textEn: I don't know… I thought knowing someone like you could give me something.

lines.textCh: 我想逃离塔科夫。
lines.textEn: I want to escape from Tarkov.

lines.textCh: 重生？日食？你到底在说什么鬼东西？
lines.textEn: Rebirth? Eclipse? The hell are you talking about?

lines.textCh: 好吧，我会试试的。而且我还希望你能在这件事上帮帮我。
lines.textEn: Well, I'm going to try. And I was hoping you would help me with this.

lines.textCh: 他们？你说的是谁？
lines.textEn: They? Who are you talking about?

lines.textCh: 我是Lightkeeper。我注视着一切，也守护着所有人，而所有人……都能看见我的光芒。 在这个动荡不安的时代，掌握必要的信息至关重要。 信息创造联系，而联系则产生机会。
lines.textEn: I am Lightkeeper. I watch over everything and everyone, and all can see my light. In our restless time, it's critical to have the necessary information. Information creates connections, connections yield opportunities.

lines.textCh: 没错。是改变周遭环境的机会，以及随之而来的——改变现实本身。 在这样的环境中，生存只是人类最基本的需求。 我想做的不仅仅是活下去而已，我要把生存本身牢牢握在手中。
lines.textEn: Yes. The opportunity to change the surroundings and, as a consequence, the reality. In this kind of environment, the basic necessity for human beings is survival. I don't want to simply survive, I want to control the survival.

lines.textCh: 对幸存者来说，确实如此。但对于那些确保他人能够生存下去的人来说，一切都不一样了。 我们的相遇是有原因的。所有事件都有它的意义，世上没有巧合。
lines.textEn: It does, for the survivor. For someone who ensures survival, everything is different. We met for a reason. All events have a meaning, there are no accidents.

lines.textCh: 难道不是你一直想要见我吗？嗯？要不要问问你自己是为了什么？
lines.textEn: But it was you who was looking for me, wasn’t it? Did you ask yourself why?

lines.textCh: 对于有些人来说，分崩离析意味着新生的开始——更像是那种存在。 你不想只是活下去，你想要掌控一切。
lines.textEn: Being close to the one for whom the collapse is the beginning of the new. You don’t want to simply survive, you want to be in control.

lines.textCh: 塔科夫已经成为了你的一部分。你不可能逃离你自己，就像我也没法逃离我的过往一样。
lines.textEn: Tarkov is who you are. You cannot escape from yourself. Just as I could not escape from myself.

lines.textCh: 这个世界正在走向终结，一切可悲的尝试不过就像是在茫茫大海上抓住一块正在融化的浮冰，希望得到救赎而已——城市里正在上演的那些帮派斗争，那些商人虚假的善良，那些教唆与挑拨，以及以暴制暴的无尽循环都是如此。 这一切都将导向一个明确的结果。不会再有日蚀，只会迎来重生。
lines.textEn: This world is ending, all these pathetic attempts to hold on to a melting ice floe in the middle of a raging ocean - all these local fights, the hypocrisy of the traders, the instigation, violence multiplied by violence. All this leads to a very specific result. There will be no eclipse, there will be rebirth.

lines.textCh: 你永远也逃不出塔科夫。
lines.textEn: You will not escape Tarkov.

lines.textCh: 你不会明白的，但这也很正常。 当他们第一次联系我的时候，我一开始也没明白这是怎么回事。
lines.textEn: You don’t understand, but this is natural. I didn't understand it at first either, when they reached out to me.

lines.textCh: 我们之间已经没有什么好谈的了。随着时间推移，当你慢慢解开这团乱麻时，你自然会明白一切。
lines.textEn: There's nothing more for us to talk about. In time, you'll figure it out for yourself, as you unravel the tangle.

lines.textCh: 至于我是谁，这种问题在现在根本不重要。 重要的是你是谁，以及你来到这里是为了什么。
lines.textEn: Who I am is not important at all at the moment. What matters is who you are and why you are here.

lines.textCh: 搭车
lines.textEn: Take a ride

lines.textCh: 运送物品至藏身处
lines.textEn: Move items to stash

lines.textCh: 我能载你去任何地方，我也能在你被盯上的时候提供掩护。我还能把你的东西送到该去的地方，对，就是你的藏身处。你需要什么？
lines.textEn: I can get you where you want to go, I can provide cover fire if you're being tailed. I can also move your stuff to the right place, to your hideout. So, what's it gonna be?

lines.textCh: 火力掩护
lines.textEn: Cover fire

lines.textCh: SelectSubServiceId
lines.textEn: SelectSubServiceId

lines.textCh: 上交物品
lines.textEn: Transfer items

lines.textCh: 成交。上交 {0}
lines.textEn: Deal. Hand over {0}

lines.textCh: 成交。 上交 {0}
lines.textEn: Deal. Hand over {0}

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 在你待在车里的时候，只要外面敢有人露头，我们就会无差别开火。我们还会清空你的下车点，掩护你离开，但时间有限。
lines.textEn: The whole time you're in the BTR, we'll shoot anyone who sticks their noses out. We'll also clear the drop zone and cover you while you get out, but not for long.

lines.textCh: 把东西放在这吧，花点小钱到时候就能送回你的仓库里。
lines.textEn: Leave your items here, and we'll transfer them to your stash for a small fee.

lines.textCh: 现在能去这些地方。挑一个吧。
lines.textEn: Here's where I can drop you off. Pick one.

lines.textCh: {selectedSubServiceDealDescription}
lines.textEn: {selectedSubServiceDealDescription}

lines.textCh: 抱歉，我帮不了你。
lines.textEn: Sorry, can't do anything for you.

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 你不会后悔的。
lines.textEn: You're not gonna regret this.

lines.textCh: 这就是 Elektronik 要的全部。
lines.textEn: This is everything Elektronik asked for.

lines.textCh: Elektronik 有消息吗？
lines.textEn: Any word from Elektronik?

lines.textCh: 行，把东西给我，我来处理。
lines.textEn: Okay, give it to me, I’ll sort it out.

lines.textCh: 暂时就这些。
lines.textEn: That's all for now.

lines.textCh: （上交电池）
lines.textEn: (Hand over the batteries)

lines.textCh: 完美！
lines.textEn: Perfection!

lines.textCh: 完美！
lines.textEn: Perfection!

lines.textCh: 让我猜猜，我又得帮你一次？
lines.textEn: Let me guess, I’ll have to help you again?

lines.textCh: （上交电路板）
lines.textEn: (Hand over the circuit boards)

lines.textCh: 拿出来吧。
lines.textEn: Hand it over.

lines.textCh: （上交工具套件）
lines.textEn: (Hand over the toolsets)

lines.textCh: 有是有，但不全是好消息。
lines.textEn: Yeah, but it’s not all good news.

lines.textCh: 需要帮忙吗？
lines.textEn: Need any help?

lines.textCh: 那当然！有时候我都觉得这地方就你还算个正常人。
lines.textEn: Naturally! Sometimes it feels like you’re the only sensible fella in here.

lines.textCh: 别哼唧了，我又不是让你白干！
lines.textEn: Stop crying, I’m not asking for free!

lines.textCh: 总之事情是这样。Elektronik 说他的供应断了，现在没有工具处理那玩意儿的飞行记录仪。
lines.textEn: Anyway, here’s the deal. Elektronik says his supplies are cut off. He’s got no tools to deal with the flight recorder.

lines.textCh: 我本来想把自己的借给他，但我这边也全都预约满了，都有用场。
lines.textEn: I’d lend mine, but everything’s currently already reserved.

lines.textCh: 你得自己出去找点电子零件。我让我的人把完整清单发给你。
lines.textEn: You’ll have to look for some electronic parts in the wild. I’ll send you a full list with my guys.

lines.textCh: 东西全找齐后给我，我通过 Mechanic 转交给 Elektronik。这次不用去海岸那边放货了。
lines.textEn: Once you get everything, pass it to me, I’ll forward it to Elektronik through Mechanic. No more drop-offs on the coast this time.

lines.textCh: 另外，搞完之后你得等一阵子。准备好了我会联系你。
lines.textEn: Also, you’ll need to wait a bit after this. I’ll contact you when it’s ready.

lines.textCh: 我来这儿是为了 Elektronik 要的工具。
lines.textEn: I'm here about Elektronik's tools.

lines.textCh: 动作快点。
lines.textEn: Make it quick.

lines.textCh: 都带来了？不错嘛。
lines.textEn: All here? Good job.

lines.textCh: 行，把东西给我，我处理。
lines.textEn: Okay, give it to me, I’ll sort it out.

lines.textCh: 完美！
lines.textEn: Perfection!

lines.textCh: 我找到记录了。拿去。（上交机组记录）
lines.textEn: I found the transcript. Take it. (Hand over the crew's transcript)

lines.textCh: 坏消息。
lines.textEn: Bad.

lines.textCh: 他妈的啥？！
lines.textEn: Fucking what?!

lines.textCh: 好极了，所以我们现在把信息全丢光了？
lines.textEn: Excellent. So we've lost all the info?

lines.textCh: 我找到 U 盘了。（交出 Elektronik 的 U 盘）
lines.textEn: I found the flash drive. (Hand over Elektronik's flash drive)

lines.textCh: 拿来。
lines.textEn: Hand it over.

lines.textCh: 那 Elektronik 还有其他消息吗？
lines.textEn: So, any more news from Elektronik?

lines.textCh: 现在有消息了：好消息和坏消息，你想先听哪个？
lines.textEn: Now we’ve got news: good and bad. Which first?

lines.textCh: 好的那个。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 那听好了。Elektronik 解密了飞行记录仪。结果砰的一声，全烧了——当然不是 Elektronik 自己，是那个黑匣子！
lines.textEn: Listen up then. Elektronik decrypted the flight recorder. But then boom, all burned down. Not Elektronik, the box!

lines.textCh: 黑匣子烧没了。
lines.textEn: The box burned.

lines.textCh: 那我们现在怎么拿到情报？
lines.textEn: How do we get the info now?

lines.textCh: 放轻松。Elektronik 转录了一份通话记录的打印件。但那混蛋不想白给我们。
lines.textEn: Relax. Elektronik got a transcript of the conversations. But this bastard's not giving it up for free.

lines.textCh: 看来里面的情报相当、相当重要。他开的是天价。
lines.textEn: Seems like the intel is very-very serious. He’s asking for a real fortune.

lines.textCh: 那全没了？
lines.textEn: So it’s all gone?

lines.textCh: 不不不，Elektronik 抄了副本。但那混蛋不愿意白交出来。
lines.textEn: No, no. Elektronik made a transcript. But that bastard won’t hand it over for free.

lines.textCh: 不过你知道吗，我会付钱。毕竟我们之前说好了。
lines.textEn: But you know what, I’ll pay him. We’ve made a deal after all.

lines.textCh: 我需要你去投放点拿到副本和加密 U 盘。
lines.textEn: I need you to pick up the transcript and the secure flash drive from the drop point.

lines.textCh: 又是在海岸线，某个发霉的破旧房子里。 把所有东西都带来。我等你。
lines.textEn: It’s at Shoreline again, some moldy old house. Bring it all here. I’ll be waiting.

lines.textCh: 这他妈……那里到底发生了什么屁事？！还有这个什么鬼 Kerman 是谁……？ 等下，有人打电话。喂……？ 好了，这个电话很急。你还是先走吧，我之后联系你，朋友。至于奖励，我的手下会给你的。 嗯，我在。 终于有点好消息了。给我。
lines.textEn: What in the goddamn… What kind of shit went down there?! And who the hell is this mister Kerman…? Hang on a sec, someone’s calling. Hello…? Alright, this is urgent. You go for now, I’ll be in touch later, friend. My guys will give you the reward. Yes, I’m here. Finally some good news. Hand it over.

lines.textCh: 对话记录也找到了。给你。（上交机组记录）
lines.textEn: Found the transcript as well. Here. (Hand over the crew's transcript)

lines.textCh: 搞到了？不错嘛。
lines.textEn: You got it? Good job.

lines.textCh: (离开)
lines.textEn: (Leave)

lines.textCh: 是，我看了。（说实话）
lines.textEn: Yeah, I had a look. (Tell the truth)

lines.textCh: 箱子留在我这里。
lines.textEn: The case stays with me.

lines.textCh: 是的，我看过了。（撒谎）
lines.textEn: Yeah, I had a look. (Lie)

lines.textCh: 不，那不在任务里。（说实话）
lines.textEn: No, that wasn’t part of the job. (Tell the truth)

lines.textCh: 关于那个箱子……
lines.textEn: About the case…

lines.textCh: 我还没找到。
lines.textEn: I haven’t found it.

lines.textCh: 开玩笑的啦，给你箱子。
lines.textEn: Just playing with you. Here’s your case.

lines.textCh: 我决定把箱子留在我这儿了。别想让我改变主意。
lines.textEn: The case stays with me. Don’t try to change my mind.

lines.textCh: （把箱子交出去）
lines.textEn: (Hand over the case)

lines.textCh: 你想说 U 盘和记录的事是吧？
lines.textEn: You wanted to talk about the flash drive and transcript?

lines.textCh: 算是吧。你在路上是不是偷看了那份记录？
lines.textEn: In a way, yeah. Did you read the transcript while you were bringing it?

lines.textCh: 这次我就不骂你管不住自己的手了，你的好奇心这回反而派上了用场。
lines.textEn: I won’t chew you out for poking your nose where it doesn’t belong. This time it actually helped.

lines.textCh: 不错，我还挺佩服你的。总之，记录里提到了个叫 Kerman 的人。然后他刚才亲自给我打电话。还用变声器，哈。
lines.textEn: Good for you, I respect that. Anyway, the transcript mentioned some mister Kerman. And now he called me himself. Used a voice scrambler, ha.

lines.textCh: 还记得那个 Kerman 吗？他亲自给我打了电话。声音假得跟机器人一样。那小子自己干扰自己！
lines.textEn: Remember that mister Kerman bit? He called me himself. His voice was fake, robotic. The kid’s scrambling his comms!

lines.textCh: 他说飞机上有个加固手提箱。飞机摔到地上四分五裂解体的时候，那箱子掉了出去。
lines.textEn: He said there was an armored case on that plane. When the plane started coming apart, it fell out.

lines.textCh: Kerman 说箱子里装着离开塔科夫的“门票”。对，他就是这么叫的——“门票”。
lines.textEn: Kerman claimed it contained a ticket out of Tarkov. Yeah, he actually called it that. The “Ticket”.

lines.textCh: 这到底啥意思？
lines.textEn: What does that even mean?

lines.textCh: 鬼知道！我也不知道。但我们得查清楚。
lines.textEn: Hell if I know! No idea. But we need to look into it.

lines.textCh: 把那个箱子找出来。按我的推算，它应该掉在树林附近某个地方。
lines.textEn: Find that case. By my calculations it should’ve landed somewhere around the Woods.

lines.textCh: 哦，对了，还有件事。我把情报卖了——就是关于那架坠毁飞机的那份。
lines.textEn: Oh, and one more thing. I sold the info — about the downed plane, I mean.

lines.textCh: 你帮了我不少，所以这是你的分成，从大买家那来的。现在去，把那个箱子给我找回来。
lines.textEn: You helped me a lot, so here’s your cut, from a pretty big website. Now go find me that case.

lines.textCh: 哎哟，说吧，我听着呢。
lines.textEn: Well-well, I’m listening.

lines.textCh: 我找到箱子了。
lines.textEn: I found the case.

lines.textCh: 好消息！我就知道能指望你。干得漂亮。把箱子交出来。
lines.textEn: That’s good news! Knew I could count on you. Nice work. Hand the case over.

lines.textCh: 别跟我扯淡。我又不傻。我的人看到你把箱子藏起来了！ 想讨价还价？行啊，你随便来。
lines.textEn: Don’t bullshit me. I’m not an idiot. My guys saw you stash that case! Wanna haggle? Fine, haggle if you want.

lines.textCh: 行，那箱子我就自己留着了。
lines.textEn: Alright, the case will just stay with me then.

lines.textCh: 你疯了吗，新兵？事情不是这么干的！
lines.textEn: Are you out of your mind, rookie?! That’s not how things work.

lines.textCh: 一切都是为了那张“门票”，是吧？你想自己溜出塔科夫？你觉得你能自己打开那玩意儿？
lines.textEn: It’s all about the “Ticket”, huh? Planning on skipping out of Tarkov? Think you can open the case yourself?

lines.textCh: 能弄开它的人只有我认识！
lines.textEn: Only I know the people who can do that right!

lines.textCh: 我自己会处理，放心吧。
lines.textEn: I’ll open it myself, don’t worry.

lines.textCh: 挺能吹啊！看看你拿着那张“门票”怎么从塔科夫逃出去。
lines.textEn: Big talker, huh! Let’s see how you get out of Tarkov with your “Ticket”.

lines.textCh: 走着瞧吧，新兵。
lines.textEn: We’ll see about that, rookie.

lines.textCh: 要是你把箱子给我，我会帮你，还会把情报告诉你。但现在嘛……我倒要看看你怎么逃出塔科夫。
lines.textEn: If you’d handed me the case, I’d have helped you. Shared the info. But now… Let’s see how you get out of Tarkov.

lines.textCh: 滚吧。我不想再看到你这种背后搞事的脸。
lines.textEn: Now get the hell out. I don’t want to see your backstabbing face again.

lines.textCh: 你挺搞笑的……把它给我！
lines.textEn: Funny fucking guy… Give it here!

lines.textCh: （交出箱子）
lines.textEn: (Hand over the case)

lines.textCh: 行，箱子没问题。但你开的这个玩笑烂透了。
lines.textEn: Alright, the case is fine. But your jokes are dogshit.

lines.textCh: 好，这是你的奖励。现在我得搞清楚这“门票”到底是什么。或者找谁来买它。我敢说肯定有人想要。
lines.textEn: Okay. Here’s your reward. Now I’ll have to figure out what this “Ticket” is. Or find someone to buy it. I’m sure there’ll be takers.

lines.textCh: 接下来我得搞明白这“门票”到底是什么。或者干脆找个人高价卖掉。肯定会有人抢着要。
lines.textEn: Now I’ll have to figure out what this “Ticket” is. Or find someone to buy it. I’m sure there’ll be takers.

lines.textCh: 行了，大兵，你可以走了。别一次性把钱花光了。
lines.textEn: Alright, soldier, you’re free to go. Don’t blow it all at once.

lines.textCh: （先把箱子拿在手上）
lines.textEn: (Keep the case for a moment)

lines.textCh: 干得漂亮，大兵。箱子完好无损，你干净利落地完成了。给，这是你的奖励，实至名归！
lines.textEn: Great job, soldier. The case is intact, you did it clean. Here’s your reward. You earned it!

lines.textCh: 你干得漂亮，我多给你点奖金。
lines.textEn: I added a little bonus for getting the job done right.

lines.textCh: 你耍我是吧？
lines.textEn: Are you messing with me?

lines.textCh: 啊，先要钱是吧？行，你确实是有本事，战士。给你奖励。
lines.textEn: Ah, money first, yeah? Fine, you earned it, warrior. Here’s your reward.

lines.textCh: 我还多给了点，就当小费了。现在把箱子给我。
lines.textEn: I even threw in a little extra. Call it a generous tip. Now gimme the case.

lines.textCh: 给，箱子是你的。（交出箱子）
lines.textEn: Here, it’s yours. (Hand over the case)

lines.textCh: 完美。
lines.textEn: Perfecto.

lines.textCh: 不，我的任务可不包括这个。（撒谎）
lines.textEn: No, that wasn’t part of the job. (Lie)

lines.textCh: (离开)
lines.textEn: (Leave)

lines.textCh: 我不需要你帮我找越野车了，我自己找到了。
lines.textEn: I don’t need your help with the SUV anymore. I found it myself.

lines.textCh: 我不需要你帮我找越野车了，我自己找到了。
lines.textEn: I don’t need your help with the SUV anymore. I found it myself.

lines.textCh: 他把我们坑了？
lines.textEn: He screwed us?

lines.textCh: 有那辆越野车的消息吗？
lines.textEn: Any news on the SUV?

lines.textCh: 有那辆越野车的消息吗？
lines.textEn: Any news on the SUV?

lines.textCh: 想想看，我刚把钱打给线人，他立刻就发来一条消息。
lines.textEn: Imagine, I had just sent the payment to the informant when he immediately sent a single message.

lines.textCh: 他说什么？
lines.textEn: What did he say?

lines.textCh: 他说：“去塌方的隧道附近找一辆黑色大 G。”剩下的你应该能搞定，年轻人。祝你好运。
lines.textEn: He said: “Search for the black G-Wagon near the blown-up tunnel”. I believe you can manage from there, young man. Good luck.

lines.textCh: 不不！这人是老资历了，他不会干那种事的，尤其不会为了这么点小钱……
lines.textEn: No, no! This person is time-tested, he would never. Especially not for such a small sum…

lines.textCh: 那他说了什么？
lines.textEn: What did he say?

lines.textCh: 我从 Prapor 那里听说你自己把车找到了。很好。我会告诉线人他的情报过期了。我相信我们之后还会继续合作的。
lines.textEn: I heard from Pavel Yegorovich that you managed the search on your own. Very well. I will inform the informant that his data is outdated. I believe this will not be the last time we work together.

lines.textCh: 我需要找到办法进入港口区。
lines.textEn: I need help with access to the Terminal.

lines.textCh: 你能帮我和游荡者谈判吗？
lines.textEn: Can you help me negotiate with the Rogues?

lines.textCh: 你能让那些黑袍人别一见到我就动手吗？
lines.textEn: Can you make those black coat people stop attacking me on sight?

lines.textCh: 嘿，你能让你那位狙击手老兄护送我离开吗？
lines.textEn: Listen, can your sniper friend help me get out of here?

lines.textCh: 好了，这些应该足够了。 (上交 "{0}")
lines.textEn: Alright, this should be enough. (Hand over "{0}")

lines.textCh: 好了，这些应该足够了。 (上交 "{0}")
lines.textEn: Alright, this should be enough. (Hand over "{0}")

lines.textCh: 好了，这些应该足够了。 (上交 "{0}")
lines.textEn: Alright, this should be enough. (Hand over "{0}")
Alright, this should be enough. (Hand over "{0}")

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 你要什么？
lines.textEn: Wanted something?

lines.textCh: 游荡者们可以帮助你安全离开此区域。不过你付得起服务费吗？
lines.textEn: The Rogues can help you leave this area alive. But can you afford it?

lines.textCh: 我可以给你一个特别的护身符，让你免受他们的攻击。记得不要得寸进尺。
lines.textEn: I can offer you a special amulet that will keep you safe from them for some time. Just make sure you don't upset them.

lines.textCh: Zryachiy 是世界上最厉害的狙击手之一。他会在你回程的路上保护你，干掉所有挡路的人。但是他的服务并不是免费的。准备好掏钱了吗？
lines.textEn: Zryachiy is one of the best snipers in the world. He'll have your back, kill anyone who crosses your path. But this kind of help comes at a price. You ready to shell out?

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 我这里概不退款，记住这一点。
lines.textEn: No refunds, just so you know.

lines.textCh: 现在还不是时候。时候会到的。
lines.textEn: Not now. The time will come.

lines.textCh: 给。这是门禁卡。我想你知道怎么用。
lines.textEn: Here. This is a keycard. I think you know how to use it.

lines.textCh: 就知道你靠得住。
lines.textEn: Never doubted you.

lines.textCh: 已经完事儿了？干得不错。
lines.textEn: Done already? Nice working with you.

lines.textCh: 就知道你靠得住。
lines.textEn: Never doubted you.

lines.textCh: 这就是我需要的。谢啦！
lines.textEn: Just what I wanted. Thank you!

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 有活儿要我干吗？
lines.textEn: Got any work for me?

lines.textCh: 太好了！我会等着的。
lines.textEn: Cool! I'll be waiting.

lines.textCh: 不错。谢了！
lines.textEn: Well done. Thanks!

lines.textCh: 离开的时候，睁大眼睛，小心点儿。
lines.textEn: Keep your eyes open on your way out.

lines.textCh: 这些可都是稀罕货。
lines.textEn: Those are quite rare.

lines.textCh: 好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 轻拿轻放。
lines.textEn: Be careful with it.

lines.textCh: 太好了。
lines.textEn: Excellent.

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 有活儿要我干吗？
lines.textEn: Got any work for me?

lines.textCh: 明白。
lines.textEn: Understood.

lines.textCh: 我这里不接受退货。
lines.textEn: I do not accept refunds.

lines.textCh: 真不错！完事儿了就回来找我。
lines.textEn: Amazing! Come back when you're finished.

lines.textCh: 我已经处理了营地里的麻烦，顺带把包裹交给 Prapor 了。
lines.textEn: Your base is now clear. I found the package and delivered it to Prapor.

lines.textCh: 就知道你靠得住。
lines.textEn: Never doubted you.

lines.textCh: 听起来很简单。我来搞定。
lines.textEn: Sounds easy enough. I'll handle it.

lines.textCh: 我现在帮不了你。
lines.textEn: I cannot help you right now.

lines.textCh: 嗨。Mechanic 说你需要一些帮助。
lines.textEn: Hey. Mechanic said you needed some help.

lines.textCh:
所以 Mechanic 派了你过来，是吗？可以，所以事情是这样的：我之前找了个地方当窝，里面车库、零部件什么的全都有，连放货的地方都齐了。结果突然冒出来一帮混混觉得他们能为所欲为，直接把整个地方洗劫一空！总有一天我得报这个仇，但在此之前，所有的送货订单都乱了套！ 

其中的顶头大事是 Prapor 那一单，他已经开始等得不耐烦了，那个货箱还在 Priozersk 保护区的伐木场附近。如果你真的打算帮我的话，先去那附近找到包裹，然后把它带给 Prapor。我能在路上捎你一程，但是我打死也不出 BTR。外面的世界麻烦实在太多了，有这层铁皮盖着我还安心点。
lines.textEn:
So Mechanic sent you, huh? Cool. So I used to have a base, with a hangar, spare parts, cargo shipments even. Then some assholes thought they could just clean the place out! I'm gonna find those bastards. But while I'm at it, all the deliveries are messing up! 

The most important one is a package for Prapor, he's really anxious for it, and the box is still at the depot near the sawmill in Priozersk. If you're down to help me, look for this package and deliver it to Prapor. I can give you a ride to the depot, but I ain't leaving the BTR. I don't like it outside, it's more comforting inside this armor.

lines.textCh: 太好了！我会等着的。
lines.textEn: Cool! I'll be waiting.

lines.textCh:
Prapor 生气了没？我草，那可真是麻烦大了！不过多谢帮忙了。

现在我得出发去看看我的营地里还剩些什么了。你是个可靠的好人，所以常联系好吗？等我找到那群混混之后，还得请你出手帮忙呢。
lines.textEn:
So, was Prapor pissed? Well shit, it's an emergency over here! But hey, thanks for helping me out.

Now I might go and check out what's left of the base. You're a good guy, so stay in touch, yeah? When I find these shitheads, I'll need your help again.

lines.textCh: 真不错！完事儿了就回来找我。
lines.textEn: Amazing! Come back when you're finished.

lines.textCh: 都搞定了。我照你说的做了。
lines.textEn: All done. I did what you asked.

lines.textCh: 就知道你靠得住。
lines.textEn: Never doubted you.

lines.textCh: 那附近到处都是没人要的轮子，别担心，我会搞定的。
lines.textEn: There are wheels everywhere, don't worry. I'll take care of it.

lines.textCh: 或许下次再说成吗？现在不行。
lines.textEn: Perhaps some other time, okay? Not right now.

lines.textCh: 情况怎么样？你回去过自己的营地了吗？
lines.textEn: How are things? You back to your base yet?

lines.textCh:
所以我又回到了那个火车站……那群混蛋把整个地方都糟蹋完了，就连装甲车的零件也被他们洗劫一空。我的意思是，偷工具或者其他什么装备好歹还能理解，但是他们偷我的车轮干什么？就算凑再多轮子也拼不出第二辆 BTR 来啊。

无论如何，我需要新的备用轮子，越早找来越好。我也不知道这上哪能找来这种东西，你得先想想哪里可能有这种军用规格的车轮再出发。只要你不是什么大字不识一个的白痴，结果应该也大差不差。你可以先从海关区域找起，但我已经很长时间没去过那了，所以我也不确定那里到底有没有我要的东西。
lines.textEn:
So I went to the depot... Those assholes ruined the place and took my spare parts. I mean, I can understand tools or equipment. But why the fuck would someone take the fucking wheels? You're not gonna build a second BTR like that.

Anyway, I need a spare wheel, and the sooner the better. You gotta find where the proper wheels could be laying around. I don't know where to look exactly, but you're not a moron, you'll figure it out. You can start with the customs area, but I haven't been there for ages, so I can't promise they'll be there.

lines.textCh: 太好了！我会等着的。
lines.textEn: Cool! I'll be waiting.

lines.textCh: 太棒了！这些就足够了，这事你办得又快又利落，我说的！不过给这辆装甲宝贝换轮子得需要点时间，毕竟这可不是拉达车。
lines.textEn: Awesome! These will do, and you also did it quick. I commend that! Changing the wheels will take some time though, it's not a Lada after all.

lines.textCh: 太棒了！等你完成后再回来找我。
lines.textEn: Amazing! Come back when you're finished.

lines.textCh: 这次应该标对了。
lines.textEn: I think I marked it right this time.

lines.textCh: 就知道你靠得住。
lines.textEn: Never doubted you.

lines.textCh: 你应该告诉我你要带轮毂的那种，而不是只要轮胎的……算了，我再去找一次。
lines.textEn: You should have just told me you needed rims too... Okay, I'll look some more.

lines.textCh: 要是真的这么简单，那你自己去搞啊！我没时间和你弄这些。
lines.textEn: Go do it yourself if it's that easy! I don't have time for this.

lines.textCh: 所以，你找到你要的轮子了没？
lines.textEn: So, have you found your wheels yet?

lines.textCh:
我们浪费的时间已经够多了，再等下去 BTR 迟早会抛锚在路上。就在你去外头瞎晃悠，找些卡车轮子来糊弄我的时候，我认真做了点调查，找到了哪里可能有真正的军用负重轮。去军事储备基地，我要的轮子就在那里。 

我要的是带轮毂的那种，而且尺寸也和 BTR 的一样。这次别再搞砸了，时限真的快要到了。
lines.textEn:
We've already lost time, but if we wait any longer, the BTR's gonna stall. While you were screwing around, I did some digging and found out where we can get some proper wheels. Go to the reserve military base, the wheels we need are there. 

They come with rims attached, and they're a proper diameter for the BTR, too. Don't mess it up this time, the deadline's coming up.

lines.textCh: 太好了！我会在这儿等着你。
lines.textEn: Cool! I'll be waiting.

lines.textCh:
这样就完事了，给装甲车换轮子并不是轻松的活，但是起码我们现在有备件了。 

谢谢你帮忙，还有，呃……之前对你大吼大叫说了一堆脏话，对不起。我真的没法承受在失去了营地之后又来新的挫折，一想到会失去我的宝贝装甲车我就失去理智了。
lines.textEn:
There you go. It's a pain in the ass to change the wheels, but at least we have spares now. 

Thanks for your help. And, uh, I'm sorry for being an asshole. I just really can't lose my baby while we're dealing with this emergency.

lines.textCh: 太棒了！完事了就回来找我吧。
lines.textEn: Amazing! Come back when you're finished.

lines.textCh: 我找到那些混混了，他们再也不会来烦你了。
lines.textEn: I found those dickheads. They won't be bothering you anymore.

lines.textCh: 就知道你靠得住。
lines.textEn: Never doubted you.

lines.textCh: 好，我会帮忙的。
lines.textEn: Alright, I'm in.

lines.textCh: 我自己的麻烦事已经够多了，这回真的帮不上忙。
lines.textEn: I've got enough on my plate already. I can't help you.

lines.textCh: 要是还有什么我能帮得上忙的，说一声就行。
lines.textEn: Let me know if you need some more help.

lines.textCh:
怎么样？这车跑起来是不是顺畅不少？你找来的那些轮子还真挺好用。 

现在我们可以想想该怎么对付那些洗劫我的车库的混蛋了。那些肯定是当地的混混，搞不好还在自然保护区里逍遥自在。去给那些家伙点颜色尝尝，行吗？
lines.textEn:
So? Feel how smooth it runs now? You did me a solid with the wheels. 

Now we can start thinking about the fuckers who robbed my base. They can't have gotten far, they're probably still in the nature reserve. Go and punish those fucks, will you?

lines.textCh: 太好了！我会等着的。
lines.textEn: Cool! I'll be waiting.

lines.textCh: 干得漂亮！现在那些 Scav 肯定不敢再随便伸手了。
lines.textEn: Nice work! Now the Scavs will think twice before messing with me.

lines.textCh: 太棒了！完事了就回来找我吧。
lines.textEn: Amazing! Come back when you're finished.

lines.textCh: 虽然不算轻松，但我已经解决了那些麻烦，他们不会再回来了。
lines.textEn: It took some work, but your problem is solved. They're not coming back.

lines.textCh: 了解，我会去办的。
lines.textEn: Understood, will do.

lines.textCh: 我现在帮不了你。
lines.textEn: I cannot help you right now.

lines.textCh: 轮子跑起来怎么样？
lines.textEn: How are the wheels?

lines.textCh:
你看到我给这辆宝贝换的新负重轮了吗？得了，当我没说，免得你真的探出头去看又搞出什么麻烦来。之前的奔波太耗时间了，不过我们仍然有机会抓到那些差点把我家拆了的混蛋们。我听说他们是从储备基地过来搞的破坏。如果现在动手，也许还来得及把他们逮个正着。 

我建议你从森林启程，沿着那条道路去储备站，我们得赶在他们逍遥法外前把他们都钉死在地上。
lines.textEn:
Have you seen the new wheels? Actually, nevermind, before you fuck them up by looking at them or something. We've lost enough time, but there's a chance we can still find those half-assed engineers. I learned they came from the reserve base. If we don't hesitate, we can still catch up with them and punish them.

Start in the forest and follow that path to the military base, we need to nail these assholes before they lay low.

lines.textCh: 太好了！我会等着的。
lines.textEn: Cool! I'll be waiting.

lines.textCh: 你赶上他们了？太棒了，这下他们就算再有非分之想也得好好考虑后果了。
lines.textEn: You got them in time? Good. Let the others think twice before ransacking my place again.

lines.textCh: 太棒了！完事了就回来找我吧。
lines.textEn: Amazing! Come back when you're finished.

lines.textCh: 我已经跟他们谈过了，但是他们没有给我一个明确的答复。
lines.textEn: I've talked to them, but they're not giving me a quick answer.

lines.textCh: 就知道你靠得住。
lines.textEn: Never doubted you.

lines.textCh: 好，我会和他们谈的。
lines.textEn: Alright, I'll try talking to them.

lines.textCh: 或许下次再说成吗？现在不行。
lines.textEn: Perhaps some other time, okay? Not right now.

lines.textCh: 又遇到麻烦了，是吧？
lines.textEn: So you're having troubles again, yeah?

lines.textCh:
你知道吗？你帮了我这么长时间，我还没有让你了解整件事情的全貌呢。所以现在是这样：我和 Skier 合作，替他送货，有时候也会被拉去加入他的其他行动。一开始我们合作得还算愉快，也还算得上是个赚钱的好差事，但是现在这个混蛋使唤我不带停的，就好像我是他家养的运货牲口一样！

他似乎发现我已经厌倦了这一切，之前那件事就是他带着他的小混混干的，把我的营地搬空，要给我点教训。我不会再忍受这一切了，要是能有办法，我早就踹开他了。但是在这之前，我需要有其他人为我提供安全和生意上的保障。既然你和其他商人有联系，你能帮我美言几句吗？事到如今我们应该能算半个朋友了吧，你能帮忙吗？
lines.textEn:
You know, you've been helping me out for a while now, and I haven't even brought you up to speed with this whole situation. So, I'm working with Skier now. I deliver his goods, and sometimes I'm involved in his operations. At first it was a nice lucrative gig, but now this asshole won't let me off the hook for even a second. He thinks I'm his personal fucking mule now!

He seems to have found out somehow that I'm tired of all this, and now he's brought his punks to my base to teach me a lesson. I'm not gonna put up with this shit anymore. I'd leave him a long time ago, but I do need protection and guarantees, you know. And since you're in contact with other traders, you could put in a good word for me. Can you help a friend out?

lines.textCh: 太好了！我会等着的。
lines.textEn: Cool! I'll be waiting.

lines.textCh:
好吧，这种情况多少在我的预想之中。

但关键在于，我们已经有了个好的开始。现在我真的有机会能摆脱那个混蛋了。
lines.textEn:
Yeah, well, I was kinda expecting that.

But the key is that we've made a start. Now I have a real chance of getting away from this shithead.

lines.textCh: 太棒了！完事了就回来找我吧。
lines.textEn: Amazing! Come back when you're finished.

lines.textCh: 都搞定了。我照你说的做了。
lines.textEn: All done. I did what you asked.

lines.textCh: 就知道你靠得住。
lines.textEn: Never doubted you.

lines.textCh: 听起来很简单。我来搞定。
lines.textEn: Sounds easy enough. I'll handle it.

lines.textCh: 或许下次再说成吗？现在不行。
lines.textEn: Perhaps some other time, okay? Not right now.

lines.textCh: 你那边有什么进展吗？
lines.textEn: Any progress on your end?

lines.textCh:
你的朋友答应好的援助迟迟未到，我这边的补给可是已经要用完了——自从那群混混洗劫我的营地之后，我就一直攒不下什么东西。如果再不想办法的话，装甲车马上就要没有燃料了。我找到个可能会有燃料的地方，但是我得需要你的帮助才行。

你知道本地的那群走私者吗？他们在“蔚蓝海岸”疗养院旁有一处前哨站，放几个空油桶到那里，他们会帮忙把桶灌满。不过回程就不用你费心了，他们会派自己的人送货。你会帮我吗？
lines.textEn:
Your friends are still taking their time, and I'm already running low on supplies because of that depot attack. I'm gonna run out of fuel if I don't do something. I found a place to get fuel, but I need your help.

You know the local smugglers? They got a base near the Azure Coast. That's where you gotta drop off some gas cans. They'll fill me some fuel in return. But I think we can handle that part without you. They'll send their own people. So, you in?

lines.textCh: 太好了！我会等着的。
lines.textEn: Cool! I'll be waiting.

lines.textCh: 太好了，至少现在这辆宝贝不会趴窝在荒郊野外了。谢谢你，朋友！
lines.textEn: Perfect. At least now the baby won't die in the middle of a random field. Thank you, friend!

lines.textCh: 太棒了！完事了就回来找我吧。
lines.textEn: Amazing! Come back when you're finished.

lines.textCh: 我的活干完了，该给报酬了。
lines.textEn: My job's done. Time to pay up.

lines.textCh: 就知道你靠得住。
lines.textEn: Never doubted you.

lines.textCh: 听起来很简单。我来搞定。
lines.textEn: Sounds easy enough. I'll handle it.

lines.textCh: 或许下次再说成吗？现在不行。
lines.textEn: Perhaps some other time, okay? Not right now.

lines.textCh: Ragman 说了，他愿意出手帮忙，但肯定不是白帮的。他想让你告诉他几条独家路线，好让他的手下运货。
lines.textEn: Ragman said he's ready to help but not for free. Said he wants you to share some routes for his convoys.

lines.textCh:
所以，你说 Ragman 在找新的送货路线是吗？我现在也在想同样的事情，毕竟 Skier 那个滑头肯定不会轻易把我放走。有条路线 Ragman 可能确实用得上，虽然我的 BTR 开不过去，但是在我还靠两条腿乱跑的那会，我可是经常从那里偷偷溜过封锁线。

你知道悬崖边那个村子吗？ 有很多小屋的那个。你可以从其中一户人家的后院往上爬，然后沿着岩壁间的缝隙一直走。然后，你就到了那些富人的房子，但是路过那里你得小心，周围相当危险，有一回听到有人在说外语，吓得我撒腿就跑。

在塔科夫，根本就没有绝对保险的路。所以我想这条路总比没有好，做完标记后一定要回来找我，我会用我的地图再检查一遍，以保万无一失。
lines.textEn:
So Ragman's looking for new routes, you say? I'm thinking about that myself right now, since Skier won't let me go so easily. But there is one option that Ragman could use. I won't pass on my BTR through there, but when I was a puny pedestrian, I used to sneak around there often.

You know the village by the cliffs where the cottages are? You can go up from one of the backyards, and then follow the crevice. Then, you reach those wealthy houses, you'll have to be on guard over there.

There are no truly safe roads left, so I guess this one's better than nothing. Just make sure you come back to me when you've marked it, I'll double check it with my maps just to be sure.

lines.textCh: 太好了！我会等着的。
lines.textEn: Cool! I'll be waiting.

lines.textCh:
我觉得你应该是找对地方了，虽然我自己对那里的细节记得也不是很清楚了……

但是悬崖上毕竟没有第二条路了，所以应该就是这里。
lines.textEn:
I think you got it all right. Honestly, I don't remember the details very well...

But there was no other such path in the cliffs, so yeah, it's all good.

lines.textCh: 太棒了！完事了就回来找我吧。
lines.textEn: Amazing! Come back when you're finished.

lines.textCh: 已经完事儿了？干得不错。
lines.textEn: Done already? Nice working with you.

lines.textCh: 这是你要的东西。下回别指望我替你背这种东西来。
lines.textEn: Here's your stuff. This is the last time I'm doing tank battery delivery. Surely.

lines.textCh: 就知道你靠得住。
lines.textEn: Never doubted you.

lines.textCh: 给。
lines.textEn: Here.

lines.textCh: 正是我要的，谢啦！
lines.textEn: Just what I wanted. Thank you!

lines.textCh: 搬那种东西非得把腰折了不可……算了，我去找找看。
lines.textEn: Breaking my back for you... Okay, I'll figure it out.

lines.textCh: 免了，上回我找到一块那种电池，结果花了几个小时才爬回藏身处。抱歉，但我不打算再爬一次。
lines.textEn: Yeah no. One time I had to crawl for several hours with a battery like that. Sorry, but I'm not doing this.

lines.textCh: 情况怎么样？都还好吗？
lines.textEn: How are things? All good?

lines.textCh:
你那边的谈判究竟怎么样了？我的意思是，我知道 Prapor 需要时间考虑，但是我真的没有时间了！你在外头牵线搭桥的时候，我这里还得正常过活啊！当然，只是有点急躁，没有怪你的意思。

我现在连备用电池都没有了，车上的电子设备随时可能会罢工。就算是坦克电池也行啊——虽然型号不对，但是总归能让我的 BTR 用上电。

你能帮我找一块坦克电池来吗？要是没了电，我这也基本算是完了。
lines.textEn:
How are the negotiations progressing? I mean, I understand that Prapor needs to mull it over first, but I'm running out of time! Gotta survive somehow while you're building bridges. No complaints against you, obviously.

I don't even have any spare batteries now, and electronics can go to shit at any moment. I could even do with a tank battery right now, I might be able to make it work with my BTR.

You think you can find one of those? Because without it, it's over for me.

lines.textCh: 太好了！我会等着的。
lines.textEn: Cool! I'll be waiting.

lines.textCh: 不错。谢了！
lines.textEn: Well done. Thanks!

lines.textCh: 真是个大家伙！希望你把它搬来的路上没费太大功夫。放在这就行了，你为我做了这么多事，我这辈子都不会忘记的。谢谢你！
lines.textEn: That's a big one! I hope it wasn't too much of a hassle. Alright, just leave it right here. You're doing a lot of work for me, and I won't forget it. Thank you.

lines.textCh: 太棒了！完事了就回来找我吧。
lines.textEn: Amazing! Come back when you're finished.

lines.textCh: 已经完事儿了？干得不错。
lines.textEn: Done already? Nice working with you.

lines.textCh: 这是你要的东西。下回别指望我替你背这种东西来。
lines.textEn: Here's your stuff. This is the last time I'm doing tank battery delivery. Surely.

lines.textCh: 就知道你靠得住。
lines.textEn: Never doubted you.

lines.textCh: 给。
lines.textEn: Here.

lines.textCh: 正是我要的，谢啦！
lines.textEn: Just what I wanted. Thank you!

lines.textCh: 搬那种东西非得把腰折了不可……算了，我去找找看。
lines.textEn: Breaking my back for you... Okay, I'll figure it out.

lines.textCh: 免了，上回我找到一块那种电池，结果花了几个小时才爬回藏身处。抱歉，但我不打算再爬一次。
lines.textEn: Yeah no. One time I had to crawl for several hours with a battery like that. Sorry, but I'm not doing this.

lines.textCh: 情况怎么样？都还好吗？
lines.textEn: How are things? All good?

lines.textCh:
你那边的谈判究竟怎么样了？我的意思是，我知道 Ragman 需要时间考虑，但是我真的没有时间了！你在外头牵线搭桥的时候，我这里还得正常过活啊！当然，只是有点急躁，没有怪你的意思。

我现在连备用电池都没有了，车上的电子设备随时可能会罢工。就算是坦克电池也行啊——虽然型号不对，但是总归能让我的 BTR 用上电。

你能帮我找一块坦克电池来吗？要是没了电，我这也基本算是完了。
lines.textEn:
How are the negotiations progressing? I mean, I understand that Ragman needs to mull it over first, but I'm running out of time! Gotta survive somehow while you're building bridges. No complaints against you, obviously.

I don't even have any spare batteries now, and electronics can go to shit at any moment. I could even do with a tank battery right now, I might be able to make it work with my BTR.

You think you can find one of those? Because without it, it's over for me.

lines.textCh: 太好了！我会等着的。
lines.textEn: Cool! I'll be waiting.

lines.textCh: 不错。谢了！
lines.textEn: Well done. Thanks!

lines.textCh: 真是个大家伙！希望你把它搬来的路上没费太大功夫。放在这就行了，你为我做了这么多事，我这辈子都不会忘记的。谢谢你！
lines.textEn: That's a big one! I hope it wasn't too much of a hassle. Alright, just leave it right here. You're doing a lot of work for me, and I won't forget it. Thank you.

lines.textCh: 太棒了！完事了就回来找我吧。
lines.textEn: Amazing! Come back when you're finished.

lines.textCh: 已经完事儿了？干得不错。
lines.textEn: Done already? Nice working with you.

lines.textCh: 来，这是你要的东西。
lines.textEn: Here you go. Hope that's what you're looking for.

lines.textCh: 就知道你靠得住。
lines.textEn: Never doubted you.

lines.textCh: 给。
lines.textEn: Here.

lines.textCh: 正是我要的，谢啦！
lines.textEn: Just what I wanted. Thank you!

lines.textCh: 好，我会帮忙的。
lines.textEn: Alright, I'm in.

lines.textCh: 或许下次再说成吗？现在不行。
lines.textEn: Perhaps some other time, okay? Not right now.

lines.textCh: Skier 那边的情况怎么样？
lines.textEn: How are things with Skier?

lines.textCh:
你身后没跟着探子吧？Skier 肯定在谋划些什么东西。现在我在 BTR 里都睡不安稳了！但是现在还不能退缩，我已经着手建造新的营地，这一回我要把它打造得固若金汤。

有人愿意为我提供一套像样的电子干扰系统。我已经付清了货款，只差把包裹交给我了。他们选了一个不寻常的地方交货：森林里的墓地。虽然不大，但你会找到的。附近到处都是担架和尸体

你能从交货点帮我把包裹拿来吗？但不要从这里直接过去，会被其他人发现的。回你的藏身处喘口气，然后再去那个地方。我担不起货物被人发现的风险。
lines.textEn:
You weren't being tailed, were you? Skier is definitely up to something. I'm even afraid to sleep in the BTR now! But I can't back down now. I've started setting up a new base, and this time I want to build a solid defense.

Someone's willing to provide me with a decent electronic jamming system. We've already settled the payment, it's just a matter of delivering the package to me. They picked an unusual place for the transfer: a cemetery in the forest. It's not big, but you'll find it no problem. There's a stretcher and bodies lying around near it.

Can you get the package from the stash? Oh, but don't go straight there from here. Go to your base, take a breather, and then go to the stash from there. Can't let anyone find out about my new purchase.

lines.textCh: 太好了！我会等着的。
lines.textEn: Cool! I'll be waiting.

lines.textCh: 不错。谢了！
lines.textEn: Well done. Thanks!

lines.textCh:
谢谢你！现在终于能有个安心睡觉的地方了。

这下就算是那种嗡嗡响的巡飞弹也没法威胁到我的营地了，至于地面上，雷区应该足够挡住他们了。我把一切防御设施都隐蔽起来了，看他们还敢不敢来偷我的东西！
lines.textEn:
Thank you! At least now I have a place to sleep.

Nothing will come down from above now. And on the ground, the landmines should stop them. I've covered everything. Let's see them looting my spare parts again!

lines.textCh: 太棒了！完事了就回来找我吧。
lines.textEn: Amazing! Come back when you're finished.

lines.textCh: 事情办完了，我这里一切就绪。
lines.textEn: Here about the job. Everything's done on my end.

lines.textCh: 就知道你靠得住。
lines.textEn: Never doubted you.

lines.textCh: 哦，我可是爱死了提着头去搞这种排爆任务。算了，我会去办的。
lines.textEn: Oh man, I love life-threatening EOD missions. Alright, I'll do it.

lines.textCh: 我现在帮不了你。
lines.textEn: I cannot help you right now.

lines.textCh: 你搞清楚 Skier 都在计划什么了没？
lines.textEn: Have you figured out what Skier is planning?

lines.textCh:
我对 Skier 的猜想果然是对的。这个家伙不只是想要插手我的生意，他甚至想把我的 BTR 给炸毁！看样子他已经从别的地方搞来了一大批 RPG 火箭筒。 

就算 Skier 帮派里的那些蠢货大字都不识一个，只能抱着火箭筒乱打，那我们的处境还是好不到哪去。只要他们准备的弹药足够多，就算第一发打不中，难道第十发还能让我们给躲过去吗？不过，我可能真猜到了 Skier 那帮人存放火箭弹的地点。既然时间已经过去了这么久，那他们一定已经走到设置埋伏阵地那一步了。

在城市里，他们也许能做到神出鬼没，但森林可是我们的主场。直接跟着我的常规路线一路排查，看看哪里最有可能用来发动伏击就行。

找到那些装着火箭弹的箱子，给那些混蛋留点意外之喜。等他们来取弹药的时候，就有这帮人好受的了。
lines.textEn:
I was right about Skier. He's not just trying to interrupt my work, he's trying to fucking destroy the BTR! Looks like somebody supplied him with a big load of RPG rockets. 

Those knuckle-dragging idiots can't even shoot it properly, but so what? With enough ammo, they'll take me down if not on the first, then on the tenth attempt. However, I might have an idea where Skier is storing these rockets. Plenty of time's passed, they've already organized their firing positions, I'm sure of it.

They could be anywhere in the city, but in the forest we may be able to find all of their positions. Just follow my usual driving route and check all the places they might use to ambush me.

Find the rocket crates and leave some presents for those fuckers. Let them have an explosive surprise when they come for their ammo.

lines.textCh: 太好了！我会等着的。
lines.textEn: Cool! I'll be waiting.

lines.textCh: 太壮观了！最后一声爆炸直到 20 分钟前才停下。现在这个 Skier 滑头手里没牌了，下次再想威胁我可就没那么容易了。
lines.textEn: Magnificent! I think I heard one explosion about 20 minutes ago already. Now this bitch Skier will think twice before threatening me.

lines.textCh: 太棒了！完事了就回来找我吧。
lines.textEn: Amazing! Come back when you're finished.

lines.textCh: 我按照你说的做了，每一步都准确无误。
lines.textEn: I did everything you asked. Strictly as instructed.

lines.textCh: 就知道你靠得住。
lines.textEn: Never doubted you.

lines.textCh: 要做的事情还真多……我会尽力圆满完成的。
lines.textEn: That's... a lot. I'll try not to mess it up.

lines.textCh: 我现在帮不了你。
lines.textEn: I cannot help you right now.

lines.textCh: Ragman 联系你了吗？要是没有旁人帮忙，光靠我们自己可撑不了多久。
lines.textEn: Has Ragman contacted you yet? We won't last long without help.

lines.textCh:
我们挫败了 Skier 的阴谋，但我告诉你，现在是我们唯一的机会，不能错失良机。

等到他重新恢复实力后，他绝对会把我盯得死死的，到时候我们再想出什么招数都寸步难行了。所以我们现在就得想出一个反击的法子——现在我们都是同一根绳上的蚂蚱了！

听着，我已经想好计划了。只是整个方案实在是太复杂了，我不放心拜托给别人去做。 

我之前偶然深挖了一下 Skier 的背景，找到了不少劲爆黑料。这些消息如果落到对的人手里，那他就翻不了盘了。所有的东西都在那封信里，这是我们扳倒他的唯一希望。

你需要到海关去取，信就在建筑工地旁边那栋楼的顶层。就是紧靠铁路那边的楼，你一眼就能看到它，希望你不会找错地方。

然后从海关直接去储备基地，把信放在军队总部办公楼三楼，那个沙袋堆得像个堡垒一样的的窗口边上。 

整个计划的重中之重是要确保 Skier 的人不会截获这封信。因此，在你藏好那封信之后，你还得跑到 Priozersk 自然保护区大吵大闹一番。在干掉几个拾荒的制造足够多的动静之后，再去灯塔海边发射信号弹，来一个声东击西——注意得是黄色的，千万别弄混了！

最好在海边度假别墅的码头上和火车站的月台上分别打一颗，这样附近 Skier 据点里的人就会被吸引过来。在这一切搞完之后，快跑！ 

我把所有事项都写在了一张纸上，防止你中途搞砸。你要一气呵成搞定所有步骤，明白了吗？
lines.textEn:
We foiled Skier's plans, and I'll tell you this - we can't let this opportunity slip away.

When he recovers, he will never let me out of his sight. That's why we need to think of a defensive plan now, because you and I are both going to get nailed!

So listen, I've got a plan all worked out. Except I don't have anybody else I'd trust to do something this complex. 

I was able to dig up some background intel on Skier. The kind of information that could compromise him real bad if it fell into the right hands. It's all in this letter, and it's our guarantee.

You need to pick it up at the customs area. The letter will be on the top floor of the building by the construction site. You know, the one near the railroad platform, you'll see it. Hopefully.

From there, go straight to the reserve base and leave it in the headquarters on the third floor, at the fortified point with windows. 

The key is to make sure that Skier's men don't intercept the letter. That is why after stashing the letter, run to Priozersk and make some noise. After you kill a couple of Scavs, go to the lighthouse peninsula and shoot a flare. You need a yellow one, don't get it mixed up!

The best place to do it is on the pier at the vacation houses and on the platform at the train station, it'll distract the guys from Skier's nearest base. After that, you run out of there! 

I've written all the instructions on a piece of paper to make sure you don't fuck it up. You gotta do it all at once, you understand?

lines.textCh: 太好了！我会等着的。
lines.textEn: Cool! I'll be waiting.

lines.textCh:
我去！你真的搞成了！你是这么多人里唯一一个肯替我撑腰的。最重要的是，我们甚至把后路都准备好了。 

虽然以后也会很难，但起码 Ragman 同意出手帮忙，那封信应该也会有用。我不会忘记你的恩情的，记得常来坐坐，朋友！
lines.textEn:
Ho-ly shit! You did it! You're the only one to stick up for me. What's most important is that we've already prepared the stage. 

It won't be easy, but Ragman promised to help, and the letter ought to work too. I won't forget all the help you've given me. Drop by often, friend.

lines.textCh: 太棒了！完事了就回来找我吧。
lines.textEn: Amazing! Come back when you're finished.

lines.textCh: 我按照你说的做了，每一步都准确无误。
lines.textEn: I did everything you asked. Strictly as instructed.

lines.textCh: 就知道你靠得住。
lines.textEn: Never doubted you.

lines.textCh: 要做的事情还真多……我会尽力圆满完成的。
lines.textEn: That's... a lot. I'll try not to mess it up.

lines.textCh: 我现在帮不了你。
lines.textEn: I cannot help you right now.

lines.textCh: Prapor 联系你了吗？要是没有旁人帮忙，光靠我们自己可撑不了多久。
lines.textEn: Has Prapor contacted you yet? We won't last long without help.
