lines.textCh: 太棒了！完事了就回来找我吧。
lines.textEn: Amazing! Come back when you're finished.

lines.textCh: 已经完事儿了？干得不错。
lines.textEn: Done already? Nice working with you.

lines.textCh: 顺便一问：你听说过疗养院地下设施以及钥匙卡的任何消息吗？
lines.textEn: By the way, I wanted to ask you: have you heard anything about the facility under the health resort and the keycards to access it?

lines.textCh: 就知道你靠得住。
lines.textEn: Never doubted you.

lines.textCh: 给。
lines.textEn: Here.

lines.textCh: 正是我要的，谢啦！
lines.textEn: Just what I wanted. Thank you!

lines.textCh: 你昨天没喝到“样品”就挂了。给，Ragman 让我把这个带给你，让你亲自试喝。
lines.textEn: You didn't make it to the "test sample" yesterday. Here, Ragman asked me to give it to you so that you could test it yourself.

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 你居然还能开车？Ragman 喝了一晚上之后都快站不起来了。
lines.textEn: How are you even operational right now? Ragman's barely standing straight after yesterday.

lines.textCh:
我昨天在一场友好的碰头会上高估了自己的酒量。别担心，之前更糟的情况我也挺过来了。有一次我实在是喝废了，连挡位都找不到在哪。然后我想了个法子，用绷带把手捆在档把上，不就能继续开了吗？哈哈！发明精神可是和机器打交道的必备美德！

Ragman 要检查货物质量，在这方面我可是见多识广。不过这可是我有生以来头一回记不得最后有没有尝他的样品了。不管怎么样，我和他总是可以再聚一次。放着这么好的夜景不喝大酒可是太浪费了，我觉得你也会喜欢这种感觉的！

不过还是得说一句，你碰到 Ragman 的时候最好还是和他提一嘴私酒的事情，我之前答应过要帮他的，但喝大了之后也没搞清楚帮没帮成。
lines.textEn:
I miscalculated my abilities yesterday at a friendly get-together. Don't worry, we've sailed in worse storms than this. One time I was so wasted I couldn't find the gearbox in this thing. So I tied my hand to the lever with a bandage! Inventiveness is the main principle for a machinist!

Ragman needed to check some goods, and I'm a veteran in this field. Except I can't remember, for the life of me, whether we finally got to his test sample or not. Well, whatever. If it's so important, we can get together again. Such an evening is a sin not to do again, I know you'd like it too!

But still, if you need to visit Ragman, ask him about the moonshine, I promised I'd help him. And now I don't even know if I did help him or not.

lines.textCh: 太好了！我会在这儿等着。
lines.textEn: Cool! I'll be waiting.

lines.textCh: 不错。谢了！
lines.textEn: Well done. Thanks!

lines.textCh:
你确定就是这个吗？嗯，我能闻到酒香，就是这个味！ 

Ragman 昨天把疗养院地下牢房的事情告诉我了，喋喋不休的，我甚至得把他灌上一轮才勉强岔开话题。反正疗养院下面是个苏联时期的防空洞，然后竞技场裁判准备在那里举办角斗，仅限 VIP 观众入场的那种。我猜他们还把 Tagilla 给抓来了，不，应该是别的什么东西。

那反正，为了搞这个竞技场的东西，裁判从 Ragman 那定了一大批装备，一切都筹备得差不多了。结果主持人一下子出局了。什么情况？鬼才知道。

Ragman 对这个计划打了水漂还是很介意的。但他应该已经交付了部分装备，并且肯定用过你正在找的那些钥匙卡。具体细节你最好还是问他本人，昨天的事情我已经有点想不起来了。顺便一提，谢谢你的酒。
lines.textEn:
Are you sure this is it? Okay, I can smell it, that's definitely the one! 

Ragman told me about the health resort's cellars yesterday, I even had to fucking get him wasted so we could finally change the subject. Anyway, there was a Soviet bomb shelter under the health resort, and Ref was going to organize a new arena there, for VIP audiences. I think it also involved Tagilla somehow... No, it was something else...

Anyway, for this arena, Ref organized a big gear acquisition from Ragman, everything was almost ready. And then our host guy suddenly backed out. Why? Who the fuck knows.

Ragman was really upset that the idea had fallen through. But he'd already delivered some of the gear, and he definitely used those keycards you're looking for. You better ask him yourself, I don't remember much from yesterday. Thanks for the drink, by the way.

lines.textCh: 附近似乎刚刚爆发了一场恶战，也许该去探查一番，为那些无处安息的灵魂祈祷。
lines.textEn: There was a battlefield nearby. It's worth investigating it and praying for the unresting souls.

lines.textCh: 是一匹死马……走近些看看吧。
lines.textEn: It's a dead horse... It's worth examining it closer.

lines.textCh: 先小心地检查一遍鸟巢。
lines.textEn: Examine the nest carefully first.

lines.textCh: 没法再前进了！什么梯子，去他的吧！
lines.textEn: You can’t go on! Screw this ladder!

lines.textCh: 也许还是瞧瞧周围不那么高的地方。就算你看到了什么有意思的东西，也不意味着就该冒险爬到那么高的地方。
lines.textEn: Perhaps it’s worth checking something not too high up. You won’t have to climb if you notice something interesting.

lines.textCh: 或者试着把那扇门给打开？……
lines.textEn: Or try opening that door?..

lines.textCh: 还是返回神庙废墟一探究竟吧。
lines.textEn: It's worth returning to the temple ruins.

lines.textCh: 是时候上路前往塔格勒了。
lines.textEn: Time to head to Targrad.

lines.textCh: 是时候出发前往塔格勒了。
lines.textEn: Time to set out for Targrad.

lines.textCh: 翻找鸟巢里的东西。
lines.textEn: Rummage through the nest.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 你一直热爱冒险，这点不便根本难不倒你。
lines.textEn: You’ve always loved adventuring, and small hardships never bothered you.

lines.textCh: 出发上路。
lines.textEn: Set out on the road.

lines.textCh: 战场更吸引你。
lines.textEn: The battlefield draws you more.

lines.textCh: 在抬头前，似乎应该先看看周围还有什么。
lines.textEn: It seems right to inspect everything at eye level first.

lines.textCh: 战场也许会有什么有意思的东西。
lines.textEn: The battlefield could hold something interesting.

lines.textCh: 你捂着被蛇咬伤的手，取回钥匙缓缓爬下。没有必要再把梯子放回去了，就让它留在原处吧，或许还能帮上别人的忙。钥匙已在手中，现在该看看这把钥匙能开启哪扇门了。
lines.textEn: Cradling your bitten hand, you retrieve the key and slowly climb down. You won’t return the ladder to its place. Let it stay for whoever else might need it. The key is in your hands. Now to see what it opens.

lines.textCh: 你快速爬下梯子。没有必要再把梯子放回去了，就让它留在原处吧，或许还能帮上别人的忙。钥匙已在手中，现在该看看这把钥匙能开启哪扇门了。
lines.textEn: You quickly climb down. You won’t return the ladder to its place. Let it stay for whoever else might need it. The key is in your hands. Now to see what it opens.

lines.textCh: 把它放在原地。
lines.textEn: Leave it here, where it belongs.

lines.textCh: 附近似乎刚刚爆发了一场恶战，也许战场上有什么值得趁着白天探索的东西。
lines.textEn: There was a battlefield nearby. It's worth investigating it in daylight.

lines.textCh: 最好还是待在楼上吧。万一在黑暗中摔断了腿可就呼救无门了。
lines.textEn: Perhaps it's best to stay up here. You don’t want to break your legs.

lines.textCh: 值得再仔细检查一遍所有东西。
lines.textEn: It’s worth examining everything more closely.

lines.textCh: 不，什么都不值得你浪费时间。是时候出发去塔格勒了。
lines.textEn: No, nothing will. Not worth wasting time. Time to head to Targrad.

lines.textCh: 直接爬上墙就是了。这堵墙看着还算结实，用断砖当垫脚石也不会太费劲。能出什么问题呢？
lines.textEn: Climb straight along the wall. It looks solid enough, and the broken sections even resemble steps somewhat. What could go wrong?

lines.textCh: 快点蹲下，恢复身体平衡！
lines.textEn: Crouch down as quickly as possible to regain balance!

lines.textCh: 呼喊求助！
lines.textEn: Call for help!

lines.textCh: 梯子就在眼前！但你不想撕破衣服。你决定还是徒手攀爬上去。
lines.textEn: The ladder was so close! But you don’t want to tear your clothes. You’ll climb up without it.

lines.textCh: 看起来需要一把钥匙才能开门。
lines.textEn: Seems like it needs a key.

lines.textCh: 还是更仔细地四周观察观察吧。
lines.textEn: Need to look around more carefully.

lines.textCh: 也许该看看屋顶，或许上面会有什么有趣的东西。
lines.textEn: It's worth checking the roof. Maybe there’s something interesting there.

lines.textCh: 得为逝者祈祷。
lines.textEn: Need to pray for the dead.

lines.textCh: 还是先仔细检查一遍尸体。
lines.textEn: Examine the bodies more closely first.

lines.textCh: 他们选择了自己的命运。
lines.textEn: They chose their own fate.

lines.textCh: 将戒指留在原地。
lines.textEn: Leave the ring with the dead man.

lines.textCh: 快速检查一遍那匹死马。
lines.textEn: Quickly examine the dead horse.

lines.textCh: 你不会插手。
lines.textEn: You wouldn't interfere.

lines.textCh: 最后再看一眼神庙。
lines.textEn: Take one last look at the temple ruins.

lines.textCh: 是时候继续上路了。
lines.textEn: Time to move on.

lines.textCh: 天气十分宜人，但路途相当艰难。你的伤口隐隐作痛，但还是能坚持下去。如果能捱到傍晚时分应该会好些，或者你会在塔格勒多停留几天休养生息。
lines.textEn: The weather is lovely, but walking is hard. Your scratches ache, but overall, you manage. By evening, it should feel better. Perhaps you’ll stay in Targrad a couple of days to recover.

lines.textCh:
你把梯子靠在倾颓的墙边。梯子的高度刚好能够到鸟巢。你用一只脚踏上梯子的第一级，想要试试它能否承担你的体重。梯子嘎吱作响，但稳稳地支撑着你的身体。
你小心翼翼地爬上梯子。终于，鸟巢就在眼前了。
lines.textEn:
You prop the ladder against the partially ruined wall. It’s just high enough to reach the nest. Testing its stability, you place your foot on the first rung and shift your weight. The ladder creaks, but holds.
You climb cautiously but determinedly. Finally, the nest is in front of you.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 直接爬上墙就是了。这堵墙看着还算结实，用断砖当垫脚石也不会太费劲。能出什么问题呢？
lines.textEn: Climb straight along the wall. It looks solid enough, and the broken sections even resemble steps somewhat. What could go wrong?

lines.textCh:
你环顾四周，这次将目光聚焦在墙壁上。既然手中已经有了钥匙，那么四周一定有能用钥匙打开的门。
沿着墙边行走时，你感受到了脚下绵软的草丛。远处有鸟儿啁啾，但在倾颓的屋顶下，穿堂风呼啸而入。
终于，你发现了一扇几乎完全被藤曼掩盖的门。
lines.textEn:
You look around, focusing on the walls this time. With the key, there must be a door somewhere.
Walking along the walls, grass springs softly under your feet. Birds sing in the distance. The wind howls beneath the broken ceiling.
Finally, you spot a door, almost completely hidden by ivy.

lines.textCh:
你环顾四周，这次将目光聚焦在墙壁上。既然手中已经有了钥匙，那么四周一定有能用钥匙打开的门。
沿着墙边行走时，你感受到了脚下绵软的草丛。远处有鸟儿啁啾，但在倾颓的屋顶下，穿堂风呼啸而入。
终于，你发现了一扇几乎完全被藤曼掩盖的门。
lines.textEn:
You look around, focusing on the walls this time. With the key, there must be a door somewhere.
Walking along the walls, grass springs softly under your feet. Birds sing in the distance. The wind howls beneath the broken ceiling.
Finally, you spot a door, almost completely hidden by ivy.

lines.textCh: 你睁开了眼睛。四周绿意盎然；残破的古老神庙高悬于头顶。尽管匆忙睡了一觉，你却感觉没有休息好，全身依然酸痛。你伸展双臂，心想这终究不是自己熟悉的床铺，素日来的风雨兼程已经让“床”这个概念显得如此陌生。
lines.textEn: You open your eyes. All around you is greenery; The ruins of an ancient temple loom overhead. Your whole body aches after the restless sleep. You stretch your shoulders and think that you've gotten out of the habit of sleeping outside of a normal bed.

lines.textCh: 这一切很快就会结束，而你也将回归自己平静的生活。
lines.textEn: Soon this will all be over and you’ll return to your peaceful life.

lines.textCh: 你叹了一口气，环顾头顶的神庙废墟。只剩下大约一天的路程了。之后便是归途，还有应得的休憩。你开始怀念起修道院房间里那张窄窄的床铺。
lines.textEn: You sigh and look at the temple ruins ahead. Only about a day’s walk remains. After that, the road back home and some well-earned rest. You miss the narrow bed in your monastery cell.

lines.textCh: 你叹了一口气，环顾头顶的神庙废墟。只剩下大约一天的路程了，之后便要踏上归途。这段旅程终究还是太短了些，如果完全随心所欲的话，你恨不得一直流浪到世界尽头。但是你对教团的义务并非可以轻易推卸之事。
lines.textEn: You sigh and look at the temple ruins ahead. Only about a day’s walk remains, then the return journey. The trip feels far too short. If it were up to you, you’d wander endlessly. But your obligations to the Order are not something you can walk away from.

lines.textCh: 站起来。
lines.textEn: Stand up.

lines.textCh:
你站起身，深深地吸了一口气。不知怎的，你感觉身上的酸痛似乎一扫而空，精神焕发，准备好踏上前往城市的最后一程。
教团派你执行一项重要使命：将记载有神启的卷轴送到塔格勒市内。你不知道卷轴上都写着什么。好奇心在胸中燃烧，但违抗命令的恐惧终究战胜了好奇心：你只能在城市领主面前打开它。
lines.textEn:
You rise to your feet and take a deep breath. Surprisingly, you feel rested and ready to make the final push toward the city.
The Order sent you on an important mission: to deliver a divine revelation to Targrad. You don’t know what’s written in the scroll you were given. Curiosity burns at you, but the fear of disobedience is stronger. You can only open it before the city’s ruler.

lines.textCh:
你意识到，等会上路也来得及，为什么不四周看看呢？
神庙的废墟以古老的存在感和幽暗神秘的阴影吸引着你。你还记得来时路过一片战场。当时是黄昏时刻，你不敢靠近，但此时白昼已至，可以去探查一番。但又该从何处开始探索呢？
lines.textEn:
You realize you still have a little time. Why not take a look around?
The ruins of the temple beckon with their ancient presence and dark, mysterious shadows. You also remember passing a battlefield on the way here. At dusk you didn’t dare get too close, but now, in daylight, you can investigate it. Where should you begin your search?

lines.textCh: 环顾四周。
lines.textEn: Look around.

lines.textCh: 废墟里一定会有些有意思的东西。
lines.textEn: There’s bound to be something interesting in the ruins.

lines.textCh: 黑洞洞的窗户宛如空洞无神的眼窝，彩绘玻璃早已剥落，只有残存的窗棂仿佛在诉说往日的光彩。即使外面阳光普照，这里仍然透着几分寒意。奇怪的是，这寒意反而让你获得了些许平静。你明白这座圣地不会伤害你分毫。
lines.textEn: The dark window openings, long stripped of their stained glass, watch you like the eyes of some terrifying beast. Even in the sunlight, it’s cold around here. Strangely, it brings a sense of calm. You know this is sacred ground, it won’t harm you.

lines.textCh:
出乎你的意料，战场并非一片死寂——你总以为死亡经过之处必归于寂静，但自然界并不会为了谁而特意驻足哀悼。况且，又哀悼谁呢？那些因为些许怨恨就拔刀相向自相残杀的人？

你看到了尸体、撕碎的战旗，以及四处散落的武器。你用袖子捂住口鼻，试图掩盖住扑面而来的死亡气息。
lines.textEn:
The battlefield greets you with a hundred simultaneous sounds. You always thought where death had passed there would be silence, but nature has no time for mourning. Besides, mourning whom? People who kill each other over petty grievances?

You look at the bodies, broken banners, and fallen weapons. You press your sleeve to your nose and mouth to keep the stench of death from dizzying you.

lines.textCh: 你想抬头看看原本神庙屋顶该在的地方。
lines.textEn: You want to look up and see where the roof once was.

lines.textCh:
你带着几分奇异的虔诚抬起了头。头顶是一片密林，阳光只能勉强穿透经年累月长成的树冠，在地面上投下星星点点的光斑。这些树是否是从别处移植而来，最终突破了窠臼重新投向自然的怀抱？
神庙的屋顶已然坍塌，鸟儿在某些地方筑起了巢穴。凡是人造的，最终总会回归自然。你注意到其中一个鸟巢里闪着微光。
lines.textEn:
You tilt your head upward with a strange reverence. The sun barely pierces through the trees that have grown up around the temple over the years. Were they once part of a nature park and finally found freedom?
The temple’s roof has collapsed, and birds have built their nests in some places. Nature always reclaims what belongs to it. You notice a glint in one of the nests.

lines.textCh:
你走近仔细观察。残破的神庙在森林中显得格格不入，宛如曼妙女郎却偏偏长了一颗蛀牙一样刺眼。你意识到这地方曾经必定宏伟壮观。或许这里曾矗立着一整座修道院，而不仅仅是座教堂？
你的目光注意到一扇几乎完全被植物掩盖的门。
lines.textEn:
You look closer. The temple’s skeleton rises from the forest like rotten teeth in a beauty’s mouth. You realize the place must have been huge. Perhaps a monastery once stood here, not just a church?..
Your gaze is drawn to a door almost completely hidden by greenery.

lines.textCh: 只是一扇门而已，门后大概什么也没有。
lines.textEn: Just a normal door, probably leads nowhere.

lines.textCh: 无需在意，也许只是鸟见到什么亮闪闪的东西，然后把它带回了鸟巢里而已。
lines.textEn: Nothing special, maybe a bird dragged some shiny thingie to its chicks.

lines.textCh: 你轻蔑地哼了一声。为什么你会觉得鸟巢里能有什么有意思的东西呢？况且真要爬上去，势必要冒着相当大的风险，要想按时赶到塔格勒，至少身上零件得都在才行。不过，或许还有其他东西能吸引你的注意？
lines.textEn: You snort in disdain. Why did you even think something interesting could be there? Besides, it’s too risky to climb, and you need to reach Targrad with all your bones intact. But maybe something else will catch your attention?

lines.textCh: 门大概已经被封死了。你决定没必要在这种事情上浪费时间，你有更重要的使命要去完成。
lines.textEn: The door is probably locked anyway. You decide to not waste your time. You have more important matters.

lines.textCh: 这里大概没什么有意思的东西了。也许去战场附近转转？
lines.textEn: There’s probably nothing interesting here. Maybe the battlefield?

lines.textCh: 你走近了一些。眼前是一堵斑驳的砖墙，斑驳的壁画还残留着往日辉煌的痕迹。你环顾四周，规划爬上鸟巢的路线。乍看之下，有两种办法。
lines.textEn: You approach. In front of you is a wall of crumbling bricks, still showing traces of murals here and there. You glance around and plan your path toward the nest. At first glance, there are two options.

lines.textCh: 找一把梯子。附近的拾荒者应该不会把这种东西都捡走。
lines.textEn: Search for a ladder. Looters probably didn’t take it.

lines.textCh:
你在神庙四周绕了一圈，寻找趁手的工具。直接爬上去显然更省事，但墙砖已经摇摇欲坠，谁又知道整堵墙不会在你的脚下四分五裂呢？
终于，在一个阴凉的角落里，你看到了像是梯子的长影。但荆棘丛生的玫瑰丛挡住了你的去路。
lines.textEn:
You wander through the temple looking for something suitable. Climbing directly would be easier, but the brick is already crumbling. What if it collapses under your feet?
Finally, in a dark corner, you spot something resembling a ladder. But thorny rose bushes block your path.

lines.textCh: 看样子是别无选择了。我得穿过荆棘丛。
lines.textEn: Looks like I have no choice. I’ll go through the thorns.

lines.textCh:
你靠近灌木丛。纤细的嫩枝刺向你的肩膀。灌木后方，梯子若隐若现，仅露出顶端。这就是你的目标，你必须拿到它。
你深吸一口气，向前踏出一步，扑进荆棘丛中。
你躲开枝条，将它们拨开。身为信使，你的使命让你咬紧牙关，绝不发出一声痛呼。
lines.textEn:
You approach. Young, thin branches jab at your shoulders. Behind the bush, the ladder is barely visible, only its top. This is your goal. You must succeed.
Taking a deep breath, you step forward and dive into the thorns.
You dodge the branches, push them aside, and grit your teeth. Not a single cry of pain must escape your lips.

lines.textCh: 荆棘丛比想象中的要深许多。然而事已至此已经没有回头路了。荆棘撕裂了你的掌心，穿透衣衫刺进肩膀。你从未想过玫瑰丛竟会如此……凶猛。仿佛它正牢牢环抱着你，试图吮吸你的鲜血！
lines.textEn: The bush is bigger than you expected. There’s no turning back. Thorns tear at your palms and dig into your shoulders through your clothes. You never imagined rose bushes could be… aggressive. It’s as if it’s trying to drink your blood!

lines.textCh: 你不管不顾地继续前行。仿佛是察觉到了你不可动摇的意志，灌木丛屈服了。荆棘依然刺痛，而你在到达梯子面前时才发现鲜血正从掌心和裸露的脸颊流淌。你抓紧梯子，又扑回荆棘丛中。
lines.textEn: You push forward stubbornly. As if sensing your indomitable will, the bush gives way. The thorns still prick, but when you reach the ladder, you realize blood streams down your palms and exposed cheeks. You grab the ladder and dive back through the thorns.

lines.textCh: 归途似乎顺畅多了。没错，你的手和脸伤痕累累，衣服也破破烂烂，但你拿到了梯子。现在只需爬上梯子，就能触及鸟巢，看看巢中那个神秘的物件到底是什么。
lines.textEn: The return feels less destructive. Yes, your hands and face are scratched, and your clothes are worse for wear, but you have the ladder. Now it’s just a matter of climbing to the nest and the mysterious object inside.

lines.textCh:
没有什么可怕的——鸟巢是空的，于是你决定翻找一番。那闪闪发光的物体看似被一团碎屑覆盖着。你毫不畏惧地伸手探查鸟巢内部。
你的指尖触碰到一个温暖、光滑的……活物。你还没来得及抽手，受惊的蛇一口咬住了你的手。要不是意识到自己正在梯子上强忍住退缩的冲动，你早就一个后仰从梯子上摔下来了——正是这个念头救了你一命，倘若没能忍住，你也许会摔到地上粉身碎骨。
lines.textEn:
Nothing scares you. The nest is empty, so you decide to rummage through it. The shiny object is covered with debris. Fearlessly, you reach in to see what’s inside.
Your fingers touch something warm, smooth, and… alive. You don’t have time to pull back. A disturbed snake bites your hand. Only through sheer will do you avoid flinching or falling back. And rightly so — it could have cost you your life.

lines.textCh:
鸟巢似乎早已废弃。你小心翼翼地将手伸近：或许里面没有鸟儿，但谁知道会藏着什么危险的昆虫？你不想冒险——毕竟你刚从荆棘丛中跋涉而来。
你小心清理杂物，看见一条蛇。它柔韧的身体缠绕着一把钥匙。你庆幸自己没有鲁莽行事——不然，蛇很有可能会一口咬在你的手上。现在你可以在不伤害这条蛇的情况下取走钥匙了。
lines.textEn:
The nest seems long abandoned. You carefully move your hand closer. Maybe there aren’t any birds, but who knows what dangerous insect might hide there? You don’t want to take the risk, not after wading through the thorn bushes.
You carefully clear the debris and see a snake. Its flexible body has curled around a key. You’re glad you didn’t rush — otherwise, the snake would have bitten you. Now you can take the key without harming it.

lines.textCh:
蛇悄然溜走。你将被咬伤的手按在胸口，低声咒骂着。伤口刻骨铭心，你责备自己太过粗心。你决定下一次再也不能这么莽撞了。
你再次看向鸟巢，蛇原来盘踞的位置此刻只剩下一把钥匙。原来就是它吸引了你的注意力。
lines.textEn:
The snake slithers away. You press your bitten hand to your chest and mutter a curse under your breath. The pain is sharp, and you scold yourself for carelessness. Next time, you’ll surely be more careful.
Looking at the nest again, you see a now exposed key. That's what caught your eye from the ground.

lines.textCh: 你捂着被蛇咬伤的手，取回钥匙缓缓爬下。没有必要再把梯子放回去了，就让它留在原处吧，或许还能帮上别人的忙。钥匙已在手中，现在该看看能不能打开那扇门了。
lines.textEn: Cradling your bitten hand, you retrieve the key and slowly climb down. You won’t return the ladder to its place. Let it stay for whoever else might need it. The key is in your hands. Now to see if it fits that one door.

lines.textCh: 你快速爬下梯子。没有必要再把梯子放回去了，就让它留在原处吧，或许还能帮上别人的忙。钥匙已在手中，现在该看看能不能打开那扇门了。
lines.textEn: You quickly climb down. You won’t return the ladder to its place. Let it stay for whoever else might need it. The key is in your hands. Now to see if it fits that one door.

lines.textCh: 返回门旁。
lines.textEn: Return to the door.

lines.textCh: 再次查看神庙。
lines.textEn: Examine the temple one more time.

lines.textCh: 返回门旁。
lines.textEn: Return to the door.

lines.textCh: 再次查看神庙。
lines.textEn: Examine the temple one more time.

lines.textCh: 使用钥匙。
lines.textEn: Use the key.

lines.textCh: 使用钥匙。
lines.textEn: Use the key.

lines.textCh:
你拨开藤曼，找到钥匙孔。乍看之下钥匙似乎不合，但你还是试了试。
尽管多年过去了，锁早已生锈，钥匙却能转动。门吱呀一声打开。台阶通向黑暗深处。你只能看见楼梯的起点，其余部分仿佛被阴影吞噬。你既没有火把也没有灯。
lines.textEn:
You push the ivy aside and find the keyhole. At first glance, the key might not fit, but you try anyway.
After so many years, the lock is rusted, but the key turns. The door creaks open. Steps lead down into darkness. You see only the start of the staircase, the rest is swallowed by shadows. You have neither torch nor lamp.

lines.textCh: 仍然走下去。
lines.textEn: Go down anyway.

lines.textCh: 你缓缓拾级而下，毫无畏惧。走到一半时，你停下了脚步，试图让双眼适应黑暗。继而继续前行，借着阶梯的模糊轮廓指引方向。
lines.textEn: You descend slowly and fearlessly. Halfway down, you stop to let your eyes adjust. Then you continue, using the faint silhouettes of the steps to guide you.

lines.textCh: 终于，你来到一间狭小的房间。靠近天花板处，有一扇被树叶半遮掩着的窄窗，但透进的光线足以照亮中央的桌子，桌上放着一本书。
lines.textEn: Finally, you reach a tiny room. Near the ceiling, a narrow window is partially hidden by leaves, but enough light filters through to reveal a table in the center, and on it, a book.

lines.textCh: 拿上书。
lines.textEn: Take it with you.

lines.textCh:
你走近了一些。桌子和书本都蒙着厚厚的灰尘。想到这里已荒废多时，你的脊背不禁发凉：为什么有人会把书遗留在这座芜杂的地下牢房，这片被人遗忘之地？是有意藏匿这一不祥之物吗？
脑中萦绕着太多的问题，却没法想出合理的答案。你决定最好不要冒险。这本书在此沉睡多年，就让它再留片刻吧，直到下一个好奇的旅人到来。终究会有人拿走它的。
你重新上楼，回到了阳光下。
lines.textEn:
You step closer. The table and the book are covered in thick dust. A shiver runs down your spine at the thought of how long no one has been here. Why would anyone leave a book in a forgotten, godforsaken dungeon? Were they hiding it?
There are too many questions, and no answers. You decide not to risk it. The book has lain here for years, so let it stay a little longer, until the next curious traveler comes along. Someone will need it eventually.
You climb back to the sunlight.

lines.textCh:
你走近了一些。桌子和书本都蒙着厚厚的灰尘。想到这里已荒废多时，你的脊背不禁发凉：为什么有人会把书遗留在这座芜杂的地下牢房，这片被人遗忘之地？是有意把它藏匿起来吗？
你拿起那本书。尽管它已经在此静置多年，却丝毫未见时光流逝的痕迹。你用手拂过封面，擦去上面厚厚的尘埃。奇怪，这本书似乎没有书名。
你把书塞进背包。或许下次休息时可以读一读。
lines.textEn:
You step closer. The table and the book are covered in thick dust. A shiver runs down your spine at the thought of how long no one has been here. Why would anyone leave a book in a forgotten, godforsaken dungeon? Were they hiding it?
You pick up the book. Though it has sat here for ages, it feels untouched by time. You brush your hand over the cover, wiping away dust, but there is no title. Curious.
You tuck the book into your bag. Maybe at your next rest you can read it.

lines.textCh: 感觉在废墟里没有什么可做的了。是时候继续上路了。
lines.textEn: Now it feels like there’s nothing left to do in the ruins. It’s time to continue.

lines.textCh: 塔格勒的使命可不等人！是时候重新上路了。
lines.textEn: Targrad won’t wait! It's best to return to the road.

lines.textCh: 荆棘丛比想象中的要深许多。然而事已至此已经没有回头路了。荆棘撕裂了你的掌心，穿透衣衫刺进肩膀。你从未想过玫瑰丛竟会如此……凶猛。仿佛它正牢牢环抱着你，试图吮吸你的鲜血！
lines.textEn: The bush is bigger than you expected. There’s no turning back. Thorns tear at your palms and dig into your shoulders through your clothes. You never imagined rose bushes could be… aggressive. It’s as if it’s trying to drink your blood!

lines.textCh: 附近似乎刚刚爆发了一场恶战，也许该去探查一番，为陨落的灵魂而祈祷。
lines.textEn: There was a battlefield nearby. It's worth investigating it and praying for the souls of the fallen.

lines.textCh:
你不想浪费自己宝贵的时间。眼看着太阳越升越高，如果加快速度，也许能在日落前赶到塔格勒。
你收拾好行装，把所有东西装进简易背包里。路途可不等人。
lines.textEn:
You don’t want to waste your precious time. The sun rises higher and higher. If you hurry, you’ll reach Targrad before sunset.
You gather your belongings, packing everything into your simple backpack. The road doesn’t wait.

lines.textCh: 没错，是时候前往塔格勒了。说不定正有人焦急地等待这份卷轴呢。
lines.textEn: Yes, it’s time to head to Targrad. Someone is waiting for you there.

lines.textCh: 你把几样行李装进了帆布包里。一阵轻风拂过你的发梢。今天肯定会是顺利的一天，你已经准备好继续上路了。
lines.textEn: You pack your few belongings into a canvas bag. A light breeze ruffles your hair. The day promises to be excellent. You are ready to move forward.

lines.textCh: 这里真恶心，不值得你继续浪费时间。更何况塔格勒说不定还有人在等着你。
lines.textEn: It’s disgusting here. Not worth wasting time. Someone is waiting for you in Targrad.

lines.textCh: 你必须徒手攀爬到相当高的地方，但你确信自己能做到。你踏稳脚步，双手紧扒着砖缝，奋力向上攀爬。砖墙几乎完全掩盖在往年落叶与杂物之下。你必须全神贯注地向上攀登。
lines.textEn: You’ll have to climb high, but you’re confident you can manage it. You place your foot, grip with your hands, and pull yourself up. The brickwork is barely visible beneath last year’s leaves and other debris. You need to focus as you make your way upward.

lines.textCh: 你越爬越高。惊起了几只鸟儿，它们叽喳叫着，仿佛是在抗议你闯入自己的领地。你忍不住笑了一下，这简直轻而易举。你觉得自己担心过头了——这比当初看起来的要容易多了。
lines.textEn: You climb higher and higher. Disturbed birds take off, squawking in protest at your intrusion. You smile. There’s a light breeze here that doesn’t reach the ground. You think you worried for nothing—this is much easier than it looked.

lines.textCh:
你已经快爬到鸟巢的位置了。你微微抬起头，发现这里要么是第二层，要么曾经有过露台。如今墙面已经倾颓殆尽，但从这一高度俯瞰四周，眼前的景致令人忍不住屏住呼吸。
你欣喜地呼出一口气。微风拂过脸颊，鸟鸣在耳畔回荡。还有什么比这更像天堂呢？
你向前迈出一步，脚下砖块却突然碎裂。你瞬间失去了平衡。
lines.textEn:
Now you’re almost at the nest. You tilt your head and realize that a second floor or balcony once began here. The walls are gone now, so from this height you get a stunning view of the surroundings.
You exhale in delight. The wind brushes your cheeks, and birds sing around you. What could be more like paradise?
You take a step forward, but the brick under your foot crumbles unexpectedly. You lose your balance.

lines.textCh: 快抓住什么！
lines.textEn: Grab onto something immediately!

lines.textCh: 你确实努力了，但那些砖块早已被岁月腐蚀，在你脚下噼啪作响地碎裂崩塌。无论你如何挣扎，如何挥动双臂，终究还是惊恐地向一侧倒下。
lines.textEn: You try, really, but the bricks, long destroyed inside by time, crack and crumble beneath your feet. No matter what you do, how you move or wave your arms, you topple to the side.

lines.textCh:
你从墙上掉了下去。你喘着粗气，徒劳地试图自救。你的原始本能嘶吼着：一切都结束了；你却试图说服自己，不会有什么事的。但你看不见，自己正直直坠向一块锋利的碎石。
一秒后，伴随着一声脆响，你的脊柱断成了两截。你不知道那块石头砸到了什么地方，只感觉大事不好。
lines.textEn:
You fall. You gasp for air in a vain attempt to save yourself. Your primal instinct screams that this is the end; your mind tells you nothing terrible will happen. But you can’t see that you’re falling straight onto a sharp broken stone.
A second later, your spine snaps with a deafening crack. The stone breaks something. Something very important.

lines.textCh: 试着移动身体。
lines.textEn: Try to move.

lines.textCh: 你试着移动自己的胳膊与双腿，但什么也没有发生。尽管你祈祷着这一切都是暂时的错觉，但无论是五分钟后还是一个小时后，仍然没有任何改观。你感觉不到你的肢体了，现在的你只剩下头脑和眼睛还在转动。
lines.textEn: You try to move your arms and legs, but nothing responds. You hope it’s temporary, but neither after five minutes nor an hour does it get any better. You don’t feel your body, you can only move your head and eyes.

lines.textCh: 你试图呼救，却连气都喘不上来。恐慌席卷了全身：你的手脚已然麻木，身体其他部位更是失去了知觉。鸟儿栖在倒塌的墙上，用仿佛在嘲弄的目光注视着你。
lines.textEn: You try to cry out, but barely manage a breath. Panic washes over you. You can’t feel your hands or legs. Birds perch on the fallen wall, looking at you as if mocking.

lines.textCh:
你意识到没有人会前来搭救，甚至不会有人知道你瘫倒在这里。飞鸟将啄食你的眼珠，野兽将啃噬你的骸骨。你将长留此地，成为这座废弃神庙的无声守卫。
你的故事在此结束了。
lines.textEn:
You realize that no one will find you, no one will save you. Birds will peck your eyes, wild animals will gnaw your bones. You will remain here as the silent guardian of the abandoned temple.
Your story ends here.

lines.textCh: 你回到墙边，被蔷薇丛折磨得狼狈不堪却安然无恙。你没有其他衣服可供更换，你可不想在向塔格勒的领主复命时看起来像个衣衫褴褛的贫民。
lines.textEn: You return to the wall, humbled by the rose bushes but intact. You don’t have a change of clothes with you, and you don’t want to appear before the ruler of Targrad looking like a commoner.

lines.textCh:
你放弃了继续拿到梯子的努力。你在荆棘丛面前败下阵来：那些玫瑰丛完美执行了保卫梯子的任务。
你退后一步，挣脱荆棘的缠绕，暗自咒骂。此刻只有徒手攀上高墙这一条路了。
lines.textEn:
You give up. You’re defeated. The rose bushes have done their job guarding the ladder perfectly.
You step back, freeing yourself from the thorns, quietly cursing. There’s only one way left to climb.

lines.textCh:
你再次靠近。这里已经多年无人打理，石板地面已长满杂草，此刻几乎没过膝盖。苔藓与藤曼爬满墙壁。处处可见自然正在收回曾经属于它的领地。
你拨开柔韧的藤蔓，用力拉动门把手。门纹丝不动。
lines.textEn:
You approach again. Over the years without people here, grass has grown through the stone floor slabs, now reaching almost to your knees. Moss and ivy cover the walls. Everywhere you feel nature reclaiming what once belonged to it.
You push aside the flexible ivy stems and tug the handle. The door won’t budge.

lines.textCh: 再用点力说不定能成。
lines.textEn: Just need to pull harder.

lines.textCh: 你再次拉扯门把手，门依然纹丝不动。整座神庙都废弃了，为什么这扇门偏偏锁上了？！看来你确实需要找到钥匙。但它又能藏在哪呢？
lines.textEn: You tug the handle again. The door still won’t budge. Who even thought of locking something in a ruined temple?! It seems you really do need to find a key. But where could it be?

lines.textCh: 你决定不把精力浪费在徒劳的尝试上。门把手下方有个钥匙孔，所以你需要找到钥匙。但它又能藏在哪呢？
lines.textEn: You decide not to waste your strength on a pointless effort. There’s a keyhole under the handle, so you need to find a key. But where could it be?

lines.textCh: 该四处看看了。有那么一瞬间你觉得看到了什么东西……没错，就在上面！
lines.textEn: It’s worth looking around again. You think you saw something… Yes, up there!

lines.textCh: 你再次抬头望去。就在那个鸟巢里，你瞥见一道闪光。肯定是有只好奇的鸟把钥匙拖到那里去了！你得爬上去查个究竟。
lines.textEn: You look up again. There, in the nest, you spotted a glint. Surely a curious bird dragged a key up there! You need to climb and check.

lines.textCh: 你环顾四周，抬眼望去。残破的墙壁上四处爬满了藤曼，小花丛砖缝中探出，还有鸟巢。你注意到其中一个巢里闪着光芒。或许只是鸟儿把闪光的东西拖回自己的巢里而已，也许，钥匙就在那里！你得爬上去查个究竟。
lines.textEn: You look around, raising your gaze. On the broken walls are ivy, small flowers, bird nests. You notice a glint in one of them. Perhaps a bird stole a shiny object, or maybe an entire key! You need to get up there and check.

lines.textCh:
不，你的好奇心绝不会轻易被驯服。内心深处，你迫不及待想推开那扇门，一探究竟。里面会藏着宝藏吗？又或者是曾在此居住的修士们所留下的秘密记录？
你就是不愿承认，自己可能会发现的不过是个普通的扫帚间。
lines.textEn:
No, your curiosity won’t be tamed so easily. Inside you itch to open the door and see what’s behind it. Could there be treasures? Or secret records of monks who once lived here?
You just don’t want to think you might find an ordinary broom closet.

lines.textCh: 你走向散落在地面上的尸体。微风轻拂，让你得以短暂逃离空气中的腐败恶臭，呼吸到新鲜一些的空气。此刻你可以仔细查看这些尸体，并为那些离开人世的亡者们祈祷。
lines.textEn: You approach the bodies lying on the ground. A light breeze blows, letting you inhale without the stench of decay. Now you can examine the bodies and pray for those who have departed this world.

lines.textCh: 祈祷。
lines.textEn: Pray.

lines.textCh:
你双手合十，以祈祷的姿势默诵起经文。尽管四周充斥着自然的喧嚣，你却只专注于神圣的词句，仿佛你不是在尸横遍野的战场上，而是又回到了故乡的修道院中。你衷心祈愿所有阵亡的战士都能安息。
终于，祷告结束了。你睁开双眼，立刻注意到其中一名亡者手指上戴着一枚奇异的戒指。
lines.textEn:
You fold your hands in a prayer gesture and begin to recite the words silently. Around you, there are so many sounds, but you focus only on the sacred words. You even feel as if you’re back in a temple in your hometown. You sincerely hope that all these fallen warriors find peace.
Finally, the prayer comes to an end. You open your eyes and immediately notice a strange ring on one of the dead men.

lines.textCh:
你走近些。已经许久没下过雨了，地面干涸尘土飞扬。尸体旁的草丛沾染着干涸的血迹。即便近在咫尺，风也无法完全掩盖那股死亡的腐臭味。
你的目光掠过地上的尸体。
lines.textEn:
You move closer. It hasn’t rained in a long time, so the ground is dry and dusty. Next to the bodies, the grass is stained with dried blood. Even in this proximity, the wind doesn’t mask the scent.
Your gaze slides over the fallen.

lines.textCh: 太可惜了，他们的人生才刚刚开始。
lines.textEn: Saddening. They still had life ahead of them.

lines.textCh:
你摇头叹息，满腹忧愁地看着那些尸体。战争从不留情，哪怕是老幼妇孺也无法幸免。
突然，你注意到其中一具尸体手指上的戒指。
lines.textEn:
You shake your head, looking at the bodies with sorrow. War spares no one, neither the young nor the old.
Suddenly, your attention is drawn to the ring on one of the dead men.

lines.textCh:
你抿着嘴唇，凝视着那些尸体。你并不为他们感到可惜。这些人做出了自己的选择，也拥抱了自己的命运：任何战士都有可能会沦为乌鸦啄食的尸骸。
你的目光掠过地上的尸体，突然注意到其中一人手指上戒指的反光。
lines.textEn:
You purse your lips, looking at the bodies. You feel no pity: these people chose this path. Any warrior risks ending up a corpse among crows.
Your eyes sweep over the fallen, and you notice the glint of a ring on one of them.

lines.textCh: 你走近些。尸体以一种不自然的姿势躺在地上，但紧闭着双眼，面容安详。你立刻注意到这人的衣着比其他人更华贵。有意思——这个人究竟是什么来头？还有那枚戒指……它吸引着你的目光。
lines.textEn: You move closer. The corpse lies in an unnatural position, but his eyes are closed and his face is peaceful. You immediately notice that the man’s clothing is richer than the others’. Interesting—what is his story? And that ring… It draws your gaze.

lines.textCh: 拿走戒指。
lines.textEn: Take the ring.

lines.textCh: 你环顾四周，仿佛有人会看见你。你从未偷过东西，但……戒指的主人已经死了，他不再需要它了。如果拿走它，无异于让这枚戒指再现人世，而不是随它的原主人一同下葬。你用这个念头安慰自己，将戒指从那具冰冷的手上取下。尸体仿佛随时会握紧拳头发出低吼，但什么也没发生。你只是默默收起戒指，放进背包。
lines.textEn: You look around, as if someone might see you. You’ve never stolen anything, but... the owner of the ring is already dead, he doesn’t need it anymore. By taking it, you give it a second life, preventing it from staying buried. You soothe yourself with this thought as you remove the ring from the lifeless hand. It feels as if the corpse might squeeze his hand and growl, but nothing happens. You simply take the ring and place it in your bag.

lines.textCh:
不，你不能这么做。你不是小偷！这枚戒指生前属于这个人，死后仍然是他的财产。
你退后一步，感到一种奇特的解脱，仿佛刚刚抵御住了某种可怕的诱惑。
lines.textEn:
No, you can’t do that. You’re not a thief! The ring belonged to this man in life, so it belongs to him in death.
You step back, feeling a strange relief, as if you’ve just resisted a terrible temptation.

lines.textCh: 你向战士们的尸体投去最后一瞥。现在该干什么呢？
lines.textEn: You cast one last glance at the fallen warriors. What to do now?

lines.textCh: 神庙废墟也许会有什么有意思的东西。
lines.textEn: The temple ruins might hide something interesting.

lines.textCh: 你回到了先前过夜的那座神庙。还有点时间能四处看看。
lines.textEn: You return to the temple where you spent the night. You still have a little time to explore it.

lines.textCh: 你走向那匹马。刺鼻的气味令人窒息，呛得你眼泪直流。你看着这可怜的动物和旁边散架的马车。战争对任何人都不留情面，连动物也不例外。
lines.textEn: You approach the horse. The smell is suffocating and sharp, making your eyes water. You look at the poor animal and the broken cart nearby. War shows no mercy to anyone, not even animals.

lines.textCh:
看来你对这场冲突的局势已经了如指掌。两个家族相互厮杀，双方的背后都有更加强大的势力在暗中支持，而你们教团则奉行互不干涉的立场——至少你们对外宣称的态度如此。至于实际情况……由于你尚未攀至高位，没法了解事情的全貌。但也许在传递完这封信件后，你就会被吸纳进教团的权力核心。
你忍不住想象，如果有一天你真的权倾天下，自己会如何行事。
lines.textEn:
It seems you know everything about this conflict. Two families are fighting each other, secretly supported by far more powerful forces. Your Order chose a policy of non-interference. At least, that’s what you’re all supposed to say. In reality... you haven’t climbed high enough yet to see the full picture. But perhaps after delivering this message, you’ll finally be accepted into the inner circle.
You can’t resist imagining what you would do if you had access to such power.

lines.textCh: 你会阻止这些无谓的战争。
lines.textEn: You'd stop these clashes.

lines.textCh:
你觉得这太不公平了。眼前这片尘土飞扬的土地上散落的尸体，他们生前想必也曾见识过某种崇高的东西。或许他们都是在为某种理想而战。但你厌恶这种想法。倘若你能掌握权力，一定会竭尽所能让这个世界摆脱战争。
为了这一目标，你愿意穷尽一切。
lines.textEn:
You think it’s terribly unfair. Surely most of those lying on the dry ground before you saw something greater in the war. Perhaps they fought for an ideal. You dislike this. If you had power, you would do everything possible to free this world from war.
Everything possible.

lines.textCh: 在这个世界上，总有人在与他人厮杀。这是永无止境的循环，而诸如你们教团这般势力早已学会从中牟利。你们心知肚明——永恒的战争，正是维系你们存在的根基，滋养你们繁荣的土壤。放任他们厮杀吧，就任凭这些战士为自己相信的“崇高”理念而死吧。
lines.textEn: In this world, someone is always fighting someone else. It’s an endless cycle that people like your Order have learned to exploit. And you understand it. Eternal wars — this is what allows you to exist, what sustains your prosperity. So let them fight, let them die for the sake of a greater idea.

lines.textCh:
你凝望远方，嘴角浮起一抹浅笑。如果一切顺利，你将在今晚完成自己的使命。再过几天，你将重返教团。你确信长老们一定会为你一路上的艰辛给予丰厚的报偿。
但此刻，你必须专注于眼前的任务。
lines.textEn:
You cast your gaze into the distance and smile faintly. Tonight, you will have completed everything required of you. In a few days, you’ll return to the Order. You’re confident the elders will reward you.
But for now, you need to focus on your task.

lines.textCh: 上路前检查一遍战士们的尸体。
lines.textEn: Examine the bodies of the warriors before hitting the road.

lines.textCh: 你离开了战场。随着脚步渐远，死亡的腐臭气味也越来越淡，直至在神庙废墟附近彻底消散。
lines.textEn: You leave the battlefield. With each step, the smell grows weaker until it disappears entirely near the temple ruins.

lines.textCh: 你回头瞥了眼那座废弃的神庙。不知为何，你总觉得这是最后一次见到它。甩开这个念头，你继续沿着道路前行。
lines.textEn: You glance back at the abandoned temple. For some reason, you have the feeling you’re seeing it for the last time. Shaking off the thought, you return to the road.

lines.textCh: 你已经浪费了太多宝贵的时间。前往塔格勒的路途可是不等人。你匆匆扫了眼神庙废墟便转身离去。在穿过杂草丛生的小径之后，终于踏上了通往塔格勒的大道。今晚，你将不再风餐露宿，而是在真正的床上安然入睡。这个念头驱使你继续前行。
lines.textEn: You’ve already wasted a lot of precious time. Targrad doesn’t wait. You cast a short glance at the temple ruins and turn away. Pushing through the mixed grasses, you reach the road to Targrad. Tonight, you’ll sleep there in a real bed. The thought drives you forward.

lines.textCh: 天气灿烂，微风轻拂。你踏着轻快的步履前进，塔格勒已经近在眼前，尽管城市的塔楼仍隐没在地平线彼端。
lines.textEn: The weather is beautiful, with a gentle breeze. You walk briskly. Targrad is close, though its towers are still hidden beyond the horizon.

lines.textCh: 在悠闲漫步了几小时后，一些简朴的房屋映入眼帘。你的路线穿过一座小村庄。这里地处前往塔格勒的贸易路线上，也一度繁荣过，但战争改变了一切。如今商人稀少，市面上的钱财也越来越匮乏。人们正陆续离开。通往塔格勒的路程已经不远了，也许该在这里停留一会补充饮水？
lines.textEn: After a few hours of unhurried walking, you see the first modest houses. Your route passes through a tiny village. Once it thrived from trade coming from Targrad, but the war changed everything. Now there are fewer traders, less money. People are leaving. The road to Targrad isn’t long, but maybe it’s worth at least replenishing your water supplies?

lines.textCh: 我……不会……逃跑！
lines.textEn: I... will... not retreat!

lines.textCh:
你走近仔细观察。残破的神庙在森林中显得格格不入，宛如曼妙女郎却偏偏长了一颗蛀牙一样刺眼。你意识到这地方曾经必定宏伟壮观。或许这里曾矗立着一整座修道院，而不仅仅是座教堂？
你的目光注意到一扇几乎完全被植物掩盖的门。
lines.textEn:
You look closer. The temple’s skeleton rises from the forest like rotten teeth in a beauty’s mouth. You realize the place must have been huge. Perhaps a monastery once stood here, not just a church?..
Your gaze is drawn to a door almost completely hidden by greenery.
