lines.textCh:
奉神秘领航者教团首领之命，你必须将一封信件送达塔格勒。关于这项任务，你所知道的仅有两点：信中记载着一则预言，且在抵达城市宫殿前的路途中严禁打开卷轴。
你能将教团首领的意志顺利传递到塔格勒吗？抑或你命中注定消亡在旅途中，永远无法完成使命？
lines.textEn:
By command of the head of the mysterious Order of Navigators, you must deliver a message to Targrad. All you know is that it contains a prophecy and that the scroll must not be opened until you arrive at the city palace.
Will you be able to convey the will of your leader to Targrad? Or is your fate to perish, never completing your mission?

lines.textCh:
当前已有游戏存档。如果选择开始新游戏，将会失去先前的所有进度！
确定要开始新游戏吗？
lines.textEn:
You already have an existing save. If you continue, you will lose your progress!
Are you sure?

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 怎么回事， Zryachiy？给我回话！我们之间没什么好说的了，出去！
lines.textEn: What’s going on, Zryachiy? Answer me! We’re done. Out!

lines.textCh: Zryachiy，我是 Lightkeeper！Zryachiy，回话！先这样，我们的会面已经结束了，出去！
lines.textEn: Zryachiy, this is Lightkeeper! Zryachiy, come in! That’s it, our meeting is over, go away!

lines.textCh: Zryachiy，你收到了吗？Zryachiy！该死。你，现在给我出去，立刻马上！
lines.textEn: Zryachiy, do you copy? Zryachiy! Alright, you get out of here, now!

lines.textCh: Zryachiy，回话。处理一下！会面已经结束了，现在给我出去！
lines.textEn: Zryachiy, come in. Deal with this! The meeting is over, leave, now!

lines.textCh: 尽可能拖住他们，Zryachiy！你，出去，就是现在！
lines.textEn: Handle this gunfight, Zryachiy! You, leave, now!

lines.textCh: Zryachiy，枪声是怎么回事？就这样，我们到此为止，给我出去！
lines.textEn: Zryachiy, what's with that shootout? That’s it, we’re done, get out of here!

lines.textCh: 我们没什么可谈的——你的时间到了。
lines.textEn: We’re done here - your time ran out.

lines.textCh: 看样子你一点都不守时，出去。
lines.textEn: You don't appreciate time at all. Out.

lines.textCh: 请你离开这里。时间到了。
lines.textEn: Please leave the premises. Time’s up.

lines.textCh: 你的时间到了。
lines.textEn: Your time is up.

lines.textCh: 时间到了，保重。
lines.textEn: Time is over. Take care.

lines.textCh: 时间到了。门在那里，自己走吧。
lines.textEn: Time’s up. The door is this way.

lines.textCh: 注意时间，大兵！
lines.textEn: Your time, soldier!

lines.textCh: 看看钟，时间快要到了。
lines.textEn: Clock’s ticking. Time is almost up.

lines.textCh: 我可没时间在这和你耗。
lines.textEn: Our time is running out.

lines.textCh: 时间差不多咯。
lines.textEn: Time is running out.

lines.textCh: 待在原地，等待那帮人注意到你。
lines.textEn: Wait until they notice you.

lines.textCh: 丢枚硬币讨个彩头。
lines.textEn: Throw a coin for luck.

lines.textCh: 丢枚硬币讨个彩头。
lines.textEn: Throw a coin for luck.

lines.textCh: 再丢一次。
lines.textEn: Throw one more.

lines.textCh: 丢枚硬币讨个彩头。
lines.textEn: Throw a coin for luck.

lines.textCh: 再丢一次。
lines.textEn: Throw one more.

lines.textCh:
你为食物付了钱，摊主喜笑颜开地把金币放进了钱包里。
— 什么风把你吹到我们这儿来了？
既然你已经买了他的香肠，这个男人显然愿意多聊上几句。为了搞清楚哨所的情况，你应该利用好这个机会。
lines.textEn:
You pay for the food, and the vendor quickly tucks the coins into his purse.
— What brings you to our village?
The man has relaxed since you bought the sausage. This is your chance to learn something about the outpost.

lines.textCh: 我会帮忙的，我必须得赶到河岸对面去。
lines.textEn: I'll help. I really need to get to the other side.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 你怒不可遏。什么鬼暗号？！难道是长老骗了你？你必须立刻查个水落石出，还是该冒险一把，强行冲过去？
lines.textEn: You are furious. What damn password?! Did the elder trick you? You need to find out right now. Or should you risk it and try to break through?

lines.textCh: 什么暗号？
lines.textEn: What password?

lines.textCh: 逃跑。
lines.textEn: Run.

lines.textCh: 你已经去过那片战场了，但可没看到有什么戒指。不过你本来也不是抱着那个心思才去的。
lines.textEn: You have already been to the battlefield, but saw no ring. Then again, you did not look for one.

lines.textCh: 尝试用香肠讨好狗。
lines.textEn: Appease the dog with the sausage.

lines.textCh: 掉头返回。
lines.textEn: Turn back.

lines.textCh: 丢枚硬币讨个彩头。
lines.textEn: Throw a coin for luck.

lines.textCh: 再丢一次。
lines.textEn: Throw one more.

lines.textCh:
你为食物付了钱，摊主喜笑颜开地把金币放进了钱包里。
— 什么风把你吹到我们这儿来了？
既然你已经买了他的香肠，这个男人显然愿意多聊上几句。为了搞清楚哨所的情况，你应该利用好这个机会。
lines.textEn:
You pay for the food, and the vendor quickly tucks the coins into his purse.
— What brings you to our village?
The man has relaxed since you bought the sausage. This is your chance to learn something about the outpost.

lines.textCh: 不，身上携带的给养还够。快点上路吧。
lines.textEn: No, you have everything you need. Better hurry.

lines.textCh: 接近肉贩。
lines.textEn: Approach the man.

lines.textCh: 他们把你当成什么了？你可是有着教团首脑签发的最高通行证，能在这片土地上畅通无阻！
lines.textEn: Who do they think they are? You have a permit from the head of the Order to pass through all these lands!

lines.textCh: 无论他们是什么人，你都得过河。你将独自面对他们。
lines.textEn: Whoever they are, you need to get to the other side of the river. You will go to them by yourself.

lines.textCh:
你身上唯一值钱的东西就是那枚在战场上捡到的戒指。也许你想自己留着，可是你前往塔格勒的使命更为重要。为此，你已经做好了割爱的准备。然而，倘若就这么将这样宝贵的东西随便地交给陌生人未免过于轻率了。你要求见他们的头目。那群人互相对视了一番，勉强答应下来。
— 别乱动，不然我们就把你给大卸八块，像杀猪一样！— 其中一人威胁道，你只能点头。无论如何，你确实别无选择。
lines.textEn:
The only valuable thing you have is the ring you found on the battlefield. Maybe you wanted to keep it, but getting to Targrad matters more. You are ready to part with it. Still, handing something so valuable to just anyone is foolish. You ask to be taken to their leader. The men exchange glances and reluctantly agree.
— Do not twitch, or we will cut you like a pig. — one says, and you nod. You really have no choice either way.

lines.textCh: 你们必须让我过去。
lines.textEn: You are obliged to let me through.

lines.textCh: 暂时不拿出戒指。
lines.textEn: Hold the ring back for now.

lines.textCh: 暗号是 Tetriandoch。
lines.textEn: The password is Tetriandoch.

lines.textCh: 买些香肠应该会不错。
lines.textEn: Some sausage would be great.

lines.textCh: 你应该问问桥上的守军怎么了，毕竟你来到这就是为了这个。
lines.textEn: You should ask about the garrison. That is why you came here.

lines.textCh: 你还知道什么情况？
lines.textEn: Do you know anything else?

lines.textCh: 或许你该去拜访一下村子里的长老。
lines.textEn: You should probably visit the village elder.

lines.textCh: 预言？你倒是不介意听听看。
lines.textEn: Prophecies? You wouldn't mind getting one.

lines.textCh: 靠近些。
lines.textEn: Come closer.

lines.textCh: 还是小心些为妙。谁也不知道井下面都是些什么妖魔鬼怪。
lines.textEn: Better be careful. Who knows what kind of spirit is there.

lines.textCh: 但已经没时间细想这些了，还是尽快去拜访村子的长老吧。
lines.textEn: But it's not the time to brood on it. Best go to the elder as soon as possible.

lines.textCh: 没错，该去长老那里了。
lines.textEn: Exactly. Best go to the elder now.

lines.textCh: 我想聊聊。
lines.textEn: Actually, I wanted to chat.

lines.textCh: 为什么不向城里写信，让他们派出援兵来帮你们呢？
lines.textEn: Why not write to the city so they send their warriors to deal with it?

lines.textCh: 先和屠夫聊聊。
lines.textEn: Chat with the butcher first.

lines.textCh: 还是往后退一步吧。
lines.textEn: Better step back a little.

lines.textCh: 先告诉我你要我办什么事吧。
lines.textEn: Tell me what you need first.

lines.textCh: 你为什么不自己派人去找呢？
lines.textEn: Why do you not go look for it yourself?

lines.textCh: 也许先看看那个被死马压住的贵族？
lines.textEn: Maybe that noble was pinned by the dead horse?

lines.textCh: 他们选择了自己的命运。
lines.textEn: They chose their own fate.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 你会放我过去的，对吧？
lines.textEn: Are you letting me through?

lines.textCh: 你怒不可遏。什么鬼暗号？！难道是长老骗了你？你必须立刻查个水落石出，还是该冒险一把，强行冲过去？
lines.textEn: You are furious. What damn password?! Did the elder trick you? You need to find out right now. Or should you risk it and try to break through?

lines.textCh:
你为食物付了钱，摊主喜笑颜开地把金币放进了钱包里。
— 什么风把你吹到我们这儿来了？
既然你已经买了他的香肠，这个男人显然愿意多聊上几句。为了搞清楚哨所的情况，你应该利用好这个机会。
lines.textEn:
You pay for the food, and the vendor quickly tucks the coins into his purse.
— What brings you to our village?
The man has clearly relaxed after you bought a slice of sausage. This is your chance to learn something about the outpost.

lines.textCh: 说话。
lines.textEn: Speak.

lines.textCh: 你已经去过了那片战场，并且看到了这个老家伙梦寐以求的那个戒指。早知道是这样，当初你就该拿上它，但老天爷，谁又能知道呢？
lines.textEn: You have already been to the battlefield and saw the ring the elder wants so badly. You should have taken it then, but oh well.

lines.textCh: 上一次你只匆匆检查了那匹死马就离开了。在那周围可不会有什么戒指。
lines.textEn: Last time you only examined the dead horse, then left. There will definitely be no rings by it.

lines.textCh: 也许先看看那个被马尸压住的贵族？
lines.textEn: Maybe that noble was pinned by the horse?

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 停下来。
lines.textEn: Stop.

lines.textCh: 再丢一次。
lines.textEn: Throw one more.

lines.textCh: 搞清楚到底发生了什么，好奇心哪会害死猫呢！
lines.textEn: Figure out what happened. Curiosity wins!

lines.textCh:
在悠闲漫步了几小时后，一些简朴的房屋映入眼帘。

你的路线穿过一座小村庄。这里地处前往塔格勒的贸易路线上，也一度繁荣过，但战争改变了一切。如今商人稀少，市面上的钱财也越来越匮乏。人们正陆续离开。通往塔格勒的路程已经不远了，也许该在这里停留一会补充饮水？
lines.textEn:
After a few hours of unhurried walking, you see the first modest houses.

Your route passes through a tiny village. Once it thrived from trade coming from Targrad, but the war changed everything. Now there are fewer traders, less money. People are leaving. The road to Targrad isn’t long, but maybe it’s worth at least replenishing your water supplies?

lines.textCh: 没错，最好停留一会。
lines.textEn: Yes, it's best to stay here for a bit.

lines.textCh: 你突然发觉自己已经很久没吃过东西了，而饮水更是在昨晚就已经喝得一干二净。再往前不会再有集市，因此你确实得停下来补充点物资。
lines.textEn: You realize you have not eaten in a long time. And your water ran out last night. There is nowhere to resupply between here and Targrad, so it makes sense to stop.

lines.textCh: 你不想在这里浪费时间。你身上还有足够的水，况且到了塔格勒后就能饱餐一顿了。当下更重要的是把信送到。
lines.textEn: You are not going to waste time. You have enough water, and you can grab a bite once you reach Targrad. The message is more important right now.

lines.textCh: 你身旁有位妇人在卖牛奶，正对面站着个男人，面前摆着几块肉。两人都在热情招呼你，希望你能购买他们的商品。
lines.textEn: A woman beside you is selling milk. Right across from her stands a man with chunks of meat. Both are working hard to draw you to their goods.

lines.textCh:
你径直穿过村庄，未曾停留。看样子今天是赶集的日子：村子中央的货摊摆满了各式货物。村民们带着一丝希望注视着你，指望你能停下脚步买些东西。你却只是继续前行。
终于，你看到了前方的一处哨所，以及哨所守卫的河上桥梁。但你总觉得哪里不对劲——没有塔格勒的旗帜，没有守卫……你及时停下脚步，瞥见大门处站着几个人。他们的盔甲破旧不堪，这些衣衫褴褛的人绝对不是守军。顿时，寒意爬上了你的脊背。
lines.textEn:
You walk straight through the village, not stopping anywhere. Today looks like market day: various goods are laid throughout the village's center. The locals watch you with a hint of hope, wishing you would buy something. You just keep walking.
At last, an outpost with a bridge over the river appears ahead. But something is off. No Targrad pennants, no guards... You stop just in time to notice men at the gate. Their armor is battered, their looks unkempt. They are definitely not soldiers. Goosebumps run down your back.

lines.textCh: 最好返回村子，问问当地人守桥的都是些什么人，以及原来的士兵都去哪了。
lines.textEn: You should probably go back to the village and ask the locals who they are and where the garrison went.

lines.textCh:
你以最快速度抽身返回。那些人没有注意到你。你完全不知道这些人为什么会出现在这里，塔格勒的守军又去了哪里，更不知该如何渡过此处……
你回到村庄环顾四周。身旁有位妇女在卖牛奶，正对面站着个男人，托盘里摆满各式香肠和肉干。两人都在竭力吸引你购买他们的商品。
lines.textEn:
You retreat as quickly as you can. The men do not notice you. You have no idea what they are doing there, where the Targrad guards went, or how you are supposed to cross now...
You return to the village and look around. A woman beside you is selling milk. Right across from her stands a man with a tray full of various sausages and pieces of dried meat. Both are trying hard to lure you to their goods.

lines.textCh: 接近农妇。
lines.textEn: Approach the woman.

lines.textCh:
守桥的汉子们迅速发现你，精神一振，高声喊道：
— 喂，你在这儿干什么？过来！
你走近他们。
这些人都拿着武器，神情凶狠。
— 你来这儿干什么？不说话干什么？被猫把舌头给叼了？我们可以帮你一把，把你的舌头捋捋直！
lines.textEn:
The men spot you quickly, perk up, and shout,
— Hey you, what are you doing here? C'mere!
You come closer.
The men are armed and look hostile.
— So why're you here? Cat got your tongue? We can help you pull it out!

lines.textCh: 你不想与他们正面冲突，尽量平静地回答。
lines.textEn: You don't want to fight. Answer calmly.

lines.textCh:
你扬起下巴，径直走向那群男人。他们注意到你，互相交换眼神，随即皱起眉头。
— 你来这干什么？要过河？
你点了点头。
— 那就少废话，给钱吧。
他们露出冷笑。其中一人伸出手。你意识到那张由教团首脑签署的旅行特许状在此处毫无用处。
lines.textEn:
You lift your chin and walk straight toward the men. They notice you, exchange looks, and frown.
— So, why are you here? Need to get to the other side?
You nod.
— Then pay.
They smirk. One of them holds out his hand. You realize your travel charter signed by the head of the Order will not help here.

lines.textCh:
— 我得去河对岸。
相当委婉的回答！
— 要么给钱要么滚蛋。
lines.textEn:
— I need to get to the other side.
A very diplomatic answer!
— Then pay.

lines.textCh:
你拿出身上所有的钱，但那些人只是嗤笑个不停。
——这几个小钱你还是自己留着吧。想要过河，加码可比这高得多了。等找到真金白银再来吧。
你意识到留在这里很危险，便拼命往回退去。
lines.textEn:
You offer all the money you brought, but the men only laugh.
— Keep those pennies. Crossing costs much more. Come back when you find real money.
You realize it's dangerous to stay here, so you retreat as fast as you can.

lines.textCh: 你回到村子里，环顾四周。你身旁有位妇人在卖牛奶，正对面站着一个屠夫，面前摆满了各式各样的香肠和肉干。两人都在热情招呼你，也许是指望你能买上几样东西。
lines.textEn: You return to the village and look around. A woman beside you is selling milk. Right across from her stands a man with a tray full of various sausages and pieces of dried meat. Both are trying hard to lure you to their goods.

lines.textCh:
他们将你带进哨站。你注意到墙上残留着陈旧的暗红色血迹——看样子这里发生过一场恶战。
原本哨兵的房间里，一个体格魁梧的男人迎面走来。他只是转向你，没有摘下头盔。一把锤子就在他伸手可及之处。如果你的反应让他不满意，他随时能一把抓起它砸碎你的脑袋。
— 这人是谁？— 头目的声音在头盔里回响，显得含糊不清。
— 他说想过河，愿意付钱。
— 那就亮出来。— 队长盯着你。你迅速掏出戒指。
lines.textEn:
They lead you into the outpost. You notice old, dark bloodstains on the walls — looks like bodies once lay there.
In the former guardroom a powerfully built man meets you. He does not take off his helmet, he only turns toward you. A hammer lies within his reach. He could easily grab it and smash your head if you do something stupid.
— Who is this? — the chief's voice is muffled by the helmet.
— Says he wants to cross. Wants to pay you.
— Well then, show what you have. — the chief is staring at you. You quickly pull out the ring.

lines.textCh:
面对这群败类，你决定必须来硬的。
— 我奉领航者教团，必须通过此地！
然而你的计谋毫无效果。即使听到教团的大名后，眼前这些人不仅面无惧色，反倒被你的口气激怒了。
— 哦？那又怎样？你还有什么要说的？— 众人逼近了你，并拔出武器。
lines.textEn:
You decide you should talk to scum like this accordingly.
— I have the right to pass through this outpost in the name of the Order of the Navigators!
Only your plan does not work in the slightest. There is not a trace of fear on the faces before you, only anger.
— Oh yeah? Anything else you wanna share? — the men close in and draw their weapons.

lines.textCh: 我愿意付钱。
lines.textEn: I can pay.

lines.textCh:
你想起了在战场上找到的戒指，把它亮了出来。众人顿时平静下来，虽然还是举着武器。
— 早说愿意付钱不就行了。跟我们走，把那个东西交给头儿。
lines.textEn:
You remember the ring you found and show it. The men calm down at once, though they do not lower their weapons.
— Should have said so from the start. Come with us, you can give the payment to the chief.

lines.textCh:
你挺直肩膀，紧抿双唇。你觉得必须据理力争，才能让眼前的这帮强盗屈服。
只是他们此刻根本没有心思与你辩论
— 你以为你是什么东西？！
一名男子抽出长剑，直接向你逼近——你确实把他们给惹火了。你闪开了第一剑，勉强躲开了第二剑，但第三剑还是击中了你。
当剑刃撕开你的腹部时，恐怖的疼痛如火灼烧。你本能捂住伤口，却感受到内脏从指缝间滑落。光是想到手中捧着的是自己的肠子，你就不禁踉跄后退。又或许是疼痛逼着你不得不屈服？
lines.textEn:
You square your shoulders and press your lips together. You feel you need to stand your ground. It is the only way these bandits will get the message.
Only they are not in the mood to understand anything.
— Who do you think you are?!
One of the men advances on you with a bare sword. Looks like you really managed to anger them. You dodge the first strike, slip away from the second, but the third catches you.
Horrifying pain burns as the blade rips open your stomach. Your insides slip under your fingers when you instinctively grab the wound. The very thought of touching your own guts makes you stagger. Or maybe it's the pain?

lines.textCh: 你捂着肚子倒在地上。内脏破裂的恶臭与血腥味扑鼻而来，周围已经洒满了自己的鲜血。头晕目眩间，你闭上了双眼。
lines.textEn: You fall to the ground, clutching your stomach. The stench is vile; everything around is covered with your blood. Your head spins and you close your eyes.

lines.textCh: 拿出戒指。
lines.textEn: Offer the ring.

lines.textCh:
你犹豫了。如果亮出戒指后他们不信守承诺，直接把你给丢出去怎么办？你僵在了原地，紧攥拳头里的戒指。
头目显然不喜欢这样。
他大步流星地走过来，像提起一只小猫一样揪住你的衣领。衣领勒进喉咙，让你哈不过气来。
— 你到这来求我让你过河，结果却磨磨蹭蹭的不肯给钱？！你以为自己是谁，连我们都敢耍？！
lines.textEn:
You hesitate. Will they throw you out the moment you show the ring? You freeze, gripping it tightly in your fist.
The chief clearly does not like that.
He strides up with a soldier’s quick step and grabs you by the scruff like a kitten. Your collar bites into your throat and steals your breath.
— You come here asking me to let you cross and you are clutching the payment?! Who do you think you are?!

lines.textCh:
你决定还是不要冒这个风险，将戒指摊在摊开的掌心。头目跺着脚凑近，一把攫住戒指。他抬起手端详戒指时吐露出一声嗤笑：
— 不错的东西。值一大笔钱，你从哪儿弄来的？算了，怎么着也无所谓了。
他把戒指揣进口袋，盯着你看。
— 暗号呢？
lines.textEn:
You decide not to risk it and hold the ring out on your open palm. The chief stomps closer and snatches it. Lifting his hand, he snorts as he studies the ring.
— Nice trinket. Worth a lot. Where did you get it? Although, doesn't matter.
He pockets the ring and looks at you.
— Password?

lines.textCh: 交出戒指。
lines.textEn: Give him the ring.

lines.textCh: 什么暗号？
lines.textEn: What password?

lines.textCh:
— 还能是什么暗号？就是一直在用的那个！没有暗号，就别想过去。
壮汉把戒指放进口袋，转身离开了。
— 没拿到暗号就别回来了。
他们把你领出了卫兵房间，推搡着把你赶出哨所。
lines.textEn:
— The usual one! We won't et you through without it.
The man pockets the ring and turns away from you.
— Don't come back until you learn the password.
They lead you out of the guardroom and shove you out of the outpost.

lines.textCh:
尽管看不见他的脸，但你能感受到头目火辣辣的眼神直盯着你。他有意不说话，现场陷入了诡异的沉默之中，显然是想让你紧张。你却平静地等待他开口。
— 天知道你是怎么弄到暗号的，但确实没错。— 他朝手下吹了声口哨，又朝你这边点了一下头示意手下：— 带他走吧。
lines.textEn:
You feel the chief’s gaze on you, even though you cannot see his face. He lets the silence stretch, obviously to make you nervous. You wait calmly.
— Hell knows how you know the password, but it is correct. — he whistles to his men and nods at you. — Escort him.

lines.textCh:
屠夫一看到你朝他那边走去，立马殷勤地开口了：
— 哈，我们可是好久没遇上客人了！
你正想问他怎么知道你不是本地人，他却抢先开口：
— 我们这是个小村子，这里所有人我都认识。那么，需要买点什么吗？
lines.textEn:
The butcher perks up the instant he sees you heading his way.
— Ha, we have not had guests in a good while!
You want to ask how he knows you are not local, but he talks first.
— Our village is small. I know everyone. So, are you buying anything?

lines.textCh: 还是不了，我只是来逛逛。
lines.textEn: Just browsing, thanks.

lines.textCh:
你决定带点东西上路，一小块香肠就行。
— 真是识货！这香肠是我老婆做的，她的手艺可是一绝！你尝了就知道，绝对不会让你后悔的。
摊主利落地切下一块香肠递给你。
lines.textEn:
You decide to take something for the road. A small hunk of sausage will do.
— Great choice! My wife makes it, she's got golden hands! You will not regret it.
The vendor neatly slices off a piece and hands it to you.

lines.textCh:
你摇了摇头，摊主的嘴角不悦地抿一下。他显然想向你兜售些什么，然而你此时既不饿，也不想在这里花上一分钱。
— 好吧，那祝你一路平安。
你隐约觉得，他巴不得你转身就一跤摔在地上才好。
lines.textEn:
You shake your head, and the vendor presses his lips in annoyance. He clearly hoped to peddle something to you. You, however, are not hungry and do not want to spend money.
— Well then, safe travels.
You get the feeling he would be happy to wish you the opposite.

lines.textCh: 这家伙显然是不打算开口了，还是去买牛奶的妇人那里碰碰运气吧。
lines.textEn: The guy won't tell you anything now. You should try your luck with the milk seller woman.

lines.textCh:
你为食物付了钱，摊主喜笑颜开地把金币放进了钱包里。
— 什么风把你吹到我们这儿来了？
既然你已经买了他的香肠，这个男人显然愿意多聊上几句。为了搞清楚哨所的情况，你应该利用好这个机会。
lines.textEn:
You pay for the food, and the vendor quickly tucks the coins into his purse.
— What brings you to our village?
The man has relaxed since you bought the sausage. This is your chance to learn something about the outpost.

lines.textCh: 河上的那座哨站是怎么回事？
lines.textEn: What about that outpost at the river?

lines.textCh:
那人耸耸肩，朝拿着牛奶的女人示意。
— 我只知道，里面站岗的已经不是我们的人了。娜斯塔西娅知道得更多，就算你不从她那儿买东西，她也乐意聊聊。
lines.textEn:
The man shrugs and gestures toward the woman with the milk.
— Those are not our people out there anymore. Nastasya will tell you more than I can, even if you do not buy anything from her. She's always ready to chat.

lines.textCh: 好吧，那我就听听她有什么说法。
lines.textEn: Alright, I'll head to her then.

lines.textCh:
你向屠夫道别，走向那位妇人，礼貌地微笑着。她知道你需要什么。
— 哎呀呀，这是哪位帅小伙儿光临我们村子啦！— 她咧嘴一笑，你能看到她少了一颗牙。— 来点牛奶，还是来聊天呢？
lines.textEn:
You say goodbye to the butcher and head to the woman, smiling politely. She knows what you need.
— Well now, what handsome fellow has dropped by our village! — she grins wide. She is missing a tooth. — Here for milk or for a chat?

lines.textCh:
你总觉得这个男人应该还知道更多情况，事实证明，你猜得没错。你的话音刚落，他就靠了过来，低声向你耳语道：
— 我们这儿的井里有某种邪灵。每次去打水的时候，总能听到诡异的预言，每个人的说法都不一样。
lines.textEn:
You feel like this man might know something else, and your hunch is right. The moment you fall silent, he leans in and whispers conspiratorially.
— There is some kind of evil spirit in our well. Along with the water you get strange prophecies. Everyone sees their own version.

lines.textCh: 从他的反应来看，这家伙应该是不会再开口了，至少别想从他嘴里套出任何有用的东西出来。不付钱就只能被冷面相待。
lines.textEn: From his reaction you can tell he will not say anything more, at least nothing useful. You missed your chance by not buying anything.

lines.textCh:
— 那河边原来的守军……他们都去哪了？— 你小心翼翼地提问。摊主皱起眉头，紧张地耸了耸肩。
— 不在就不在呗。现在有别人在里面守着，不关我的事。
他转身把脸移开，你意识到再也问不出什么了。
lines.textEn:
— And that garrison at the river... What happened to it? — you ask casually. The vendor frowns and gives a nervous shrug.
— It's gone. Others are there now. Not my business.
He turns away. You realize you will not get anything more out of him.

lines.textCh: 还是和卖牛奶的妇人聊聊吧，或许她更了解这里的情况。
lines.textEn: Better talk to the milk seller woman. Maybe she knows something.

lines.textCh: 这可不是我想听到。
lines.textEn: That is not quite what I wanted to hear.

lines.textCh:
你挑了挑眉毛——也就乡下人会把这种事情当真！能预言的水井，搞什么鬼？若非出于礼貌，你早就要当面笑出声来。
你向屠夫道别后便退到一旁。
lines.textEn:
You raise your eyebrows. What village nonsense! Talking wells, really? Only your politeness keeps you from laughing in his face.
You say goodbye and step aside.

lines.textCh: 你向男人问出了位置，向那口水井走去。
lines.textEn: You ask the man where the well is and head there.

lines.textCh: 这口井看起来平平无奇，和其他一般的水井没什么不同。有人把水桶留在了井栏上，你不禁怀疑，这会不会和传言中井里栖居的恶灵有什么关系。
lines.textEn: The well does not impress you. It looks like just an ordinary well. Someone left a bucket on the rim. You wonder if that has anything to do with the evil that supposedly lives below.

lines.textCh: 还是不要在这浪费时间了。
lines.textEn: Not worth wasting your time.

lines.textCh: 你的使命可比起在一口水井旁边东张西望要紧多了！还是干正事吧。
lines.textEn: You have better things to do than poke around village wells! Time to get back to business.

lines.textCh: 你走上前去。草丛在你脚步下轻柔沙沙作响。这里安静得怕人：四下里听不到公鸡啼鸣，也没有儿童的嬉笑喧闹声。寒意涌上了你的心头。
lines.textEn: You step closer. The grass rustles softly under your steps. The silence here is strange and unnatural: no roosters crow, no children shout. Goosebumps race along your back.

lines.textCh: 你难道还能被这种东西吓到吗？就该大胆上前。
lines.textEn: Are you a coward? You should act confidently.

lines.textCh: 该怕的不是你，而是下面的恶灵吧！你挺直肩膀，大胆地走向井边。
lines.textEn: It is not you who should be afraid, they should be! You square your shoulders and approach the well with confidence.

lines.textCh: 谨慎是最大的美德，宁可一时放慢脚步，也总比未来后悔强。这个习惯救了你不止一次，也许还将再救你一命。你小心地靠近井口。
lines.textEn: You think it is better to be overly cautious than not cautious enough. That habit has saved you more than once. Maybe it will save you here. You approach the well carefully.

lines.textCh:
你向下看去，目力所及只有一片黑暗。你能听到下方更远的地方，有水在汩汩流淌，但显然是在更深的地方。突然，黑暗中传来一阵奇怪的叮当声。
你俯下身子，试图看清声音的来源。或许是有人落下了什么东西，随着水流碰撞井壁叮叮当当作响？
lines.textEn:
You peer inside and see only darkness. Somewhere far below, water sloshes. Much too far below. Suddenly you hear a strange ringing from the dark.
You lean lower, trying to see the cause. Maybe someone dropped something, and it is dangling and clinking?

lines.textCh: 下面唯有黑暗与水面折射的微光。你并未俯身探出边缘，只是在井边探头，用一只眼睛窥视。突然间，深渊中传来阵阵回响。或许是幽灵试图迷惑你，但你始终保持冷静。
lines.textEn: Down below there is only darkness and faint gleams on the water. You do not lean over the lip, you only peek with one eye. Suddenly a ringing rises from the depths. Maybe the spirit is trying to distract you, but you keep your cool.

lines.textCh:
霎时间，黑暗中伸出无数手掌。你瞥见尖锐的利爪与鳞片，皮肤泛着青蓝光泽，却来不及后退。
那些手攥住衣襟，利齿深深嵌进你柔嫩的喉咙。一股力量将你拽入深井。
— 这都是你的错！就因为你，我们都死了，还要再经历死亡的痛苦，还会继续经历这个轮回！
你听见愤怒的低语，随即惨叫出声：
— 我什么都没干！— 你撕声力竭，但怪物却拽得更紧。你拼命抠抓试图挣脱，指甲都抠破了，怪物却丝毫没有松手的意思。
你在井中下落，不断坠落，直到一头栽进水中。
lines.textEn:
All at once, hands appear out of the dark. You notice sharp claws and scales, a bluish sheen to the skin, but you do not have time to jump back.
The hands grab your clothes and bite into the soft skin of your throat. Something pulls you down into the well.
— It is all because of you. Because of you we all died, will die, and will keep dying!
You hear a furious whisper and cry out.
— I did not do anything! — you shout, but the monster only pulls harder. You tear your nails trying to save yourself, but nothing helps.
You fall and fall and fall until you hit the water.

lines.textCh:
你的谨慎再次救了自己一命——无数手掌如鬼魅般从黑暗中探出，你勉强能看清一团尖利的爪子、宛如尸体一样的青紫皮肤，和丛生的鳞片。你凭本能猛地向后一跳，跌落在地。那些手紧紧抓着井沿停住。仿佛有人在低声呜咽，接着传来声音：
— 因为你，我们都死了，还要再经历死亡的痛苦，还会继续经历这个轮回！周而复始，永无止息！你就是死亡的化身！
lines.textEn:
That is exactly what saves you when the ghoulish hands appear from the dark. You manage to see the sharp claws, the corpse’s bluish skin, the scales. Acting on instinct, you jump back and fall. The hands clutch the rim of the well and stay there. Someone whimpers, then a voice speaks.
— Because of you we all died, will die, and will keep dying. Over and over, over and over. You are death itself for these lands.

lines.textCh: 待在原地。
lines.textEn: Stay where you are.

lines.textCh:
声音仿佛分裂成层层叠叠的回响。你能听见稚嫩清亮的童声，也能听见沙哑苍老的垂暮嗓音。你纹丝不动——只是凝神注视，侧耳倾听。
— 我们都要死了。那张纸……不能。绝不能打开。
幽灵的指尖沿杯沿滑动，利爪在木质井栏上刮擦，吱呀作响。
— 只有你死了，我们才能活……
霎时间，攀在井栏上的乱手消失无踪。下方远远地传来水花溅落的声响。有人叹息，你听见一声低语正在逐渐消逝：“我们都完了”。
lines.textEn:
The voice seems to split and layer over itself. You hear very young voices, bright and cheerful, and old ones, creaky and worn. You do not move — you only watch and listen.
— We will all die. The paper… Cannot. Must not open.
The spirit slides its fingers along the rim and scratches the wood with its claws.
— You must die so that we can all live.
Suddenly the hands disappear. Something splashes in the distance. Someone sighs. You hear the fading words: "we are all doomed".
And then silence.

lines.textCh:
恐惧令你喉咙发干，但你强忍着开口：
— 你到底在说什么东西？我才刚到这个村子而已。
那恶灵的爪子猛地伸向井栏，仿佛要一把抓住你。
— 你就是死亡本身。你早就该死了，你本该从梯子上摔下去，死在那座神庙里。你绝对不能抵达塔格勒，你绝对不能开启封印。
井中的怪物狂暴咆哮，撕扯着井沿，发出低吼、哀鸣与哭喊。
— 我们都会因你而死。所有人，所有人都会死。
突然间，攀在井栏上的乱手消失无踪。下方远远地传来水花溅落的声响。你听见一声低语正在逐渐消逝：“我们都完了”。
接着重新归于沉默。
lines.textEn:
Your throat is dry with fear, but you gather yourself and speak.
— What are you talking about? I only just arrived in this village.
The spirit’s hands shoot up and rake the rim, as if trying to reach you.
— You are death itself. You should have died, fallen from the ladder. You must not reach Targrad. You must not open the seal.
The thing in the well rages, tears at the rim, growls, moans, and cries.
— We will all die because of you. All of us, all of us will die.
Suddenly the hands vanish. There is a splash somewhere in the depths. You hear the fading words: "we are all doomed".
And then silence.

lines.textCh: 你还没来得及去思考这到底是怎么一回事，身体便已自行移动。你慌忙后退，猛地跳起身来，目光始终未曾离开那口井。那些怪手仍然搭在井沿，嘶吼声在井里回荡着，但你已经不想再去分辨了，你径直逃了出去。
lines.textEn: You barely have time to think "to hell with this" before your body moves on its own. You scramble back and jump to your feet, never taking your eyes off the well. The hands still lie on the rim, the words echo from the depths, but you do not care. You run away headlong.

lines.textCh: 仿佛屏障散去了一般，周围的世界重新焕发生机。所有声音都回来了，鸟儿在歌唱，孩童在欢笑。阳光温暖着你的头顶。你意识到井底的恶灵——无论那到底是什么，确实已经消散了。你在原地又等了一会儿，以防万一，然后站起身来。你总觉得，你刚刚又一次死里逃生。
lines.textEn: The world around you comes alive again. All the sounds return, birds sing, children laugh. The sun warms your head. You realize the spirit has truly gone. You wait a little longer, just in case, then get to your feet. You cannot shake the feeling that you just dodged death.

lines.textCh:
直到走回小贩们聚集的广场前，你才停下脚步。众人用怀疑的目光盯着你，屠夫却露出一丝冷笑。
你喘着粗气，用双手撑着膝盖努力尝试平复呼吸。终于，你的心跳不再砰砰作响。
显然，井里的那个东西想杀了你。它已经夺走了多少条性命？
你环顾四周。村子里一切照旧，仿佛那口诅咒之井与任何人都毫无关系。也许它本来也不应该和你有什么交集？
lines.textEn:
You only stop when you reach the square by the vendors. Everyone eyes you with suspicion, and the sausage man smirks.
Hands on your knees, you breathe heavily and steady yourself. Calm finally returns and your heart stops pounding.
That thing wanted to kill you. How many has it taken already?
You look around. The village goes on with its life, as if a cursed well does not concern anyone. Maybe it should not concern you either?

lines.textCh: 没时间想这个了。最好还是问问卖牛奶的。
lines.textEn: No time to brood on it. It's best to question the milk seller as well.

lines.textCh: 没错，最好还是去问问卖牛奶的妇人。
lines.textEn: Exactly. It's best to question the milk seller as well.

lines.textCh: 你回到了集市上，环望四周。所有摊贩都在自己的摊子上忙碌着。你盯着那个屠夫，可他根本不打算朝你这看一眼。算了，反正你也不是专门回来兴师问罪的。
lines.textEn: You return to the market and look around. All the vendors are at their stalls. You glance at the butcher, but he does not even look your way. Well, you did not come here for him.

lines.textCh:
你挤出一副笑容靠近了卖牛奶的妇人。她也许知道更多情况，所以礼貌一点准没错。要是能拉近些关系，说不定能打探到更多消息。

— 哎呀呀，这是哪位帅小伙儿光临我们村子啦！— 她咧嘴一笑，你能看到她少了一颗牙。— 是来点牛奶，还是来聊天呢？
lines.textEn:
You approach the milk seller with a friendly smile. She might know something, so it is best to be nice. Friendly talk loosens tongues.

— Well now, what handsome fellow has dropped by our village! — she grins wide. She is missing a tooth. — Here for milk or for a chat?

lines.textCh: 给我倒一杯吧。
lines.textEn: Pour me one.

lines.textCh: 哨站怎么了？
lines.textEn: What happened to the outpost?

lines.textCh:
妇人轻笑一声，双手叉腰。
— 那你可是找对人了！我自打天亮就站这儿了，累得够呛，连个聊天的都没有。

她叹了口气，带着不满望向那条河。看得出那个哨所让她心怀怨念。

— 那些人来了之后就把城里的人杀得七零八落，自打那以后，过往的旅人就越来越少了。大家都绕道而行。你也晓得，没有过路旅客，村子就没有生意。你能想象牛奶卖不出去白白倒掉的场面吗？！
lines.textEn:
The vendor gives a short laugh and plants her fists on her hips.
— You came to the right person! I have been standing here since dawn, tired already, and there's no one even to chat with.

She sighs and looks toward the river with disapproval. You can tell that outpost rubbed her the wrong way.

— When those people came and cut up the city folks, fewer travelers started showing up. Everyone goes around. And you know, without travelers there is no trade. I have to pour out part of the milk, can you imagine?!

lines.textCh: “那些人”到底是什么来头？
lines.textEn: Where did "those people" even come from?

lines.textCh:
她摇了摇手。

— 是打河对岸来的，我也不清楚。最近的年景很糟糕，也许他们是军队里的逃兵，打算驻扎在这里吃拿卡要。

她环顾四周，随后微微俯身凑近你耳语道：

— 但我觉得是村里的长老把他们召来的，哨所里的强盗都是长老的人。他们每次收到过路费，长老都能分一杯羹。而过路的人不得不掏钱，全是因为他的诡计！
lines.textEn:
She waves a hand.

— From across the river. I do not know for sure. Times are restless here, maybe they broke off from the armies and decided to make coin.

She glances around and leans in a little.

— But I think the elder is the one who called them. They're his buddies. He gets a bit of share from them. And we only part with our money because of his scheme!

lines.textCh:
— 我要是识字，早就动笔自己写了。但整个村子只有长老认识字，况且他不知道为什么就是不肯动笔求助，说是有这帮人守着河岸也好，比塔格勒派来的卫兵靠谱多了，之类的话！但实际上，那些强盗只管压榨过路人的油水，搞得没人愿意从这里经过了。

她大声擤了擤鼻子。

— 长老肯定和那些人有交易，说不定就是他自己把那些坏人叫来的。他收钱是收得舒服了，可是我们呢？啥也得不到！
lines.textEn:
— I would write if I could. Only our elder knows how, and he is not writing for some reason. Says it is better with them. They protect us better than those Targrad guards, he says! But in reality, they just shake people down at the crossing.

She snorts loudly.

— He made a deal with them. Maybe he called them himself. Well it's good for him, he gets some coin. And us? Nothing!

lines.textCh: 妇人继续说个没完，你发觉唯一能帮你过河的人恐怕只有村里的长老了。你必须得上门拜访一下他。
lines.textEn: She keeps talking, and you realize the only person who can help you cross the river is the elder. You need to visit him.

lines.textCh: 前往长者处。
lines.textEn: Go to the elder.

lines.textCh:
长老的住处并不难找——高高的屋顶在周围一众简朴的小屋环绕之下显得格格不入，一望即知整个村子的财富都把握在谁手中
院子里，一头狗在坚固的栅栏后对着你狂吠。它一路蹦跳着奔向栅栏，向着你这个不速之客猛扑过来。
lines.textEn:
It is not hard to find the elder’s house: it is the richest in the village and rises above the modest roofs around it.
In the yard, behind a sturdy fence, a dog greets you with loud barking. It jumps at the fence, trying to reach you.

lines.textCh: 哪来的狗，决不后退！
lines.textEn: Some mutt is not going to scare you! Stand your ground.

lines.textCh: 你狠狠盯着那只狂叫不止的狗，脸上毫无惧色。它根本够不到你，所以无需害怕。你可是见多识广的信使，一条杂种狗可吓不倒你。
lines.textEn: You stare down the barking dog. Not a muscle twitches on your face. It will not reach you, so you aren't afraid. You have seen worse things than some mutt.

lines.textCh:
你决定还是不要冒这个险。没错，围栏应该能挡下这条臭狗，但万一节外生枝呢？你后退几步，狗几乎立刻安静下来。
看样子它是训练有素。
— 伙计，你对着谁叫呢？
一个男人从屋里出来，你立刻明白他就是屋子的主人。狗摇着尾巴欢快地冲向他，发出讨好的呜咽声。他揉了揉狗的耳朵，然后看向你。
— 你是谁？
你正要回答时，长老举起了一只手。
— 进来吧，我们进去说。门开着呢，进来吧。
lines.textEn:
You decide not to risk it. Yes, the fence can hold, but there is always a chance things go wrong. You step back a few paces, and the dog quiets almost at once.
It is well trained.
— Buddy, what is all this barking for?
A man comes out of the house. You immediately understand he is the owner. The dog rushes to him with a happy yelp and wags its tail. He rubs its ear, then looks at you.
— Who might you be?
You are about to answer when the elder raises a hand.
— Come inside. We will talk there. The gate is open, come in.

lines.textCh: 那条狗似乎察觉到你对它的努力不屑一顾，于是低吼着贴地俯下身子。转眼间，它就已经跃过了栅栏，利齿深深咬进你的手臂。剧痛瞬间席卷全身。你猛地后退，试图甩开狗，却毫无作用。狗嘴已经牢牢钳住你的手臂，不肯轻易放脱。
lines.textEn: The dog, as if noticing you don't care about its efforts, growls and flattens to the ground. In a heartbeat it vaults the fence and sinks its teeth into your arm. Pain engulfs you. You jerk back, try to shake the dog off, but nothing works. The jaws are locked.

lines.textCh:
— 伙计，退下！坐！
你的救星从屋里现身。狗立刻松开你，蹦到一旁摇着尾巴。你真想踢它一脚，却不敢当着主人的面动手。
— 好孩子，真是条好狗！— 男人说着打开栅门，把狗引了回去。他瞥了瞥你的手臂，瘪了瘪嘴。
— 抱歉，这狗只是在恪尽职守而已。进来吧，让我看看你的手臂。
lines.textEn:
— Buddy, back! Sit!
Your savior appears from the house. The dog releases you at once, jumps aside, and wags its tail. You really want to kick it, but you do not dare in front of the owner.
— Good boy, a real guardian! — the man says as he opens the gate and ushers the dog back in. Looking over your arm, he clicks his tongue.
— Apologies. The dog is just doing his job. Come inside, let's see your arm.

lines.textCh:
你推开栅门走向屋门，那条狗仍然紧盯着你，这次却没有再扑过来，仿佛明白主人已经邀请你进入院子。
屋内暖意融融，飘着面包刚出炉的香气。长老没有请你坐下。
— 你是谁？你要去哪儿？村子里可从没见过你这号人物。
lines.textEn:
You push the gate and walk toward the door. The dog watches you but does not attack, as if it understands its master invited you in.
Inside is warm and smells of fresh bread. The elder does not offer you a seat.
— Who are you and where are you headed? I have not seen you in the village before.

lines.textCh:
屋里，那位显然是村庄长老的人检查了你的手臂。狗咬出的伤口没有深到见骨的程度，流血也不多。伤口虽然疼，但没什么大碍。他亲自用一条亚麻布条给你包扎起来。
— 你会没事的，别担心。你到我这里来干什么？
lines.textEn:
Inside, the man, obviously the village elder, examines your arm. The dog did not bite down to the bone, there isn't much blood. The bite aches but is nothing serious. He wraps it with a strip of linen himself.
— You'll live, don't worry. Why did you come here?

lines.textCh:
你向他说明自己需要前往塔格勒，并提到了渡口以及里面的强盗。那名老者嘴角上扬，双手抱在胸前。
— 现在是我的朋友们守在那里。如果不给够报酬的话，他们是不会放任何人过河的。但倘若你帮我一个忙，我就能让你过去。
lines.textEn:
You explain you need to get to Targrad and mention the crossing. The elder smirks and folds his arms across his chest.
— My friends are posted there now. They do not let anyone through, and if they do, they ask for gold. I can help you if you help me.

lines.textCh: 那我要是绕开渡口另找一条路，阁下又该如何应对？
lines.textEn: What is stopping me from going around the crossing and finding another way?

lines.textCh:
长老露出令人不快的笑容，嗤笑起来。
— 倘若你愿意多花上三天时间，不妨试着找到最近的浅滩蹚水过去。但今年春天的水位可是上涨了不少，那条路恐怕已经没了……
你意识到自己别无选择。
lines.textEn:
The elder smiles in an unpleasant way and laughs.
— If you have three days to spare, you can try to reach the nearest ford. But spring was rough this year, it might have been washed out...
You realize you do not really have a choice.

lines.textCh: 先告诉我你要我办什么事吧。
lines.textEn: Tell me what you need first.

lines.textCh:
— 不久之前，附近发生了一场恶战。Turva 和 Karhu 两边再度交锋。有个贵族出身的年轻人，据传他逃离了塔格勒的家族加入了战士行列。战斗早在几天前就打完了，但那家伙和他的人始终没回来。
老人停顿片刻，确认你听清楚了。
你示意自己在听。
— 那么，事情就是，这个家伙带着人从我们这儿歇脚的时候，我留心到他手上戴着个不错的戒指。把那个给我找来。
lines.textEn:
— Not long ago there was a battle nearby. Turva and Karhu crossed blades again. There was a young man, a noble. By rumor he ran away from Targrad to join the warriors. The battle was a couple of days ago, but that fellow and his men never returned.
The elder pauses to make sure you are listening.
You are listening.
— So. When that fellow was here, I noticed a nice ring on him. You need to find it.

lines.textCh:
— 爽快，我喜欢你这个态度！— 长老面露微笑。
— 不久之前，附近发生了一场恶战。Turva 和 Karhu 两边再度交锋。有个贵族出身的年轻人，据传他逃离了塔格勒的家族加入了战士行列。战斗早在几天前就打完了，但那家伙和他的人始终没回来。
老人停顿片刻，确认你听清楚了。
你示意自己在听。
— 那么，事情就是，这个家伙带着人从我们这儿歇脚的时候，我留心到他手上戴着个不错的戒指。把那个给我找来。
lines.textEn:
— I like that attitude! — the elder smiles.
— Not long ago there was a battle nearby. Turva and Karhu crossed blades again. There was a young man, a noble. By rumor he ran away from Targrad to join the warriors. The battle was a couple of days ago, but that fellow and his men never returned.
The elder pauses to make sure you are listening.
You are listening.
— So. When that fellow was here, I noticed a nice ring on him. You need to find it.

lines.textCh: 他说的难道就是你找到的那枚戒指？
lines.textEn: Is he talking about that one ring you found?

lines.textCh:
你卸下背上的行囊，打开背包翻找起来。老者一脸疑惑地看着你这番举动。
终于，你摸到戒指，把它拿了出来。
— 这就是你要找的东西吗？
长老眼前一亮，他往前走近了一步，眼睛始终盯着那枚戒指。
— 没错，没错，就是这个！看样子你已经去过战场上了，收获还不小呢，是吧？— 他咧嘴而笑，紧接着摆了摆手。— 把它放在桌上，我会为你写一封路条，把条子给哨站的人看，他们就会放你过去。
lines.textEn:
You take your travel pack off your back, open it, and rummage. The elder watches, puzzled.
At last you feel the ring and pull it out.
— Is this what you are looking for?
The elder’s eyes flare at once. He steps forward, unable to take his eyes off the ring.
— Yes, yes, that is it! You already visited the field, did you? — he smirks, then waves a hand. — Put it on the table. I will write a letter to the outpost so they let you pass.

lines.textCh:
长老对你的蠢问题嗤之以鼻。
— 那片战场现在早就成了乱葬岗了。你觉得我会去那种死人堆里东翻西找，把每个死鬼的手都检查一遍吗？村子里的谣言可是传得飞快。
他冷冷看着你，眼睛早已没了先前的暖意。
— 你掰扯够了吧，现在就去找，别浪费我的时间。
lines.textEn:
The elder snorts at your question.
— The battlefield is an open graveyard right now. And how would I look, walking among the dead and inspecting their hands? News travels fast in this village.
He looks at you with less warmth.
— That is all. Go now, don't waste my time.

lines.textCh: 你知道自己别无选择。你没带多少钱上路，所以肯定是出不起过路钱的。你点了点头，离开了长老的屋子，无论如何，你都得找到那个该死的戒指。
lines.textEn: You realize you have no choice. You haven't brought much money with you, so you cannot pay for the crossing. You nod and leave the elder’s house. You will have to find that damn ring.

lines.textCh:
出乎你的意料，战场并非一片死寂——你总以为死亡经过之处必归于寂静，但自然界并不会为了谁而特意驻足哀悼。况且，又哀悼谁呢？那些因为些许怨恨就拔刀相向自相残杀的人？

你看到了尸体、撕碎的战旗，以及四处散落的武器。你用袖子捂住口鼻，试图掩盖住扑面而来的死亡气息。
你得找到那个戒指，但它又会在哪呢？
lines.textEn:
The battlefield greets you with a hundred simultaneous sounds. You always thought where death had passed there would be silence, but nature has no time for mourning. Besides, mourning whom? People who kill each other over petty grievances?

You look at the bodies, broken banners, and fallen weapons. You press your sleeve to your nose and mouth to keep the stench of death from dizzying you.
Your goal is the ring. But where could it be?

lines.textCh: 先检查一下士兵们的尸体。
lines.textEn: Check the bodies first.

lines.textCh: 你走向散落在地面上的尸体。微风轻拂，让你得以短暂逃离空气中的腐败恶臭，呼吸到新鲜一些的空气。现在你可以仔细查看这些尸体了。
lines.textEn: You approach the bodies lying on the ground. A light breeze blows, letting you inhale without the stench of decay. Now you can examine the bodies.

lines.textCh:
你走向那匹马。刺鼻的气味令人窒息，呛得你眼泪直流。你看着这可怜的动物和旁边散架的马车。战争对任何人都不留情面，连动物也不例外。
你绕着死马转了一圈，发现这里根本没有骑手，也从来没有过。你应该检查一下士兵们的尸体。
lines.textEn:
You approach the horse. The smell is suffocating and sharp, making your eyes water. You look at the poor animal and the broken cart nearby. War shows no mercy to anyone, not even animals.
You circle the carcass and realize there is no rider here, and never was. You should search the bodies.

lines.textCh:
你走近些。已经许久没下过雨了，地面干涸尘土飞扬。尸体旁的草丛沾染着干涸的血迹。即便近在咫尺，风也无法完全掩盖那股死亡的腐臭味。
你的目光掠过地上的尸体。
lines.textEn:
You move closer. It hasn’t rained in a long time, so the ground is dry and dusty. Next to the bodies, the grass is stained with dried blood. Even in this proximity, the wind doesn’t mask the scent.
Your gaze slides over the fallen.

lines.textCh: 太可惜了，他们的人生才刚刚开始。
lines.textEn: Saddening. They still had life ahead of them.

lines.textCh:
你摇头叹息，满腹忧愁地看着那些尸体。战争从不留情，哪怕是老幼妇孺也无法幸免。
突然，你注意到其中一具尸体手指上的戒指。
lines.textEn:
You shake your head, looking at the bodies with sorrow. War spares no one, neither the young nor the old.
Suddenly, your attention is drawn to the ring on one of the dead men.

lines.textCh:
你抿着嘴唇，凝视着那些尸体。你并不为他们感到可惜。这些人做出了自己的选择，也拥抱了自己的命运：任何战士都有可能会沦为乌鸦啄食的尸骸。
你的目光掠过地上的尸体，突然注意到其中一人手指上戒指的反光。
lines.textEn:
You purse your lips, looking at the bodies. You feel no pity: these people chose this path. Any warrior risks ending up a corpse among crows.
Your eyes sweep over the fallen, and you notice the glint of a ring on one of them.

lines.textCh: 你走近了一些，蹲在骑手的尸体旁。尸体以一种不自然的姿势躺在地上，但紧闭着双眼，面容安详。你立刻注意到这人的衣着比其他人更华贵。很明显，这就是长老提到的那个贵族。
lines.textEn: You crouch near the body. The corpse lies in an unnatural position, but his eyes are closed and his face is peaceful. You immediately notice that the man’s clothing is richer than the others’. This is clearly the noble the elder talked about.

lines.textCh: 拿走戒指。
lines.textEn: Take the ring.

lines.textCh:
你环顾四周，仿佛有人会看见你。你从未偷过东西，但……戒指的主人已经死了，他不再需要它了，而你，却得用它付过路费前往塔格勒……
你从原主人毫无生气的手中拿下了戒指。
恍惚间，你悚然觉得尸体仿佛随时会握紧拳头发出低吼，但什么也没发生。你只是默默收起戒指，放进背包。现在你可以回村去找长老复命了。
lines.textEn:
You look around, as if someone might see you. You’ve never stolen anything, but... the owner of the ring is already dead, he doesn’t need it anymore, but you need it to get to Targrad...
You remove the ring from the lifeless hand.
It feels as if the corpse might squeeze his hand and growl, but nothing happens. You simply take the ring and place it in your bag. Now you can return to the village.

lines.textCh:
你径直回到了长者的宅子。这一回，狗被好好地拴在院子里，甚至没有再朝你叫一声——看起来他已经认出了你。你推门进了屋子。老人从长凳上起身迎接你，神情略显惊讶。
— 这么快！找到了吗？
你点头将戒指递给他。你只想尽快摆脱这枚戒指，离开这个村庄。
他接过戒指，朝长凳的方向指了一下，示意你坐下。
— 坐会儿，我给哨站的朋友写封信。把路条交给他们，他们就会放你通过。
lines.textEn:
You head straight back to the elder’s house. The dog is tied this time and does not even bark — seems like it remembers you. You enter. The elder rises from the bench to meet you, somewhat surprised.
— That was quick! Did you find it?
You nod and hand him the ring. You want to get rid of it and leave the village as soon as possible.
He takes the ring and nods at the bench.
— Sit for a bit. I will write a letter to my friends at the outpost. Hand it over and they will let you through.

lines.textCh:
你手持长老的信件走向路口。这次你信心十足，即便这帮强盗高声喝斥，你也纹丝不动。你将信递给走出来的人。

他反复翻看纸张，吐了口唾沫，便将信收进屋里。

— 在这等着。

过了大概十分钟后，他又折返出来。

— 拿上你的信。— 他把字条还给了你。— 现在滚吧。
lines.textEn:
You approach the crossing with the elder’s letter in hand. This time you feel confident and do not even flinch when they shout. You hand the letter to the man who comes out.

He turns the paper over and over, spits, and takes it somewhere inside.

— Wait here.

About ten minutes later he returns.

— Take it. — he hands the letter back. — Now beat it.

lines.textCh:
你回到长老的屋子。门槛上的狗惊讶地抬起头。似乎它没料到还会见到你。
你冲进屋内。长老猛地站起身，皱起眉头。你厉声索要暗号。
— 什么暗号？哪有什么暗号！— 显然，他并不习惯撒谎，脸挣得通红。— 你自己想想好了。我没必要故意为难你。我已经拿到了我要的东西，巴不得你走得越远越好。我不知道什么暗号。现在给我滚出我的家。
lines.textEn:
You return to the elder’s house. The dog on the threshold lifts its head in surprise. Seems like it did not expect to see you again.
You burst into the house. The elder jumps up at once and frowns. You demand the password.
— What password? There was no password! — he is not a good liar. — Think about it. Why would I do that? I got what I wanted. I do not need you here. I know no passwords. Now get out of my house.

lines.textCh:
— 好了……暗号是对的。— 渡口的男子皱起眉头。看来他本想再逗弄你几句取乐。但既然你已经报出了暗号，便没必要再和你纠缠下去。
他挥了挥手。
— 走吧，我叫人把你送过河。
lines.textEn:
— All right... The password's correct. — the man at the crossing frowns. Looks like he wanted to mess with you a bit more for fun. But you said the correct word, so there is no point dragging it out.
He waves a hand.
— Come on. I will have you escorted to the other bank.

你将戒指递给头目，他立刻把你放了下来，一把攫过那枚饰品，透过头盔的缝隙仔细端详起来。
— 你要是愿意付钱那早就该开口。— 他把戒指收进了自己的腰包。— 现在，口令。
lines.textEn:
You hand the ring to the chief. He lets you go at once, snatches the trinket, and studies it through the slits of his helmet.
— Should've done that from the start. — The ring disappears into his belt pouch. — Now say the password.

lines.textCh: 信有什么问题吗？
lines.textEn: Something wrong with the letter?

lines.textCh: — 不，信没问题。— 那人咧嘴一笑，朝你脚边吐了口唾沫。— 但没有暗号。如果你不报暗号，我们可绝不会让你通过。
lines.textEn: — Nah, the letter's good. — the man grins and spits at your feet. — But there is no password. We will not let you through without a password.

lines.textCh: — 当然没问题！— 那人咧嘴一笑，朝你脚边吐了口唾沫。— 你没报暗号。如果你不报对暗号，我们可绝不会让你通过。
lines.textEn: — Of course not! — the man grins and spits at your feet. — You have no password. We will not let you through without a password.

lines.textCh:
卖牛奶的妇人移开了脸，长叹一口气。

— 嗯……之前守着渡口的都是些好人，他们经常来村子里找我们的姑娘们玩。然后那些强盗就出现了。— 她抿着嘴唇表示不满，— 然后就变成这样了，小伙子们死的死，逃的逃了。
lines.textEn:
The milk seller’s face shifts and she sighs.

— Well... There were decent lads there once, used to visit our girls often. Then those thugs showed up, — she presses her lips in displeasure, — and that was that. The lads are gone.

lines.textCh:
— 我……我知道暗号。
你的脑海中突然浮现了一串字母组合，但你已经来不及多想了，这段暗号不对也得对了。
— 真的吗？那就报出来啊。
那个男人用怀疑的眼神打量着你。
lines.textEn:
— I... I know the password.
The knowledge surfaces in your mind as if on its own, but you do not doubt it. The password is correct.
— Really? Then go on, say it.
The man is eyeing you with suspicion.

lines.textCh: 暗号是 Tetriandoch。
lines.textEn: The password is Tetriandoch.

lines.textCh:
妇人迅速将牛奶倒入一个木杯，伸手递给你。你掏口袋想要付钱，妇人却摇了摇头。

— 不必了，孩子，别客气。就当是我请客吧，我们这儿欢迎客人。

你有些不好意思，但还是答应了。你不想拒绝她的好意，于是接过了杯子啜饮一口。你从没尝过如此美味的牛奶，你一饮而尽，用袖子擦了擦嘴。

— 好喝吗？妇人笑着说。你点点头。看得出来，她的心情很好，或许会分享些有用的信息。

— 我们村子很久没有外人来过了。自从那个哨所出事后，就没再……
lines.textEn:
The merchant woman quickly pours you some milk into a wooden mug and hands it over. You reach for money, but the woman shakes her head.

— No, dear, don’t. Consider it my treat. We like travelers here.

You feel awkward, but you agree. You don’t feel like arguing at all. You take the mug and sip. You’ve never tasted milk this good. You finish it all and wipe your mouth with your sleeve.

— Like it, don't'cha? — the woman laughs. You nod. The woman is in high spirits now. Maybe she’ll share something useful.

— It’s been a long time since we’ve had anyone here. Ever since what happened with the outpost…

lines.textEn: Exit

lines.textCh:
战场以百般声响迎接你的到来。你离开时的一切未曾改变，唯有血腥味愈发浓烈。你皱起眉头，耸了耸肩，径直走向那些尸体。现在还是不要磨磨蹭蹭的好。

死去的战士尸体仍倒在地面上，鲜血已经把泥土染成了暗红色。你蹲在他身旁，准备好这一次拿走他的戒指。
lines.textEn:
The battlefield greets you with a hundred sounds at once. Nothinmg changed while you were, except the smell is now stronger. You wince, roll your shoulders, and head straight for the bodies. No point delaying.

The fallen warrior lies on ground soaked with blood. You crouch beside him, ready this time to take the ring.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
你重返战场。百般声响与骇人恶臭迎面扑来，你不得不用衣袖捂住自己的口鼻。

你环顾四周，可又该去哪里寻找那枚戒指？
lines.textEn:
You return to the battlefield. It greets you with a hundred sounds and a horrible stench. You have to cover your nose and mouth with your sleeve.

You look around. Where should you search for the ring?

lines.textCh: 先检查一下士兵们的尸体。
lines.textEn: Check the bodies first.

lines.textCh: 拿走戒指。
lines.textEn: Take the ring.

lines.textCh: 检查尸体。
lines.textEn: Examine the bodies.

lines.textCh:
你注视着几具躺在血泊中的尸体，随后走近。一个衣着华丽的男人吸引了你的注意。

你蹲在他身旁。烈日曝晒的尸体散发出的恶臭扑面而来。你屏住呼吸，仔细检查死者的双手。

你很快找到了那枚戒指。
lines.textEn:
You focus on several corpses lying on the blood-soaked ground, then come closer. One man with richer clothing catches your attention.

You crouch beside him. The stench of sun-baked bodies hits you harder. You hold your breath while you examine the dead man’s hands.

You find the ring quickly.

lines.textCh: 拿走戒指。
lines.textEn: Take the ring.

lines.textCh:
你本来想把香肠留着之后再大快朵颐，但现在情况紧急，你必须做出取舍了。

你从背包里掏出的那块香肠飞越篱笆。狗儿先是畏缩，随即嗅到气味，便悄悄靠近。它扑向食物的模样，就像是有好几年没吃过饱饭一样。
lines.textEn:
You wanted to eat the sausage yourself later, but the situation calls for sacrifice. You are ready to make it.

The piece of sausage you pull from your pack flies over the fence. The dog flinches at first, then, catching the scent, edges closer. It grabs the food like it has not been fed in years.

lines.textCh: 进入院子。
lines.textEn: Enter the yard.

lines.textCh: 狗正忙着享用它的意外之财，通往屋子的路畅通无阻。你小心翼翼地推开栅栏门，踏了进去。
lines.textEn: The dog is busy with its windfall, which means the way to the house is open. You carefully open the gate and step inside.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
一个男人从屋里走了出来。他看起来约莫四十岁 — 身材高大，肩宽体壮，衬衫紧绷着圆滚滚的肚子。你立刻明白，此人便是村里的长者。

— 搞什么鬼？你喂我的狗干什么？现在它要怎么看门？它吃饱了只会犯懒！

他踢了踢狗，把它从香肠旁赶开。狗呜咽着，却乖乖退后，贪婪地盯着剩下的肉块。

— 不过你的小聪明确实很机灵，— 长老打量着你，又朝身后点头示意。— 进来吧。说说你来找我有什么事。
lines.textEn:
A man comes out of the house. He looks around forty — tall, broad-shouldered, with a belly taut under his shirt. You immediately understand this is the village elder.

— What is this? Feeding my dog? How is he supposed to guard then? He cannot do it on a full belly!

He kicks the dog, driving it away from the sausage. It yelps but obediently backs off, staring greedily at the leftover chunk.

— But I will praise your wits, — the elder says, looking you over, then nods behind himself. — Come inside. Tell me what you came for.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
你和长老一起走进门，屋内暖意融融，飘着面包刚出炉的香气。但他并没有请你坐下。

— 你是谁？你要去哪儿？村子里可从没见过你这号人物。
lines.textEn:
You go inside with the elder. It is warm and smells of fresh bread. He does not offer you a seat.

— Who are you and where are you headed? I have not seen you in the village before.

lines.textCh: 你看着眼前这个人，意识到不值得冒这个险。他们会毫不犹豫地杀了你，眼睛都不眨。不，还是再去找那位长老，问问他在玩什么把戏。
lines.textEn: You look at the man standing in front of you and realize it’s not worth the risk. They’d just kill you without a second thought. No, better to visit the elder again and ask what kind of game he’s playing.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
你在长老那儿一无所获，悻悻地出了门。现在怎么办？到底该上哪里找这该死的密码？

事情绝非表面看起来那么简单。但只要你深入探究，肯定能找到最后的出路。整个世界仿佛充满了难解的谜题，但这正是冒险的乐趣所在，不是吗？

你知道你需要好好思考。或许你该休息一下，也许向你旅途之外的朋友寻求帮助。
lines.textEn:
You leave the elder empty-handed. Now what? Where are you supposed to find this damn password?

There’s got to be more to this than it seems. If you dig deep enough, you’ll find a way forward. This whole world feels like it’s made of nothing but puzzles. But isn’t that what makes it more exciting?

You know you need to think. Maybe you should rest. Or maybe turn to one of your friends outside your path for help.

lines.textCh: 冒险一试！
lines.textEn: Take the risk!

lines.textCh:
你没时间来回奔波去追查什么密码。于是你决定采取行动。

你猛地向前一扑，把那人推开。他显然没料到你会如此大胆，一时没能反应过来。你飞奔向前，溜进了哨站的大门。
lines.textEn:
You don’t have time to run back and forth chasing down some password. So you decide to act.

You lunge forward, shoving the man out of your way. He clearly didn’t expect that kind of boldness and doesn’t react right away. You sprint ahead, slipping through the gate of the outpost.

lines.textCh: 不要停下来啊！
lines.textEn: Don’t stop running!

lines.textCh:
你继续前进，一溜烟冲进了大门。

眼前是一处狭小的庭院，庭院尽头便是通往对岸的桥。你的目标近在咫尺！

但哨所里守卫的不仅仅是你刚才甩在身后的那一个强盗而已。院子里还有几个人正在打牌。他们一看到你，立刻跳起身来，抓起武器。

— 你他妈的往哪跑呢？！— 其中一人高声咒骂道，随即吹响一声尖利的口哨。
lines.textEn:
You keep going, bursting through the gate.

Ahead of you lies a tiny courtyard, and just beyond it the bridge to the other side. Your goal is so close!

But the outpost isn’t guarded by just the man you left behind. In the courtyard, a few others are playing cards. The moment they spot you, they leap to their feet and grab their weapons.

— Where the hell do you think you’re going?! — one of them curses, then whistles sharply.

lines.textCh: 继续冲刺。
lines.textEn: Charge through.

lines.textCh:
你别无选择，只能孤注一掷。

你像个狂战士般冲了出去，一边嘶吼着，一半是为了吓退强盗，一半是为了给自己打气。

但你只冲到了庭院的中间。
lines.textEn:
You have no choice but to go all in.

Like a berserker, you dash forward, yelling, half to scare the bandits, half to steel yourself.

But you only make it halfway across the courtyard.

lines.textCh:
你顿时僵住了，不知该如何是好。往回跑？不，那太蠢了。往前冲？你连武器都没有！

不过，你已经没机会做决定了。
lines.textEn:
You freeze, unsure what to do. Run back? No, that’s stupid. Forward? You don’t even have a weapon!

Not that you get the chance to decide.

lines.textCh:
你决定转身离开。显然，你高估了自己。

你举起双手，勉强挤出一个半分愧疚半分尴尬的笑容，然后退后了一步。你甚至连一句辩解的话都没能说出口。
lines.textEn:
You decide to turn back. Clearly, you’ve overestimated yourself.

You raise your hands, force a guilty smile, and step back. You don’t even manage to say a word in your defense.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
突然，你听到一声微弱的呼啸声，紧接着，有什么东西猛地撞上了你的肩膀。那种疼痛仿佛有人正试图将你的手臂连根扯下来。你下意识地用手捂住伤口。

你中了一箭。
lines.textEn:
Suddenly, you hear a faint whistle, and a moment later something slams into your shoulder. The pain feels like someone’s trying to rip your arm clean off. Instinctively, you clutch the wound with your hand.

An arrow hits you.

lines.textCh: 快藏起来！
lines.textEn: Hide, quickly!

lines.textCh:
但你还没来得及喘口气，另一支箭便从另一侧射来。这支箭深深扎进了你的大腿，你踉跄了一下，单膝跪倒在地。

你像被逼入绝境的野兽般惨叫，恳求他们停手，但第三支箭却径直穿透了你的头颅。

你瘫倒在地，气息全无。也许在你的无名墓碑上，他们会刻下“勇敢的傻瓜蛋”，作为你可悲的一生的评价。
lines.textEn:
But before you can even catch your breath, another arrow strikes you from the other side. This one buries itself in your thigh, and you stumble, dropping to one knee.

You scream like a cornered animal, begging them to stop, but the third arrow punches straight through your skull.

You collapse lifelessly. On your nameless grave they’ll write “Brave, but foolish”.

lines.textCh: 死亡
lines.textEn: DEATH

lines.textCh: 你从钱袋里掏出一枚金币，利落地抛进了漆黑的井口中。你本以为会听到“噗通”一声，但足足过了一秒钟也没有任何动静。这井真的有那么深吗？
lines.textEn: You pull a gold coin from your pouch and toss it neatly into the dark mouth of the well. A second later you expect to hear a splash, but nothing comes. Is it really that deep?

lines.textCh: 太奇怪了，最好小心行事，后退几步。
lines.textEn: Strange. Better play it safe and step back.

lines.textCh:
你耸了耸肩，又往井里扔了一枚硬币。这次，有个闪闪发光的东西猛地弹射上来，正中你的额头，随后又弹回井底。

接着，你听见井底“哗啦”一声水响。

那口井刚刚把你的硬币丢了回来！或者说，是井底盘踞着的那个东西扔回来的。
lines.textEn:
You shrug and toss another coin into the well. This time, something shiny shoots back up and smacks you square in the forehead before bouncing back down.

Now you hear a splash.

The well just threw your coin at you! Or whatever lives inside it did.

lines.textCh: 还是不要再冒这个险了。小心为上。
lines.textEn: Better not risk it again. Play it safe.

lines.textCh:
你向井里张望，只见一片漆黑。在下面深不见底的某处，你能听到水花四溅的声音。突然，一阵奇怪的叮当声从深处传来。

你俯下身子，试图看清声音的来源。
lines.textEn:
You peer inside and see nothing but darkness. Deep, deep below, you can hear water splashing. Suddenly, a strange ringing sound rises from the depths.

You lean lower, trying to catch sight of its source.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 检查尸体。
lines.textEn: Examine the body.

lines.textCh: 再试一次。
lines.textEn: Try again.

lines.textCh: 眼前的沼泽绵延不绝，太阳仿佛躲了起来，穿入云中不肯露面。你向前走着，不时微微蹙起眉头，身上的伤口仍然疼痛不止，因此赶路速度要慢上一些，但眼下所有的艰难困苦都已留在身后——塔格勒已经近在咫尺。
lines.textEn: Ahead, the swamps stretch out. The sun hides behind clouds more and more often. You walk forward, frowning slightly. All your scratches hurt, so you move slower than planned. But it’s fine: surely all the difficulties are behind you. Targrad is not far now.

lines.textCh: 返回。
lines.textEn: Go back.

lines.textCh: 继续赶路。
lines.textEn: Continue on your way.

lines.textCh: 最好还是先仔细打量打量这座屋子。
lines.textEn: Better examine the house more carefully.

lines.textCh: 检查尸体。
lines.textEn: Examine the body.

lines.textCh: 还是把它留在原地吧。
lines.textEn: Better leave it.

lines.textCh: 最好还是不要再试了。
lines.textEn: Perhaps it's better not try this again.

lines.textCh: 我什么也不知道，饶命！
lines.textEn: I didn’t know! Spare me!

lines.textCh: 你是谁？
lines.textEn: Who are you?

lines.textCh: 待在原地不动。
lines.textEn: Freeze in place.

lines.textCh: 跑！
lines.textEn: Run!

lines.textCh: 哈！你就这点能耐？
lines.textEn: Ha! Is that all you've got?

lines.textCh: 保持沉默。
lines.textEn: Remain silent.

lines.textCh:
终于，你抵达了河对岸。回望渡口，身后没有人依依不舍地为你送行。这倒也好，你再也不想看到那些强盗们的狰狞面容。
你至今仍不明白为什么自己一下子就参悟了暗号。想必是主赐予你的急中生智——而这意味着他要你安然抵达塔格勒，意味着你的使命至关重要。这份觉悟驱使你继续前行。
lines.textEn:
Finally, you reach the other side of the river. You look back at the crossing. No one is seeing you off, and that’s for the best. The last thing you want is to see the faces of those bandits again.
You still don’t understand how you knew the password. Surely it was the Lord who blessed you with secret knowledge. That means He wants you to reach Targrad. That means your work is important. This understanding pushes you forward.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 眼前的沼泽绵延不绝，太阳仿佛躲了起来，穿入云中不肯露面。你步伐轻盈地向前走去，所有的艰难困苦都已留在身后——塔格勒已经近在咫尺。
lines.textEn: Ahead, the swamps stretch out. The sun hides behind clouds more and more often. You walk forward, stepping lightly. Surely all the difficulties are behind you. Targrad is not far now.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 你不停往前走。周围的沼泽地千篇一律，让你渐渐分不清方位。半个小时过去了，一个小时过去了。你翻开地图才发现，按照路途你早就该踏上坚实的干了，而在此刻，沼泽却在你的面前无尽延伸开去。
lines.textEn: You walk and walk. The swamps around look so alike that you stop knowing exactly where you are. Half an hour passes. An hour passes. You look at the map and realize you should have reached solid, dry land, but the swamps don’t end.

lines.textCh: 继续前进。
lines.textEn: Keep moving forward.

lines.textCh: 你叹了口气，继续前行。或许地图标错了，又或者你迷失了方向。但只要沿着路走下去，迟早会抵达某个地方。对吧？……
lines.textEn: You sigh and keep moving. Maybe the map is inaccurate, maybe you lost your way. But sooner or later, you’ll reach somewhere if you stay on the path. Right?..

lines.textCh:
你停下脚步，环顾四周。肯定是在某个地方走错路了，必须原路返回。你转身朝相反方向走去。
但又走了半小时后，仍然没有看到渡口与哨所的踪影，一小时后，眼前仍然是沼泽。焦虑开始在你的心底翻涌，这到底是怎么回事？
lines.textEn:
You stop and look around. Surely you turned the wrong way somewhere. You need to go back and start over. You turn around and head away.
But you don’t see the outpost after half an hour, nor after an hour. Anxiety rises inside you. What the hell is going on?

lines.textCh:
终于，你看见前方有间小屋，便停下了脚步。周围是无法穿越的沼泽。一个人怎么可能独自在这里生存？
小屋看似打理得井井有条，但不知为何……透着一股不属于这个世界的气息。
lines.textEn:
Finally, you see a hut ahead and stop. Impassable swamps surround it. How could anyone survive here alone?
The house looks well-kept, but somehow… otherworldly.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 进屋子。
lines.textEn: Head inside.

lines.textCh:
这栋透着神秘气息的屋子还挺可爱，但现在不是插手不相干事情的时候。你必须尽快抵达塔格勒。
你绕过房子继续前行。
lines.textEn:
The house is cute and mysterious, but now is not the time to meddle in things that aren’t yours. You need to reach Targrad as soon as possible.
You pass the house and continue onward.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
你继续向前走去，走了又走。
道路如窄窄的缎带向前延伸开来，在沼泽丘陵间蜿蜒盘旋。前方出现了一处建筑，你走上前去……
lines.textEn:
You walk. And walk. And walk.
The road stretches ahead like a narrow ribbon, winding among swampy hummocks. You see a structure ahead and approach…

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
……你突然意识到，这竟是同一栋房子。甚至你上次还是从同一面靠近的它。难道你迷路了？但你记得自己是直直向前走的，根本没有回头！
这绝对是某种魔法，而房子的主人正想让你进去。
lines.textEn:
…and realize that it is the same house. You even approached it from the same side as last time. Could you have gotten lost? But you remember walking on an absolutely straight road!
This is definitely some kinnd of magic. And its owner wants you to enter the house.

lines.textCh:
门微微敞开着，你推门而入。
首先映入眼帘的是一具尸体，几乎横卧在门槛上的。接着你注意到了天花板上悬挂着草药，你意识到这座屋子的主人——或者说前主人——是一位女巫。
lines.textEn:
The door is slightly open. You push it and step inside.
The first thing you notice is a body lying almost on the threshold. Then — herbs hanging from the ceiling. You realize some witch lives here. You lower your gaze to the body. Or, rather, lived here.

lines.textCh: 进到里面。
lines.textEn: Enter inside.

lines.textCh: 让这屋子见鬼去吧！该动身了。
lines.textEn: To hell with it! Time to leave.

lines.textCh:
你正要离开，继续在沼泽中徘徊寻找出口，突然一股力量将你拉了回来。
“帮我……”
你浑身发抖地环顾四周。那声低语，你绝对听见了！但周围空无一人，只有……你望向那具尸体。寒毛倒竖的你意识到，似乎有人——或者说某种东西——不愿轻易放你离开。你别无选择。
lines.textEn:
You are about to leave and continue wandering the swamps in search of an exit, when suddenly some force pulls you back.
"Help me..."
You shiver and look around. A whisper, you definitely heard it! But there’s no one around, only… You look at the body. Goosebumps run down your spine. It seems someone — or something — doesn’t want to let you go easily. You simply have no choice.

lines.textCh: 最好还是先仔细打量打量这座屋子。
lines.textEn: Better examine the house more carefully.

lines.textCh:
你继续往里走。这间小屋显然只供一人居住：你只发现一张床铺，一套木制餐具。这里的一切都浸润着魔法气息，却意外地温馨舒适。没有装满可疑药剂的怪异大锅，没有邪恶符文，没有黑猫或公鸡。若不是它矗立在沼泽树桩之上，你根本分辨不出这里与普通的乡间小屋有任何不同。
你没发现什么有趣的东西。
lines.textEn:
You move further. The hut is clearly meant for one person: you find only one bed, one set of wooden dishes. Everything here is imbued with magic and unexpectedly homely comfort. No strange cauldrons with suspicious brews, no devilish marks, no black cats or roosters. If this hut weren’t standing on swamp stumps, you would never distinguish it from any regular village house.
You find nothing interesting.

lines.textCh: 检查尸体。
lines.textEn: Examine the body.

lines.textCh: 你靠近了尸体，停在了旁边。一名年轻女子面朝下躺着，一把剑直直地刺在她的背上。没人会主动将武器留在尸体上。你盯着那把杀人武器，意识到这把剑似乎价值不菲。
lines.textEn: You approach and stand directly over the corpse. A young woman lies face down, a sword protruding from her back. No one would voluntarily leave their weapon in a corpse. You look at the sword and realize it’s quite expensive.

lines.textCh: 拿上剑，留着自己用。
lines.textEn: Take it for yourself.

lines.textCh: 你上前抓住剑柄。突然间，掌心被一种前所未有的冰冷所刺痛，仿佛被烧灼了一样。你下意识地缩回双手。
lines.textEn: You approach and grab the sword’s hilt. Suddenly, your palms are burned by a cold like nothing you’ve ever felt. Reflexively, you pull your hands back.

lines.textCh: 你决定将剑留在原处。在你的内心深处突然浮现了一个念头，让你不愿继续玷污这个陌生人的尸体。或许你该把她移走，葬在院子里。
lines.textEn: You decide to leave the sword in place. Something inside you resists the idea of further mutilating the body of a stranger. Perhaps you should even move her and bury her in the yard.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 但就在你弯腰之前，一个幽灵突然在你眼前从尸体上升起。你猛地退后，不知所措。
lines.textEn: But before you can bend down, a ghost rises from the body right before you. You recoil, unsure what to do.

lines.textCh:
你无视警告。前方就是通往塔格勒的道路了，而先前渡口的那群强盗绝非唯一一帮趁着城市虚弱，守军自顾不暇时占山为王的匪徒。毕竟你需要的不是冰冷的尸体，而是那柄剑。
你再次抓住剑柄，咬紧牙关抵御住寒意将剑拔出。剑身从尸体中滑落。
lines.textEn:
You ignore the warning. Ahead lies the path to Targrad. Surely the bandits from the crossing are not the only ones who exploited the city’s weakness. You need the sword more than the cold corpse.
You grab the hilt again, clenching your teeth against the cold, and pull the sword out. It slides from the body.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
突然，一股力量将你震飞出去。你撞上了墙壁，喘着粗气爬起身来。眼前，被杀害的女子的亡魂缓缓升起。屋子内顿时寒气逼人，你开始瑟瑟发抖。到底是控制不住的寒战，抑或是恐惧？
亡魂的面容因愤怒而扭曲。
— 你竟敢亵渎无辜者的遗体？！
lines.textEn:
Suddenly, a wave of force throws you back. You hit the wall and catch your breath. Before you, the ghost of the murdered woman rises. The hut grows so cold that you start shivering. Or is it fear?
The ghost’s face is twisted in rage.
—How dare you mock the body of an innocent victim?!

lines.textCh: 我只是动了下那把剑而已！
lines.textEn: I only took the sword!

lines.textCh: 别靠过来，你个吓死人不偿命的鬼！
lines.textEn: Don’t come near, you ghoulish specter!

lines.textCh: 幽灵大笑起来。她的笑声在屋子里回荡，令你脊背发凉。你该怎么办？
lines.textEn: The ghost laughs. Her laughter echoes through the hut, sending chills down your spine. What do you do?

lines.textCh:
幽灵并没有回话，只是微笑着。在你眼前的已经不是一具尸体，而是一位年轻女子。但千万别昏了头，你提醒自己，就算幻化成少女的模样，恶灵终究是恶灵。
你会怎么做？
lines.textEn:
The ghost does not answer, only smiles. You see not a corpse, but a young woman. But don’t be deceived, you remind yourself, evil spirit remains evil spirit.
What do you do?

lines.textCh: 跑！
lines.textEn: Run!

lines.textCh: 待在原地不动。
lines.textEn: Freeze in place.

lines.textCh:
你决定冒险一试。屋子的出口近在咫尺，你完全可以冲出去。
你猛地跳起来冲向敞开的门。
砰——门在你面前哐当关上。你使劲拉门把手，却纹丝不动。
— 别跑。你在我的地盘上，你是逃不掉的。
你转身面对那个幽灵。突然间，你似乎意识到了什么。
lines.textEn:
You decide to take a risk. The hut’s exit is very close, you can make it.
You jump to your feet and rush for the open door.
Bang — the door closes right in front of you. You tug the handle, but it doesn’t budge.
— Do not run. You won’t succeed anyway. You are on my territory.
You turn to the ghost. Suddenly, you realize something.

lines.textCh:
你僵立在原地，凝视着那各幽灵。她微微歪头，向你倾身靠近。
— 还好你不打算逃跑。
她的声音在你脑海某处回荡。你没有移开视线。
— 反正你现在是在我的地盘上。
突然间，你恍然察觉到了什么。
lines.textEn:
You freeze in place, staring at the ghost. She tilts her head slightly and leans toward you.
— Good thing you didn’t run.
Her voice echoes somewhere in your head. You don’t look away.
— You are on my territory anyway.
Suddenly, you realize something.

lines.textCh:
但你的话语只是从幽灵身旁掠过。你看见从她身体延伸出霜花一般的轨迹，直指你而来。那女子的幽灵咆哮着扑向你。顷刻间，她半透明的手掌刺入你的胸膛。
你本以为会感到疼痛，但一秒过去，又一秒过去……却毫无反应。幽灵猛地退开，再度悬浮在尸体上方。
lines.textEn:
But your words pass the ghost by. You see frost tracing paths from her body toward you. The woman’s ghost roars and lunges at you. In a second, her semi-transparent hand plunges into your chest.
You expect pain, but a second passes, then another... and nothing happens. The ghost recoils and hovers again over the body.

lines.textCh: 你……伤不了我分毫。
lines.textEn: You… cannot harm me.

lines.textCh:
鬼魂露出微笑，一股焦虑感扑面而来。她为何在笑？她的攻击根本没成功！你明明还活着……
突然，一股剧痛刺穿胸膛。你踉跄后退，痛楚蔓延至背脊与手臂。幽灵的笑容也愈发狰狞。
— 现在呢？喜欢吗？
你跪倒在地，耳边只有她那空灵的声音还在回响。此刻呼吸已成奢望。你还没明白到底发生了什么，你的意识就已经消散得无影无踪。
你的生命，也随之消逝。
lines.textEn:
The ghost smiles, and a wave of anxiety hits you. Why is she smiling? Her attack didn't work! You are alive and…
Suddenly, pain pierces your chest. You stagger. The pain radiates to your back and arm. The ghost’s smile widens.
— What about now? Do you like it?
You hear her otherworldly voice as you fall to your knees. Breathing is now impossible. You barely understand what happened before consciousness leaves you.
As does your life.

lines.textCh: 我没法走出沼泽是你干的吗？
lines.textEn: Is it your doing that I can’t get out of the swamps?

lines.textCh: 死亡
lines.textEn: DEATH

lines.textCh:
那个幽灵女孩点了点头。
— 在我放你走之前，你别想离开这里。
你意识到她并没有在说大话，但她营造这一切又是为了什么呢？
lines.textEn:
The ghostly girl nods.
— You won’t leave here until I allow it.
And you realize she is not lying. But why does she need all this?

lines.textCh: 那你想让我干什么？
lines.textEn: What do you want from me?

lines.textCh:
— 只要你帮我，我就会放你走，— 幽灵的形态忽地清晰起来，一会又宛如波纹般闪烁，如同有石块投入湖面般荡漾不已。
你不由自主地瞥向她身下躺着的尸体。
lines.textEn:
— Help me, and I will let you go, — the ghost flickers between clarity and a ripple, like a lake disturbed by a thrown stone.
You involuntarily glance at the body lying beneath her.

lines.textCh: 但我好像帮不上什么忙。
lines.textEn: It doesn’t look like I can help you with anything.

lines.textCh: — 我说的是我自己！不是这具躯壳。— 幽灵顿了顿。你猛地一惊，只见她脸上掠过嗜血的狞笑，但下一秒表情又恢复平静。看来她厌恶无谓的提问。最好记住这一点。
lines.textEn: — I mean myself! Not the body. — the ghost shifts for a moment. You flinch as a bloodthirsty snarl flashes across her face, but a second later, her expression is calm again. It seems she dislikes useless questions. Best remember that.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
你闭上双眼。或许他们没杀死女巫，却烧毁了整座村庄！也许这样最好，一报还一报。
你紧闭双眼，直到最后一声尖叫与垂死喘息消散。当一切结束时，女巫已站在你身旁。
— 把镜子给我！
lines.textEn:
You close your eyes. Maybe they didn’t kill the witch, but they burned an entire village! Perhaps this is for the best.
You keep your eyes shut until the last scream and dying gasp fade. When it’s over, the witch is beside you.
— Bring me the mirror!

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
你闭上双眼。或许他们没杀死女巫，却烧毁了整座村庄！也许这样最好，一报还一报。
你紧闭双眼，直到最后一声尖叫与垂死喘息消散。当一切结束时，女巫已站在你身旁。
— 把镜子给我！
lines.textEn:
You close your eyes. Maybe they didn’t kill the witch, but they burned an entire village! Perhaps this is for the best.
You keep your eyes shut until the last scream and dying gasp fade. When it’s over, the witch is beside you.
— Bring me the mirror!

lines.textCh:
她触碰你，寒意便从接触处蔓延至全身。你的伤口自行愈合了，呼吸突然变得顺畅，疼痛逐渐消退。
— 找到那面镜子。
显然女巫并非出于善意才这么做，她只想让你快点满足她的要求。
lines.textEn:
She touches you, and a chill spreads from the contact through your body. Your wounds close, breathing becomes easier, and the pain fades.
— Find the mirror.
It’s clear the witch didn’t do this out of kindness, she wants you to fulfill her demand quickly.

lines.textCh:
她触碰你，寒意便从接触处蔓延至全身。你的伤口自行愈合了，呼吸突然变得顺畅，疼痛逐渐消退。
— 找到那面镜子。
显然女巫并非出于善意才这么做，她只想让你快点满足她的要求。
lines.textEn:
She touches you, and a chill spreads from the contact through your body. Your wounds close, breathing becomes easier, and the pain fades.
— Find the mirror.
It’s clear the witch didn’t do this out of kindness, she wants you to fulfill her demand quickly.

lines.textCh: 尝试用香肠赢得他们的信任。
lines.textEn: Try to gain their trust. With sausage.

lines.textCh: 我该上哪去找那些凶手？
lines.textEn: Where do I find your murderers?

lines.textCh: 我的任务失败了！
lines.textEn: My task is failed!

lines.textCh: 继续观望。
lines.textEn: Keep watching them.

lines.textCh: 继续躲藏。
lines.textEn: Keep eavesdropping.

lines.textCh: 跟着他们。
lines.textEn: Follow them.

lines.textCh: 跑！
lines.textEn: Run!

lines.textCh: 我是领航者教团的信使！
lines.textEn: I’m a messenger of the Order of Navigators!

lines.textCh: 我只是领航者教团的信使罢了。
lines.textEn: I’m just a messenger of the Order of Navigators.

lines.textCh: 我觉得我们应该一起合作。
lines.textEn: I think we should team up.

lines.textCh: 我知道走出去的办法。
lines.textEn: I know what will get us all out of here.

lines.textCh: 小小地撒点谎。
lines.textEn: Lie a little.

lines.textCh: 我们必须想办法骗过那个女巫。
lines.textEn: We need to figure out how to trick the witch.

lines.textCh: 这里有人懂该怎么驱魔吗？
lines.textEn: Is there anyone here who knows how to do that?

lines.textCh: 值得一试。
lines.textEn: Worth a shot.

lines.textCh: 值得一试。
lines.textEn: Worth a shot.

lines.textCh:
你出人意料地轻松拔出长剑。剑刃上残留着女巫的血迹，你却毫不在意。你的心意已决，除此之外已心无旁骛。你紧握剑柄，与首领四目相对。
— 看看这家伙，他真觉得自己会用剑呢！— 他们嘲弄着，你却不为所动。
首领拔出武器朝你袭来，蓄势准备一击。
lines.textEn:
You surprisingly draw your sword with ease. Traces of the witch’s blood still stain the blade, but you pay it no mind. You have a goal, and nothing stands in your way. You grip the hilt tightly and lock eyes with the leader.
— Look at this serious guy! — they mock, but you don’t take the bait.
The leader draws his weapon and comes at you, winding up for a strike.

lines.textCh: 格挡对方的攻击！
lines.textEn: Parry!

lines.textCh: 格挡对方的攻击！
lines.textEn: Parry!

lines.textCh: 专心战斗。
lines.textEn: Focus on the fight.

lines.textCh: 抵抗。
lines.textEn: Resist.

lines.textCh: 保持沉默。
lines.textEn: Stay silent.

lines.textCh: 那还用说！
lines.textEn: Definitely free!

lines.textCh: 这已经不关你的事了。
lines.textEn: This is no longer your business.

lines.textCh:
首领转身望向你，眼中闪烁着蔑视的怒火。
— 就算在我手里又怎样？你想抢？有种就来啊？
lines.textEn:
The leader turns to you, glaring with contempt.
— And if have it, so what? You gonna take it from me? Think you're up for it?

lines.textCh:
突然间，众人纷纷后退。有人划十字，有人咒骂。你猛地抬起头，看见女巫正站在你和匪徒之间。
— 复仇，我要复仇，— 她几乎是低吼着。乱发如蛇般扭动，连你都感到不安。— 现在他们是我的了，他们都得死。
— 可我们没做错什么！我们没有杀你啊！— 人群中有人喊道。众人纷纷点头，仿佛这能说服嗜血的阴间来客放弃自己的执念。真的有必要掺和进来吗？
lines.textEn:
Suddenly, everyone flinches back. Some cross themselves, others curse. You jerk your head up and see the witch standing between you and the bandits.
— Vengeance, I need vengeance, — she almost growls. Her hair is disheveled, writhing like snakes. Even you feel uneasy. — They’re mine.
— But we didn’t do anything! We didn’t kill you! — someone shouts from the crowd. Everyone nods, as if that could convince a bloodthirsty otherworldly being. Is it even worth getting involved?

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
你闭上双眼。或许他们没杀死女巫，却烧毁了整座村庄！也许这样最好，一报还一报。
你紧闭双眼，直到最后一声尖叫与垂死喘息消散。当一切结束时，女巫已站在你身旁。
— 把镜子给我！
lines.textEn:
You close your eyes. Maybe they didn’t kill the witch, but they burned an entire village! Perhaps this is for the best.
You keep your eyes shut until the last scream and dying gasp fade. When it’s over, the witch is beside you.
— Bring me the mirror!

lines.textCh: 嘿！你们要吃东西吗？先回答我的问题！
lines.textEn: Hey! Want to eat? Answer my questions first!

lines.textCh: 好吧，我的错。我这就走。
lines.textEn: Alright, my bad. I’m leaving.

lines.textCh: 接受你的命运。
lines.textEn: Accept your fate.

lines.textCh: 接受你的命运。
lines.textEn: Accept your fate.

lines.textCh:
— 杀害我的凶手必须血债血偿。但首先，你必须从他们手中拿回他们偷走的东西。
你不知如何回应。仿佛一切早已为你注定。但或许你该尝试说些什么……
lines.textEn:
— My murderers must face punishment. But first, you must return what they stole from me.
You don’t know how to respond. It’s like everything’s already been decided for you. But maybe you should try something...

lines.textCh: 可我并不是个战士。
lines.textEn: I’m no warrior.

lines.textCh:
鬼魂俯身凑近，距离你的脸庞仅有几寸之遥。她的声音骤然化作诡异而超凡的嘶鸣。
— 我不在乎。你已经在这儿了，那就自己去想办法，— 她一边说着，一边漫不经心地耸耸肩便退了回去。— 我也没指望你把他们都杀干净，当个贼，把我的东西拿回来。
lines.textEn:
The ghost leans forward, stopping mere inches from your face. Her voice turns into an eerie, otherworldly hiss.
— I don’t care. You’re here, so you’ll manage, — she says, pulling back with a careless shrug. — You don’t need to be a warrior. Being a thief will do.

lines.textCh:
— 他们是沿着路从那边的村子来的，他们住在那里，我被偷去的镜子也在那。找到它，把它还给我。
你无奈地点点头。幽灵飘到你身边，将手覆上你的脸颊。倘若她尚在人世的话，大概是想这么做吧。但此刻你只感到刺骨的寒意，脸颊逐渐麻木，仍仍然一动也不敢动。女巫抽回手，指向插在她尸体上的长剑。
— 拿上这把剑，也许会派上用场。现在出发吧，别让我失望。
lines.textEn:
— They came from the village by the road. Their home is there, and so is my stolen mirror. Bring it back to me.
You nod resignedly. The ghost glides beside you, placing her hand on your cheek. Or she would have, if she were alive. Instead, you feel an unbearable cold. Your cheek goes numb, but you stand still, unmoving. The witch pulls away and gestures toward the sword protruding from her body.
— Take this sword. You might need it. Now go, and don’t fail me.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
你走出茅屋，颤抖着呼出一口气。和煦的微风温暖了你冰冷的身体，你用双手揉搓着脸颊，试图甩去残留的寒意，你调整了一下肩上的背包，现在，一把剑正静静地卧在其中。
你还是没能完全理解刚刚发生的一切。你刚踏上旅途的时候，可曾想到过此程会遇上鬼魂？甚至出手帮助它？
但你别无选择。女巫的魔法让你无法离开沼泽，你必须遵从她的要求。
lines.textEn:
You step out of the hut and exhale shakily. A gentle breeze warms your chilled body. Rubbing your cheeks with your hands, you shrug off the lingering cold and adjust the bag on your shoulder. Now, a sword rests inside it.
You still haven’t fully processed what happened. Did you ever think you’d meet a ghost? Or help one?
But you have no choice. The witch’s magic won’t let you leave the swamps. You must do as she asked.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
你朝着村庄走去。这一次，你没有绕远路，也没有徘徊，而是径直向着村子奔去。
起初，你没察觉到任何异样，直到稀疏的沼泽树丛分开，惨象呈现在你的面前。
村庄已被焚毁殆尽、洗劫一空。你呆呆站立在原地。
lines.textEn:
You head toward the village. This time, you don’t wander and walk straight to it.
At first, you don’t realize what’s wrong, but then the sparse swamp trees part, revealing the full scene.
The village is burned and pillaged. You freeze in place.

lines.textCh: 这么多无辜的人死去了……
lines.textEn: So many victims...

lines.textCh: 风中飘来令人窒息的烟尘与焦肉恶臭。你目睹了村庄废墟里的遍地尸骸，举目望去满目疮痍……你多想就这么一走了之，但你对女巫的承诺却将你束缚在此：无论付出什么样的代价，你都必须抵达塔格勒。或许杀害女巫的凶手早已毙命……若果真如此，将神器带回给她或许就足够了。你祈祷这能令她满意，放你走出沼泽。
lines.textEn: The wind carries the suffocating stench of smoke and burned flesh. You see corpses, such devastation... You want to flee, but your task holds you here. You must reach Targrad, no matter the cost. Perhaps the witch’s murderers are already dead... If so, bringing her the artifact might be enough. You hope it will satisfy her.

lines.textCh:
女巫说她的凶手们躲藏在这个村庄里。但如果他们现在全都死了呢？鬼魂会听你的吗？还是会以为你在欺骗她？ 
你意识到自己陷入了大麻烦。但至少还能找到那件神器吧？
lines.textEn:
The witch said her murderers were holed up in this village. But what do you do if they’re all dead now? Will the ghost listen to you? Or will she think you’re trying to deceive her? 
You realize you’re in deep trouble. But maybe you can at least find the artifact?

lines.textCh:
你踮着脚尖，谨慎地靠近废弃村庄的边缘。无论是谁将这里焚毁殆尽，他们都不可能走得太远。女巫的诅咒一定会让他们无法走出这里。
突然，你听见有人交谈的声音。那不是求救的哀嚎，也不是悼念亡者的哭泣，而是关于寻常琐事的讨论。你意识到，这些正是袭击村庄的凶手。
lines.textEn:
You approach the edge of the ruined village, crouching and moving cautiously. Whoever destroyed this place couldn’t have gotten far. The witch’s curse wouldn’t allow it.
Suddenly, you hear voices. They’re not begging for help or mourning the dead; they’re discussing mundane things. You realize these are the ones who attacked the village.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 站出来与他们对峙。
lines.textEn: Step out to confront them.

lines.textCh: 好吧，反正你也无路可退了。如果他们和你一样被困在这里，或许不会立刻发动攻击。倘若他们真动手了，死亡或许能让你免于执行女巫的差事。
lines.textEn: Well, you’ve got nothing to lose. If they’re trapped here like you, maybe they won’t attack right away. If they do, death might spare you from carrying out the witch’s errand.

lines.textCh:
你决定暂时藏身。谁知道这些能摧毁整个村庄的家伙会对你做什么？幸运的是，他们都没注意到你。
你紧贴着烧毁房屋的角落，侧耳倾听。
一个男人声音低沉，带着些许陌生的口音。另一个则毫无口音，声音尖锐得近乎刺耳。
— 这么大一个村子怎么就这点物资？我饿得要命，可这里却什么都没有，— 带着口音的那人抱怨道。
— 我们都要死在这里了！这片沼泽被诅咒了，我们根本不知道怎么破除咒语，— 尖声那人歇斯底里地回应。你意识到他们同样被诅咒困在这里，并且饥肠辘辘。
lines.textEn:
You decide to stay hidden for now. Who knows what these men, capable of destroying an entire village, might do to you? Luckily, none of them notice you.
You press yourself against the corner of a burned-out house and listen.
One man has a deep voice with a slight, unfamiliar accent. The other speaks without an accent, his voice higher and almost shrill.
— How can a village like this have so few supplies? I’m starving, and there’s nothing, — grumbles the one with the accent.
— We’re gonna die here! These swamps are cursed, and we’ve got no idea how to break the spell, — the shrill one replies hysterically. You realize they’re trapped here by the curse too. And they’re hungry.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
你迈步上前，举起双手示意自己来者无恶意。几名面露倦容的男子站在你面前。当你从半焚的房屋后现身时，他们紧握武器，带着戒备的恐惧盯着你。
— 居然是活人，— 其中一各人说着，肩膀微微放松了下来，— 你是谁？
你听出他话语里带着隐约的口音，却辨不出具体来源。不过眼下这倒无关紧要。
lines.textEn:
You step forward, raising your hands to show you come in peace. Several tired-looking men stand before you. They grip their weapons tighter, eyeing you with wary fear as you emerge from behind the half-burned house.
— A live one, — says one of the men, slightly relaxing his shoulders. — Who are you?
You hear a faint accent in his voice, but you can’t place it. Not that it matters right now.

lines.textCh: 站出来与他们对峙。
lines.textEn: Step out to confront them.

lines.textCh:
— 我发誓，头儿肯定知道些什么。比如，到底是什么把我们困在这里，— 那个尖嗓子压低了声音，迫使你不得不凑近才能听清。
— 别瞎扯。他怎么可能知道？— 带口音的那人似乎没那么怀疑。— 不许在背后说头儿的坏话！
— 行行行，我只是说说而已！
随着那几人走远，你听见他们的脚步声渐渐消失。
lines.textEn:
— I swear, chief knows something. Like, why we’re stuck here, — the shrill one lowers his voice, forcing you to lean forward to hear.
— Cut it out. How would he know? — The one with the accent seems less suspicious. — Don’t badmouth our leader!
— Alright, alright, it's just a theory!
You hear their footsteps fade as the men walk away.

lines.textCh: 站出来与他们对峙。
lines.textEn: Step out to confront them.

lines.textCh:
你觉得那些男人或许会透露更有用的情报。你尽可能悄无声息地尾随他们，屏息侧耳倾听，却在专注于尾随他们时踩到了一根被热气烤焦的树枝。树枝在你的脚下咔嚓一声断裂，男人们听见了动静。
— 谁在那？赶快滚出来！
lines.textEn:
You think the men might reveal more useful information. You follow them as quietly as possible, straining to listen, but you get too caught up and step on a dry, heat-cracked branch. It snaps loudly, and the men hear it.
— Who’s there? Come out now!

lines.textCh: 从藏身处站起来面对他们。
lines.textEn: Step out from your hiding spot.

lines.textCh:
你只想立刻逃跑。你飞奔转过街角。躲藏的房屋缺了一面墙，因此那群人发现了你。
— 站住，你这鬼鬼祟祟的鼠辈！— 那个尖嗓子高声叫道。你看见他追了上来。另一个人不知为何却不见踪影。
lines.textEn:
You can’t think of anything better than to bolt. You dart around the corner. The house you were hiding behind is missing a wall, so the men spot you.
— Stop, you little rat! — the shrill one yells. You notice him giving chase. The other man, for some reason, is nowhere in sight.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 但好景不长。他突然出现在你面前，从拐角处窜了出来。你猛地向侧面闪避，却被一堆烧焦的木头挡住了去路。身后，那个尖嗓子正逼近而来。你被困住了。
lines.textEn: But not for long. He suddenly appears in front of you, stepping out from around a corner. You veer to the side, but there’s a pile of half-burned logs blocking your path. Behind you, the shrill one is closing in. You’re trapped.

lines.textCh: 我和你们一样被困在这里了！
lines.textEn: I’m stuck here just like you!

lines.textCh:
— 那你为什么偷听？— 那个带口音的虽然已经放下了剑，但语气仍然带着几分怀疑。
— 是啊，你为什么逃跑？— 那个尖嗓子插话道。
lines.textEn:
— Then why were you eavesdropping? — the one with the accent asks, still skeptical, though he lowers his sword.
— Yeah, and why’d you run? — the shrill one chimes in.

lines.textCh: — 我们从没听说过这种事，— 那个带口音的人说着，再次拔出剑来，用怀疑的目光盯着你。你只剩最后一张牌可打了。
lines.textEn: — We’ve never heard of that, — the accented one says, drawing his sword again and eyeing you suspiciously. You’ve got one last card to play.

lines.textCh: 我和你们一样被困在这里了！
lines.textEn: I’m stuck here just like you!

lines.textCh: 我只是……被吓到了。
lines.textEn: I was just... scared.

lines.textCh:
男人们交换眼神，随即齐声爆发出大笑。
— 有什么好笑的？— 一个低沉粗粝的新声音轰然响起。两人猛地站直了身子。你转身望去。
