另一栋烧毁房屋的废墟后，又冒出几个人影。他们显然是同一伙人：疲惫不堪，满腹怒火，眼神深处却透着极度恐惧。
— 这又是什么人？— 一个身穿皮甲的高个子男人盯着你。他那扭曲的胡须尖锐如刃，目光里满是轻蔑与猜忌。
看样子这帮人的头目就是他了，今天连着对付了好几伙强盗，真是麻烦透顶啊！
lines.textEn:
The men exchange glances and burst into synchronized laughter.
— What’s so funny? — a new voice booms, low and harsh. Both men snap to attention. You turn around.
From behind the ruins of another burned house, several more figures emerge. They’re clearly from the same band: exhausted, angry, and deeply terrified beneath it all.
— Who’s this now? — a tall man in leather armor stares at you. His mustache is sharply twisted, and his gaze drips with disdain and distrust.
Well, it seems this is the leader. You’re already exhausted from dealing with bandits today!

lines.textCh: 我和你们一样被困在这里了。
lines.textEn: I’m stuck here just like you.

lines.textCh:
男人们听你这么一说，互相交换了眼神。
— 没听说过。你是从哪来的？本地人早就死透了。
他们再度绷紧神经，开始向你逼近。
lines.textEn:
The men exchange glances at your words.
— Never heard of it. Where’d you come from? All the locals are long dead.
They tense up again and start closing in on you.

lines.textCh:
如今男人们看你的眼神变了。
— 我们被困在这里都多长时间了！— 一直沉默的那个终于开口了。另一人用肘捅了他一下。
— 快点一五一十的都说清楚！
— 管他呢？说不定他是来帮我们收拾这个烂摊子，把我们给救出去的！
lines.textEn:
Now the men look at you differently.
— We’ve been trying to get out of here for who knows how long! — says one who’d been silent until now. The other elbows him in the side.
— Just spill everything already!
— What’s it matter? Maybe he’s been sent to sort this mess and get us out!

lines.textCh: 我知道情况……也许我能帮忙。
lines.textEn: I know something... Maybe I can help.

lines.textCh:
你明白这是唯一一次争取他们的机会。男人们盯着你，仿佛在掂量你的话语。你说的某句话显然触动了他们的心弦。
突然，周围又传来了动静。在另一栋烧毁房屋的废墟后，又冒出几个人影。他们显然是同一伙人：疲惫不堪，满腹怒火，眼神深处却透着极度恐惧。
— 这又是什么人？— 一个身穿皮甲的高个子男人盯着你。他那扭曲的胡须尖锐如刃，目光里满是轻蔑与猜忌。你新结实的两位“伙伴”在他面前马上站直了身子。
看样子这帮人的头目就是他了，今天连着对付了好几伙强盗，真是麻烦透顶啊！
lines.textEn:
You realize this is your chance, there won’t be another. The men stare at you, as if weighing your words. Something you said clearly struck a chord.
Suddenly, there’s a noise nearby. From behind the ruins of another burned house, several more figures emerge. They’re clearly part of the same band: exhausted, angry, and deeply terrified beneath it all.
— Who’s this now? — a tall man in leather armor stares at you. His mustache is sharply twisted, and his gaze drips with disdain and distrust. Your new acquaintances both snap to attention.
Well, it seems this is the leader. You’re already exhausted from dealing with bandits today!

lines.textCh:
— 他说自己和我们一样被困在这里。说自己或许能帮上忙，— 其中一人向首领引荐你。后者只是眯起眼睛冷笑。
— 这个娘娘腔能帮上什么忙？你能拿得稳剑吗，就说这样的大话？
lines.textEn:
— He says he’s trapped here like us. Says he might help, — one of them introduces you. The leader squints and sneers.
— And how’s this runt supposed to help us? Can you even hold a sword?

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 虽然战斗不是我的强项，但不代表我就一无是处。
lines.textEn: My strength isn’t in fighting.

lines.textCh:
强盗头目挑了挑眉，随即发出残忍而讥讽的笑声。他的爪牙们也跟着哄笑起来，笑声空洞刺耳。
— 那又怎么样？写字？我们可不需要抄写员。文字？那些花里胡哨的能有什么用？
lines.textEn:
The bandit leader raises an eyebrow, then laughs with a cruel, mocking sound. His lackeys join in, their laughter hollow.
— In what, then? Writing? We don’t need scribes. Words? Those are useless too.

lines.textCh: 我知道走出去的办法。
lines.textEn: I know what will get us all out of here.

lines.textCh:
你看见整个队伍都盯着你，眼中闪烁着希望的光芒。但领头的首领却却不为所动。
— 我们凭什么相信你？先把你知道的都告诉我们，再看你值不值得信任。
lines.textEn:
You see the entire group staring at you, hope flickering in their eyes. The leader, though, isn’t convinced.
— Why should we trust you? Tell us what you know first, then we’ll decide if you’re worth believing.

lines.textCh: 立刻说出真相。
lines.textEn: Tell the truth right away.

lines.textCh:
你决定没必要再向他们隐瞒什么。这些匪徒和你一样渴望逃离这片被诅咒的沼泽地。无论他们之前都干了什么，但此时此刻你们已然结成了同盟，其中不少人想必心知肚明。
— 这一切都是当地人搞的鬼。他们杀死了沼泽女巫，还把珍贵的圣物给偷走了。女巫要夺回那件神器，更要报仇雪恨。
几名强盗神色慌张地环顾四周，仿佛在寻找杀害女巫的凶手。但很不幸——杀害女巫的凶手、女巫所要复仇的对象，正是他们自己。
lines.textEn:
You decide there’s no point in hiding anything. These bandits want to escape the cursed swamps just as badly as you do. Right now, you’re allies, and many of them likely understand that.
— It’s all because of the locals. They killed the swamp witch and stole a valuable artifact. She wants it back. And, of course, she wants revenge.
A few bandits glance around nervously, as if looking for those responsible for the witch’s death. But alas, they’re the ones who killed them.

lines.textCh:
这些强盗曾经把整个村庄夷为平地。完全信任他们未免太过愚蠢了。万一他们听完真相就把你给杀了呢？你决定还是稳妥行事为好。
— 是那个女巫搞的鬼。她被这个村子的人杀了，还被洗劫一空。她派我来寻找被偷走的东西。要是我有什么三长两短，她肯定会毁灭这片土地的所有生灵。
当然，女巫可没说过你在这场复仇中能有什么地位，但强盗们不必知道这点。
他们相信了你，你能从他们的眼光中看出这一点。此刻他们注视你的目光比先前带有几分尊敬的意思，甚至有人微微后退，仿佛心怀敬畏一般。
lines.textEn:
These are the bandits who wiped out an entire village. Trusting them completely would be foolish. What if they kill you as soon as they hear the truth? You decide to play it safe.
— t’s because of the witch. She was killed and robbed by the people of this village. She sent me to find what was stolen. If anything happens to me, she’ll destroy everyone in the area.
Of course, the witch never said you were particularly important, but the bandits don’t need to know that.
You see in their eyes that they believe you. Now they look at you with more respect than before. Some even step back slightly, as if afraid.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: — 那么，你打算让我们怎么做？— 领头的发话了，皱着眉头盯着你，带着期待地问道。
lines.textEn: — So, what do you suggest we do? — the leader asks, frowning and staring at you expectantly.

lines.textCh: 我们必须得找到那面被偷的镜子才行。
lines.textEn: We need to find the stolen mirror.

lines.textCh:
既然女巫已经明示了解决问题的办法，又何必费神自己发明一套新的说辞？没错，光靠你自己是无法惩罚那些罪人的，但这或许才是最好的安排？
逃兵头目不悦地皱起眉头，他举手投足间透着微妙的变化，你却难以捉摸背后的玄机。身后传来一位年轻男子尖锐的嗓音，让你吓了一跳。 
— 我们确实见过一面镜子，所有镜子都烧毁了，就那一个还是完整的！是一面圆镜子。
头目猛地转过身去，几乎是在咆哮： 
— 肯定，不是，那面，镜子！
你和那青年同时愣在了原地，这样的反应通常只意味着一件事。
lines.textEn:
Why come up with something new when the witch already gave you a clear path? Sure, you can’t punish the guilty, but maybe that’s for the best?
The bandit leader frowns discontentedly. Something shifts in his movements, but you can’t quite place what. You’re distracted by the high-pitched voice of a young man standing just behind him. 
— We did see a strange mirror that doesn’t burn! A round one.
The leader spins toward the young man and practically growls:
— That’s definitely. Not. It!
You freeze, as does the young man. That kind of reaction can only mean one thing.

lines.textCh:
你意识到女巫恐怕不会只满足于夺取那件神器。更别提你首先得想办法弄到它。正当你陷入沉思时，那个提过魔镜的年轻人突然又开口了。
— 要不我们直接弄个驱魔仪式，把女巫给赶走？— 众人转头望向他，他耸耸肩，— 我早想这么做了，可之前根本不知道女巫的存在！
lines.textEn:
You realize the witch probably won’t be satisfied with just the artifact. And that’s not even considering how you’ll get it in the first place. You start to think, but the same young man who mentioned the mirror suddenly speaks up again.
— What if we just banish the witch? — everyone turns to look at him, and he shrugs, — I would’ve tried earlier, but we didn’t know about the witch!

lines.textCh: 是你拿了那面镜子，对吧？
lines.textEn: You have the mirror, don't you?

lines.textCh: 你知道该怎么做吗？
lines.textEn: Do you know how to do that?

lines.textCh:
— 嗯，当然知道怎么干， — 年轻人挺起胸膛，咧嘴炫耀道， — 在这之前，我可是 Turva 那帮子人的祭司。比这更疯狂的事我做过多了！
这主意倒不赖。但你真敢把性命托付给这个毛头小子？
lines.textEn:
— Well, yeah, I know how, — the young man says, puffing out his chest with a boastful grin. — I was a priest with Turva’s band. I’ve done crazier things than this!
It’s a reasonable idea. But can you really trust your life to some young kid?

lines.textCh:
— 没错，我当然知道， — 年轻人一边说一边张开双臂， — 在这之前，我可是 Turva 那帮子人的祭司。比这更疯狂的事我做过多了！
这主意倒不赖。但你真敢把性命托付给这个毛头小子？
lines.textEn:
— Yeah, I do, — the young man says, spreading his arms, — I was a priest with Turva’s band. I’ve done crazier things than this.
It’s a solid idea. But can you really trust your life to some kid?

lines.textCh: 太冒险了。
lines.textEn: Too risky.

lines.textCh: 太冒险了。
lines.textEn: Too risky.

lines.textCh: 你摇了摇头。或许那孩子当真是个祭司，但冒这么大的险……你只想逃离这片沼泽，可不想因为一个愤怒女巫的任性而永远困在这里。
lines.textEn: You shake your head. Maybe the kid really is a priest, but taking such a risk... You want to escape these swamps, not get stuck here forever because of an angry witch’s whim.

lines.textCh:
豁出去了！你同意了年轻人的计划。首领摸着下巴沉思片刻，随后耸耸肩：
— 姑且一试吧，反正现在也走投无路了。
他将目光转向你：
— 行，你就负责带路到那个女巫的葬身之地吧。
lines.textEn:
Here goes nothing! You agree to the young man’s plan. The leader rubs his chin thoughtfully, then shrugs:
— Might as well try. We’ve got nothing to lose.
He turns his gaze to you.
— Alright, lead the way to where this witch of yours is hiding.

lines.textCh: 我们必须得找到那面被偷的镜子才行。
lines.textEn: We need to find the stolen mirror.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
你带领队伍穿越沼泽，直奔那间小屋。旅程似乎比预想中漫长，但你并未在意这其中有什么不对。
队伍在小屋前停下。那个自称祭司的年轻人拽了拽你的衣袖。
— 顺便说一句，我叫姆斯季斯拉夫。叫我斯拉夫卡就好，— 他咧嘴笑着，朝小屋方向点头示意，— 反正告诉你一声，免得你不知道是谁办成了驱魔这件大事。
他放声大笑，仿佛丝毫没有恐惧。
lines.textEn:
You lead the group through the swamps, heading straight for the hut. The journey seems to take longer than it should, but you brush off the strangeness.
You stop right in front of the hut. The young man who claims to be a priest tugs at your sleeve to get your attention.
— By the way, I’m Mstislav. Call me Slavka, — he says with a grin, nodding toward the hut. — Just thought you should know the name of the guy who’s gonna banish that witch, right?
He laughs, as if he’s not scared at all.

lines.textCh:
首领转向你，投来鄙夷的怒视。
— 就算镜子在我手里又怎样？你想抢？有种就来啊？
lines.textEn:
The leader turns to you, glaring with disdain.
— And if I’ve got the mirror, so what? You gonna take it from me? Think you're up for it?

lines.textCh: 和他打！
lines.textEn: Fight him!

lines.textCh:
几小时前遭遇的创伤令你浑身酸痛。你拔出长剑，动作却笨拙不堪。匪首冷笑着看着你勉强举起武器的笨拙样子。
— 你这书呆子，除了羽毛笔就没碰过更重的东西吧！
他利落地拔剑上前，蓄势准备一击。你意识到这记重击的威力远非你能抵挡。
lines.textEn:
Your body aches from what happened just hours ago. You draw your sword, but your movements are clumsy. The bandit leader smirks, watching your struggle with the weapon.
— You’ve never held anything heavier than a quill, you little punk!
He deftly draws his own sword and advances, winding up for a strike. You realize the force of his blow will be too much for you to block.

lines.textCh: 躲开这一剑！
lines.textEn: Dodge!

lines.textCh: 躲开这一剑！
lines.textEn: Dodge!

lines.textCh:
你侧身闪避，躲开了剑刃的轨迹。长剑呼啸掠过你的耳畔，却未触及耳廓分毫。首领借势转过身子，试图再度劈砍。你向后一步跳开。
其余的逃兵还没有加入这场战斗。你能看出他们的脸上浮现出困惑的神情。— 他们终于意识到，自己的首领竟然如此贪婪，不惜牺牲自己和他们的性命也不愿交出战利品。
你意识到可以向他们喊话，让他们反戈一击。但这样做可能分散注意力，让你暴露在首领下一击的攻击范围内。
lines.textEn:
You slide to the side, dodging the path of the strike. The sword whistles past your ear but doesn’t touch you. The leader spins with the momentum, trying to hit you again. You leap back.
The other bandits haven’t joined the fight yet. You see confusion on their faces. It’s dawning on them that their leader is willing to sacrifice both his life and theirs for greed.
You realize you could call out to them. But doing so might distract you, leaving you open to the leader’s next strike.

lines.textCh: ……但这又有什么关系？激战的怒火将你吞噬，愤怒的烈焰仿佛能把人灼伤。你挥剑迎击首领的猛攻……或者说试图迎击，因为对方一击之力便粉碎了你仓促构筑的防御。你被击飞到一旁，绊倒在焦黑的木头上，摔倒在地。你没有哭叫出声来，没有，只是咒骂着挣扎着爬起来。
lines.textEn: ...But what does it matter? The fury of battle engulfs you, its fire burning hot. You meet the leader’s strike with your blade... or try to, as the force of his blow obliterates your barely prepared defense. You’re knocked to the side, tripping over a charred piece of wood and falling. You don’t scream, no, just curse and struggle to get up.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
首领迈步靠近，在你身旁吐了口唾沫。你僵立片刻，抬头望着他。
— 太自以为是了，你这小混蛋，— 冷笑着将剑举过你的头顶，— 替我向那个女巫问好吧。
他猛然挥剑劈下。剑刃如切黄油般划过你毫无防护的身体，直刺心脏。
你甚至来不及喘出最后的吐息，便可悲地死去了。
lines.textEn:
The leader steps closer and spits near you. For a moment, you freeze, looking up at him.
— Too much pride, you little punk, — he sneers, raising his sword above you, — Send my regards to that witch of yours.
He swings down. The blade cuts through your unarmored body like butter, slicing your heart.
You die before you can take your final breath.

lines.textCh: 你们难道看不出来，他拿你们的性命冒险，就为了自己的一点蝇头小利吗？！
lines.textEn: Don’t you see he’s ready to risk your lives for his own gain?!

lines.textCh:
你注意到几个强盗心生畏惧，彼此交换眼神。你明白独自对抗强者总是令人胆寒，但他们人多势众！你祈祷他们能保持理智。 
而你的判断没错。 
那个提起镜子的年轻人率先举手。 
— 他真打算抱着那面镜子绕死在这里！
另一人抓起战斧点头附和：
— 是啊，到时候我们都得像条狗一样死在这里！我们在这沼泽里都折腾多少天了？！我裤裆里到处都爬满了水蛭！
众人开始愤怒地嘀咕起来。你本想听个究竟，但头目显然打算先解决你，再收拾其他人。
lines.textEn:
You notice a few bandits flinch, exchanging glances. You know standing up alone against someone stronger is always terrifying, but there are so many of them! You hope for their common sense. 
And you’re not wrong.
The young man who mentioned the mirror is the first to raise his hand.
— He’s really ready to cling to that mirror until he dies!
Another man nods, grabbing his battle axe.
— Yeah, until we all die here like dogs! How many days have we been slogging through these swamps?! My junk’s already crawling with leeches!
One by one, they start grumbling angrily. You’d love to listen, but the leader clearly plans to deal with you first before sorting out the others.

lines.textCh:
已经没有时间再左顾右盼了。死在某个可悲的逃兵的刀下，绝非你梦寐以求的殉道结局。
你已经错失了拉拢旁人的机会，同时又没能躲过首领的突袭。千钧一发之际，你闪身避开，随后挥剑反击，他却敏捷地格挡开来，剑锋划过你的衣襟，在侧腹留下了一道伤口。痛楚让你嘶声尖叫。
— 现在还能装硬汉吗？— 首领嘲讽着逼近，眼中闪烁着嗜血的光芒。
霎时，你感知到了某种异样的存在——那是常人感官无法捕捉的虚无气息。空气骤然冰冷，你浑身战栗。有东西正试图融入你的身体，你的耳畔传来微弱的呢喃：“让我进来”。
lines.textEn:
There’s no time to get distracted. Dying a martyr to some pathetic deserter bandit’s blade isn’t the fate you dreamed of.
You miss the chance to gain allies but don’t miss the leader’s strike. Dodging just in time, you swing back, but he deftly parries and nicks you with his sword. The blade tears through your clothes and slices your side. You scream in pain.
— Not so brave now, huh? — the leader taunts, stepping closer. His eyes gleam with bloodlust.
Suddenly, you feel a presence, something intangible to ordinary senses. The air grows colder, and you shiver. Something is trying to merge with you. You hear a faint whisper: "Let me in".

lines.textCh: 让它附身。
lines.textEn: Let it in.

lines.textCh:
你曾在沼泽小屋里感受过这般寒意。这一次轮到女巫来出手帮你了，你又怎么敢拒绝呢？
你让她进入了自己的身体，被刺骨的寒意呛得喘不过气。仿佛被扔进冬日的冰封湖泊。
自那一刻起，这副躯体就不再受你掌控了，你仿佛成了自己生命的看客：你的四肢不由自主地蠕动起来，舌尖吐出陌生的语言。钟声在脑中轰鸣，万物化作浮光掠影闪过眼前。
逃兵首领以一个荒诞的姿势僵在了原地，他的眼睛仿佛感知到了最为本能的恐惧，散大的瞳孔在你眼前闪烁着。他的头一下子从躯干分离开来，滚落到地面上。
lines.textEn:
You’ve felt this cold before, back in the swamp hut. The witch has come to your aid, and who are you to refuse her?
You let her in, gasping from the icy chill. It feels like being plunged into a frozen lake in winter.
From that moment, you’re a passenger in your own body: your arms and legs move on their own, your tongue speaks words in an unfamiliar language. A bell seems to toll in your head. You see everything in flashes.
The leader freezes mid-sentence in a ridiculous pose. His eyes, wide with primal terror, flash before you. His head, severed from his body, rolls across the ground.

lines.textCh: 不，你的躯体永不会被邪恶魔法玷污，任何幽灵都无法触及你。你用仅存的每一分力气抵抗着。女巫的声音在你耳畔低语着你是个傻瓜，随即消散——就在这一刻，首领的利刃斩落了你的头颅。
lines.textEn: No, your body will never be defiled by vile magic, no spirits will touch you. You resist with every ounce of strength left. The witch’s voice whispers in your ear that you’re a fool, then fades. Right as the leader’s blade severs your head.

lines.textCh: 很高兴认识你。
lines.textEn: Nice to meet you.

lines.textCh: 你微笑着回以自我介绍。这家伙看起来还算个好人。或许日后能引导他走上正途，加入你们的领航者教团。但那都是后话了。眼下更紧迫的问题是，姆斯季斯拉夫能否对付那名女巫。
lines.textEn: You smile and introduce yourself in return. The guy seems decent. Maybe later you can guide him toward the true path, to join your Order of Navigators. But that’s for later. Right now, the more pressing question is whether Mstislav can handle the witch.

lines.textCh: 你根本不在乎他的名字。真正重要的是他能否对付那个女巫。你只希望他真的有那个本事，被困在这片沼泽里的其他人大概也都这么盼望着。
lines.textEn: You couldn’t care less about his name. What matters far more is whether he can deal with the witch. You hope he can, as does likely every living soul trapped in these swamps.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
只有你和姆斯季斯拉夫敢踏入这间小屋。尸体仍横卧在地板上。你浑身发抖，尽管此刻鬼魂带来的刺骨寒意已然消散。
姆斯季斯拉夫深吸一口气，呼出长长的气流，闭上双眼，开始诵念祷文。
你感到一阵奇异的颤动，不由后退一步，仿佛要为那些近乎吟唱的词句让开道路。屋内烛火骤然熄灭，万物骤然陷入黑暗。你甚至没注意到这些烛火竟一直燃烧着！
lines.textEn:
Only you and Mstislav dare to enter the hut. The corpse still lies on the floor. You shiver, though the biting cold that comes with the ghost’s presence isn’t here now.
Mstislav takes a deep breath, exhales loudly, closes his eyes, and begins reciting a prayer.
You feel a strange tremor and step back, as if making way for the words, almost a song. The candle flames in the hut flicker out, plunging everything into darkness. You hadn’t even noticed they’d been burning this whole time!

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
现在屋子里变得越来越冷了，你抱紧双臂，脚尖不停挪动，等待女巫现身，她却始终未至。斯拉夫卡闭目轻摇，念完祷文后叹了口气。寒意骤然消散，如同来时那般戛然而止。
你们静立凝神，倾听着。尽管蜡烛已熄灭，小屋却仿佛愈发明亮。
— 看来是大功告成了，— 姆斯季斯拉夫笑着挠了挠后脑勺，— 这里没有邪恶了。我想我们可以离开了。
lines.textEn:
Now it’s getting cold. You hug your shoulders, shifting from foot to foot, waiting for the witch to appear, but she doesn’t. Slavka finishes the prayer, swaying slightly with his eyes closed, then sighs. The cold vanishes as abruptly as it came.
You both stand silently, listening. The hut seems to grow brighter, despite the extinguished candles.
— Well, looks like that’s it, — Mstislav says with a smile, scratching the back of his head. — No more evil here. I think we can leave now.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
你们像胜利者般走出茅屋。逃兵们满怀希望地望着你们，就连头目也不禁问道：
— 这样就成了？我们自由了？
lines.textEn:
You step out of the hut like victors. The bandits look at you with hope. Even the leader allows himself to ask:
— That’s it? We’re free?

lines.textCh: 看起来是这样。
lines.textEn: Seems like it.

lines.textCh: 欢呼声骤然响起。逃兵们轮番拍着你和斯拉夫卡的肩膀。这场磨难终于结束了，他们终于可以离开了。
lines.textEn: Cheers erupt. The bandits slap you and Slavka on the shoulders. The ordeal is finally over. They can finally leave.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
你转身离去，继续走，不停地走。起初感觉很正常：或许这里就是很大，而不是什么魔法在作祟？
但随后……
lines.textEn:
You walk away. And keep walking. And walking. It feels normal at first: maybe the distances here are just vast without magic?
But then...

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
……你又回到了同一个小屋。
似乎你已经无法逃离这个地方了。
lines.textEn:
...you arrive back at the same hut.
It seems there’s no escape from this place.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 我们还有最后的机会，把镜子还给女巫！
lines.textEn: There’s still a chance to do things right and return the mirror to the witch!

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
但你刚一提起这事，首领就嗤之以鼻。
— 才怪，我才不会放弃刚拿到手的宝贝。
lines.textEn:
But as soon as you mention it, the leader snorts derisively.
— Hell no, I’m not giving up a damn thing.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 终于结束了。你再也感受不到女巫幽灵般的存在。你瘫跪在地，喘着粗气，随即迅速检查自己的侧腹。什么都没有，只有撕裂的衣衫。看来女巫治愈了你的伤口。你默默低语着感谢。
lines.textEn: Finally, it’s over. You no longer feel the witch’s ghostly presence. You collapse to your knees, catching your breath, then quickly check your side. Nothing, just torn clothes. It seems the witch healed your wound. You whisper a silent gratitude.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
匪徒们盯着你，不知该敬畏还是赞叹。
— 呃，看来镜子现在是你的了，— 那个年轻人率先回过神来说道。你点点头，试图站起身来。
lines.textEn:
The bandits stare at you, unsure whether to fear or praise you.
— Well, looks like the mirror’s yours now, — the young man says, snapping out of it first. You nod and try to stand.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
他的动作轻微一闪，你一个踉跄，刚好惊险避开。刀锋擦过你的手臂，几乎割到骨头，但总比伤及心脏好。你几乎已经握不住手里的剑了，但此刻已无需再战：
逃兵们把首领团团围住。你能看见他们起了争执，直到那年轻人从背后潜行而至，将匕首刺进他的肋骨。
首领呻吟着倒下了，双手徒劳地抓着空气，试图撑起身体反击。但没有人上前相助。
等到他最终断气后，那个年轻人翻遍了他的外套，掏出那面镜子。
— 好了，我们先给你包扎，然后把镜子交给女巫！— 他笑着说道。
lines.textEn:
He makes a subtle movement, and you barely dodge in time. His blade grazes your arm, cutting nearly to the bone, but better that than your heart. You can hardly hold your sword, but it’s no longer necessary.
The rebelling bandits surround their leader. You see them arguing, but only until the young man sneaks up behind him and drives a dagger under his ribs.
The leader wheezes and collapses. In a futile attempt to stay upright, he clutches at the air. No one moves to help him.
When he finally breathes his last, the young man rummages through his jacket and pulls out the mirror.
— Alright, we’ll patch you up and take the mirror to the witch! — he says with a smile.

lines.textCh:
突然间，众人纷纷后退。有人划十字，有人咒骂。你猛地抬起头，看见女巫正站在你和匪徒之间。
— 复仇，我要复仇，— 她几乎是低吼着。乱发如蛇般扭动，连你都感到不安。— 现在他们是我的了，他们都得死。
— 可我们没做错什么！我们没有杀你啊！— 人群中有人喊道。众人纷纷点头，仿佛这能说服嗜血的阴间来客放弃自己的执念。真的有必要掺和进来吗？
lines.textEn:
Suddenly, everyone flinches back. Some cross themselves, others curse. You jerk your head up and see the witch standing between you and the bandits.
— Vengeance, I need vengeance, — she almost growls. Her hair is disheveled, writhing like snakes. Even you feel uneasy. — They’re mine.
— But we didn’t do anything! We didn’t kill you! — someone shouts from the crowd. Everyone nods, as if that could convince a bloodthirsty otherworldly being. Is it even worth getting involved?

lines.textCh: 他们什么也没做！
lines.textEn: They didn’t do anything!

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
话音刚落，一道冰冷的箍带便扼住了你的喉咙。你捂住脖子，拼命喘息着。
— 他们杀了杀我的凶手。他们不让我复仇，便是将罪孽揽在自己身上，— 女巫头也不回地说。你明白亡者自然有自己的一套逻辑，而活人难以与之争辩。但你拒绝接受这个事实！你猛然跃起冲向幽灵，仿佛自己真的能从女巫手中救下这群人——你对此深信不疑，直到女巫伸出手，径直穿过你的胸膛。
lines.textEn:
As soon as you speak, an icy band clamps around your throat. You clutch your neck, gasping for air.
— They killed those who killed me. They took their sins upon themselves, — the witch says without turning to you. You realize the undead have their own logic, beyond the grasp of the living. But you’re not ready to accept it! You leap to your feet and charge at the ghost, as if you could actually do something. And you believe you can, until the witch extends her hand and passes it straight through your chest.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
起初，你还没有知觉。随后心跳仿佛丧失了节律，僵在了原地。你捂住胸口，瘫倒在地。
伴随着逃兵们惊恐的惨叫与临死前的呻吟，你失去了意识。而女巫正在他们之间大开杀戒，把他们撕扯得支离破碎。
lines.textEn:
At first, you feel nothing. Then your heart seems to forget how to beat. You clutch your chest and collapse.
You die to the screams and death rattles of the bandits being torn apart by the witch.

lines.textCh: 死亡
lines.textEn: DEATH

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 需要完整版游戏
lines.textEn: Full game version required

lines.textCh: 退出
lines.textEn: Exit

lines.textCh: 死亡
lines.textEn: Death

lines.textCh: 死亡
lines.textEn: Death

lines.textCh: 需要完整版游戏
lines.textEn: Full game version required

lines.textCh: 退出
lines.textEn: Exit

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
你闭上双眼。或许他们没杀死女巫，却烧毁了整座村庄！也许这样最好，一报还一报。
你紧闭双眼，直到最后一声尖叫与垂死喘息消散。当一切结束时，女巫已站在你身旁。
— 把镜子给我！
lines.textEn:
You close your eyes. Maybe they didn’t kill the witch, but they burned an entire village! Perhaps this is for the best.
You keep your eyes shut until the last scream and dying gasp fade. When it’s over, the witch is beside you.
— Bring me the mirror!

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
你需要和这些人交谈，为女巫寻找那件神器。
还有什么比食物更能拉近人与人之间的距离呢？
你从背包里掏出那根在村里买的香肠，走向那群男人。
lines.textEn:
You need to talk to these people to find the artifact for the witch.
And what brings people closer than food?
You pull a piece of sausage bought in the village from your pack and approach the men.

lines.textCh: 我带着食物，只要你们愿意告诉我一些事情，我就把它给你们。
lines.textEn: I’ve got food. I’ll give it to you if you tell me something.

lines.textCh:
男人们惊讶得僵在原地，瞪大眼睛盯着你。他们的目光滑落到你手中的香肠上，饥饿感瞬间在他们眼中燃烧起来。

— 你他妈是谁？凭什么拿着这东西就敢逗我们？— 那个尖声尖气的人嗤笑着拔出剑来。
lines.textEn:
The men freeze in surprise, staring at you wide-eyed. Their gazes drop to the sausage in your hands. Hunger flares in their eyes instantly.

— Who the hell are you? And why so bold? — the shrill-voiced one sneers, drawing his sword.

lines.textCh: 别装傻，我全都听见了。你们在这找不到任何能吃的东西。
lines.textEn: Don’t play dumb, I heard everything. You won’t find any more supplies here.

lines.textCh:
你决定给强盗施压，却低估了他们的绝望程度。

— 你大可以换个地方炫耀，— 那个尖声尖气的强盗逼近你。第二个带着口音的嗤笑着补充：

— 到下面去和死鬼炫耀去吧。

两人拔出剑来，猛地扑向了你。
lines.textEn:
You decide to press the bandits, but you misjudge how desperate they are.

— You can show off somewhere else, — the shrill one advances on you. The second, with an accent, snorts and adds:

— On the other side.

Both lunge at you, swords bared.

lines.textCh:
— 站住！— 那个带口音的也拔出了剑。你后退一步，目光始终锁定在他们身上。他们却死死盯着你手中的香肠。

事态发展太快，你甚至来不及拔出女巫给你的那把剑。两人如饿狼扑食般扑来，大张着嘴，后槽牙外露，动作宛如僵尸一般生硬。他们很清楚自己在做什么。
lines.textEn:
— Hold it right there, — the accented one also draws his sword. You step back, not taking your eyes off them. They’re fixated on the sausage in your hands.

It happens too fast, you don’t even have time to draw the sword the witch gave you. Both men charge like starving dogs, teeth bared, movements jerky. They know exactly what they’re doing.

lines.textCh: 尝试逃跑。
lines.textEn: Try to run.

lines.textCh: 尝试逃跑。
lines.textEn: Try to run.

lines.textCh:
你拼命试图逃跑。烧毁的村庄、女巫和她的要求都见鬼去吧！你只想活命。

但一切都是徒劳的。那些男人虽然饥肠辘辘，显然比你更加训练有素。其中一人已经追了上来。
lines.textEn:
You make a desperate attempt to flee. To hell with the burned village, the witch, and her request! You just want to live.

But it’s no use. The men, though hungry, are clearly better trained than you. One catches up.

lines.textCh:
一切都结束了，你从转身逃离的那一刻起就对此心知肚明：你不可能跑得过这群强盗，无论对方有多饥肠辘辘，他们仍然跑得更快，围堵猎物更有经验。

当身后的强盗一边尖嚎着，一边挥动利刃一刀斩落你的头颅时，你甚至没有感受到疼痛。你的身体瘫倒在地，手指在死亡痉挛中仍死死攥着香肠。匪徒们撬开你的手掌，把仍有余温的香肠夺走，但你早已不在乎了。

你死了。
lines.textEn:
You know it’s the end. You can’t outrun these bandits: hungry or not, they’re faster, better trained.

You don’t even feel the pain as the shrill one’s blade severs your head in one swing. Your body collapses, fingers clutching the sausage in a death spasm. The bandits pry it from your grip, but you no longer care.

You’re dead.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
彻骨的疼痛击穿了你的身体。你的双腿一软，开始不听使唤：脊椎被利剑劈成了两段。你低头寻找剧痛的根源，眼前的景象却让你几乎窒息——剑尖无情地从腹部太阳神经丛附近刺出。

你跪倒在地，随即脸朝下趴倒。香肠从你的手中滑落，一名强盗快步上前将香肠捡起。耳边传来了另一个人急促的话语，像是正在与他争执，但已经分辨不清了。你的意识逐渐模糊，很快便不再感到疼痛。

你死了。
lines.textEn:
A sharp pain. Your legs give out: your spine severed by a sword. You choke on terror, glancing down to see the blade’s tip protruding near your solar plexus.

You fall to your knees, then face-first. The sausage slips from your hands. One bandit steps closer and takes it. The other argues with him, but you can’t make out the words. Consciousness fades.

You die.

lines.textCh: 死亡
lines.textEn: DEATH

lines.textCh: 出门的时候当心点。
lines.textEn: Watch yourself on the way out.

lines.textCh: 这些可都是稀罕货。
lines.textEn: Those are quite rare.

lines.textCh: 我已经联系上那些司机了。这可不容易，但是我确实了解到了一些有意思的东西。
lines.textEn: I managed to contact the drivers. This wasn't easy, but I did unearth something interesting.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 轻拿轻放。
lines.textEn: Be careful with it.

lines.textCh: 这单就这么结了。
lines.textEn: Consider it done.

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 我能理解你不会一下子就把重要的活交给我，但我到这来是为了替你效力的。要怎么样才能让你相信我有那个实力？
lines.textEn: I get that you won’t trust me with a big job right away, but I’m here to work with you. What can I do to prove myself?

lines.textCh: 明白了。
lines.textEn: Got it.

lines.textCh: 那么，你都查到了些什么？
lines.textEn: So, what’d you find out?

lines.textCh: 顺便一提，我这里概不退款。
lines.textEn: No refunds, just so you know.

lines.textCh:
让我们开门见山吧。我听说有一群人铁了心想要插手我的生意。你应该能明白，这种行为我肯定看不下去。

你的任务是，从像你一样的雇佣兵那里打探消息，搞明白那些人究竟是谁。你要不惜一切代价，明白吗？

去找那些撤离点的司机们套套话，他们肯定知道这些事情。我只知道如果光用嘴皮子说的，就算谢谢说的再诚恳，那帮人肯定啥也不会告诉你，所以你得努努力。懂了吗？快去吧。
lines.textEn:
Now, let's begin. I have heard rumors that a certain group of people have decided to stick their noses into my business. I, as you can imagine, am not satisfied with that kind of activity.

Your job is to gather information from someone who's always hanging around mercenaries like you, and find out who these people are. You got to figure it out at all costs, okay?

Talk to the car evac drivers, they certainly know about this kind of business. I'm sure they won't give you anything for just a hearty thanks, so you'll have to work hard. Understood? Go on, then.

lines.textCh: 出门的时候当心点。
lines.textEn: Watch yourself on the way out.

lines.textCh: 这些可都是稀罕货。
lines.textEn: Those are quite rare.

lines.textCh: 我赶到的时候，线人已经死了。看样子他把所有的情报都写在了日记里，给你。
lines.textEn: The informant was already dead when I arrived. It seems he kept all the important details in his diary. Here you go.

lines.textCh: 都办完了。
lines.textEn: It's done.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 轻拿轻放。
lines.textEn: Be careful with it.

lines.textCh: 这单就这么结了。
lines.textEn: Consider it done.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 关于那个线人，他在市区亲眼目睹了一场会面，然后呢？
lines.textEn: About the informant. He set a meeting in the city. What’s next?

lines.textCh: 明白了。
lines.textEn: Got it.

lines.textCh: 看起来那些传言都是真的。确实有人在暗中破坏我的生意。这些滑头要在那个老旧的储备基地会面，交换情报。之后再来吧，等我想明白该怎么处理他们。
lines.textEn: It looks like the rumors have been confirmed after all. Someone really dared to start undermining me. These snakes are going to meet at the old federal reserve base, to transfer information. Come back later, while I figure out what to do about it.

lines.textCh: 顺便一提，我这里概不退款。
lines.textEn: No refunds, just so you know.

lines.textCh: 那个线人在车行附近开了个会，还是什么秘密地点？那你他妈的愣在这干什么呢？要是在你傻站着的这会他已经被逮住了，那就去找一个藏身处，藏身处的钥匙应该就在那附近。无论他挖出了什么东西，都带过来给我。这一回别让我失望了。
lines.textEn: The informant set up a meeting near the car dealership, at a hidden spot? So why the hell are you still here? If he gets busted while you're still here, look for a hidden hideout, a spare key for it must be somewhere in there too. Find everything he's dug up. Don't let me down.

lines.textCh: 出门的时候当心点。
lines.textEn: Watch yourself on the way out.

lines.textCh: 这些可都是稀罕货。
lines.textEn: Those are quite rare.

lines.textCh: 那个障眼的东西已经就位了，这是那份真的情报。好好看看吧。
lines.textEn: The dirt is in its intended place, and here is the original. Enjoy the read.

lines.textCh: 就这样吧，我不在乎。把报酬给我就行。
lines.textEn: Anyway, not my concern. Just give me my reward.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 轻拿轻放。
lines.textEn: Be careful with it.

lines.textCh: 这单就这么结了。
lines.textEn: Consider it done.

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 你之前提到军事基地那的事情。有什么新进展吗？
lines.textEn: You mentioned some business at the military base. Any updates?

lines.textCh: 明白了。
lines.textEn: Got it.

lines.textCh: 欢迎回来。现在，让我们看看他们要怎样。
lines.textEn: Welcome back. Now, let's see what they're up to.

lines.textCh: 顺便一提，我这里概不退款。
lines.textEn: No refunds, just so you know.

lines.textCh:
你来了，很好。现在给我听好：我的人去了会面的地方，而他们的任务是，把那些滑头努力准备的文件夹替换成我安排好的，但是我的小队已经几个小时没有回应了。

他们最后一次联系我的时候，说看到了一队游荡者。Knight 和他的人不可能知道这次行动，估计是其中某个美国佬把整件事给搅黄了。

你要做的第一件事情是，去检查一下游荡者的大本营，找到弄丢的情报——但千万别直愣愣地冲进去，不然就算是那帮脑子不灵光的外国佬也会发现不对劲，然后牵扯到我身上，开始问些蠢问题。拿到那份情报后，你需要把它送到储备站，我已经在那里的机械设备检修中心安排好了一个接头的地方。原版文件就在那辆 BMP 装甲车上，把你在污水厂找到的假情报留在那里，然后把真的那份文件给我带回来。

最重要的是把文件带给我。是时候揭露这些不要命的内奸的真面目了。
lines.textEn:
You're here, good. Now listen carefully. My men went to the meeting place, their job was to replace the folder these snakes were so diligently preparing with the one I had arranged, but it's already been several hours since my group stopped responding.

The last time they contacted me, they reported seeing a group of Rogues. Knight and his men are not aware of this operation, perhaps one of them interfered with the delivery.

The first thing you must do is to check the Rogues' base and find the lost data, but don't go to them right away, or they'll figure out I'm involved and will start asking questions. Then you'll have to deliver it to the federal reserve base, a meeting place has been set up at the machinery and equipment repair center. Find that folder and leave at the base, and bring the real one to me.

It's crucial to deliver this information to me. It's time to find out who these suicidal moles are.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 出门的时候当心点。
lines.textEn: Watch yourself on the way out.

lines.textCh: 这些可都是稀罕货。
lines.textEn: Those are quite rare.

lines.textCh: 那些吵闹鬼再也发不出动静了。我把文件也放好了，代我向那些 USEC 问好。
lines.textEn: All the nosy people are no longer nosy. I've stashed all the documents. Tell the USECs I said hi.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 轻拿轻放。
lines.textEn: Be careful with it.

lines.textCh: 这单就这么结了。
lines.textEn: Consider it done.

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 打听到那群古怪家伙的消息了吗？
lines.textEn: Managed to find anything out about that curious bunch?

lines.textCh: 明白了。
lines.textEn: Got it.

lines.textCh: 你做得很好，雇佣兵。你会成为我们的得力助手的。我这还有一些事情需要人手去办，过段时间再过来。
lines.textEn: You've done well, mercenary. You will be a useful asset. Come back later, there's still some unfinished business to take care of.

lines.textCh: 顺便一提，我这里概不退款。
lines.textEn: No refunds, just so you know.

lines.textCh:
这下一切都豁然开朗了。和我想的一样，那些客户并不是本地人，订单全部来自封锁线那一头。

我联络了几个人，他们也愿意帮忙，但是同时也给我们开了条件。他们在 Priozersky 自然保护区有一处……就说是设施好了。你在任何地方都能看到那个地方，但是没人知道山底下藏了什么。如果你去过那里，你一定见到过整个森林里最高的那座山。一眼就能注意到。

情况是，有一些好奇的游客一直在山附近晃悠，而且他们手痒痒得想要打开每一扇门。你应该知道，好奇害死猫。做点正事儿，把那些四处嗅探的“好奇猫”都赶走。等到了地方之后，把给 USEC 的文件放在他们的营地里。记住，这些文件绝不能落入其他人手中。
lines.textEn:
The whole thing is starting to become clearer. It seems that the customer is not from around here, as I initially assumed. The order came from the beyond the border.

I have contacts who are willing to assist, but they will need a favor in return. They own a certain, shall we say, facility, located in the Priozersk Nature Reserve. You can see the facility from everywhere, but nobody has a clue what is hiding under the mountain. If you've been in those places, you must have seen the hill that towers over the entire forest.

So, some curious tourists began to flock around that hill, and they are itching to open all the doors they see. As you know, curiosity killed the cat. Do the right thing and get rid of those cats. And while you're there, leave the documents for the USECs in their camp. Remember, these documents must not fall into the wrong hands.

lines.textCh: 出门的时候当心点。
lines.textEn: Watch yourself on the way out.

lines.textCh: 这些可都是稀罕货。
lines.textEn: Those are quite rare.

lines.textCh: 我抄近路来了。事情已经办好了。
lines.textEn: Shortest route possible straight to you. The job is done.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 轻拿轻放。
lines.textEn: Be careful with it.

lines.textCh: 这单就这么结了。
lines.textEn: Consider it done.

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 调查进行得怎么样？找到内鬼了吗？
lines.textEn: How's the investigation going? Found your mole yet?

lines.textCh: 明白了。
lines.textEn: Got it.

lines.textCh: 我看到信号了，干得好。我建议你不要在我们收拾残局的时候去那个地方。
lines.textEn: Saw the signal, great job. I advise you not to go to the base while my men are out there working.

lines.textCh: 顺便一提，我这里概不退款。
lines.textEn: No refunds, just so you know.

lines.textCh:
事情已经水落石出了。事实证明那群胆大包天的人都是 Glukhar 安排的，你应该知道那个混混，就是那个带着一群小弟在储备站驻扎着的前海军步兵。就是他拿走了你藏匿在储备站的文件。

谁想过他有那胆子来搞我？总之，他这下算是自寻死路了。做掉他们，把这事一劳永逸地解决掉。事成之后，找个高地用照明弹给我发个信号，我会派人去他们的老窝里抄家。我们得知道，他们到底发现了些啥。

发射完信号之后，就抄最近的路直接来我这里报告。
lines.textEn:
Well, the situation became plain enough. This group of hotshots is, as it turns out, run by Glukhar, an ex-marine who settled at the Reserve base with his crew. That's where he took the documents you planted.

Who'd have thought he'd have the nerve to undermine me? Well, he signed his own sentence. Hunt them down and settle the matter. When it's done, give a signal with a flare rocket from high ground, and I'll send men to their lair to sort out their junk. We need to find out what else they've been digging up.

As soon as you've fired the signal, you take the shortest possible route straight to me.

lines.textCh: 出门的时候当心点。
lines.textEn: Watch yourself on the way out.

lines.textCh: 这些可都是稀罕货。
lines.textEn: Those are quite rare.

lines.textCh: 完事了。
lines.textEn: Job’s done.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 轻拿轻放。
lines.textEn: Be careful with it.

lines.textCh: 这单就这么结了。
lines.textEn: Consider it done.

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 我们已经对付完了 Glukhar，还有其他事情要办吗？
lines.textEn: We’ve dealt with Glukhar. Anything else needs doing?

lines.textCh: 明白了。
lines.textEn: Got it.

lines.textCh: 行，你已经给我们的朋友留下了消息，让我们静观其变。现在你可以先走了。
lines.textEn: Alright, you left the message for our friends. Now we wait for their reaction. You can go for now.

lines.textCh: 顺便一提，我这里概不退款。
lines.textEn: No refunds, just so you know.

lines.textCh:
时间就是生命。我派出去清场的手下找到了一些证据，证明 Glukhar 暗中勾结某个受 TerraGroup 庇护的军火商。

你的下一个任务是，做点蠢事儿来挑衅这个军火贩子。对方很可能还不知道，Glukhar 已经被我们给料理完了。

去一趟 Ultra，TerraGroup 早些时候在那里设置了一个中转站。去把那个地方弄得稀烂，做做样子。记得用上你从 Glukhar 身上找到的战利品。至于那些故作聪明的家伙，就留下些羞辱性的东西，当作是我的问候——这么说吧，杂种狗必须知道自己的位置。
lines.textEn:
Time is of the essence. My cleaner crew found evidence of Glukhar's connection to the arms development that took place under the aegis of TerraGroup.

The next task for you is to provoke Glukhar's contacts into doing something foolish. They probably don't know yet that Glukhar is no longer available.

Go to Ultra, TerraGroup has had a staging post there since the early days. Make a mess of it. Use the trophy you took from Glukhar. And for the particularly savvy, leave something humiliating in place to say hello, so to speak. The mutts must know their place.

lines.textCh: 出门的时候当心点。
lines.textEn: Watch yourself on the way out.

lines.textCh: 这些可都是稀罕货。
lines.textEn: Those are quite rare.

lines.textCh: 我翻遍了整个实验室才找到这个，希望这是你要的那个东西。
lines.textEn: Tore through the lab and found this. Hope it’s what you need.

lines.textCh: 我翻遍了整个实验室才找到这个，希望这是你要的那个东西。
lines.textEn: Tore through the lab and found this. Hope it’s what you need.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 轻拿轻放。
lines.textEn: Be careful with it.

lines.textCh: 这单就这么结了。
lines.textEn: Consider it done.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 你那些大陆上的那些客户是什么情况？
lines.textEn: What’s with those mainland clients of yours?

lines.textCh: 明白了。
lines.textEn: Got it.

lines.textCh: 你找到数据载体了？很好，给我吧。解码需要一些时间，完事之后我会告诉你的。
lines.textEn: Do you have the recorder? Perfect, give it to me. It will take time to complete the decoding. I'll let you know when we're done.

lines.textCh: 顺便一提，我这里概不退款。
lines.textEn: No refunds, just so you know.

lines.textCh:
看来消息已经传达到位了——就连底舱的老鼠也知道船要沉了，开始四处逃窜。客户下令销毁开发工作的所有证据。

你的任务是潜入 TerraGroup 实验室，找到那个加密磁带，里面应该装着我们需要的数据。找到了之后就带过来给我。你还在等什么呢？指望我送你个棒棒糖祝你一路顺风？快点动起来！
lines.textEn:
The message found its recipient. Rats on a sinking ship began to scurry. The customers gave orders to destroy all evidence of ongoing developments.

Your mission is to infiltrate TerraGroup's lab, find the data carrier containing the data we need, and deliver it to me. What are you waiting for, a candy for good luck? Hurry up!

lines.textCh: 出门的时候当心点。
lines.textEn: Watch yourself on the way out.

lines.textCh: 这些可都是稀罕货。
lines.textEn: Those are quite rare.

lines.textCh: 我回来了，你要的东西都已经到位了。
lines.textEn: I’m back. Everything you asked for is in place.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 轻拿轻放。
lines.textEn: Be careful with it.

lines.textCh: 这单就这么结了。
lines.textEn: Consider it done.

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 带子里有什么有意思的东西吗？
lines.textEn: Find anything interesting on that tape?

lines.textCh: 明白了。
lines.textEn: Got it.

lines.textCh: 装备全部就位，通话完毕……好了，雇佣兵，下个任务可不简单，你得做好准备了。
lines.textEn: All the equipment is in place, over... Okay, mercenary, you're going to have to work hard for the next part.

lines.textCh: 顺便一提，我这里概不退款。
lines.textEn: No refunds, just so you know.

lines.textCh:
这下事情就变得有意思了：你所找到的数据表明，这些内鬼还参和了在市区袭击政府车队的事情——如果你去过街区，应该知道那个地方，就是 Nikitskaya (Никитская) 大街和 Primorsky (Приморский) 大道交汇的那个十字路口，也就是说，他们在附近肯定有个窝点，时不时会回到那里。

你的任务是侦查那片区域，找到几个好的监视点，并且准备一些装备。具体行动就不需要你来了，我这已经有一位神枪手能料理一切。帮我找一个 AI .338 消音器和一个 Trijicon 热成像仪来，分别藏在监视点里。
lines.textEn:
The situation takes an interesting turn. The data you delivered to me suggests that these moles were involved in the attack on the government convoy in the city, at the intersection of Nikitskaya Street and Primorsky Avenue, which means that from time to time they inhabit those parts.

Your job is to scout the area, prepare and equip some good positions to monitor the area. Nothing more than that for now. I already have a marksman for the job. You will need a silencer for .338 from AI and a Trijicon thermal imager.

lines.textCh: 出门的时候当心点。
lines.textEn: Watch yourself on the way out.

lines.textCh: 这些可都是稀罕货。
lines.textEn: Those are quite rare.

lines.textCh: 我已经是一个真正的狙击疯魔了。接下来呢？
lines.textEn: I'm a real psycho sniper now. So, what's next?

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 轻拿轻放。
lines.textEn: Be careful with it.

lines.textCh: 这单就这么结了。
lines.textEn: Consider it done.

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 狙击的事情怎么样了？对面都被收拾完了吗？
lines.textEn: How’s it going with the shooter? Dealt with the enemy?

lines.textCh: 明白了。
lines.textEn: Got it.

lines.textCh: 我们一直在观察你。我的神枪手已经出发了，就是这样。时间到了我会通知你的。
lines.textEn: We've been watching you. My shooter gave the go-ahead. That's all for now. I'll let you know when the time comes.

lines.textCh: 顺便一提，我这里概不退款。
lines.textEn: No refunds, just so you know.

lines.textCh:
看样子，在我的神枪手愿意以身试险、去你给他找的那个的狙击点里办事之前，他想看看你作为观察员的水平究竟如何。这一担心不无道理。还好我们预留的时间足够。就这么说吧：城市周围市区里到处都有狙击手，我们不能冒险让 Zryachiy 踏进危险地带。

提升一下你的反狙击技巧，然后我的人就信得过你了。快去吧，或者按照我们海军的说法，一帆风顺！
lines.textEn:
It seems that before my marksman decides to take risks at your prepared positions, he needs proof of your skill as an experienced spotter. Which makes sense. Time allows, thankfully. Let's just say there are snipers in and around the city who are operating out of their positions.

Improve your counter-sniper skills, and then my man will trust you. Go on then, seven feet under the keel.

lines.textCh: 出门的时候当心点。
lines.textEn: Watch yourself on the way out.

lines.textCh: 这些可都是稀罕货。
lines.textEn: Those are quite rare.

lines.textCh: 货物标记好了，那个区域已经在掌控之中了。我希望这件事值得我跑这么一趟。
lines.textEn: The cargo is marked, the area is under control. I hope it was worth it.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 轻拿轻放。
lines.textEn: Be careful with it.

lines.textCh: 这单就这么结了。
lines.textEn: Consider it done.

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 那支车队到底遭遇了什么？还需要我做什么事情吗？
lines.textEn: What happened with that convoy in the end? Anything else I need to do?

lines.textCh: 明白了。
lines.textEn: Got it.

lines.textCh:
你最近给 Zryachiy 准备的狙击点派上用场了。他已经成功干掉了几个变节者。

现在，既然你已经清理完了那片区域，标记完货物之后，只需要再打开那扇安全门，看看他们到底送的是什么宝贝东西就行了。

从这场阴谋牵涉的到的人来看，里面藏着的猛料不止能震动整个公司，恐怕就连许多在本土身居高位的头面人物也得人头落地。看来咱们要大赚一笔了，雇佣兵。保持联系。
lines.textEn:
The positions for Zryachiy that you recently prepared have come in handy. He successfully eliminated several conspirators.

Now, after you've cleaned up the area and marked the cargo, it's just a matter of opening the secured door and finding out what was it that they were transporting that was so valuable.

Judging by the people involved in this conspiracy, there may be something in there that could blow the heads off not only of the corporation, but of some very high-ranking people as well. Looks like we're in for some great business, mercenary. Keep in touch.

lines.textCh: 顺便一提，我这里概不退款。
lines.textEn: No refunds, just so you know.

lines.textCh:
Primorsky 大道的那一单就这样结了。这座城市到底藏着什么秘密？看样子那群恶棍连我这个栖身天涯海角的孤独老人都不放过，就因为我经手了一下那个车队护送的货物！

那些头脑简单的滑头们还没有意识到，他们已经把这批货物拱手让人了，我接手不过是顺理成章的事情。他们真以为靠几封廉价的敲诈信就能唬住我？他们把我当成什么了？！

好了，现在仔细听我说，你的任务是清理十字路口周围的区域，并且用指示器标记好货物。剩下的事情我的人会负责处理。
lines.textEn:
So much for Primorsky Avenue. What other secrets does this city hold? It turns out that these wretches have decided to make an attempt on my humble person because I could get my hands on the cargo which was carried by this very convoy.

The simple-minded snakes don't even realize that they're the ones who led me to this cargo with their own hands. Did they really think they could scare me with some cheap blackmail? Me?!

Alright, listen to me, your job is to secure the area around the intersection and mark the location of the cargo with a beacon. My men will do the rest.

lines.textCh: 出门的时候当心点。
lines.textEn: Watch yourself on the way out.

lines.textCh: 这些可都是稀罕货。
lines.textEn: Those are quite rare.

lines.textCh: 办完了，这是我找到的所有材料，都是关于那个裁判的。
lines.textEn: Done, here’s everything I found on Ref.

lines.textCh: 办完了，这是我找到的所有材料，都是关于那个裁判的。
lines.textEn: Done, here’s everything I found on Ref.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 轻拿轻放。
lines.textEn: Be careful with it.

lines.textCh: 这单就这样吧，你很快就能拿到所有的数据了。
lines.textEn: Consider it done. Soon you'll have all the data.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 你应该明白独门消息自有其重大价值。如果你还想深挖那个裁判的底细，我可以帮你。
lines.textEn: You know the value of unique intel. If you want to know more about Ref, I can help with that.

lines.textCh: 明白了。
lines.textEn: Got it.

lines.textCh: 很高兴你能明白，和谁做朋友更有利。
lines.textEn: I'm glad you understand who it's more advantageous to be friends with.

lines.textCh: 顺便一提，我这里概不退款。
lines.textEn: No refunds, just so you know.

lines.textCh: 我听说你卷进了 Fence 和竞技场裁判之间的风波。也是，在招惹到这种人物之后，这里算是你唯一能来的地方了。你想报复一下那个裁判？嗯……这倒是可能会对我有利。去给我找点他的脏材料来，我会想办法利用好的。
lines.textEn: I heard you got involved in this affair with Fence and Ref. So of course you decided to come to me. You want to mess with Ref? Hmm, that would be beneficial to me. Bring me the dirt on him, and I'll find a way to use it.

lines.textCh: 出门的时候当心点。
lines.textEn: Watch yourself on the way out.

lines.textCh: 这些可都是稀罕货。
lines.textEn: Those are quite rare.

lines.textCh: 办完了，你的朋友应该会欣赏我的留言方式的。
lines.textEn: It's done. Your friends are gonna love this.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 轻拿轻放。
lines.textEn: Be careful with it.

lines.textCh: 从没想到我也会卷入某种仪式……我会想办法搞清楚的。
lines.textEn: I didn't think I'd be part of some ritual... Well, I'll figure it out when I get there.

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 我已经等不及要干一票大的了，你这里有什么活吗？
lines.textEn: I’m ready for a big job. Got work for me?

lines.textCh: 明白了。
lines.textEn: Got it.

lines.textCh:
也许现在你已经从一场新的灾难中拯救了塔科夫，这场浩劫本会将这座城市从地球上抹去......但这座城市毕竟命数未尽。

这是你的报酬。哦，多提一句，如果换成是我，绝不会继续在那个危险的地牢周边继续打探消息。
lines.textEn:
Perhaps now you've saved Tarkov from a new calamity that could have wiped the city off the face of the earth... before its time.

Your reward is here. Oh, and one more thing. If I were you, I'd stop enquiring about those dungeons if you want to survive these troubled times.

lines.textCh: 顺便一提，我这里概不退款。
lines.textEn: No refunds, just so you know.

lines.textCh:
我有一项新的差事要交给你。有人找到办法闯入了疗养院地下牢房。这对塔科夫来说不算好事。即使在和平时期，好奇心也经常害死猫，至于在现在的局势下，一个人的错误选择可能牵连更多人丧命。

我知道该如何保卫地堡免受闯入者的侵扰。你可能还没有和这座城市的夜间守护人打过交道，但他们肯定已经见过你的面孔。现在你要做的则是在那个 Knossos 设施里用他们自己的道具为他们留下一则简短的消息。

但你要做的不是简单地把刀插在旧时代的瓦砾堆上，你需要为其赋予意义，整幅景象真正成为精神象征。具体的藏匿地点由你自己去想，如果连这种简单的问题都搞不定，那我也没有必要再和你合作了。
lines.textEn:
I have a new job for you. Someone found a way into the cellars under the health resort. This is not a good set of circumstances for Tarkov. Excessive curiosity often ruins a man in peacetime, but in the present situation, the mistake of one will lead to the death of many.

I know how to safeguard the bunker. You may not have yet met the wardens who watch the city at night. But they certainly have met you. And now I need you to leave a short message for them at the Knossos facility, with their instruments.

However, just dropping these knives in the rubble won't be enough. You need places with meaning, so that the knife you stick in becomes a symbol of sorts. Which places should you choose? You'll figure it out on your own. And if you can't, why should I even work with you?

lines.textCh: 出门的时候当心点。
lines.textEn: Watch yourself on the way out.

lines.textCh: 这些可都是稀罕货。
lines.textEn: Those are quite rare.

lines.textCh: 事情办完了，我这里一切就绪。
lines.textEn: Here about the job. Everything's done on my end.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 轻拿轻放。
lines.textEn: Be careful with it.

lines.textCh: 好，我会去办的。
lines.textEn: Okay, I'm in.

lines.textCh: 我现在帮不了你。
lines.textEn: I cannot help you right now.

lines.textCh: 你听说 BTR 司机和 Skier 之间闹出的冲突了吗？听起来阵仗还挺大的。
lines.textEn: Heard about the conflict between the BTR driver and Skier? Sounds serious.

lines.textCh: 明白了。
lines.textEn: Got it.

lines.textCh: 干得好，报酬不会让你失望的。
lines.textEn: Well done. The reward will not disappoint you.

lines.textCh: 顺便一提，我这里概不退款。
lines.textEn: No refunds, just so you know.

lines.textCh:
我对当地混混之间的冲突一点都不感兴趣，两边都不准备搭理。但是既然你都来了，那我顺带找个事情给你做。

任务很简单：在储备站军医院楼顶取一个货箱，把货物带到转移点去。搬箱子的时候千万小心点，还有中途不允许打开。这件货物可能会引起某些人的兴趣，所以我需要一个知道该怎么保持口风的人来办得妥妥帖帖。你最好够格。
lines.textEn:
I am not interested in localized conflicts and I am not going to help either side. But since you are already here, I have a job for you.

The task is simple: pick up one cargo from the roof of the military hospital at the reserve base and deliver it to the transfer point. Be careful with the cargo and do not open the crate. This shipment might be of interest to certain people, so I need a man with special skills. Someone like you.

lines.textCh: 出门的时候当心点。
lines.textEn: Watch yourself on the way out.

lines.textCh: 这些可都是稀罕货。
lines.textEn: Those are quite rare.

lines.textCh: 事情办完了，我这里一切就绪。
lines.textEn: Here about the job. Everything's done on my end.

lines.textCh: 很好。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 轻拿轻放。
lines.textEn: Be careful with it.

lines.textCh: 听起来很简单。我来搞定。
lines.textEn: Sounds easy enough. I'll handle it.

lines.textCh: 我自己的麻烦事已经够多了，这回真的帮不上忙。
lines.textEn: I've got enough on my plate already. I can't help you.

lines.textCh: 你听说 BTR 司机和 Skier 之间闹出的冲突了吗？听起来阵仗还挺大的。
lines.textEn: Heard about the conflict between the BTR driver and Skier? Sounds serious.

lines.textCh: 明白了。
lines.textEn: Got it.

lines.textCh: 很好。我已经准备好奖励了。
lines.textEn: Perfect. I've already prepared the reward.

lines.textCh: 顺便一提，我这里概不退款。
lines.textEn: No refunds, just so you know.

lines.textCh:
你应该也知道，我对本地混混之间的小打小闹一点都不感兴趣。真正要紧的事情还在等着我，自然，我是不会出手去帮助冲突的任意一方的。既然说到干活，我需要有人帮我把一件货物从藏匿点带到另一个地方。 

那件货物就藏在军事基地空域控制中心的电子设备仓库里，目的地则是 Priozersk 自然保护区。交货点地标是一处乱葬岗——你看到那些担架和横七竖八的尸体就明白了，不是所有人都能有幸入土为安的。 

考虑到货物性质的特殊性，可能会有其他人对它下手。因此我需要一个能够保障运输期间货物绝对安全的人来做这件事。
lines.textEn:
Surely you don't think I would be interested in petty local conflicts? I have much more important matters to attend to, and I am not going to help either of the parties. Speaking of which. I need to move an item from point A to point B. 

It is hidden at the electromechanical warehouse in the airspace control center at the military base. It's to be delivered to the Priozersk nature reserve. The landmark will be a small cemetery. You'll recognize it by the stretchers and the bodies around it -- not everyone has been buried in time. 

Since my cargo is very specific, some people may have a particular interest in it. That is why I need someone who can guarantee the safety of the cargo during transportation.

lines.textCh: 你死了
lines.textEn: You died

lines.textCh: 返回主界面
lines.textEn: Return to Main menu

lines.textCh: 哈哈，不错的笑话。
lines.textEn: Haha, funny joke.

lines.textCh:
你意识到女巫需要你去取回那件神器。你走向逃兵们残缺不全的尸体。女巫如同野兽一般撕碎了他们。想要在这团碎肉中找到那面镜子实在是痛苦非凡。但你需要找到那件神器。
终于，你找到了那面镜子。不过是一面小巧的、磨损严重的银镜，没什么特别之处。但对那鬼魂而言，它必定意义非凡。
你转身想与她交谈，却发现空无一人。
lines.textEn:
You realize the witch needs you to deliver the artifact. You approach what’s left of the bandits. The witch tore them apart like a wild beast. It’s painful to look at what remains of them, but you need to find the artifact.
Finally, you find the mirror. Nothing special, just a small, worn silver mirror. It must be very important to the ghost.
You turn, hoping to speak with her, but no one’s there.

lines.textCh: 这算是奖励吗？
lines.textEn: Is that a threat?

lines.textCh:
你意识到女巫需要你去取回那件神器。你走向逃兵首领的尸体，小心翼翼地搜查着，同时避开其他匪徒残缺不全的尸体。女巫连那个年轻小伙子都没放过——你注意到他的断臂就躺在附近，急忙移开视线。
终于，你找到了那面镜子。不过是一面小巧的、磨损严重的银镜，没什么特别之处。但对那鬼魂而言，它必定意义非凡。
你转身想与她交谈，却发现空无一人。
lines.textEn:
You realize the witch needs you to deliver the artifact. You approach the body of the bandit leader, carefully searching it while avoiding the grisly remains of the other bandits. The witch didn’t spare even that young lad. You notice his severed arm lying nearby and quickly look away.
Finally, you find the mirror. Nothing special, just a small, worn silver mirror. It must be very important to the ghost.
You turn, hoping to speak with her, but no one’s there.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 这次，你只花了几分钟时间就抵达了小屋。这肯定又是女巫的魔法在作祟。屋内依旧寂静如故，尸体躺在原处一动不动。
lines.textEn: This time, you reach the hut in mere minutes. It must be the witch’s magic. Inside, it’s as quiet as before; the body lies in the same spot.

lines.textCh: 把镜子放在尸体旁。
lines.textEn: Place the mirror beside it.

lines.textCh:
当你把镜子放在尸体旁边时，鬼魂便出现了。女巫微笑着，眼眶几乎泛起泪光。刹那间，你差点忘了就在刚才，她一瞬间屠戮了那么多久经沙场的战士！
— 你完成了我的请求，— 她感激地点点头。你注意到她的幽灵身躯开始从脚底逐渐消散。— 谢谢你。
她飘近些，用指尖轻拂你的脸颊。你感受到那熟悉的寒意。 
— 我们会再次见面的，比你想象的更快。
lines.textEn:
As soon as you set the mirror next to the body, the ghost appears. The witch smiles, almost in tears. For a moment, you forget she slaughtered so many hardened warriors in an instant!
— You fulfilled my request, — she nods gratefully. You notice her ghostly form starting to dissolve, beginning at her feet. — Thank you.
She drifts closer, brushing your cheek with her fingertips. You feel that familiar chill. 
— We’ll meet again. Sooner than you think.

lines.textCh: 你在说什么？
lines.textEn: What are you talking about?

lines.textCh:
女巫没有回应，只是带着一副通晓一切的微笑静静地待在原地。她的身体几乎完全消散，只剩下头颅悬浮在空中。
— 不要惧怕死亡，这是我们每个人无可避免的归宿，— 她说道，随即彻底消失无踪。
lines.textEn:
The witch doesn’t respond, only smiling softly, knowingly. Her body has almost completely dissolved, only her head remains.
— Don’t fear death, it comes for everyone, — she says, then vanishes completely.

lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 向着广场边缘屋子之间走去。
lines.textEn: Move toward the gap between the houses at the edge of the square.

lines.textCh: 但你们连我的名字都还不知道。
lines.textEn: "But you don't even know my name."

lines.textCh: 真是遗憾。
lines.textEn: A pity.

lines.textCh: 稍等一会。
lines.textEn: Linger a bit.

lines.textCh: 城门封锁上了吗？
lines.textEn: Are the gates closed?

lines.textCh:
你稳稳地站着，身体几乎没晃动。那对兄弟冲你微笑，你也勉强挤出一个尴尬的笑容。
— 来吧，坐下，干嘛还站着？— 他们领着你走到一根倒下的树干旁，让你坐下。片刻后，其中一人把一个酒壶塞到你手里。
— 来，喝吧，别客气。咱们都是朋友嘛！— 你别无选择，只好抿了一口。
不出所料，壶里装着他们自酿的烈酒，你甚至分不清到底是哪一种。
— 说说看，你来这儿干什么？也是在躲那些士兵吗？— 其中一个兄弟问，另一个也插话道：
— 我们不得不抛下一切。家园、牲畜……现在大概都已化为废墟了吧。
lines.textEn:
You hold your ground, barely swaying. The brothers smile at you, and you manage an awkward smile back.
— Come on, let’s sit, why stand around? — They lead you to a fallen log and sit you down. A moment later, one of them shoves a flask into your hand.
— Go on, drink, don’t be shy. We’re all friends here! — You have no choice but to take a sip.
As expected, it’s some kind of strong brew, and you can’t even tell what it is.
— So, what’re you doing here? Running from those soldiers too, eh? — one brother asks, and the other chimes in:
— We had to abandon everything. Our home, our livestock... It’s probably all in ruins by now.

lines.textCh: 只是有些累了。
lines.textEn: It’s just exhaustion.

lines.textCh: 为什么你们还没进城呢？
lines.textEn: Why aren’t you in the city yet?

lines.textCh: 为什么你们还没进城呢？
lines.textEn: Why aren’t you in the city yet?

lines.textCh: 给他们一些钱。
lines.textEn: Give them money.

lines.textCh: 别一下子把钱花光了。
lines.textEn: Just spend the money wisely.

lines.textCh: 举手示意。
lines.textEn: Raise your hand.

lines.textCh: 不要插手。
lines.textEn: Don’t intervene.

lines.textCh: 你洪亮的嗓音应该足够让所有人听见了。
lines.textEn: Your powerful voice should be quite enough.

lines.textCh: 利用他们内心的脆弱之处。
lines.textEn: Lean into their sense of vulnerability.

lines.textCh: 自己找到出路。
lines.textEn: Find your own way.

lines.textCh: 我没想给你钱，只是在找路。
lines.textEn: I wasn’t planning to spend money on you. I’m just looking for the way.

lines.textCh: 你的孩子……他们怎么了？
lines.textEn: Your children… what’s wrong with them?

lines.textCh: 你的孩子……他们怎么了？
lines.textEn: Your children… what’s wrong with them?

lines.textCh: 保持沉默。
lines.textEn: Stay silent.

lines.textEn: Do nothing.

lines.textEn: Do nothing.

lines.textEn: Where are you taking me?

lines.textCh: 顺从。
lines.textEn: Comply.

lines.textCh: 向人群求助。
lines.textEn: Ask the crowd for help.

lines.textCh: 向着宫殿前进。
lines.textEn: Head toward the palace.

lines.textCh: 还击！
lines.textEn: Fight back!

lines.textEn: Think of something.

lines.textEn: Turn back

lines.textEn: Try to buy him off.

lines.textEn: Try to reason with him.

lines.textCh: 谢谢你们陪我聊天，还给我酒喝。
lines.textEn: "It’s for the chat and the drink."

lines.textCh: Svetozar
lines.textEn: Svetozar

lines.textCh: Shchuka
lines.textEn: Shchuka

lines.textCh:
当你行至塔格勒附近时，已经是黄昏时分。你望见地平线上城市的轮廓，不禁叹了口气。
你的旅程即将抵达终点。
lines.textEn:
The day is already drawing to a close when you find yourself near Targrad. You see its silhouette on the horizon and let out a sigh.
Your journey is nearing its end.

lines.textCh: 终于啊。
lines.textEn: Finally.

lines.textCh: 你已经精疲力竭了——你曾无数次命悬一线，但这并不能算什么。很快你就能稍作休整，再次踏上归途重返教团……支撑你继续走下去的无非是这些念头而已。
lines.textEn: You’re exhausted. Too many times, your life hung by a thread. But no matter, soon you’ll be able to rest a little before returning to the Order... You’re already living for those thoughts.

lines.textCh:
是的，你的性命不止一次危在旦夕，但你已许久未曾在冒险中感受到自己的生命力是如此的鲜活。
或许归途会同样波澜壮阔？
lines.textEn:
Yes, your life was in danger more than once, but you haven’t felt this... alive in a long time.
Maybe the journey back will be just as eventful?

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
但现在不是分心的时候。只剩最后一段路了。你得在日落前把卷轴送达城市，这样才能安心休息。他们有义务为你提供住宿。
你加快了脚步。街道上人来人往：富人乘马车进城，农民则徒步跋涉。但人们似乎有些不对劲。空气中弥漫着紧张的气氛。你摇了摇头，把刚刚浮现的异样感觉归咎于自己的疲惫。
lines.textEn:
But now’s not the time to get distracted. One final push remains. You want to deliver the scroll before sunset so you can rest peacefully. They’re obligated to provide you with quarters for that.
You quicken your pace. The road is bustling: wealthy folks ride into the city in carriages, peasants trudge on foot. But something feels off about the people. The air is tense. You chalk it up to your own exhaustion.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
终于，你抵达了中央城门，只见门前聚集着一大群人。冷汗瞬间浸透了你的全身：难道城门被封锁了吗？这意味着什么？你该如何进去？
你加快脚步走向人群。这里大多是身无长物、行囊轻便的农民。有人神情愤怒，有人仿佛认命一般垂头丧气，还有人显然惊恐万分。你看到用枯草搭起的简易帐篷和铺垫。看来有些人已经等了好几天。周遭恐惧的气氛压得你喘不过气来。
在你面前，你看到一名卫兵正和某个家伙大声争执。
lines.textEn:
At last, you reach the central gates and see a crowd gathered before them. Cold sweat grips you: is the city sealed? What does this mean? How will you get inside?
You quicken your pace and approach the crowd. Most here are peasants, traveling light. Some are angry, others resigned, and some clearly frightened. You spot makeshift tents and bedding made of wilted grass. It seems some have been waiting for days. The atmosphere of fear presses down on you.
Ahead, you see a guard arguing with someone.

lines.textCh: 径直走到卫兵身前。
lines.textEn: Go straight to the guard.

lines.textCh:
你决定先了解一下情况。塔格勒城墙下的这片临时营地简直像难民营一样，四处弥漫着绝望的气息。你想弄清楚到底发生了什么。
环顾四周，你注意到两个年轻人。他们身材魁梧，金发碧眼，身穿简朴的短袍，脚上穿着沾满灰尘的麻布鞋。他们正谈笑风生，在这片阴郁的氛围中显得格外耀眼。你径直走向他们。
lines.textEn:
You decide to assess the situation first. This impromptu encampment at Targrad’s walls is steeped in despair. You want to find out what’s happened.
Glancing around, you notice two young men. They’re sturdy, fair-haired, dressed in simple tunics and dust-covered bast shoes. They’re chatting and laughing, standing out like bright sparks against the local gloom. You head straight for them.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
他们一看到你就停下了交谈，随即露出了如出一辙的笑容，你顿时明白了：这两人是亲兄弟。
— 你好啊，旅行者！有什么事吗？— 其中一个脸上点缀着雀斑的男孩朝你挥手说道。他显然是两兄弟中更开朗的哪一位，你注意到他缺了一颗门牙。
另一个个子稍矮但肩膀更宽的男孩，把强壮的双臂交叉在胸前，不耐烦地跺着脚，却还没加入谈话。
lines.textEn:
They fall silent as they notice you, then flash identical smiles, and you instantly know: they’re brothers.
— Greetings, traveler! What’s the matter? — says one, freckled and cheerful, waving at you. You notice he’s missing a front tooth. 
The other, shorter but broader-shouldered, crosses his strong arms and taps his foot impatiently but doesn’t join the conversation yet.

lines.textCh: 我刚到这座城市，还不清楚这里发生了什么。
lines.textEn: I just arrived and don’t understand what’s going on here.

lines.textCh:
两个年轻人一动不动地盯着你。那个缺了一颗牙的年轻人突然间笑出声来。
— 哎，这种事谁没经历过呢！— 他说道，接着用尽全身的力气拍了拍你的肩膀。
lines.textEn:
The young men stare at you, unblinking. The one missing a tooth suddenly laughs.
— Well, we’ve all been through it! — he says, clapping you on the shoulder with all his youthful strength.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
他拍的这一下让你不禁低声呻吟，那股冲击在胸腔里回荡。你今天经历了太多事情，早已精疲力尽。双腿几乎支撑不住身子，全靠一腔意志力才让你勉强站立。
— 你还好吗，老兄？— 那个个子较矮的兄弟可没被你装出来的硬汉样子骗过去。也许你脸色一瞬间变白了，也许是别的什么原因，但他察觉到了不对劲。
lines.textEn:
The impact makes you groan, the blow resonating in your chest. You’re so exhausted, having endured so much today, that your legs nearly give out. Only sheer willpower keeps you standing.
— You alright, friend? — The shorter brother isn’t fooled. Maybe you pale for a moment, or maybe it’s something else, but he senses something’s off.

lines.textCh: 没事，一切都很好。
lines.textEn: Everything’s fine.

lines.textCh:
兄弟俩互相对视了一眼，随后把你带到一旁的一根倒下的树干旁。你意识到这树干八成是他们自己拖过来的。他们让你坐下，然后把一个酒壶塞到你手里。
— 来，喝吧，别客气。咱们都是朋友嘛！— 你别无选择，只好抿了一口。
不出所料，壶里装着他们自酿的烈酒，你甚至分不清到底是哪一种。
— 说说看，你来这儿干什么？也是在躲那些士兵吗？— 其中一个兄弟问，另一个也插话道：
— 我们不得不抛下一切。家园、牲畜……现在大概都已化为废墟了吧。
lines.textEn:
The brothers exchange a glance, then lead you a bit aside to a fallen log. You realize they probably dragged it here themselves. They sit you down and press a flask into your hands.
— Go on, drink, don’t be shy. We’re all friends here! — You have no choice but to take a sip.
As expected, it’s some kind of strong brew, and you can’t even tell what it is.
— So, what’re you doing here? Running from those soldiers too, eh? — one brother asks, and the other chimes in:
— We had to abandon everything. Our home, our livestock... It’s probably all in ruins by now.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: — 我们还没正式自我介绍呢！我是 Yaropolk，叫我 Yarik 就好。这位是 Svyatopolk，— 那个缺牙的人说着，先指了指自己，又指了指他的兄弟。出于礼貌，你也自报家门。
lines.textEn: — We haven’t properly introduced ourselves! I’m Yaropolk, just call me Yarik. And this is Svyatopolk, — the toothless one says, pointing first to himself, then to his brother. You introduce yourself in return.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 这些人怎么了？
lines.textEn: What’s with this crowd?

lines.textCh:
— 倒也不是这样！— 那个缺牙的人叹了口气，随即突然伸出手来。
— 我们还没介绍自己呢！我是 Yaropolk，叫我 Yarik 就好。这位是 Svyatopolk。— 你握住他们伸过来的手，然后试着换种说法再问一次。
lines.textEn:
— Not exactly! — The toothless one sighs, then suddenly extends a hand.
— We haven’t properly introduced ourselves! I’m Yaropolk, just call me Yarik. And this is Svyatopolk. — You shake their outstretched hands, then try asking again, rephrasing.

lines.textCh: 这些人怎么了？
lines.textEn: What’s with this crowd?

lines.textCh:
— 他们不让我们进去！— Svyatopolk 双手一摊，但 Yarik 纠正了弟弟：
— 他们可以让我们进去，但得付钱，或者找人担保才行。所以我们正缠着每个商人，希望能让他们雇我们运货。

两兄弟几乎异口同声地呸了一声。Yarik 接着说：
— 听说这座城很快就要封锁起来了，到时候谁都进不去，我们得在那之前挤进去。

你感到惊讶。封锁？这里既没有敌军包围，也没有瘟疫肆虐。你确信他们会放你们进去，但这两个小伙子……也许你该帮帮他们？
lines.textEn:
— They won’t let us in! — Svyatopolk throws up his hands, but Yarik corrects his brother:
— They’ll let us in, but you gotta pay or have someone vouch for you. So we’re hassling every merchant, hoping they’ll hire us to haul their goods.

Both brothers spit in near unison. Yarik continues:
— Word is, the city might close off to everyone soon. We wanna get in before that happens.

You’re surprised. Close off? There’s no siege, and no plague is ravaging the area. You’re sure they’ll let you in, but these lads... Maybe you should help them?

lines.textCh: 让他们自求多福吧。
lines.textEn: Let them fend for themselves.

lines.textCh: 你看了看那对兄弟，意识到就算没有你帮忙，他们多半也能挤进城去。再说，你肩负着重要任务，没时间在陌生人身上浪费。
lines.textEn: You look at the brothers and realize they’ll manage without you. Besides, you’ve got an important mission and can’t waste time on strangers.

lines.textCh: 好吧，我得走了。
lines.textEn: Alright, I’ve got to go.

lines.textCh:
兄弟俩不情愿地点了点头。看得出他们很想继续聊下去。他们虽然没活干，但你却有任务在身，而且必须在天黑前完成。
你匆匆向他们道别，朝塔格勒的大门走去。
lines.textEn:
The brothers nod, reluctantly. You can tell they’d love to keep chatting. They’ve got no work, but you do, and it needs to be done by nightfall.
You bid them a quick farewell and head toward the gates of Targrad.

lines.textCh:
你默默地在背包里翻找，无视那对兄弟好奇的目光。他们是好小伙子。Karhu 与 Turva 之间的战争毁掉了他们往昔的美好生活，他们应该在城市里重新开始。
终于，你找到了钱袋，掏出几枚硬币。你会留一些给自己，以防万一。
— 拿着吧，应该够了。
那对兄弟睁大眼睛盯着你。Yarik 最先回过神来。
— 什么，这是在开玩笑吗？
你摇摇头，把钱袋递过去。他缓缓接过，脸上仍满是困惑。
Svyatopolk 却一把抱住了你。
— 谢谢你，好心人，谢谢！你救了我们的命！我们这下有救了！我们的长子就以你的名字命名！
lines.textEn:
You rummage through your satchel in silence, ignoring the brothers’ curious glances. They’re good lads. The war between Karhu and Turva took their old lives, and they deserve a fresh start.
Finally, you find your coin pouch and pull out a couple of coins. You’ll keep some for yourself, just in case.
— Here, this should help.”
The brothers stare at you, wide-eyed. Yarik snaps out of it first.
— What, is this a joke?
You shake your head and hold out the pouch. Slowly, he takes it, still looking bewildered.
Svyatopolk, on the other hand, throws his arms around you.
— Thank you, kind soul, thank you! You’ve saved our lives! We’re gonna make it now! We’ll name our first sons after you!

lines.textCh: 谢谢你们陪我聊天，还给我酒喝。
lines.textEn: It’s for the chat and the drink.

lines.textCh:
— 哦，太谢谢你了！— 你看到 Yarik 眼中泛起一抹泪光。— 这世上果然还是有好人的！

你微笑着与兄弟俩握手。该出发了，否则天黑前赶不到城里。
lines.textEn:
— Oh thank you! — You see a faint glimmer of tears in Yarik’s eyes. — The world’s not without kind people after all!

You smile and shake the brothers’ hands. It’s time to go, or you won’t make it to the city by nightfall.

lines.textCh:
兄弟俩齐齐点了点头。Svyatopolk 已经小心地把钱袋收好在身上。聪明的家伙，没把钱袋拿出来炫耀。

— 我们这就动身去城里！

你和他们握手道别。心里感到一阵轻松。你知道自己做了件正确的事情。
lines.textEn:
The brothers nod in unison. Svyatopolk has already tucked the coin pouch away somewhere. Smart move, not flashing it around.

— We’re gonna head to the city right now!

You shake their hands and say goodbye. Your heart feels light. You know you did the right thing.

lines.textCh:
你走向那名被人群包围的卫兵。大家都在喊叫、哀求，你一言我一语，场面一片混乱。突然，卫兵厉声吼道：
— 排好队，你们这群狗杂种，排好队！
人群吓得纷纷后退。卫兵继续喊道：
— 有公务在身的优先进塔格勒！
你意识到你的机会到了。
lines.textEn:
You approach the guard, who’s surrounded by a crowd. Everyone’s shouting, pleading, talking over each other. It’s a chaotic mess. Suddenly, the guard bellows:
— Line up, you sons of bitches, line up!
The crowd shrinks back in fear. The guard continues:
— First come those with official business in Targrad!
You realize this is your chance.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 大声喊叫。
lines.textEn: Shout out.

lines.textCh: 你举起了手，但周围人太多，没人注意到，那个卫兵更是没朝你这看一眼。
lines.textEn: You raise your hand, but with so many people around, no one notices, especially not the guard.

lines.textCh: 大声喊叫。
lines.textEn: Shout out.

lines.textCh:
— 我有官方事务在身，必须马上进城！
所有人都转过头来看着你，随后让开一条路。卫兵严厉地盯着你，眉头紧锁。你的样子似乎没能说服他。
lines.textEn:
— I have official business in Targrad that can’t be delayed!
Everyone turns to look at you, then parts to make way. The guard eyes you sternly, frowning. Your appearance doesn’t seem to convince him.

lines.textCh: 展示信件。
lines.textEn: Show the letter.

lines.textCh:
那封盖满印章的官方公文瞬间说服了守卫。他微微鞠了一躬，便指引你走向城门。

在此之后，中途又有两次有人要你出示公文才放你继续前行。不过在 20 分钟后，你还是来到了城市广场。
lines.textEn:
The official letter with all its seals instantly convinces the guard. He gives a brief bow and directs you toward the gates.

Twice more, you’re asked to show the letter before being allowed to proceed. But twenty minutes later, you finally find yourself in the city square.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
一群人站在你面前。他们不是闲逛的路人，也不是赶集的商贩，而是一群愤怒又惊恐的人。你听见有人谈论要阻止难民进入，并立即关闭城门。卫兵们试图安抚人群，但毫无用处。回应他们的是一连串的咒骂和指责，说他们拖延不决，早该把所有人从城墙边赶走。
双方的怒火都在沸腾。冲突一触即发。你觉得自己或许能改变局面。
lines.textEn:
A crowd stands before you. Not idle strollers or market shoppers, but angry and frightened people. You overhear talk about keeping refugees out and closing the gates immediately. The guards try to calm the crowd, but it’s no use. They’re met with a barrage of curses and accusations of delay, that they should’ve driven everyone away from the walls long ago.
Both sides are getting angrier. It’s a step away from a clash. You feel you could make a difference.

lines.textCh: 出手干预。
lines.textEn: Intervene.

lines.textCh:
你意识到不能就这样放任不管。还有谁能安抚人群，阐明是非对错？只有你，没有其他人了。也许，这才是你一直以来的真正使命。
你挤过人群。前方有一辆装满木箱的手推车，正好可以充当临时讲台。
lines.textEn:
You realize you can’t just let this slide. Who else will calm the crowd and explain what’s right? No one. Maybe this was your true mission all along.
You push through the crowd. Ahead, there’s a cart loaded with crates, perfect to use as a makeshift platform.

lines.textCh: ……但这个念头只持续了几秒钟。这既不是你的城市，他们之间的争论也不关你的事。这里没人欢迎你。再说，你得先把卷轴送达。只有教团的预言能够为城市带来救赎。你最后瞥了一眼怒不可遏的人群，然后远远地拐了个弯绕开他们。
lines.textEn: ...But that thought lasts only a few seconds. This isn’t your problem or your city. No one here welcomes you. Besides, you need to deliver the scroll first. That’s how you’ll be most useful to these people. You cast one last glance at the furious crowd and skirt around it in a wide arc.

lines.textCh: 是的，你必须爬上去。
lines.textEn: Yes, you need to climb up.

lines.textCh:
你决定留在原地对着这群惊恐又愤怒的人群演讲。
你开始说话，挥舞着手臂，但除了离你最近的几个人外，没人听见你的声音。有人朝你的脚边吐口水，另一个人推了你一把。你意识到，这样下去他们是不会听的。
lines.textEn:
You decide to stay put, level with the frightened, angry crowd.
You start speaking, waving your arms, but no one hears you except those closest by. Someone spits at your feet, another shoves you. You realize they won’t listen like this.

lines.textCh: 最好是爬高些。
lines.textEn: Best to climb higher after all.

lines.textCh:
你爬上了那辆手推车。脚下的木箱吱呀作响、摇摇晃晃，车主大喊着什么，试图把你拉下来。你用脚把他踹开，高举起双臂。
人们开始转头张望，纳闷到底是谁在发疯。有人发笑，但大多数人只是盯着看，等着看你会做什么。
lines.textEn:
You clamber onto the cart. The crates beneath you creak and wobble, and the cart’s owner yells something, trying to pull you down. You push him away with your foot and raise your arms.
People start turning to look, wondering who’s lost their mind. Some laugh, but most just stare, waiting to see what you’ll do next.

lines.textCh: 唤起他们的人性。
lines.textEn: Appeal to their human qualities.

lines.textCh:
— 我们都是人，感到恐惧是人之常情！— 你的声音起初柔和而谦逊，随着话语的推进却愈发坚定。— 但恐惧只会让我们裹足不前。战争正在这片土地上四处肆虐，你们真的要抛弃城外的那些难民吗？他们可是和你们一样活生生的人！
越来越多的面孔转向你。你看到了他们的情绪，他们的疑虑。深吸一口气，你继续说道：
— 待人如己所愿。你愿意被遗弃在城门外，饥肠辘辘、痛苦不堪、冻得发抖吗？！
人群中响起一阵低语。有人喊道这不关他们的事，但大多数人似乎都被你的话打动了。
lines.textEn:
— We’re all human, and it’s natural to feel fear! — Your voice, soft and unassuming at first, grows stronger with each word. — But fear only holds us back. War is spreading across these lands. Are you truly ready to abandon people just like you?
More and more faces turn toward you. You see their emotions, their doubts. Taking a deep breath, you continue:
— Treat others as you’d want to be treated. Would you want to be left outside the gates, hungry, miserable, and freezing?!
A murmur ripples through the crowd. Someone shouts that it’s not their problem, but most seem moved by your words.

lines.textCh:
— 你们确定把城门封死真的能救你们吗？如果这座城市能在艰难时刻庇护那些难民，他们将很乐意拿起武器，用生命捍卫这片土地！
你的声音越来越大。面对市民们的不公与短视，你感到义愤填膺。
— 如果把他们留在城外，他们不是死就是绝望地加入匪帮！
此刻，更多人将目光投向你。怀疑与不安在他们脸上闪过。有人窃窃私语，有人试图反驳，但他们的声音都被你那愤怒喷涌的炽烈激情所淹没。
— 如果这座城市想在 Karhu 与 Turva 的混乱中屹立不倒，就必须放他们进来！
lines.textEn:
— Are you sure closed gates will really save you? Out there are people ready to take up arms and defend the city that shelters them in these hard times!
Your voice grows louder. You feel righteous anger at their injustice and shortsightedness.
— If you leave them out there, they’ll either die or join bandits out of desperation!
More people look at you now. Doubt and uncertainty flicker across their faces. Some whisper to each other, others try to argue, but their voices drown in your fervent outrage.
— You must let them in if you want to stand strong against the chaos of Karhu and Turva!

lines.textCh:
你望着人群，人群也望着你。思绪在脑海中翻涌，却不知该如何开口。你觉得没人会听你说话，这真是个错误。
你笨拙地从推车上爬下来，人群很快便失去了兴趣。你为自己那愚蠢的冲动感到尴尬，却没有忘记自己的使命。
lines.textEn:
You look at the crowd. They look back at you. Your mind swirls with thoughts, but words fail you. You feel no one will listen. This was a mistake.
Awkwardly, you climb down from the cart, and the crowd quickly loses interest. You’re embarrassed by your foolish impulse but don’t forget your mission.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 你溜进广场后面的一个小巷，转头又是一道巷子，仿佛迷宫一般。你需要赶往领主的宫殿，但街道实在太过狭窄且错综复杂，不出所料，你迷了路。当地人怀疑地打量着你那身旅途劳顿的衣衫。你该去问问去宫殿的路吗？
lines.textEn: You slip into an alley behind the square, then another, and another. You need to reach the palace, but the streets are so narrow and tangled that you predictably get lost. Locals eye your travel-worn clothes with suspicion. Should you ask for directions to the palace?

lines.textCh: 没错，最好试试。
lines.textEn: Yes, best to try.

lines.textCh:
你意识到，在这种紧张的气氛下，没人会帮助你。说不定，他们还会把你引到一条黑暗的小巷里，把你上上下下洗劫一空。
你总会想办法走到宫殿门口的。
你继续前行，直到来到一个岔路口。右边是一段陡峭的上坡路，很可能通往更富庶的街区。而在左边，那些陈旧肮脏的鹅卵石路面逐渐被崭新的路面取代。 
你会选择哪条路？
lines.textEn:
You realize that with the tense mood in the air, no one will help you. If anything, they might lure you into a dark alley and rob you of your valuables.
Sooner or later, you’ll reach the palace.
You press forward until you come to a fork in the road. To the right, a steep climb begins, likely leading to a wealthier district. To the left, the old, grimy cobblestones give way to newer ones. 
Where will you go?

lines.textCh: 站在原地，不要自己乱跑。
lines.textEn: Stay put and don’t go anywhere.

lines.textCh: 你发觉自己完全迷路了。是时候停下来喘口气了，好好理清思绪，决定下一步该怎么做。或许，还是该向当地人求助为好？
lines.textEn: You realize you’re completely lost. It’s time to stop, catch your breath, and collect your thoughts to decide what to do next. Maybe you should ask the locals for help after all?

lines.textCh:
你停下脚步，环顾四周，寻找可能伸出援手的人。街道上的人比你预想的要少；大多数人都避开你的目光。
突然，一位带着两个小孩的妇女从拐角处走了出来。孩子们哭着紧紧抱住她，各自朝相反的方向扯着她的头发。她看起来非常沮丧，直到你走近才注意到你。
— 我们不需要施舍，— 她皱着眉头，警惕地打量着你。
lines.textEn:
You stop and look around for someone who might help. The street is less crowded than you expected; most people avoid meeting your gaze.
Suddenly, a woman with two young children emerges from around a corner. The kids cling to her, crying, each pulling her hair in opposite directions. She looks deeply unhappy and doesn’t notice you until you approach.
— We don’t need handouts, — she frowns, eyeing you warily.

lines.textCh: 没错，最好试试。
lines.textEn: Yes, best to try.

lines.textCh: 当然，就该向右走，有钱人喜欢住在高处。从富人区出发，应该很容易就能到达宫殿。你继续向前走。
lines.textEn: Of course, going right makes sense, rich folk tend to live higher up. From there, it should be easy to reach the palace. You head forward.

lines.textCh: 道路并不是随随便便铺出来的，这条崭新的石子路很可能通往富人区，从那儿肯定右路到宫殿。在这个念头的鼓舞下，你向左转去。
lines.textEn: Roads aren’t paved just anywhere, so the newer cobblestones likely lead to a wealthier district, and from there, you can surely reach the palace. Encouraged, you turn left.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
今天走了无数步路，你的双脚早已灼痛难耐。但你依然坚持前行：必须把消息送达领主那儿。
突然，你听见一阵骚动：急促的脚步声和盔甲的哐当声。你皱着眉头转过街角，差点与几名卫兵撞个满怀。
lines.textEn:
Your feet burn from the countless steps you’ve taken today, but you press on. You must deliver the message.
Suddenly, you hear a commotion: hurried footsteps and the clank of armor. Frowning, you turn a corner and nearly collide with several guards.

lines.textCh: 我只想问个路，女士。
lines.textEn: I just need directions, ma'am.

lines.textCh: — 哦，你不是本地人，— 那女人语气缓和了些。她的两个儿子顿时安静下来，一动不动地盯着你。这场景有些奇怪，甚至让人感到一丝不安。
lines.textEn: — Oh, you’re not from here, — the woman softens slightly. Her two boys fall silent, staring at you unblinkingly. It’s odd, even a bit unsettling.

lines.textCh: — 你肯定不是我们这的，一上来就这么粗鲁，— 女人皱起眉头，一脸不悦。她的两个儿子顿时安静下来，一动不动地盯着你。这场景很奇怪，甚至让人有点不安。
lines.textEn: — You’re clearly not from here, being so blunt right away, — the woman frowns, displeased. Her two boys fall silent, staring at you unblinkingly. It’s odd, even a bit unsettling.

lines.textCh: 无视孩子。
lines.textEn: Ignore the children.

lines.textCh: 无视孩子。
lines.textEn: Ignore the children.

lines.textCh:
那女人听到你的问题，不由得一惊，把孩子们搂得更紧了。
— 孩子不都这样，你干嘛多管闲事？— 她警惕地往后退了一步。— 所以，你要去哪儿？你这是打算问路？
你点点头，正要开口，孩子们却突然开口说话了。
lines.textEn:
The woman flinches at your question and pulls her children closer.
— Just normal kids, why are you prying? — She steps back, wary. — So, where are you headed? Need directions?
You nod and open your mouth to speak, but the children suddenly start talking.

lines.textCh:
— 那，你要去哪儿？— 女人把孩子们抱起来，抬头看着你，显然急着离开。
你正要开口说要去领主的宫殿，孩子们却突然开口说话了。
lines.textEn:
— So, where are you off to? — The woman hoists her kids up and looks at you, clearly eager to move on.
You open your mouth to say you’re headed to the palace, but the children suddenly start talking.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 你看着那位母亲走远。这又是什么？难道是某种警告？一阵寒意袭上心头，但你很快镇定下来。不过是诡计罢了，你没什么好怕的。你只需要抵达领主的宫殿就好，那些孩子虽然奇怪，但指的路方向没错。
lines.textEn: You watch her walk away. What was that? A warning? A chill runs through you, but you quickly pull yourself together. It’s all the work of some trickery. You have nothing to fear. You just need to reach the palace. Those strange children pointed you in the right direction.

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 我靠！
lines.textEn: Damn it!

lines.textCh: 就在卫兵们抓住你时，你感到肋骨被狠狠戳了一下，耳边传来一阵轻笑。其中一人似乎说道：“就是他。”你完全摸不着头脑。
lines.textEn: You feel a sharp jab in your ribs and a chuckle in your ear as the guards seize you. It seems one of them said “That’s him”. You’re utterly confused.

lines.textCh: 卫兵们迅速打量了你一眼，随即说道：“就是他”，便一把拽住了你的胳膊。你完全摸不着头脑。
lines.textEn: The guards quickly look you over and, with the words “That’s him”, grab you by the arms. You’re utterly confused.

lines.textCh: 卫兵们并没有理会你的话，他们迅速打量了你一眼，随即说道：“就是这家伙”，便一把拽住了你的胳膊。你完全摸不着头脑。
lines.textEn: The guards don’t react to your words. They quickly look you over and, with the words “That’s him”, grab you by the arms. You’re utterly confused.

lines.textCh: 抵抗。
lines.textEn: Resist.

lines.textCh: 抵抗。
lines.textEn: Resist.

lines.textCh: 抵抗。
lines.textEn: Resist.

lines.textCh:
不，这样可不行。你绝不能就这样完蛋。你猛地一挣，试图挣脱，但守卫们紧紧攥住你，掐得你胳膊生疼。
— 你要是再敢乱动，绝对会给自己招来更大的麻烦。我可不建议你这么做。
你最后一次试图挣脱手臂，但毫无用处。守卫们失去了耐心：他们粗暴地摇晃着你，把你拖向某个地方。你环顾四周，意识到逃跑是不可能的。至少不是现在。
lines.textEn:
No, this won’t do. You’re not going down like this. You jerk, trying to break free, but the guards hold you tightly, squeezing your arms until it hurts.
— Keep squirming, and you’ll have bigger problems. I wouldn’t recommend it.
You make one last attempt to wrench your arm free, but it’s no use. The guards’ patience runs out: they roughly shake you and drag you somewhere. You glance around, realizing escape isn’t an option. At least, not now.

lines.textCh: 你没有反抗，任由他们架住。反抗有什么用？那可是整整一队卫兵，几秒钟时间就能把你给按趴下。不如顺从他们，省的他们心生歹念，不管他们想从你身上得到什么。
lines.textEn: You go limp in their grasp, not resisting. What’s the point? It’s a whole squad of guards, they’d overpower you in seconds. This way, at least, you might get on their good side, whatever they want from you.

lines.textCh: 我做什么了？
lines.textEn: What did I do?

lines.textCh: — 闭嘴，别再扭来扭去了，不然我们把你的胳膊掰断。— 你右边的守卫翻了个白眼。当然，没人愿意回答你的问题。你该继续反抗吗？还是就此认输？
lines.textEn: — Shut up and stop squirming before we break your arms. — The guard on your right rolls his eyes. Of course, no one bothers answering your questions. Should you keep resisting? Or give in?

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
卫兵夹着你穿过狭窄的街道。你试图记住路线，但转了几次弯后，就已经搞不清方向了。刚才那个路口是右转……还是左转？
最终，你放弃了徒劳的努力。卫兵们一言不发，只是押解着你不停地向前走。
终于，你发现自己站在了宫殿门前。你猛地一停，随即肋骨处被人猛击了一下。
这就是你要去的地方！是巧合吗？还是卫兵们是在奉领主的命令行事？
lines.textEn:
They lead you through narrow streets. You try to memorize the path, but after a few turns, you’re already confused. Was the last one right... or left?
Eventually, you abandon the futile effort. The guards don’t speak, just keep marching you forward.
Finally, you find yourself in front of the palace. You freeze, earning a sharp jab in the ribs.
This is where you needed to go! Coincidence? Or were the guards acting on the ruler’s orders?

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh: 下一步
lines.textEn: Next

lines.textCh:
突然，有人抓住了你的胳膊。你猛地一缩，下意识地试图挣脱，但那人抓得很紧。你转过身，发现是个卫兵。
— 够了，你的蹩脚表演到此为止。滚下来，跟我们走。
lines.textEn:
Suddenly, someone grabs your elbow. You flinch, instinctively trying to twist free, but the grip is firm. You turn and see it’s a guard.
— That’s enough. Show’s over. Get down and come with us.

lines.textCh: 抵抗。
lines.textEn: Resist.

lines.textCh:
你奋力挣扎，仍试图挣脱卫兵的桎梏。

— 住手，否则我把你捅个透心凉！— 卫兵厉声喝道，猛地把你揪住一拽，随后把你拖倒在地。更多卫兵围了上来，抓着你的胳膊把你叉走。

广场上的人群看到你被带走，纷纷发出不满的低语。
lines.textEn:
You resist, still trying to shake off the guard’s grip.
