lines.textEn: Seen Partisan on your way here? Alright, sit down.

lines.textCh: 随时来坐坐，孩子。
lines.textEn: Drop by anytime, kid.

lines.textCh: 需要装备？让我看看。
lines.textEn: Need to gear up? Let's see.

lines.textCh: 路上怎么样？坐下，我来听你说。
lines.textEn: How was the trip? Sit down, I’ll listen.

lines.textCh: 我给你留了几样东西，来看看吧。
lines.textEn: I saved a few things for you, take a look.

lines.textCh: 狩猎顺利。
lines.textEn: Good hunting.

lines.textCh: 这些试炼，不只是为了技术。 压力之下，每个人都会露出真面目。强者更强，弱者崩溃。 要清理这座满是劫掠者的城市，我需要可靠的战士。
lines.textEn: These trials, they aren’t just for skill. Under pressure, everyone shows who they are. The strong get stronger, the weak break. To clear the city of pillagers, I need reliable fighters.

lines.textCh: 现在一切都很安静。趁还有时间最好先休息一下。
lines.textEn: All quiet for now. Rest up while you can.

lines.textCh: 坐下吧，我们聊聊。
lines.textEn: Take a seat, let’s chat.

lines.textCh: 坐下吧，我们聊聊。
lines.textEn: Take a seat, let’s chat.

lines.textCh: 是什么风把你给吹来了？坐下，说说吧。
lines.textEn: What brings you here? Take a seat, let’s chat.

lines.textCh: 准备打猎？我能帮你挑。
lines.textEn: Getting ready for a hunt? I can help with that.

lines.textCh: 再见。
lines.textEn: See you.

lines.textCh: 想帮帮这座城市？这是个高尚的目标。
lines.textEn: Want to help the city? That’s a noble cause.

lines.textCh: Voevoda 在我们一起狩猎时教过我这些。 现在很清楚了，Voevoda——他的队员都叫他 Batya，把他当成自己的父亲一样。他的小队只为真相而战，而软弱者早就投靠那些逐利的帮派去了。 试炼会揭示每个人的本性，也会告诉你谁值得信任。
lines.textEn: Voevoda taught me this when we hunted together. Now it’s clear – Batya and his guys fought for truth alone, and weaklings went to gangs chasing profit. The trials show everyone’s place, and who you can trust.

lines.textCh: 你以前只是个普通的林务员，对吧？可现在你给的训练甚至按塔科夫的标准都算残酷的。为什么？你到底在为什么做准备？
lines.textEn: You used to be a simple forester, right? But now you give trials that seem brutal even by Tarkov standards. Why? What are you preparing for?

lines.textCh: 来，坐这儿，茶刚煮好。
lines.textEn: Come here, the tea’s just boiled.

lines.textCh: 保重。
lines.textEn: Take care.

lines.textCh: 是的，我这有几把不错的霰弹枪。
lines.textEn: Yeah, I’ve got a couple of solid shotguns.

lines.textCh: 想做好事？我这有几把好猎枪。
lines.textEn: Looking to do some good? I’ve got a couple of leads.

lines.textCh: 你读过书，对吧？ 那你就该明白，恶棍永远比强者多。 所以像你这样的战士很重要。你们每一个都必须硬得足以在任何情况下压倒敌人。 这样我们才能把罪恶的腐朽从这座城市里剔除干净。
lines.textEn: You’ve read books, right? Then you must know that there are always more scoundrels than strong-willed. That’s why every fighter like you counts. Each of you must be hardened to overcome enemies in any situation. That’s how we’ll clean the city of rot.

lines.textCh: 最好别让我生气。活儿做完再来见我。
lines.textEn: Better not make me angry. Come back when the job’s finished.

lines.textCh: 为什么来来回回？先把任务做完，我们再一起喝茶。
lines.textEn: Why go back and forth then? Finish the task first, then we’ll drink tea.

lines.textCh: 不行。把活儿做完，再回来。
lines.textEn: That won’t do. Finish the work, then come back.

lines.textCh: 有东西要卖吗？
lines.textEn: Have anything for sale?

lines.textCh: 想买点东西？当然可以。
lines.textEn: Looking to buy something? Sure thing.

lines.textCh: 只有你心中的信念能让你立于不败之地。 当然，并不是所有人都能通过我的测试。 但我也不是对所有人都照单全收的。唯有双手稳如磐石、头脑清明如水的战士才能应对这样的污泥。
lines.textEn: What will keep you from failing is your character. Sure, not everyone passes my tests. But I don’t need everyone. Only warriors with a steady hand and clear mind can handle this filth.

lines.textCh: 想清理塔科夫的罪恶腐朽吗？你来对地方了。
lines.textEn: Want to clean out Tarkov’s rot? You came to the right place.

lines.textCh: 没做完就不该来。但你既然来了，说你需要什么。
lines.textEn: Shouldn’t have come before finishing. But since you’re here, tell me what you need.

lines.textCh: 快点。没做完别回来。
lines.textEn: Hurry. Don’t come back until it’s done.

lines.textCh: 没什么好说的。你最好赶紧去干。
lines.textEn: Nothing more to say, then. You better get to it.

lines.textCh: 敢违背交易？那我们没什么可谈的了。
lines.textEn: Disrespecting the deal? We have nothing to talk about then.

lines.textCh: 有什么活儿给我吗？
lines.textEn: Got any work for me?

lines.textCh: 塔科夫需要救赎。掠夺的、抢劫的太多了，这城市都看不出来原本的样子了。 你不会真以为我们在人数上占优势吧？ 像你这样的士兵，一个要打十个。 所以我对你要求更多，你的试炼也更艰难。
lines.textEn: Tarkov needs saving. Too many looters and pillagers, the city’s unrecognizable. You don’t think we’re in the majority, do you? For every soldier like you, there’s a dozen bandits. That’s why I demand more from you, and the trials for you are tougher.

lines.textCh: 塔科夫需要像你这样的人。让我看一下记录。
lines.textEn: Tarkov needs people like you. Let me glance at my notebook.

lines.textCh: 事情不是这么做的。你可以提要求，但工作还是得先完成。
lines.textEn: Not how things are done. Ask what you want, but do the job after.

lines.textCh: 你大老远赶来就为了说这个？快回去干活。
lines.textEn: And you came all this way just to say that? Go do it.

lines.textCh: 那你来干什么？任务很重要，别再拖了。
lines.textEn: Why are you here then? The task is important, don’t delay further.

lines.textCh: 要是我知道会这样，我就派别人了。更可靠的人。
lines.textEn: If only I knew, I’d send some other fighter. Someone reliable.

lines.textCh: 我就是为了这个来的。
lines.textEn: Here just about this.

lines.textCh: 我就是为了这个来的。
lines.textEn: Here just about this.

lines.textCh: 我还在做你的活儿。但我这次来，是为了别的事。
lines.textEn: Still working on your job. I'm here about another thing.

lines.textCh: 让我到后面看看，给我一分钟
lines.textEn: Let me look in the back, give me a minute.

lines.textCh: 你以为这些所谓的“文明”改变了世界？其实没有。 只有最顶尖的掠食者才能在弱肉强食的规则下存活。这就是我要教给你的东西。 那些连我的试炼都撑不过的家伙只会变成猎物。
lines.textEn: You think all this “civilization” changed the world, but it hasn’t. Only the predator that stays ahead survives. That’s what I’m teaching. Those who can’t handle my trials? They become prey.

lines.textCh: 有了你帮忙应该会方便很多。
lines.textEn: Maybe your help will come in handy for something.

lines.textCh: 我记得你那项任务，但我还没做完。等我搞定了我会回来。
lines.textEn: I remember about your task, but I haven’t finished it yet. I’ll come back after it’s done.

lines.textCh: 可惜。不过既然你都来了，那说吧。
lines.textEn: Shame. But since you’re already here, go ahead.

lines.textCh: 这么重要的事就不该托付给你的。打起精神来！
lines.textEn: Shouldn’t have trusted you with something this important. Pull yourself together!

lines.textCh: 我还在处理。
lines.textEn: I’m still working on it.

lines.textCh: 你要让我们等多久？事情很简单，去把活儿做完。
lines.textEn: How long are you going to keep us waiting? The deal was simple, go finish the job.

lines.textCh: 那你什么时候有时间？你觉得那些钥匙是白给的吗？
lines.textEn: When will you have time then? You think we gave you the keys for free?

lines.textCh: 我还在做你交代的事，但还没完成。我现在得走了。
lines.textEn: I'm still working on your mission, but I'm not done yet. I better go now.

lines.textCh: 我得走了。
lines.textEn: I’ve got to go.

lines.textCh: 好，我得检查一下库存，给我一分钟。
lines.textEn: Well, I’ll need to check the stash.

lines.textCh: 在野外很简单：别溜号，不然你自己就会变成猎物。 我们的城市也是一样。谁不明白这个道理——塔科夫就会直接吞了他。 很多人说我的试炼太严苛，甚至毫无意义。但塔科夫不会理会他们的抱怨，迟早会把他们生吞活剥。这些懒惰的人消失在塔科夫无非是时间问题。
lines.textEn: Out in the wild, it’s simple: don’t relax, or you’ll end up prey. Our city’s become the same. Anyone who doesn’t get that – Tarkov takes them. Many said my trials are too harsh, pointless even. Tarkov swallowed them anyway. Some sooner, some later.

lines.textCh: 现在事情很多。让我翻翻我的笔记。
lines.textEn: Plenty of work right now. Let me check my notes.

lines.textCh: 我还没做完。我是来问你点事。
lines.textEn: Haven’t finished it yet. I came to ask you something.

lines.textCh: 你应该专心干活。现在问你要问的，但之后赶紧去做。
lines.textEn: You should focus on the job. Ask what you need now, but get to work after.

lines.textCh: 那你为什么要穿过整片森林就为了说这个？现在的年轻人啊……
lines.textEn: So why did you trek all this way through the forest just for this? The youth these days…

lines.textCh: 现在没时间。我之后再做。
lines.textEn: No time for it now. I’ll do it later.

lines.textCh: 哼！我们说好了的，那些钥匙可不是白给你的。
lines.textEn: Huh! We made a deal, those keys weren’t given to you for free.

lines.textCh: 你不会想无视我们的约定吧？这事不能拖，你明白吗？
lines.textEn: Didn’t think you’d ignore our deal like that. You can’t drag this out, you understand?

lines.textCh: 这事我帮不了你。但你去问别人时，最好也提高警惕。 有一次这样的“调查”引发了实验室病毒泄漏，差点把附近的人全杀光。
lines.textEn: I cannot help you with this. And if you come ask someone else, be on your guard. One time these “investigations” led to a lab virus outbreak that nearly killed everyone around.

lines.textCh: 你为什么觉得我会知道？去问那些跟这些秘密有关系的人。
lines.textEn: Why do you think I’d know anything about this? Ask someone who’s connected to all these secrets.

lines.textCh: 也许你做的事是好事，但它依然危险。 小心点。 我回答不了你的问题，去问别人吧。
lines.textEn: Maybe it’s a good cause you’re doing, but it’s still dangerous. And be careful. I can’t answer your question, check with others.

lines.textCh: 我对此一无所知，也不想知道。 去问别人。
lines.textEn: I don’t know anything about this, and I don’t want to. Ask someone else.

lines.textCh: 我从不踏足那片泥潭。那里从来没有好事，唯有死亡。
lines.textEn: I don’t go into that muck. Nothing good there, only death.

lines.textCh: 别问我。 我的职责是保护自然保护区，不是去挖那些肮脏的秘密。
lines.textEn: Don’t ask me. My job is to protect the nature reserve, not dig through some filthy secrets.

lines.textCh: 这事我帮不上忙。去问别的商人吧。
lines.textEn: I won’t be of any use with this one. Try the other traders.

lines.textCh: 不在我的范围内。我帮不上忙。
lines.textEn: Out of my scope. Can’t help you there.

lines.textCh: 我从没对那方面感兴趣。去找更懂的人。
lines.textEn: Never had any interest in that subject. Look for someone more knowledgeable.

lines.textCh: 我不觉得我现在能帮上你。
lines.textEn: Don’t think I’m the one you need right now.

lines.textCh: 我第一次听说这事。
lines.textEn: First time I’ve heard of it.

lines.textCh: 去问别人更好。
lines.textEn: Better ask someone else.

lines.textCh: 我对那件事一无所知，佣兵。
lines.textEn: I don’t know anything about that, mercenary.

lines.textCh: 我完全不知道你在说什么，小伙子。去问别的商人吧。
lines.textEn: I do not have the slightest idea what you are referring to, young man. Ask the other traders.

lines.textCh: 我和这事没任何关系。
lines.textEn: I have no involvement in this matter.

lines.textCh: 我必须承认，我不知道。请去问别人。
lines.textEn: I must admit, I do not know. Please inquire with someone else.

lines.textCh: 你问的问题很对，但问的人不对。我不知道那里发生了什么。
lines.textEn: You are asking very appropriate questions, but not of the right person. I am not aware of what is occurring.

lines.textCh: 这事和我无关。我什么都不知道。
lines.textEn: This matter does not concern me. I know nothing about it.

lines.textCh: 很遗憾，我没有这类信息。
lines.textEn: Unfortunately, I do not possess such information.

lines.textCh: 抱歉，小伙子，这超出了我的能力范围。
lines.textEn: I am sorry, young man, this is beyond my competence.

lines.textCh: 这事我帮不了你，勇士。去找别人，也许有人知道。
lines.textEn: Can’t help you with this, warrior. Try someone else, maybe they know something.

lines.textCh: 你干嘛觉得我会知道这些东西？
lines.textEn: Why would you think I’d know about any of this?

lines.textCh: 我不掺和这种事。去问别人。
lines.textEn: I don’t get involved in stuff like this. Ask someone else.

lines.textCh: 你到底在说什么？我一句都听不懂。
lines.textEn: What are you even talking about? Don’t understand a thing.

lines.textCh: 没头绪。问别人吧。
lines.textEn: No clue. Ask someone else.

lines.textCh: 不，战士，这事我一点都不知道。
lines.textEn: Nah, warrior, I don’t know anything about this.

lines.textCh: 什么？我感觉你在跟我乱扯。我根本不知道。
lines.textEn: What? I feel like you’re bullshitting me. I’ve got no clue.

lines.textCh: 你居然以为我会知道这种事，真是搞笑。
lines.textEn: Funny you thought I’d be in the loop on that.

lines.textCh: 那不归我管。去问别人吧。
lines.textEn: That’s not my thing. Ask someone else.

lines.textCh: 听起来挺有意思，但我完全不知道。
lines.textEn: Sounds very interesting, but I’ve got no idea.

lines.textCh: 不啊，兄弟，我对那事完全不了解。
lines.textEn: Nah, brother, I don’t know anything about that.

lines.textCh: 我第一次听说这事。
lines.textEn: First time hearing about this.

lines.textCh: 那件事完全与我无关，谢天谢地。
lines.textEn: That one totally passed me by. Thankfully.

lines.textCh: 不是我的领域，抱歉。你去问别人吧。
lines.textEn: Not my area, sorry. You better ask someone else.

lines.textCh: 你在说啥呢，兄弟？我一点头绪都没有。
lines.textEn: What are you on about, brother? I know nothing.

lines.textCh: 听过一点，但不能说。
lines.textEn: Heard bits, but can’t talk about it.

lines.textCh: 抱歉，伙计，我可不想掺和那种烂事。
lines.textEn: Apologies mate, I’m not getting into that mess.

lines.textCh: 说实话，我对这事一无所知。
lines.textEn: I’ll be honest, I don’t know shit about this.

lines.textCh: 不不不，别把我扯进去，我还想活久一点呢。去问别人吧。
lines.textEn: No-no-no, don’t involve me in this, I still wanna live. Ask someone else.

lines.textCh: 什么？你为什么觉得我有参与那事？
lines.textEn: What? Why’d you think I’m involved in that?

lines.textCh: 我不知道这事。你得去找别人问。
lines.textEn: Don’t know about that. You’ll have to talk to someone else.

lines.textCh: 瞧你这样子……门是打开了吧？
lines.textEn: Look at you. So you got the door open, yea?

lines.textCh: 你既然来了，那门肯定是开了，对吧？
lines.textEn: If you’re here, you’ve opened that door, yeah?

lines.textCh: 这么快就回来了啊。门开了没？
lines.textEn: You’re back quick, eh. Is the door open?

lines.textCh: 活儿怎么样？门搞定了没有？
lines.textEn: How’s the job, door sorted or what?

lines.textCh: 那门呢？已经打开了吗？
lines.textEn: How’s that door? You open it already?

lines.textCh: 怎么样？那扇门开了吗？
lines.textEn: So, what’s the word? You get that door open yet?

lines.textCh: 我希望活儿已经干完了，过来。
lines.textEn: Hope you’re done with the job, coming here.

lines.textCh: 我正要叫你呢。活儿做完了吗？
lines.textEn: Was just about to call you. Job done?

lines.textCh: 终于！按我说的方式都做了，对吧？
lines.textEn: Finally! You did it all like I told you, yeah?

lines.textCh: 喂！这么快就弄完了？
lines.textEn: Opa! You done already?

lines.textCh: 好！活儿干完了吧？
lines.textEn: Alright! Job’s done, yeah?

lines.textCh: 喂！过来这边。
lines.textEn: Opa! Come here.

lines.textCh: 喂！过来这边。
lines.textEn: Opa! Come here.

lines.textCh: 喂你！杵那儿干嘛？好啦别紧张，我听说过你！你要去港口，对吧？你耍的那点把戏根本算不上计划，不过随你好了。
lines.textEn: Hey you! What’re you standing there for? Alright, don’t stress, I’ve been told about you! Headed to the port, yeah? Plan’s bollocks, but you do you.

lines.textCh: 别站那儿发呆，过来。
lines.textEn: Don’t just stand there. C’mere.

lines.textCh: 快进来！最近怎么样，伙计？
lines.textEn: Come in! How’s life, mate?

lines.textCh: 你想干嘛？
lines.textEn: What'cha want?

lines.textCh: 呦看看谁来了。
lines.textEn: Look who’s here.

lines.textCh: 好吧，那你保重。
lines.textEn: Alright, then. Take care.

lines.textCh: 嘿老兄！最近咋样？
lines.textEn: Hello mate! How’s it going?

lines.textCh: 等等再来吧？到时候我们再聊。
lines.textEn: Drop by later, yeah? Maybe we can talk then.

lines.textCh: 嘿！
lines.textEn: Hey!

lines.textCh: 谢谢，伙计。保重。
lines.textEn: Cheers, mate. Take care.

lines.textCh: 哟——哟，踹门的来了！
lines.textEn: Hello-hello, bandit!

lines.textCh: 不，现在挺清静的。
lines.textEn: Nah, all quiet right now.

lines.textCh: 存了点钱对吧？放轻松，我就是问问。你知道去哪儿找东西。
lines.textEn: Saved up some coin, yeah? Relax, just asking. You know where to look.

lines.textCh: 回头见。
lines.textEn: Catch you later.

lines.textCh: 要挣钱？好，我看看能把你安排到哪儿。
lines.textEn: Need coin? Alright, let’s see where I can slot you in.

lines.textCh: 做生意永远来得及。
lines.textEn: There’s always time for business.

lines.textCh: 回见！
lines.textEn: See you!

lines.textCh: 啊，有想法！你能赚点钱，我也能看得起你。
lines.textEn: Ah, good thinking! You’ll earn some coin, and my respect.

lines.textCh: 听说你现在搞各种灰色生意？那你一开始是干什么的？
lines.textEn: Heard you’re into different crime schemes. What did you start with?

lines.textCh: 放轻松点，流浪者。
lines.textEn: Take it easy, wanderer.

lines.textCh: 我这儿总有点东西。你带钱了吗？
lines.textEn: I always got something. You got cash on you?

lines.textCh: 你不记笔记的吗？要是把任务搞砸了，就别想拿报酬。
lines.textEn: You don’t keep notes? If you mess up any orders, don’t expect a reward.

lines.textCh: 你来这儿干嘛？先把活儿做完再聊。
lines.textEn: What are you doing here? Finish the job, then we chat.

lines.textCh: 你脑子坏了？规矩写得清清楚楚的。那你来这儿干嘛？
lines.textEn: You thick or what? The deal was clear as day. Why are you here then?

lines.textCh: 想半路改规矩？你现在闭嘴把事做好还来得及，但这是最后一次——再来这一套我可不惯着。
lines.textEn: Trying to change the deal mid-way? You still have time to shut up and do it proper, but that’s the last warning — no more of this crap after.

lines.textCh: 让我看看你在卖什么。
lines.textEn: Wanna see what you’re selling.

lines.textCh: 也许能找点活儿给你。
lines.textEn: Might find something for you.

lines.textCh: 那可是好时候啊，真跟你说。货一堆，傻子更多，抢着买……每个人都以为自己要发大财了。可光靠那些玩意儿哪能建起商业帝国呢。我早就知道，真正的生意是在港口。对，就是那儿，真家伙们交易的地方。 所有人都以为自己要发大财。 可光靠那些玩意儿哪能建起商业帝国呢。我早就知道真正的玩法是在港口。 对……真正的现金都流向了那儿。
lines.textEn: Good times, let me tell you that. Loads of goods, loads of idiots buying ‘em… Everyone thought they’d hit it big. But you don’t build an empire like that. I knew the real game was at the Port. Yeah… That’s where the proper money flowed.

lines.textCh: 现在一堆活儿。看看记录里写了啥。
lines.textEn: Loads of work now. Let’s check the notes and see what’s up.

lines.textCh: 不太合规矩。但如果能快点问完的话，就开口吧。但别拖我给你安排的活儿——否则你会后悔。
lines.textEn: Not very proper. But if it’s a quick question, go on. Don’t ignore my order though — you’ll regret it.

lines.textCh: 那你杵这儿干嘛？活儿做完了再说。
lines.textEn: What are you standing here for, then? Finish the gig, then we’ll talk.

lines.textCh: 那你找我干嘛？先把门打开，再给消息——咱俩就是这么约的。
lines.textEn: Then what do you want from me? Door first, info second — that was the deal.

lines.textCh: 你是不是搞糊涂了？我需要你把那扇门打开，你要消息。交易就是交易，毁约的是些该死的老鼠。你不是老鼠，对吧
lines.textEn: You’ve lost the plot, haven’t you? I need that door opened, you want info. Deal’s a deal, and breaking deals is for bloody rats. You’re not a rat, right?

lines.textCh: 有活儿给我吗？
lines.textEn: Got any jobs for me?

lines.textCh: 那时候大家都在外面摆摊……在街市卖破烂，冻得屁股都麻了，手里抱着瓶伏特加看着自己那点破货。 那他们现在在哪儿呢？ 以为卖几袋进口货就算大人物了？ 想都别想，得有脑子、有胆子、还得够硬气才行。
lines.textEn: Everyone was out there back then… Flogging junk in street markets, freezing their arses off, guarding their stock with a bottle of vodka in hand. And where are they now, eh? Thought shifting a bag of imports made you a big shot? Nah, you need brains, guts, and the stones to back it all up.

lines.textCh: 活儿永远干不完，问题是谁来接。
lines.textEn: Always work to be done, question is who to give it to.

lines.textCh: 你动作挺慢的啊？行吧，我心情好，快问。
lines.textEn: Bit slow, aren’t ya? Fine, ask quick while I’m in a good mood.

lines.textCh: 那你他妈来干嘛？蠢货！快点把活儿干完！
lines.textEn: Then why the fuck are you here, you muppet? Get the job over with!

lines.textCh: 别浪费我时间。先干活，再聊天！
lines.textEn: Stop wasting my time. Job comes first, chat after!

lines.textCh: 你这小子脸皮挺厚啊。这次我就算了——但现在闭嘴干活。交易就是交易。
lines.textEn: You’re a cheeky bastard. I’ll let it slide this once — now quit talking and do the job. Deal's a deal.

lines.textCh: 我就是为这事来的。
lines.textEn: Here exactly about this.

lines.textCh: 我就是为这事来的。
lines.textEn: Here exactly about this.

lines.textCh: 活儿我还在做，我来问你点事。
lines.textEn: Still working on it. I came to ask you something.

lines.textCh: 带钱了吗？好，那看吧。
lines.textEn: Got coin? Alright, take a look then.

lines.textCh: 好奇心会害死你的，伙计！是啊，我干过这些，那又怎样？ 想从泥坑爬出来，你就得先踩点脏水。 走私装备、违禁品、音响这些破玩意儿，统统都有。 这行里你不抢机会，别人就会抢——最后你既没钱，也没人脉。
lines.textEn: Curiosity’ll get you clipped, mate! Yeah, it happened, so what? You wanna climb outta the gutter, you’ve gotta wade through some filth. Smuggled gear, banned goods, stereos, all that crap. In this business, if you don’t grab the chance, someone else will — and you’ll be left with no coin or connections.

lines.textCh: 也许有活儿，让我看看。
lines.textEn: Might be something, let me check.

lines.textCh: 活儿我还在做，来问点事。
lines.textEn: Still working on your job. Here to clarify something.

lines.textCh: 到底啥问题？想问啥赶紧问，问完去干活。
lines.textEn: What’s the fucking problem? Ask whatever the hell you want and get on with the job.

lines.textCh: 那你来干嘛？走走走！
lines.textEn: Why even come then? Beat it!

lines.textCh: 你在这儿晃悠啥？想耍我是吧？
lines.textEn: What’re you loitering for? Trying to mug me off or what?

lines.textCh: 我找不到你那破钥匙了。能不能不靠它解决？
lines.textEn: I can’t find your damn key. Can we somehow manage without it?

lines.textCh: 别给我掺和乱七八糟的。活儿是你接的，就给我做完。要不就滚，之后别来哭着找活干。
lines.textEn: Don’t start mixing things up. You took the job, now finish it. Or jog on, but don’t come crying for business after.

lines.textCh: 我才发现还没做完。再给我点时间。
lines.textEn: Just realized I haven't finished it. I need a bit more time.

lines.textCh: 我得走了。
lines.textEn: I’ve got to go.

lines.textCh: 早说嘛！兄弟们会带你看一遍的
lines.textEn: Should’ve said so! The lads will show you everything.

lines.textCh: 哈，美好的回忆啊！ 那时候我还是个小喽啰，但也在搞点小动作。口香糖啊、衣服啊，那都是小打小闹。 真正的大钱，是我在港口认识一个哥们之后才开始滚进来的。那才叫有意思。
lines.textEn: Ha, what a thing to remember! I was still a nobody back then, but running a few schemes already. Gum and clothes, that’s all small-time piss. The coin money started rolling when I got a mate at the port.

lines.textCh: 我脑子装不下所有活儿。来，看看记录。
lines.textEn: Can’t keep all the jobs in my head. Let’s take a look at the notes.

lines.textCh: 还没做完。我晚点再来。
lines.textEn: Not done yet. I’ll come back later.

lines.textCh: 行，快问完赶紧滚！命令可不等人。
lines.textEn: Alright, ask quickly and get lost! The order won’t wait.

lines.textCh: 靠！那你赶紧滚去干活！
lines.textEn: Fuck’s sake! Off you go then!

lines.textCh: 还没做，我在忙别的。
lines.textEn: Not yet. I’m busy with something else

lines.textCh: 那你回来干嘛？想要消息？先把那破活儿做完！
lines.textEn: Then what’re you back here for, eh? You want the info — finish the bloody job first!

lines.textCh: 你搞反了，伙计。我说了，开开之后才有消息，就这么简单。
lines.textEn: You’ve got it twisted, mate. I said you get the info after the door’s open, simple as that.

lines.textCh: 你不会碰巧知道戴这种臂章的 BEAR 吧？看着像是特种部队的。
lines.textEn: You wouldn’t happen to know anything about BEAR operatives who wore patches like this, would you? Looks like it’s from a special unit.

lines.textCh: 你听说过 BEAR 的特殊部队吗？我想知道这个臂章属于谁。
lines.textEn: Have you heard anything about a special BEAR unit? I’m trying to find who this patch belonged to.

lines.textCh: 我看到一个奇怪的 BEAR 臂章。你知道 BEAR 里的那些特殊单位吗？这东西可能是谁的？
lines.textEn: I came across an unusual BEAR patch. Do you know anything about BEAR’s special divisions? Who might’ve worn something like this?

lines.textCh: 我找了到一个 BEAR 臂章，看着像是特种部队的。你听过吗？
lines.textEn: I found a BEAR patch, looks like it’s from some kind of special unit. Ever heard of them?

lines.textCh: 明白了，谢谢！
lines.textEn: Got it. Thank you!

lines.textCh: 你的人有没有遇到过戴这种臂章的 BEAR？我想多了解一下他们的部队。
lines.textEn: Have your people ever crossed paths with BEAR guys wearing patches like this? I’m trying to learn more about that unit.

lines.textCh: 说说“花楸树”营地的情况。
lines.textEn: Tell me about Ryabina.

lines.textCh: 我找到一块奇怪的 BEAR 臂章，在这附近有没有见过这支小队的伤员？
lines.textEn: I found an unusual BEAR patch. Did anyone from that unit ever show up wounded around here?

lines.textCh: 我找到了一块奇怪的 BEAR 臂章，你听说过谁会戴这个吗？
lines.textEn: I found this unusual BEAR patch. Perhaps you’ve heard about anyone wearing this?

lines.textCh: 让我看看……我认识他们，没错。是真正的战士，不像现在这些人。
lines.textEn: Let me see… I know them, yes. True warriors, nothing like today’s lot.

lines.textCh: 我没听过他们。能告诉我点吗？
lines.textEn: I’ve never heard of them. Can you tell me about them?

lines.textCh: 他们叫 Bogatyrs，是一支特种小队，人手由 Voevoda 亲自挑选……但他们已经失踪一段时间了。Batya 也很久没联系我了。
lines.textEn: They were called the Bogatyrs. A special squad, hand-picked by Voevoda… But they disappeared some time ago. Batya hasn’t contacted me in a long while.

lines.textCh: 你知道我能在哪找到他们吗？
lines.textEn: Perhaps you know where I can find them?

lines.textCh: 我听说过他们的几个前哨基地，叫“花楸树”，还有一个叫“鸟巢”。
lines.textEn: I’ve heard about a couple of their outposts, Ryabina and Gnezdo.

lines.textCh: 跟我说说“鸟巢”的情况吧。
lines.textEn: Tell me about Gnezdo.

lines.textCh: 那是个 BEAR 前哨，Bogatyrs 偶尔会在那里补给、向指挥部传情报。但那不是他们的永久基地，我不知道主基地在哪。
lines.textEn: A BEAR outpost, the Bogatyrs used to stay there from time to time, stocking up on supplies and passing intel to command. But that wasn’t their permanent base, I’ve got no clue where their main base might be.

lines.textCh: 我要去哪找这个前哨？
lines.textEn: Where do I find that outpost?

lines.textCh: 在 Ultra 商场后面有个森林营地，他们伪装得很好。从 Ultra 的背面看去靠仓库那一侧。
lines.textEn: Behind the Ultra mall there is a forest camp, they’ve camouflaged it well. Look from the back side of Ultra, from the warehouse side.

lines.textCh: 那是 Bogatyr 建立的一个小型观察哨。我想他们以前在那里监视 USEC 营地。从 USEC 营地对面的岩石地带找那个营地。
lines.textEn: It’s a small Bogatyr observation post. I reckon they used to watch over the USEC camp from there. Look for the camp in the rocks across the road from the USEC camp.
(Enter frequency 35.70)

lines.textCh: （信号断了几秒，随后断断续续地回来了）
lines.textEn: (The signal cuts out completely for a few seconds, then returns with interruptions)

lines.textCh: （在杂音中，你只能听到 “-dio…mitage” 这样的残片）
lines.textEn: (All you can hear through the static is “-dio…mitage”)

lines.textCh: （通话继续了下去，似乎并未被察觉。）
lines.textEn: (The conversation continues. Looks like it went unnoticed)

lines.textCh: （杂音似乎拼成了类似摩斯密码的节奏……也可能只是你的错觉。）
lines.textEn: (The static seems to spell something like Morse code… or maybe it’s just your imagination)

lines.textCh: （输入频率 90.1）
lines.textEn: (Enter frequency 90.1)

lines.textCh: （等一会。）
lines.textEn: (Wait a bit)
(Enter code 27.893.2000)
(Enter frequency 102.48)

lines.textCh: 我是 Bogatyr 小队的指挥官。如果你想帮助我们完成正义之举，就去找 Lightkeeper，把我们的识别符号交给他。但如果你是我们的敌人——我们会主动上门来追杀你的，不死不休。
lines.textEn: I am the commander of the Bogatyr squad. If you want to help us do something right, find Lightkeeper. Give him our identification signs. But if you are our enemy, we will come for you.

lines.textCh: （你只能隐约听到一段旋律……也可能只是幻觉）
lines.textEn: (You can barely make out a faint melody. Or maybe you imagined it)

lines.textCh: （信号很强，肯定来自塔科夫。但杂音把所有内容都淹没了）
lines.textEn: (The signal is strong, definitely coming from Tarkov. But the static drowns everything out)

lines.textCh: 喂？有人能听到吗？完毕。
lines.textEn: Hello? Can anyone hear me? Over.

lines.textCh: （音乐渐渐消失，被不断增强的杂音吞没）
lines.textEn: (The music fades, swallowed by growing static)

lines.textCh: 如果有人能听到，请回应！我再说一次：请确认收到！
lines.textEn: If anyone can hear me, please confirm! I repeat: confirm receipt!

lines.textCh: （尝试增强信号）
lines.textEn: (Try to boost the signal)

lines.textCh: 我被困在塔科夫！我需要帮助！
lines.textEn: I'm stranded in Tarkov. I need help!

lines.textCh: （干扰达到峰值，扬声器被噪音淹没）
lines.textEn: (The interference peaks, overloading the speaker with noise)

lines.textCh: 回答！有人吗？
lines.textEn: Come in! Is anyone there?

lines.textCh: 请求撤离！确认收到啊，该死的！
lines.textEn: Requesting evacuation! Confirm receipt, damn you!

lines.textCh: 回应！有人能听到我吗？
lines.textEn: Come in! Does anyone hear me?

lines.textCh: 我被困在塔科夫！我需要帮助！
lines.textEn: I'm stranded in Tarkov! I need help!

lines.textCh: （听起来像是有人在回应，但干扰让人完全听不清。）
lines.textEn: (It sounds like someone is trying to reply, but the interference makes it impossible to make out)

lines.textCh: （干扰中传来一声闷响，然后归于寂静。）
lines.textEn: (Amid the interference, a thud rings out, then silence)

lines.textCh: 你现在在哪儿？
lines.textEn: Where are you now?

lines.textCh: 好，好！彼此彼此……
lines.textEn: Okay, okay! Same to you…

lines.textCh: 回应！回应！有人在吗？
lines.textEn: Come in! Come in! Is anyone there?

lines.textCh: （扫描附近频率。）
lines.textEn: (Scan nearby frequencies)

lines.textCh: （等一会。）
lines.textEn: (Wait a bit)

lines.textCh: （离开无线电）
lines.textEn: (Leave the radio)

lines.textCh: （稍等片刻）
lines.textEn: (Wait a bit)

lines.textCh: （离开无线电）
lines.textEn: (Leave the radio)

lines.textCh: 我是 Bogatyr 小队的指挥官。如果你想帮助我们完成正义之举，就去找 Lightkeeper，把我们的识别符号交给他。但如果你是我们的敌人——我们会主动上门来追杀你的，不死不休。
lines.textEn: I am the commander of the Bogatyr squad. If you want to help us do something right, find Lightkeeper. Give him our identification signs. But if you are our enemy, we will come for you.

lines.textCh: 我是 Bogatyr 小队的指挥官。如果你想帮助我们完成正义之举，就去找 Lightkeeper，把我们的识别符号交给他。但如果你是我们的敌人——我们会主动上门来追杀你的，不死不休。
lines.textEn: I am the commander of the Bogatyr squad. If you want to help us do something right, find Lightkeeper. Give him our identification signs. But if you are our enemy, we will come for you.

lines.textCh: （只有杂音传来）
lines.textEn: (Nothing but static comes through)

lines.textCh: 我是 Bogatyr 小队的指挥官。如果你想帮助我们完成正义之举，就去找 Lightkeeper，把我们的识别符号交给他。但如果你是我们的敌人——我们会主动上门来追杀你的，不死不休。
lines.textEn: I am the commander of the Bogatyr squad. If you want to help us do something right, find Lightkeeper. Give him our identification signs. But if you are our enemy, we will come for you.

lines.textCh: （强烈的杂音遮住了大部分信号，但背景里似乎有人在说话）
lines.textEn: (Heavy static obscures most of the signal, but someone seems to be talking in the background)

lines.textCh: （信号若有若无，勉强存在。肯定不是圣彼得堡的广播）
lines.textEn: (The signal, if it’s coming through at all, is barely there. Definitely not a St. Petersburg broadcast)

lines.textCh: （音乐稍微大了一点，但旋律依然听不清）
lines.textEn: (The music grows a little louder, but the melody is still unclear)

lines.textCh: 正在发送求救信号。请确认收到！完毕。
lines.textEn: Sending a distress call. Please acknowledge! Over.

lines.textCh: 有人吗？确认收到啊，该死！
lines.textEn: Is anyone there? Confirm receipt, damn it!

lines.textCh: （依旧没有回应。信号弱得几乎听不出内容）
lines.textEn: (Still nothing. The signal is too faint to hear anything)

lines.textCh: 这是紧急情况！正在发送 SOS 信号，我重复一遍：SOS！
lines.textEn: This is an emergency! Sending an SOS signal, I repeat: SOS!

lines.textCh: 水是湿的。我重复：水是湿的！
lines.textEn: Water is wet. I repeat: Water is wet!

lines.textCh: （杂音停了一瞬，但信号仍然太弱）
lines.textEn: (The static stops for a second, but the signal is still too weak)

lines.textCh: （没有变化，你听到的仍然是模糊的旋律和杂音）
lines.textEn: (Nothing changes, all you can hear is an indistinct melody and static)

lines.textCh: 正在发送 SOS，我重复：SOS！请确认！
lines.textEn: Sending an SOS signal, I repeat: SOS! Please confirm!

lines.textCh: 水是湿的！水他妈是湿的啊，该死！
lines.textEn: Water is wet! Water is fucking wet, damn it!

lines.textCh: 有人吗？确认收到！
lines.textEn: Is anybody there? Confirm receipt!

lines.textCh: 如果有人听到，请回应！
lines.textEn: If anyone hears me, acknowledge!

lines.textCh: （通话中断了几秒，然后恢复。语句明显变短。）
lines.textEn: (The conversation drops out for a few seconds, then resumes. The phrases are noticeably shorter)

lines.textCh: （仍然没有回应。）
lines.textEn: (Still nothing, no reply)

lines.textCh: （杂音增强，淹没了扬声器。）
lines.textEn: (The static intensifies, flooding the speaker with noise)

lines.textCh: （扬声器只发出机械噪声与干扰。）
lines.textEn: (The speaker emits only mechanical sounds and interference)

lines.textCh: （一个强而清晰的信号传入，带着某段讯息，但你听不出任何词。这不像是普通干扰。）
lines.textEn: (A strong, clear transmission comes through, carrying a message, but you can’t pick out any words. This doesn’t sound like normal interference)

lines.textCh: （等一会。）
lines.textEn: (Wait a bit)

lines.textCh: （信号持续中。似乎有人在发送循环讯息，但内容暂时无法辨认。）
lines.textEn: (The signal continues. Someone appears to be sending a looped message, though the content is currently indecipherable)

lines.textCh: （这个频率依旧传来奇怪的信号。讯息似乎是破碎的，或是加密的。）
lines.textEn: (The frequency is still carrying the strange signal. The message seems either broken or encoded)

lines.textCh: （没有变化。信号强且无阻碍，干扰不是问题。）
lines.textEn: (No change. The signal is strong and unobstructed, so interference isn’t the issue)

lines.textCh: （离开无线电）
lines.textEn: (Leave the radio)

lines.textCh: （附近频道没有任何内容，只有杂音或死静。）
lines.textEn: (Nothing comes through on the nearby channels, just static or dead air)

lines.textCh: （等一会。）
lines.textEn: (Wait a bit)

lines.textCh: 你了解 Bogatyr 小队吗？我收到他们指挥官的讯息，他让我来找你。还让我出示他们的臂章给你看。 （展示 Bogatyr 臂章）
lines.textEn: Do you know anything about the Bogatyr squad? I found a message from their commander, and he sent me to you. Told me to show you their insignia, here. (Show the Bogatyr squad insignia)

lines.textCh: 是的，那确实是他们的东西。我不需要，你留着吧。
lines.textEn: Yes, those are indeed their things. I don’t need them, you can keep them.

lines.textCh: 那 Bogatyr 小队呢？你到底知道些什么？
lines.textEn: So what about the Bogatyr squad? What do you know about them?

lines.textCh: 那 Bogatyr 小队呢？你对他们了解多少？
lines.textEn: So what about the Bogatyr squad? What do you know about them?

lines.textCh: 那支小队由真正的专业人士组成。Voevoda 只要那些“道德罗盘”尚未失效的人。 Voevoda 以前还帮我处理过一件私事。 他们主要负责从塔科夫最危险的区域撤离人员。
lines.textEn: The squad is made of professionals. Voevoda only takes those whose “moral compass” hasn’t failed. Voevoda even helped me with a personal matter once. They mostly handled evacuation from Tarkov’s most dangerous areas.

lines.textCh: 那为什么他们不在塔科夫？他们去了哪里？
lines.textEn: So why are they not here in Tarkov? Where did they go?

lines.textCh: 他们内部有人背叛了宛如父亲一般的队长。从那时开始，整支小队就一直被追杀。现在 Bogatyrs 都在暗中行动。
lines.textEn: Someone from their own betrayed Batya. Since then, they’re being hunted. Now the Bogatyrs stay hidden.

lines.textCh: 所以他们现在是独立行动？没有支援？
lines.textEn: Does this mean they operate independently now? Without support?

lines.textCh: 没错。塔科夫已没剩下多少符合 Voevoda 标准的战士了。有些离开了，有些死了，有些成了掠夺者。 Voevoda 正在召集那些仍追求正义的幸存者们。
lines.textEn: Correct. Few fighters remain in Tarkov who meet Voevoda’s standards. Some left, some died, some became looters. Batya gathers those who survived and still seek justice.

lines.textCh: 那 Voevoda 是亲自给他们下任务吗？他们现在的目标是什么？
lines.textEn: So Voevoda gives tasks to his squad himself? What are their goals now?

lines.textCh: 他们不向我汇报。Voevoda 在追寻真相，并为那些背负着罪孽的人降下审判。与塔科夫大多数人不同的是，他总是能做到。 不过，他也不断树敌……但他清楚所有后果。
lines.textEn: They don’t report to me. Batya seeks the truth and punishes the guilty. Unlike most in Tarkov, he gets results. Though, he makes increasingly dangerous enemies… But he knows all the risks.

lines.textCh: 你的信号在我这边卡了。等一下……好了，现在应该好些。
lines.textEn: You’re lagging on my feed. Hold on… okay, that should be better now.

lines.textCh: 很好，你露面了。
lines.textEn: Good, you showed up.

lines.textCh: 还是别浪费时间了。
lines.textEn: Let’s not waste time.

lines.textCh: 我们继续吧。
lines.textEn: Let’s get to it.

lines.textCh: 明白，再见。
lines.textEn: Got it. Out.

lines.textCh: 嗯，嗨。
lines.textEn: Yeah, hi.

lines.textCh: 别死在外面，我需要你活着。
lines.textEn: Don’t die out there. I need you alive.

lines.textCh: 你好。
lines.textEn: Hello there.

lines.textCh: 是的，塔科夫不等人。
lines.textEn: Right. Tarkov does not wait.

lines.textCh: 我们之后再谈。
lines.textEn: We’ll talk again.

lines.textCh: 保持联络。
lines.textEn: Stay in touch.

lines.textCh: 我不会用“憎恨”这么强的词。我只是做我该做的。我知道一切的内情，这个世界绝不能容许 TerraGroup 继续为非作歹。
lines.textEn: I would not use such a strong word as hate. I do what I must. I saw everything from the inside. TerraGroup cannot be allowed to exist.

lines.textCh: 你挺好奇的，是吧。我只回答你其中一个问题：TerraGroup 依附在全人类身上的一处溃烂伤口，它的存在必须被抹去。你很快就会亲眼见识到这一点。仔细看看、挖挖情报、探索塔科夫——证据到处都是。
lines.textEn: Curious type, aren’t you. I’ll answer one of your two questions. TerraGroup is a festering wound on humanity and must not exist. You will see for yourself soon enough. Look closer, dig for information, explore Tarkov: the evidence is everywhere.

lines.textCh: 你究竟是谁？为什么你这么憎恨 TerraGroup？
lines.textEn: Who are you anyway? Why do you hate TerraGroup so much?

lines.textCh: 你继续在那儿发呆吧，我都要自己逃出塔科夫了，压根儿不靠你！
lines.textEn: While you sit there in silence, I’ve almost made it out of Tarkov. Without your help!

lines.textCh: 我是谁并不重要，重要的只有目标。而那个目标，就是让 TerraGroup 倒下。若想让人类拥有更好的未来，那家企业就不该继续存在。理由很充分，你很快就会亲眼看到。
lines.textEn: Who I am does not matter. Only the goal matters. And that goal is TerraGroup’s fall. That corporation should not exist if we want a better future for humanity. There are reasons for that. You will see soon enough.

lines.textCh: 就这样？既不回应也不帮忙？我算是看明白了。
lines.textEn: So that’s it? No response, no help? I see how it is.

lines.textCh: 我得走了。
lines.textEn: I have to go.

lines.textCh: 我得走了。
lines.textEn: I have to go.

lines.textCh: 我既然已经看清了这一切，你真的以为我会像那些盲目听命的人一样？我以为你早该明白我是谁了。
lines.textEn: Why would I, having opened my eyes and seen what’s happening, love TerraGroup? Do you really think I’m like those who blindly follow a handler? I thought you already understood who I am.

lines.textCh: 没听你的，是我判断失误。抱歉。我现在仍然需要你的协助。
lines.textEn: I was wrong not to listen to you. I’m sorry. I still need your help.

lines.textCh: 听着。我知道你想要什么。我们来谈谈吧。
lines.textEn: Listen. I know you want something. Let's talk about this.

lines.textCh: 我把箱子给Prapor了。
lines.textEn: I gave the case to Prapor.

lines.textCh: 我把箱子给Prapor了。
lines.textEn: I gave the case to Prapor.

lines.textCh: 我本以为你不会愚蠢到这种程度。看来判断失误了。结果令人遗憾。
lines.textEn: I hoped you were not that dumb. Looks like I was wrong. Unpleasant outcome.

lines.textCh: 我早就说过箱子至关重要。不是对 Prapor，而是对你。
lines.textEn: I told you the case was crucial. Not to Prapor, but to you.

lines.textCh: 现在你已经完全没有离开塔科夫的机会了。恭喜你。
lines.textEn: Now you have zero chance of getting out of Tarkov. Congratulations.

lines.textCh: 准备好在封锁区里继续苟活吧。一切会炫彩夺目，但转瞬即逝。而且会痛苦不堪。
lines.textEn: Prepare for life inside the closed zone. It will be flashy but short. And painful.

lines.textCh: 当你把那个箱子上交的那一刻，这就是你自己选的路。
lines.textEn: You chose this yourself when you handed over the case.

lines.textCh: 不要无视我！
lines.textEn: Stop ignoring me!

lines.textCh: (离开)
lines.textEn: (Leave)

lines.textCh: 我去了 Prapor 那了。他很干脆地让我滚蛋。
lines.textEn: I went to Prapor. He told me to go fuck myself.

lines.textCh: 我给你的箱子呢？你怎么处理的？
lines.textEn: What did you do with the case I gave you?

lines.textCh: 我很好。
lines.textEn: I’m alright.

lines.textCh: 怎么求？
lines.textEn: How?

lines.textCh: 那现在怎么办？
lines.textEn: What now?

lines.textCh: 你想要聊些什么？
lines.textEn: What did you want to talk about?

lines.textCh: 塔科夫待你如何？
lines.textEn: How is Tarkov treating you?

lines.textCh: 如果你没有把箱子给别人就更好了。
lines.textEn: It would be better had you not given the case away.

lines.textCh: 他妈的真是受够塔科夫了。
lines.textEn: Fucking tired of Tarkov.

lines.textCh: 哦是吗？要是你当初没把那个箱子交给 Prapor。你现在早就能走人了。
lines.textEn: Oh really? Maybe you should not have given the case to Prapor then. You could have left by now.

lines.textCh: 好吧，我猜你现在知道自己干了件蠢事。
lines.textEn: Alright, I assume you realize you acted stupidly.

lines.textCh: 我也希望你明白——你现在需要把那个箱子要回来。
lines.textEn: I hope you also understand you need the case back.

lines.textCh: 要是事情有那么简单就好了。
lines.textEn: If only it were that simple.

lines.textCh: 你连试都没试就开始抱怨了。你这种态度怎么还没死在塔科夫？
lines.textEn: You did not even try and you already complain. How are you still alive in Tarkov with that attitude?

lines.textCh: 振作点，去找 Prapor。也许你还能把箱子求回来。
lines.textEn: Pull yourself together and go to Prapor. Maybe you can beg your way back to the case.

lines.textCh: 很简单。第一步——先去和 Prapor 说话。接着无论他要你干什么，你就去做。
lines.textEn: Simple. First step — talk to Prapor. Then just do as you’re told.

lines.textCh: 呵，有意思。你为什么在乎？
lines.textEn: Huh, interesting. And why would you care about this?

lines.textCh: 我需要它。
lines.textEn: I need it.

lines.textCh: 啊——我懂了……好啊，让我打个响指，我的人马上给你拿回来，你是不是觉得会这样？
lines.textEn: A-ah, I see… Alright, let me snap my fingers and my guys will fetch it.

lines.textCh: 你以为有这么容易？为了那个箱子我他妈可是花了一大笔钱，还有数不尽的资源！现在它是我的了。
lines.textEn: Though it would be that easy? I already paid a fuck ton of resources and cash for that case. It’s mine.

lines.textCh: 也许我们可以谈谈？你要多少钱才能肯把它卖给我？
lines.textEn: Maybe we can work something out? How much do you want for it?

lines.textCh: 你凭什么觉得箱子还在我手上？
lines.textEn: And why do you assume it’s still with me?

lines.textCh: 还有别的事吗？没有就滚。我还有生意要处理。
lines.textEn: Anything else? Then get out. I’ve got business to handle.

lines.textCh: 很符合他的风格，意料之中。
lines.textEn: In his manner, predictable.

lines.textCh: 你耍我？我在这破事上浪费了时间！
lines.textEn: You messing with me? I wasted my time on this bullshit!

lines.textCh: 别激动，英雄。听过一句话吗：“一切都是最好的安排”？
lines.textEn: Don’t get so worked up, hero. Heard the saying "everything happens for the best"?

lines.textCh: 现在你得听我的。
lines.textEn: You listen to me.

lines.textCh: Prapor 不会告诉你箱子去了哪儿。但我可以。
lines.textEn: Prapor would not tell you where the case went. But I can.

lines.textCh: 我的情报显示 Prapor 的人最近在灯塔那边逗留了一天。那边很可能留下了什么痕迹。
lines.textEn: My intel shows Prapor’s people were at the Lighthouse recently, camped there for a day. Likely they left a footprint.

lines.textCh: 士兵可不擅长清理现场。那里可能还有些有用的东西。
lines.textEn: Soldiers cannot clean up traces well. There might be something useful left.

lines.textCh: (离开)
lines.textEn: (Leave)

lines.textCh: 能在这座被诅咒的城市活到现在，还不够说明问题吗？
lines.textEn: Isn't surviving in this cursed city proof enough?

lines.textCh: 我有我自己的目标。但现在，我需要任何关于塔科夫到底发生了什么，以及谁对此负责的情报。
lines.textEn: I have my own goals. But right now I need any info on what happened in Tarkov and who’s responsible for this.

lines.textCh: 我们已经撤离了那些据点。引发塔科夫灾难的那帮混蛋已经转移了。下一个目标是整个诺文斯克特区，我们在那边行动了六个月。不过塔科夫这里还有一堆事情要做。
lines.textEn: We left those spots. The fucks who sparked the catastrophe in Tarkov moved on. Next is Norvinsk, and we have been operating here for six months. Still plenty to do in Tarkov though.

lines.textCh: 这里是 Voevoda。Lightkeeper 说你是个正派的人，想查明真相。是这样吗？
lines.textEn: This is Voevoda. Lightkeeper sent word you are a decent man and want to get to the truth. Is that right?

lines.textCh: 是的。总部不关心塔科夫的破事。但这一切混乱的幕后一定有人在操纵着一切，我想知道是谁。
lines.textEn: Affirmative. HQ does not care about Tarkov. But someone is behind all this, and I want to know who.

lines.textCh: 形势已十分严峻。BEAR、USEC——都已经不复存在。如今只剩下靠战友情谊凝结起来的战斗兄弟会。那些不会任由这片废土腐烂下去、并会把真相拖出黑暗的男人。
lines.textEn: Very serious time, right now. BEARs, USECs — all that is gone now. Now there is only the battle brotherhood. Men who will not let this ruin stand and who will show the truth.

lines.textCh: 所以你在隐藏你的目的，是吗……不过现在已经没有 BEAR，也没有 USEC 了。只有战斗兄弟会。如果你在追寻真相，那至少目前我们的道路是一致的。
lines.textEn: So you’re hiding your goals, huh… Well, there are no BEARs, no USECs anymore. Only the battle brotherhood. And if you hunt the truth, our paths align for now.

lines.textCh: 你们到底是怎么展开行动的？不光是“鸟巢”前哨站，就连“花楸树”和“旋转木马”营地全都空无一人。
lines.textEn: How do you operate? I found nobody at the Gnezdo, Ryabina, or the Carousel camps.

lines.textCh: 我们已经撤离了那些据点。引发塔科夫这场灾难的那帮混蛋已经转移了。下一个目标是整个诺文斯克地区，我们已经在那边行动了六个月。不过塔科夫这边还有很多事要处理。
lines.textEn: We left those spots. The fucks who sparked the catastrophe in Tarkov moved on. Next is Norvinsk, and we have been operating here for six months. Still plenty to do in Tarkov though.

lines.textCh: （离开无线电）
lines.textEn: (Leave the radio)
(Enter frequency 35.70)

lines.textCh: （电台里只有杂音）
lines.textEn: (Nothing but static comes through)
(Enter code 27.893.2000)

lines.textCh: （杂音渐渐消失，信号变得更清晰）
lines.textEn: (Static fades, the signal is getting clearer)

lines.textCh: 喂。喂！呼叫 Voevoda，请回应。
lines.textEn: Hello. Hello! Calling for Voevoda, come in.

lines.textCh: 收到。完毕。
lines.textEn: Solid copy. Out.

lines.textCh: （无回应。看来对方已经关闭了电台。）
lines.textEn: (No response. Looks like the other side has already shut off their radio)

lines.textCh: 你能找到我们的营地，说明你够敏锐，也会战斗。但我们不能容忍任何错误。 所以先证明你能完成我们的任务，然后再说。完毕。
lines.textEn: If you’ve found our camps, that means you’re sharp and know how to fight. But we can't have any room for mistakes. So first, prove you can handle our tasks, and then we’ll see. Over and out.

lines.textCh: 这谈话非常重要，你得忍受我在这儿听着。
lines.textEn: The talk is so serious that you’ll have to endure me.

lines.textCh: 我和 Voevoda 谈过，我正在替他做事。老爹想让你主动联系他。
lines.textEn: I talked with Voevoda and I am doing some work for him. Batya wants you to contact him.

lines.textCh: 你打算就这么站在这里一直听我们说话吗？如果这事儿很重要，你应该立刻出去行动。
lines.textEn: And you are planning to just stay here while we talk? If this is serious, you should step outside.

lines.textCh: Voevoda 说我应该在这里。
lines.textEn: Voevoda said I should be here.

lines.textCh: 嗯……那就留下吧。Lightkeeper 呼叫 Batya，Lightkeeper 呼叫 Batya，请回应。
lines.textEn: Hm… Stay then. Lightkeeper to Batya, Lightkeeper to Batya, come in.

lines.textCh: 你忘了你在和谁说话。想活到明天，就注意你的措辞。
lines.textEn: You forget who you are dealing with. Watch what you say if you want to see tomorrow.

lines.textCh: 这是关于 Voevoda 的事，我是奉他之命在这里。
lines.textEn: This concerns Voevoda, and I am here on his word.

lines.textCh: 爬得越高……让我们听听他怎么说。Lightkeeper 呼叫 Batya，Lightkeeper 呼叫 Batya，请回应。
lines.textEn: The higher you rise… Let us see what he says. Lightkeeper to Batya, Lightkeeper to Batya, come in.

lines.textCh: 这里是 Voevoda。发生什么事了？
lines.textEn: This is Voevoda. Something happened?

lines.textCh: 你来告诉我啊。是你的人来找我，说我必须联系你。
lines.textEn: You tell me. One of your fighters came and said I need to contact you.

lines.textCh: 等等，我有点不明白。邪教徒和军方之间到底有什么关系？
lines.textEn: Hold on, I don’t get it. What is the connection between the cultists and the army?

lines.textCh: Yastreb 得到的所有情报都是通过中间人传递的。Prapor 的人把那位将军的留言塞进了邪教徒的圈子里。Yastreb 只通过他们进行联络。
lines.textEn: Yastreb got all his tips through intermediaries. Prapor’s people left messages from the General inside the cultist circles. Yastreb communicated only with them.

lines.textCh: 什么……Vitya，这到底搞什么？我可是把你女儿救出了塔科夫！这是真的吗？
lines.textEn: What the... Vitya, what the hell? I pulled your daughter out of Tarkov! Is this true?

lines.textCh: 我不为他们的行为负责。城里有太多势力，而“见证者”只是链条上的一环。 一切都是有关联的。没错，我本该为“将军”提供通讯渠道，但我的参与到此为止了。
lines.textEn: I do not answer for their actions. There are many forces in the city, and the Witnesses are only one link in the chain. All is interlinked. Yes, I was supposed to provide a channel to the General, but that was where my involvement ended.

lines.textCh: 你想告诉我你什么都不知道？没有接触？没有报告？从来没听说过这个将军？
lines.textEn: You want to tell me you knew nothing? No contacts? No reports? Never heard of this General?

lines.textCh: “无名者”已经渗透进军队了，要是谁试图去挖那位将军的底，就是简直就是自投罗网。 即使我当时选择冒那个险，也不会改变任何结果的。
lines.textEn: The Unheard already have people embedded in the army, and digging under the General would have been suicide. Even if I had taken that risk, it would not have changed anything.

lines.textCh: 我已经看不透你了。你至少可以提醒我一下！也许我们就不用亲手埋葬那些兄弟了。现在我们去哪儿找这个将军？
lines.textEn: I do not recognize you. You could’ve at least warned me! Maybe we would not have had to bury the boys. Where do we look for this General now?

lines.textCh: 他已经完成他的任务，然后躲了起来。没有我，你找不到他。 但我想结束这件事，而且我需要Bogatyrs的安全保证。为了这个，我会亲手解决那位“将军”。 这不正是你想要的，对吧？
lines.textEn: He played his role and then laid low. You will not find him without me. But I want this matter closed and I want safety guarantees from the Bogatyrs. For that I will eliminate the General. That is what you want, right?

lines.textCh: 我必须为 Moreman 报仇。但我已经不再信任你了，Vitya。天知道是谁把你洗了脑。 还有一件事——那个小子，不像你，他是真心想要追查真相。你会帮他的。
lines.textEn: I must avenge Moreman. But I no longer trust you, Vitya. Hell knows who washed your head like that. One more thing — that kid, unlike you, actually wants the truth. You will help him.

lines.textCh: 你下结论太早了。但我接受你的条件。 雇佣兵，你需要什么？
lines.textEn: You rush to conclusions. But I accept your terms. Mercenary, what do you need?

lines.textCh: 我要文件。证明“无名者”已经渗透进俄罗斯军队的证据。
lines.textEn: Documents. Proof that The Unheard are in the Russian army.

lines.textCh: 你还没看到全貌。光是文件并不能让你明白世界正在发生什么。但我会遵守承诺。 Voevoda！等“将军”的事解决之后，我会亲自联系你。
lines.textEn: You do not see the full picture, the documents alone may not make you understand what is going on in the world. But I will keep my word. Voevoda! When the General matter is handled, I will contact you myself.

lines.textCh: 我已经查到是谁背叛了Bogatyrs小队。他自称“将军”。他一直通过邪教徒进行沟通，而Lightkeeper指示那些邪教徒协助他。
lines.textEn: I found out who betrayed the Bogatyrs. He calls himself the General. He was communicating through the cult members who, on “Lighthouse Warden’s” instruction, were helping him.

lines.textCh: 士兵！你到底在说什么！
lines.textEn: Soldier! Explain yourself.

lines.textCh: 你本可以阻止这件事的。通话结束。
lines.textEn: You could have prevented this. Out.

lines.textCh: （离开）
lines.textEn: (Leave)

lines.textCh: Mechanic?
lines.textEn: Mechanic?

lines.textCh: 我在他们的营地里找到了一张字条。
lines.textEn: I found a note at their camp.

lines.textCh: 我说过，士兵永远会留下痕迹的。这是他们的天性。
lines.textEn: Told you, soldiers always leave traces. It is their nature.

lines.textCh: 你为什么这么确定就是那个箱子？
lines.textEn: Why are you so sure it is the right case?

lines.textCh: 我的直觉。说真的，你觉得我会把你往死胡同里赶吗？
lines.textEn: My gut. Seriously, do you think I would send you on a wild goose chase?

lines.textCh: 就是同一个箱子，别怀疑。
lines.textEn: It's that same case, don't doubt it.

lines.textCh: 接下来呢？
lines.textEn: What next?

lines.textCh: 现在搞清楚谁拿着那个箱子。
lines.textEn: Figure out who has the case now.

lines.textCh: Prapor 的人把箱子转给谁了，你有什么头绪吗？
lines.textEn: Any ideas on who Prapor passed it to through his people?

lines.textCh: Lightkeeper?
lines.textEn: Lightkeeper?

lines.textCh: 没错，就是他！
lines.textEn: We have a winner!

lines.textCh: 是个有意思的猜测。但他为什么要这么做？而且为什么是在灯塔？
lines.textEn: Interesting guess. But why do that? And why at the Lighthouse?

lines.textCh: Mechanic 又不是那边的头儿。但谁才是呢？
lines.textEn: Mechanic is not the head honcho over there. But who is?

lines.textCh: Lightkeeper?
lines.textEn: Lightkeeper?

lines.textCh: 答对了。
lines.textEn: Bingo.

lines.textCh: 他大概非常清楚箱子里是什么东西，而且不会轻易交出来。
lines.textEn: He likely knows exactly what is in the case and will not hand it over easily.

lines.textCh: 所以准备好再吃点苦头。然后去找 Lightkeeper。
lines.textEn: So prepare for some more hardships. And then go to Lightkeeper.

lines.textCh: 我已经拿到所有文件了。
lines.textEn: I have all the documents.

lines.textCh: 我在找一样东西，而你能帮上忙。
lines.textEn: I’m looking for something, and you can help me with this.

lines.textCh: 我在找 TerraGroup 的那个箱子。
lines.textEn: I’m looking for the TerraGroup case.

lines.textCh: 明白！
lines.textEn: Understood!

lines.textCh: 有意思。说清楚点。我的时间很宝贵。
lines.textEn: Interesting. Speak precisely. My time is valuable.

lines.textCh: 我需要 Prapor 给你的那个箱子。
lines.textEn: I need the case Prapor handed you.

lines.textCh: 有意思。我拿走那个箱子是有原因的。它很重要。
lines.textEn: Interesting. I took that case for a reason. It is important.

lines.textCh: 然后呢？你以为我像 Ragman 那样收集所有带 TerraGroup 标记的东西？你搞错了。
lines.textEn: And? You think I collect everything marked TerraGroup like that Ragman? You’re mistaken.

lines.textCh: 我说的那个箱子，是 Prapor 给你的。
lines.textEn: The case I’m talking about was given to you by Prapor.

lines.textCh: 下次别浪费你我的时间问这种没意义的问题。没错，我有那个箱子。而且这个箱子非常重要，不可能就这么给你。
lines.textEn: Next time, don’t waste either your time or mine on pointless questions. Yes, I have the case. And this case is far too important to hand it over just like that.

lines.textCh: 也许我们可以谈谈交易？
lines.textEn: Maybe we can make a deal?

lines.textCh: 看来你开始上道儿了。
lines.textEn: Seems like you’re starting to understand something.

lines.textCh: 好。我用箱子换你去帮我干活。你得证明你自己的价值。怎么样，成交吗？
lines.textEn: Fine. I’ll trade the case for your work. You’ll have to prove yourself. Agreed?

lines.textCh: 我还能有选择吗？
lines.textEn: Like I have a choice.

lines.textCh: 没人说你有。
lines.textEn: No one said you did.

lines.textCh: 听好了，我不会说第二遍：你需要在塔科夫找到那些蓝色文件资料。我不想让它们落在那些以为自己聪明、想东问西问的人手里。
lines.textEn: Listen carefully, I won’t repeat twice: you need to find the blue folder documents in Tarkov. I don’t want them freely available to anyone thinking they’re smart enough to ask questions.

lines.textCh: 你把它们交给我之后，我会给你下一个任务。
lines.textEn: Once you hand them to me, you’ll get the next task.

lines.textCh: 现在去吧。
lines.textEn: Now go.

lines.textCh: 很好，你走之前把它们交给我。
lines.textEn: Good, you’ll hand them over when you leave.

lines.textCh: 现在听你的任务：在立交桥，你需要……引起注意。你知道怎么做。之后，把所有赶来的家伙都解决掉。
lines.textEn: Now listen for your task: at the Interchange, you’ll have to… draw attention. You know how. After that, you eliminate all those who come.

lines.textCh: 这一切必须在同一个时间段内完成，不能中断。
lines.textEn: All this has to be done in one time slot, without breaks.

lines.textCh: 明白了吗？
lines.textEn: Clear?

lines.textCh: 你到底要这些干嘛？
lines.textEn: Why do you even need this?

lines.textCh: 现在去，带着好消息回来。
lines.textEn: Now go and come back with results.

lines.textCh: 你凭什么认为我会告诉你我的想法？你的目标是完成任务，而不是提问。
lines.textEn: Why do you think I’m going to share you my thoughts? Your goal is to complete the task, not ask questions.

lines.textCh: 走吧。时间不等人。
lines.textEn: Then go. Time doesn’t wait.

lines.textCh: (离开)
lines.textEn: (Leave)

lines.textCh: 你知道怎么着？我现在就把箱子拿走。
lines.textEn: Actually, you know what? I'll get the case right now.

lines.textCh: 关于箱子：先放你那儿。我之后来取。（腾出你的特殊栏位）
lines.textEn: About the case: Let it stay with you for now. I'll get it later. (Free your Special slot)

lines.textCh: 他的目的是什么？
lines.textEn: What are his goals?

lines.textCh: 关于箱子：待会儿我会自己来取。先留着。（腾出你的特殊栏位）
lines.textEn: About the case: I'll come get it later. Let it stay with you for now. (Free your Special slot)

lines.textCh: 我来拿箱子了。
lines.textEn: I'm here for the case.

lines.textCh: 任务完成了。
lines.textEn: The tasks are complete.

lines.textCh: 我知道。你干得很好。
lines.textEn: Yes, I know. You handled everything.

lines.textCh: 这是你的奖励。
lines.textEn: Here’s your reward.

lines.textCh: 这一次，不要交给任何人。自己留着。还有——替我向 Kerman 先生问好。
lines.textEn: This time, do not give it to anyone. Use it yourself. And also: send regards to Mr. Kerman.

lines.textCh: 嗯？你认识他？
lines.textEn: Huh? You know him?

lines.textCh: 你忘了我知道塔科夫的一切？他不是第一次把手伸到这里来了。
lines.textEn: Did you forget I know everything happening in Tarkov? It’s not the first time he’s reaching here.

lines.textCh: 这人是谁？
lines.textEn: Who is this man?

lines.textCh: 只有他自己知道。
lines.textEn: Only he can say.

lines.textCh: 这么说吧：他和 TerraGroup 有关系。所以别盲目信他。
lines.textEn: Let’s just say he’s connected to TerraGroup. So don’t trust him blindly.

lines.textCh: 我需要那个箱子。现在。
lines.textEn: I need the case. Right now.

lines.textCh: 明白。
lines.textEn: Understood.

lines.textCh: 我之前来找你帮过忙，我现在还是需要你的帮助。
lines.textEn: I came before for that one favor. I still need help.

lines.textCh: 我需要你帮一个忙。
lines.textEn: I need a favor.

lines.textCh: 坏消息。
lines.textEn: Bad.

lines.textCh: 我看你脸色就知道事情很严重。但我对你还不够了解，没法帮你。
lines.textEn: I see by your face that this is serious. But I don’t know you well enough yet to help with that.

lines.textCh: 我看你脸色就知道事情很严重。但我对你还不够了解，没法帮你。
lines.textEn: I see by your face that this is serious. But I don’t know you well enough yet to help with that.

lines.textCh: 嗯？什么事？
lines.textEn: Yes? What’s up?

lines.textCh: 我需要打开一个公文箱。
lines.textEn: I need to open a briefcase.

lines.textCh: 好，我明白了。箱子在你那里吗？把它给我，我要看看要做些什么。
lines.textEn: Okay, got it. Is the case with you? Hand it over, I’ll size up the work.

lines.textCh: 嗯，好吧。如果……算了，没事。
lines.textEn: Hm, alright. What if… No.

lines.textCh: 雇佣兵，有两条消息。好消息和坏消息。先听哪个？
lines.textEn: Two news, mercenary. Good and bad. Which first?

lines.textCh: 好消息。
lines.textEn: Good.

lines.textCh: 我知道怎么打开这个箱子，也能教你。但我缺少合适的工具。
lines.textEn: I know how to open the case and can explain it. But I lack the proper tools.

lines.textCh: 你得先把那些东西找来。
lines.textEn: You’ll have to find them first.

lines.textCh: 我现在打不开它，我没有所需的工具。但我知道你可能在哪找到。
lines.textEn: I cannot open it right now, I don’t have the proper tools. But I know where you may find it.

lines.textCh: 据我所知，TerraGroup 研究过某种特殊的干扰器。我需要其中一个。
lines.textEn: As far as I know, TerraGroup worked on some kind of special jammers. I need one of those.

lines.textCh: 我去哪找？
lines.textEn: Where do I find it?

lines.textCh: 当然是在他们的实验室里。把干扰器带来，我就教你怎么用它。
lines.textEn: In their labs, of course. Bring me the jammer, and I’ll show you how to use it.

lines.textCh: 现在去吧，你有新任务了。
lines.textEn: Now go, you have your objective.

lines.textCh: 之后再来。
lines.textEn: Come back later.

lines.textCh: 我记得。当时我们互相还不熟。我不会随便帮人。
lines.textEn: I remember. We didn’t know each other well enough then. I don’t help just anyone.

lines.textCh: 说吧，你需要什么？
lines.textEn: So, what do you need?

lines.textCh: 之后再来。
lines.textEn: Come back later.

lines.textCh: 如果这样能帮到我，我可以等。
lines.textEn: I can wait if this helps me.

lines.textCh: 我找到干扰器了。
lines.textEn: I found the jammer.

lines.textCh: 很好。我会给你一份物品清单。搞到剩下的那些东西就容易多了。
lines.textEn: Excellent. I’ll give you a list of what else you’ll need. Those items are way easier to get.

lines.textCh: 打开箱子需要时间。做好准备吧。
lines.textEn: It will take time to open the case. Be ready.

lines.textCh: 我没多少时间了。
lines.textEn: I don’t have much time.

lines.textCh: 有些事情必须等。尤其是这种箱子。一步走错，里面的东西就全毁了。
lines.textEn: Sometimes you have to wait. Especially in cases like this. One wrong move and everything inside could be destroyed.

lines.textCh: 我不建议你急着冒险。
lines.textEn: I don’t recommend rushing this and taking risks.

lines.textCh: 祝你好运，雇佣兵。
lines.textEn: Good luck, mercenary.

lines.textCh: 这态度不错。祝你好运，雇佣兵。
lines.textEn: That’s the right attitude. Good luck, mercenary.

lines.textCh: 有嫌疑人吗？
lines.textEn: Any suspects?

lines.textCh: 所以你觉得幕后还有别人？
lines.textEn: So you think someone else was behind this?

lines.textCh: 我从哪开始？
lines.textEn: Where should I start?

lines.textCh: Taran，听着呢。
lines.textEn: Taran, listening.

lines.textCh: 你是谁？Voevoda 呢？
lines.textEn: Who are you? Where’s Voevoda?

lines.textCh: 暂时由我代替他。最近事太多了。你已经证明你够能干，所以我们直接说正事。你得帮我们找一个叛徒。
lines.textEn: I’m covering for him for the time being. Too much going on. You’ve proven yourself competent, so let’s get to it. You have to find a certain rat for us.

lines.textCh: 有人出卖了Bogatyr小队？
lines.textEn: Someone betrayed the Bogatyr squad?

lines.textCh: 我们还在塔科夫的时候，有个 BEAR 把我们带进了死角。他叫 Yastreb。我们立刻把那混蛋做掉了，但因此失去了几个好兄弟。
lines.textEn: Back when we were in Tarkov, some BEAR got us stuck in a bad spot. Went by the name Yastreb. We took that fucker out immediately, but lost some good men because of him.

lines.textCh: 那我要做什么？你们不是已经处理了吗？
lines.textEn: So what’s my part in this? You handled it, didn’t you?

lines.textCh: 看样子你并不急着帮我们啊。那我说清楚点：Yastreb 不可能自己计划这些的，一定有人付钱给他。是谁？我不知道。但你得找出下令的人。
lines.textEn: Not really feeling any eagerness to help us. Let me spell it out for you: Yastreb couldn’t have pulled this off alone, someone paid him. Who exactly – no clue. You need to find the one who ordered the hit.

lines.textCh: 这种工作不可能是一个人完成的。有人想一口气把我们全干掉。你得找到是谁布下的埋伏。
lines.textEn: Jobs like that aren’t one-man shows. Somebody wanted to wipe us all out in one go. You need to find who set up the ambush.

lines.textCh: 那我找到之后呢？
lines.textEn: And when I find him, what’s next?

lines.textCh: 别亲自动手——你的任务是获取情报。然后联系 Batya，就是我们的队长。同一个频道。还有问题吗？
lines.textEn: Don’t get involved yourself – your job is to gather the info. Then, contact Batya. Same channel. Questions?

lines.textCh: 没有。
lines.textEn: Negative.

lines.textCh: 好，那就这样。完毕。
lines.textEn: Alright then. Out.

lines.textCh: Yastreb 是 BEAR，所以你得从那些 BEAR 中间入手。或者和他们合作的人。好了，我得走了。完毕。
lines.textEn: Yastreb was a BEAR, so you have to look among those. Or anyone working with them. Alright, time’s up. Out.

lines.textCh: 如果不是 BEAR，那就是外部势力。可能是任何人，从 TerraGroup 到 Prapor，甚至他上头的人都可能。好了，我真得走了。完毕。
lines.textEn: If it’s not the BEARs, then it’s someone from the outside. Could be anyone, from TerraGroup to Prapor and the brass above him. Alright, I need to go. Out.

lines.textCh: （离开电台）
lines.textEn: (Leave the radio)
(Enter frequency 35.70)

lines.textCh: （你只能听到杂音）
lines.textEn: (You can only hear static)
(Enter code 27.893.2000)

lines.textCh: （杂音逐渐消退，信号变得更清晰）
lines.textEn: (The static dies down, the signal is getting clearer)

lines.textCh: 呼叫 Voevoda，请回应！
lines.textEn: Calling for Voevoda, come in!

lines.textCh: 我有关于你的情报。
lines.textEn: I have information about you.

lines.textCh: 我需要名字。
lines.textEn: I need a name.

lines.textCh: 我想知道你的上级都给你下达了什么命令。
lines.textEn: I want to ask you about orders from your superiors.

lines.textCh: 嗯？问是可以。但你为什么突然觉得我会随便对哪个新兵透露这种事情？
lines.textEn: Huh? Well, asking’s fine, I guess. But why do you suddenly think I’d tell some rookie anything?

lines.textCh: 因为你害死了好人。
lines.textEn: Good men died because of you.

lines.textCh: 那又怎样？这是塔科夫，士兵。每天都有好人白白死去。
lines.textEn: So what? This is Tarkov, soldier. Good men die every day here.

lines.textCh: 哦，是吗？很多人都握着我的“黑料”。有什么新的、值得兴奋的吗？
lines.textEn: Oh yeah? Plenty of people have dirt on me. Anything new and exciting?

lines.textCh: 是你亲自把那些 BEAR 带进埋伏的。
lines.textEn: You’ve set up those BEARs.

lines.textCh: 什么？你打算指控我，臭小子？！我从不坑我们自己的人。
lines.textEn: What? You going to accuse me, you pup?! I don’t mess with our guys.

lines.textCh: 我已经收集到证据了。你是收到命令后去做的。是谁授权的？
lines.textEn: I collected the evidence. You were given orders. On whose authority?

lines.textCh: 好吧，被你逮到了。我确实接到过命令。严格说，我只有一个任务：把消息从城里传出去。我把那些纸条留在疯子们的粉笔圈里——那些邪教徒的标记。
lines.textEn: Fine, you got me. I did have orders. Well, technically I had one job. I passed messages out of the city. I left notes in the chalk circles of those crazies, the cultists.

lines.textCh: 你知道是谁下达的指示吗？
lines.textEn: Do you know who gave the instructions?

lines.textCh: 绝对不可能，战士。那是最高机密。所有指令都来自“将军”。我从不问问题。知道得越少，睡得越踏实。
lines.textEn: Absolutely not, warrior. This was top secret. Everything came from the General. I didn’t ask questions. The less you know, the more you sleep.

lines.textCh: 要是我自己知道就好了！我只是个传话的，中间人而已。只从“将军”那接命令。那可能都不是他真正的头衔，谁知道呢。
lines.textEn: If I knew myself! I was just a middleman, nothing fancy. I took orders from the General. That’s probably not even the real title, but who knows.

lines.textCh: 现在满意了吧，你个勒索犯？滚吧。
lines.textEn: Satisfied now, mister blackmailer? Now get out.

lines.textCh: (离开)
lines.textEn: (Leave)

lines.textCh: 既然我有完整的指令，你还有什么用？
lines.textEn: Why do I need you if I already have all the instructions?

lines.textCh: 你说得对。TerraGroup 的信息现在很可能已经过时了。
lines.textEn: You’re right. TerraGroup’s info is probably out of date by now.

lines.textCh: 我已经决定怎么处理那份指令了。
lines.textEn: I've decided what to do with the instruction.

lines.textCh: 我拿到钥匙卡了。
lines.textEn: I have the keycard.

lines.textCh: 好消息。我就知道你能办到。
lines.textEn: Good news. I was counting on you.

lines.textCh: 箱子里有一份指示。
lines.textEn: There was an instruction inside the case.

lines.textCh: 集团的经典操作。大人物就喜欢那些好看的文件。扔了吧，没用。
lines.textEn: Typical. Important players love pretty paperwork. Toss it, it's useless.

lines.textCh: 但我觉得我能用上。
lines.textEn: I could use it though.

lines.textCh: 你当然能。然后你也会被困在塔科夫，再也得不到我的帮助。
lines.textEn: You could. And then you could also stay stranded in Tarkov without my help.

lines.textCh: 因为那些漂亮的纸根本没用。TerraGroup 不可能把塔科夫发生的一切都提前写在纸上。
lines.textEn: Because pretty paper is worthless. TerraGroup could not have predicted everything that happened in Tarkov and wrote it all down.

lines.textCh: 所以你的选择是什么？
lines.textEn: So what’s your choice?

lines.textCh: TerraGroup 比你知道得多。从现在开始我自己来。
lines.textEn: TerraGroup knows more than you. I will take it from here.

lines.textCh: 随你便。这是你的命。你想怎么死我不拦你。但你不会再从我这得到任何帮助。
lines.textEn: Fine. It’s your life. Do as you want. But you will not get more help from me.

lines.textCh: 这才对。把那份指令扔了。
lines.textEn: Good thinking. Toss the instruction.

lines.textCh: 那张卡没有激活是用不了的。
lines.textEn: The card will not work unless activated.

lines.textCh: 你需要找到：一张实验室主卡、一张干净的 RFID 空白卡，以及一台钥匙卡加密设备。
lines.textEn: You need to find a master pass, clean RFID blank and a card encryption device.

lines.textCh: 主权限卡应该还在克鲁格洛夫那里，要么是办公室，要么公寓里。
lines.textEn: The master pass should be somewhere with Kruglov, his office or apartment.

lines.textCh: 至于空白卡，TerraGroup 有整整一仓库的存货。
lines.textEn: Now the blank cards. TerraGroup had whole warehouses filled with them.

lines.textCh: 不过也许现在有点缺货了——本地的 Scav 以为这些钥匙卡能刷开什么金库的门，早就把它们哄抢一空了。不过也许你的运气比较好还能找到几张？
lines.textEn: They are probably scarce now — locals grabbed them thinking they opened something. But perhaps you’ll get lucky?

lines.textCh: 只有实验室里才有那种钥匙卡加密设备。
lines.textEn: The encryption device can only be found in the Laboratory.

lines.textCh: 想把所有东西凑齐需要花不少功夫。所谓“循此苦旅，终抵繁星”嘛。
lines.textEn: It will take effort to find everything. Per aspera ad astra, as they say.

lines.textCh: (离开)
lines.textEn: (Leave)

lines.textCh: Kappa 安全箱在塔科夫简直和圣杯一样，许多人花上一辈子也搞不到。有没有其他解决的手段？
lines.textEn: That Kappa’s basically the holy grail around here. Takes a lifetime in Tarkov to get your hands on one. Maybe there’s another way to handle this?

lines.textCh: 好吧
lines.textEn: Alright.

lines.textCh: 这是你要的 Kappa 安全箱 (上交 Kappa 安全箱)
lines.textEn: Here’s your Kappa. (Hand over Secure container Kappa)

lines.textCh: 如果你是为了那些紧急任务才来的，那么……
lines.textEn: If you're here about those urgent tasks, then...

lines.textCh: 那么，我们该如何处理这些东西？
lines.textEn: So, what do we do with all this, huh?

lines.textCh: 我已经准备好再跑一趟这些任务了。
lines.textEn: I’m ready to run the tasks again.

lines.textCh: 不，到时候我要的是结果。不是到处胡闹，而是真正干点实事出来。
lines.textEn: Nope, I needed results back then. Not playing around, but actually working.

lines.textCh: 我想到了……安全箱知道吧？有一种叫 Kappa 的，TerraGroup 开发的那个。给我弄一个来，我们就两清了。
lines.textEn: I got an idea… Heard about the secure containers? There’s one called Kappa, a TerraGroup development. Bring me one, and we’ll settle.

lines.textCh: 我自己也需要那个东西。
lines.textEn: I need it myself.

lines.textCh: 我可不是在和你讨价还价，小朋友，这是一项命令！把 Kappa 安全箱带来，我就给你安排进去港口的路。
lines.textEn: That wasn’t a suggestion, kid, that was an order. Bring me the Kappa, and I’ll arrange for you to get through the Port.

lines.textCh: 现在滚吧，不想看到你。
lines.textEn: Now get out of my sight.

lines.textCh: 很好，那我就等你的好消息了，勇士。这次倒是不急。
lines.textEn: Great, I’m waiting then, warrior. No rush this time.

lines.textCh: 太棒了，就放在这吧。
lines.textEn: Great, hand it here.

lines.textCh: 很好，至少这一次你没有搞砸。办的不错，现在你可以前往港口了。
lines.textEn: Nice, at least you didn’t screw this one up. Good job. Now you can head to the Port.

lines.textCh: 那钥匙卡怎么办？
lines.textEn: What about the keycard?

lines.textCh: 我在港口有几个朋友，我打了几通电话就把事情安排好了。只需要我开一张路条就行了。等你动身时，我会给你的。
lines.textEn: My friends are there, I made a few calls, so everything’s arranged. You'll only need a note from me. I'll give it to you once you head out.

lines.textCh: 还有……祝你好运，孩子。希望你能成功出去。
lines.textEn: And… good luck, kid. Hope you actually make it out.

lines.textCh: 我可不是在和你讨价还价，小朋友，这是一项命令！把 Kappa 安全箱带来，我就给你安排进去港口的路。
lines.textEn: That wasn’t a suggestion, kid, that was an order. Bring me the Kappa, and I’ll arrange for you to get through the Port.

lines.textCh: 现在滚吧，不想看到你。
lines.textEn: Now get out of my sight.

lines.textCh: (离开)
lines.textEn: (Leave)

lines.textCh: 我在调查海岸线的一座地下设施，你肯定知道内情。能不能分享点关于“迷宫”的情报？
lines.textEn: I’m looking for a certain facility on the coast, you’ve got to know something about it. Can you share any info about the Labyrinth?

lines.textCh: 你知道任何与海岸线 TerraGroup 地下设施相关的情报吗？
lines.textEn: Do you know anything about a TerraGroup underground site on the coast?

lines.textCh: 你听说过任何和疗养院地下设施相关的事情吗？那个地方应该和 TerraGroup 有联系。
lines.textEn: Have you heard anything about an underground facility beneath the resort? It’s supposed to be connected to TerraGroup.

lines.textCh: 据说海岸线有一座 TerraGroup 地下秘密设施，你有相关的情报吗？
lines.textEn: Do you have any info about a TerraGroup underground site on Shoreline?

lines.textCh: 你听说过疗养院附近有 TerraGroup 秘密设施的事情吗？
lines.textEn: Have you heard about a secret TerraGroup facility somewhere near the resort?

lines.textCh: 我听说你之前手里有海岸线某座 TerraGroup 秘密设施的钥匙。
lines.textEn: I heard you used to have keys to some secret TerraGroup site at the coast.

lines.textCh: 来吧，给我几把钥匙。我已经把你的活给干完了！
lines.textEn: Come on, give me a couple. I’ve done good work!

lines.textCh: 所以他就这么把他的人丢下了？我可得提醒你，疗养院周围有不少雇佣兵在四处打探，总会有人想办法进去的。
lines.textEn: So he forgot about his guys? There are plenty of mercs around now, someone would’ve gone there.

lines.textCh: 你听说疗养院地下那个“迷宫”的事情了吗？有传言说那是个 TerraGroup 的秘密设施。
lines.textEn: Have you heard about the “Labyrinth” under the Health Resort? There are rumors there’s some kind of secret TerraGroup facility.

lines.textCh: 我觉得我知道你说的是什么。没错，之前我这儿的确有过疗养院地下某种设施的钥匙。
lines.textEn: I believe I understand what you are asking. Indeed, some time ago I had keys to a facility beneath the Health Resort.

lines.textCh: 能搞一把给我吗？
lines.textEn: Can I get one?

lines.textCh: 要是我这有多的话，我倒是会很乐意给你，但这些东西毕竟数量有限。
lines.textEn: I would gladly give one to you, but they are not unlimited.

lines.textCh: 老天啊，你这是在苦苦哀求要我施舍把钥匙给你？我还以为你不是那种人呢。
lines.textEn: Goodness, you are seriously begging for keys now? I had a better opinion of you.

lines.textCh: 我没有钥匙。而且我也没有时间和你磨磨蹭蹭，听你谈天说地胡扯自己对这个设施有多感兴趣。这件事我帮不了你。
lines.textEn: I do not have the keys. And I do not have time to dally with you and your interest in this facility either. I cannot help you with this.

lines.textCh: 我听说过那个地方。有个朋友提到过他的 BEAR 战友们突袭了这个“迷宫”。 早在契约战争那会。 一开始一切似乎都很正常。他们向总部报到之后就下到里面去了。然后，嘣，通讯全都没了。小队再也没有回来……
lines.textEn: Heard about it. A friend said his BEAR buddies stormed this Labyrinth. Back during the Contract Wars. Everything seemed fine at first. They reported in and went inside. Then poof, comms went dead. They never came back.

lines.textCh: 难道之后就没有再派人去过吗？
lines.textEn: So was nobody sent after them?

lines.textCh: 当时实在无人可派。局势一下子陷入了混乱…… 我的朋友一直都在尝试组织一支新的队伍下去打探情况，但一切都是徒劳。
lines.textEn: There wasn’t anyone to send at the time. Such chaos broke out… My friend tried to get a new team for this for a long time. All for nothing.

lines.textCh: 我必须得进去，但是我没法破开门锁。如果你的那个朋友能帮忙弄到钥匙，我会负责打探那些 BEAR 的下落。
lines.textEn: I need to get inside. But the door is locked with some special unobtainium key. If your “friend” helped, I could also look for the BEARs in there.

lines.textCh: 计划听起来不错。他的确也提到了钥匙……但想要联络他可是得花点时间，之后再来问吧。
lines.textEn: That’s a good plan. He mentioned the keys too… But contacting him takes time. Come back later.

lines.textCh: 把你的那些蠢问题留给自己吧！别满嘴喷粪指责我朋友了。那个地方可是相当要命，根本没人敢下去。 他光有钥匙没用，没人愿意冒险下去。
lines.textEn: You answer for yourself! Don’t blame my friend. The place is deadly, everyone’s afraid of it. My friend had the key, but no one took the job.

lines.textCh: 我想在 TerraGroup 设施里找点东西。如果你的那个“朋友”能帮我进去的话，我可以在里面打探那些 BEAR 的下落。
lines.textEn: I’m looking for something at TerraGroup facilities. If your “friend” helps me get inside, I can look for his BEARs in there.

lines.textCh: 嗯……要是你能活着离开那个地方的话，应该能有点用。我会去和我的朋友联系的，但要花点时间，之后再来吧。
lines.textEn: Hm, this would indeed help, if you manage to leave that place alive. I’ll try to contact my friend, but this will take some time. Come back later.

lines.textCh: 我失去了他的信任。
lines.textEn: I lost his favor.

lines.textCh: 我拿到箱子了。
lines.textEn: I have the case.

lines.textCh: 我拿到箱子了。
lines.textEn: I have the case.

lines.textCh: 很好，有那么一会我还以为你要把它交给 Prapor 了，看得出来你的确是个稳重的人。
lines.textEn: Good. For a second I thought you’d give in to Prapor. You held firm.

lines.textCh: 但我背叛了他，我没法再和他合作了！
lines.textEn: And now I can’t work with him like before!

lines.textCh: 他现在是气得发疯，但总归会冷静下来的。我来善后。
lines.textEn: He’ll stay angry for a bit then calm down. I’ll take care of it.

lines.textCh: 只是附带伤害罢了，我会帮你解决的。
lines.textEn: Just a side effect. I’ll sort it out.

lines.textCh: 像 Prapor 这种劣迹斑斑的地头蛇，只要抓住点小辫子，很容易就能让他改变想法。
lines.textEn: There will always be a ton of dirt on a man like Prapor that could change his mind.

lines.textCh: 我会联系你的。
lines.textEn: I will contact you.

lines.textCh: 我对这个“世界之眼”的神神叨叨的事情有点推进不下去了，帮我一把。
lines.textEn: I’m a bit stuck with this Eye of the World. I need help.

lines.textCh: 我从线人那里已经知道你的发现了。别担心，我可没在监视你，只是碰巧得到消息罢了。
lines.textEn: I heard from my contacts you found something. Don’t worry, I’m not spying on you.

lines.textCh: 我找到了一座损坏的通讯塔，邪教徒似乎在那里尝试和什么东西连上线，还找到了 KORD 14-4 站点的值班主管钥匙卡。
lines.textEn: I found a broken comms tower where the cultists tried to connect to something, and the senior shift key for the KORD 14-4 station.

lines.textCh: 确实是重大发现，可不能让机会白白溜走了。 如果你已经修好了那座通讯塔，拿到了主管钥匙卡的话，你就能潜入 KORD 14-4 站点，从里面提取出高价值数据了。
lines.textEn: Sounds like a big find. You can’t let this slip. If you’ve repaired the tower and got the senior shift key, you can infiltrate KORD 14-4 and extract highly valuable data.

lines.textCh: 我到底需要做什么？
lines.textEn: What exactly do I need to do?

lines.textCh: 拿上这个 U 盘，找到那个站点，用主管钥匙卡重新启动系统。
lines.textEn: Take this flash drive, find the station, reboot it using the senior shift key.

lines.textCh: 在此之后，帮我把终端里的代码下载下来。
lines.textEn: After that, download the code from the terminal for me.

lines.textCh: 我找到了那支 BEAR 小队。设施里的 TerraGroup 科学家死前在录音里坦白了一切。你朋友肯定不会听我一张嘴就相信下面发生的情况，所以你直接把这盘带子转交给他吧。
lines.textEn: I found your BEARs. One of the TerraGroup people recorded his confession before dying. Your friend’s not gonna believe just my words, so it’s best you give him this tape.

lines.textCh: “迷宫”的事情有进展了吗？你和你朋友联系过了没？
lines.textEn: So what’s the news on the Labyrinth? Did you contact your friend?

lines.textCh: 没错，他那里的确还有钥匙，他也很乐意分给你几把，但前提是你得查出那些 BEAR 到底怎么了。
lines.textEn: Yes. He has some keys and is willing to share if you find out what happened to the BEARs.

lines.textCh: 好，等我查到什么，我会回来找你的。
lines.textEn: Alright. I’ll return once I know something.

lines.textCh: 真是个烂摊子……不过你倒是干成了。我朋友送了点东西给你，算是谢礼。给。
lines.textEn: What a mess… Well, you did the job. My friend sent you something as a thank-you. Here.

lines.textCh: 我现在要去追杀掠夺者吗？
lines.textEn: Do I have to look for those Raiders now?

lines.textCh: 我需要搞个钥匙卡加密设备。
lines.textEn: I need a keycard encryption device.

lines.textCh: 他大概要多少钱？
lines.textEn: So how much will convince him?

lines.textCh: 我没找到那个加密设备。
lines.textEn: I can't find the encryption device.

lines.textCh: 没错，我听说你遇到阻碍了。我还以为最困难的部分是找到空白钥匙卡呢……
lines.textEn: Yeah, heard you are stuck. I thought finding a clean card would be the hardest…

lines.textCh: 估计是那些掠夺者干的。他们简直把实验室里刮得一干二净，搞不好把那个 RFID 钥匙卡加密设备也给顺走了。
lines.textEn: Probably the Raiders' doing. They stripped the laboratory clean, so maybe they took the encryptors as well.

lines.textCh: 下一步怎么办？
lines.textEn: So what’s the plan now?

lines.textCh: 肯定是找到那个加密设备重新写入卡片，去找掠夺者的麻烦没有意义了。
lines.textEn: Find the encryptor, obviously. No point chasing the Raiders.

lines.textCh: 没必要像个拾荒的一样追着那帮人，必须目光再放前一点。
lines.textEn: No point chasing them and picking through stashes. Gotta think ahead.

lines.textCh: 他们得手的东西立马就卖掉了，追查他们毫无意义。
lines.textEn: They probably sold everything they looted.

lines.textCh: 猜猜看整个塔科夫的科技产品都流向了谁？没错，Mechanic 嘛。
lines.textEn: And who deals most with tech around here? That’s right, Mechanic.

lines.textCh: 所以情况就很简单了——去找 Mechanic，和他做笔交易。
lines.textEn: Should be straightforward enough — just go to Mechanic and make a deal.

lines.textCh: 你拿那个设备干什么用我就不多问了。
lines.textEn: Not gonna ask why you need it.

lines.textCh: 总而言之，我能帮忙。但有个……问题。
lines.textEn: All in all, I can help. But there is… a problem.

lines.textCh: 我这没有现货，你也晓得，我不是开仓储店的。但我知道有个人可能会有这个设备。
lines.textEn: I do not have the device on me. Not my specialty, as you understand. But I know someone who does.

lines.textCh: 那我该怎么联系他们？
lines.textEn: How do I contact them?

lines.textCh: 你别管。我自己处理。你得等。一天左右吧。在这期间我会联系到他。
lines.textEn: You don’t. I’ll handle it myself. You’ll have to wait. A day, something like that. During that time I’ll reach him.

lines.textCh: 当然了，我只是替你做个中介，并不能保证 Elektronik 就愿意出让那个设备。
lines.textEn: And of course, you have to understand that I can’t guarantee Elektronik will agree.

lines.textCh: 我明白。
lines.textEn: I understand.

lines.textCh: 好的。等我收到回复后再告诉你。到时候你再来一趟就行。
lines.textEn: Good. I’ll let you know when I hear back. Stop by again then.

lines.textCh: 别着急。我不知道，也不会替别人开价。
lines.textEn: Don’t rush it. I don’t know, and I won’t speak for someone else.

lines.textCh: 我收到回复后会联系你。先去忙吧，你肯定还有别的事要处理。
lines.textEn: I’ll contact you once I get a reply. Go for now, I’m sure you have other things to do.

lines.textCh: 我该上哪去找钥匙？
lines.textEn: Where do I find the key?

lines.textCh: 我找到比特币了。
lines.textEn: I found the Bitcoins.

lines.textCh: 就这样？没别的了？
lines.textEn: That’s it? Nothing else?

lines.textCh: 没错，都办妥了。非常好。
lines.textEn: Yes, all set. Excellent.

lines.textCh: 那设备呢？
lines.textEn: What about the device?

lines.textCh: Elektronik 把设备留在了交货点，你必须进城去，找到那栋上锁的公寓。我一会把地址给你。
lines.textEn: Elektronik left it at the specific spot. You need to go into the city, find a specific apartment. The door is locked. I’ll give you the address.

lines.textCh: 拿货之前我还得翻遍城里的每件夹克才能搞到钥匙不成？
lines.textEn: So do I need to search random jackets and filing cabinets to find the key?

lines.textCh: 没那么麻烦，Elektronik 替你想好了，给，这是钥匙。
lines.textEn: Elektronik made it easier. Here’s the key.

lines.textCh: 我有，这就是。
lines.textEn: I have it. Here.

lines.textCh: 之后你可以把钥匙插在门上，或者扔了也行。
lines.textEn: Afterwards, you can leave it in the lock or toss it.

lines.textCh: 去拿那个设备吧，祝你好运，雇佣兵。
lines.textEn: Go get the device. Good luck, mercenary.

lines.textCh: 你查到关于那个设备的消息了吗？
lines.textEn: Did you find out anything about the device?

lines.textCh: 我和 Elektronik 接上头了，他愿意帮忙。
lines.textEn: I got in touch with Elektronik. He’s willing to help.

lines.textCh: 他要多少钱？
lines.textEn: What’s the price?

lines.textCh: 他只收比特币，不要别的。我得足额给他交过去才行。
lines.textEn: He’s only accepting Bitcoins, nothing less. I’ll send the exact amount.

lines.textCh: 行，我去弄来。
lines.textEn: Fine, I’ll get it.

lines.textCh: 我就告诉 Elektronik 你同意这笔生意了。
lines.textEn: I’ll tell Elektronik you accept the deal.

lines.textCh: 是，没别的了。想加班吗？我可是都记着呢。
lines.textEn: Yes, nothing else. Got the itch to work overtime? I’ll keep that in mind.

lines.textCh: 现在去吧。比特币可不是随随便便就能搞到的东西，你必须分秒必争才行。祝你好运，雇佣兵。
lines.textEn: Now go. Bitcoins aren't easy to come by, so don't waste a second. Good luck, mercenary.

lines.textCh: (离开)
lines.textEn: (Leave)

lines.textCh: 也就是说，是城市里面爆发的袭击？
lines.textEn: Could it have been an attack from inside the city?

lines.textCh: 你肯定知道为什么当地所有电子设备都瘫痪了。
lines.textEn: Surely you know why all the local electronics went down.

lines.textCh: 有意思。就算我确实知道背后的原因，也不过是一点点罢了。我没那个时间深入调查，但是有一点可以肯定——绝对某种武器造成的直接后果。
lines.textEn: Interesting. Let’s say I do. But only a little. Didn’t have time to investigate it properly. One thing’s certain — it’s the result of some weapon.

lines.textCh: 你觉得是有人对塔科夫发动了远程攻击？
lines.textEn: You think someone attacked Tarkov remotely?

lines.textCh: 不，我不这么认为。我之前查了查……大规模断电是从市中心辐射开去的。
lines.textEn: No, don’t think so. I did some research… The blackout wave spread from Tarkov's streets and the city center.

lines.textCh: 从我掌握的数据来看，应该就是这么个情况。有人在塔科夫市中心的什么地方引爆了那个武器。
lines.textEn: Judging by my data, that’s exactly what it was. The weapon detonated somewhere in Tarkov's downtown and the city center.

lines.textCh: 看得出来，你很想查出真相。我们可以互相帮助：我自己也想弄清楚那里究竟发生了什么。把残骸带给我，我看看能查出什么端倪。
lines.textEn: I see you want to find out more. We can help each other. I myself want to understand what exactly happened there. Bring me the debris, I’ll see what I can figure out.

lines.textCh: 我该从那里开始入手？
lines.textEn: Where should I look?

lines.textCh: 我本来想说从原爆点开始找起，但恐怕那些刮地皮的 Scav 和邪教怪胎们已经把原爆点的所有东西都拣了个干干净净。所以你大概要和他们打交道才能找到了。我猜邪教徒们大概已经把那个武器的碎片当作圣物供起来拜了。
lines.textEn: I’d love to say “at the blast site”, but I fear the Scavs and those cultist crazies have already looted everything. So you should try looking for it on them. I think the cultists have even started to worship these fragments.

lines.textCh: 你能弄清楚这是个什么设备吗？
lines.textEn: Can you figure out what this device is?

lines.textCh: 你知道这个碎片是从哪儿来的吗？
lines.textEn: Do you know where exactly this fragment came from?

lines.textCh: 我找到了碎片。(上交设备碎片)
lines.textEn: I found the debris. (Hand over the device fragment)

lines.textCh: 怎么样才能知道这是什么？
lines.textEn: How do I figure out what this is?

lines.textCh: 我找到了碎片。(上交设备碎片)
lines.textEn: I found the debris. (Hand over the device fragment)

lines.textCh: 嗯，上面的标识很有意思，从没见过这样的东西，看样子又是 TerraGroup 的杰作。
lines.textEn: Hm, interesting markings, never seen these before. Looks like TerraGroup’s work.

lines.textCh: 你真的打算单打独斗吗？光靠你自己大概是查不出什么的，但我可以帮忙。首先我得连上 TerraGroup 的本地网络。
lines.textEn: Alone? You probably can’t. But I can help. For this I need to connect to TerraGroup’s local network.

lines.textCh: 也许可以，但首先我得连上 TerraGroup 的本地网络。
lines.textEn: I can, but for this I’ll need to connect to TerraGroup’s local network.

lines.textCh: 去他们的实验室机房里放一个局域网入侵设备。给，这个应该能大大加快速度。
lines.textEn: Install a local network hack device on one of the servers in their lab. Here, this should speed things up.

lines.textCh: 不，但本地的数据库里可能还有那种东西。还记得你在实验室机房里放的那个入侵装置吗？
lines.textEn: No. But it can be in the local database. Remember when you connected my hacking device to the servers in the laboratory?

lines.textCh: 那个能管用吗？
lines.textEn: Can it help us?

lines.textCh: 如果还没坏的话，应该还是管用的。等你下次来见我的时候应该就有消息了。
lines.textEn: Yes, if it still works. I'll know for sure by the next time you visit.

lines.textCh: 我找到了碎片。(上交设备碎片)
lines.textEn: I found the debris. (Hand over the device fragment)

lines.textCh: 不知为何，我早料到会是这样。
lines.textEn: I expected nothing less, somehow.

lines.textCh: 成交。
lines.textEn: Deal.

lines.textCh: 想不想帮我找出那些引发爆炸的元凶？
lines.textEn: Wanna help me find those who caused the explosion?

lines.textCh: 在 TerraGroup 的局域网里有什么发现了吗？
lines.textEn: Did you find anything in TerraGroup’s local network?

lines.textCh: 可以说有，也没有。 TerraGroup 在撤离之前把所有东西都删掉了。我不得不深挖下去。
lines.textEn: Both yes and no. Before the evacuation, TerraGroup cleaned everything up. I had to dig a bit.

lines.textCh: 不过我的确找到了些东西。没错，文件并不完整，但是至少比什么都没有要强。
lines.textEn: But I did find something. Yes, this document is incomplete, but it’s better than nothing.

lines.textCh: 长话短说，这些是所谓的“#1156 项目”的部分技术规格文件， 这是一款革命性的电磁脉冲放大装置，是在俄国本地制造的。看样子他们在塔科夫引爆的就是这个东西。
lines.textEn: In short, this is a part of specification for a certain “Item 1156”. It’s an innovative electromagnetic supercharger, made here in Russia. Looks like it’s what caused the Tarkov explosion.

lines.textCh: 谁会对自己的祖国下手呢？！
lines.textEn: Who would attack their own country?!

lines.textCh: 你这直觉还真神奇，我都有些羡慕了。
lines.textEn: Makes me almost envy your instincts.

lines.textCh: 显然并不是所有人都这么想。
lines.textEn: Someone who clearly doesn’t like it.

lines.textCh: 顺便说一句，我有个提议。你找到的那个装置碎片…… 我觉得它还能派上用场。 我愿意出高价买下它。现金在塔科夫可比这么个东西有用多了。
lines.textEn: By the way, I have a proposition. That device fragment you found… I think I can find a use for it. I’m ready to pay you well. In Tarkov, money’s worth more than this scrap.

lines.textCh: 不，我想自己留着。
lines.textEn: No, the fragment stays with me.

lines.textCh: 也可以吧，我不强求。
lines.textEn: You call. I won’t insist.

lines.textCh: 太棒了，我已经提前准备好了钱。
lines.textEn: Excellent. I prepared the cash beforehand.

lines.textCh: 好吧，就这样。现在我真的帮不上什么忙了。
lines.textEn: Well, that’s it. Now I really can’t help you further.

lines.textCh: 我需要找出是爆炸的元凶到底是谁。
lines.textEn: I need to find who caused the explosion.

lines.textCh: 不，我觉得这是不可能的事情。
