lines.textEn: No. I don’t think that’s even possible.

lines.textCh: 恐怕办不到。大部分线索可能早就消失了。
lines.textEn: Doubt you’ll be able to. All traces are long gone, most likely.

lines.textCh: 说不定其他人知道情况呢？
lines.textEn: Could somebody else know something?

lines.textCh: Prapor 也许了解一二。但我很怀疑他会不会承认，祝你调查好运吧，雇佣兵。
lines.textEn: Prapor, perhaps. But I doubt he’d admit it. Good luck in your investigation, mercenary.

lines.textCh: 就是这些了。
lines.textEn: That's all for now.

lines.textCh: 那艘叫 Boreas 的船上还有一个科学家活下来了，我试过把他弄下船，但这家伙彻底疯了，真是活见鬼。这是录音，你自己听听看吧。(上交数字化版本的 Boreas 科学家录音带)
lines.textEn: There was a surviving scientist left aboard the “Boreas”. I tried to get him out, but the guy completely lost his fucking mind. Here, listen for yourself. (Hand over the digitalized Boreas scientist’s audio tape)

lines.textCh: 这份文件描述了“Boreas”号核动力破冰船的航线，也许能帮我们理清 TerraGroup 的设施分布情况。(上交数字化版本的 Boreas 水手日志)
lines.textEn: This describes the routes of the nuclear icebreaker “Boreas”. Might help us understand TerraGroup’s infrastructure better. (Hand over the digitalized Boreas sailor’s diary)

lines.textCh: 这份指示里提到了“Boreas”号破冰船，这艘船肯定和 TerraGroup 的行动有关系。(上交数字化版本的 Paradigm 航运指示)
lines.textEn: This directive mentions the icebreaker “Boreas”. It’s definitely connected to TerraGroup’s operations. (Hand over the digitalized Paradigm Shipping directive)

lines.textCh: 这份名单上的人有权访问 Boreas 号破冰船上的机密数据库。(上交数字化版本的 C-1 舱室访问报告)
lines.textEn: The people on this list had access to the secret archive aboard the icebreaker “Boreas”. (Hand over the digitalized Compartment C-1 access log)

lines.textCh: 看一看吧。(上交数字版本的 Vi-24 测试对象笔记)
lines.textEn: Have a read. (Hand over the digitalized assistant's notes on TG-Vi-24 test subjects)

lines.textCh: 给你，这应该对我们的共同目标有所帮助。(上交数字版本的 #3 & #10 测试对象笔记)
lines.textEn: Here you go, this should help our cause. (Hand over the digitalized assistant's notes on Group #3 and Group #10)

lines.textCh: 给。幸好他们把这种破玩意儿录下来了。(上交数字版本的 #8 测试对象笔记)
lines.textEn: Here. Good for us they recorded shit like this. (Hand over the digitalized assistant's notes on Group #8)

lines.textCh: 看看这个，足够让 TerraGroup 的高管坐牢了。(上交数字版本的 #3 测试对象笔记)
lines.textEn: Check this out. Enough to lock up some TerraGroup exec. (Hand over the digitalized assistant's notes on Group #3)

lines.textCh: 这可是第一手证据。(上交数字版本的 #12 测试对象笔记
lines.textEn: Here’s firsthand evidence. (Hand over the digitalized assistant's notes on Group #12)

lines.textCh: 这应该会让你非常感兴趣，我很确定。(上交数字版本的 Leshy 日记)
lines.textEn: This should be very interesting to you, I'm sure of it. (Hand over the digitalized Leshy's diary)

lines.textCh: 找到了这个。(上交数字版本的 Strelets 个人档案)
lines.textEn: Found this. (Hand over the digitalized Strelets' personal file)

lines.textCh: 有用的东西，给。(上交数字版本的 Taran 个人档案)
lines.textEn: Something useful, here. (Hand over the digitalized Taran's personal file)

lines.textCh: 某个 BEAR 好哥们的档案。(上交数字版本的 Voevoda 个人档案)
lines.textEn: Some info on the BEAR guy. (Hand over the digitalized Voevoda's personal file)

lines.textCh: 我敢肯定你能从这里面挖点料出来。(上交数字版本的 Moreman 个人档案)
lines.textEn: I'm sure you'll dig something out of this. (Hand over the digitalized Moreman's personal file)

lines.textCh: 现在在塔科夫居然还能找到这个(上交数字版本的情况报告录音带)
lines.textEn: Something like this somehow survived in Tarkov. (Hand over the digitalized audio tape with report)

lines.textCh: 虽然不是关于 TerraGroup 的，但是仍然有点价值。(上交数字版本的 Voevoda 人质解救报告)
lines.textEn: Not really about TerraGroup, but still. (Hand over the digitalized hostage evacuation report from Voevoda)

lines.textCh: 这些文件可能会对你有用。(上交数字版本的 Bogatyr 小队行动报告)
lines.textEn: These docs should be useful to you. (Hand over the digitalized Bogatyr squad operations report)

lines.textCh: 我花了好长时间一直在追查 TerraGroup 的情报，但一直没有进展。能不能给点提示？
lines.textEn: I’ve been hunting TerraGroup intel for ages, but it’s going nowhere. Can you give me a lead?

lines.textCh: 可能会有用。(上交数字版本的 FSB 报告)
lines.textEn: Found something useful. (Hand over the digitalized FSB report)

lines.textCh: 我找到了那个 ARRS 站点，甚至还替 Mechanic 下载了里面的数据。但看样子邪教徒同样连上了那个系统。
lines.textEn: I found the ARRS station and even downloaded the data for Mechanic. But it seems the cultists connected to the system as well.

lines.textCh: 我想办法挖出了一些 TerraGroup 和 Paradigm 航运之间关系的料。
lines.textEn: I managed to learn more about TerraGroup’s ties to Paradigm Shipping.

lines.textCh: 从亲爱的 Reshala 那拿来的 (上交数字版本的 Reshala 窝棚里的信')
lines.textEn: Took this note from dear Reshala. (Hand over the digitalized letter from Reshala's bunkhouse)

lines.textCh: 看来我们原本能从 Lightkeeper 那里搞到更重要的情报，但他把我拒之门外了，我们现在已经不再合作了。
lines.textEn: It seems we could’ve gotten important intel through Lightkeeper. But I’m cut off and can’t work with him anymore.

lines.textCh: 我从 TerraGroup 高管的保险箱里找到了这些。发过去了，仔细看看吧。(上交数字版本的与 A 女士的谈话记录)
lines.textEn: This was sitting in a TerraGroup executive’s safe. Sending it over, take a closer look. (Hand over digitized transcript of conversation with Ms. A.)

lines.textCh: 给。(上交数字版本的科兹洛夫房间里的信)
lines.textEn: Here. (Hand over the digitalized letter from Kozlov's room)

lines.textCh: 我挖到了关于”蓝冰“的消息。这并不是他们向世界所宣称的燃油催化剂那么简单。
lines.textEn: I found info on Blue Ice. It isn’t the fuel catalyst they made the world believe it to be.

lines.textCh: 可能就是你要找的东西。(上交数字版本的邮箱里的信)
lines.textEn: You were looking for something like this. Should work fine. (Hand over the digitalized letter from the mailbox)

lines.textCh: 我得到了 TerraGroup 在一处附属设施进行残忍活体实验的关键证据。
lines.textEn: I’ve got evidence of savage illegal experiments at one of TerraGroup's facilities.

lines.textCh: 这条消息可能会引发轰动。(上交数字版本的邪教受害者录音带 #2)
lines.textEn: This info could be a bombshell. (Hand over the digitalized cult victim audio tape #2)

lines.textCh: 我挖到了些大货，是关于“无名者”的。
lines.textEn: I found something big. It's about The Unheard.

lines.textCh: 这肯定会引发骚动。(上交数字版本的邪教受害者录音带 #1)
lines.textEn: This will definitely stir things up. (Hand over the digitalized cult victim audio tape #1)

lines.textCh: 我挖到了关于 TerraGroup 的大料。
lines.textEn: I found some big evidence on TerraGroup.

lines.textCh: 经济部副部长什库连科曾试图和本地的犯罪帮派达成交易。
lines.textEn: Deputy Minister Shkurenko attempted to strike a deal with the local crime group.

lines.textCh: 给，我发现了这张纸条。虽然短，却能拼凑事情的全貌。 (上交数字版本的降临仪式的准备笔记)
lines.textEn: Here, I found this note. It's not much, but helps build a bigger picture. (Hand over the digitalized note on preparations for the Arrival)

lines.textCh: TerraGroup 在城市上空引爆了实验型号的电磁脉冲武器。
lines.textEn: An experimental electromagnetic weapon from TerraGroup was used over the city.

lines.textCh: 看看这个，媒体会感兴趣的。(上交数字版本的降临之书)
lines.textEn: Check this out. This should interest the press. (Hand over the digitalized Book of the Arrival)

lines.textCh: TerraGroup 有一座巨大的监视网络。
lines.textEn: TerraGroup had a massive surveillance system.

lines.textCh: 找到了奇怪的文件，看看吧。(上交数字版本的提到某种协议的文件)
lines.textEn: Found some sus documents, take a look. (Hand over the digitalized document mentioning a protocol)

lines.textCh: TerraGroup 里面到处都是“无名者”安插的间谍。
lines.textEn: TerraGroup is full of The Unheard agents.

lines.textCh: 现在就这样吧。
lines.textEn: That's it for now.

lines.textCh: 给，找到了这个 (上交数字版本的向 TerraGroup 全球总部提交报告的副本)
lines.textEn: Here, found this. (Hand over the digitalized copy of report for TG Worldwide)

lines.textCh: 我在执行任务的时候找到了这个 (上交数字版本的写有笔记的货运清单)
lines.textEn: Found this while on a mission. (Hand over the digitalized transport log with notes)

lines.textCh: 也许你至少知道 TerraGroup 某些主要承包商或者合作伙伴的消息？
lines.textEn: Maybe you at least know some major TerraGroup contractors or business partners?

lines.textCh: 我想办法挖出了一些 TerraGroup 和 Paradigm 航运之间关系的料。
lines.textEn: I managed to learn more about TerraGroup’s ties to Paradigm Shipping.

lines.textCh: 我从 TerraGroup 高管的保险箱里找到了这些。发过去了，仔细看看吧。(上交数字版本的与 A 女士的谈话记录)
lines.textEn: This was sitting in a TerraGroup executive’s safe. Sending it over, take a closer look. (Hand over digitized transcript of conversation with Ms. A.)

lines.textCh: 这个应该有用 (上交数字版本的硬盘恢复内容)
lines.textEn: This should definitely work. (Hand over the digitalized hard drive printout)

lines.textCh: 城市最近有没有发生奇怪的现象？在塔科夫这里，如果事出反常，那么十有八九和 TerraGroup 有关系。
lines.textEn: Maybe something unusual has been happening in the city? Knowing how things work in Tarkov… there’s bound to be a trace of TerraGroup here.

lines.textCh: 我挖到了关于”蓝冰“的消息。这并不是他们向世界所宣称的燃油催化剂那么简单。
lines.textEn: I found info on Blue Ice. It isn’t the fuel catalyst they made the world believe it to be.

lines.textCh: 我找到了这个 (上交数字版本的货运传真)
lines.textEn: I found this. (Hand over the digitalized cargo transport fax)

lines.textCh: 像 TerraGroup 这样的巨头，肯定少不了媒体刺探动向，说不定有记者已经开展行动揭露了部分事实？
lines.textEn: Companies as big as TerraGroup tend to attract plenty of press. Maybe some journalist has tried to uncover something?

lines.textCh: 我得到了 TerraGroup 在一处附属设施进行残忍活体实验的关键证据。
lines.textEn: I’ve got evidence of savage illegal experiments at one of TerraGroup's facilities.

lines.textCh: 证据都在这盘带子里，听听看吧 (上交数字版本的 A.P. 会议录音带 - 2)
lines.textEn: The evidence is on this tape. Take a listen. (Hand over the digitalized A.P. meeting audio tape Part 2)

lines.textCh: 我相当确定 TerraGroup 在塔科夫还有其他的秘密设施。我已经找到了秘密实验室的情况，说不定还有其他设施？
lines.textEn: I'm sure TerraGroup had some secret facilities in Tarkov. I know about the hidden labs. Perhaps some other sites existed too?

lines.textCh: 我挖到了些大货，是关于“无名者”的。
lines.textEn: I found something big. It's about The Unheard.

lines.textCh: 我已尽可能地提供了所有材料，就算集团再有能耐，这些东西也足以毁掉他们的信誉。
lines.textEn: I sent everything I could. This dirt will destroy any reputation.

lines.textCh: 听听这个。(上交数字版本的 A.P. 会议录音带 - 1)
lines.textEn: Listen to this. (Hand over the digitalized A.P. meeting audio tape Part 1)

lines.textCh: 要是你能查出谈话人的具体身份，这份材料就更有用了。不过，我会想办法让这份记录派上用场的。
lines.textEn: It would’ve been better if you’d identified exactly who was speaking. Still, I’ll try to find a use for this transcript.

lines.textCh: 也许你知道其他 PMC 的行动情报？我们从没得到过其他部队的任何消息，就算在通讯瘫痪前也是各自为战的。
lines.textEn: Perhaps you have intel on PMC operations? We never got info on other units, even before the comms went dead.

lines.textCh: 经济部副部长什库连科曾试图和本地的犯罪帮派达成交易。
lines.textEn: Deputy Minister Shkurenko attempted to strike a deal with the local crime group.

lines.textCh: 这对我们的确有点用，但还不够多。
lines.textEn: This will help our cause. But I still need more.

lines.textCh: 我找到了 TerraGroup 的一些材料。你肯定会感兴趣的。
lines.textEn: I've found some information about TerraGroup. You'll find it interesting.

lines.textCh: 我挖到了这个。 (上交数字版本的更新企业协作流程的文件指示)
lines.textEn: I've dug up this. (Hand over the digitalized document on changes in enterprise interactions)

lines.textCh: 或许我该问问当地人？他们大概知道些情况。
lines.textEn: Maybe I should ask the locals? They probably know something.

lines.textCh: TerraGroup 在城市上空引爆了实验型号的电磁脉冲武器。
lines.textEn: An experimental electromagnetic weapon from TerraGroup was used over the city.

lines.textCh: 干得不错。但别忘了继续寻找更重要的东西。
lines.textEn: Good job. But don't forget to keep looking for bigger stuff.

lines.textCh: 我以为我给你的 TerraGroup 黑料已经足够多了。
lines.textEn: I think I gave you enough dirt on TerraGroup.

lines.textCh: 应该能有点价值 (上交数字版本的诺文斯克地区政府设施情报)
lines.textEn: This should be interesting. (Hand over the digitalized intelligence on Norvinsk region facilities)

lines.textCh: 我会让这个派上用场的。
lines.textEn: I'll put this to work.

lines.textCh: 关于塔科夫的传言满天飞……但我总不能去追查每个篝火旁的传说吧？
lines.textEn: Lots of rumors about Tarkov were floating around… But I can’t chase down every campfire tale, can I?

lines.textCh: 我不干了，又不是只有你能把我弄出塔科夫。再见！
lines.textEn: I’m out. You’re not the only one who can pull me outta Tarkov. Farewell!

lines.textCh: TerraGroup 有一座巨大的监视网络。
lines.textEn: TerraGroup had a massive surveillance system.

lines.textCh: 我找到了 TerraGroup 在本地的违法证据，这些料够吗？
lines.textEn: I found the evidence of TerraGroup's misdeeds. Will this be enough?

lines.textCh: 我找不到其余的东西了。
lines.textEn: I can’t find the rest.

lines.textCh: 那我们来谈谈报酬吧。
lines.textEn: Let’s talk reward then.

lines.textCh: 不坏，但你得再多挖点东西出来才行。
lines.textEn: Not bad, but I need more.

lines.textCh: 这是我找到的东西 (上交数字版本的 TerraGroup 全球总部的直接命令)
lines.textEn: Here's what I found. (Hand over the digitalized order from TerraGroup Worldwide headquarters)

lines.textCh: 或许我应该瞄准高管们？或是更高层的人士……有什么办法能做到？
lines.textEn: Perhaps I should aim for the executives? Or someone even higher… Any idea how to do that?

lines.textCh: 好吧，我会继续调查的。
lines.textEn: Okay, I’ll search more.

lines.textCh: 再给我一次机会吧，我会再挖出些东西来的，我有那个预感！
lines.textEn: I need another chance. I know I can still find something else!

lines.textCh: 这是你的第二次机会。但不要以为我会一直忍气吞声，让你用这种根本算不上成效的东西糊弄我。给我回去继续搜遍整个城市，等你找到有价值的线索再回来见我。
lines.textEn: This is your second chance. But don’t expect me to keep accepting results like this. Get back to searching and come see me when you’ve found something worthwhile.

lines.textCh: 我要纠正这一切，彻底扳倒 TerraGroup，不惜一切代价。
lines.textEn: I want to make this right and bring TerraGroup down. One way or another.

lines.textCh: 希望你能明白这其中的利害关系。塔科夫肯定还留存着不少宝贵的证据，但要是你继续犯浑搞砸事情，就别指望我继续在你身上下注了。
lines.textEn: I hope you understand what’s at stake here. There’s definitely still valuable evidence somewhere in Tarkov, but I’m not going to keep betting on you if you continue screwing everything up.

lines.textCh: TerraGroup 里面到处都是“无名者”安插的间谍。
lines.textEn: TerraGroup is full of The Unheard agents.

lines.textCh: 看看这个吧。(上交数字化的机组通话记录)
lines.textEn: Take a look at this. (Hand over the digitalized plane crew transcript)

lines.textCh: 够什么？
lines.textEn: Enough for whom?

lines.textCh: 对你来说够吗？
lines.textEn: For you.

lines.textCh: 你找到的不过是些边角料而已。发出去之后也许能制造些波澜，但说到底仍然不足以动摇集团的根基。你必须得找点猛料才行。
lines.textEn: The pieces you have are not enough. Yes, a publication of these will cause a stir, but it will be too small. I need more.

lines.textCh: 你花的时间也太久了。
lines.textEn: It’s taking too long.

lines.textCh: 你是不是开始喜欢上了这里，不想离开塔科夫了？
lines.textEn: Is Tarkov so great you reconsidered leaving?

lines.textCh: 不，你明明可以。你就是不想去查罢了。
lines.textEn: Yes you can. You just do not want to.

lines.textCh: 我告诉过你，你找到的证据将决定 TerraGroup 是否会为他们在塔科夫的所作所为付出代价。 原以为我们心意相通，为共同目标而努力。让全人类摆脱 TerraGroup 的阴影，迎来更好的未来。
lines.textEn: I told you these docs determine whether TerraGroup pays for what they did in Tarkov. I thought we were on the same page, working for the same goal. Wanting only the best for all of humanity.

lines.textCh: 可现在情况是：你想逃避，逃离责任。你究竟在指望什么？
lines.textEn: But here we are: you want out, to walk away from your responsibilities. What are you hoping for?

lines.textCh: 好，随便。我的答案是不行，我需要更多证据。否则我就不帮你了。很简单。
lines.textEn: Fine, whatever. My answer is no, I need more evidence. Otherwise I will stop helping you. Simple.

lines.textCh: 好吧，我会继续调查的。
lines.textEn: Okay, I’ll search more.

lines.textCh: 很高兴你终于有点觉悟了，可惜谈话的时间都浪费了。
lines.textEn: Good to hear. Bad that we had this conversation.

lines.textCh: 下了。
lines.textEn: Out.

lines.textCh: 我对你寄予厚望，可是你还是决定把所有东西都搞砸了，好吧，这是你自己选的。这辈子就烂在塔科夫吧。
lines.textEn: You were promising. But still decided to fuck it all up. Well, that’s your call. Stay in Tarkov then.

lines.textCh: 你为什么会这样想？你之前发来的所有材料不过是最微不足道的表面文章。
lines.textEn: Why do you think that? Everything you brought before is small stuff.

lines.textCh: 我要的是决定性证据，能直接扳倒整个 TerraGroup 的那种！
lines.textEn: I need something that will truly sink TerraGroup.

lines.textCh: 我实在不知道还能去哪里找了。
lines.textEn: I have no idea where else to look.

lines.textCh: 我告诉过你，有问题尽管问。我会尽力指明方向。
lines.textEn: I told you, you could ask me. I will try to point you in the right direction.

lines.textCh: 我要的是 TerraGroup 所犯下的一切罪行。全部、所有——明白了吗？现在这点根本不够，继续挖。
lines.textEn: I need all the dirt on TerraGroup. Everything. What you gave is not enough. Keep digging.

lines.textCh: 嗯，我看到了。干得漂亮。
lines.textEn: Yeah, I noticed. Excellent work.

lines.textCh: 那钥匙卡的事情呢？
lines.textEn: What about the keycard?

lines.textCh: 直奔主题啊？有点没礼貌，你觉得呢？
lines.textEn: Straight to business, huh? A little rude, don’t you think?

lines.textCh: 没错，你说得对。
lines.textEn: Yes, you’re right.

lines.textCh: 那张卡之前没用是因为卡上的哈希代码过期了。你需要写入新的代码才行。
lines.textEn: The card failed because its hash codes were old. You'll need new ones.

lines.textCh: 我会通过可靠联系人传递最新进展。他不知道具体情况，所以就别费神从他嘴里套话了。
lines.textEn: I will pass new ones through a trusted contact. He will not know the details. So do not waste time asking.

lines.textCh: 你好好等着，会有人联系你的。
lines.textEn: You wait. Someone will contact you.

lines.textCh: 虽然内容很少，却不无价值。
lines.textEn: Small, but not worthless.

lines.textCh: 也就是说你已经追查到“无名者”了？我以为你会花上更多时间才能发现他们的踪迹，但这样反而更好。继续说。
lines.textEn: So you're already on the trail of The Unheard. I thought it would take you much longer. But that's even better this way. Keep going.

lines.textCh: 又找到了另一项 TerraGroup 项目的内情，当然，是保密的那种。需要向整个世界公之于众。
lines.textEn: Another spec on another TerraGroup project. A secret project, of course. The world needs to know this.

lines.textCh: 你知道吗？在古代宗教中，蓝色常象征死亡。或许正因如此，人们才称其为“蓝焰”。 无论如何，媒体都会蜂拥而至，等着曝光 TerraGroup 背着大家都搞了什么见不得人的勾当。
lines.textEn: Did you know that in ancient religions the color blue often symbolized death? Maybe that is why they called it the Blue Fire. In any case, the press will be thrilled to learn what TerraGroup was doing behind everyone’s back.

lines.textCh: 我对官员与犯罪集团勾结并不感到意外。不确定真正的幕后金主是谁，但现在这已无关紧要。 公众将会了解到，这一切都是精心策划过的，肯定会引起极大反响。
lines.textEn: I am not surprised an official worked with a criminal authority. Not sure who the real client is, but that does not matter now. The public will be interested to learn that all this was planned.

lines.textCh: “无名者”的势力盘根错节，深入到各个方面。如果我们泄露这些文件，民众必将陷入混乱，但这正合我们的心意——直接打乱他们的所有计划。
lines.textEn: The Unheard have dug in deep. There’ll be chaos among the people when I leak these files, but that’s working in our favor. It will scramble all their plans.

lines.textCh: 我确实一直怀疑 TerraGroup 在贩卖人口，但没想到规模会这么大…… 他们很可能直接贿赂官员让失踪人员案件匆匆结案。全世界必须知道这些勾当。
lines.textEn: I suspected TerraGroup trafficked people, but on such a scale… They likely paid officials to close missing person cases. The world must know.

lines.textCh: 你费尽心机，就为了能和他搭上线，结果却还是把一切搞砸了。我真没想到你这么有能耐。
lines.textEn: You’d have to try really damn hard to get that close to him and still screw it all up. Didn’t think you were capable of that.

lines.textCh: 准备好在封锁区里继续苟活吧。一切会炫彩夺目，但转瞬即逝。而且会痛苦不堪。
lines.textEn: Prepare for life inside the closed zone. It will be flashy but short. And painful.

lines.textCh: 看样子这只是冰山一角。(上交数字版本的提到“守望者”的文件)
lines.textEn: And looks like it's just a tip of the iceberg. (Hand over the digitalized document mentioning the Warden)

lines.textCh: 邪教徒们尝试染指这个东西，但我没让他们得逞。(上交数字版本的 ARRS 系统规格)
lines.textEn: The cultists tried to get their hands on it, but I didn't let them. (Hand over the digitalized ARRS system specifications)

lines.textCh: 但我还是没能搞明白为什么。(上交数字版本的 #1156 项目技术规格)
lines.textEn: But I still don't get why. (Hand over the digitalized Item #1156 specification)

lines.textCh: 他们想要瓜分城市的控制权，虽然没有 TerraGroup 直接参与的迹象，但还是会有些价值。(上交数字版本的犯罪证据录音带)
lines.textEn: They wanted to split control of the city. There’s no trace of TerraGroup, but this could still be interesting. (Hand over the digitalized audio tape with incriminating evidence)

lines.textCh: 这份材料能够证明“无名者”的势力已经渗透进了多个国家的政府高层。(上交数字版本的间谍网络部署情况报告)
lines.textEn: This proves The Unheard have people inside government agencies across several nations. (Hand over the digitalized agent network deployment report)

lines.textCh: 这肯定能一举撕下 TerraGroup 的面纱。(上交数字版本的“迷宫”设施研发报告)
lines.textEn: This should definitely be enough to destroy TerraGroup. (Hand over the digitalized Labyrinth facility research report)

lines.textCh: 准确来说不止如此。但 TerraGroup 对其余部分保持沉默。看看吧。(上交数字版本的燃料催化剂测试报告)
lines.textEn: Not just that, to be precise. But TerraGroup kept quiet about the rest. Take a look. (Hand over the digitalized fuel catalyst test report)

lines.textCh: 我完全搞不懂那堆乱七八糟的东西。Mechanic 把闪存盘里的数据研究了个遍，但还是没能找出任何有用的东西。
lines.textEn: I couldn’t make sense of all that shit. Mechanic studied the data on the flash drive, but he didn’t find anything important on it.

lines.textCh: 没错，发表这些内容会引起局部轰动，但反响还是太小了。
lines.textEn: Yes, a publication of these will cause a stir, but it will be too small.

lines.textCh: 有什么具体的方面吗？
lines.textEn: Anything in particular?

lines.textCh: 还记得市中心上空的那场蓝色爆炸吗？我之前从没见过那种场面。新式武器？秘密计划？总得深挖看看吧。
lines.textEn: Remember that blue blast in the city center? I’ve never seen anything like it. New weapon? Secret project? Worth digging into.

lines.textCh: 我已经告诉过你“无名者”的事情了。我还以为你以及自己去调查他们了呢。在塔科夫找找他们的踪影。
lines.textEn: I already told you about The Unheard. I figured you’d stumble on them yourself by now. Look for their traces in Tarkov.

lines.textCh: 听说过邪教徒的事吗？去调查他们。他们可不是凭空出现在塔科夫的。
lines.textEn: Heard anything about the cultists? Investigate them. They did not just appear out of nowhere in Tarkov.

lines.textCh: 我听说本地有个人试图向调查记者爆料，结果之后就失踪了。查查这事，说不定正是我们需要的线索。
lines.textEn: I heard a local went missing after trying to leak something to journalists. Check it out. Could be what we need.

lines.textCh: 打听打听其他被派到塔科夫的 PMC 的消息。他们可能遇到了什么大麻烦。
lines.textEn: Look into PMCs sent to Tarkov just like you. They may have already run into something serious here.

lines.textCh: 最近有人在疗养院的地下层里发现了一整个秘密设施，整个塔科夫都被惊动了。最好去去那个地方调查一下。
lines.textEn: The whole Tarkov shook recently when someone found a secret facility under the health resort. It ties back to TerraGroup. You better look into that carefully.

lines.textCh: 之前有一位享誉世界的战地记者，叫米哈伊尔·沃兹涅先斯基的。这人甚至直接写了一篇报道直击 TerraGroup。结果后来发现这位居然是个女记者，看看能不能找出她的更多消息。
lines.textEn: There was a world-class journalist, war correspondent Mikhail Voznesensky. Wrote even about TerraGroup. Then, it turned out it was not he, but she. Search for info on her.

lines.textCh: 连我都听说过外头有个疯子在夜里四处杀人，还给受害者套上死猪头的传闻。你试试去查清楚这事。
lines.textEn: Even I heard the rumor about some maniac killing at night and leaving real pig heads. Try to sort that out.

lines.textCh: 那你补救了吗？嗯？
lines.textEn: Did you fix it?

lines.textCh: (离开)
lines.textEn: (Leave)

lines.textCh: 集团旗下有不少子公司。但就在几年前，他们突然收购了一家大型航运公司。在我看来，那些集装箱里装的可不只是合法货物。试着往这个方向查一查吧。
lines.textEn: They’ve got plenty of subsidiaries. But a few years ago they bought out a major shipping company. I doubt those cargo containers were hauling only legal freight. That’s the direction you should dig in.

lines.textCh: 你都查到了什么？
lines.textEn: What did you find?

lines.textCh: 他们正在谋划，准备让开罗和东京再次上演塔科夫的混乱局面。这一切都是更大规模计划的预演。(上交破解闪存盘中提取的数据)
lines.textEn: They’re planning to repeat the Tarkov scenario in Cairo and Tokyo. It’s all part of some large-scale protocol. (Hand over the data from the decrypted hard drives)

lines.textCh: 的确算得上猛料，还有别的发现吗？
lines.textEn: That’s serious. Anything else?

lines.textCh: TerraGroup 组建了自己的全球卫星网络，可以随意拦截各国的通讯，甚至能引发大规模通信瘫痪。
lines.textEn: TerraGroup has its own global satellite network. It can intercept communications and even trigger blackouts.

lines.textCh: 我早料到是这样，但我一度心存侥幸，认为自己可能高估了 TerraGroup 的势力。我必须得亲自验证这里面的说法。
lines.textEn: I suspected as much, but I was hoping I’d overestimated TerraGroup’s capabilities. I’ll have to verify all of this myself.

lines.textCh: 再给我一次机会吧。我必须逃出塔科夫这个鬼地方！
lines.textEn: Give me one more chance. I need to get the hell out of Tarkov!

lines.textCh: 希望你能明白这其中的利害关系。塔科夫肯定还留存着不少宝贵的证据，但要是你继续犯浑搞砸事情，就别指望我继续在你身上下注了。
lines.textEn: I hope you understand what’s at stake here. There’s definitely still valuable evidence somewhere in Tarkov, but I’m not going to keep betting on you if you continue screwing everything up.

lines.textCh: 你认真的吗？ARRS 站点的事情已经够扯的了吧，之后我又给了你一次机会，现在你居然腆着脸让我再饶你一回？
lines.textEn: You serious? You already fucked up with the ARRS terminal and got your second chance, and now you’re asking for another one?

lines.textCh: 虽然我不是什么赛马好手，但傻子也能看出来，你已经废了。我不想继续在没用的废物身上下注了，你已经用自己的表现亲身证明了这一点。
lines.textEn: I’m not stupid enough to bet on a lame horse. You’ve already proven you can’t do your job professionally, which means you’re no longer useful to me.

lines.textCh: 我可以补救。
lines.textEn: I can still fix this.

lines.textCh: 不，你什么也补救不了。我告诉过你，TerraGroup 是否会为塔科夫发生的一切付出代价，集团能否得到正义审判，全指望这份证据的调查结果。但你还是不懂这件事的严重性——或者干脆从一开始就没明白过！
lines.textEn: No, you can’t fix anything. I told you that this evidence determines whether TerraGroup will answer for what happened in Tarkov. But you still don’t understand how important that really is.

lines.textCh: 完毕。
lines.textEn: Out.

lines.textCh: 那你又在指望什么呢，傻白甜？要是那帮邪教徒连进过系统，那他们早就把剩下所有还有价值的东西都删光了。我还以为你没那么蠢呢。
lines.textEn: And what exactly were you expecting? If the cultists got into the system, they could’ve wiped every piece of valuable data. I expected better from you.

lines.textCh: 我可以为你找些其他证据来。
lines.textEn: I can still find other evidence for you.

lines.textCh: 你真的是这么想的？你真的还以为都到这会了，我还会相信你这个没脑子的做出的任何判断？
lines.textEn: You really believe that? You seriously think I trust your judgment at this point?

lines.textCh: 我不会再搞砸了，再给一次机会让我证明自己吧。
lines.textEn: No more screwups from me. Just give me the chance.

lines.textCh: 我不觉得你这套说辞能打动谁。你已经和塔科夫本地至少一位头面人物断绝了往来，然后现在你又搞砸了 ARRS 站点的事情，到我这哭丧着脸说“搞不懂那堆乱七八糟的东西”。
lines.textEn: Don’t think words are enough to convince me. You already lost access to one of the key people in Tarkov, and now you “couldn’t figure out that shit” at the ARRS terminal.

lines.textCh: 这是你的第二次机会。但不要以为我会一直忍气吞声，让你用这种根本算不上成效的东西糊弄我。给我回去继续搜遍整个城市，等你找到有价值的线索再回来见我。
lines.textEn: This is your second chance. But don’t expect me to keep accepting results like this. Get back to searching and come see me when you’ve found something worthwhile.

lines.textCh: 我能拿到 Kerman 给你的那个东西了吗？
lines.textEn: Can I finally get what Mr. Kerman sent you?

lines.textCh: 我是为了 Kerman 送给你的东西才来的。
lines.textEn: I’m here about the thing Mr. Kerman sent you.

lines.textCh: 我是为了 Kerman 送给你的东西才来的。
lines.textEn: I’m here about what Mr. Kerman sent you.

lines.textCh: 什么任务？
lines.textEn: What task?

lines.textCh: 我是为了 Kerman 送给你的东西才来的。
lines.textEn: I’m here about the thing Mr. Kerman sent you.

lines.textCh: 我听说 Kerman 送了一件东西到你这里。
lines.textEn: I’m here about the thing Mr. Kerman sent you.

lines.textCh: 收到那封信之后你居然还有胆子来这里。佩服。
lines.textEn: You had the guts to come here after getting that letter. Respect.

lines.textCh: 有位我们共同的朋友托我给你送来点东西。
lines.textEn: I've got something for you from our mutual acquaintance.

lines.textCh: 我能拿吗？
lines.textEn: Can I take it?

lines.textCh: 慢着，你这副德性实在不可靠。想想看，我怎么可能跟一个没法信任的人做生意？
lines.textEn: Hold your horses. Your mug looks too untrustworthy. Think about it: how can I do business with someone I can’t trust?

lines.textCh: 那你想要什么？钱？
lines.textEn: So what do you want? Money?

lines.textCh: 要是我真有那么天真每次都能用钱摆平，我早就人间蒸发了。
lines.textEn: If it were that simple, I wouldn’t be standing here.

lines.textCh: 你本来就该直接给我的。
lines.textEn: You were supposed to just give it to me.

lines.textCh: 那又怎样？在我看来这依然像是在做生意。
lines.textEn: So what? This still sounds like business to me.

lines.textCh: 我需要更了解你。建立起足够的信任，只有这样我们才能谈正事。
lines.textEn: I need to know you better. Have trust in you. Only then can we talk business.

lines.textCh: 我可没有时间陪你继续耗！
lines.textEn: I don’t have time for this!

lines.textCh: 少耍小孩脾气！我的决心已定。要么按我的规矩乖乖办事，要么滚蛋。
lines.textEn: Cut the tantrum! My decision stands. Either you play by my rules, or you get the fuck out.

lines.textCh: 谈话结束了，门在那边，自己滚吧。
lines.textEn: Talk’s over. Door’s that way.

lines.textCh: 你的动作还真快啊，呵。
lines.textEn: You sure arrived quick, heh.

lines.textCh: 我们共同的朋友有东西要给你，但我可不打算就这么拱手让人。
lines.textEn: I’ve got something from our mutual acquaintance. But I can’t just hand it over.

lines.textCh: 为什么？
lines.textEn: Why?

lines.textCh: 因为这就是塔科夫，整座城市没有什么是不付出代价的。
lines.textEn: Because nothing in Tarkov comes easy.

lines.textCh: 这到底搞什么鬼？把东西给我！
lines.textEn: What the hell is this? Just give me the thing!

lines.textCh: 注意你的态度！要是继续这么急躁，你最后只会什么都拿不到。
lines.textEn: Watch the attitude! Keep talking like that and you’ll get nothing.

lines.textCh: 你替我办件事，就能拿到报酬。别搞什么花样，听明白了吗？还有，别碰我的弟兄们——敢动他们一根毫毛，你都得付出代价。清楚了吗？
lines.textEn: You’ll do a job for me, and you’ll get your prize. No funny business, got it? And don’t touch my guys — you’ll pay for each one of them. We clear?

lines.textCh: 告诉我到底是什么差事。
lines.textEn: Tell me about the job.

lines.textCh: 我会把所有细节都发给你，别担心。这样你就能清楚地列出自己的目标。就这样，剩下的自己琢磨吧。快去吧，你的奖励可是在等着你呢。
lines.textEn: I’ll send you all the details, relax. So that you have a clear list of your objectives. That’s it, figure out the rest yourself. Go on, your prize is waiting.

lines.textCh: 啊，是你啊，我听说你最近办成的事情了。干得还不错。
lines.textEn: Ah, you again. Heard about your recent work. Well done.

lines.textCh: 我们终于可以谈谈那个东西了，它可是等了你好久。
lines.textEn: We can finally talk about the item that’s been waiting for you.

lines.textCh: 你这语气前后差别也太大了……
lines.textEn: You sound different…

lines.textCh: 嗯，不妨说每个人都有两面。听我一句劝——你如果还想要我的信任，就不要说风凉话纠结这种事。
lines.textEn: Hm, let’s just say I’ve got split personalities. And take my advice — don’t dwell on things like that if you want to keep my trust.

lines.textCh: 总之，言归正传。你必须完成我给你的任务。
lines.textEn: Anyway, down to business. You have to complete my task.

lines.textCh: 当初谈条件的时候可没说过这个！
lines.textEn: That wasn’t part of the deal.

lines.textCh: 哪些条件是这个他妈的交易的一部分是我说了算！你没资格！
lines.textEn: You don’t get to decide what’s part of the damn deal and what’s not.

lines.textCh: 当然是对我有好处的事情，至于你也能得到点甜头。否则，你就准备和那个货说再见去吧。
lines.textEn: One that benefits me. And you, obviously. Otherwise, you’re not getting what you want.

lines.textCh: 首要条件——别碰那些 Scav。他们是我罩的。这事你应该已经心知肚明了，但重申一次总没错。
lines.textEn: Main condition — don’t touch the Scavs. They’re under my protection. You already know that, but repetition never hurts.

lines.textCh: 其他的部分呢。
lines.textEn: Tell me more about the job.

lines.textCh: 我会把所有细节都发给你，这样你就清楚知道到底该干什么了。
lines.textEn: I’ll send you all the details. So that you have a clear list of your objectives.

lines.textCh: 明白了？我会等着结果。最好快点。
lines.textEn: Got it? I’ll be waiting for the results. Preferably soon.

lines.textCh: 收到那封信后你居然还敢来这里。佩服。
lines.textEn: You had the guts to come here after getting that letter. Respect.

lines.textCh: 你的动作还真快啊，呵。
lines.textEn: You sure arrived quick, heh.

lines.textCh: (离开)
lines.textEn: (Leave)

lines.textCh: (保持沉默)
lines.textEn: (Stay silent)

lines.textCh: 我已经干完了我的活。
lines.textEn: I’ve done my part of the deal.

lines.textCh: 事情办完的消息已经传到我这了。
lines.textEn: I’ve already been told you handled the task.

lines.textCh: 那么我们总该谈谈奖励了吧。
lines.textEn: Then let’s talk about the reward.

lines.textCh: 没错，现在是可以谈了。
lines.textEn: Yeah, now we can.

lines.textCh: 给你，小子。别弄丢了，这小玩意儿可重要了，哈！早知道就多甩点活给你了，让你到处奔波奔波出出汗……
lines.textEn: Here you go, kid. Don’t lose it, this little thing’s important, ha! Probably should’ve given you more jobs first, make you sweat a bit…

lines.textCh: 不过，好了！现在你终于可以逃出这里了。
lines.textEn: But alright! Now you can finally escape.

lines.textCh: 你怎么知道它很重要的？
lines.textEn: How do you know?

lines.textCh: 我又不傻，小朋友。想逃离塔科夫的雇佣兵可不止你一个。但得当心你的那些战友们——要是船上没足够的座位，他们可不会介意反手一枪把你狗脑子轰出来。
lines.textEn: I’m not stupid, kid. You’re not the only one dreaming of getting out of Tarkov. Just make sure your buddies don’t blow your brains out if there aren’t enough seats on that boat.

lines.textCh: 放轻松，我知道你想拿那个 U 盘干什么。
lines.textEn: Relax. I know what you need that flash drive for.

lines.textCh: 每天都有那么多人试图逃离这座城市。其中许多人甚至为此不惜手足相残。但你知道吗？这帮蠢货是在白费力气。像塔科夫这样的荒野——可是充满了机会啊。
lines.textEn: A lot of people are trying to get out. And a lot are ready to kill for it. But you know what? They’re wasting their time. A place like Tarkov — it’s full of opportunities.

lines.textCh: 总之，你的 U 盘已经到手。去干你的正事吧，四脚着地连滚带爬地逃出这座城市。能为你做的也只有祝你好运了。
lines.textEn: Anyway, you’ve got your flash drive. Go do your thing, crawl out of this city. I can only wish you luck.

lines.textCh: (离开)
lines.textEn: (Leave)

lines.textCh: 弄到了装着数据的 U 盘。
lines.textEn: Got the flash drive with the data.

lines.textCh: 弄到了装着数据的 U 盘。
lines.textEn: Got the flash drive with the data.

lines.textCh: 我找到了所谓的“世界之眼”。
lines.textEn: I found the Eye of the World.

lines.textCh: U 盘还在那，我会想办法弄到它的。
lines.textEn: The flash drive is still there. I'll go get it.

lines.textCh: 我得到了“世界之眼”的消息。
lines.textEn: I have news about the Eye of the World.

lines.textCh: 听起来不坏，还有其他发现吗？
lines.textEn: Sounds promising. Found anything else?

lines.textCh: 我找到了所谓的“世界之眼”。
lines.textEn: I found the Eye of the World.

lines.textCh: 太棒了，恭喜。那我们之间的协议呢？
lines.textEn: Excellent, congratulations. What about our agreement?

lines.textCh: 这真是好消息，给我吧。
lines.textEn: That’s good news. Give it to me.

lines.textCh: 多谢了，雇佣兵。有空我会研究的。很高兴与你做生意。你真的是从没有让我失望过。
lines.textEn: Thanks, mercenary. I’ll study it when I have time. Pleasure doing business. Not that I expected anything less from you.

lines.textCh: (上交 U 盘)
lines.textEn: (Hand over the flash drive)

lines.textCh: 我可以等，但千万不要让我等上太久。
lines.textEn: I’ll wait then. But don’t drag it out.

lines.textCh: 我需要你帮忙，你知道怎么才能逃出塔科夫吗？
lines.textEn: I need your help. Do you know how to get out of Tarkov?

lines.textCh: 我需要你帮忙，你知道怎么才能逃出塔科夫吗？
lines.textEn: I need your help. Do you know how to get out of Tarkov?

lines.textCh: 我需要你帮忙，你知道怎么才能逃出塔科夫吗？
lines.textEn: I need your help. Do you know how to get out of Tarkov?

lines.textCh: 我需要你帮忙，你知道怎么才能逃出塔科夫吗？
lines.textEn: I need your help. Do you know how to get out of Tarkov?

lines.textCh: 我需要你帮忙，你知道怎么才能逃出塔科夫吗？
lines.textEn: I need your help. Do you know how to get out of Tarkov?

lines.textCh: 我需要你帮忙，你知道怎么才能逃出塔科夫吗？
lines.textEn: I need your help. Do you know how to get out of Tarkov?

lines.textCh: 我需要你帮忙，你知道怎么才能逃出塔科夫吗？
lines.textEn: I need your help. Do you know how to get out of Tarkov?

lines.textCh: 我把化武箱子带来了 (上交箱子)
lines.textEn: I've found the biological weapon. (Hand over the case)

lines.textCh: 剩下的我稍后再带过来。
lines.textEn: I'll get the rest later.

lines.textCh: 剩下的我等会就给你。
lines.textEn: I'll get the rest later.

lines.textCh: 我把钱带来了。(上交 1,000,000 美元)
lines.textEn: I brought the money. (Hand over 1,000,000 USD)

lines.textCh: TerraGroup 也参与进来了？！
lines.textEn: TerraGroup was into that too?!

lines.textCh: 这要花多长时间？
lines.textEn: How long will this take?

lines.textCh: 这就是我们谈好的全部东西了。
lines.textEn: That's all we agreed to.

lines.textCh: 这就是我们谈好的全部东西了。
lines.textEn: That's all we agreed to.

lines.textCh: 我想问你一些事情……
lines.textEn: I wanted to ask you something…

lines.textCh: 当然！没谁专门到我这来只是为了聊天的。
lines.textEn: Of course! No one comes to me just to chat.

lines.textCh: 好了，别摆出那副样子。我知道你为什么来。
lines.textEn: Alright, don’t frown. I know why you’re here.

lines.textCh: 我们的人在港口看见你了。他们看到你试着用那张过期钥匙卡把门骗开的蠢样差点没把头给笑掉了。
lines.textEn: My guys saw you at the Port. They laughed their asses off while you tried to open the door with your keycard.

lines.textCh: 我打听过了。你的门禁卡出了点问题，那个……呃，叫什么来着……哈希代码不对！你得换成最新的才行。
lines.textEn: I’ve asked around. Your keycard had something wrong with the, um… hash codes! You need new ones.

lines.textCh: 你知道哪里能搞到这种东西？
lines.textEn: Do you know where to find them?

lines.textCh: 当然知道，港口那边的同志们告诉我的！不过这一回别指望靠近大门了，岗哨不会留情了，见到人就开火。
lines.textEn: ‘Course I do. From our guys at the Port! But they’re not gonna let you get close again, they’ll just shoot on sight.

lines.textCh: 但我可以和他们做个交易……
lines.textEn: But I can make a deal with them.

lines.textCh: 要多少钱？
lines.textEn: How much?

lines.textCh: 帮我办个差事，咱们就两清了。我刚得到了一些新情报。
lines.textEn: One task, and we’re square. I just got some fresh intel.

lines.textCh: 某个自作聪明的 TerraGroup 科学家在混乱爆发前偷走了一个相当重要的公文包，里面装的可是生物武器。
lines.textEn: Some smartass TerraGroup scientist managed to steal an important briefcase before the mess started. With biological weapons inside.

lines.textCh: 生物武器？在塔科夫？
lines.textEn: Biological weapons in Tarkov?

lines.textCh: 没错，就是这样。
lines.textEn: Yup, exactly.

lines.textCh: 为什么不呢？我敢打赌他们干过的勾当里比这疯得多的事情多了去了。
lines.textEn: Why not? I bet they’ve done even crazier stuff.

lines.textCh: 人怎么样我不关心，但是我最起码得找到这个公文包。他们说这个科学家跑到储备基地的地堡里窝起来了。
lines.textEn: Bottom line, I need this briefcase. They say the scientist was holed up in a bunker at the Reserve base.

lines.textCh: 找到那个箱子，把东西带过来。还有别忘了钱。为了打听你那该死的门禁卡的情报可是花了我一大笔钱。
lines.textEn: Find it – bring it here. And don’t forget the money. Intel on your damn keycard cost a fuck ton of cash.

lines.textCh: 就这样，现在出发吧，战士。
lines.textEn: That’s it, go, warrior.

lines.textCh: 完美。现在我只需要把所有东西都交出去就行了。
lines.textEn: Perfect. Now I just need to hand it all over.

lines.textCh: 我还得等上多久？
lines.textEn: How much more do I wait?

lines.textCh: 别太贪心，新兵！我刚刚可是帮了你一个大忙！
lines.textEn: Don’t get greedy, rookie! I already did you a favor.

lines.textCh: 要再过几天，有消息我会联系你的。
lines.textEn: Take a couple of days off. I’ll contact you when there’s news.

lines.textCh: 放在这吧。
lines.textEn: Give it here.

lines.textCh: 我还弄来了那个箱子。(上交箱子)
lines.textEn: I've also found the biological weapon. (Hand over the case)

lines.textCh: 钱也在这里了。(上交 1,000,000 美元)
lines.textEn: I've also brought the money. (Hand over 1,000,000 USD)

lines.textCh: 非常好，现在我只要把东西都交出去就行了。
lines.textEn: Perfect. Now I just need to hand it all over.

lines.textCh: 放在这吧。
lines.textEn: Give it here.

lines.textCh: 快点行动，战士！在一切都准备好之前不要回来！
lines.textEn: Be quicker, warrior! Don't come back until everything's ready.

lines.textCh: 非常好，现在我只要把东西都交出去就行了。
lines.textEn: Perfect. Now I just need to hand it all over.

lines.textCh: (离开)
lines.textEn: (Leave)

lines.textCh: 我需要你的帮助。
lines.textEn: I need your help.

lines.textCh: 我需要你的帮助。
lines.textEn: I need your help.

lines.textCh: 我需要你的帮助。
lines.textEn: I need your help.

lines.textCh: 我需要你的帮助。
lines.textEn: I need your help.

lines.textCh: 我需要你的帮助。
lines.textEn: I need your help.

lines.textCh: 我需要你帮忙。
lines.textEn: I need your help.

lines.textCh: 我需要你的帮助。
lines.textEn: I need your help.

lines.textCh: 嗯。
lines.textEn: Yup.

lines.textCh: 我又得请你帮忙了。
lines.textEn: I need your help. Again.

lines.textCh: 哦，真的吗？我还真是意外啊。
lines.textEn: Oh really? I never would’ve guessed.

lines.textCh: 我不明白啊，新兵。你来我这是为了求我帮你的，可我根本没觉得你有半点尊重我的意思啊。
lines.textEn: I don’t get it, rookie. You come to me asking for help. But I don’t feel any respect.

lines.textCh: 你真觉得自己出去鬼混了几天，我就认不出你了？我们的旧债就消了？当初可是你先耍了我一道，现在又爬回来想当作无事发生？
lines.textEn: You think I’ll just forgive everything?! First you fuck me over, and now you crawl back.

lines.textCh: 是有几个大人物替你说了几句好话，可他妈的，事情哪是这么办的！
lines.textEn: Important people put in a good word for you, but damn it, that’s not how things are done!

lines.textCh: 也许我们可以商量出个办法？
lines.textEn: Maybe we can work something out?

lines.textCh: 你的胆子真的是越来越大了，新兵。我恨不得当场就毙了你。不过你倒还能派上用场。
lines.textEn: You’re betting bolder and bolder, rookie. Makes me want to shoot you on the spot. But you could still be useful.

lines.textCh: 好了，我会想办法给你找点活干的。但你最好给我认真了去做，明白没有？
lines.textEn: Alright, I’ll figure something out to keep you busy. But you better do it damn well, got it?

lines.textCh: 我会圆满完成的。
lines.textEn: I’ll do everything perfectly.

lines.textCh: 给我全力以赴，你不会有第二次机会。现在滚吧，到时候我通知你任务的内容。
lines.textEn: Try your best. No second chances. Now get lost. I’ll send you the tasks.

lines.textCh: 很好，现在滚吧。到时候你会知道任务是什么的。
lines.textEn: Good. Now get lost. I’ll send you the tasks.

lines.textCh: (离开)
lines.textEn: (Leave)

lines.textCh: 我需要你的帮助，你知道怎么才能离开塔科夫吗？
lines.textEn: I'm gonna need your help. Do you know how to leave Tarkov?

lines.textCh: 你的关系网这么广，知道离开塔科夫的办法吗？
lines.textEn: You’ve got plenty of connections. Know any way to get out of Tarkov?

lines.textCh: 也许你知道怎么才能离开塔科夫？
lines.textEn: Perhaps you know how to escape Tarkov?

lines.textCh: 不知道怎么出去了吗？当然，我说的是塔科夫。
lines.textEn: Don't know how to get out? From Tarkov, I mean.

lines.textCh: 你知道怎么离开塔科夫吗？
lines.textEn: Do you know how to leave Tarkov.

lines.textCh: 我需要你的帮助，我得逃出这座城市，你知道我该怎么办吗？
lines.textEn: I need your help. I want to get out of Tarkov. Do you know how?

lines.textCh: 我真的需要你帮我，你知道怎么才能离开塔科夫吗？
lines.textEn: I'm gonna need your help. Do you know how to leave Tarkov?

lines.textCh: 我需要你的帮助。
lines.textEn: I need your help.

lines.textCh: 我已经知道是怎么一回事了。
lines.textEn: I already know what it’s about.

lines.textCh: 别忘了，我是 Lightkeeper，塔科夫发生的一切都逃不过我的眼睛。
lines.textEn: Don’t forget. I am the Lightkeeper. I know everything happening in Tarkov.

lines.textCh: 你一直都在尝试逃离这个地方，而你现在距离成功已经只有咫尺之遥了。
lines.textEn: You're trying to escape this place. And right now, you're closer than ever.

lines.textCh: 怎么办？
lines.textEn: How?

lines.textCh: 你的庇护者已经抛弃了你。虽然我也能帮你一把，但并不会白白为你做这件事。
lines.textEn: Your patron has abandoned you. I can help you. But not for free.

lines.textCh: 我早料到会这样。
lines.textEn: I expected nothing less.

lines.textCh: 很好。你自始至终你都应该用清醒的头脑来评判一切。
lines.textEn: Good. You should always judge everything with a clear mind.

lines.textCh: 那么，现在你距离逃离只有一步之遥了。此时你孤身一人，却没有钥匙。但没有关系——完成我的任务，钥匙就是你的了。
lines.textEn: So, you are at the brink of escape. Alone and without the key. Complete my tasks, and the key is yours.

lines.textCh: 我准备好了。
lines.textEn: I'm ready.

lines.textCh: 那么听好了：我需要一些地形调查情报，但现在只有一个问题，搜集这些东西需要跑遍整个塔科夫，但显然我自己没有那个时间这么做。
lines.textEn: Then listen. I need topographic survey intel. But there is one problem: those documents have to be collected all over Tarkov, and I don't have time for that.

lines.textCh: 完整搜集各个地方的数据，记录到 U 盘里面，然后带到这里来。
lines.textEn: Gather them, record the data onto a flash drive, and bring it here.

lines.textCh: 完成这个任务之后，我们再说下一项任务的事情。
lines.textEn: Finish this task, and you'll get the next one.

lines.textCh: 总共有多少任务？
lines.textEn: How many in total?

lines.textCh: 我说了算——我说多少就是多少。现在走吧，我等着你的结果。
lines.textEn: As many as I say. Now go, I expect results.

lines.textCh: (离开)
lines.textEn: (Leave)

lines.textCh: 干得不错。
lines.textEn: Good work.
Sure, here's your money. (Hand over 5,000,000 RUB)

lines.textCh: 嗯哼，拿过来吧。
lines.textEn: Mm-hm. Hand it over.

lines.textCh: 我把 U 盘带来了。(上交 A.P. 的 U 盘)
lines.textEn: I brought the flash drive. Here. (Hand over the A.P. flash drive)

lines.textCh: 可你不是所有技术设备的专家吗？
lines.textEn: I thought you handled all tech-related stuff.

lines.textCh: 我弄到钱了，这是你要的钱。(上交 5,000,000 卢布)
lines.textEn: I found the cash, here you go. (Hand over 5,000,000 RUB)

lines.textCh: 不错。等到 Elektronik 那边回话之后，我就联系你。
lines.textEn: Excellent. Once Elektronik replies, I’ll contact you.

lines.textCh: 你把东西带来了？不坏。
lines.textEn: You brought it? Good.

lines.textCh: 但我身上没带那个 U 盘。
lines.textEn: But I don't have the flash drive on me.
No. (Gather 5,000,000 RUB)

lines.textCh: 你能帮我读一个 U 盘吗？
lines.textEn: Can you help me read a flash drive?

lines.textCh: 你自己的藏身处里没有电脑不成？
lines.textEn: Don’t you have a computer in the Hideout?

lines.textCh: 问题不在这儿。
lines.textEn: That’s not the problem.

lines.textCh: 那你又是有什么问题？
lines.textEn: Then what is it?

lines.textCh: U 盘里都是些技术文档，没有什么真正的信息。
lines.textEn: The flash drive has technical files, but no real info.

lines.textCh: 这倒是有意思……不过摆弄电脑并不是我的专长。
lines.textEn: Interesting… But that’s not really my field of expertise.

lines.textCh: 那谁能搞定？
lines.textEn: Whose then?

lines.textCh: Elektronik
lines.textEn: Elektronik’s.

lines.textCh: 不要擅自妄做揣测，雇佣兵，或者说，不要擅自期待一些不存在的东西。每个人都有自己的能力极限。不过我认识一个人能帮上忙。
lines.textEn: Don’t assume, mercenary. Even I have limits. But I know who can help.

lines.textCh: 谁？
lines.textEn: Who?

lines.textCh: Elektronik
lines.textEn: Elektronik.

lines.textCh: 我可以联系他，请他帮忙。但这活不白干，你身上带钱了没？
lines.textEn: I can contact him and ask for help. But not for free. You got cash on you?

lines.textCh: 我可以等，但千万不要让我等上太久。
lines.textEn: I’ll wait then. But don’t drag it out.

lines.textCh: 很好，雇佣兵。放在这吧。我会去联系 Elektronik 的，他回话之后我就通知你。至于眼下，等吧。
lines.textEn: Excellent, mercenary. Give it here. I’ll reach out to Elektronik. Once he replies, I’ll contact you. For now, you wait.

lines.textCh: 这是那个 U 盘。(上交 A.P. 的 U 盘)
lines.textEn: And here's the flash drive. (Hand over the A.P. flash drive)

lines.textCh: 谢谢。
lines.textEn: Thanks.

lines.textCh: 事情都办完了。
lines.textEn: Job's done.

lines.textCh: 我知道。等你什么时候要出去了自然会交出来的，我就不浪费时间了。
lines.textEn: I know. You’ll hand it over on your way out so that I don’t waste my time.

lines.textCh: 现在是下一项任务。
lines.textEn: Now here’s the next task.

lines.textCh: 我要你去森林保护区干掉几个 PMC，最近老是有人在那架坠毁的飞机附近嗅来嗅去，我很不喜欢。
lines.textEn: I need you to eliminate PMCs in the nature reserve. Lately, too many are poking around the downed plane. I don’t like it.

lines.textCh: 把人干掉之后，就把狗牌带来。
lines.textEn: And bring me PMC dogtags.

lines.textCh: 带着结果返回。
lines.textEn: Return with results.

lines.textCh: 没错，我都注意到了。干得不坏，狗牌等你一会出门的时候再交吧。
lines.textEn: Yes, I have been notified. Good work. You’ll hand the dogtags on your way out.

lines.textCh: 我把情报都搞来了，这是 U 盘。
lines.textEn: I recorded the intel. Take the flash drive.

lines.textCh: 现在是下一项差事，听清楚了，我不会说第二次的。
lines.textEn: Now here is another task, listen carefully, I won't repeat myself.

lines.textCh: 那些邪教护身符。去给我回收几个护身符回来，放在灯塔旁边的屋子里。
lines.textEn: The cultist amulets. You will have to find them and leave them in the building next to the lighthouse.

lines.textCh: 我该上哪去找这种东西？
lines.textEn: Where do I even look for those?

lines.textCh: 我建议你从他们用符号标记的房间里开始找起，我就说这么多。
lines.textEn: I recommend searching the rooms with cult symbols. That is all.

lines.textCh: 我只等着要结果。
lines.textEn: I await the results.

lines.textCh: (离开)
lines.textEn: (Leave)

lines.textCh: 嗯，其实，我还是现在就把港口钥匙卡拿走吧。
lines.textEn: Hm, actually, let me take the Terminal access card right now.

lines.textCh: 关于那个港口钥匙卡……
lines.textEn: About that port access card…

lines.textCh: 那我为什么会答应你呢？
lines.textEn: Why should I agree?

lines.textCh: 好，我同意。
lines.textEn: Okay, I agree.

lines.textCh: 我之后再拿。先放你那儿吧。（需要先腾出特殊栏位）
lines.textEn: I'll take it later. Let it stay with you for now. (Free your Special slot)

lines.textCh: 我回来拿港口钥匙卡了。
lines.textEn: I've come back for the Terminal access card.

lines.textCh: 你交代的差事我都办完了。
lines.textEn: I’m done with all your tasks.

lines.textCh: 我的确注意到了你的努力。
lines.textEn: I’ve been notified of your results.

lines.textCh: 你还有差事要办吗？
lines.textEn: Need any more help?

lines.textCh: 不。这样就够了。你已向我展示了我想要看到的一切。你的决心很坚定。 我尊重这一点。可惜你到现在还没意识到——这一切都毫无意义。
lines.textEn: No. That should suffice. You’ve shown me everything I wanted to see. Your resolve is strong. I respect that. Too bad you haven’t realized it’s all pointless.

lines.textCh: 你很快就会亲眼见识到的。
lines.textEn: You’ll see for yourself soon enough.

lines.textCh: 还有一件事我们需要讨论。
lines.textEn: There’s something else we need to discuss.

lines.textCh: 我听着呢。
lines.textEn: I’m listening.

lines.textCh: 就算你逃出了塔科夫，也不代表你欠我的就一笔勾销了：我只要求一项任务，我的人会为你带来消息的。但你在接到任务后必须立刻完成，不得有任何迟疑。
lines.textEn: Even after escaping from Tarkov, you will owe me: one task, delivered through my people. It must be done immediately and without hesitation.

lines.textCh: 什么任务？
lines.textEn: What task?

lines.textCh: 你现在不需要知道，时候到了你自然会知道的。
lines.textEn: You don’t need to know yet. When the time comes, you’ll find out.

lines.textCh: 不答应，你就永远留在塔科夫吧。我不会把钥匙给你的。
lines.textEn: Otherwise, you stay in Tarkov forever. I won’t give you the key.

lines.textCh: 看起来我没得选。
lines.textEn: Sounds like I have no choice.

lines.textCh: 你永远有的选，只是其他的结果不是你想要的。
lines.textEn: There’s always a choice. It’s just that the other outcomes won’t suit you.

lines.textCh: 选择本身没有价值，重要的是选择带来的后果。你能承受你自己决定的结果吗？想清楚。
lines.textEn: Choice isn’t valuable on its own. It’s what follows from it that matters. Will you live with the consequences of your decisions? Think on that.

lines.textCh: 只有一个任务。完成之后，我会忘了你，你也会忘了我。
lines.textEn: One task. After it, I’ll forget you, and you’ll forget me.

lines.textCh: 给你。这是钥匙卡。你应该知道怎么用。
lines.textEn: Here. This is a keycard. I think you know how to use it.

lines.textCh: 现在你可以离开塔科夫了。记住：我会亲自联系你。任务必须立即执行，不能拖延。
lines.textEn: Now you can leave Tarkov. Remember: I’ll contact you myself. The task must be done without delay.

lines.textCh: （拿起钥匙卡）
lines.textEn: (Take the access card)

lines.textCh: 明白。
lines.textEn: Understood.

lines.textCh: 给你。这是钥匙卡。我想你知道怎么用。
lines.textEn: Here. This is a keycard. I think you know how to use it.

lines.textCh: 现在你可以离开塔科夫了。记住：我会亲自联系你。任务必须立即执行，不能拖延。
lines.textEn: Now you can leave Tarkov. Remember: I’ll contact you myself. The task must be done without delay.

lines.textCh: 你打给我就是为了炫耀吗？
lines.textEn: You called me only to show off?

lines.textCh: 那我去哪找那“别的东西”？
lines.textEn: Where do I look for this “something more”?

lines.textCh: 你怎么知道 U 盘的？
lines.textEn: How do you even know about the flash drive?

lines.textCh: 你找到的那个 U 盘只是钥匙的一部分。它只解开了锁的一部分。你还需要别的东西才能打开那扇门。
lines.textEn: The flash drive you found is a key. It removes only part of the lock. You will likely need something more to open the door.

lines.textCh: 你怎么知道U盘的事？
lines.textEn: How do you even know about the flash drive?

lines.textCh: 你忘了我知道塔科夫发生的一切了吗？
lines.textEn: You forgot I know everything happening in Tarkov?

lines.textCh: 所以你到底想说什么？
lines.textEn: So what did you want to say?

lines.textCh: 我还没开始呢。
lines.textEn: Didn’t even start.

lines.textCh: 你找到的那个 U 盘是一把钥匙。它只解开了锁的一部分。你很可能还需要别的东西，才能真正打开那扇门。
lines.textEn: The flash drive you found is a key. It removes only part of the lock. You will likely need something more to open the door.

lines.textCh: 什么？
lines.textEn: What?

lines.textCh: 我又不是你妈，没义务一口一口喂你。
lines.textEn: I am not going to spoon feed you.

lines.textCh: 去你已经去过的地方。
lines.textEn: Where you have already been.

lines.textCh: 动动脑子。员工怎么获得权限？除了U盘，他们还会需要什么？我不会再告诉你更多了。你自己想。
lines.textEn: Think. How would employees gain access? What else would they need besides the flash drive? I will not give you more. You will figure it out.

lines.textCh: 我还知道你把 U 盘交给了 Elektronik。
lines.textEn: And I know you handed the flash drive to Elektronik.

lines.textCh: 他确实不错，但还没到我这个级别。特别是他那堆老古董设备。
lines.textEn: He is good, but not on my level. Especially with his old hardware.

lines.textCh: 我来打听个人——一个记者，也可能是调查员。阿纳斯塔西娅·米哈伊洛娃你认识吗？
lines.textEn: I came to ask about someone — a journalist or maybe an investigator. Do you know anything about Anastasia Mikhailova?

lines.textCh: 我正在查一个牵扯到记者或调查员的案子。你知道阿纳斯塔西娅·米哈伊洛娃吗？
lines.textEn: I’m trying to figure out a case involving a journalist or an investigator. Do you know anything about Anastasia Mikhailova?

lines.textCh: 我在找一个人，她好像是记者……
lines.textEn: I’m looking for information about someone, I think she worked as a journalist…

lines.textCh: 我是来打听某个记者或者调查员的事。阿纳斯塔西娅·米哈伊洛娃，这名字你熟吗？
lines.textEn: I stopped by to ask about Anastasia Mikhailova, I think she used to be an investigator. Haven’t heard anything about her, have you?

lines.textCh: 你听说过阿纳斯塔西娅·米哈伊洛娃，或者她调查的东西吗？
lines.textEn: Maybe you’ve heard something about Anastasia Mikhailova or her investigations?

lines.textCh: 你的人不能直接破门吗？
lines.textEn: Can’t your boys just break the door open?

lines.textCh: 我想找某个人的资料。你知道阿纳斯塔西娅·米哈伊洛娃的事吗？
lines.textEn: I’m trying to find some info on a person. Do you know anything about Anastasia Mikhailova?

lines.textCh: 我想问你一个记者……或者调查员？我也不太确定。你听说过阿纳斯塔西娅·米哈伊洛娃这个人吗？
lines.textEn: Wanted to ask you about a certain journalist… Or an investigator maybe, I'm still not sure myself. Ever heard of Anastasia Mikhailova?

lines.textCh: 是的，我听过这个名字。你问她干嘛？算了，不关我的事。不过你明白规矩吧？现在信息都要花钱。你帮我干个小活，我就告诉你我知道的。
lines.textEn: Yeah I know that one. Why’re you asking, though? Eh, whatever, not my business. But you do get how things work, right? Info costs money these days. You sort a little job for me, and I’ll tell you what I know.

lines.textCh: 我需要你知道的一切。什么活？
lines.textEn: I need any bit of info you’ve got. What’s the job?

lines.textCh: 听好了。我以前有个哥们——真汉子，懂行。现在他已经退出舞台了，但他在城里还有个公寓。你得把那个门打开。他失联一阵子了，但我必须确认公寓里的一些东西。你把门撬开，回来找我，我会让我的人进去处理剩下的事。
lines.textEn: Right, listen up. Had a mate once — proper hard lad, knew his stuff. He’s out of the picture now, but he’s still got a flat in the city. That’s the one you’ll need to open. He’s gone dark for a while, but there’s something I’ve gotta check in his place. You crack the door, come back here, and I’ll send my boys in after to handle the rest.

lines.textCh: 那钥匙在哪儿呢？
lines.textEn: Where might the key be?

lines.textCh: 要是我都知道，我还需要你？有钥匙谁都能办这事。
lines.textEn: You think I’d ask for your help if I knew everything myself? Any muppet could handle this with a key.

lines.textCh: 是，他们能做到。他们也能在必要的时候把某些蠢货的脑子敲明白了。想试试吗？不想？那就别再问这些蠢得要命的问题。没有钥匙就是打不开，就这么简单。
lines.textEn: Yes they can. They can also knock the stupid outta people when they have to. Wanna test that? No? Then stop asking stupid bloody questions. Can’t do it without the key, simple as that.

lines.textCh: 给点方向也行？
lines.textEn: Any landmarks at least?

lines.textCh: 只有大概的位置。记下来。
lines.textEn: Only rough ones. Jot this down.

lines.textCh: 兄弟，现在帮不了你。我忙得脑袋快炸了。之后再来吧。
lines.textEn: Listen, bro, can’t help right now. Busy as hell, brain’s fried. Come back later.

lines.textCh: 那这个阿纳斯塔西娅·米哈伊洛娃现在在哪？
lines.textEn: Where is Anastasia Mikhailova?

lines.textCh: 她失踪了？
lines.textEn: She disappeared?

lines.textCh: 我听说你对那个记者姑娘挺了解的。
lines.textEn: I’ve been told you know a lot about the journalist girl.

lines.textCh: 我大概知道你在问谁。行，我现在有点空。你想知道什么？
lines.textEn: I have a hunch who you’re asking about. Alright, I got some free time now. What do you want to know?

lines.textCh: 你认识阿纳斯塔西娅·米哈伊洛娃吗？
lines.textEn: Are you acquainted with Anastasia Mikhailova?

lines.textCh: 算是吧。我们以前在一起过。很久以前，那是……一切发生之前。 她够强硬，很多政客都怕她。当然，也恨她。 你知道如果记者惹了什么不该惹的人，都会有什么下场吧？
lines.textEn: Yeah, something like that. We were together once. Long time ago, before… everything. She was tough, many politicians feared her. And hated her, of course. You know what happens to journalists who poke the wrong people?

lines.textCh: 要是我能知道就好了！她是我女朋友。至少我以为是。 我甚至都计划好婚礼了！还想着说服她去见我的家人…… 娜斯佳 (阿纳斯塔西娅的爱称) 聪明又坚强。一开口就能把任何小看她的人辩得哑口无言！ 她喜欢深挖政治，专门戳政治人物的痛处。就算那些人能随便整她，她也不怕。 你也知道，记者如果踩到了不该踩的尾巴，都会有什么下场。
lines.textEn: If only I knew myself! She was my girlfriend. Or at least I thought so. I even planned a wedding! Thought about convincing her to meet my family… Nastya was smart and tough. Could put anyone in their place! Loved digging into politics, ruffling politicians’ feathers. They messed with her whenever they could. You know what happens to journalists who poke the wrong people.

lines.textCh: 她被杀了？
lines.textEn: Was she killed?

lines.textCh: 我……希望不是这样。撤离之后就再也没有她的消息了。我本想把她带出去的，但一直联系不上她。
lines.textEn: I… hope not. No word from her since the evacuation. I planned to get her out, but couldn’t reach her.

lines.textCh: 是啊。可那是在撤离的时候。她就那么消失了！我本来打算亲自开车把她带出去的，但始终联系不上她。
lines.textEn: Yeah. But that was during the evacuation. She just vanished! I was going to drive her outta here myself, but couldn’t reach her.

lines.textCh: 也许她早就已经离开了塔科夫，住在莫斯科，继续在报纸上撰写尖锐的文章戳人痛处吧……
lines.textEn: Maybe she left Tarkov and now writes scathing articles somewhere in Moscow.

lines.textCh: 她住哪？
lines.textEn: Where did she live?

lines.textCh: Chekannaya 街 13 号，二楼的公寓。 好吧，我就把我知道的都告诉你。除此之外的事情我也帮不上忙了。
lines.textEn: Chekannaya Street 13. Apartment on the second floor. Alright, I told you all I know. Can’t help more than that.

lines.textCh: 是的，我已经把门打开了。你可以让你的人过来了。
lines.textEn: Yes, I opened the door. You can send your crew.

lines.textCh: 干得漂亮，伙计！事情都办完了你还傻站在这干啥？哦对，你想知道关于阿纳斯塔西娅的事，是吧？对，她是个记者妞，有点疯，你懂吧？试图挖一些狠角色的黑料，不过具体我不知道。她招惹的可不止一个。
lines.textEn: Nice one, mate! Why’re you still here then? Oh right, you wanted to know about Anastasia, didn’t you? Right, so she was some journalist bird, proper off her rocker, you get me? Tried to dig up dirt on some serious lads, but I don’t know the details. Lotta people had it in for her.

lines.textCh: 总之，Ragman 以前跟她走得挺近。要想知道更多，去问他吧。
lines.textEn: Anyway, Ragman used to hang about with her quite a bit. Go ask him if you want the full story.

lines.textCh: 就这样？你答应给我的是“信息”，不是八卦。
lines.textEn: That’s it? You promised information, not some rumors.

lines.textCh: 别激动啊，兄弟。我告诉你的就是我知道的全部了。不是我的错。下次想不被坑，就学会提前谈好条件，懂？
lines.textEn: Easy there, mate. I told you everything I know. Not my fault. If you don’t wanna get mugged off next time, learn to lock in the deal properly, yeah?

lines.textCh: 我听说你知道谁掌管这附近的地盘。那海关的老大是谁？
lines.textEn: Heard you know who’s running the local gangs. So who’s in charge of the Customs territory?

lines.textCh: 什么，你不知道？哦对，你是个他妈的游客。总之，以前是切皮加说了算，但他现在出局了。具体原因就不和你细说了，抱歉。但他洗手不干的时候，切皮加把位置交给了 Reshala——这名字你总该听过了吧？
lines.textEn: What, you don’t know? Oh yeah, right, you’re a bloody tourist. Anyway, used to be Chepyga calling the shots, but he’s out of the game now. Can’t tell you why, sorry mate. But when he bailed, he left Reshala in charge. You’ve heard of him, yeah?

lines.textCh: 听过这个名字。你能让我联系到他吗？
lines.textEn: Heard the name, yes. Can you get me in touch with him?

lines.textCh: 冷静点啊，伙计！我不知道你是真的天真无知，还是一心求死。Reshala 是个疯子。我可不会凑到他身边去自己找抽。这家伙以前还能保持点理智，甚至还挺能来事，现在彻底疯了。别人看他一眼不顺，他就干掉。你这条命如果还要的话，最好是离他远点。
lines.textEn: Let’s calm down a bit, mate! Reshala’s a nutter. I wouldn’t get within a shot’s reach of him. Used to keep his cool, now he’s gone full psycho. Drops people just for looking at him funny. If you value your hide, steer clear of him.

lines.textCh: 你胆子可真够大的，搞砸了还敢回来。在你重振名誉之前，我绝对不会和你再有半点合作。
lines.textEn: You’ve got some nerve. You screw up and still come back. I’m not gonna work with you until you rebuild your name.

lines.textCh: 你好。在你洗清自己的名誉之前，我是不会和你做生意的。
lines.textEn: Hello. We’re not talking business until you clean your reputation.

lines.textCh: 我不是说过不让你进来吗？除非你重新做人。
lines.textEn: Didn’t I say not to let you in? Not until you fix your rep.

lines.textCh: 先赢回我的信任再谈。
lines.textEn: Earn my trust back first, then we’ll talk.

lines.textCh: 以为自己天下无敌了是吧？干了那种事还敢来这里？给我滚！
lines.textEn: Think you’re immortal? Showing up here after what you pulled? Piss off!

lines.textCh: 你以为我不会查出来？谁还会信你这个蛀虫！
lines.textEn: You think I wouldn’t find out? You lost my trust!

lines.textCh: 那你他妈还在这儿干什么？你辜负了我的信任，那就加倍表现挣回去！
lines.textEn: The fuck are you doing here? You broke my trust, so go earn it back!

lines.textCh: 如果你真的这么快就办完了，奖励直接翻倍。所以你真的弄完了？
lines.textEn: If you really finished it that fast, I’ll double your reward. Job done?

lines.textCh: 任务完成了？这么快？
lines.textEn: Task complete? That quick?

lines.textCh: 你确定把活都干完了？我怎么感觉你这个混蛋是在耍我。
lines.textEn: Feels like you’re gonna try to bullshit me. You sure you got it done already?

lines.textCh: 这么快就回来了？别告诉我你真做完了。
lines.textEn: Back already? Don’t tell me you actually finished it.

lines.textCh: 还真是快啊，你这就弄完了？
lines.textEn: That was quick. You already done?

lines.textCh: 那么，任务完成了吗？
lines.textEn: So, did you finish the job?

lines.textCh: 回见。
lines.textEn: See you around.

lines.textCh: 别再浪费我的时间了。
lines.textEn: Don’t waste too much of my time.

lines.textCh: 他们会带你出去的。
lines.textEn: They’ll show you out.

lines.textCh: 自己挑吧。
lines.textEn: Pick what you need.

lines.textCh: 我不会回答那种无聊的问题。我们能不能谈正事，别扯这些无聊的。
lines.textEn: Not answering that crap. Let’s talk business, not this nonsense.

lines.textCh: 别浪费我太多时间。
lines.textEn: Don’t waste too much of my time.

lines.textCh: 你好。
lines.textEn: Greetings.

lines.textCh: 之后再说吧。
lines.textEn: Later.

lines.textCh: 可以。
lines.textEn: Fine.

lines.textCh: 搞什么？难道你非得知道这事不可？是准备在朋友面前吹牛耍酷？
lines.textEn: Why the hell would you need to know this? Trying to sound cool in front of your buddies?

lines.textCh: 进来吧。我就不和你客套了，反正我们这儿也没多余的椅子让你坐。赶紧掰扯完算逑了。
lines.textEn: Come on in. Not gonna offer a seat, we don’t have a spare one. Let’s get this over with quick.

lines.textCh: 你把钱带来了？
lines.textEn: You got the cash?

lines.textCh: 闭上你的嘴。
lines.textEn: Keep your mouth shut.

lines.textCh: 我以前曾是和你一样的雇佣兵，直到我膝盖上中了一枪。你真以为我会天真到向你敞开心扉？
lines.textEn: I used to be a mercenary like you, then I took a bullet in the knee. You really think I’m gonna bare my soul to you?

lines.textCh: 现在没什么能给你的。
lines.textEn: Nothing for you right now.

lines.textCh: 你到底是什么人？为什么总是这么神秘？这副面具，以及周遭所有的黑暗……
lines.textEn: Who the hell even are you? Why are you so secretive? The mask, all this darkness…

lines.textCh: 你好。
lines.textEn: Greetings.

lines.textCh: 啊，是你啊。
lines.textEn: Ah, it’s you.

lines.textCh: 只要现金。
lines.textEn: Cash only.

lines.textCh: 记住，没人知道你来过这里。
lines.textEn: Remember, nobody should know you were here.

lines.textCh: 终于想让自己有点用了？聪明的选择。
lines.textEn: Wanna make yourself useful? Smart move.

lines.textCh: 你知道塔科夫里好奇心太重的人会怎样吗？再问这种问题，你就会亲自体验一下。
lines.textEn: You know what happens to the overly curious in Tarkov? Keep asking questions like that, and you’ll find out.

lines.textCh: 想交易？
lines.textEn: Want to trade?

lines.textCh: 你好啊，小孩。
lines.textEn: Well hello there, kid.

lines.textCh: 是啊，走吧。
lines.textEn: Yeah, keep moving.

lines.textCh: 好吧，行。
lines.textEn: Alright, sure.

lines.textCh: 让我来瞧瞧你能在哪派上用场。
lines.textEn: Let’s see where you might be useful.

lines.textCh: 你真觉得我来这儿是为了聊我自己？
lines.textEn: You really think I’m here to chat about myself?

lines.textCh: 你这儿有新活要办吗？
lines.textEn: Got any work for me?

lines.textCh: 快点下定决心，我可不会呆等着你。
lines.textEn: Make up your mind fast, I’m not waiting around.

lines.textCh: 你直接发问的勇气能得个 A，可是问出来的蠢问题只想让我给你个 F 把你打发走。
lines.textEn: You get an A for courage for asking straight up, but an F for dumb questions.

lines.textCh: 这里永远不缺活干。
lines.textEn: Always got work here.

lines.textCh: 我不会再重复目标了，你早该记在心上的。还有其他问题吗？
lines.textEn: I’m not repeating the objective, you should’ve remembered it. Anything else?

lines.textCh: 滚吧，我要的是结果。
lines.textEn: Then get lost. I need results.

lines.textCh: 还在办，我有问题要问。
lines.textEn: Still working on it. Need to ask you something.

lines.textCh: 我最喜欢有人问我蠢得要命的问题。真他妈开心。
lines.textEn: I live for people asking me dumbass questions. My fucking favorite.

lines.textCh: 只做高风险的活。
lines.textEn: Only high-risk stuff.

lines.textCh: 哦——谢谢你告诉我外头的消息，好心的先生。所以你到底要什么？能不能麻利点说明白了。
lines.textEn: Thank you kindly for the update. So what do you want? Make it quick.

lines.textCh: 没干完——就没有奖励。记住这点，然后去干活！
lines.textEn: No results — no reward. Remember that, and get to work!

lines.textCh: 我来就是为了这个。
lines.textEn: I'm here about it.

lines.textCh: 还有些事情需要我处理完。我现在就出发。
lines.textEn: There's still something I have to finish. I'll head out now.

lines.textCh: 我得走了。
lines.textEn: I’ve got to go.

lines.textCh: 我这儿从不打折，你最好记住这一点。
lines.textEn: I don’t do discounts, just so you know.

lines.textCh: 我怎么不记得我们的关系铁到能互相关心这种话题了？你以为你是谁，随随便便就想打探我的私事？你要是还想在塔科夫活命，就收起你那无处安放的好奇心。
lines.textEn: I must’ve missed the part where we became best fucking buddies and you get to ask me personal questions. Watch your curiosity if you want to stay alive in Tarkov.

lines.textCh: 我得确认一下。
lines.textEn: Need to check.

lines.textCh: 还没有。
lines.textEn: Not yet.

lines.textCh: 我不记得任务里有“过来闲聊”这一项。你他妈来干嘛？
lines.textEn: Don’t recall “drop by for a chat” being part of the task. The fuck you need?

lines.textCh: 那你在这里做什么？你的目标不在这里。
lines.textEn: What are you doing here, then? Your objective isn’t here.

lines.textCh: 我得走了。
lines.textEn: I’ve got to go.

lines.textCh: 当然，看看吧。
lines.textEn: Sure. Take a look.

lines.textCh: 这他妈不关你的事。
lines.textEn: That’s none of your fucking business.

lines.textCh: 给你？让我们想想。
lines.textEn: For you? Let’s think of something.

lines.textCh: 还在忙这个，有点事情要问你。
lines.textEn: Still working on it. Need to ask you something.

lines.textCh: 你要是有空在这里问些蠢问题，还不如早点去把活干完。算了，这次又是什么？
lines.textEn: That’s a funny way to work if you’re standing here instead of doing the job. Fine, what is it?

lines.textCh: 那就去把该死的活干完，别在这杵着！
lines.textEn: Then go finish the damn job instead of standing around here!

lines.textCh: 不，我不知道任何事情，去找其他人。
lines.textEn: No, don’t know anything. Others might.

lines.textCh: 我还没参与这事情就办完了。
lines.textEn: That matter’s being handled without me.

lines.textCh: 上别的地方打听去。
lines.textEn: Ask someone else.

lines.textCh: 我看起来像会在乎这种事的人吗？这根本不值一提。
lines.textEn: Do I look like someone who cares about that? Not my level.

lines.textCh: 那不关我的事。去别处打听吧。
lines.textEn: That’s not my concern. Ask around elsewhere.

lines.textCh: 不知道。去别处问问吧。
lines.textEn: Dunno. Ask somewhere else.

lines.textCh: 你在说什么呢？完全听不懂。
lines.textEn: What are you even talking about? Don’t get it.

lines.textCh: 行，给我，我来处理。
lines.textEn: Okay, give it to me, I’ll sort it out.

lines.textCh: 真是完美！
lines.textEn: Perfection!

lines.textCh: 行吧，我来看看。给我，然后你可以解散了。
lines.textEn: Alrighty, let’s take a look. Give it here, and you’re dismissed.

lines.textCh: 交出来。
lines.textEn: Hand it over.

lines.textCh: 都在这了？不错。
lines.textEn: All here? Good job.

lines.textCh: 你到底想说些什么？
lines.textEn: What did you want to talk about?

lines.textCh: 时候已经到了：所有的任务都已完成，所有的证据也都掌握在了手中。
lines.textEn: The time has come. All missions are complete, all evidence is collected.

lines.textCh: 很快我们将让人们清醒过来，让他们看清那条在自己怀中恢复了温暖，却又打算恩将仇报的毒蛇。
lines.textEn: Soon we will open people’s eyes to the snake they warmed on their chest.

lines.textCh: 别忘了带上那些文件，没了它们，你的这趟旅途将毫无意义。
lines.textEn: Don't forget to bring the documents. Without them your journey is meaningless.

lines.textCh: 公众会相信这些证据吗？TerraGroup 的根基到底有多深？他们是否已经把全球媒体都纳入了自己的掌控之下？我不知道，但只能去猜测。
lines.textEn: Will the public believe the evidence? How deep are TerraGroup’s roots? Can they influence the global press? I do not know, only guess.

lines.textCh: 但我仍然心存希望，虽然连我自己也不想用这么模棱两可的话。
lines.textEn: I still have hope, though I do not like to use such words.

lines.textCh: 我们在另一头再见吧
lines.textEn: See you on the other side.

lines.textCh: 再见了 (离开)
lines.textEn: Farewell. (Leave)

lines.textCh: 要是我动不动就泄露关键情报，那我就配不上 Lightkeeper 这个名号了。 我一个字也不会告诉你。
lines.textEn: I wouldn’t be the Lightkeeper if I gave away critical information at the drop of a hat. You’ll get nothing from me on this subject.

lines.textCh: 要是我天真到对所有像你一样头一次上门的 PMC 都不分青红皂白地吐露消息，还有谁会愿意把自己的秘密交给我，嗯？
lines.textEn: Who do you think would trust me with their secrets if I handed them out to PMCs like you at the first request?

lines.textCh: 当然，我是有这方面的消息的。 至少别指望从我这里得到。 去找哪个愿意为自己闲言碎语承担后果的人来吧。
lines.textEn: Of course I have information on this. But don’t expect to get it here. Find someone ready to face the consequences of their own chatter.

lines.textCh: 我知道一些情况，但我不打算和你分享。
lines.textEn: I know something about this, but I’m not sharing it with you.

lines.textCh: 你这是在以身试险。 我不会去主动深挖那些害你送命的秘密。
lines.textEn: You’re poking at something dangerous. I won’t help you dig up secrets that will get you killed.

lines.textCh: 你难道真的以为这个信息唾手可得，跳着舞步进去就能轻松拿到？ 太天真了，就算是对你这种水平的人来说也是。
lines.textEn: You really thought you could waltz in here and get that information? Too naive, even for you.

lines.textCh: 好吧，交给我，我来负责理清楚。
lines.textEn: Okay, give it to me, I’ll sort it out.

lines.textCh: 真是完美！
lines.textEn: Perfection!

lines.textCh: 交出来，然后你就可以走了。 好吧，让我们看看。
lines.textEn: Give it here, then you’re dismissed. Alrighty, let’s take a look.

lines.textCh: 放在这儿。
lines.textEn: Give it here.

lines.textCh: 都在这了？干得好。
lines.textEn: All here? Good job.

lines.textCh: 干得不错。
lines.textEn: Good work.

lines.textCh: 嗯哼，交过来。
lines.textEn: Mm-hm. Hand it over.

lines.textCh: 你把东西带来了？谢谢。
lines.textEn: You brought it? Appreciate it.

lines.textCh: 谢谢。
lines.textEn: Thanks.

lines.textCh: 我想离开这里，但所有出口都被封锁了。你能帮我悄悄离开这座城市吗？我会付钱的。
lines.textEn: I want to get out of here, but all the exits are closed off. Maybe you could get me out of the city quietly? I can pay.

lines.textCh: 我只是想离开这里，如果我愿意交出手里的 TerraGroup 情报和数据，能不能换来一次逃离的机会？
lines.textEn: I want to get out of here. What if I traded TerraGroup intel or data for an evacuation?

lines.textCh: 我的计划果然没能成功，正如你所说。他们不让任何人进入港口。
lines.textEn: My plan really didn’t work out, just like you said. They’re not letting anyone into the port.

lines.textCh: 港口的守军让我直接滚，你知道该怎么离开这里吗？
lines.textEn: They turned me away at the port. Do you know any way to get out of here?

lines.textCh: 我不想扯进这种麻烦里，你去找别人吧。
lines.textEn: I don’t get involved in stuff like this. Ask someone else.

lines.textCh: 现在谁都不准进港口了。但你们还在从城里撤离平民对吧？也就是说你们还是和外界有着某种程度的联系。
lines.textEn: No one’s being allowed into the port anymore. But you’re still evacuating civilians from the city, aren’t you? That means you’ve got some kind of contact with the outside world.

lines.textCh: 老实说，我根本一点都不知道。
lines.textEn: I’ll be honest, I don’t know shit about this.

lines.textCh: 我从不踏足那片泥潭。那里从来没有好事，唯有死亡。
lines.textEn: I don’t go into that muck. Nothing good there, only death.

lines.textCh: 你应该还和军方高层有联系。就不能把这里发生的事汇报给他们吗？
lines.textEn: You must still have some connection to the military command. Can you report what’s happened here to them?

lines.textCh: 很抱歉，年轻人，这已经超出了我的能力。
lines.textEn: I am sorry, young man, this is beyond my competence.

lines.textCh: 你以为我会知道这事，真有意思。
lines.textEn: Funny you thought I’d be in the loop on that.

lines.textCh: 你人脉广，业务也多。如果安排妥当了，能不能趁着他们转运护甲的时候把人偷偷夹带在货箱里运出去？
lines.textEn: You’ve got a lot of connections and business. Is it possible to smuggle someone out inside an armor shipment, if we arrange everything properly?

lines.textCh: 这不归我管，抱歉。去问别人吧。
lines.textEn: Not my area, sorry. Ask someone else.

lines.textCh: 抱歉，我才不会和你搅和上这摊子烂事。
lines.textEn: Sorry, I’m not getting into this mess with you.

lines.textCh: 你之前提到了 Peacekeeper，也许他会帮忙？
lines.textEn: You mentioned Peacekeeper before. Maybe he could help?

lines.textCh: 我看起来像会在乎这种事的人吗？这根本不值一提。
lines.textEn: Do I look like someone who cares about that? Not my level.

lines.textCh: 你就不能和你的上级谈谈吗，让他们自己去开辟一条安全通道，而不是使用港口？
lines.textEn: Can you talk to your superiors, get them to open a safe corridor instead of using the port?

lines.textCh: 那你能帮我和我的上级建立沟通渠道吗？
lines.textEn: Maybe you know how to establish a communication channel with my superiors?

lines.textCh: 可偷运大量货物进来的人明明是你！你肯定有手段能帮我搞个私人撤离通道？
lines.textEn: But you’re the one smuggling tons of goods in here! Maybe you could arrange a personal evacuation for me?

lines.textCh: 你见过类似的情况吗？任何消息都能帮上大忙。
lines.textEn: Have you seen anything like this? Any information would help.

lines.textCh: 听说你真找到办法混进港口了。要不是你蠢得要命把事情搞砸了，本来倒也值得称赞。
lines.textEn: I heard you did find a way into the port. That would be commendable were you not such an idiot.

lines.textCh: 现在怎么想起来找我了？又需要我帮忙了？太晚了！
lines.textEn: Why'd you stop ignoring me now? Need help again? Too late.

lines.textCh: 你只不过接触到了点边角料的东西，看到了 TerraGroup 罪恶的皮毛就收手了，要么就是被吓得屁滚尿流。
lines.textEn: You scratched the surface and saw only the tip of TerraGroup’s crimes, then gave up. Or got too afraid.

lines.textCh: 真可惜你居然是这么个意志薄弱的怂蛋，我真是看走了眼才把赌注押在你身上。但你要知道，想要逃离这里的人可不止你一个。
lines.textEn: Shame you were so weak willed. For once I backed the wrong horse. But you are not the only one trying to escape.

lines.textCh: 逃出塔科夫的安全路线。
lines.textEn: Safe travels out of Tarkov.

lines.textCh: 我还以为你终于让我清静一会了呢。去你妈的道德说教。(离开)
lines.textEn: And here I was hoping you’d finally left me alone. Go fuck yourself and your moral lessons. (Leave)

lines.textCh: 我明白了。我会继续找的。
lines.textEn: I get it. I'll keep looking.

lines.textCh: 我该拿搜集到的这些文件怎么办？
lines.textEn: What should I do with the docs I gathered?

lines.textCh: 再见，我会另寻出路离开塔科夫。而不是靠你和你的这些把戏。
lines.textEn: I’m out. I’ll find another way out of Tarkov. Without you and your games.

lines.textCh: 不，这全是胡扯！去你的！我自己来搞定！
lines.textEn: No, this is all bullshit. Screw you, I’ll handle it myself!

lines.textCh: 能不能提醒下我，你的最终目标到底是什么？
lines.textEn: Remind me, what’s your end goal here?

lines.textCh: 什么他妈的计划？我们不是约好了吗！
lines.textEn: What fucking plan? We had an agreement!

lines.textCh: 你还想在封锁线另一头再见面？
lines.textEn: You want to meet outside the cordon?

lines.textCh: 你到底为什么想要这个？
lines.textEn: Why do you want this anyway?

lines.textCh: 好吧，继续……
lines.textEn: Alright, go on…

lines.textCh: 钥匙卡在港口没用。
lines.textEn: The keycard didn’t work at the Port.

lines.textCh: 意味着一切都按计划进行。
lines.textEn: Means everything went according to the plan.

lines.textCh: 这是什么意思？
lines.textEn: What does this mean?

lines.textCh: 你在这里的活还没有办完呢。
lines.textEn: That your work here is not done.

lines.textCh: 是是是，你生气了，气得跳脚，不过是这类垃圾话。但先听我说完。
lines.textEn: Yeah-yeah, you’re mad and so on and so forth. But hear me out first.

lines.textCh: 钥匙卡没有用是因为卡里少了东西，至于具体是什么，还不是你这种人需要担心的事情。
lines.textEn: The card failed because something is missing. What exactly is not for you to worry about yet.

lines.textCh: 你必须找到揭露 TerraGroup 罪证的证据，只有这样我们才能拯救更多的人。
lines.textEn: I need you to find documents that will expose TerraGroup. Only then can we save as many lives as possible.

lines.textCh: 这不止是 TerraGroup，在集团之上还有那些“无名者”。你必须自己发掘世界的真相。
lines.textEn: It is not only TerraGroup. Above them are The Unheard. You must discover them yourself.

lines.textCh: 你为什么不早点告诉我这件事？
lines.textEn: Why didn’t you tell me about this earlier?

lines.textCh: 因为我不相信利他主义，额外的动机总是必不可少的。
lines.textEn: Because I don’t believe in altruism. Extra motivation is always needed.

lines.textCh: 现在，说回文件的事情。我们需要弄来他们的内部许可、秘密科技的技术说明，还有规格文档。 所有 TerraGroup 还没来得及销毁或者转移的东西。 把这些当成是你逃出塔科夫真正的门票吧。
lines.textEn: Now, back to the documents. We need permits, secret tech descriptions, specifications. Anything TerraGroup did not destroy or move out. Think of those as your true Ticket out of Tarkov.

lines.textCh: 你要多少？
lines.textEn: How many do you need?

lines.textCh: 这取决于你找到的是什么。边角料当然也可以，但我想要的是大货，爆炸性的，能够一次性把集团这个利维坦给掀翻的猛料。
lines.textEn: Depends on what you find. Small dirt is fine, but I want something big. Powerful. Something that can topple a giant.

lines.textCh: 要是我根本找不到猛料怎么办？
lines.textEn: What if I cannot find anything big?

lines.textCh: 你会的，你早就深陷其中，这是你自己的选择。我敢肯定你自己也想知道 TerraGroup 都干了什么。 如果你真的遇到困难了，我会尽力提供帮助。但别指望我会代劳一切。
lines.textEn: You will. You are already knee deep in this by your own choice. I bet you want to know what TerraGroup did. If you really get stuck, I will try to help. But do not abuse that.

lines.textCh: 你应该知道，TerraGroup 在大部分人眼里到底是什么形象。许多人几乎将他们奉若神明，却看不到其背后的都是什么样的怪物在作祟。 我希望正义得到伸张，我要让整个世界都看到它的真面目？还有其他问题没有？
lines.textEn: You know how people treat TerraGroup. Many practically worship them and do not see the monster behind it. I want evil punished. I want the world to see its true face. Any other questions?

lines.textCh: 明智之选。我期待你的第一批成果。
lines.textEn: Good choice. I await the first results.

lines.textCh: 随你，那就这样吧。全塔科夫的大聪明这么多，想要逃离塔科夫又愿意帮我干活的人并不是只有你一个。
lines.textEn: Your call. That’s it, then. You’re not the only one smart enough to help me and get himself out of Tarkov.

lines.textCh: 给我吧。
lines.textEn: Give them to me.

lines.textCh: 当面还是别的什么？
lines.textEn: In person or how?

lines.textCh: “还是别的什么”，我需要尽早拿到文档，才能开始把它们发到网络上。
lines.textEn: “Or how”. I need the docs sooner to start pushing them online.

lines.textCh: 也许，但在此之前我得先搞到文件才行。
lines.textEn: Maybe. But I need the docs before this.

lines.textCh: 让信使传递太冒险了——说不定一转头就全泄给第三方了。
lines.textEn: A courier is too risky — could leak everything to third parties.

lines.textCh: 你必须先把这些材料数字化处理，再通过安全节点发送。
lines.textEn: You must digitize them and send via a secure node.

lines.textCh: 我会告诉你怎么做的，但别忘了我同样需要东西的原件。找个坚固的箱子把那些东西装起来，方便动身时随身带走。
lines.textEn: I will send instructions. Do not forget I need the originals too. Pack them in a sturdy case and take them with you when you leave.

lines.textCh: 你在耍我吗？到现在了还觉得这是一场游戏？去你的吧。
lines.textEn: Are you kidding me? You think this is a game? Go fuck yourself.

lines.textCh: 你原本前途无量，但最终还是把一切搞砸了。好吧，这是你自己的选择。那就一辈子留在塔科夫吧。
lines.textEn: You were promising. But still decided to fuck it all up. Well, that’s your call. Stay in Tarkov then.

lines.textCh: 你原本前途无量，但最终还是把一切搞砸了。好吧，这是你自己的选择。那就一辈子留在塔科夫吧。
lines.textEn: You were promising. But still decided to fuck it all up. Well, that’s your call. Stay in Tarkov then.

lines.textCh: (离开)
lines.textEn: (Leave)

lines.textCh: 我带上了所有证据的原件 (将证据放入 Alpha-1 安全箱中)
lines.textEn: I have all the original evidence on me. (Compile the evidence into Secure container Alpha-1)

lines.textCh: 所以，一切都按照计划进行。
lines.textEn: So everything is going according to the plan.

lines.textCh: 别忘了带上文件。倘若没了这些证据，你的一切努力都将白费了。
lines.textEn: Don't forget to bring the documents. Without them your journey is meaningless.

lines.textCh: 就知道你靠得住。
lines.textEn: Never doubted you.

lines.textCh: 很好，给。
lines.textEn: Perfect. Here.

lines.textCh: 就知道你靠得住。
lines.textEn: Never doubted you.

lines.textCh: 这个是不是？
lines.textEn: Is this it?

lines.textCh: 我应该见过类似的东西，我会试着去找找看的。
lines.textEn: I think I've seen something similar. I'll try looking for it.

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 最近怎么样？BTR 跑得还顺畅吧？
lines.textEn: How's it going? BTR doing alright?

lines.textCh:
试过我的新加热器没？这个小东西可是好用极了！不过人是暖和起来了，BTR 上路又成了大麻烦……我得热车热上一个小时才能勉强让引擎正常运转，这还没算发动引擎的那通折腾呢！

这台老姑娘一开始根本不肯在大冷天启动。柴油机光冒烟不出力，嚎了半天也打不着。得把燃油添加剂的量翻倍才能勉强转起来，但你也知道的，在封锁区里，货物可不会自己从架子上长出来。所以手头的库存是用一罐少一罐。

呃，你能帮帮忙吗？就当是帮朋友一个小忙。既然你没在藏身处里猫冬，那应该在外头见到过一些燃油添加剂吧？这东西对你来说也许没有太大用场，但放在我这可是和救命一样啊。
lines.textEn:
You tried out my new heater yet? This little thingie works perfectly! But getting out on the routes now is a whole different story... I have to warm the engine for an hour, and that's not even counting the start itself!

At first the old girl wouldn't start cold at all. Diesel was waxing up like a bastard. Had to double the amount of additives. And you know that stuff's not exactly growing on trees around here anymore. Every can counts now.

Say, maybe you could help a friend out? Since you're not hiding in your basement right now, you should be able to track down some fuel conditioner. I doubt you need it for anything, but it'd save my ass big time.

lines.textCh: 太棒了！我会等着的。
lines.textEn: Cool! I'll be waiting.

lines.textCh: 你真是个了不起的家伙！我欠你一个人情。
lines.textEn: You're a hell of a guy, that's what I'll say! I owe you one.

lines.textCh: 没错！就是它！
lines.textEn: Yes, that's it!

lines.textCh: 就知道你靠得住。
lines.textEn: Never doubted you.

lines.textCh: 都按照你说的办完了，那些 Scav 近期应该没那个胆子再在你的营地探头探脑了。
lines.textEn: Did all you asked. I doubt the regular Scavs will come snooping around any time soon.

lines.textCh: 就知道你靠得住。
lines.textEn: Never doubted you.

lines.textCh: 听起来还成。我只希望去帮你赶走那些混混的时候别被冻死在外边。
lines.textEn: Sounds good. Hope I don't get too cold sitting there guarding your place.

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: Back

lines.textCh: 燃料怎么样了？没有新的问题吧？
lines.textEn: How's your fuel? No new issues?

lines.textCh:
我正等着你上门呢！虽然外头冰天雪地，我这儿可是有加热器护身——生意好到不能再好。PMC 们简直是排着队赶着搭车，免得冻僵在雪地里头，或者至少上车暖和一会。相信我，这可比给其他商人跑腿赚的多得多啦！

所以我故意放出话去，就说我的 BTR 坏了，免得哪个商人又想用什么合同把我给困住。还是自己给自己打工最畅快，至少还能帮帮路边的普通人，而不是像头牲口一样疲于奔命。但有一个问题。

近些天我没怎么回基地，但我总得时不时往回跑一趟。有些挺宝贵的设备还放在仓库里，没法一次性全部转移走。要是我那些“合作伙伴”的狗腿们听到风声开始在四周探头探脑，那就全完了！

所以我又得请你帮忙了。去我的基地看看，把不相干的人都赶走，成吗？不过别碰 PMC！他们现在可是我的大客户了，要是惹毛了他们，我可是吃不了兜着走。
lines.textEn:
I was waiting for you! With these frosts and the new heater, business has been booming like never before. PMCs are lining up just to warm up or catch a ride somewhere. And trust me, that's a lot easier and more profitable than running under the traders.

So I started a rumor that my BTR was down, just to keep them from dragging me into their contracts. Figured I'd work for myself for a bit, help out the regular folks too. Only one problem though.

I don't hit the Depot often these days, but I can't avoid it completely. There's a bunch of important equipment still there, stuff you can't just move in one go. And if any rats from my "partner's" crew start snooping around, the whole thing goes to hell.

So I need your help again. Make sure there are no extra eyes in the Depot, yeah? Just don't touch the PMCs! They're my main customers right now, they won't rat me out.

lines.textCh: 太棒了！等你消息。
lines.textEn: Cool! I'll be waiting.

lines.textCh:
干得漂亮！我已经回去过几次基地了，也自己瞧了瞧周围的情况。我都快记不清基地上一回这么安静是在什么时候了。

我给你准备了些谢礼。给，拿着吧。
lines.textEn:
Nice one! I've checked out the Depot a couple times already, saw it all with my own eyes. It's been a long time since it was that quiet there.

I've got something ready for you as a thank you. Here, take it.

lines.textCh: 你肯定知道 TerraGroup 和 Paradigm 航运是怎么勾搭到一起去的，以及他们的船到底运的是些什么货。能不能让我也知道知道？
lines.textEn: You definitely know how TerraGroup and Paradigm Shipping are tied together, and what kind of cargo moves through those vessels. Mind sharing?

lines.textCh: 你知道 Paradigm 航运的情况吗？搞不好你这来过他们的船，或者知道该从哪下手查查他们的底？
lines.textEn: You know anything about Paradigm Shipping? Maybe you’ve got one of their ships here, or at least know where I should start looking?

lines.textCh: 有没有 Paradigm 航运公司相关的情报？这家公司绝对和 TerraGroup 有关系。
lines.textEn: You get any intel on a company called Paradigm Shipping? They’re definitely tied to TerraGroup somehow.

lines.textCh: 你听说过和 TerraGroup 合作的一家海运公司吗？应该是叫 Paradigm 航运。
lines.textEn: You ever hear about a maritime shipping company working with TerraGroup? Goes by the name Paradigm Shipping.

lines.textCh: 你知道 Paradigm 航运的事情吗？他们在本地都干些什么，说不定他们的员工来过你的办公室？
lines.textEn: Do you know anything about Paradigm Shipping’s operations? Maybe some of their employees passed through your office?

lines.textCh: 听说过 Paradigm 航运吗？以及这家公司和 TerraGroup 之间有什么关系？
lines.textEn: Do you know anything about Paradigm Shipping and their connection to TerraGroup?

lines.textCh: 我想查查 TerraGroup 关联公司的消息，可能是集团的承包商，或者商业伙伴。搞不好你听说过集团在本地的重大交易或者并购活动？
lines.textEn: I’m looking for information on TerraGroup contractors and possible business partners. Maybe you’ve heard about any major deals or mergers?

lines.textCh: 你就没去试着挖挖这单生意的底细？集团可不会无缘无故地就出资拿下这么大的一家公司。
lines.textEn: And you didn’t even try to dig into it? Companies don’t just swallow something that big for no reason.
