lines.textCh: 我当然是认真的，你有什么头绪吗？
lines.textEn: I do. You have something?

lines.textCh: 呃，早知道会这样，当初在队里的时候就多和通讯兵学两招了…
lines.textEn: Seems like I should’ve taken a couple lessons from our comms guy…

lines.textCh: 我承认刚刚是有点过分了，还是别浪费时间了，趁早行动起来吧。
lines.textEn: I admit I was wrong. Let’s not waste time and get to work.

lines.textCh: 我在城区里找到了一张海报，看样子和 TerraGroup 并购 Paradigm 航运公司的事情有关。你对这单生意了解多少？
lines.textEn: I found a poster in the city about the TerraGroup and Paradigm Shipping merger. You know anything about that deal?

lines.textCh: 早在几年前，TerraGroup 就收购了 Paradigm 航运的控股权。 这家公司实际上早就变成了 TerraGroup 的附庸。
lines.textEn: A few years back, TerraGroup acquired a controlling stake in Paradigm Shipping. In practice, the company became just another TerraGroup subsidiary.

lines.textCh: 也就是说，有一整支货运船队在集团掌控之下，随时可以把任何货物运往他们想要的任何地方？
lines.textEn: So they basically got a fleet under their control that’s ready to move whatever cargo they want?

lines.textCh: 这并不意味着集团在运输危险品方面享有任何特殊权利。 不过你我都明白 TerraGroup 是怎么看待官方法规的。
lines.textEn: That doesn’t give them any special rights when it comes to transporting hazardous materials. But you and I both know how TerraGroup treats official restrictions.

lines.textCh: 我相当怀疑他们买下整个航运公司的目的，恐怕不只是为了节约船运费用那么简单。
lines.textEn: Doubt they bought a carrier that big just to cut transport costs.

lines.textCh: 我注意到这个并购生意也有一会了。就算我特意查找相关信息，却还是一无所获——就连那些嗅觉最灵敏的调查记者也没有采取行动。 不过，我现在感觉，也许我们有机会自己把一切查清楚。
lines.textEn: I’ve been meaning to look into this for a while. I specifically searched for information, but even serious journalists haven’t produced a single investigation on the subject. Although now it feels like we might have a chance to figure it out ourselves.

lines.textCh: 你指的是？
lines.textEn: What do you mean?

lines.textCh: 实际上我试过打探背后的消息，不止一次。 但似乎除了我们没人觉得这桩生意有任何可疑之处。
lines.textEn: I actually tried more than once to find information on this. But it seems like no one besides us ever found that deal suspicious.

lines.textCh: 然后呢？你就这么收手了？你可不像是那种半途而废的人。
lines.textEn: And you just stopped looking? Didn’t think you’d give up that easily.

lines.textCh: 有时候我总觉得你是在试探别人的底线……但也许这回你能有机会让自己派上点用场。 你是真打算一起调查，还是只是口头说说而已？
lines.textEn: Sometimes it feels like you’re testing how far you can push things… But right now you could actually be useful. Do you want to investigate this or not?

lines.textCh: 你说呢，聪明鬼？
lines.textEn: What do you think, smartass?

lines.textCh: 那我劝你趁早滚蛋，等什么时候学会正常说话了再回来。
lines.textEn: Then leave and come back when you’re ready to talk properly.

lines.textCh: 这才像点样子。对于那家 Paradigm 航运公司，我或许有点线索。
lines.textEn: That sounds more like a serious conversation now. I might have a lead on Paradigm Shipping.

lines.textCh: 什么样的线索？
lines.textEn: What kind of lead?

lines.textCh: 就在前天，我截到了一条来自海上的求救信号，显然不是军队的人发出来的。看样子是有一艘大型船只被困在封锁区里了，而且自打城市被封锁以来一点消息都没出。 结果现在他们突然开始和塔科夫的人建立联络——你想想，有这么凑巧的事情吗？
lines.textEn: The day before yesterday I intercepted a distress signal coming from the water, clearly not military. It looks like a large vessel got stuck inside the blockade perimeter and hasn’t shown any signs of life this whole time. And now they’ve suddenly established contact with someone in Tarkov.

lines.textCh: 他们具体都说了些什么？
lines.textEn: What were they talking about?

lines.textCh: 不知道，我的设备不是用来拦截海上通讯的，况且信号强度实在是有点弱。但你应该能帮我解决这个问题。
lines.textEn: I don’t know. My setup wasn’t meant for intercepting maritime comms, and the signal is weak. You could help with that, however.

lines.textCh: 我具体要做些什么？
lines.textEn: What needs to be done?

lines.textCh: 没什么难的。森林保护区西北部有一座信号塔，那个地方能接收到更稳定的信号。你只要去把哪里的设备给修好就行。
lines.textEn: Nothing complicated. There’s a communications tower in the northwestern part of the nature reserve that can give us a cleaner signal. That’s what needs to be repaired.

lines.textCh: 你应该不会指望我是什么网络系统专家吧？
lines.textEn: You don’t expect me to know anything about network systems, do you?

lines.textCh: 别担心，这种简单的维修活你应该应付的来。
lines.textEn: Don’t worry. Your skills are enough for a simple repair like this.

lines.textCh: 能再提醒我一下信号塔在哪吗？
lines.textEn: Remind me where it is, please?

lines.textCh: Priozersk 自然保护区北边，你要找的是一座红白相间的通讯基站，离 Scav 地堡不远。
lines.textEn: Northern part of the Priozersk nature reserve. Look for a red-and-white cellular tower, not far from the Scav bunker.

lines.textCh: 嘿，事情是这样的。我在藏身处的无线电拦截到了一段奇怪的信号，但根本无法识别出任何有用的东西。但听起来像是求救信号。你最近收到过类似的信号吗？
lines.textEn: Hey, so I intercepted a strange signal, but couldn’t make anything out. It sounded like a distress call. You heard anything like that recently?

lines.textCh: 没错。你会赚到一笔不错的报酬，说不定还能知道点拿钱换不到的东西。
lines.textEn: Yes. You’ll make good money, and you might learn something even more valuable.

lines.textCh: 不像是什么节省开支的举措啊…
lines.textEn: This doesn’t look like a simple cost-cutting acquisition…

lines.textCh: 没错，我也收到过。但就算是用我的设备处理过了之后，还是有太多杂音。
lines.textEn: Yeah, I picked it up too. But even with my equipment, there was too much noise.

lines.textCh: 也就是说：什么都没听出来？
lines.textEn: Nothing at all?

lines.textCh: 我可没不会这么说。信号是从外海来的。看样子有一艘船被困在了封锁区里，诡异的是，他们在此期间一直保持无线电静默。 结果现在船员不仅突然打破了静默，开始向外界发送信号，甚至还在和什么人密切联系。
lines.textEn: I didn’t say that. The signal came from the water. Looks like a ship got stuck inside the blockade and stayed silent all this time. But now the crew has not only suddenly made contact, but is actively communicating with someone.

lines.textCh: 你觉得发送信号的会是什么人呢？
lines.textEn: Any idea who it might be?

lines.textCh: 这艘船肯定不是军方的——信号制式不像，也就是说，它很有可能是 Paradigm 航运旗下的货船。
lines.textEn: The vessel is definitely not military, which means it could very well be one of Paradigm Shipping’s cargo ships.

lines.textCh: 这家公司是干什么的？
lines.textEn: What do they do?

lines.textCh: 海上货运。公司和 TerraGroup 之间的关系才是重点：早在几年前，TerraGroup 就把他们收购了。 现在你明白我的意思了吧？
lines.textEn: Maritime cargo transport. But what matters more is their connection to TerraGroup. A few years ago, TerraGroup bought them out. You see where I’m going with this?

lines.textCh: 你是指望能从什么神秘的货船上搜出 TerraGroup 的劲爆材料来吗？
lines.textEn: You’re hoping to find valuable TerraGroup materials on some random cargo ship?

lines.textCh: 现在就下结论未免为时过早了。但我不会就这样无视这段信号。 就算船上没有任何稀罕东西，至少上面的电子设备应该还是好的——那艘船距离市中心的原爆点足够远，EMP 应该不会彻底瘫痪船上的设备。
lines.textEn: Too early to draw conclusions. But I’m not going to ignore this signal. Even if there’s nothing rare onboard, the electronics might have survived the EMP. It was far enough from ground zero.

lines.textCh: 我可不觉得船员会乖乖地把船交出来。
lines.textEn: Doubt the crew will just hand the ship over.

lines.textCh: 事情总有商量的余地。 如果他们不识趣的话，就该轮到你这种佣兵上场的时候了。
lines.textEn: There’s almost always a way to negotiate. And when there isn’t, that’s where people like you come in.

lines.textCh: 你想让我帮忙？
lines.textEn: You want my help?

lines.textCh: 你应该不想错过这么一个深入了解 TerraGroup 在本地行动的机会， 我说的没错吧？
lines.textEn: I don’t think you’d want to miss a chance to learn more about TerraGroup’s operations. Am I wrong?

lines.textCh: 是啊，我确实想知道。但首先我们至少多掌握点那艘船以及船上通讯的情报才行。
lines.textEn: Oh no, you’re right. But first we need more info about the ship and those communications.

lines.textCh: 我的设备不适合用来监听海事信号。 但如果我们能连上森林里那座信号塔的话，说不定能有些不同的发现。
lines.textEn: My equipment isn’t tuned for maritime signals. But if we connect to the communications tower in Priozersk, I can work something out.

lines.textCh: 你需要我去做些什么？
lines.textEn: What do you need from me?

lines.textCh: 好吧，我干。你知道那艘船在哪吗？
lines.textEn: Alright, I’m in. Do you know where the ship is?

lines.textCh: 你难道忘了他们发出的信号吗？首先我们得找出船员到底是在和谁通话，然后才能搜集关于那艘船的情报。
lines.textEn: You already forgot about the transmissions? First we identify who the crew is talking to and gather more intel on the vessel.

lines.textCh: 把自然保护区里的通讯基站给修好。这活不需要什么特殊工具，带上最常见的工具套件就行。
lines.textEn: Restore the cellular tower in the nature reserve. No special tools needed, just a standard toolset will do.

lines.textCh: 我具体该上哪去找？
lines.textEn: Where do I look for it exactly?

lines.textCh: 森林西北部，Scav 地堡附近，就是个红白相间的信号塔，最普通的那种。
lines.textEn: Northwestern part of the forest, near the Scav bunker. It’s a standard red-and-white tower.

lines.textCh: 我很确定他们的目的没这么单纯。 老实说，网上居然没有任何人深入调查这桩生意，本身就让我挺意外的。
lines.textEn: I’m certain of that. Honestly, I’m surprised there hasn’t been a single serious investigation about it online.

lines.textCh: 你为什么对 TerraGroup 搞货运这么感兴趣？你可不像是什么立志于揭露集团真面目的斗士。
lines.textEn: Why do you even care about TerraGroup shipping? You don’t strike me as someone trying to expose them.

lines.textCh: 搞不好船上有大批电子设备躲过了 EMP 袭击，我关心的主要是这个。 但如果你真的想深挖 TerraGroup 的底细，这也多少算是个机会。
lines.textEn: I’m primarily interested in the equipment and electronics that might’ve survived the EMP. But if you yourself want to learn more about TerraGroup, this is a good opportunity.

lines.textCh: 好吧，那你是怎么打算的？
lines.textEn: Alright. What’s your plan?

lines.textCh: 首先，我们必须收集那艘船的情报，以及查出船员到底是在和谁通话。
lines.textEn: First, we gather more information about the ship and whoever the crew is talking to.

lines.textCh: 你想让我截住这帮人的下一次通讯？
lines.textEn: You want to intercept the next transmission?

lines.textCh: 没错。但如果我们不改进设备的话，他们的信号还是会一样弱，这样一来所有的机会就都白费了。 如果你能修复森林保护区里那座信号塔的话，也许我们能搞点名堂出来。
lines.textEn: Yes. But without improvements, the signal will remain weak. If you restore the communications tower in Priozersk, I’ll be able to work with it.

lines.textCh: 我具体该上哪去找？
lines.textEn: Where do I look for it exactly?

lines.textCh: 森林西北部，Scav 地堡附近。 就是个红白相间的信号塔。
lines.textEn: Northwestern part of the forest, near the Scav bunker. It’s a standard red-and-white tower.

lines.textCh: 我把信号塔给修好了，现在应该一切都正常了。
lines.textEn: I fixed the tower. Everything should be working now.

lines.textCh: 听起来游荡者不像是要去救人的样子。
lines.textEn: Doesn’t sound like the Rogues are planning to rescue anyone.

lines.textCh: 活干的没问题，我已经成功拦截到了另一波通讯。
lines.textEn: You did everything correctly. I already managed to intercept another transmission.

lines.textCh: 有什么发现？
lines.textEn: And?

lines.textCh: 老实说，没什么太大收获。船员在和 Knight 通话，就是那群游荡者的老大。
lines.textEn: Nothing great, if I’m honest. The crew was talking to Knight, the Rogues commander.

lines.textCh: 这个 Knight 到底是什么人？
lines.textEn: Who’s that Knight guy?

lines.textCh: 我了解的不多。 和其他 USEC 不一样，这家伙早在契约战争打得如火如荼的时候就脱离指挥单干了。 至于塔科夫后来发生的灾难更是助长了他的势头，越来越多的前雇佣兵被他招募过去，这群“游荡者”最后发展成了本地一大祸害。最好小心些。
lines.textEn: I don’t know much. Unlike the others, he broke away from command on his own during the Contract Wars. The Tarkov disaster only helped him gather more fighters and become a serious threat. Be careful around him.

lines.textCh: 更像是想把船上还有用的东西都抢回来， 或者他们知道了些我们还没掌握的情况。
lines.textEn: More likely they want to take whatever is useful from the ship. Or they know something we don’t.

lines.textCh: 无论如何，我们都必须快点行动了。但我也没法盲目行事。
lines.textEn: Either way, we need to move fast. But I’m not going in blind.

lines.textCh: 你说得对。所以我们这么办：我继续在网上深挖他们的底细；你呢，就负责实地调查吧。 但港口你肯定是进不去的——军队早就把那里围起来了。
lines.textEn: You’re right. Let’s do it this way: I’ll dig for information online, you work on the ground. But you won’t be able to get into the port terminal.

lines.textCh: 那卸货场或者办公室呢？我记得海关一座大楼上就有这家公司的标记，从那开始查？
lines.textEn: What about unloading zones or offices? I think there was a terminal with their logo at the customs territory.

lines.textCh: 我不觉得整个地方被 Scav 洗劫过之后还能有什么东西剩下… 等等，去灯塔的那个火车站看看吧。Paradigm 承运的大部分货物都会通过那里。
lines.textEn: Unlikely anything is still there… Try the railway station near the lighthouse. Most of their cargo passed through there.

lines.textCh: 具体在哪？
lines.textEn: Where is it exactly?

lines.textCh: 靠近污水处理厂，尽头有墙围起来的地方。 没必要挨个搜集装箱，去看看火车站旁边的厂房吧，里面说不定还留着些文件。
lines.textEn: Beyond the water treatment plant. There’s no point searching containers themselves, but the nearby hangar might still have documents.

lines.textCh: 我在厂房里找到了一条奇怪的指示。在某艘船驻泊期间，大多数职员被明令禁止登船。这帮人肯定是在隐瞒什么。
lines.textEn: I found a strange directive in the hangar. During one ship’s stay, access for most personnel was revoked. They were definitely hiding something.

lines.textCh: 让我猜猜… 是 Boreas 号吧？
lines.textEn: Let me guess. “Boreas”?

lines.textCh: 你也查到相关的情报了？
lines.textEn: You found something too?

lines.textCh: 没错。但问题在于，Boreas 号从未入港。 当 TerraGroup 的丑闻败露之后，这艘船就被拒之门外了。
lines.textEn: Yeah. But the thing is, “Boreas” never reached the port. It was blocked outside Tarkov when the TerraGroup scandal started.

lines.textCh: 也就是说，整艘船和上面的船员在封锁期间一直被困在这里？
lines.textEn: The ship and crew stayed trapped in the blockade this whole time?

lines.textCh: 是的，我看他们再撑一段时间也完全不成问题，事实上这艘船的自持能力比你想象的要夸张的多。这是艘破冰船，还不是普通的那种。
lines.textEn: Yes. And it could’ve stayed there much longer. It’s an icebreaker, and not an ordinary one.

lines.textCh: 有什么特别之处吗？
lines.textEn: What’s the catch?

lines.textCh: 我找来了它的采购记录和已知航线。 而这艘 Boreas 号大部分时间里要么是完全自主地在北极海域穿行，要么就是往返于北方各个港口之间。 破冰船一般负责为北海航线上开道，
lines.textEn: I reviewed its procurement history and known routes. But “Boreas” spent most of its time either on autonomous Arctic expeditions or traveling between northern ports. Icebreakers are usually used to open routes along the Northern Sea Route.

lines.textCh: 不会 TerraGroup 凑巧在每个港口都有办事处吧 ？
lines.textEn: And TerraGroup has offices in all those ports, right?

lines.textCh: 正是如此，但我们对它北极远征的目的以及具体航线一无所知， 完全没有任何情报。
lines.textEn: Exactly. But there’s zero information about those expeditions or their purpose. Nothing at all.

lines.textCh: 你知道那艘船在哪吗？我怎么才能上船？
lines.textEn: Do you know where the ship is and how I can get there?

lines.textCh: 我们分工一下吧：我会为你查出那艘破冰船的坐标，你自己搞定上船的办法。 想想在塔科夫还有有谁能搞到车辆载具。
lines.textEn: Let’s split the work: I’ll determine the exact location of the icebreaker, and you figure out how to reach it. Think about who still has access to working vehicles.

lines.textCh: 能帮我个忙吗？具体的细节还不太清楚，但我现在得想办法搞到交通工具才行。
lines.textEn: Can you help me with something? I can't share the details yes, but I really could use a transport right now.

lines.textCh: 能不能想办法把我弄到海湾里的一艘船上去？
lines.textEn: Can you help me board a certain ship in the gulf?

lines.textCh: 能不能想办法把我弄到海湾里的一艘船上去？用船或者其他的交通工具。
lines.textEn: Do you have any transport to help me get onto a ship in the gulf?

lines.textCh: 芬兰湾里停了艘船在那，我想上去瞧瞧。搞不好你这有条摩托艇什么的？
lines.textEn: I need to board a ship in the Gulf of Finland. Do you have a spare motor boat, maybe?

lines.textCh: 我需要运输方面的帮助。你认识谁能把我送到芬兰湾那边的一艘船上？
lines.textEn: I need help with a transport. Do you have anyone who could get me onto a ship in the gulf?

lines.textCh: 抱歉，伙计，我可不想掺和那种烂事。
lines.textEn: Apologies mate, I’m not getting into that mess.

lines.textCh: 上别的地方打听去。
lines.textEn: Ask someone else.

lines.textCh: 你是搞运输的吧？你那边有船吗？我需要出海，去海湾那边找一艘船。
lines.textEn: You deal with transport, right? Any chance you’ve got a boat? I need to reach a ship out in the gulf.

lines.textCh: 我需要找点不一样的交通工具去搞定一项差事。你能帮忙吗？
lines.textEn: I need some unusual transport for a job. Can you help?

lines.textCh: 这事和我无关。我什么都不知道。
lines.textEn: This matter does not concern me. I know nothing about it.

lines.textCh: 我在找交通工具，而且不是常见的那种，你能帮忙吗？
lines.textEn: I need some unusual transport. Can you help with that?

lines.textCh: 我需要找人带我一程，你能帮忙吗？
lines.textEn: I need transport. Can you help?

lines.textCh: 那你为什么不直接去找那个开 BTR 的？你把我当成什么人了，上我这打车来了？
lines.textEn: Then why didn’t you go straight to the BTR guy? What am I, a taxi service?

lines.textCh: 帮忙？你？算了，我劝你趁早滚蛋，我“帮”你帮得可是够多了！
lines.textEn: Help? You? No, thanks. I’ve already “helped” you enough!

lines.textCh: 既然你说到做到，那我也会尽力帮忙。说吧，你这是打算去哪，一般去找你那个 BTR 司机不就行了吗？
lines.textEn: You keep your word, so I’ll help if I can. Where are you headed, and why didn’t you just go to the BTR driver?

lines.textCh: 你说啥呢，兄弟。我刚刚勉强把这辆 BTR 修好，哪有精力搞船。
lines.textEn: Nah man. I barely got this BTR back on its feet, no time for boats.

lines.textCh: 你脸皮还真够厚的啊？以为我不知道你当时站在 Skier 那边？
lines.textEn: You got some nerve, you know that? Thought I wouldn’t find out you sided with Skier back then?

lines.textCh: 哥们，如果是为了你的事，我就算用铁皮拼也要给你拼一艘出来！不过你估计等不了那么久吧。
lines.textEn: Brother, for you I’d build one out of scrap if I had to! But you’re probably not ready to wait that long.

lines.textCh: 整个基地太大了，单靠我一个人可没法彻底肃清整个地方。
lines.textEn: I can’t physically guarantee full security on a site that big.

lines.textCh: 所以，直升机的事情有消息了吗？
lines.textEn: So, any news on the chopper?

lines.textCh: 有，还是你妈天大的好消息！明明储备站里还有敌人，你却发信号让我的人进去了，你是脑子缺根筋还是怎么的？！
lines.textEn: Yeah, great fucking news! Why the hell did you give my guys the green light while there were still hostiles there?!

lines.textCh: 我把能找到的敌人都消灭干净了。如果你指望我给整个军事基地来上一场大清洗，那好像是你们军队的职责吧。
lines.textEn: I took out everyone I found. If you expected a full sweep of the whole military base, that’s on you.

lines.textCh: 怎么干活是你的问题，不是我的！我的机师迎面撞上了 Glukhar 手下的那帮人——你管这个叫他妈的“安全”？ 还好我的人不是和你们这些 PMC 一样的废物，要不然就逃不出来了！
lines.textEn: How you do the job isn’t my problem! My techs ran into Glukhar’s boys. Is that your idea of “safe”? If they were any greener, they wouldn’t have made it out!

lines.textCh: 万幸你的人不是废物，所以他们找到你要的东西了没有？
lines.textEn: Good thing they’re not green then. Did they get what they needed?

lines.textCh: 找到了个屁！我可不会再把他们送回那个屠宰场里去了，明白了没？ 你自己搞出来的烂摊子，现在就交给你来收场，自己提着脑袋去储备站里找吧。
lines.textEn: As if! And I’m not sending them back into a meat grinder, got it? You’ll risk your own ass and find it yourself.

lines.textCh: 行吧，所以我到底要找什么东西？
lines.textEn: Fine. What am I looking for?

lines.textCh: 特种润滑油，标着 AMG-10 的那种。要么是罐装的，要么就是成箱的。 别他妈想着拿普通机油糊弄我！
lines.textEn: Special lubricant. AMG-10. Comes in canisters or crates. And don’t you dare bring me regular engine oil!

lines.textCh: 那我该上哪去找？
lines.textEn: Where do I find it?

lines.textCh: 上哪，哪……蠢问题一个接一个。兵营中央广场，停着米里直升机的那个地方，在周边找找，或者看看火车站周围堆着的货物里有没有。 如果你还想搭我的宝贝直升机，你就自己去搞明白。
lines.textEn: Where, where… Check near the MI bird on the barracks square, or look through the cargo by the train platforms. If you really want my chopper, you’ll figure it out.

lines.textCh: 虽然我讨厌你找借口的样子，但你说的有点道理。 还好我派出去的人不是什么菜鸟，他们遇到状况后就及时撤出来了。
lines.textEn: You piss me off, but you’re right. Good thing I sent experienced guys. They pulled back in time.

lines.textCh: 所以他们拿到货物了吗？
lines.textEn: Did they manage to grab the cargo?

lines.textCh: 没有，他们在路上被 Glukhar 那帮人截住了， 我可不会再把宝贵的机修师送进那个地方了。既然是你提出来的要用那架直升机，那就由你负责搞定这件事。
lines.textEn: Nope. Glukhar’s boys caught them on the approach. And I’m not sending valuable techs again. You want it, you go.

lines.textCh: 好了，那我要找的是什么？
lines.textEn: Alright. What do I need?

lines.textCh: 特种润滑油，也叫液压油，AMG-10 型号的。 一般是罐装的，或者装在其他容器里。没了这东西就没法飞。
lines.textEn: Special lubricant, called AMG-10. Usually stored in canisters or containers. Can’t fly without it.

lines.textCh: 你的机修师原本打算上哪找这东西来着？
lines.textEn: Where were your techs planning to find it?

lines.textCh: 去军营广场上那架米里直升机周围看看吧， 如果那里没有的话，到火车站平台那边的仓库找找。哦，对了，搞不好军事学院的地下室里有，你应该知道的，标着黑主教棋子的那栋楼。
lines.textEn: Check near the MI bird on the barracks square. If it’s not there, try the platforms, cargo areas, maybe the academy basement. You know, Black Bishop.

lines.textCh: 为什么上船的时候不能坐直升机进去？
lines.textEn: Why won’t they do the insertion?

lines.textCh: 你认真的？到底是什么原因？
lines.textEn: Are you serious? What’s the problem?

lines.textCh: 我把润滑油给你的直升机找来了。(上交 AMG-10)
lines.textEn: I’ve brought the oil for your helicopter. (Hand over the AMG-10)

lines.textCh: 把东西放在门口吧，我会让狗腿们把直升机整备好的。
lines.textEn: Leave it by the entrance. I’ll have the boys prep the bird.

lines.textCh: 那我们什么时候起飞？
lines.textEn: When do we fly?

lines.textCh: 情况是这样的……我和飞行员谈了一下，所以我直说好了： 他们不会贸然飞到那艘船上的，我们对船上的情况一无所知。
lines.textEn: Here’s the situation… I talked to the pilots. I’ll be straight with you: they’re not flying to some unknown ship.

lines.textCh: 那我折腾这一通到底是为了什么？！
lines.textEn: Then what the hell was all that for?!

lines.textCh: 冷静点，行吗？我又不是在拿你寻开心。 你会坐上那架直升机的，只不过仅限撤离的时候。进去的时候你就自己想其他办法吧。 进去的时候你就自己想其他办法吧。
lines.textEn: Calm down, alright? I’m not screwing you over. You’ll get the chopper, but only for extraction from the ship. To get in, you’ll have to figure something else out.

lines.textCh: 简直他妈的完美！
lines.textEn: Fucking fantastic!

lines.textCh: 是啊，太完美了。 所以这直升机你是坐还是不坐？
lines.textEn: Fantastic, yeah. So, you taking the chopper or not?

lines.textCh: 算了，坐还是要坐的。
lines.textEn: I’ll take it.

lines.textCh: 你会坐上那架直升机的，只不过仅限撤离的时候。 进去的时候你就自己想其他办法吧。
lines.textEn: You’ll get the chopper, but only for extraction from the ship. To get in, you’ll have to figure something else out.

lines.textCh: 为什么上船的时候不能坐直升机进去？
lines.textEn: What’s the issue with insertion?

lines.textCh: 风险太高了。谁也不知道船上到底是什么人，搞不好直升机都会折进去，还要搭上整个机组。 我可没有后备飞行员。
lines.textEn: Too risky. There’s no telling who’s dug in on that ship. I could lose the bird, crew included. And I don’t have spare pilots.

lines.textCh: 这是他们告诉你的，还是单纯你自己不想冒这个险？
lines.textEn: Is that what they told you, or you just don’t want to risk your heli?

lines.textCh: 这重要吗？ 所以这直升机你是坐还是不坐？
lines.textEn: Doesn’t matter. So, you taking the heli or not?

lines.textCh: 行吧。
lines.textEn: Alright.

lines.textCh: 那就听好了。 直升机只能在合适的停机坪上起降。你说的那条船上最好是有这样的地方。 把地方清空，打上一颗信号弹，然后直升机就会来接你了。
lines.textEn: Then listen up. The chopper can only pick you up from a proper landing zone. Hope your ship’s got one. Clear it, pop a signal flare, and the bird will come in.

lines.textCh: 这样就行了？
lines.textEn: Is that it?

lines.textCh: 还有一件事， 别忘了带钱。直升机每次出动都是要花钱的，别逼我们把你扔在船上。
lines.textEn: One more thing. Don’t forget to bring cash. Every flight costs money.

lines.textCh: 我带来了你要的滤波器。
lines.textEn: I brought the filters you asked for.

lines.textCh: 出门的时候交给我的手下就行。
lines.textEn: Hand them over to my guys on the way out.

lines.textCh: 所以现在我们能聊聊你那架直升机的事情了？
lines.textEn: So now we can talk about your helicopter?

lines.textCh: 好了，我们是可以谈谈。首先，那架飞机还需要维护。 以及，不，我不会让你靠近那架飞机的，想都别想。
lines.textEn: Alright, we can talk. First, it needs maintenance. And no, I’m not letting you anywhere near a machine like that.

lines.textCh: 所以我只要等着就好了？
lines.textEn: So I just have to wait?

lines.textCh: 啥？你是不是还指望我派人给你的藏身处送瓶啤酒，免得你等得无聊了？ 门都没有，菜鸟！
lines.textEn: What, you want me to send you a beer to your hideout so you don’t get bored? No chance, rookie!

lines.textCh: 那到底要做什么才行？
lines.textEn: Then what needs to be done?

lines.textCh: 去储备站好好找找，给我弄一种航空润滑油回来，叫 AMG-10 的那种。 要么是用罐子装的，要么就是在特殊的容器里。
lines.textEn: Check the Reserve base. You’ll need aviation oil, called AMG-10. It’s stored in canisters or special containers.

lines.textCh: 那我具体该上哪儿去找？
lines.textEn: And where exactly should I look for it?

lines.textCh: 你是不是以为帮我干了点活，自己就有资格来和我谈条件，让我帮你把一切都准备好了？ 你想搭直升机，就用用脑子，自己去找！
lines.textEn: You really think that after everything you’ve done I’m going to help you with your job too? You want the helicopter, use your head and find it yourself.

lines.textCh: 所以，怎么说？难道交易就这么泡汤了？
lines.textEn: So what, the deal’s off?

lines.textCh: 我找到了直升机需要的那种润滑油。(上交 AMG-10)
lines.textEn: I brought the oil for the helicopter. (Hand over the AMG-10)

lines.textCh: 干得漂亮！ 把东西留在门口那吧，我会让狗腿们来接手的，不过关于那架直升机，还有一件事。
lines.textEn: Nice work! Leave it at the entrance, I’ll pass it to my guys. But there’s one other thing about the helicopter.

lines.textCh: 嗯？
lines.textEn: Hm?

lines.textCh: 我就直接告诉你吧：我们对那艘船的情况一无所知，为了搭你一程就直奔那里实在是太冒险了。 我和飞行员谈过了，他们也同意我的意见。
lines.textEn: I’ll tell you straight: it’s too dangerous to drop you onto some unknown ship. I talked to the pilots, and they agree.

lines.textCh: 所以问题到底出在哪？
lines.textEn: What exactly is the issue?

lines.textCh: 要是船上的人突然朝直升机开火怎么办？ 你自己愿意冒这个险是一回事，但我没法在这种情况下贸然派我的飞行员和直升机陪你一起送死。
lines.textEn: What if someone on that ship starts shooting at the helicopter? You taking risks is one thing, but I can’t send my pilots and the machine in blind.

lines.textCh: 好吧，那你说怎么办？我总得想办法登船才行。
lines.textEn: So what do you suggest? I still need to get on that ship.

lines.textCh: 我会让你搭上直升机的，但只有撤离的时候能出动，也就是你确保船上已经安全之后才行。 至于登船这一趟，你还是另想办法吧，对不住了。
lines.textEn: I’ll give you the helicopter, but only for extraction, when things are already safe. For insertion, you’ll have to find another way. Sorry.

lines.textCh: 行吧，如果我打算出来，那我该怎么呼叫直升机？
lines.textEn: Alright. How do I call it in once I’m there?

lines.textCh: 首先，找一块合适的停机坪——如果那艘船真的像你说的那样，船上应该有类似的地方。 保证周边安全之后，再打一颗信号弹就行了。
lines.textEn: First find a proper landing zone. There should be one on the ship. Make sure it’s secure, then fire a signal flare.

lines.textCh: 还有其他条件吗？
lines.textEn: Anything else?

lines.textCh: 记得随身带些钱，上飞机前付给飞行员。 虽然你之前的确信守承诺，但我可不会白耗油料带着你到处飞。
lines.textEn: Bring some cash with you and pay the pilots. You kept your word before, but I’m not flying you around for free.

lines.textCh: 我已经把那些走私者的营地给清理干净，你和他们谈了吗？
lines.textEn: I cleared the smugglers’ camps. Did you talk to them?

lines.textCh: 谈了，要不是你出动把营地里的那些人赶跑，他们肯定理都不理你。
lines.textEn: Yeah. And if it wasn’t for you, they wouldn’t have even bothered talking.

lines.textCh: 所以他们愿意提供交通工具了？
lines.textEn: So they’re ready to provide transport?

lines.textCh: 是的，他们有一艘气垫船，到时候会在海岸线那接你，不过有一个额外的条件。
lines.textEn: Yup. They’ve got a hovercraft. They’ll pick you up from the coast. But there’s a catch.

lines.textCh: 他们那艘船很多地方都要用，而且谁也不知道你那艘船上有什么等着你。所以他们只愿意把你送过去，不负责接你回来。
lines.textEn: They need that craft in a lot of places, and nobody knows what’s waiting on that ship of yours. So they’re only willing to drop you off, not pick you back up.

lines.textCh: 管杀不管埋是吧，这有什么用？
lines.textEn: And how is that supposed to help me?

lines.textCh: 你爱怎么想怎么想。他们可不会干等着，等你把船翻个底朝天再接你回去。条件就是这么开的，现在也没有更好的选择。
lines.textEn: Call it what you want. They’re not sticking around while you poke through every corner out there. Those are the terms, and you’re not getting a better deal right now.

lines.textCh: 所以我得另外想办法才能下船了。
lines.textEn: So I'll have to find another way to exfil from the ship.

lines.textCh: 所以问题是什么？
lines.textEn: What catch?

lines.textCh: 是这样没错，但起码他们会送你上船，别担心。准备好了之后就去海岸线的游艇码头，或者污水处理厂旁边的海边小屋吧。
lines.textEn: Yup. But they'll do your infil, don't worry. When you're ready, head to the pier on the shore or the sea cottages near the water treatment plant.

lines.textCh: 还有其他条件吗？
lines.textEn: Anything else to know?

lines.textCh: 明白了，我会记得带一套专用工具来，免得半路出岔子。而且普通的工具还派不上用场，真是活见鬼！
lines.textEn: I'd bring something to repair their boat if something goes wrong. But not a regular toolset, that definitely won't help!

lines.textCh: 成交。
lines.textEn: Deal.

lines.textCh: 想不想帮我找出那些引发爆炸的元凶？
lines.textEn: Wanna help me find those who caused the explosion?

lines.textCh: 你提到过，关于那个 EMP 装置的事情，你想和我做笔交易。
lines.textEn: You were saying you had a proposition for me about that EMP device.

lines.textCh: 不，我想自己留着。
lines.textEn: No, the fragment stays with me.

lines.textCh: 也可以吧，我不强求。
lines.textEn: You call. I won’t insist.

lines.textCh: 太棒了，我已经提前准备好了钱。
lines.textEn: Excellent. I prepared the cash beforehand.

lines.textCh: 好吧，就这样。现在我真的帮不上什么忙了。
lines.textEn: Well, that’s it. Now I really can’t help you further.

lines.textCh: 我需要找出是爆炸的元凶到底是谁。
lines.textEn: I need to find who caused the explosion.

lines.textCh: 不，我觉得这是不可能的事情。
lines.textEn: No. I don’t think that’s even possible.

lines.textCh: 恐怕办不到。大部分线索可能早就消失了。
lines.textEn: Doubt you’ll be able to. All traces are long gone, most likely.

lines.textCh: 说不定其他人知道情况呢？
lines.textEn: Could somebody else know something?

lines.textCh: Prapor 也许了解一二。但我很怀疑他会不会承认，祝你调查好运吧，雇佣兵。
lines.textEn: Prapor, perhaps. But I doubt he’d admit it. Good luck in your investigation, mercenary.

lines.textCh: 我愿意出高价买下它。现金在塔科夫可比这么个东西有用多了。
lines.textEn: I’m ready to pay you well. In Tarkov, money’s worth more than this scrap.

lines.textCh: 我把弹药带来了，你应该能用得上。
lines.textEn: I brought the ammo. That should help.

lines.textCh: 放在那边的空座上吧。
lines.textEn: Drop it on the empty seat.

lines.textCh: 现在呢？
lines.textEn: Now what?

lines.textCh: 现在你得证明自己不是在给 Skier 跑腿才行。
lines.textEn: Now you prove you’re not running errands for Skier.

lines.textCh: 怎么证明？
lines.textEn: How do I do that?

lines.textCh: 去搞他，狠狠干他娘的一票。
lines.textEn: You mess with him. Properly.

lines.textCh: 你有什么好主意？
lines.textEn: Any nice ideas?

lines.textCh: 不止是“主意”，我可是准备好了一整套计划！现在他正等着城里南边各个藏匿点发回的报告，有个跑腿的在替他收集这些东西。
lines.textEn: More than that. I’ve got a whole plan! Right now he’s waiting on reports from all his stashes in the southern part of the city, got a runner collecting them.

lines.textCh: 你是想让我把那人干掉？
lines.textEn: You want me to take him out?

lines.textCh: 不用那么麻烦。那个狗腿之前在海关附近被人惊动了，于是把文件藏起来以防万一。那小子早就跑没影了，但把文件夹给落下了。
lines.textEn: Even simpler. Someone already spooked him near customs. He stashed the documents just in case. The kid got away, but left the folder behind.

lines.textCh: 所以我要在这人回去拿到文件之前把东西截住？
lines.textEn: So I intercept it before he gets back?

lines.textCh: 对，不过还不够。
lines.textEn: Yeah. But that’s not all.

lines.textCh: 你还要我做什么？
lines.textEn: What else?

lines.textCh: 把那些文件毁了。让 Skier 永远拿不到他的情报。把它们烧掉，在海关拿到文件之后就直接开始烧！
lines.textEn: You destroy those documents. Make sure Skier never finds them. Burn them right there at customs!

lines.textCh: 明白。所以我要上哪去找那堆东西？
lines.textEn: Got it. Where do I find them?

lines.textCh: 他从有实验室的那栋楼——你们雇佣兵管它叫医疗楼的那个地方——往烂尾工地跑的时候，本地的混混突然开火，把他给逼进中间的那些土沟里了，文件应该就在那附近。
lines.textEn: He got pinned down in a ravine, running from the lab building toward construction. They’ll be somewhere around there.

lines.textCh: 海岸线那边的呢？
lines.textEn: How do I find the shoreline camp?

lines.textCh: 行。什么时候能给我消息？
lines.textEn: Alright. When can I expect news from you?

lines.textCh: 我已经把 Skier 的报告处理掉了。
lines.textEn: I got rid of Skier’s reports.

lines.textCh: 你确定是按我说的把它们彻底烧掉了？
lines.textEn: You burned them like I said?

lines.textCh: 烧了。现在你该帮我了吧？
lines.textEn: Yeah. Now you help me?

lines.textCh: 行吧……或许以后还能再合作。至于运输，走私者那边也许有办法，但他们不会白帮你。
lines.textEn: Fine, maybe we can work together again, someday… As for transport, the smugglers might have something. But they won’t help you for free.

lines.textCh: 这我能想到。我需要做什么？
lines.textEn: Well, that’s expected. What do I need to do?

lines.textCh: 听说最近有不少外人跑到他们海岸线和立交桥那边的营地晃悠。你把那些人清理掉，我就跟他们说是你帮的忙。
lines.textEn: Heard they’ve had a lot of outsiders showing up at their camps on the shore and interchange. You clear them out, I’ll tell them it was you who helped.

lines.textCh: 立交桥那个营地怎么找？
lines.textEn: How do I find the interchange camp?

lines.textCh: 从 Ultra 正门出来，过马路，再过一条铁轨就看到了。整个营地是用集装箱搭起来的，有大铁棚子、帐篷，还有一些临时搭的破屋子。那边有个红星标记，很显眼。
lines.textEn: Head out from Ultra, cross the road and the railway, you’ll run straight into it. Container camp, big canopy, tents, makeshift shacks. There’s a red star marking it, you won’t miss it.

lines.textCh: 海岸线不是有条路通往海关方向么？从疗养院东楼出发，往海关方向下坡，有一大片空地。过了那片地之后，你会看到几个棚屋和一些集装箱围起来的地方，那里就是了。
lines.textEn: Go down from the health resort toward customs, there’s a big open field. Past that you’ll see a few hangars with shipping containers.

lines.textCh: 等你把事办完回来，我这边也差不多有消息了。不过你要是想听到好消息，就别拖拖拉拉的。
lines.textEn: By the time you’re done and back, I’ll have info for you. But don’t drag your feet if you want good news.

lines.textCh: 我已经把那些走私者的营地清理干净了。
lines.textEn: I cleared the smugglers’ camps.

lines.textCh: 看来你还有点机会把我的信任挣回来……今后再说吧。
lines.textEn: Maybe you’ve actually got a shot at earning my trust back. Someday…

lines.textCh: 走私者那边呢？你跟他们谈了吗？
lines.textEn: What about the smugglers? You talked to them?

lines.textCh: 谈了。他们有一艘气垫船。不过有个条件。
lines.textEn: Yeah. They’ve got a hovercraft. But there’s a catch.

lines.textCh: 所以问题是什么？
lines.textEn: What catch?

lines.textCh: 那帮走私的只负责把你送过去。没人会在那儿傻等你办完事再把你接回来。
lines.textEn: The smugglers will only handle your insertion. No one’s gonna be waiting around for you to finish your business and come back.

lines.textCh: 等等，那我怎么回来？
lines.textEn: Wait, what? How am I supposed to get back?

lines.textCh: 你叫个屁，这关我什么事？也不关他们的事！那艘气垫船用途多了去了，没人会为了你冒险把船给搭进去。
lines.textEn: You know what, that’s neither my nor their problem! They’ve got better uses for that hovercraft, and nobody’s risking it for you.

lines.textCh: 所以这就是最终条件了？
lines.textEn: So those are the final conditions?

lines.textCh: 我可不会再帮你去谈条件了。至于怎么从那艘船上撤离，你自己想办法去。
lines.textEn: I’m not going back to negotiate for you. So figure out the extraction from the ship yourself.

lines.textCh: 明白了。他们在哪接我？
lines.textEn: Understood. Where do they pick me up?

lines.textCh: 他们会在海边等着，就在游艇码头的大楼那儿。如果换作是我，在上他们的船之前绝对会带一套修船专用的工具。这帮家伙的船不说崭新出厂，至少也算是伤痕累累了。
lines.textEn: They’ll be waiting on the coast, off to the side of the port terminal. And if I were you, I'd bring a suitable marine repair kit. Their boat isn't exactly brand-new.

lines.textCh: 关于上船的事情，有消息了吗？
lines.textEn: Any news about transport to the ship?

lines.textCh: 有是有，不过有一个小问题。
lines.textEn: Yeah, but there’s a problem.

lines.textCh: 他们要收钱？
lines.textEn: I have to pay?

lines.textCh: 你要这么说，那现在就变成两个问题了。
lines.textEn: Alright, make that two problems.

lines.textCh: 到底是怎么一回事？
lines.textEn: So what happened?

lines.textCh: 走私者那边有一艘气垫船，他们愿意把你送过去。但他们不会等你，也不会负责把你接回来。
lines.textEn: The smugglers have a hovercraft and they’re willing to get you there. But they won’t wait for you or extract you after.

lines.textCh: 为什么？
lines.textEn: Why?

lines.textCh: 他们说对船来说风险太高。说实话，我觉得就是太抢手了。我能理解，我这 BTR 赶活的间隙里连加油都来不及，更何况是他们。
lines.textEn: They say it’s too risky for the craft. Honestly, I think it’s just in high demand. I get it, I barely keep my BTR fueled between jobs.

lines.textCh: 所以他们不会把我从那艘船上撤出来。
lines.textEn: So they won’t extract me from the ship.

lines.textCh: 他们在哪接我？
lines.textEn: Where do they pick me up?

lines.textCh: 没错，不过上船这一趟不用担心，他们说话算话！记得带上修船用的专用工具就行，以防万一嘛。
lines.textEn: Yes. But don't worry about the infil, they'll keep their word! Just make sure you bring a marine repair kit, just in case.

lines.textCh: 他们会在疗养院附近或者污水处理厂附近的海边游艇码头接你上船。准备好了之后按时赶到地方就行。
lines.textEn: The boat will pick you up either at the shore near the health resort, or next to the water treatment plant. When you're ready, head to one of those spots.

lines.textCh: 交通工具的事情处理好了。
lines.textEn: I’ve got transport sorted.

lines.textCh: 太棒了。 我已经找到了那艘破冰船的精确坐标，但在此之后我就没拦截到任何后续通话了。那些游荡者很可能已经在出发前往 Boreas 号的路上了。
lines.textEn: Excellent. I’ve identified the icebreaker’s coordinates, but I haven’t intercepted any more transmissions. Most likely the Rogues are already on their way to "Boreas".

lines.textCh: 还有什么是我该在上船之前知道的吗？
lines.textEn: Anything else I should know before I go in?

lines.textCh: 记住，这艘破冰船可是 TerraGroup 的重要资产。也就是说上面可能会有重兵把守。祝你好运。
lines.textEn: Remember, this icebreaker could be an important TerraGroup asset. That means it’s likely well defended. Good luck.

lines.textCh: 我需要找点不一样的交通工具去搞定一项差事。你能帮忙吗？
lines.textEn: I need some unusual transport for a job. Can you help?

lines.textCh: 我在找交通工具，而且不是常见的那种，你能帮忙吗？
lines.textEn: I need some unusual transport. Can you help with that?

lines.textCh: 我需要找人带我一程，你能帮忙吗？
lines.textEn: I need transport. Can you help?

lines.textCh: 那你为什么不直接去找那个开 BTR 的？你把我当成什么人了，上我这打车来了？
lines.textEn: Then why didn’t you go straight to the BTR guy? What am I, a taxi service?

lines.textCh: 帮忙？你？算了，我劝你趁早滚蛋，我“帮”你帮得可是够多了！
lines.textEn: Help? You? No, thanks. I’ve already “helped” you enough!

lines.textCh: 既然你说到做到，那我也会尽力帮忙。说吧，你这是打算去哪，一般去找你那个 BTR 司机不就行了吗？
lines.textEn: You keep your word, so I’ll help if I can. Where are you headed, and why didn’t you just go to the BTR driver?

lines.textCh: 芬兰湾里停了艘船在那，我想上去瞧瞧。搞不好你这有条摩托艇什么的？
lines.textEn: I need to board a ship in the Gulf of Finland. Do you have a spare motor boat, maybe?

lines.textCh: 我需要运输方面的帮助。你认识谁能把我送到芬兰湾那边的一艘船上？
lines.textEn: I need help with a transport. Do you have anyone who could get me onto a ship in the gulf?

lines.textCh: 你是搞运输的吧？你那边有船吗？我需要出海，去海湾那边找一艘船。
lines.textEn: You deal with transport, right? Any chance you’ve got a boat? I need to reach a ship out in the gulf.

lines.textCh: 你说啥呢，兄弟。我刚刚勉强把这辆 BTR 修好，哪有精力搞船。
lines.textEn: Nah man. I barely got this BTR back on its feet, no time for boats.

lines.textCh: 你脸皮还真够厚的啊？以为我不知道你当时站在 Skier 那边？
lines.textEn: You got some nerve, you know that? Thought I wouldn’t find out you sided with Skier back then?

lines.textCh: 哥们，如果是为了你的事，我就算用铁皮拼也要给你拼一艘出来！不过你估计等不了那么久吧。
lines.textEn: Brother, for you I’d build one out of scrap if I had to! But you’re probably not ready to wait that long.

lines.textCh: 你的库存里不会刚好有那种爆破炸药吧？
lines.textEn: You wouldn’t happen to have any plantable explosives in stock?

lines.textCh: 我登上了那艘破冰船。游荡者抢先一步，他们干掉了大部分船员。可以肯定的是，袭击期间有人激活了船上的防御系统，船上不同的区域都被封死了。
lines.textEn: I made it to the icebreaker. The Rogues were already there and killed most of the crew. During the assault, a defense system activated and sealed off different sections of the ship.

lines.textCh: 也就是说，船员里有人活了下来？
lines.textEn: So this means someone survived?

lines.textCh: 有个科学家之类的家伙把自己锁在试验区里了。嚷嚷着除非亲眼见到船长，否则打死也不会出来。
lines.textEn: Some scientist guy locked himself in a lab block. Refuses to come out until he sees the captain.

lines.textCh: 那船长上哪去了？
lines.textEn: Where’s the captain?

lines.textCh: 八成在舰桥上，但我得穿过所有封锁层才能到那里。
lines.textEn: Should be on the bridge, but to get there I’ll have to go through all the sealed levels.

lines.textCh: 你有什么计划？
lines.textEn: Do you have a plan?

lines.textCh: 现在我需要弄到爆破炸药，清理出前往舰桥的路。
lines.textEn: Right now I need explosives to break into the bridge.

lines.textCh: 这我就帮不了你了， 但我听说 Prapor 那最近到了一批聚能炸药，去找他吧。
lines.textEn: I can’t help you with that. But I heard Prapor recently got a shipment of shaped charges. Ask him.

lines.textCh: 哦，还有……
lines.textEn: Oh, also…

lines.textCh: 你想问什么？
lines.textEn: What is it?

lines.textCh: 那艘船周围都是浮冰，船上也到处都是积雪。现在这个季节怎么还会有这种情况？
lines.textEn: The ship is surrounded by ice and snow. How is that possible this time of year?

lines.textCh: 好问题。 芬兰湾里的确有部分水域会受到拉多加湖流入寒流的影响，但我不确定这点寒流是否足以把海面都冻上。
lines.textEn: Good question. There are cold currents in parts of the gulf coming from Lake Ladoga, but I’m not sure that’s enough to freeze the surface.

lines.textCh: 所以肯定是其他原因在作祟咯？
lines.textEn: So there’s another reason?

lines.textCh: 气候正在以我们意想不到的方式飞速变化。沙漠里反常地下起了雪，洋流紊乱的情况更是出乎所有专家的预料… 但与此同时，也不能排除真的是 TerraGroup 的实验在捣鬼。
lines.textEn: The climate is changing fast. Abnormal snowfalls in deserts, shifts in currents where no one expected them… But I wouldn’t rule out TerraGroup experiments affecting this as well.

lines.textCh: 你是说他们正在开发气象武器？
lines.textEn: You think they’re developing climate weapons?

lines.textCh: 这就有点扯了… 更像是 TerraGroup 掌控的设施出了点状况，导致洋流出现了波动，引起局部地区气温异常降低。我不觉得他们具备操纵气候的能力，至少目前没有。
lines.textEn: That’s a stretch... It’s more likely some kind of accident at a TerraGroup facility caused changes in currents, leading to localized temperature shifts.

lines.textCh: 啥，你是觉得手榴弹的劲太小不成？
lines.textEn: What, grenades aren’t good enough for you now?

lines.textCh: 我要的是聚能装药的那种。
lines.textEn: I need a shaped charge.

lines.textCh: 嗯… 我可不想让其他人发现塔科夫里还有这种东西。 类似的东西我有，但如果你胆敢把那玩意用在市区里的话，最好还是在外头自我了断，别回来见我了。
lines.textEn: Hm… I don’t want anyone finding out those charges are still around in Tarkov. I can find something, but if you try to use it inside the city, don’t bother coming back.

lines.textCh: 那个科学家说密码的剩余部分是离船最近 TerraGroup 分部的区域代码 。
lines.textEn: The scientist said the second half is a regional code of the nearest TerraGroup facility.

lines.textCh: 那个科学家说密码的剩余部分是离船最近 TerraGroup 分部的区域代码 。
lines.textEn: The scientist said the second half is a regional code of the nearest TerraGroup facility.

lines.textCh: 我想办法更深入破冰船里面了，但遇上了一扇用密码锁封上的门。
lines.textEn: I made it further on the icebreaker, but hit a code-locked door.

lines.textCh: 我倒是想帮你找个合适的破解方法，但目前我手头还没有合适的工具。
lines.textEn: I’d suggest the optimal way to crack it, but I don’t have the right equipment right now.

lines.textCh: 我已经知道了密码的上半部分，同时还问出了下半部分可能会在什么地方。
lines.textEn: I already have half the code and know where to get the second half.

lines.textCh: 结果你还是上我这来了，所以你大概是想让我帮你解出下半部分？
lines.textEn: Yet you came to me, so I figure you need my help.

lines.textCh: 嗯……实验室本地数据库里可能会有那种代码。 幸好我们之前在调查那场蓝色爆炸的时候就已经让你连上了他们的机房。
lines.textEn: Hm… That code should still be in the lab’s local database. Good thing you already linked me to it during your EMP investigation.

lines.textCh: 所以我什么都不用做吗？
lines.textEn: So I don’t need to do anything?

lines.textCh: 如果我们运气好的话，确实是什么都不用干。但我让你安装的设备不可能无限期运行下去，所以我会尽量赶在它失效之前访问集团的数据库，看看能不能挖到什么有用的东西。 等下次见面的时候应该就会有发现了。
lines.textEn: If we’re lucky, yes. My device won’t last forever, but I’ll try to access the database through it. By the next time we meet, I should have something.

lines.textCh: 实验室的本地机房里肯定会有那种东西，我们需要建立远程连接。
lines.textEn: That code should definitely be somewhere in the lab’s local database. We need to establish remote access.

lines.textCh: 怎么弄？
lines.textEn: How do I do that?

lines.textCh: 在他们实验室的服务器机房里安装一个远程访问设备。我尽量在你回来之前找到你需要的那部分情报。
lines.textEn: Leave a remote access device in the lab’s server room. By the time you return, I’ll try to retrieve the information we need.

lines.textCh: 那个科学家说密码的剩余部分是离船最近 TerraGroup 分部的区域代码 。
lines.textEn: The scientist said the second half is a regional code of the nearest TerraGroup facility.

lines.textCh: 那么，你找到那个代码了吗？
lines.textEn: So, did you get the code?

lines.textCh: 是啊，我们这次还挺走运。不过下一回可别指望那个设备了。 准备好记下代码了吗？
lines.textEn: Yes, we got lucky. But I wouldn’t count on that device again. Ready for the code?

lines.textCh: 准备好了。
lines.textEn: Ready.

lines.textCh: 那就记下来吧…
lines.textEn: Write this down…

lines.textCh: ……呃，你是打算说出来还是怎么样？
lines.textEn: …You gonna say it or what?

lines.textCh: 哦，刚刚分了下神，抱歉。 你要的代码是：220。
lines.textEn: Slipped my mind for a second, sorry. Your code is: 220.

lines.textCh: 你弄到我要的代码了吗？
lines.textEn: So, did you get the code?

lines.textCh: 没错，我找到了，应该就是这个，记下来吧…
lines.textEn: Yes, I found the correct code. Write this down…

lines.textCh: ……呃，你是真打算告诉我，还是在卖关子？
lines.textEn: …You gonna say it or what?

lines.textCh: 哦，刚刚分了下神，抱歉。你要的代码是：220。
lines.textEn: Slipped my mind for a second, sorry. Your code is: 220.

lines.textCh: 你弄到我要的代码了吗？
lines.textEn: So, did you get the code?

lines.textCh: 没错，我找到了，应该就是这个，记下来吧…
lines.textEn: Yes, I found the correct code. Write this down…

lines.textCh: ……呃，你是真打算告诉我，还是在卖关子？
lines.textEn: …You gonna say it or what?

lines.textCh: 哦，刚刚分了下神，抱歉。你要的代码是：220。
lines.textEn: Slipped my mind for a second, sorry. Your code is: 220.

lines.textCh: 我见到船长了，更确切的说，是船长的尸体。
lines.textEn: I managed to reach the captain. Or rather, his body.

lines.textCh: 那个科学家呢，他怎么样了？
lines.textEn: What about the scientist?

lines.textCh: 恐怕从他那是问不出什么有用的情报了。
lines.textEn: Doubt we’ll get anything useful out of him.

lines.textCh: 好吧，不过我们之前可是约好了，你会帮我从船上回收电子设备。 找到什么有价值的东西没有？
lines.textEn: Alright. But we agreed that you’d help me recover electronics. Did you find anything valuable?

lines.textCh: 舰桥专门隔出了几层区域，仅限 VIP 乘客通行，我在那里找到了一个需要最高权限才能访问的档案库。
lines.textEn: Several levels of the bridge were set aside for VIP passengers, and that’s where I found an archive secured with top-level access.

lines.textCh: 你打开它了吗？里面都有什么？
lines.textEn: Did you open it? What was inside?

lines.textCh: 大批设备、服务器、一整个卫星通讯基站……我还找到了一些闪存盘，但应该是加密了。你能帮我解开吗？
lines.textEn: Lots of equipment, servers, a satellite communications station… I found some drives, guessing they’re encrypted. Can you help with that?

lines.textCh: 可以。但我有一个条件：你必须回到破冰船上，找到我要的那些电子设备，能拿多少就拿多少，我通通都要。 你在船上行动的时候，我会着手破解你搞来的这些闪存盘。
lines.textEn: I can. But on one condition: you go back to the icebreaker and bring me the equipment I need. While you’re there, I’ll start working on the drives.

lines.textCh: 具体要哪些东西？
lines.textEn: What do you need?

lines.textCh: 我听说 TerraGroup 开发了集团内部专用的卫星通讯系统，非常贵，非常先进。 文件里提到这玩意叫“Ultralink”。
lines.textEn: I’ve heard TerraGroup developed their own advanced satellite communication system. In the documentation, it’s referred to as “Ultralink”.

lines.textCh: 你认为这种东西会在那艘破冰船上吗？
lines.textEn: You think something like that is on the icebreaker?

lines.textCh: 从你之前描述的情况看，船上搭载的设备应该就是这种。 我会尽快开始破解，尽量在你回来的时候搞定第一个闪存盘。
lines.textEn: Based on what you’ve told me, that’s exactly the kind of equipment that should be there. I’ll try to decrypt the first drive by the time you return.

lines.textCh: 所以这些设备没通过海关就直接偷运进来了，而且集团竟然还能在不暴露行踪的情况下，在所有人都不知道的地方成功让部队登陆了？
lines.textEn: So all of this was brought in bypassing customs, and they still managed to land on an unknown foothold without losing secrecy?

lines.textCh: 那“东方能源”号呢？
lines.textEn: What about “Eastern Energy”?

lines.textCh: “开罗纽带”号是怎么和登陆行动扯上关系的？
lines.textEn: How is “Kairo Nexus” connected to the landing?

lines.textCh: 我找到了你要的那个 Ultralink 模块。你这边有什么进展吗？(上交 Ultralink 模块)
lines.textEn: I managed to find the Ultralink modules you asked for. Were you able to get any information? (Hand over the Ultralink module)

lines.textCh: 太棒了，东西就放在那吧。 第一个闪存盘我已经破解完了。话说，你知道第一批 USEC 是怎么被投送到塔科夫来的吗？
lines.textEn: Excellent, leave it here. I managed to decrypt the first drive. What do you know about the first USEC deployment in Tarkov?

lines.textCh: 当时我不在场。他们说初次行动只持续了几个月时间，第一批人员是假借保护 TerraGroup 财产的名义进来的，而且只来了很少一部分人马。
lines.textEn: I wasn’t there. They say the operation lasted several months, and only a small portion of the units were brought in under the guise of guarding TerraGroup facilities.

lines.textCh: 没错，就是这样。但你或许没意识到，这场行动真正的规模到底有多大。
lines.textEn: That’s correct. But you probably don’t realize just how large-scale that operation was.

lines.textCh: 难道他们用的是 Paradigm 航运的船？
lines.textEn: Did they use Paradigm Shipping vessels?

lines.textCh: 登陆行动本身没什么特别的，不过是按照规范协调各种民用船只和军用登陆艇把人员设备送进塔科夫而已。 但在集团总部下达出动命令之前，所有的部队、车辆载具、武器以及各种补给物资可都是存放在芬兰湾里的几艘 Paradigm 货船上：分别是“太平洋轴线”号、“开罗纽带”号，以及“东方能源”号——你瞧瞧，这就是他们的海上预制舰，集团有着自己的海军。
lines.textEn: For the landing itself, they used appropriate civilian and military equipment. But before the deployment order, troops, vehicles, weapons, and supplies were all stored on Paradigm Shipping vessels in the Gulf of Finland: “Pacific Axis”, “Kairo Nexus”, and “Eastern Energy”.

lines.textCh: 讲讲“太平洋轴线”号的事情吧。
lines.textEn: Tell me about “Pacific Axis”.

lines.textCh: 一艘支线集装箱船，比较小的那种。这种船几乎不挑港口，任何海港都能进。 数据显示，上面搭载着大部分武器设备和作战所需的其他硬件设施。
lines.textEn: A small feeder container ship. Vessels like that can enter almost any port. According to the data, most of the equipment and hardware was stored there.

lines.textCh: 通信系统、LAV 装甲车，以及其他类似的装备？
lines.textEn: Communication systems, LAVs, and similar gear?

lines.textCh: 比这多得多。 一切你能想到的用来部署火力网以及构筑隐蔽基地的设备，上面都有。
lines.textEn: And much more. Everything needed to deploy networks of firing positions and covert bases.

lines.textCh: 搞不好我还亲眼见过这艘船，就在海湾里。 也是艘支线集装箱船，不过相对要大一些，他们跑船的称作 Feedermax 的那种，一般用于中等距离的航线，承载的货物容量也很大。
lines.textEn: I think I’ve even seen that one in the gulf myself. It’s a Feedermax-class vessel, used for medium-range routes and capable of carrying large amounts of cargo.

lines.textCh: 所以真正的大部队在这艘船上等着呢？
lines.textEn: So the main forces were waiting there?

lines.textCh: 没错，满载着士兵、载具、给养以及弹药。 很难想象船上的人都经历了些什么，挤在根本不是为载人而设计的船舱里，一等就是几个月时间…
lines.textEn: Exactly. Soldiers, vehicles, provisions, and ammunition. It’s hard to imagine what it was like for them, waiting for months in compartments not meant for personnel…

lines.textCh: 一艘老掉牙的油轮。 这是三艘船里嫌疑最小的，现在看来，它驶入塔科夫水域更像是用来吸引眼球的障眼法。
lines.textEn: An old oil tanker. Of the three, it’s the least suspicious. It seems it was brought to Tarkov purely as a distraction.

lines.textCh: 你该不会是在暗示，那次漏油事故是他们有意制造出来的吧？
lines.textEn: You’re not suggesting they staged that oil spill on purpose?

lines.textCh: 这有什么好惊讶的？“东方能源”号一出事，所有人都紧盯着后续清理工作以及当局起诉 Paradigm 航运的新闻，根本顾不上其他船的小动作。
lines.textEn: What surprises you about that? During the incident on “Eastern Energy”, everyone was focused on the cleanup and the legal claims against Paradigm Shipping.

lines.textCh: 但这样不就把应急部门的人和环保人士都吸引到那里去了吗？
lines.textEn: But wouldn’t that also draw responders and activists to the area?

lines.textCh: 这些人再怎么闹腾也不会去看一眼海边，况且漏油事故早在他们大张旗鼓之前就得到了控制。 集团要的是不会有人注意到另外两艘船，同时把边防军海巡队的人调离登陆船队所在的航线。
lines.textEn: There was no real threat to the coastline, and the spill was contained quickly. All they needed was to divert attention from Kairo Nexus and Pacific Axis, and pull coastal services away from the landing route.

lines.textCh: 别忘了在此之前，TerraGroup 的设施早就遍布整个塔科夫了，那些 USEC 部队也是。 还有，文件里还提到了灯塔区域有一位特殊线人，就是他帮忙协调了登陆行动。
lines.textEn: Don’t forget that USEC units, TerraGroup facilities, and infrastructure were already present in Tarkov. Also, the documents mention a special agent at Lighthouse who helped coordinate the landing.

lines.textCh: 我明白了…
lines.textEn: I see…

lines.textCh: 顺便那份报告里甚至提到了 Knight 那伙人。 记录显示，他们是第一批踏上塔科夫土地的雇佣兵，比集团自导自演的漏油事故还要早。那会儿他们还听从 USEC 的指挥。
lines.textEn: By the way, the report even mentions Knight and his fighters. According to the data, they were deployed in the first wave, before the tanker incident. Back then, they still followed USEC command.

lines.textCh: 第一批？比起真实记录，更像是什么噱头。
lines.textEn: First wave? That sounds more like a story than fact.

lines.textCh: 但记录里确实是这么写的。 所以也难怪 Knight 脱队后还能在他那堆“同事”里造成那么大的影响。
lines.textEn: The data says otherwise. It’s no surprise Knight managed to gather so much influence afterward.

lines.textCh: 你说破解了第一个闪存盘，剩下其他的部分呢？
lines.textEn: You said you decrypted the first drive. What about the others?

lines.textCh: 我遇到了难题。 破解这种程度的加密信息需要大量内存加快运算。 就算我把手头的内存都用上了，但还是慢的要命。
lines.textEn: I ran into a problem. Breaking that level of encryption requires a massive amount of RAM. Even with what I have, it’s extremely slow.

lines.textCh: 你认真的吗？你也不打听打听现在是什么行情，结果你要我给你弄一箱子内存条来？
lines.textEn: Want me to bring you crates of RAM sticks? In this economy?

lines.textCh: 继续堆内存也不会有太大作用。我会继续尝试，但如果你能从那艘破冰船上搞点服务器级别内存条来的话，也许能大大加快进度。
lines.textEn: That won’t help. I’ll keep working, but if you can find server-grade memory on the icebreaker, it would speed things up significantly.

lines.textCh: 你说的这个东西长什么样？
lines.textEn: What does it look like?

lines.textCh: 和你在市区看到的那些电脑上用的内存条不太一样。 城里应该没有任何地方用得上这么强力的玩意，但在 Boreas 号上能找到这玩意的概率还是挺大的。
lines.textEn: It’s a bit different from the RAM you’ve seen in Tarkov. You won’t find anything that powerful in the city, but on the “Boreas”, there’s a good chance it exists.

lines.textCh: 明白了，我会尽力去找的。
lines.textEn: Understood. I’ll try to find it.

lines.textCh: 天啊…
lines.textEn: Holy fuck…

lines.textCh: 这个协定究竟是要达成什么目的？
lines.textEn: So what are the goals of this protocol?

lines.textCh: 你真的觉得他们会往东京这样的大城市部署 PMC 吗？我不认为这种程度的行动没有人注意到。
lines.textEn: You really think they’d deploy PMCs in Tokyo? I don’t think they could do that unnoticed.

lines.textCh: 在开罗制造冲突为的是什么？
lines.textEn: What’s the point of a conflict in Cairo?

lines.textCh: 我在破冰船上找到了一些内存条，这些应该够了吧？(上交服务器内存模块)
lines.textEn: I found some RAM sticks on the icebreaker. Will these do? (Hand over the server RAM modules)

lines.textCh: 应该可以，拿过来吧… 这下第三个盘的破解速度能快得多了。
lines.textEn: That should do, hand them over… Work on the third drive will definitely go faster now.

lines.textCh: 第二个呢？你已经破解完了？
lines.textEn: What about the second one? You decrypted it already?

lines.textCh: 没错，几个小时之前弄完的。 但恐怕里面没有什么好消息。
lines.textEn: Yes, I finished a couple of hours ago. And the news isn’t good.

lines.textCh: 你都查到了些什么？
lines.textEn: What did you learn?

lines.textCh: 看样子整个塔科夫发生的一切只是大规模事变的预演——或者按照集团的说法，有一项涉及范围更广的协定正等着这个世界。 只可惜破解流程触发了某种自毁协议，我没来得及阻止它，好多内容都被抹掉了。
lines.textEn: It seems the entire Tarkov incident was something like a test run for a larger protocol. But during my decryption, a self-erasure program triggered, and I couldn’t stop it in time.

lines.textCh: 什么协定？
lines.textEn: What kind of protocol?

lines.textCh: 具体名字和其他部分数据一起被抹掉了。 但从剩下的部分来看，这个协定会在目标区域引发局部冲突，并彻底切断当地现有的贸易路线、断绝居民的物资供应，同时动摇当局的统治。
lines.textEn: The name was erased along with part of the data. But from what remains, it involves triggering local conflicts and completely severing established trade, political, and logistical connections.

lines.textCh: 这是什么意思？
lines.textEn: What does that mean?

lines.textCh: 以塔科夫为例，这里爆发的冲突已经严重扰乱了本地的物资供应链，还让俄罗斯与西方国家的外交关系一夜间倒退了十几年。 而这仅仅是集团宏大计划中的一小部分而已。
lines.textEn: The conflict in Tarkov disrupted supply chains and set international relations with the West back by decades. And that’s just one part of a much larger system.

lines.textCh: 所以说……？
lines.textEn: So..?

lines.textCh: 试想一下，这样的巨变如果再上演五次—— 人们习以为常的秩序体系还会存在吗？整个世界都会被搅得天翻地覆。 甚至十次呢？
lines.textEn: Imagine five such disruptions? The world you knew would no longer exist. Ten?

lines.textCh: 据我所知，其目的是彻底瓦解全球现有的秩序体系，以便他们能在混乱之上建立新的统治。
lines.textEn: From what I can tell, its purpose is to completely dismantle existing global systems so that they can build something new on top of the resulting chaos.

lines.textCh: 你说的“他们”是谁，TerraGroup 吗？
lines.textEn: Who are “they”? TerraGroup?

lines.textCh: 看样子的确如此，不过，要是有人告诉我集团的背后还有更强大的势力为他们撑腰，我也不会有多惊讶。 这个计划涉及的规模之大堪称恐怖，即使是 TerraGroup 也没法轻松将其付诸实践。
lines.textEn: It seems so. Although I wouldn’t be surprised if there’s someone even more powerful behind them. The scale of this is enormous, even for TerraGroup.

lines.textCh: 规模到底有多大？
lines.textEn: What scale are we talking about?

lines.textCh: 除了文件中提到的两处地名以外，我手头并没有确切的数据。 但我的确看到文件里提及要在东京和开罗复刻他们在塔科夫的行动。
lines.textEn: I don’t have precise data besides two locations. I found references to preparations for repeating the Tarkov scenario in Tokyo and Cairo.

lines.textCh: 为什么选择东京下手？
lines.textEn: Why Tokyo?

lines.textCh: 日本首都和整个东日本地区构成了一个庞大的金融与贸易网络： 证券交易所、物流供应链，还把控着电子设备和其他尖端技术的进出口… 一旦这样的经济枢纽陷入崩溃和停滞，必然会在整个亚洲乃至更大的范围内引发强烈的连锁反应。
lines.textEn: Japan’s capital is tied into a massive web of links across the entire eastern region. Stock markets, logistics chains, exports of electronics and technology… The collapse of a hub like that would inevitably cause a chain reaction across all of Asia, and not just there.

lines.textCh: 在一切陷入混乱之前，我也曾天真地以为塔科夫是一座和平繁荣的城市，有着美好的发展前景。 但之后发生的事情我们已经都知道了——TerraGroup 掌握的资源远比我们想象的要多，他们对于世界各国的渗透更甚于此。
lines.textEn: There was a time I thought Tarkov was a peaceful city with a big future ahead of it. And yet here we are, which only shows TerraGroup has a lot more resources than we think.

lines.textCh: 苏伊士运河仍然是沟通欧亚大陆的最重要的水路。 任何破坏行为——哪怕是最轻微的那一种——都将对整个世界的供应链构成严重威胁。
lines.textEn: The Suez Canal still remains the main logistical bridge between Europe and Asia. Even minor disruptions can cause a major crisis.

lines.textCh: 你是说，就算只有一艘集装箱船把运河堵上，都会让整个欧洲的便利店无货可卖？
lines.textEn: You mean a single container ship blocking the canal could be enough to trigger convenience store shortages across Europe?

lines.textCh: 苏伊士运河哪怕只封锁一天，都会为全世界造成百亿美元级别的损失。原料短缺最终会导致物价直线上涨。 虽说商品不是从超市货架上长出来的，但显然在他们的操纵之下，商品完全可能会从货架上消失。
lines.textEn: Even a single day of blockage can cost billions. Resource shortages would drive prices up sharply. And yes, in some cases, goods would start disappearing from shelves.

lines.textCh: 如果连续封锁几个月呢？
lines.textEn: What if it’s blocked for months?

lines.textCh: 大型企业接连倒闭，或者在多个国家引发严重经济危机，一切都有可能。
lines.textEn: Anything from the collapse of major corporations to serious economic crises in entire countries.

lines.textCh: 战争和技术变革曾经多次重塑这个世界。 但真正的问题在于，在摧毁现有的秩序体系后，他们又打算建立起什么样的新秩序。
lines.textEn: The world has been reshaped many times before by wars and technological shifts. The real question is what they intend to build after destroying the current world.

lines.textCh: 信息量太大了……我需要点时间才能消化。
lines.textEn: That’s a lot to process.

lines.textCh: 我还以为你本来就是奔着这个上船才调查的呢…… 无论如何，我会继续研究破解第三个磁盘。但我之前可能低估了破解它的难度。
lines.textEn: I thought this was exactly what you were looking for... In any case, I’ll continue working on the third drive. It’s proving more difficult than I expected.

lines.textCh: 也就是说，我得额外花钱才行？
lines.textEn: Do I need to pay extra for that?

lines.textCh: 可以这么说，但我要的不是钱。 帮我从破冰船上多弄些电子设备来就行。
lines.textEn: You could put it that way. Bring me more electronics from the icebreaker.

lines.textCh: 这一回你要什么？
lines.textEn: What this time?

lines.textCh: 显然集团给那艘破冰船塞满了各种各样最先进的好货。我几乎可以确定，Boreas 上的那些处理器也是定制型号的，比市面上的大路货强一大截。 想办法弄点来给我。
lines.textEn: That icebreaker is clearly equipped with advanced systems. I’m almost certain the “Boreas” processors are non-standard. Bring them to me.

lines.textCh: 希望这是最后一项搜索任务了。
lines.textEn: I hope this will be the last task.

lines.textCh: 你难道觉得我是在有意吊着你，只为从你那多要些东西吗？ 别傻了，专注干活，等你找到我要的东西后，第三个磁盘差不多也就破解好了。
lines.textEn: Why would I need to mislead you? Focus on the job, and I’ll try to finish the third drive by the time you return.

lines.textCh: 好吧，我这就去办。
lines.textEn: Alright. I’ll get it done.

lines.textCh: 总有一天，会有人集结大量黑客，凭着他们手头的技术直接占领整个数字空间。
lines.textEn: Eventually someone will have enough hackers and technology to take over the digital space.

lines.textCh: 都是一派胡言。只要国家之间还存在竞争，就没有人能一手遮天掌握所有的信息渠道，更别说互联网了。
lines.textEn: That’s bullshit. As long as states compete with each other, no one can take over the entire internet and communications.

lines.textCh: 我把破冰船上上下下搜了个遍，找到了这些处理器。
lines.textEn: I searched the icebreaker and found these processors.

lines.textCh: 很好，把东西给我吧，我一会来看看。
lines.textEn: Good. Give them to me, I’ll take a look later.

lines.textCh: 磁盘破解得怎么样了？
lines.textEn: So what about the drive?

lines.textCh: 你带来的那些服务器内存条可是立了大功，数据破解出来了，并且损失相当低。
lines.textEn: Thanks to the server memory you brought, I managed to decrypt it with minimal data loss.

lines.textCh: 有什么发现吗？
lines.textEn: And what did you find?

lines.textCh: 首先，我要问你个问题：你怎么看待《1984》里关于老大哥的那套理论？
lines.textEn: First, tell me: how do you feel about Big Brother theories?

lines.textCh: 在调查完 ARRS 站点后，我觉得这些东西已经没什么好吃惊的了。
lines.textEn: After the ARRS terminal, I don’t think much can surprise me anymore.

lines.textCh: 我也是这么想的。但事实证明，ARRS 只是他们用来操纵整个世界的工具中的一种，甚至算不上最主要的手段。
lines.textEn: I thought the same. But it turns out ARRS was just one of their tools, and not even the most significant one.

lines.textCh: 还有什么比能实时监视全球动态的系统更恐怖？
lines.textEn: What could be more significant than a global surveillance system?

lines.textCh: 你这么想很正常。但如果背后操纵的势力已经在国家之上呢？
lines.textEn: That’s reasonable. But what happens if the opponent is above states?

lines.textCh: 再怎么样 TerraGroup 也只是一个公司而已，甚至还是私有的。我们还是直奔重点吧。
lines.textEn: TerraGroup is still just a corporation, private entities. Get to the point.

lines.textCh: 没错，而看样子这一点已经成为了现实。
lines.textEn: Exactly. And it looks like that has already happened.

lines.textCh: 这意味着什么？
lines.textEn: Meaning?

lines.textCh: TerraGroup 在全世界开展了多项研究，甚至还有一些项目是打着“人道主义”的幌子获得批准的，在此期间，集团买下了多颗卫星的所有权，还在世界各地获得了自由使用以及改造当地通讯网络的权利。
lines.textEn: TerraGroup has a number of research and humanitarian projects where they purchased certain satellites or obtained rights to use communication systems in different parts of the world.

lines.textCh: 那些国家怎么会允许自己的通讯网络掌握在跨国公司手里呢？这可是标准的垄断行为。
lines.textEn: They wouldn’t be allowed to create a monopoly in the communications market.

lines.textCh: 但问题在于，在外界看来，TerraGroup 并没有垄断整个世界的卫星通讯网络。
lines.textEn: The point is, from the outside, no one would suspect TerraGroup has control over satellites worldwide.

lines.textCh: 怎么可能呢？
lines.textEn: How is that possible?

lines.textCh: 他们名下的卫星覆盖的范围还不到全球的一半，自然不会触发反垄断措施。 但如果你算上那些“退役”卫星和经过 TerraGroup 之手私下进行过固件升级的卫星的话，集团卫星的覆盖范围就要广得多了。
lines.textEn: The coverage of those satellites wouldn’t even cover half the planet. But when you add decommissioned satellites and TerraGroup’s secret upgrades, the coverage increases dramatically.

lines.textCh: 但他们控制这么多卫星是为了什么呢？
lines.textEn: And what does that give them?

lines.textCh: 当然是用来截获 G20 国家关键机构的通信了，在必要情况下还能进行强力干扰。 甚至随时可以瘫痪世界上几乎任何地方的通讯和电力网络。
lines.textEn: The ability to intercept or jam communications of key institutions in G20 countries. And to trigger local blackouts almost anywhere, at any time.

lines.textCh: 你难道觉得全世界的情报部门都被他们骗过去了，没人意识到他们组建了一支覆盖全球的卫星网络，也没有人怀疑过这些设备的实际用途？
lines.textEn: Do you really think no counterintelligence agency in the world has detected this satellite network?

lines.textCh: 我几乎可以确定就是这样的。 不过老实说，我还没搞清楚这些东西到底是怎么运作的，但磁盘里的文件可是实打实地确认了整套系统已经完成了组网。
lines.textEn: I’m almost certain of it. Honestly, I don’t fully understand how the system works myself, but the report on the disk literally confirms its “completion”.

lines.textCh: 那为什么他们不把这套东西用在塔科夫呢？塔科夫的卫星通讯还能用，难道不是吗？
lines.textEn: Then why wasn’t it used in Tarkov? Satellite communication still works, doesn’t it?

lines.textCh: 我不清楚。也许在契约战争刚开打的时候整套网络还没有就绪，又或者，集团是在隐藏实力，留待更大的行动。
lines.textEn: I don’t know. Maybe it wasn’t ready when the Contract Wars began, or maybe they’re saving it for a more important case.

lines.textCh: 比如东京或者开罗？
lines.textEn: Like Tokyo or Cairo?

lines.textCh: 看来你完全没意识到情况有多严重。 在拥有这样恐怖的能力之后，全世界几乎已经没有对手能和集团抗衡了。你该走了。
lines.textEn: Seems like you don’t fully understand how bad this is. With a tool like that, they barely have any visible competitors left. I think you should go now.

lines.textCh: 那闪存盘呢？你把它们留着了吗？
lines.textEn: And what about the drives? Are you keeping them?

lines.textCh: 那些磁盘本身不重要，你恐怕也用不上了，不过我会把里面提取出来的文件都发你一份。你走吧，我得确认点东西…
lines.textEn: The drives themselves are useless to you, but I’ll send you the documentation I extracted from them. Now go, I need to double-check something…

lines.textCh: 关于突袭破冰船的活，我把你要的装备都带来了。
lines.textEn: So, about the icebreaker. I brought all the gear you asked for.

lines.textCh: 返回
lines.textEn: (Back)

lines.textCh: 你交代的东西我都弄来了。
lines.textEn: That’s everything you asked for.

lines.textCh: 这样应该就行了。
lines.textEn: That should be it.

lines.textCh: 我弄来了防毒面具，应该能派上用场。 (上交防毒面具)
lines.textEn: Here are the gas masks. Hope this helps. (Hand over the gas masks)

lines.textCh: 板子在这呢。 (上交防弹插板)
lines.textEn: Here are the plates. (Hand over the ballistic plates)

lines.textCh: 防弹衣在这。 (上交护甲)
lines.textEn: Here’s the armor. (Hand over the body armor)

lines.textCh: 我还有另一项关于交通工具的事情要问你。
lines.textEn: I’ve got another transport question.

lines.textCh: 我之前问过从船上撤离平民的事情。既然现在游荡者已经被搞定了，我们能重启撤离计划了吗？
lines.textEn: I asked before about evacuating a civilian. We dealt with the Rogues. Can we talk about the evac again?

lines.textCh: 那些走私者能帮我从船上撤离一名平民吗？
lines.textEn: Can the smugglers help me evacuate a civilian from the ship?

lines.textCh: 现在肯定不行。他们和那些占据了污水厂的前 USEC 雇佣兵们有些过节。直到麻烦结束之前，想都别想。
lines.textEn: Definitely not at the moment. They’ve got some problems with the Rogue USECs. Until that’s over, don’t even bother asking.

lines.textCh: 当然了，为什么不呢……不过老实讲，要是你的那位朋友已经在船上扎根了，那他还不如舒舒服服待在那。
lines.textEn: Sure, why not… Though honestly, your guy might be better off staying on that ship if he’s got a shelter there.

lines.textCh: 不是，哥们，你认真的吗？我已经帮你撮合一单生意了。你还想要什么？
lines.textEn: Are you for real, dude? I already got you a damn good deal. What else do you want?

lines.textCh: 不是为我找的，那艘破冰船上有一位平民，我们需要把他从船上撤出来。
lines.textEn: It’s not for me. There’s a civilian on the icebreaker who needs extraction.

lines.textCh: 整座城里又不是只有这一个平民身处险境。如果他还想好好活命，就该留在那艘倒霉的船上。
lines.textEn: He’s not the only civvie in this city. He should just stay on the ship if he wants to survive.

lines.textCh: 他不是一般人，他身上带着极度危险的东西。继续让他待在船上实在是太危险了。
lines.textEn: This isn’t just any civilian. He’s carrying dangerous materials. Too risky to leave him on the ship.

lines.textCh: 你真觉得他们会放任这个家伙大摇大摆地通过封锁线？
lines.textEn: And you think anyone’s letting a guy like that past the cordon?

lines.textCh: 我们不需要把他带出塔科夫。只需要在城市里找个安全的地方，把他随身携带的东西妥善藏好，免得被其他人发现就行。
lines.textEn: He doesn’t need to leave, I think. Just needs a safe place in Tarkov to stash the materials so that nobody finds them.

lines.textCh: 行吧……那我该怎么做？
lines.textEn: Okay then… And where do I come in?

lines.textCh: 你已经帮我进到了船里，同时你还能和走私者那边接上线。
lines.textEn: You helped me with transport, and you’ve got contacts with the smugglers.

lines.textCh: 我和他们纯粹是生意往来，没什么交情可言。别指望他们会突然大发善心。
lines.textEn: My contacts are business, not favors. Don’t count on goodwill from them.

lines.textCh: 如果真的有什么东西泄漏到海湾里，我们都不会好过。你、我、那些走私犯都会倒大霉。
lines.textEn: If something leaks into the gulf, it’s bad for everyone. You, me, them.

lines.textCh: 好了，我大概知道你说的是什么了，没错，那些该死的玩意太危险了，不能坐视不管。我会和走私者们说的。
lines.textEn: Alright, I get where you’re heading. Yeah, can’t ignore that kind of shit. I’ll talk to the smugglers.

lines.textCh: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？
lines.textEn: What can I do to help?

lines.textCh: 做点事前准备，确保他们能够安全上船。然后带足防毒面具，至少人手一个。
lines.textEn: Make sure they can land safely on the ship. And bring enough gas masks for everyone.

lines.textCh: 还有其他事情吗？
lines.textEn: Anything else?

lines.textCh: 多带几件护甲来，我不觉得你的那个平民哥们有任何防护——要是他被流弹给盯上中了奖，那我们这趟功夫不都白费了吗。
lines.textEn: Bring some proper extra body armor. I doubt your civvie’s got any protection.

lines.textCh: 明白了，我会处理好的。
lines.textEn: Got it, I’ll handle it.

lines.textCh: 把东西留在座位上吧。
lines.textEn: Leave them on the seat.

lines.textCh: 你应该知道这玩意不装插板的话是没用的吧？
lines.textEn: You do realize it’s useless without plates, right?

lines.textCh: 说得好像我们有的选一样，拿来吧你。
lines.textEn: Like we’ve got better options. Hand them over.

lines.textCh: 那么，你确定已经把船上清理过一遍了？那些走私者说到底只是法外之徒，可不是什么特种部队出身的狠哥们，他们可不会迎着那些精英佣兵的火力往上冲。
lines.textEn: Well did you clear the ship itself? The smugglers are not some spec ops guys, they’re not storming anything head-on.

lines.textCh: 我已经尽我所能削弱船上的守备力量了。至少船上的人比之前要少。
lines.textEn: I did everything I could. It won’t be heavily defended.

lines.textCh: 行……好了，应该就这样了。我和他们说过了，他们会派出一支小队的人手。
lines.textEn: Fine… Well, that should be it. I talked to them, they’ll send an extraction team.

lines.textCh: 有什么东西要我转达给那个平民吗？
lines.textEn: What does the civilian need to know?

lines.textCh: 他们会在夜间行动，悄悄地上船，打枪的不要。在找到他后，那些走私的会报出口令“Yolka”，回令是“Gendarme”。
lines.textEn: They’ll move at night, quiet entry. When they reach him, they’ll say “Yolka”. Answer is “Gendarme”.

lines.textCh: 好的，我会告诉他的。
lines.textEn: Okay, I’ll let him know.

lines.textCh: 酷，让我看看。
lines.textEn: Cool, show me.

lines.textCh: 嘿！你还活着吗？
lines.textEn: Hey! You still alive in there?

lines.textCh: 什么人？！快滚开！
lines.textEn: Who is that?! Go away!

lines.textCh: 我们难道不是已经吵过一回了……所以你到底打不打算撤出这个鬼地方？
lines.textEn: We’ve already been through this… Do you want evacuation or not?

lines.textCh: 撤什么？！哦，对了……没错，当然！交通方式都准备好了吗？
lines.textEn: What evacuation?! Ah, yes… Yes, yes, of course! Is the transport ready?

lines.textCh: 准备好了。一群走私者会在晚上来这，他们已经知道了你的情况，会用船把你送到岸边，然后把你送到森林自然保护区边缘的一个庇护所里。
lines.textEn: Affirmative. A group of smugglers will arrive here tonight. They know the situation. They’ll take you ashore by boat, then move you to a hideout somewhere near the edge of the nature reserve.

lines.textCh: 这样真的安全吗？
lines.textEn: Is it truly safe?

lines.textCh: 我可没看到有多少人排着队等着帮你。你现在打退堂鼓也没用了。
lines.textEn: I don’t exactly see a line of volunteers waiting to help you. Not the time to back out.

lines.textCh: 没错，没错，你说对的……我该怎么知道是他们来了呢？
lines.textEn: Yes, yes, you’re right… How will I recognize them?

lines.textCh: 他们会在晚上登船，然后找你对暗号。口令是“Yolka”，你的回令是“Gendarme”。
lines.textEn: They’ll come at night and say the passphrase. Password is “Yolka”, your response is “Gendarme”.

lines.textCh: 这两个词之间有什么逻辑可言吗？
lines.textEn: What’s the logic?

lines.textCh: 呃，只是暗号而已，非得有逻辑吗……总之就是这样。祝你好运。
lines.textEn: Uh, it doesn’t need to be logical… Alright, that’s it. Good luck.

lines.textCh: 所以，你把我要的人带出来了吗？行动怎么样了？
lines.textEn: So, did you get my civilian out? How’d it go?

lines.textCh: 你他妈该提前告诉我们的，那家伙就是个彻头彻尾的疯子！
lines.textEn: You could’ve warned me we were picking up a fucking lunatic!

lines.textCh: 发生什么事了？
lines.textEn: What happened?

lines.textCh: 我都不知道该从哪说起……我们足足报了三次口令，那家伙才勉强记起回令，然后就冲我的人扑了过来！
lines.textEn: Where do I even start… Guy barely remembered the password on the third try, then jumped my guys!

lines.textCh: 所以他们最后把人带出来了没？
lines.textEn: Did they get him out in the end?

lines.textCh: 屁嘞……那帮走私的也没料到会有这种事情，让那家伙带着公文包跑到别的什么舱室里去了。
lines.textEn: Hell no… They weren’t ready for such ambush, he ran off into the compartments with his briefcase.

lines.textCh: 他甚至没尝试和走私者说些别的什么东西？
lines.textEn: He didn’t even try to talk with the smugglers?

lines.textCh: 他们告诉我的是，那家伙已经完全疯了，对着一个人张嘴就咬，还对着另一个队员扔了一个安瓿瓶。
lines.textEn: From what they said, he was completely fucking mental. Bit one guy, threw some kind of vial at another.

lines.textCh: 他们最后找到他了没？
lines.textEn: Did they find him?

lines.textCh: 换做是你，你要怎么追上这种疯子？他们把附近的舱室都检查了一遍，但那个傻逼就和人间蒸发了一样，消失得无影无踪。
lines.textEn: Well would you be going after a psycho like him? They checked nearby compartments, but the fucker disappeared.

lines.textCh: 明白了。也许他没能回来，反而是件好事。
lines.textEn: Understood. Maybe it’s for the best he didn’t make it back to Tarkov.

lines.textCh: 我们这儿的疯子已经够多了，不缺他这一个。哦对了，别指望还能再有这样的行动了。那帮走私犯不会再听你的指示行事了，门都没有。
lines.textEn: We’ve got enough crazies here already. And yeah, don’t count on ops like this again. Smugglers won’t move on your word anymore.

lines.textCh: 那个平民留下了什么东西没有？
lines.textEn: Did the civilian leave anything behind?

lines.textCh: 有，某种钥匙卡。看上去像是门禁卡一类的东西，也许是他自己实验区的门卡。拿着吧，我不想和这种操蛋玩意扯上任何关系。
lines.textEn: Yeah. Some keycard, looks like it opens his lab compartment. Take it. I want nothing to do with that shit.

lines.textCh: 那我去帮他们处理那些 USEC 会怎么样？
lines.textEn: Then maybe I help them deal with those USECs?

lines.textCh: 明白了。如果我帮他们清理掉一些游荡者，那些走私的应该不会介意吧？
lines.textEn: Got it. If I thin out some of those Rogues, the smugglers won’t mind, right?

lines.textCh: 我已经大大削弱了那些游荡者的数量，情况出现变化了吗？
lines.textEn: I cut down the Rogue numbers. Did that change anything?

lines.textCh: 那肯定得等他们行动结束。不过我听说他们已经开始准备了，等我们下次再聊的时候，应该就有结果了。
lines.textEn: Well obviously we better wait until they’re done with their operation. But from what I hear, they’re already gearing up, so by the time we talk again, it’ll be clear.

lines.textCh: 听着，有没有可能跟走私者那边再谈谈，弄个更方便一点的上船方式？
lines.textEn: Listen, is there any chance to work something out with the smugglers for a more convenient way to reach the ship?

lines.textCh: 我们不是已经给你安排好气垫船了吗？出什么问题了？
lines.textEn: Something wrong with the hovercraft we arranged for you?

lines.textCh: 接应点不行，太危险了。
lines.textEn: The pickup point’s bad. Too risky.

lines.textCh: 我早就跟你说了，他们本来就不怎么待见你这种人……
lines.textEn: Told you already, they’re not exactly fans of your kind…

lines.textCh: 要不是很重要，我也不会来问。只要能让去那艘破冰船的路更安全一点，我可以多出钱，也可以多干活。
lines.textEn: I wouldn’t be asking if it wasn’t important. I’m ready to pay well and put in the work if it makes getting to the icebreaker easier.

lines.textCh: 嚯嚯，塔科夫都有破冰船了？核动力那种吧？Rosatom 那帮人就这么把这种大家伙丢在塔科夫不管了？
lines.textEn: We’ve got a whole damn icebreaker sitting around now? And Rosatom just decided to leave something that big in Tarkov?

lines.textCh: 私人公司的船，跟政府还有俄国的原子能机构都没关系。
lines.textEn: Yeah, but it’s a private ship. Nothing to do with the government.

lines.textCh: 那我就不多问了。我突然感觉活着还挺好的，你懂的。
lines.textEn: Then I’m not asking whose it is. I’d like to stay alive, if you catch my drift.

lines.textCh: 那上船方式这事呢？你能不能再帮我打听下有没有更好的路线？
lines.textEn: So what about transport? Can you find out if there’s a better route?

lines.textCh: 换成是我，我根本就不会纠结这种问题。那帮走私犯最近和盘踞在灯塔的 USEC 逃兵杠上了，根本没空搭理你这些要求。
lines.textEn: If I were you, I’d drop it right now. They’ve got some shit going on with those USEC defectors, so they’ve got zero time for you and your requests.

lines.textCh: 要是我愿意多出钱呢？
lines.textEn: Even if I pay a lot?

lines.textCh: 你还是没明白。他们现在是真有大麻烦。走私的现在还没取消生意让你自己狗刨游上船，你就偷着乐吧。
lines.textEn: You don’t get it. They’ve got real problems right now. Be glad they haven’t canceled your boat deal already.

lines.textCh: 谁知道呢。你要真这么急，就去帮呗，反正也没人拦你。
lines.textEn: Hell if I know. If you’re that desperate, go help. No one’s stopping you.

lines.textCh: 那些游荡者到底在搞什么？
lines.textEn: What exactly is going on with the Rogues?

lines.textCh: 具体我也不清楚，而且我也不想掺和。你自己去问他们吧。这帮西方佬个顶个的暴力狂，见面先开枪，话也不问。
lines.textEn: Don’t know the details, and I’m not getting into it. Go ask them yourself, they’ll shoot you first and ask questions never.

lines.textCh: 听你的语气，感觉不只是他们出事，你也被波及了？到底怎么回事？
lines.textEn: You’re talking like this hit you too, not just them. What’s going on?

lines.textCh: 那当然影响到我了！我本来指望能从他们那跑的一大批活全都泡汤了。
lines.textEn: Well it did hit me too! I lost a chunk of jobs I was counting on.

lines.textCh: 我已经跟你说过了，随你便。我自己这边的麻烦已经够多了。
lines.textEn: I already told you, do what you want. I’ve got enough shit on my plate as it is.

lines.textCh: 行。等我处理完那些游荡者再回来找你。
lines.textEn: Alright. I’ll come back once I deal with the Rogues.

lines.textCh: 老实说，没想到你一出手就有这么大的成效。连走私者都在问我，这种级别的支援是从哪冒出来的。
lines.textEn: Didn’t expect you to help that much, honestly. Smugglers themselves asked me where the hell that kind of backup came from.

lines.textCh: 那现在有没有可能有更安全的上船路线？
lines.textEn: So there’s a chance now for an easier route to the icebreaker?

lines.textCh: 别急，兄弟，现在那些游荡者把走私者的一个指挥官扣在他们基地里了，这事很麻烦。
lines.textEn: Don’t rush it, man. Right now the Rogues are holding one of the smuggler commanders at their base, and that’s a big problem.

lines.textCh: 你是想让我一个人去他们基地把人救出来？
lines.textEn: You want me to run a solo extraction from their base?

lines.textCh: 要是有人硬闯，那帮西方佬会第一时间把指挥官给撕票。不过走私的已经想出计划了。
lines.textEn: If anyone tries to storm that place, they’ll ice the commander right away. But the guys have a plan.

lines.textCh: 那你需要我做什么？
lines.textEn: So what do you need from me?

lines.textCh: 他们需要你检查一下从森林保护区到水处理厂的路线。要是这帮人顺利把人救出来了，他们会记得是你帮的忙。
lines.textEn: Need you to check the route from the nature reserve area to the water treatment plant. If they pull their guy out, they’ll remember you helped.

lines.textCh: 所以就是从森林一路走到灯塔那边？
lines.textEn: So just walk the path from woods to the lighthouse?

lines.textCh: 重点是确认这条路线是安全的，没有什么意外埋伏。用红外标记器把起点和终点都标记一下，这样他们才知道你确实检查过了。
lines.textEn: Main thing is to make sure the route’s clear and nothing unexpected is waiting there. Mark the start and end with IR strobes so they know you actually checked it.

lines.textCh: 明白了。那我做完直接回来找你？
lines.textEn: Okay. Then go right back to you?

lines.textCh: 先别急。等他们那边行动结束再说。你先去忙你在那艘船上的事，完了再回来。
lines.textEn: Hold your horses. Better wait until they finish their operation. Do your thing on that ship for now, then come back.

lines.textCh: 这些够了吗？
lines.textEn: So is that enough?

lines.textCh: 我带了点香肠，应该能下酒。（上交咸狗牛肉肠）
lines.textEn: Brought some sausage, thought it might help. (Hand over the sausage)

lines.textCh: 这有点面包干当零嘴。（上交黑麦面包干）
lines.textEn: Here are some crackers for snacks. (Hand over the croutons)

lines.textCh: 走私者那边成功把指挥官救出来了吗？
lines.textEn: So, did the smugglers pull off the commander's rescue?

lines.textCh: 我找到了一瓶私酿酒。（上交私酒）
lines.textEn: Found some moonshine. (Hand over the bottle of moonshine)

lines.textCh: 这些够了吗？
lines.textEn: So is that enough?

lines.textCh: 那现在他们有时间帮我了吗？
lines.textEn: So now they’ve got time to help me?

lines.textCh: 怎么，你不信我这张嘴？下次我们再聊的时候，我已经全给你摆平了。
lines.textEn: What, you doubt my persuasion skills? Next time we talk, I’ll have everything sorted.

lines.textCh: 我带了点东西来，这些够吗？
lines.textEn: Brought some stuff. Is that enough?

lines.textCh: 先让我看看你都带了什么。
lines.textEn: Let’s see what you’ve got.

lines.textCh: 我带了点伏特加。（上交伏特加）
lines.textEn: Got some vodka. (Hand over the bottle of vodka)

lines.textCh: 不错啊！
lines.textEn: Splendid!

lines.textCh: 哈哈，你连跑刀仔私酒都搞来了？卧槽可以啊，小心点放。
lines.textEn: You got the Hatchling? Fuck yeah man, put it down carefully.

lines.textCh: 有点小吃也行！拿过来……
lines.textEn: Some snacks’ll do! Give’em here…

lines.textCh: 我吃这玩意吃了一辈子了，还是拿不准里面塞的到底是什么馅。行了，把它丢在那吧。
lines.textEn: Been eating this crap my whole life, still don’t trust what’s in it. Alright, toss it here.

lines.textCh: 嗯，可以了。
lines.textEn: Yeah, that’ll do.

lines.textCh: 那我猜你这边还需要点时间才能有答复？
lines.textEn: Guessing it’ll take some time for the answer?

lines.textCh: 我哪知道。先继续坐气垫船，把你在那艘船上的事处理好。过段时间再回来，到时候就有明确答复了。
lines.textEn: Hell if I know. For now, keep using the hovercraft and handle your business on the ship. Come back later, we’ll have a clear answer then.

lines.textCh: 嗯。过程不算顺利，损失不小，但人是救出来了。
lines.textEn: Yeah. Didn’t go clean, they took losses. But they got their commander out.

lines.textCh: 老实说，我还真没觉得他们能打得过那些游荡者。
lines.textEn: Honestly, I didn’t even think the smugglers stood a chance against the Rogues.

lines.textCh: 那些走私的早在契约战争爆发之前就玩上枪了，他们之中还有不少本地的好手，都是服过兵役的狠角色。
lines.textEn: The smugglers already were tied to guns even before the Contract Wars, and there are plenty of local enthusiasts among them with solid training.

lines.textCh: 我不能保证。是你自己选择掺和进这堆事的。不过我正好要过去一趟，可以顺便帮你问问。
lines.textEn: Can’t promise anything. You chose to get involved in all this. But I’m heading over there anyway, I’ll ask about your situation too.

lines.textCh: 有什么是我能做的吗？你懂的，促成你们谈判。
lines.textEn: Anything I can do to influence that?

lines.textCh: 他们的损失也真不少，不过暂时把游荡者压住了。所以接下来既要哀悼……也要庆祝。懂我意思吧？
lines.textEn: They lost a lot of people, but they handled the Rogues for now. So there’ll be mourning… and celebration. You get what I’m saying?

lines.textCh: 给宴会带点见面礼。
lines.textEn: Bring something to the table.

lines.textCh: 对！带点吃的喝的，肯定能让场面好看很多。我这边可没时间替你准备这些。
lines.textEn: Exactly! Bring some supplies, it’ll help. I don’t have time to deal with that myself.

lines.textCh: 行，我尽量去搞。
lines.textEn: Alright, I’ll get what I can.

lines.textCh: 别忘了带瓶私酒来！
lines.textEn: Don’t forget the moonshine!

lines.textCh: 所以他们完全靠的是自己的人？
lines.textEn: So they rely entirely on their own people?

lines.textCh: 哪能呢。冲突升级之后，那些小伙子很快就和一些 BEAR 搭上了线，还谈成了交易。走私者负责给几个 PMC 单位供应上好的武器，雇佣兵那边则帮忙出面平事儿。
lines.textEn: Nah. Once the conflict really kicked off, the boys got in touch with some BEARs fast and worked out a deal. The smugglers supplied certain units with quality weapons in exchange for support.

lines.textCh: 那之后发生的事情呢？
lines.textEn: And what happened after that?

lines.textCh: 当所有通信手段都玩逑了之后，有些 BEAR 就和走私者们混到一起去了。至少比困守在原地，等什么狗屁指挥部的命令安全些。
lines.textEn: Once all communications went to shit, some of those BEAR guys stayed with the smugglers. Safer than sitting around waiting for orders from command.

lines.textCh: 这小玩意儿可救过我不止一次。（上交Aquamari水瓶）
lines.textEn: This little drink saved me more than once. (Hand over the bottle of Aquamari)

lines.textCh: 还好我资源管理做得好，给我留点！（上交纯净水）
lines.textEn: Thankfully I’m good at resource management. Leave some for me! (Hand over the canister with purified water)

lines.textCh: 你运气不错。（上交罐装腌黄瓜）
lines.textEn: Lucky you. (Hand over the jar of pickles)

lines.textCh: 你都这样了还开车呢？行吧，给你这个。（上交塔克肉干）
lines.textEn: Why are you even driving like this? Fine, here. (Hand over the pack of dried meat)

lines.textCh: 我就知道你用得上这个。（上交牛肉罐头）
lines.textEn: Figured you’d need this. (Hand over the can of beef stew)

lines.textCh: 幸好我带了这个。（上交淡啤酒）
lines.textEn: Good thing I brought this then. (Hand over the bottle of beer)

lines.textCh: 给你。（上交安乃近止痛药）
lines.textEn: Here. (Hand over the Analgin pills)

lines.textCh: 完美！他们需要时间准备吗？
lines.textEn: Perfect! Do they need time to prepare everything?

lines.textCh: 你那边跟走私者谈得怎么样了？没把我搭船这事忘了吧？
lines.textEn: So, how did it go with the smugglers? You didn’t forget about my transport?

lines.textCh: 怎么可能忘！我慢慢跟你说……嗝……你身上有没有什么能解酒的东西？
lines.textEn: Of course I didn’t! I’ll tell you everything… Ugh… You got anything for a hangover?

lines.textCh: 没有，身上啥也没有。
lines.textEn: No, nothing on me.

lines.textCh: 唉，真他妈难受……算了，扛一扛吧。
lines.textEn: Well, shit… Fine, I’ll live.

lines.textCh: 我不爱吃药……不过还是谢了。
lines.textEn: I hate pills… but thanks.

lines.textCh: 卧槽，这才对味！你可真是救了我这条狗命啊！
lines.textEn: Oh damn, now that’s what I’m talking about! You saved me!

lines.textCh: 不错，真不错……
lines.textEn: Not bad, not bad…

lines.textCh: 能不能弄点带肥肉的来，吃着香点？算了，有得吃就行。
lines.textEn: Got anything fattier? Eh, whatever, I’ll take it.

lines.textCh: 腌黄瓜？完美！
lines.textEn: Pickles? That’s perfect!

lines.textCh: 不行不行，要一口气全喝光，我们就得翻到路边去了……不过还是谢了！
lines.textEn: Nah, sorry. We’re gonna be stuck here for a while if I don’t chug it all… But thanks!

lines.textCh: 哟……Aquamari 啊，我自己可从来舍不得买，太贵了。拿来吧。
lines.textEn: Opa… Never bought Aquamari myself, too damn expensive. Hand it over.

lines.textCh: 那我上船的事情呢？
lines.textEn: So what about my transport to the icebreaker?

lines.textCh: 你帮着把游荡者那摊子事收拾得差不多了。所以嘛，我这边也给你谈下来了。
lines.textEn: You did a lot to wrap up that Rogue mess. So yeah, I worked something out.

lines.textCh: 他们把气垫船换到更安全的位置了？
lines.textEn: They’re gonna move the hovercraft to a better spot?

lines.textCh: 还不止！他们现在可以直接把你从家里送到破冰船上。或者你那个藏身处，随你怎么叫。
lines.textEn: Even better! They’re ready to drop you onto the icebreaker straight from your base. Or whatever you call that basement of yours.

lines.textCh: 听起来太离谱了。我可不会把藏身处的坐标给他们。
lines.textEn: Sounds too good to be true. I’m not giving them my hideout coordinates.

lines.textCh: 那你就给个附近合适的位置就行了，这事没你想的那么复杂。
lines.textEn: Then give them something nearby. It’s not that complicated, dude.

lines.textCh: 那行吧。他们什么时候能准备好？
lines.textEn: Whatever. When will they be ready?

lines.textCh: 他们已经在开始准备了。等你回去的时候，应该就差不多搞定了。记住，运费你自己出，而且价格可不低。
lines.textEn: They’re already getting things set up. By the time you’re back home, it’ll be ready. Just remember, transport fees are on you, and it’s really not cheap.

lines.textCh: 可以，没问题。谢了，这一路帮了不少忙。
lines.textEn: That works. Thank you for all the help.

lines.textCh: 我们现在说话这会儿他们就已经在忙了。所以别担心，你回去的时候就能用了。就是记得准备好钱。
lines.textEn: They’re already working on it while we’re talking. So don’t worry, it’ll be ready when you get back. Just be ready to pay.

lines.textCh: 也对……行吧，多谢帮忙。
lines.textEn: Figures… Well, thanks for the help.

lines.textCh: 我还有问题想问你，你还在那吗？(敲门)
