69001c84e85e475e590c752b.textEn: In The Lab I found a note instructing someone to send the Item 1156 blueprint by mail. There was definitely a Rus Post office in the city. Maybe I can trace the package from there?

69001c94ee0991aafd0f3698.textCh:
我决定调查塔科夫上空出现神秘蓝色爆炸之后，城市大规模停电的原因。结果发现，是 TerraGroup 在城市上空引爆了他们研发的一种实验性 EMP 武器。

可他们到底为什么要一下子瘫痪整座城市的电力？

也许那道蓝色天火是 TerraGroup 用来毁尸灭迹、抹去一切电子设备里的数据的手段。又或者，测试这种实验性武器才是塔科夫整场冲突背后的真正目的？
69001c94ee0991aafd0f3698.textEn:
I decided to investigate the reasons behind the massive power outage after the blue explosion over Tarkov. It turns out an experimental EMP weapon developed by TerraGroup was activated over the city.

But why would they need to shut down the entire city’s power?

Perhaps that blue fire was intended to fry all of TerraGroup’s electronics with data. Or maybe testing the experimental weapon was the real goal behind the whole conflict in Tarkov?

69001ca05d8e37f04d0ae9f6.textCh:
在俄罗斯邮政局，我找到了一盘录有快递员通话内容的录音带。看来他因为出城检查站爆发的大堵车而没能离开城市。

他说直接把车扔在路上了，钥匙藏在轮子下面。这意味着我还有机会找到那份蓝图。
69001ca05d8e37f04d0ae9f6.textEn:
At the Rus Post office, I found an audio tape with a recorded call from a courier. Looks like he never managed to leave the city due to traffic jams at the checkpoints.

He said he’d leave the car right on the road and hide the key under the wheel. That means I still have a chance to find the blueprints.

69001ca3384a9902240dee5f.textCh: 我找到了那辆快递车，包裹说不定就在里面。现在我只需要把货舱打开就能知道了——司机把钥匙藏在了轮子下面。
69001ca3384a9902240dee5f.textEn: I found the courier's vehicle that might hold the package I need. Now I just have to open it — the driver hid the key under the wheel.

69016bcdfe0d0d093008c3bd.textCh: 我找到了一张进入 TerraGroup 实验室的门禁卡。我相当怀疑这张门禁卡到底有多少通行权限，但至少我现在能进入到设施里面了。
69016bcdfe0d0d093008c3bd.textEn: I found an access keycard to TerraGroup Labs. I doubt it has top-level clearance, but it should at least open the way into the facility.

6903565c39d72aaf3f0c508c.textCh:
没有任何商人知道如何离开塔科夫。他们要么单纯是不信任我，或者只是拖延时间。

无论如何，如果我还想撤离，哪怕是为了争取那一丝渺茫的机会，我都得和他们建立更牢固的关系。这当然要耗费大量的时间精力。

这意味着我必须建立自己的藏身处，并扎下根来。如果不靠当地联络人的支持，单单自己硬撑，我根本撑不了多久。

我必须摸清这座城市，城市的每条街道，地区之间的每条路线都得了如指掌。对塔科夫的理解越深，撤离的时机也将越近。
6903565c39d72aaf3f0c508c.textEn:
None of the traders know how to get out of Tarkov. Or maybe they just don’t trust me, or are stalling for time.

Either way, I need to build stronger ties with them if I want even a small chance of evacuation. It’ll take time and effort.

That means I’ll have to set up my own hideout and dig in. Without any kind of support from the locals, I won’t last long.

I need to learn this city, every route and district. The more I understand Tarkov, the closer I’ll get to leaving it behind.

6903cc5963aaab6fac021c3e.textCh: 如果我想离开塔科夫，我需要恢复与 Lightkeeper 的联系。我应该去和 Mechanic 谈谈——他大概知道该怎么做。
6903cc5963aaab6fac021c3e.textEn: If I want to get out of Tarkov, I need to restore my access to Lightkeeper. I should talk to Mechanic — he probably knows what to do.

6903cc66fe75ce0c990014b0.textCh: 我设法重新获得了Lightkeeper的好感。惹怒他是很危险的，我最好不要再干这种蠢事了。
6903cc66fe75ce0c990014b0.textEn: I managed to regain Lightkeeper's favor. Angering him is dangerous, it's best I not pull this stunt again.

69077abf70d79291a9084df4.textCh: 我现在可以前往疏散区了，但在此之前，我必须穿过装卸区。第一步——找到那个该死的门。
69077abf70d79291a9084df4.textEn: I can head to the evac zone now, but to get there, I’ll have to cross the loading area. Step one — find the damn entrance.

69077ae58d3e2ebfbf0e0c7d.textCh:
我找到了一条维修通道，但没有钥匙卡我是过不去的。得把它找出来。

那些袭击港口的混蛋们身上绝对带着对应的钥匙卡……否则他们是没法神不知鬼不觉渗透进来的，更别提大肆破坏了。
69077ae58d3e2ebfbf0e0c7d.textEn:
I found a service passage, but I can’t get through without a keycard. Gotta find it.

Those bastards who hit the Terminal almost certainly had keycards with the proper access — no other way they could sneak in and sabotage things back here.

69077af5a7472ace3f0ddde7.textCh: 找到钥匙卡了。现在我可以打开通往码头的那条通道了。
69077af5a7472ace3f0ddde7.textEn: Found the keycard. Now I can unlock the passage at the seaport.

69077ba69d32614b720e02bc.textCh: 我已经进入了港口的装卸区。接下来，我得想办法赶往码头，直到溜进撤离区域成功逃出去为止。
69077ba69d32614b720e02bc.textEn: I made it into the terminal’s loading zone. Next up, I need to work out how to get to the pier and make it into the evac area.

69077bd6248b37f5730657ed.textCh:
我找到了一张字条，上面说通往码头的门被锁上了，而钥匙在泵站的一名军官手里。看来我得先回去才行，那个泵站应该在油库附近。

参照那些油罐的方位，我就能顺路摸到油库区。
69077bd6248b37f5730657ed.textEn:
I found a note saying the gates to the pier are locked, and the key is held by an officer at the pumping station. Looks like I’ll have to go back. That pumping station should be near the fuel depot.

I’ll need to navigate by the big fuel tanks.

69077bf270d79291a9084df8.textCh: 现在我可以打开通往码头撤离区域的大门了。
69077bf270d79291a9084df8.textEn: Now I can unlock the gate leading to the evacuation zone at the pier.

69077c08248b37f5730657f0.textCh: 我找到了油库区域的入口。现在我得想办法打开那道门前往码头那里才行。
69077c08248b37f5730657f0.textEn: I found the entrance to the fuel depot area. Now I need to figure out how to open those gates.

69077c1a70091d43140dcbdd.textCh: 我找到了泵站，但它被水淹了。我得把水排掉。
69077c1a70091d43140dcbdd.textEn: I found the pumping station, but it’s flooded. I’ll have to drain the water.

69077c248ef7ec568f077b3d.textCh: 现在我可以继续前进，拿到通往码头大门的钥匙了。
69077c248ef7ec568f077b3d.textEn: Now I can move on and grab the key to the gates leading to the pier.

69077c68248b37f5730657f3.textCh: 为了把水排掉，我需要修好损坏的电路面板，或者配电盘之类的东西。为此，我得找到字条中提到的那份分布图。
69077c68248b37f5730657f3.textEn: To drain the water, I need to fix the broken electrical panels. For that, I have to find the diagram mentioned in the note.

69077c90a7472ace3f0dddeb.textCh: 我找到了电气配电盘的分布图。该好好查查到底是哪个面板坏了，只要把坏的部分修好，应该就能恢复泵站的电力了。
69077c90a7472ace3f0dddeb.textEn: I found the panel diagram. Time to check each one and fix whatever's broken to restore power to the fuel station.

6907af42267c30d8c3020e2f.textCh: Kerman 劝我不要过于相信箱子里的说明书。据他所说，我必须重新激活那张门禁卡。为了办成这件事，他给了我一份清单：我需要找到一张有实验室高级权限的主卡、一张空白 RFID 钥匙卡，还有一个钥匙卡加密装置。我还需要一整套太阳能发电系统来保证整套装置有稳定的供电。
6907af42267c30d8c3020e2f.textEn: Kerman talked me out of using the instructions from the case. According to him, I’ve got to activate the keycard instead. He gave me a checklist: a master pass, a blank RFID, and an encryptor. I’ll also need a solar panel to power the setup.

6907af52e556032c5b0a3519.textCh: 我找到了一张空白RFID卡。现在可以派上用场了。
6907af52e556032c5b0a3519.textEn: I found a blank RFID card. I can put it to use now.

6907af5de84f9ce9740d5811.textCh:
我终于拿到激活好的钥匙卡了。感觉就像过了一辈子一样，但愿能得偿所愿。

撤离点在港口，是时候动身了。我就快要离开这个被诅咒的地方了。
6907af5de84f9ce9740d5811.textEn:
The activated card is finally in my hands. Took forever, but maybe it’ll pay off.

The evac point is at the port, time to move. I’m almost out of this cursed place.

6907afb8504c177fd607d865.textEn: I found the correct master pass.

6907afede84f9ce9740d5814.textCh: 我把实验室都翻了个遍，浪费了这么多时间，却一无所获。我该去问问Kerman接下来该怎么办。
6907afede84f9ce9740d5814.textEn: I’ve torn through the labs and wasted so much time, but came up empty. I should ask Kerman what to do next.

6907b0130042d8513200b6c7.textCh: Kerman先生让我去找Mechanic。希望他手里有那个钥匙卡加密装置。
6907b0130042d8513200b6c7.textEn: Mr. Kerman sent me to see Mechanic. Fingers crossed he’s got that card encryptor.

6907b01f504c177fd607d868.textCh: Mechanic能帮我。更准确地说，是他的朋友Elektronik。只希望他们别坑我。
6907b01f504c177fd607d868.textEn: Mechanic can help me. Or rather, his friend, Elektronik. Let’s just hope they don’t screw me over.

6907b03de84f9ce9740d5817.textCh: Mechanic 说 Elektronik 只接受比特币作为报酬。真是聪明的做法！他是爽了，遭罪的可是我。
6907b03de84f9ce9740d5817.textEn: Mechanic said Elektronik only takes Bitcoins for his work. Clever move! And a real pain, at least for me.

6907b04d23305ffa87025b4e.textCh: 我已经凑齐了比特币。是时候把它们交给 Mechanic 了。希望他的朋友还没有改变主意，别不愿帮我了。
6907b04d23305ffa87025b4e.textEn: I've gathered the Bitcoins. Time to hand them over to Mechanic. Hopefully his friend hasn't changed his mind about helping me.

6907b04e0042d8513200b6ca.textCh:
一切都很顺利。Mechanic 毫不犹豫地收下了比特币，并把钥匙交给了我。现在我需要去约定的位置拿那个设备：Klimov 大街 14A 号建筑。

Klimov 大街就是 Cardinal 公寓与商业街之间的那条东西方向主路，如果我把钥匙弄丢了，我应该可以和 Mechanic 交易，再弄一份复制品来。
6907b04e0042d8513200b6ca.textEn:
Everything went smoothly. Mechanic took the Bitcoins without questions and handed me the key. Now I need to pick up the device at the agreed location: Klimov Street, building 14A.

If I lose the key, I should be able to trade for a copy with Mechanic.

6907b0ba0042d8513200b6cd.textCh: 我终于拿到了钥匙卡加密装置。这倒霉玩意儿给我惹了一大堆麻烦……但至少我拿到这东西了。
6907b0ba0042d8513200b6cd.textEn: I got the card encryption device at last. Damn thing caused a ton of trouble… but at least it’s in my hands now.

6907b270e84f9ce9740d5821.textCh: 该死的钥匙卡没用！我差点因为鼓捣这破玩意儿把命丢了。我得马上联系 Kerman，弄清楚到底发生了什么鬼事。
6907b270e84f9ce9740d5821.textEn: The card didn’t work! I almost got killed messing around with this crap. I need to contact Kerman immediately to figure out what the hell’s going on.

6907b286267c30d8c3020e3c.textCh:
Kerman 承认那是故意的！棒极了……不过至少他解释了原因，而在塔科夫生活了一段时间后，我多少能理解他为什么要这样做：在信任他人之前，先考察他们的背景。

现在我得想办法挖出 TerraGroup 的黑料。虽然边边角角的东西也可以，但我真正要的是劲爆猛料。这才是最优先的部分。
6907b286267c30d8c3020e3c.textEn:
Kerman admits it was on purpose! Great… Well, at least he explained why, and after living in Tarkov a while, I can see his point: vet people before you trust them.

Now I’ve got to dig up dirt on TerraGroup. Small dirt will do, but I’m after something major. That’s the priority.

6907b29170091d43140dcda0.textCh: 我已经同意替Kerman先生收集TerraGroup的黑料。
6907b29170091d43140dcda0.textEn: I've agreed to gather dirt on TerraGroup for Mr. Kerman.

6907b29e19ec67566d0f0960.textCh:
Kerman 承认那是故意的！太好了…然后他又开始说什么需要我的帮助。我直接拒绝了他。他都已经坑过我一次了，谁知道他下一步会搞什么？不，我要自己找到离开的方法。

是时候另外想办法离开塔科夫了。我应该去问问其他商人，也许有人知道些什么。
6907b29e19ec67566d0f0960.textEn:
Kerman admits it was on purpose! Great… Then he started with his speech about needing my help. I told him no. If he’s already burned me once, who knows what he’ll pull next? No, I’ll find my own way out.

Time to look for another way to escape Tarkov. I should ask around the traders, maybe someone knows something.

6907b2b84396544d140a55c0.textCh: 完美。现在我可以把我挖到的所有TerraGroup黑料都交给Kerman了。
6907b2b84396544d140a55c0.textEn: Perfect. Now I can get all the dirt I dig up on TerraGroup over to Kerman.

6907b2c3e556032c5b0a351f.textCh: 我把塔科夫能翻的东西都翻遍了，把能找到的全都挖了出来。如果Kerman先生真的把这些全部公布，TerraGroup就彻底完蛋了。
6907b2c3e556032c5b0a351f.textEn: I scraped Tarkov clean for whatever I could find. If Mr. Kerman really publishes it all, TerraGroup will be finished.

6907b2ca0042d8513200b6d6.textCh: 我设法收集到了一堆关于TerraGroup见不得人的勾当的小证据。Kerman先生说他需要大的东西，但也许这些就足够了。
6907b2ca0042d8513200b6d6.textEn: I managed to collect a bunch of small pieces of evidence on TerraGroup's shady dealings. Mr. Kerman said he needed something big, but maybe this will be enough.

6907b2da70d79291a9084e43.textCh:
我搜遍了整个塔科夫，挖出了一堆关于TerraGroup以及幕后操纵者的信息。这活很辛苦，但值得。

Kerman说我也应该把原始证据带在身上。希望它们不会在港口被没收。
6907b2da70d79291a9084e43.textEn:
I combed through Tarkov and dug up a heap of info on TerraGroup and the ones pulling the strings. Hard work, but worth it.

Kerman said I should grab the original evidence with me as well. Let’s hope it doesn’t get taken at the port.

6907b37a8d3e2ebfbf0e1a6e.textCh: Fence 给我寄来了一封信。看来 Kerman 就是通过这种方式把哈希代码传给我的。这家伙的关系网到底是有多广啊……？
6907b37a8d3e2ebfbf0e1a6e.textEn: Fence sent me a letter. Seems like this is how Kerman will pass the hash codes to me. Just how massive is his network…?

6907b38670d79291a9084e46.textCh:
在我证明自己值得信任之前，Fence 是不会跟我再有往来的。

也许我能替他做些差事、给钱让那个和 Fence 有交集的司机带我撤离、或者帮助 Scav，和他们合作撤离来建立自己的信誉。
6907b38670d79291a9084e46.textEn:
Fence wouldn’t talk to me until I proved my reliability.

I can prove my loyalty by completing Fence’s tasks, using paid extractions, helping the Scavs and getting out of raids with them.

6907b429794bf3d8e60b7b1c.textCh: 现在 Fence 绝对不会再敷衍我了。是时候再去见他一趟了。
6907b429794bf3d8e60b7b1c.textEn: Now Fence definitely won’t brush me off. Time to pay him another visit.

6907b447504c177fd607d870.textCh: 理所当然，Fence 没有立刻把所有东西都给我。以他的名声来看，我本该料到的…好吧，我得赶紧把一切处理好。
6907b447504c177fd607d870.textEn: Naturally, Fence didn’t just give me everything immediately. Should’ve seen that coming, given his reputation… Alright, I need to sort everything out quickly.

6907b453267c30d8c3020e40.textCh:
终于，我把 Fence 发布的所有任务都完成了。不得不说是一场充满痛苦的折磨之旅，但至少我拿到那个装有哈希代码的 U 盘了。

现在只剩下最后一步了：把代码写进卡片里，让卡片能在港口那里生效。我现在只希望 Kerman 千万别在最后关头留一手。
6907b453267c30d8c3020e40.textEn:
Finally, I finished all the tasks given by Fence. It was a grind, but the flash drive with the hash codes is mine.

One step left: update the hash codes on the card so it’ll work at the port. Hopefully, Kerman hasn’t hidden any more tricks for me.

6907b46770091d43140dcda3.textCh: 在 BTR 司机的问题上我选择了站在 Skier 这边。结果不出意料，Fence 气得跳脚。看样子这下得换个方式才能逃出塔科夫了。
6907b46770091d43140dcda3.textEn: I picked Skier’s side against the BTR driver. As expected, Fence is furious. Seems like escaping Tarkov is going to require a different plan.

6907b4a6267c30d8c3020e43.textCh:
钥匙卡成功重编完毕，稳稳当当地在我手中。这一回 Kerman 应该不会再耍我了。

现在我可以前往港口了，差不多 21:00 到凌晨 6:00 天色没亮的这段时间。港口周围游荡的人越少，搞砸的几率也就越小。此外我还得用安全箱装上我找到的 TerraGroup 罪证原件一起出发。
6907b4a6267c30d8c3020e43.textEn:
The card is reprogrammed and in my possession. I doubt Kerman will try to double-cross me this time.

I should move to the port at night. From about 21:00 to 06:00 the entrance should be clear. And I better bring the secure container with the TerraGroup evidence.

6907b4af70091d43140dcda6.textCh:
Kerman 没有撒谎——他们把我放了进去。

港口终点站遭到了突发袭击，在一片混乱中，没人顾得上安排我继续完成撤离。是时候重新拿起武器，靠自己一路杀到撤离点了。
6907b4af70091d43140dcda6.textEn:
Mr. Kerman wasn’t lying — I was let into the port.

The terminal got hit, though, and nobody gives a damn about my evacuation now. Time to fight my way to the evac point.

6907b4bbe84f9ce9740d5825.textCh: 装着证据的箱子还在我手边，现在最重要的事情是前往码头疏散区域。
6907b4bbe84f9ce9740d5825.textEn: The case with the evidence is with me. Now the main thing is to get to the pier.

6907b4c923305ffa87025b5c.textCh: 我逃出了塔科夫。这座城市今后肯定会无数次闪回出现在我的噩梦之中，但没关系，我已经完成了我该干的事业——为了将正义带出塔科夫而战，同时也是为了将整个世界从 TerraGroup 的掌控之下拯救出来而战。
6907b4c923305ffa87025b5c.textEn: I got out of Tarkov. The city will keep showing up in my nightmares, no doubt, but that’s fine. I did what I had to do — fought to bring justice and protect this world from TerraGroup.

690806a1c75638a9300f58e8.textCh:
宿舍楼旁停着一辆轿车，车上留下了一份颇为粗俗的威胁信。

看样子宿舍楼里的某个居民被当地的混混给缠上了。但这个科兹洛夫肯定不是整个厂区唯一欠了债的人，从没见过这样的讨债方式——搞不好他们不是为了讨钱，而是出于别的原因在追杀他？
690806a1c75638a9300f58e8.textEn:
Next to the dorms, there’s a sedan with a threatening message left on it.

It seems one of the residents had a serious debt. But this Kozlov was probably not the only debtor in the industrial zone. Perhaps he was being hunted for a reason?

690806b3f3b8b0107d03a9cb.textCh: 似乎这就是科兹洛夫的房间了。有人在门上留下了一则消息。
690806b3f3b8b0107d03a9cb.textEn: It looks like I’ve found Kozlov’s room. Someone left a note on the door.

690806c369e89d21b4052a48.textCh: 我在海关宿舍楼里找到了一条奇怪的消息，要么是追债的混混留下的，又或者是其他人。很显然，那些混混一直在纠缠着科兹洛夫。也许他们想逮住科兹洛夫狠狠敲上一笔，也许这背后还另有更深的阴谋。
690806c369e89d21b4052a48.textEn: I found a weird note in the Customs dorm, could be from debt collectors, could be from someone else. Seems like someone’s been hunting for Kozlov. Maybe they wanted to shake him down for a debt, or maybe it’s something bigger.

690806cfd71ec6d7b104765e.textCh: 我进入了科兹洛夫的房间。该好好搜查一下了，看看能有什么发现。
690806cfd71ec6d7b104765e.textEn: I made it into Kozlov’s room. Time to take a good look around and see what’s here.

690806d9f3b8b0107d03a9ce.textCh: 从字条的内容看，科兹洛夫在海关区域的一个维修车间工作。也许能在工位上找到他的其他个人物品。
690806d9f3b8b0107d03a9ce.textEn: Judging by the note, Kozlov worked in the repair shop at the customs area. His personal belongings might still be there.

690806e169e89d21b4052a4b.textCh: 科兹洛夫的房间里还有个空磁带盒，我很好奇他都用这盘带子录了什么，又交给了谁。
690806e169e89d21b4052a4b.textEn: There’s an empty audio tape case in Kozlov's room. I’ll need to find out where the tape is and what’s recorded on it.

690806ed488b6b3f62088dd1.textCh: 科兹洛夫的手里显然掌握着什么相当有价值的猛料，甚至是本地头面人物的重大黑料也说不定。从信里的内容看，他曾经尝试联系这个叫阿纳斯塔西娅·米哈伊洛娃的人，八成是某个记者或者调查活动家……我得查查这个女人的消息，说不定商人那里会有我想要的线索。
690806ed488b6b3f62088dd1.textEn: Kozlov clearly had some important information, maybe even dirt on someone. According to the letter, he tried to contact a journalist or investigator. Anastasia Mikhailova… I need to find out more about her. Maybe one of the traders can help.

690806fe15af5fbdd50a87c3.textCh:
Skier 说他知道情况，但是要我替他干活才愿意透露给我：我得去塔科夫街区，进到一栋公寓里面。但我不能就这样踹门闯进去，所以必须先找到钥匙才行。

他留了个线索：Zmeisky 巷子 3 号，公寓应该在一楼。
690806fe15af5fbdd50a87c3.textEn:
Skier says he’ll trade the info for a job. I need to get into an apartment on Streets of Tarkov. I can’t just kick the door in, so I’ll have to find the key.

He left me a lead: Zmeisky Alley, building 3. The apartment is supposed to be on the first floor.

6908070fe68722aa1705f7b5.textCh: 我想办法溜进了 Skier 熟人的公寓里。最好还是仔细研究一下这个地方，Skier 那个滑头拼了命也要闯空门进来肯定不是没有原因的。
6908070fe68722aa1705f7b5.textEn: I managed to get into Skier’s acquaintance’s apartment. It’d be useful to look around. There’s got to be a reason Skier wanted this place opened so badly.

690807179dcb2ffe250075a5.textCh: 我看到了一则剪报，上面刊登了一起犯罪报道，提到了某个外号 Chepyga 的混混。文章说这个人现在算是整个诺文斯克最有权势的犯罪头子。
690807179dcb2ffe250075a5.textEn: I came across a newspaper clipping with an incident report about someone named Chepyga. The article says he’s one of the most powerful criminals in Norvinsk now.

6908071f80aad5e5a603c97d.textCh: 我在政府档案夹里找到了一份 FSB 报告——内容是对阿尔谢尼·切佩金 (Arseny Chepygin) 的监视报告。显然他的帮派闹出的动静实在太大，连政府当局都注意到了这帮无法无天的家伙。
6908071f80aad5e5a603c97d.textEn: I found an FSB report in one of the government folders — surveillance records on Arseny Chepygin. Seems like his gang caused enough trouble to really catch the authorities' attention.

690807268c5759308f0d4a6c.textCh: 在切皮加 (Chepyga) 的公寓里，我找到了一页《第九圈》报纸的报道。显然这篇报道引起了这个混混的高度重视，我不禁好奇文章作者是否还在人世。
690807268c5759308f0d4a6c.textEn: In Chepyga's apartment, I found an issue of a one-page newspaper called The Ninth Circle. I wonder if the author is still alive.

69080737bb7797cc57069239.textCh:
我想办法溜进了 Skier 同伙的公寓里。看样子这个狗窝就是本地最大的犯罪头子——外号切皮加 (Chepyga) 的阿尔谢尼·切佩金 (Arseny Chepygin) 曾经的容身之所了。

这个地方看起来荒废已久，Chepyga 要么已经逃出了城市，要么就是又在其他地方换了个洞窝着。

我必须得从 Skier 那里弄到阿纳斯塔西娅的消息——他说好了会交代的。
69080737bb7797cc57069239.textEn:
I managed to get into Skier’s accomplice’s apartment. Feels like Chepyga used to hide out here — one of the major crime figures around.

The place has been abandoned for a long time. Looks like Chepyga either left the city or is holed up somewhere else.

I need to squeeze that info about Anastasia out of Skier — he said he’d share it.

6908074a488b6b3f62088dd4.textCh: 不出我所料，Skier 把我臭骂了一顿，没有吐露任何有用的消息。但至少他提到了一个名字。如果 Ragman 真的像自己吹嘘的那样是什么上流人物，他肯定会和这个出名的调查记者有联系。如果说有谁最有可能和媒体圈搭上线，那就非 Ragman 莫属了。
6908074a488b6b3f62088dd4.textEn: Skier screwed me over and didn’t give me anything useful. But at least he dropped a name. Ragman had some kind of connection with that journalist. If anyone knows more about her, it’s him.

6908075515af5fbdd50a87c6.textCh: Ragman 一出手就直接替我查来了记者的地址：Chekannaya 大街，13 号公寓。我要找的公寓应该就在二楼，或许能在那里找到科兹洛夫相关的线索，甚至是他掌握的证据。
6908075515af5fbdd50a87c6.textEn: Ragman handed me the journalist’s address: Chekannaya Street, building 13. The apartment is supposed to be on the second floor. Maybe I’ll find a lead on Kozlov and his evidence there.

69080760f3b8b0107d03a9d1.textCh:
这个记者显然戒备心相当重，给自己设置了严密的安保措施。对于如何打开这扇门，我根本是毫无头绪。搞不好入口处有什么有用的东西。

公寓不像是有人常住的样子，说不定我能在楼梯间某个角落找到旧信件或快递包裹。
69080760f3b8b0107d03a9d1.textEn:
The journalist clearly set up good security for herself. I’ve got no clue how to get this door open. Maybe there’s something useful in the entryway.

It doesn’t look like anyone’s been in the apartment often. That means I might find old mail or a delivery somewhere in the stairwell.

6908076a69e89d21b4052a4e.textCh: 我在阿纳斯塔西娅的邮箱里找到了科兹洛夫寄来的信。里面说他掌握了当地经济部门副部长雅罗斯拉夫·什库连科重大丑闻相关的材料。
6908076a69e89d21b4052a4e.textEn: I found a letter from Kozlov in Anastasia's mailbox. It looks like he had compromising material on Yaroslav Shkurenko, the regional deputy minister of economy.

6908077280aad5e5a603c981.textCh:
我在安娜斯塔西娅公寓的楼梯间偶然发现了一份报纸，报道称安娜斯塔西娅正筹备一项针对塔科夫乃至整个诺文斯克地区高层人物的重大调查行动。

也就是说，科兹洛夫和他掌握的材料的确为这场调查起到了推波助澜的作用。
6908077280aad5e5a603c981.textEn:
I stumbled across a newspaper in Anastasia’s stairwell. It reported Anastasia gearing up for a major investigation, one that targeted people in high positions across Tarkov and Norvinsk.

So Kozlov and his compromising material were clearly part of that investigation.

690807ccfc58af8e110e417b.textCh:
据阿纳斯塔西娅那里找到的信件所写的，科兹洛夫说负责传递消息的信使帕沙知道该去哪找他，同时还有那份材料的事情。这是我能找到的唯一线索了。

科兹洛夫还提到帕沙开始骑自行车往来，因为那帮人同样纠缠上了萨沙。现在我的下一步是检查海关宿舍楼区域，科兹洛夫先前的住处。
690807ccfc58af8e110e417b.textEn:
According to Anastasia’s letter, Kozlov claims that the courier Pasha knows where to find him along with the compromising material. That’s the only lead I’ve got.

Kozlov mentioned that Pasha started riding a bike because he was being pressured. My first step is to examine the area around the customs dorms where Kozlov lived.

690807e38c5759308f0d4a70.textCh:
我没能查到这个信使的消息，但也许我碰上了当地帮派混混们把帕沙截住的地方。

很显然他们把帕沙的自行车给毁了，还把他打了一顿。说不定周围会有其他线索？
690807e38c5759308f0d4a70.textEn:
I couldn’t track down the courier, but it looks like I came across the spot where local thugs had cornered him.

They wrecked his bike and beat him up. Maybe there are other clues nearby?

690807ecbb7797cc5706923d.textCh: 在坏掉的自行车旁边，我找到了一封撕开的信封，显然就是科兹洛夫发出的。这意味着受害人肯定就是帕沙，科兹洛夫安排的那个信使了。我必须得查出到底是谁下手袭击了他，还有这帮人到底把帕沙带到哪里去了。
690807ecbb7797cc5706923d.textEn: Next to the bike, I found a torn envelope, clearly from Kozlov. That means the victim was definitely the courier Pasha. I need to find out who attacked him and where they took him.

6908082480aad5e5a603c985.textCh:
据 Skier 说，Reshala 已经成为了盘踞在海关的那帮混混们的老大。对于帕沙身上发生的事，Reshala 应该了如指掌。

对付这种混帮派的，肯定不能指望对方将情报乖乖奉上。我必须得自己查个水落石出了。

Reshala 在海关本地肯定有某种藏匿物品的储藏处或者仓库。不用想也知道肯定是上了锁的。
6908082480aad5e5a603c985.textEn:
Skier says the current top dog among the customs bandits is Reshala. He’s the one who knows what happened to Pasha.

But he’s unlikely to share it willingly. Looks like I’ll have to dig it up myself.

Reshala must have some stash or warehouse in the customs area. And of course, it’ll be locked.

6908082fc75638a9300f58ed.textCh: 我找到了 Reshala 用来私藏赃物的窝棚，看样子那个信使的东西也都在这。
6908082fc75638a9300f58ed.textEn: I found a bunkhouse where Reshala keeps some of his stuff. Looks like some of the courier’s seized belongings are here too.

69080831e68722aa1705f7b9.textCh: 在 Reshala 的窝棚里，我找到了混混们从帕沙身上搜出来的带地址的一张字条。这群匪徒在对信使施暴拿到情报之后，就出发前去洗劫科兹洛夫手里的证据了。
69080831e68722aa1705f7b9.textEn: In Reshala’s bunkhouse, I found a note with an address the bandits got from the courier. Looks like after attacking him, Reshala’s people went there to grab Kozlov’s evidence.

69080847702822cf010aa6fa.textCh: 在查找帕沙被他们强占的个人物品的时候，我找到了科兹洛夫的那封信。看起来科兹洛夫想办法把所有东西都转移到了一盘录音带里，而他想让阿纳斯塔西娅也拿到这些材料。
69080847702822cf010aa6fa.textEn: While searching through Pasha's seized belongings, I found Kozlov's letter. It seems he managed to transfer all his evidence to an audio tape which he wanted to share with Anastasia.

69080850d71ec6d7b1047663.textCh: Reshala 的笔记只能用抽象来形容，但他肯定是在和某个商人勾兑什么见不得人的生意。说不定 Skier 就是那个背地里和 Reshala 有密切往来的人？至少他们之间的关系肯定比表现出来的更紧密。
69080850d71ec6d7b1047663.textEn: Reshala’s notes are hard to follow, but he’s definitely in contact with someone among the traders. Could it be that Skier is closer to Reshala than he’s admitting?

6908086d9dcb2ffe250075a9.textCh: 科兹洛夫和混混们打了一场，甚至把其中一个揍飞了。虽然最终肯定还是寡不敌众，但至少从 Reshala 窝棚里拿到的信息来看，混混们没能搜到任何东西。说不定证据还存放在附近，没有被匪帮们染指。
6908086d9dcb2ffe250075a9.textEn: Kozlov put up a fight, even managed to take someone down. But he didn’t stand a chance against the bandits. According to Reshala’s note from the bunkhouse, they didn’t find anything. Maybe the evidence is still hidden around here somewhere.

6908087d488b6b3f62088dd9.textCh:
我在楼外的花坛里发现了科兹洛夫藏匿的录音带，这卷录音带是他躲避匪徒时特意藏起来的。

录音揭露了什库连科早在塔科夫冲突爆发前就和那个犯罪头目切皮加勾结，企图通过走私武器，控制封锁区内的药品供应，让他的匪帮迅速掌控整座城市。

他们似乎从那时起就对塔科夫即将爆发一场冲突心知肚明。自封锁以来发生的一切或许都是精心策划的结果。但究竟是谁在幕后操纵这一切？
6908087d488b6b3f62088dd9.textEn:
I found the audio tape that Kozlov had hidden from the bandits in the flowerbed outside the building.

It reveals that Shkurenko had been working with Chepyga even before the conflict in Tarkov, intending to funnel weapons and medicine so his gang could quickly take control of the city.

It seems they knew all along that the conflict in Tarkov was coming. Everything since the blockade might have been orchestrated. But who was pulling the strings?

690cc0c2a00d47478707bcb8.textCh:
我在塔科夫遇到了些怪事。那个圆圈还有那些神神叨叨的符号让人汗毛倒竖，这些东西肯定有自己的含义。但到底是什么呢？又是谁不厌其烦地到处涂抹这种东西？

或许这单纯就是有人经历了一切之后彻底失去了理智——留下这些奇怪的符号，然后被 Scav 杀了，或者在没人知道的地方饿死病死了。但倘若这不是偶然现象，而是某种有组织的行动呢？假如城里有一整群疯子蠢蠢欲动，准备把所有地方都涂满这些符号呢？我必须得深挖下去。
690cc0c2a00d47478707bcb8.textEn:
I came across something strange in Tarkov. That circle and those symbols have to mean something. But what exactly? And who’s behind it all?

Maybe the author just lost their mind after everything that happened and ended up dead — killed by Scavs or starved. But what if he wasn’t alone? What if there’s a whole group of lunatics operating here in the city? I need to dig deeper.

690cc0dd2e5c0e5e0309702c.textCh:
我刚撞见个……怪人。行动如影随形，悄无声息，精准利落。而且他的衣着和本地人完全不一样。

肯定不是 USEC 或者 BEAR 的一员，更不可能是本地的那些 Scav 土匪。那么这人到底是什么来头呢？如果这家伙还有同伙，天黑后我可得打起精神。谁知道这帮疯子成群结队招摇过市的时候脑子里在盘算什么。

等我离开这里，得查清楚那些戴兜帽的怪人到底是什么来头。
690cc0dd2e5c0e5e0309702c.textEn:
I just ran into someone... strange. Moved like a shadow, quiet, precise. And his gear is nothing like the locals wear.

Definitely not USEC or BEAR, and not a Scav either. So who the hell was he? If he’s got others with him, I’d better stay sharp when the sun goes down. No telling what goes on in a psycho’s mind.

Once I’m out of here, I need to dig up more info about those hooded freaks.

690cc10ae976d0c3c402a943.textCh:
那个圆圈和那些符号绝对是有含义的，看起来他们曾在这里进行某种诡异的仪式……

我必须搜集线索，搞清楚这到底是怎么一回事。
690cc10ae976d0c3c402a943.textEn:
That circle and those symbols definitely mean something. Looks like they were performing some kind of weird ritual here...

I need to find anything that can help me understand what the hell’s going on.

690cc11c534225d94e0b2783.textCh: 我找到了这群戴兜帽的留下的一条消息。也就是说，塔科夫确实有这么一群邪教，还正在为所谓的“降临”做准备。我得查查里面提到的“降临”和“世界之眼”，看看能不能有什么发现，这两样东西似乎对于他们至关重要。
690cc11c534225d94e0b2783.textEn: I found a note left by those people in hoods. So there really is some kind of cult in Tarkov preparing for the "Arrival". I need to find out more about this Arrival and the Eye of the World mentioned in the note. It seems to be something important to them.

690cc12da00d47478707bcbd.textCh: 在废弃的村庄里，我发现了这群邪教徒藏身的一处窝点。里面陈设的一切都证明了这是个用来折磨无辜之人的行刑室——但他们到底是在对谁上手段？
690cc12da00d47478707bcbd.textEn: In the abandoned village, I came across one of the cultists’ hideouts. Everything inside points to a torture chamber. But who were they torturing?

690cc13ae976d0c3c402a946.textCh:
在行刑室里，我找到了一卷匆忙录下的录音带。听起来这个人被邪教徒跟踪了相当长一段时间，就在赶往火车站逃出城市的路上被那帮怪胎截住了——邪教徒特意追杀这个人肯定事出有因。

我必须得查出这个受害者到底是谁，而那群戴兜帽的怪胎又是为了什么对他如此关注。
690cc13ae976d0c3c402a946.textEn:
In the torture room, I found a tape someone had recorded in a hurry. Looks like the person was being followed and got intercepted on the way to the train station. The cultists wouldn’t hunt random people.

I have to learn more about who this victim was and why they were targeted.

690cc149534225d94e0b2786.textCh: 在邪教徒的行刑室里，我找到了一把公寓钥匙，看起来和市区那些老旧公寓楼的钥匙别无二致——我应该去 Khrushchevka 街区看看，那一片的旧房子最多。总之首先排除那些高级公寓。
690cc149534225d94e0b2786.textEn: In the cultists' torture room, I found a key to an apartment, looks like it could be somewhere downtown. I should check the regular Khrushchevka apartment blocks, no way this key fits any luxury housing.

690cc1554d2051cf780501a7.textCh: 现在我知道那些邪教徒在废村折磨的是什么人了——伊戈尔，NGO Cobalt 的员工。这群兜帽怪人显然试图招募他，甚至往他的公寓里塞进了一整本鬼话连篇的书，书里也提到了所谓的“世界之眼”。看来，他们是想利用伊戈尔的职务便利，好进入某些限制区域，或者是窃取什么机密数据。
690cc1554d2051cf780501a7.textEn: Now I know who the cultists tortured in the abandoned village. Igor, an employee of NGO Cobalt. They tried to recruit him and planted a book that also mentioned the Eye of the World. Looks like they wanted to use his position to get access to a restricted facility or classified data.

690cc2eaef99bd35550b502d.textCh: 在受害者的公寓里，我发现了一张纸条，上面详细列出了为所谓的“降临”所做的各种准备的细节。上面提到了“蓝焰”、“世界之眼”，还有一些被称作“守望者”的人物，后者似乎拥有相当崇高的地位。
690cc2eaef99bd35550b502d.textEn: In the victim’s apartment, I came across a note outlining the stages of preparation for something they call the Arrival. It speaks of the Blue Fire, the Eye of the World, and some figures known as the Wardens.

690cc2f4ef99bd35550b5030.textCh: 他们塞给伊戈尔的可不是随便什么普通的书，这似乎是整个邪教奉若真理的经文。整本《降临之书》里诡异的图画、仪式与预言。其中某些预言与塔科夫已经发生事件的吻合程度简直达到了诡异的地步，让人毛骨悚然。
690cc2f4ef99bd35550b5030.textEn: It wasn’t just any book they planted on Igor. The cult seems to treat it as their main scripture. This Book of the Arrival is packed with strange drawings, rituals, and prophecies. And some of those prophecies look disturbingly similar to the events that have already taken place in Tarkov.

690cc3c7e976d0c3c402d4f1.textCh: 光靠我一个人闭门造车是琢磨不出什么来的。我该去问问商人们，看看他们对这个“世界之眼”有什么了解。既然邪教徒不遗余力地想招募 Cobalt 的人，说不定他们想窃取某种科技装置或数据库。如果是这样，我绝对该联系 Mechanic。
690cc3c7e976d0c3c402d4f1.textEn: There’s no way I’ll make progress alone. I should check with the traders and see what they know about the Eye of the World. Given its link to Cobalt, it might be some piece of tech or a database. If that’s the case, I should definitely contact Mechanic.

690cc3d6ef99bd35550b6ea6.textCh: 和 Mechanic 的交流没能得出什么结果。他所能确认的只有我应该去找那些邪教徒亲自一探究竟。
690cc3d6ef99bd35550b6ea6.textEn: Talking to Mechanic didn’t get me anywhere. All he did was confirm that I should be looking for information among the cultists.

690cc439fe414f390f096c41.textCh: 如果我想要追查“世界之眼”的事情，我必须单刀直入去找邪教徒的麻烦。他们当中总该有些身份更高，或者有特殊权限的人存在。最好尽快找到这些人开刀。
690cc439fe414f390f096c41.textEn: If I want answers about the Eye of the World, I’ll have to go straight to the cultists. There must be some among them with higher rank or special access. Better to start with them right away.

690cc447fe414f390f096c44.textCh: 我想办法干掉了一个所谓的“祭司”，但是他的身上并没有什么有价值的东西。看样子我必须调查他们集会的地方才行。
690cc447fe414f390f096c44.textEn: I managed to find and neutralize one of the so-called “Priests”, but he wasn’t carrying anything useful. It seems I should investigate the places where they gather.

690cc45cef99bd35550b6eac.textCh: 要是没有新的线索，我便无法继续推进调查了。哪怕是最小的线索也好，总得找到什么。
690cc45cef99bd35550b6eac.textEn: Without any new information, I won’t be able to move forward. I need to find at least some kind of clue.

690cc4a5509a0d9aa60c84cb.textCh: 我找到了一张字条，上面写着所有与“世界之眼”有联系的地方必须用特殊的符号标出来。我只需要找到他们都在哪里标点就可以了。
690cc4a5509a0d9aa60c84cb.textEn: I found a note from the cultists saying that all places connected to the Eye of the World should be marked with a special symbol. I just have to figure out where those points are.

690cc6c6509a0d9aa60c84ef.textCh: 至于和“世界之眼”有关的都是什么地方，我还没有明确的思路。但邪教徒似乎偏爱隐蔽之处。或许能在海岸线的森林地带，或是自然保护区里那些废弃村落里找到些线索。
690cc6c6509a0d9aa60c84ef.textEn: I don’t have exact directions to the locations linked to the Eye of the World. But it seems the cultists choose inconspicuous spots. Maybe I’ll find something in the forested areas along the coast or in the abandoned villages of the nature reserve.

690cc6d9239a15bdf70e851b.textCh: 我在 Sordi 通讯塔上也发现了那个“世界之眼”的标记，这帮邪教徒肯定已经祸害过这里了。
690cc6d9239a15bdf70e851b.textEn: I found one of the Eye of the World symbols on Sordi communications tower. They were definitely here.

690cc6e6e976d0c3c402d54f.textCh:
在下去的途中，我发现了一具尸体，旁边留着一张字条。这肯定是伊戈尔了——那个邪教徒们费尽心思也追捕的目标。他最后的文字证明了，他最终还是投入了邪教的怀抱。一定是那些人对他动用的酷刑把他的意志彻底打垮了，他是简直变了一个人。

他原本想在这里让“世界之眼”降临，但出了什么事故。如果我想查出那些邪教徒到底在追寻什么，就必须检查那座通讯塔，让它重新运转起来。
690cc6e6e976d0c3c402d54f.textEn:
On the way down, I came across a corpse and a note nearby. This has to be Igor, the one the cultists were after. His final entry confirms that the cultists eventually managed to recruit him. The torture must have broken him, made him change.

He was trying to get to the Eye of the World here, but something went wrong. If I want to reach the place those cultists were after, I’ll need to check the tower and get it working again.

690cc7367d5c80543b03b67f.textCh: 我把通讯塔修好了，在那些怪物看来，这座塔楼似乎与“世界之眼”存在某种联系，但我收集的信息过于支离破碎，还无法窥见事情的全貌。
690cc7367d5c80543b03b67f.textEn: I repaired the communications tower. Somehow it ties into the Eye of the World, but I don’t have enough pieces yet to see the whole picture.

690cc7420ce487a8d10aad7f.textCh: 我在村子里找到了一座废弃的屋子，邪教徒用所谓的“世界之眼”做了标记。我得彻底搜索整个屋子才行。
690cc7420ce487a8d10aad7f.textEn: I found an abandoned house in the village, the cultists marked it with the Eye of the World. I need to search it thoroughly.

690cc758837bac16dc0888ed.textCh:
在邪教徒的房子里，我找到了一份新闻剪报，上面刊登的是 NGO Cobalt 代表接受采访的内容。很显然这个组织也和所谓的“世界之眼”存在联系，冲突爆发前，他们在塔科夫大兴土木，正在建立全新的设施，或许是一整套系统也说不定。

采访中指出，Cobalt 设施的能耗达到了恐怖的地步，为此往往设在发电厂旁边。
690cc758837bac16dc0888ed.textEn:
In the cultists’ house, I found a newspaper clipping with an interview from a representative of NGO Cobalt. It’s clear that this organization is somehow connected to the Eye of the World, and in Tarkov they were building a facility, or even a whole network.

The interview suggests that Cobalt’s facilities require a lot of power, which is why they are located near power plants.

690cc7864d2051cf78055aee.textCh: 在其中一间木屋里，我发现一间房间布满了邪教符号。所有东西都被砸得粉碎，仿佛他们正拼命从中寻找什么至关重要的东西一样。我需要仔细搜查。
690cc7864d2051cf78055aee.textEn: In one of the chalets, I found a room covered in cultist symbols. Everything’s torn apart, like they were desperate to find something critical. I need to look around carefully.

690cc9d20ce487a8d10b7419.textCh:
我发现了一张纸条，显然是又一位被卷入邪教的受害者所留下的。这个人也和 Cobalt 组织，以及邪教团伙觊觎的技术存在联系。

上面提到了某种钥匙，作者显然小心翼翼地把这张条子藏了起来不让邪教徒发现，只有熟人才能找到这把钥匙。
690cc9d20ce487a8d10b7419.textEn:
I found a note, apparently written by another victim of the cultists. This person was connected to Cobalt and the technology the cultists were after.

The note mentions some kind of key, hidden from the cultists so carefully that only someone from the victim's inner circle could locate it.

690cc9dc1f2b05f5840c6886.textCh: 从相框里的照片来看，似乎写这张便条的人时不时就会去玩沙滩车。
690cc9dc1f2b05f5840c6886.textEn: Judging by the framed photo, it seems the person who wrote this note used to go on ATV rides from time to time.

690cc9e4837bac16dc08f53e.textCh: 在笔记作者的房间里，我发现一整面墙的奖杯架上陈列着历届比赛的奖杯。他一定是个非常热衷体育运动的人。
690cc9e4837bac16dc08f53e.textEn: In the note author’s room, I found a shelf filled with trophies from past competitions. He must have been really dedicated to sports.

690cc9ef0ce487a8d10b741e.textCh:
我找到了 Arshavin 的一张钥匙卡，他是 14-4 KORD 站点的值班主管。所以这就是邪教徒们真正想要拿到手的东西。

不过这么久过去，钥匙卡八成已经消磁了。得设法让它重新生效才行。
690cc9ef0ce487a8d10b741e.textEn:
I managed to find a keycard in the name of Arshavin, the senior shift at station 14-4 KORD. So that's what the cultists wanted to access.

But after all this time, the keycard's probably demagnetized. I’ll need to get it working again.

690cca287d5c80543b04fe35.textCh: 在撤离行动期间，灯塔地区的度假村区域同样是 TerraGroup 高层人士的中转站之一。如果 Cobalt 和集团有交集的话，那里应该会留下和“世界之眼”相关的消息。搞不好邪教徒们已经用那个瘆人的符号圈好地盘了。
690cca287d5c80543b04fe35.textEn: During the evacuation, the chalet at the lighthouse was actively used as one of the interim evacuation points for TerraGroup’s top-level staff. If Cobalt is connected with them, there could be information about the Eye of the World left there. Or perhaps even a cult mark.

690cca4bbb605bd4d100f6ba.textCh: 我找到了三处用“世界之眼”标出的地点。我需要整理这些发现，和 Mechanic 一起理清楚自然会更好。
690cca4bbb605bd4d100f6ba.textEn: I found three points marked with the Eye of the World symbol. I need to sort through what I’ve found, and it would be better to do it together with Mechanic.

690cca57239a15bdf70fa1e0.textCh:
和 Mechanic 商量了之后，我终于拼凑出了事情的全貌：NGO Cobalt 在塔科夫发电站附近建造了一处设施，也就是 14-4 KORD ARRS 站点。邪教徒一定是想要去那里，至少也得是相关的地方。

现在我终于有机会亲自行动了，只需找到那个站点，使用 Arshavin 的钥匙卡进去一探究竟就可以了。Mechanic 还嘱咐我，至少要把站点数据的一部分备份到 U 盘里。

不过首先，我得先让钥匙卡能用才行。
690cca57239a15bdf70fa1e0.textEn:
Together with Mechanic, I managed to piece together the full picture. The NGO Cobalt built a facility near one of Tarkov’s power plants, presumably the ARRS Station 14-4 KORD. The cultists wanted to get there or somehow connect to it.

Now I have the opportunity myself, I just need to find the station and use Arshavin’s keycard. Mechanic also asked me to download at least part of the station’s data onto a flash drive.

But first, I need to restore the keycard to working condition.

690cca6453ed7944751011a1.textCh: 不管这是干什么用的，现在钥匙卡应该重新激活了。
690cca6453ed7944751011a1.textEn: Now this keycard should work, whatever it opens.

690cca7ee5d3475b780324c4.textCh: 我成功进去了 ARRS 站点，但是这里没有电力。我得先找到 Arshavin 的钥匙卡对应的面板才行。
690cca7ee5d3475b780324c4.textEn: I made it into the ARRS station, but there’s no power. I need to find the panel that Arshavin’s keycard will work on.

690cca86239a15bdf70fa1e3.textCh:
结果 ARRS 站点居然是一个能够监控一切动向的监听站。“世界之眼”……这个名字还真是贴切啊。

眼下当务之急是尽可能下载更多数据，然后撤离这个地方。服务器机房应该配有冷却系统，我必须得先把它启动确保下载顺利进行。之后把 U 盘藏起来下载数据，就能帮 Mechanic 弄到情报了。
690cca86239a15bdf70fa1e3.textEn:
The ARRS station turned out to be a kind of monitoring hub for everything. Fitting for the Eye of the World, huh?

Right now, though, the priority is to grab the data and get out. There’s probably a cooling system in the server room. I should power that up so the download goes smoothly. Then I can stash the flash drive and pull the data for Mechanic.

690cca8e239a15bdf70fa1e6.textCh: 看样子数据下载还要花上一会，在这里闲等着没有意义，最好还是之后再回来吧。
690cca8e239a15bdf70fa1e6.textEn: Looks like the data’s going to take a while to download. No point hanging around, better to come back later.

690ccab994c95d70e60c9bcf.textCh: 数据这会儿应该已经下载好了，该去 ARRS 站点取回 U 盘了。
690ccab994c95d70e60c9bcf.textEn: The data should have finished downloading to the flash drive by now. Time to grab it from the ARRS station.

690ccabc7db40b7aef034116.textCh: 我拿到了 U 盘，该回去找 Mechanic 了。
690ccabc7db40b7aef034116.textEn: I've collected the flash drive. Time to head back to Mechanic.

690ccad31f2b05f5840c688c.textCh: 如果我能找到 NGO Cobalt 的秘密设施，我必须得从里到外好好查一查。肯定会有什么没来得及带走的重要数据或者文件。
690ccad31f2b05f5840c688c.textEn: If I find NGO Cobalt’s secret facility, I’ll need to search it carefully. There could still be important data or documentation left behind.

690ccaed1050f9826e0e36b3.textCh:
离开服务器机房后，我发现一个保险柜的门敞开着。进站时它明明是锁着的……里面装着一盘录音带，某个邪教徒声称这一切都是命中注定，而我不过是他们的傀儡。

原来我所做的一切都正中邪教徒下怀。必须阻止他们，而且要快。
690ccaed1050f9826e0e36b3.textEn:
After leaving the server room, I found an open safe. It had definitely been locked when I entered the station… Inside was an audio tape, with some cultist claiming that all of this was predestined, and that I had been their puppet.

Turns out everything I did played right into the cultists' scheme. I have to stop this, and quickly.

690ccaf874d30ccc180d77fe.textCh: 我找到了 ARRS 站点工程师留下的笔记。显然站点里设置了一个专门的按钮，以便在意外发生的时候把一切都回滚至备份配置。要是能找到开关，这招说不定就管用。
690ccaf874d30ccc180d77fe.textEn: I found a note from the ARRS station engineer. Apparently, somewhere on the station is a hidden button that can reset everything to its backup state. That might just do the trick, if I track down the switch.

690ccb0453ed7944751011a6.textCh:
我成功把 ARRS 站点的设置回滚到了备用配置。也许这样一来就能让它免受邪教徒，或者别的什么更加邪恶存在的觊觎。

数据这会儿应该已经下载好了，该去 ARRS 站点取回 U 盘了。
690ccb0453ed7944751011a6.textEn:
I managed to reset the ARRS station to its backup settings. Maybe now it’ll be safe from scum like those cultists, or whoever’s worse.

The data should definitely be fully downloaded onto the flash drive by now. Time to grab it from the ARRS station.

690ccb1753ed7944751011a9.textCh:
我循着邪教徒的踪迹追踪至 14-4 KORD ARRS 站点。看样子这里就是邪教徒所追寻的“世界之眼”了。这个站点似乎是一整套全域监视系统的核心枢纽，能够随时接入市区及周边区域的任何监控画面，更能随心所欲地加以劫持或篡改。

在我连上 U 盘下载数据时，隔壁房间突然出现了一盘来自邪教徒的录音带。录音里指斥我是“盲目者”，声称我的行为只会加速“降临”的到来。我想办法切断了 ARRS 站点的所有外部联络，防止这项危险的技术落入这帮邪教疯子的手里。

我还为 Mechanic 复制了一份数据，也许之后他能告诉我里面到底都是些什么。
690ccb1753ed7944751011a9.textEn:
I followed the cultists' tracks and reached ARRS Station 14-4 KORD. This appears to be the Eye of the World the cultists were after. The station seems to be the core of a complex surveillance system, capable of tapping into or hijacking any camera feed in the city and the surrounding area.

While I was connecting the flash drive, a cultist audio tape appeared in the adjacent room. The recording called me blind and claimed my actions are only speeding up the Arrival. I managed to isolate the ARRS station from all external contacts to prevent this dangerous technology from falling into their hands.

I also copied the data for Mechanic. Maybe later he’ll actually show me what’s on it.

690fd630b195a95b3f0f23d9.textCh: 我找到了集团的黑料，把一切都传给了 Kerman。为了挖出这些秘密，我可是花了天大的功夫，几乎走遍了整个塔科夫……也许该找他谈谈，看看我搜集来的那些料是不是已经足够了。
690fd630b195a95b3f0f23d9.textEn: I found the dirt and passed it to Kerman. Took me ages to dig it up… Maybe it’s time to talk, see if what I’ve already brought is enough for him.

690fd63b042aff6f5d0953d3.textCh: 我和 Kerman 谈过了。他说材料根本不够，还需要更多猛料才能彻底扳倒集团。看他挑剔的程度，这家伙对 TerraGroup 的事情还真是上心，但我也清楚，只有像他这样明白内情的人才能帮我达成目标。我得继续努力搜集证据帮他才行。
690fd63b042aff6f5d0953d3.textEn: I spoke with Mr. Kerman. He said it’s not enough, he needs more. He seems obsessed with TerraGroup, but I know people like him are the ones who get things done. I’ll keep gathering evidence to help him.

690fd647e30a8a7d0405e409.textCh:
我和 Kerman 谈过了。这家伙居然说什么材料根本不够，还需要更多猛料才能彻底扳倒集团。但他根本没有想过，我要的是逃离塔科夫这个鬼地方，而不是继续原地转圈，替哪个故弄玄虚的家伙找遍整个城市追查一些文件。我直接把他踹开了，接下来要怎么逃离塔科夫，要由我自己说了算。

现在我只能靠自己了，没了那个 Kerman 指指点点，也就没了钥匙卡——也许该去问问商人，也许他们能出手帮我离开这里。
690fd647e30a8a7d0405e409.textEn:
I spoke with Mr. Kerman. He said it’s not enough, he needs more. But he didn’t consider that I want to get out of Tarkov, not run around chasing some papers. I refused further cooperation. I’ll look for a way out on my own.

Now it’s just me. No Kerman, and no working keycard for the port. I should check with the traders, maybe one of them can help.

690fd660c27a8297b40e6fd7.textCh: 没人知道，或者说没人愿意吐露消息，看样子我必须得靠自己找到一条出路了。
690fd660c27a8297b40e6fd7.textEn: None of them know anything. Looks like I’ll have to carve my own way out of here.

690fd6ad64bc90f0cc02a102.textCh:
我和所有商人都谈了一圈，甚至还接触了那个神秘的 Lightkeeper，Lightkeeper 说他能出手，但他的帮助不会是免费的。我已经别无选择了，只能答应他的条件。现在我必须完成他的任务为自己赢得逃离的门票——Lightkeeper 没有明说到底有多少差事在等着，我有预感这一切不会简单收场。但如果我还想离开这里，就必须按照他的规则办事。

他要的第一样东西是本地的地形测绘材料，我得跑遍整个塔科夫，从工厂到那场奇怪爆炸的源头——中心区才能让他满意。
690fd6ad64bc90f0cc02a102.textEn:
I spoke with all the traders. Even reached Lightkeeper, and he said he could help. But not for free. I don't have another choice, so I took the deal. Now I need to complete his tasks. He didn’t say how many exactly. I have a feeling it won’t be easy, but if I want to get out of Tarkov, I'll have to play along.

First thing he wants are topographic survey materials. I’ll have to search for the data all over Tarkov: from the factory to the ground zero of that strange explosion.

690fd6c5d1930d6fd5081b3d.textCh: 我把所有的数据都导入 U 盘里了，现在我得把东西交到 Lightkeeper 手上。
690fd6c5d1930d6fd5081b3d.textEn: I've transferred all the data to a flash drive. Now I need to hand it to Lightkeeper.

690fd6edc27a8297b40e6fda.textCh:
我把 U 盘交给了 Lightkeeper，他看上去对我的成果相当满意。接下来是第二个任务，希望这家伙后续别再拿别的什么东西折腾我了。

Lightkeeper 要求我前往森林，保护某个特定的地方免受他人侵扰，说是有太多闲人四处打探。我有种预感，那些所谓的猎杀对象都是身负同样任务的竞争对手，所以我必须把这件事给办好才行。
690fd6edc27a8297b40e6fda.textEn:
I handed the flash drive to Lightkeeper, he seemed satisfied. Now he’s got me on a second job. Hopefully the last.

Lightkeeper sent me to the forest to protect a territory. Says too many people are snooping around there. Something tells me those are my competitors, so I’m personally interested in taking care of it.

690fd71a031898896a00f2f1.textCh: 我已经完成了任务，是时候回去找 Lightkeeper，把狗牌亲自交给他了。
690fd71a031898896a00f2f1.textEn: I've completed the task. Time to head to Lightkeeper and hand him the dogtags.

690fd72db58eaccd16089ea8.textCh:
差事完成了，但 Lightkeeper 不由分说又指派了另一个任务给我。看样子这是没个头了……

这一次 Lightkeeper 要我去各地的邪教仪式地点，找回他们的护身符，然后搜集来放到指定的地方。虽然没搞懂为什么他的手下不自己去收拾烂摊子，但显然在他面前一切反驳都是无力的，更何况此时我迫切需要他的帮助，一旦触怒这个手眼通天的家伙，后果不堪设想。

他说那些护身符通常都留在那些有邪教符号标记的房间里。一旦我找到了全部的护身符，必须把它们带回灯塔，放在他指定的地方。
690fd72db58eaccd16089ea8.textEn:
Job’s done, but Lightkeeper gave me another one. Feels like this won’t end anytime soon…

This time Lightkeeper wants me to find cultist amulets and leave them at a designated location. I don’t understand why his people can’t handle it themselves, but there’s no point arguing. I need his help too much to risk it.

He said the amulets are usually hidden in the rooms with those cult symbols. Once I’ve got them, I’m to stash them in the building next to the lighthouse.

690fd7417f0bc488ff0a05bc.textCh:
原来这就是最后一项差事了。Lightkeeper 终于心满意足，施舍给我了一张卡片。看上去和克鲁格洛夫的那张钥匙卡别无二致，只是把原主人的名字给刮掉了。是 Lightkeeper 派人找来的吗？还是说他的人伏击了卡片的前主人才夺来了这张卡片？又或者……这张钥匙卡本就是以他的名义注册的？

算了，现在想这些都没有意义了。是时候动身出发了：我终于能踏上离开塔科夫的归途了。只是希望 Lightkeeper 不要突然异想天开，用他那项神秘任务把我永远困在这里。
690fd7417f0bc488ff0a05bc.textEn:
Turns out that was the last job. Lightkeeper was satisfied and gave me a card. It looks like Kruglov’s access pass, but the name is scratched off. Did Lightkeeper find it? Or kill the previous owner? Or… is this card actually registered to his name?

Well, doesn’t matter now. It’s time to leave. I can finally get out of Tarkov. Hopefully, Lightkeeper won’t immediately burden me with that mysterious assignment I agreed to.

690fd7da0c957e23a302098e.textCh: 这个什么“Kerman 先生”想对我指手画脚，以为我是什么被吓大的小孩。劈头盖脸地说我意志软弱，害怕挑战之类的……这家伙根本不明白自己在说什么。我也没忍住，直接原样回敬了他。和他掰扯真是浪费时间！
690fd7da0c957e23a302098e.textEn: This Mr. Kerman decided to lecture me as if I were some scared little kid. He called me weak-willed and afraid of challenges… the guy’s lost it. I didn’t hold back and told him exactly what I think. What a waste of time.

690fd83b042aff6f5d0953d7.textCh:
我拿到了港口的通行钥匙卡。

在光天化日之下进港口，尤其是身上带着一张不属于我的钥匙卡招摇过市未免太过冒险了。最好还是在夜里溜进去，趁晚上 9 点到凌晨 6 点天没亮这会儿行动。
690fd83b042aff6f5d0953d7.textEn:
The Terminal access keycard is on me.

Going into the port during the day is too risky, especially with a card that isn’t registered to me. It’s safer to slip through at night, between 21:00 and 06:00.

690fd8457f0bc488ff0a05c2.textCh:
Lightkeeper 给的钥匙卡果然有用——他们把我放了进去！

港口终点站遭到了突发袭击，在一片混乱中，没人顾得上安排我继续完成撤离。是时候重新拿起武器，靠自己一路杀到撤离点了。
690fd8457f0bc488ff0a05c2.textEn:
Lightkeeper's keycard worked — I was let into the port!

The terminal got hit, though, and nobody gives a damn about my evacuation now. Time to fight my way to the evac point.

690fd850351b6e11bf035daa.textCh: 我终于逃出了塔科夫！当然，为了得到这个机会，我在 Lightkeeper 那里欠下了一大笔人情，但谁又会在乎呢？我还活着，浑身上下都还完好，自由自在。这就够了。
690fd850351b6e11bf035daa.textEn: I finally escaped Tarkov! Sure, I now owe Lightkeeper some big favor, but who cares. I’m alive, in one piece, and free. That’s more than enough.

6911dcc08b6f9666a8006fd4.textCh:
当我协助 Bogatyr 小队追查叛徒时，发现整场伏击的幕后黑手又是那个叫“无名者”的组织。至于 Lightkeeper，在经历了这一切之后是不太可能再向我吐露任何情报了。

然而，显然这帮人已经深深渗透进了政府机构，甚至可能不止于此。我得进一步调查他们的身份，还有他们的计划。TerraGroup 一直与政府当局密切合作——难道他们也和“无名者”有关系？
6911dcc08b6f9666a8006fd4.textEn:
When I was helping Bogatyrs track down the traitors, a certain group called "The Unheard" were behind the entire operation. Lightkeeper himself is unlikely to share any information after what happened.

However, they are clearly deeply embedded in government structures, and possibly beyond that. I need to dig more into who they are and what they’re planning. TerraGroup has worked closely with authorities. Could they be connected to The Unheard as well?

6911dcce277e44fe9f0507c9.textCh:
在《降临之书》中，邪教徒们提到了某种未知的力量将掌控全人类的命运。当然，其他那些邪教也都有类似的偶像崇拜和充满胡言乱语的经书。

但与其他疯子的预言不同，邪教徒们的一些预言却诡异地与塔科夫实际发生的事件相吻合。就好像他们事先就知道一切似的。但这是不可能的——除非他们早就在政府内部安插了内应。

他们会不会也和 TerraGroup 有关？我得去调查一下他们的办公室和设施。
6911dcce277e44fe9f0507c9.textEn:
In the Book of the Arrival, the cultists talk about some unknown forces who will control the fate of all humanity. Sure, every other cult has its idols and books full of garbage like this.

But unlike the prophecies of other crazies, some of the cultists’ predictions suspiciously resemble events that actually happened in Tarkov. It’s as if they knew everything in advance. But that’s impossible unless they had insiders in the administration or elsewhere.

Could they be tied to TerraGroup too? I’ll have to check out their offices and facilities.

6911dcd8466e028dca0d0d94.textCh:
Kerman 说，TerraGroup 背后的实际操纵者另有其人。他管这些人叫“无名者”，除此之外什么都没透露——只说我得自己去查清真相。

如果这些疯子真的和 TerraGroup 有联系，也许在集团的办公室里或者其他地方能找到相关的线索，哪怕是蛛丝马迹。
6911dcd8466e028dca0d0d94.textEn:
Kerman said someone’s pulling the strings above TerraGroup. He called them The Unheard, and that was it — no details, just that I have to figure it out myself.

If they really are tied to TerraGroup, maybe some clue or mention of them still lingers in the offices or other facilities.

6911dd02277e44fe9f0507cc.textCh:
我在一张 TerraGroup 办公纸上发现了一则奇怪的留言，上面提到了无名者的意志，以及某种用于“净化”的燃料。TerraGroup 显然与这群疯子有联系，我得收集更多关于“无名者”的信息。

首先，我得弄清楚这种“净化”燃料的真相。看起来幕后主使是 TerraGroup 的实验室。
6911dd02277e44fe9f0507cc.textEn:
I came across a strange note on a TerraGroup sheet. It mentions the will of The Unheard and some fuel needed for "purification". TerraGroup’s definitely involved in this, and I should gather more information about The Unheard.

For starters, I need to figure out this fuel. Looks like TerraGroup Labs are behind it.

6911dd36466e028dca0d0d97.textCh: 我找到了一份文件，里面提到 Polikhim 化工厂正在与 DP 石油合作开发某种催化剂。这也许就是那张便条中提到的”燃料“。文件中还指出，项目负责人是 K.N.勒热夫斯基。
6911dd36466e028dca0d0d97.textEn: I found a document mentioning the development of a catalyst at Polikhim in cooperation with DP Fuel. This might be the same fuel referenced in the note. The document also names K.N. Rzhevsky as the person in charge of the project.

6911dd408b6f9666a8006fd7.textCh: 根据传真中的信息，工厂里还留有一批特殊货物，而康斯坦丁正是转运行动的负责人。
6911dd408b6f9666a8006fd7.textEn: According to the information in the fax, a special batch of some cargo remains at the factory, and Konstantin is the one who’s supposed to move it.

6911dd50a48acf3fc00bd728.textCh: Polikhim 化工厂里可能还留有一批特殊的催化剂货物，就是 TerraGroup 地区分部主管 K.N.勒热夫斯基负责运输的那一批。我得去检查一下工厂的车间，看看那里还剩下什么。
6911dd50a48acf3fc00bd728.textEn: There may be a special shipment of the catalyst remaining at Polikhim, which K.N. Rzhevsky was responsible for transporting. I should check the factory workshops and see what’s left.

6911de9795febc38b20f4b99.textCh:
在工厂里，我找到了一本写有笔记的手册。对于 TerraGroup 或者“无名者”来说，滞留在工厂里的这批“蓝冰”货物显然至关重要。他们计划优先将这批货物转移出去，可能还贿赂了港口的某些人，甚至做好了必要时强行突围的准备。

手册上还记载着勒热夫斯基的车牌号，那辆车里说不定留下了什么重要的东西。
6911de9795febc38b20f4b99.textEn:
At the factory, I managed to find a manual with handwritten notes. The Blue Ice shipment left at the factory was clearly a big deal for TerraGroup or The Unheard. They planned to move it in first priority, probably bribed someone at the port, and even intended to fight their way out if needed.

The manual also has Rzhevsky’s service vehicle number. There could be something important left in it.

6911dea3a460b81cc809bbe0.textCh: 我成功从勒热夫斯基的车里回收了一块硬盘。虽然已经坏了，但里面可能仍有重要数据。得把它带回情报中心把里面的内容都下载下来，看看能有什么发现。
6911dea3a460b81cc809bbe0.textEn: I managed to get a hard drive from Rzhevsky’s service vehicle. It’s damaged, but there could still be something important on it. Gotta take it back to my Intel Center, download the data, and see what’s there.

6911deafe1112b904206eddd.textCh:
我从硬盘里提取了勒热夫斯基和 Polikhim 化工厂主管的对话片段。看来所谓的“无名者”或者 TerraGroup 正在研制一种双用催化剂——其本质上是一种燃料，但在必要时能转化为武器使用……还真是方便啊。

催化剂的测试报告文件被保存在工厂的一间安全屋里，没有高级权限无法进入。

如果这件事的幕后主使是“无名者”，那我就必须彻底挖出他们的所有计划。
6911deafe1112b904206eddd.textEn:
I extracted a fragment of conversation of Rzhevsky and Polikhim director from the hard drive. Looks like The Unheard or TerraGroup were cooking up a dual-use catalyst, basically a fuel that can be turned into a weapon when needed… Very handy.

The test report documents for the catalyst are stored in a secured room at the plant that cannot be accessed without a high access level.

If The Unheard are behind this, I have to dig up everything I can on them and what they’re planning.

6911debd466e028dca0d0d9b.textCh: 我找到了通信中提到的那份报告。报告显示，“蓝冰”催化剂具有双重用途，可以与大规模杀伤性武器联合使用。集团在全球各地都设有蓝冰的经销商与代表，也就是说这种物质已经遍布全球，让人倍感震惊……
6911debd466e028dca0d0d9b.textEn: I found the report referenced in the correspondence. The report indicates that the Blue Ice catalyst has a dual use and can be used in conjunction with weapons of mass destruction. Blue Ice is already distributed around the world, which makes this especially alarming…

6911decea48acf3fc00bd72b.textCh: 我在工厂上锁的房间里找到了一份文件，已经烧毁了一半。上面提到了某个协议，并说 TerraGroup 派了一位重要的上层人物到当地办公室来负责准备。文件上留下的名字只有 A.P. 这个缩写。
6911decea48acf3fc00bd72b.textEn: I found a half-destroyed document in the factory's locked room. It talks about some protocol and says TerraGroup sent a big shot from above to the local office to get it ready. All that’s left of a name are the initials: A.P.

6911dede461b770ecd071606.textCh: “蓝冰”并不只是一种燃料而已，而是被纳入某种 TerraGroup 协议中的武器级物质。为执行这项协议，TerraGroup 在员工名单中新增了一位缩写为 A.P. 的专家，并授予其最高权限。从文件措辞来看，这个人来自 TerraGroup 总部，甚至可能是更高层级的机构……难道这个人是”无名者“的一员？
6911dede461b770ecd071606.textEn: Blue Ice wasn’t just fuel. It was the weapon for some TerraGroup protocol. To carry it out, TerraGroup added a specialist with the initials A.P. to their staff list and granted them the highest access level. From the wording, this person came from TerraGroup’s headquarters or possibly even higher… Could they be one of The Unheard?

6911dee526fc56a9a304503c.textCh: 我找到了一盘在TerraGroup演讲厅录制的会议音频，但只录到一半。如果找不到第二部分，就无法完全弄清事情的真相。
6911dee526fc56a9a304503c.textEn: I found an audio tape recording of a meeting in the TerraGroup lecture hall. But it’s cut off halfway. Without the second part, it will be impossible to fully understand what’s going on.

6911deeea48acf3fc00bd72e.textCh: 我找到了一盘在TerraGroup演讲厅录制的会议音频，但从中途才开始录。如果没有前半部分，几乎无法弄清任何内容。
6911deeea48acf3fc00bd72e.textEn: I found an audio tape recording of a meeting in the TerraGroup lecture hall. But it starts halfway through, and without the first part, it will be difficult to understand anything.

6911def6972bd373980a4c9a.textCh: 我在实验室办公区的公告板上发现了一则通知，内容是关于一场将在演讲厅举行的重要会议，A.P. 将会出席。那儿肯定会留下些线索。
6911def6972bd373980a4c9a.textEn: In the boards of the office section of the lab, I found an announcement about a very important meeting in the lecture hall, which A.P. will attend. Surely there’ll be some clues left behind.

6911df0aa460b81cc809bbe5.textCh:
在 TerraGroup 的演讲大厅里，A.P. 亲自宣布了撤离的消息。TerraGroup，或者说 A.P. 本人，显然已经知道接下来会发生的事情。
录音里包含了大量信息，但最关键的一点是：“蔚蓝海岸”疗养院是撤离行动的关键中转站，而 A.P. 也会前往那里。我现在只需要弄清楚当时 A.P. 住在哪个房间。
6911df0aa460b81cc809bbe5.textEn: In the TerraGroup lecture hall, A.P. announced the start of the evacuation. TerraGroup, or A.P. himself, clearly knew what would happen next. The recording’s packed with info, but the main takeaway is that the evacuation was conducted through the Azure Coast health resort. A.P. himself was also supposed to be there. I just need to find out which room he was in.

6911df187fed7200770b9030.textCh: 在岗哨那边找到了一张字条，上面说有个大人物被安排在 305 房间。那会不会就是 A.P. 的房间？
6911df187fed7200770b9030.textEn: Found a note at the guard post, something about a big shot put in room 305. Could that be A.P.’s room?

6911df20a48acf3fc00bd731.textCh: 在 A.P. 的房间里，我找到了一把公寓的钥匙。像他这么重要的人，肯定只会住在市中心的某个豪华公寓楼里。
6911df20a48acf3fc00bd731.textEn: In A.P.'s room I found a key to an apartment. Someone that important would only live in some luxury complex somewhere downtown.

6911df2835dd7177c70e3ce5.textCh: 我找到了 A.P. 的 U 盘。里面肯定有重要的东西。
6911df2835dd7177c70e3ce5.textEn: I found A.P.'s flash drive. There’s definitely something valuable on it.

6911df478b6f9666a8006fdc.textCh: A.P. 在撤离前把自己的 U 盘落在了疗养院房间里。我得破解它，看看里面到底藏着哪些他的相关情报。
6911df478b6f9666a8006fdc.textEn: A.P. left the flash drive in his Health Resort room. I have to crack it and see what it reveals about him.

6911df505a0775c4980ff42e.textCh:
我试着破解这个闪存盘，但只能访问到一些技术文件。代码里偶尔会出现“无名者”这个莫名其妙的词汇，但代码本身无法运行，也不会执行任何操作。

这事我自己搞不定，必须要 Mechanic 出手。
6911df505a0775c4980ff42e.textEn:
I tried to decrypt the flash drive, but could only access some technical files. The word "Unheard" appears in the code occasionally, but the code itself doesn’t run or execute anything.

I won’t be able to handle this without Mechanic.

6911df58972bd373980a4c9d.textCh: Mechanic 说 Elektronik 擅长处理这些技术文件，但对方要收钱才能办事，看来我得弄点钱来了。
6911df58972bd373980a4c9d.textEn: Mechanic says the technical files are Elektronik’s territory, but he requires payment. Looks like I’ll have to cough up some cash.

6911df65277e44fe9f0507d1.textCh: 我已经把含有解密数据的闪存盘交给了 Mechanic。现在只能耐心等结果。希望 Elektronik 能给出答案。
6911df65277e44fe9f0507d1.textEn: I've given the flash drive with the decrypted data to Mechanic. Now it’s just a waiting game. Let's hope Elektronik has the answers.

6911df74e1112b904206ede0.textCh:
我收到了 Kerman 先生的消息。他说我不该指望 Elektronik 或 Mechanic 会提供什么有用的东西。他暗示那些文件可能是某种独特密钥的碎片。也许如果我把 A.P. 的文件整合进一张 TerraGroup 门禁卡里，可能会有反应。

我没有任何操作指南能参考，所以看来只能自己摸索着来了。
6911df74e1112b904206ede0.textEn:
I've been contacted by Mr. Kerman. He said I should not expect anything useful from Elektronik or Mechanic. He hinted the files might be pieces of some unique key. Maybe if I integrate A.P.’s files into a TerraGroup keycard it will do something.

I don't have any step by step guide, so I guess I'll just wing it.

6911df8126fc56a9a3045040.textCh:
我已经成功把 A.P. 的 U 盘里的文件和 TerraGroup 钥匙卡上的数据合并了。现在我得弄清楚这东西到底能打开什么，并确保它真的能用。

如果这张钥匙卡没用的话，那我就得尝试其他办法了。
6911df8126fc56a9a3045040.textEn:
I managed to merge the files from A.P.’s flash drive with the data on the TerraGroup keycard. Now I need to figure out what it actually opens and make sure it works.

If this keycard doesn't do it, I'll have to try other options.

6911dfb226fc56a9a3045043.textCh: 在 A.P. 的房间里，我找到了一把公寓的钥匙。为了接待他这种级别的专家，TerraGroup 在市中心专门租下了一整个高级公寓区一个豪华住宅区给他们住。我对那个公寓有印象，带着半片红枫叶……起了个“Premier” 或者 “Cardinal”之类的名字。
6911dfb226fc56a9a3045043.textEn: In A.P.'s room I found a key to an apartment. For specialists of that rank TerraGroup had a separate luxury residential complex built downtown. “Premier” or “Cardinal”… something like that.

6911dfc035dd7177c70e3ceb.textCh: 我检查了那间公寓，发现了一扇带 RFID 读卡器的门。无论那门后面是什么，肯定非常重要。也许是个档案室，或者是某个办公区——谁知道呢。
6911dfc035dd7177c70e3ceb.textEn: I inspected the apartment and found a door with an RFID reader. Whatever’s behind that door is definitely important. It could be an archive or a working office, who knows.

6911dfcf8b6f9666a8006fdf.textCh: 在集团包下的那件公寓里，我发现了一个隐藏房间。我用 A.P. 留下的 U 盘里的数据整合出了一张独特的门禁卡。现在就看这张卡是否真的管用了。
6911dfcf8b6f9666a8006fdf.textEn: In the corporate apartment I found a hidden room, and I assembled a unique keycard using the data from A.P.'s flash drive. Now to see if the card actually works.

6911dfdcc2d5c97f6609a102.textCh:
我顺着那些 TerraGroup 高层人员的线索一路追查下去，结果最终发现远远超出了我的预期。事实证明，整个集团不过是“无名者”掩盖自己真实意图的又一副白手套罢了——这要么是精英人物秘密结成的地下社团，要么就是真正的邪教。无论如何，他们的计划对普通人来说绝对称不上仁慈。

看起来，整个塔科夫冲突都是他们精心规划的结果，一切都在“无名者”的掌握之中。但最糟糕的是：在他们的宏大计划里，这塔科夫甚至连一颗重要的卒子都不算，只是连锁反应中倒下的第一张骨牌而已。
6911dfdcc2d5c97f6609a102.textEn:
I followed the trail of high-ranking TerraGroup people and discovered far more than I intended. The corporation turned out to be just one of the tools in the hands of The Unheard — a secret society or cult whose plans are far from benevolent, at least for ordinary people.

It seems the entire Tarkov conflict was planned and executed according to their design. The worst part is that Tarkov is barely even a piece of the bigger plan.

6911dfe7a460b81cc809bbeb.textCh:
隐藏房间原来是 A.P. 的办公室。看起来他在这里处理的绝对不是普通的行政工作。

办公室里配备了远程通信设备和数据处理设备。而且从那堆被墨水抹得一团糟的文件来看，A.P. 在离开前显然试图销毁所有痕迹。我得把能带走的全都拿上。
6911dfe7a460b81cc809bbeb.textEn:
The hidden room turned out to be A.P.’s office. Doesn’t look like he was handling normal admin stuff here.

The office is equipped for remote communication and data work. And judging by that mountain of ink-smeared papers, A.P. tried to destroy every trace before leaving. I’ve got to grab whatever I can.

6911dfee7fed7200770b9036.textCh:
这份命令里的信息，验证了 A.P. 在 TerraGroup 实验室演讲厅会议上说的所有内容。文件详细列出了 TerraGroup 的撤离计划以及 与 USEC 断绝一切关系的步骤。但接下来它竟然直接写着：“总部并没有进一步指示。”

这说明“无名者”并不是 TerraGroup 下属的执行者，他们反而是操纵集团的真正黑手！可如果连 TerraGroup 都要听命于他们——那还有多少组织、多少势力掌握在他们手里？
6911dfee7fed7200770b9036.textEn:
The information in the order confirms everything A.P. said at the TerraGroup Labs lecture hall meeting. It lays out TerraGroup’s evacuation and cutting ties with USEC. But then it straight up says the HQ “has no further instructions”.

It seems The Unheard did not carry out TerraGroup’s tasks, but were the ones giving the orders! But if even TerraGroup takes orders from them, who else is under their thumb?

6911dff7c2d5c97f6609a105.textCh:
给 TerraGroup 总部的那份报告副本里提到，“蓝冰”的经销商已经遍布世界各地，在全球市场上取得了很大成功。

这意味着随着“蓝冰”的市场份额越来越大，“无名者”不仅获得了稳定的资金来源，还确保了这一催化剂能够在光天化日之下进行自由运输。而这东西不只是燃料而已，同时还是大规模杀伤武器的成分之一。这套明谋真的是天衣无缝……简直太完美了。
6911dff7c2d5c97f6609a105.textEn:
The copy of the report for TerraGroup headquarters mentions the successful distribution of Blue Ice representatives worldwide.

This means that alongside the growing popularity of Blue Ice, The Unheard ensured free transport of the catalyst, which may be a component of weapons of mass destruction. Great… just great.

6911e00195febc38b20f4b9f.textCh: 从这些零散的文字来看，“无名者”的协议牵涉到世界各地的主要城市。这是否意味着塔科夫只是一个开始？
6911e00195febc38b20f4b9f.textEn: From the scraps of text, it looks like The Unheard’s protocol involves cities from all around the world. Does that mean Tarkov was only the beginning?

6911e009277e44fe9f0507d6.textCh: I found a document, almost completely covered in ink. It mentions the Blue Fire, as well as a Warden, who is somehow connected to control from above.
6911e009277e44fe9f0507d6.textEn: I found a document, almost completely covered in ink. It mentions the Blue Fire, as well as a Warden, who is somehow connected to control from above.

69125fe2caed34f3c90ec7ef.textCh: 结果发现 BEAR 派进塔科夫的不只是普通小队，这里还有真正的特种作战人员。我想多了解那些单位，以及他们到底在这里执行什么任务。
69125fe2caed34f3c90ec7ef.textEn: Turns out BEAR didn’t send just regular squads into Tarkov, there were real SOF guys here. I’d like to know more about those units and what exactly they were doing.

69125ff1ec30864f580e9efd.textCh:
我找到了一枚定制的臂章，上面写着“Bogatyrs”。比发给新兵的那种大路货要精致得多。我从没见过任何 BEAR 成员佩戴过这种臂章。这一定是早在其他 PMC 们部署到塔科夫之前就展开行动的老牌单位了。我得挖挖他们的料，商人里总得有人听说过他们。

如果还能再发现他们的遗物，最好还是收藏起来。就算永远没机会归还给他们的主人，至少我能知道这些战士真正的面目。
69125ff1ec30864f580e9efd.textEn:
I found a custom-made patch labeled "Bogatyrs". Definitely not the kind they issue to rookies. I’ve never seen any BEAR operatives wearing one of these. Must’ve been an old special unit that operated long before the Tarkov deployment. I need to learn more about them. Someone among the traders must’ve heard about them.

If I stumble upon more of their belongings, it's best I keep them. Even if I never get the chance to hand it back, at least I’ll know who these fighters really were.

69125ffda367f27ab60f8623.textCh: 在 Bogatyr 队员们遭到伏击的地点，我在 Moreman 的墓旁发现了一块狗牌。上面的痕迹和磨损已经说明了一切——携带它的人经历过地狱般的磨难。
69125ffda367f27ab60f8623.textEn: At the spot where the Bogatyrs were ambushed, I came across a dogtag lying beside Moreman’s grave. The marks and wear on it say enough — whoever carried it had been through hell and back.

69126005ec72e1b67a0ace6c.textCh: 在“花楸树”前哨站，我找到了一枚用变形子弹制成的护身符。像是属于某个 Bogatyr 成员的护身符。
69126005ec72e1b67a0ace6c.textEn: At the Ryabina outpost, I found an amulet made from a deformed bullet. It looks like one of the Bogatyrs wore it as a talisman.

6912600fc03e1e024902a3a3.textCh: 在“旋转木马”营地，我找到了一张印着山地风景的明信片，上面有一位士兵妻子的留言。显然这位 Bogatyr 队员的家人正在高加索等着他。不知道他们是否还有机会再见面。
6912600fc03e1e024902a3a3.textEn: At the Carousel outpost, I found a postcard with a mountain landscape and a message from a soldier’s wife. Looks like one of the Bogatyrs has a family waiting for him in the Caucasus. I wonder if they’ll ever see him again.

69126017916d21e0760256c2.textCh: 在“旋转木马”前哨站，我找到了一台录音机。从磨损程度来看，这肯定是 Voevoda 日常把玩的东西。无论是什么迫使 Bogatyr 小队撤离，肯定非常紧迫，他们甚至连私人物品都没来得及带走。
69126017916d21e0760256c2.textEn: Found a voice recorder at the Carousel outpost. Judging by the wear, Voevoda used it often. Whatever made the Bogatyr squad pull out, it happened in a hurry, since they left even their personal belongings behind.

691260313661b52d900b506c.textCh:
Jaeger 告诉了我一些 Bogatyr 队员的事情，并标出了他们之前曾经驻扎过的两个营地。先前他们主要在两个 BEAR 前哨站开展行动：“鸟巢”和““花楸树””。

“鸟巢”营地就藏在 Ultra 商场西边的树林里。“花楸树”则是在自然保护区的某个制高点，大概是当作掌控周边情况的观察哨。
691260313661b52d900b506c.textEn:
Jaeger told me a bit about the Bogatyrs and marked two of their former camp locations. They used to operate from two BEAR outposts: "Gnezdo" and "Ryabina".

"Gnezdo" is hidden in the forest west of the Ultra mall. "Ryabina" was somewhere up in the nature reserve, probably used as a lookout point.

6912603ff6359b810b0ef7f9.textCh: “鸟巢”前哨站已经被清理得一干二净，但里面可能也许还会有什么有价值的东西。我最好彻底搜查一下这个地方。
6912603ff6359b810b0ef7f9.textEn: The Gnezdo outpost has been picked clean, but there might still be something worth finding. I’d better search the place properly.

69126048a367f27ab60fa1db.textCh: “鸟巢”营地里一个 BEAR 留下的字条提到，Bogatyr 队员们在转移途中遭到了袭击。我得弄清楚那次伏击发生在什么地方。
69126048a367f27ab60fa1db.textEn: A BEAR’s note from the Gnezdo camp mentions the Bogatyrs got hit while relocating. I need to figure out where that ambush happened.

691260505d4c6d3cd105a95b.textCh: 我找到了总部关于 Bogatyr 小队行动的报告。Voevoda 似乎是个非常倔强的指挥官……但似乎是那种值得信赖的类型。他绝不会背后捅刀，始终与部下并肩作战。
691260505d4c6d3cd105a95b.textEn: I found reports from headquarters on the Bogatyr squad's operations. Voevoda seems to have been a very headstrong commander… but the right kind, it seems. He wouldn’t stab anyone in the back and always stood by his men.

69126059c03e1e024902a3a8.textCh: 我找到了一份 Bogatyr 小队成员的个人档案。呼号 Moreman，通信兵。如果能想办法联系到他就好了…
69126059c03e1e024902a3a8.textEn: I came across a personal file for one of the Bogatyrs. Callsign Moreman, comms guy. It would be useful to somehow get in touch with him…

69126062ec72e1b67a0adb19.textCh:
在“鸟巢”前哨站的平板电脑上发现了信号三角定位的迹象。看来基地指挥官截获了 Voevoda 发出的无线电信号，并用以此为依据来追踪他们的位置。

但他三角定位的第二个定位点到底是怎么得出的？他具体又是怎么帮助那些 Bogatyr 队员的？从立交桥赶往 Priozersk 自然保护区可是相当漫长的一段路。
69126062ec72e1b67a0adb19.textEn:
Found signs of signal triangulation on a tablet from the Gnezdo outpost. Looks like the base commander picked up a radio signal from Voevoda and used it to track them.

But where did he get the second point for the triangulation? And how exactly did he help the Bogatyrs? It's quite a hike from the interchange to Priozersk.

691260655d4c6d3cd105a95e.textCh: 我在 Gnezdo 营地发现了一张撕裂的纸条，上面只写着几个数字。不知道是什么意思，但也许以后能派上用场。我敢肯定，这张纸条还有另一半能拼凑起来组成完整的部分。
691260655d4c6d3cd105a95e.textEn: Found a torn piece of a note with some numbers at the Gnezdo camp. No clue what it means, but it could come in handy. Somewhere out there is the other half, I’m sure of it.

691260d316faf45cec00dda7.textCh: 根据笔记所说，Bogatyrs (战士) 小队是在北部联合国检查站外遭到袭击的。该去看看了。
691260d316faf45cec00dda7.textEn: According to the notes, the Bogatyrs were attacked just beyond the northern UN checkpoint. Time to check it out.

691260e1788350fa2305d8ee.textCh: 我发现了一具尸体。看样子这是 Moreman，Bogatyrs (战士) 小队的一员。
691260e1788350fa2305d8ee.textEn: I found a body. Looks like this is Moreman, one of the Bogatyrs.

691260eaa367f27ab60fa206.textCh: 在这名 Bogatyrs (战士) 小队成员的口袋里，我找到了那张数字字条的下半部分。看样子这两张纸的确和他们有关。看起来不像是坐标……也许是某种密码，或者无线电频率？
691260eaa367f27ab60fa206.textEn: In the pockets of the Bogatyr member, I found the second part of the note with numbers. So it’s definitely tied to them. Doesn’t seem like coordinates… maybe it’s a code, or a radio frequency?

691260f11d8f00662d0d454d.textCh: Bogatyrs (战士) 小队成员身上还有一部手机，也许存储卡里还留有些什么。
691260f11d8f00662d0d454d.textEn: The Bogatyr had a phone on him. Maybe there’s something left on the memory card.

691260ff5cc634a9240dbfc5.textCh: 我找到了 Moreman 的手机，里面可能有重要数据。等我回到藏身处，我就把存储卡里的东西全都提取出来搞明白发生了什么。
691260ff5cc634a9240dbfc5.textEn: I found Moreman’s phone, which might contain important data. Time to pull whatever’s on the memory card once I’m back at the Hideout.

6912610cec30864f580e9f3a.textCh:
Moreman 在手机上留下了最后一条记录。Bogatyrs (战士) 小队被自己人袭击了。一个叫 Yastreb 的家伙先开了枪，随后还有其他人参与了伏击……

可到底是谁会想要干掉 BEAR 最精锐的小队？
6912610cec30864f580e9f3a.textEn:
Moreman left a final entry on the phone. The Bogatyrs got hit by their own. Some Yastreb started shooting at them, and then the others joined in…

But who the hell wanted to take out one of BEAR’s best units?

69126118f8cccde6260455db.textCh: 看来 Voevoda 并不是那种温和的类型。但作为小队的指挥官，他绝对是士兵们的坚强后盾。
69126118f8cccde6260455db.textEn: Looks like Voevoda wasn’t exactly a soft commander. But he definitely had his men’s backs.

691261271d8f00662d0d4552.textCh: 找到一张写着数字的纸条，看起来像是某个无线电频率。不过要是没有像样的电台设备，谁也联系不上。
691261271d8f00662d0d4552.textEn: Found a note with a number which could be a radio frequency. No use trying to reach anyone without a decent radio, though.

691261a216faf45cec00ea3e.textCh:
我找到了“花楸树”营地。看来 Bogatyrs (战士) 小队曾从这里监视 USEC 单位在西北方向的阵地。

我必须把这里的所有东西都好好检查一遍，才能继续上路。
691261a216faf45cec00ea3e.textEn:
I found the Ryabina camp. Seems like the Bogatyrs were watching USEC’s northwest positions from here.

I shouldn't leave until I’ve checked everything properly.

691261aa5cc634a9240dc032.textCh: 在“花楸树”营地，我找到了 Voevoda 的报告。任务结束后，他们被命令转移到“旋转木马”点位。现在的问题是……这地方他妈的到底在哪？
691261aa5cc634a9240dc032.textEn: Found Voevoda's report at the Ryabina camp. After the mission, they had to move to point Carousel. Now the question is… where the hell is that place?

691261b15d4c6d3cd105a97f.textCh:
原来“旋转木马”是 Ultra 商场内部的一个防御严密的营地。相比其他据点，Bogatyrs (战士) 小队显然更常来这里活动。

得仔细检查一下这个地方。
691261b15d4c6d3cd105a97f.textEn:
The "Carousel" turned out to be a well-fortified camp right inside Ultra. The Bogatyrs clearly visited this spot more often than their other positions.

Better check the place carefully.

691261ea7a0bef6f890f7fac.textCh: 我找到了 Voevoda 的个人档案。这么完美的服役履历，不愧是最顶尖的 PMC 战士。
691261ea7a0bef6f890f7fac.textEn: I found Voevoda's personal file. With all that experience, no wonder he was one of the best.

691261f45cc634a9240dc036.textCh: 发现了一张 Strelets 写给 Den 的便条，边缘还潦草地写着一串代码。这到底会是什么意思呢？
691261f45cc634a9240dc036.textEn: Came across a note from Strelets to Den, and there’s some code scribbled on the edge. What’s it for, though?

691262017a0bef6f890f7fb0.textCh: 我找到了 Taran 的个人档案。看起来他参与突击行动的次数绝大多数的老兵还要多。
691262017a0bef6f890f7fb0.textEn: I found Taran's personal file. Looks like he hit the assaults more than most of the seasoned vets.

69126209c610e4da8e0bcb9e.textCh: 我找到了 Strelets 的个人档案。像他这么年长的狙击手可不常见。要是他们一直让 Strelets 担任这个职位，那这个人一定相当厉害。
69126209c610e4da8e0bcb9e.textEn: I found Strelets' personal file. Not often you see a sniper this old. If they kept him in the role, he must’ve been damn good.

69126215ec72e1b67a0af3fc.textCh: 找到了一盘录有Voevoda自述的磁带。经历了那么多事，难怪他会显得有些…神经紧绷。
69126215ec72e1b67a0af3fc.textEn: Found an audio tape with Voevoda's reflections. After all he’s been through, no wonder he’s a bit… on edge.

69126269d43471933208e619.textCh:
我找到几张写着数字的纸条。把那张撕破的拼在一起后，数字总和是3570，而在 Strelets 那张完整的纸条角落里，潦草地写着“27.893.2000”。

也许我可以用这些数字来调频，看看能不能收到什么信号。
69126269d43471933208e619.textEn:
I found several notes with numbers. The torn one adds up to 3570 when pieced together, and on Strelets' intact note, there’s 27.893.2000 scribbled in the corner.

Maybe I can use these to tune a frequency and pick up a signal.

691262757a0bef6f890f7fb5.textCh:
我调好了频率，并输入了 Strelets 纸条上的代码。信号很清晰，但似乎是循环播放的录制消息。

在那段录音里，指挥官说——如果我想联系上 Bogatyrs (战士) 小队，就得去找一个叫 Lightkeeper 的人，并交出所有能识别是 Bogatyrs 小队的物品。
691262757a0bef6f890f7fb5.textEn:
I set the frequency and entered the code from Strelets' note. Got a clean signal, but it seems to be looped.

In the message, the commander said that if I want to reach the Bogatyrs, I need to go to Lightkeeper and hand over all the Bogatyrs’ identifying items.

691262805d4c6d3cd105a989.textCh: Bogatyrs (战士) 小队的指挥官指示我要把所有识别物品交给那个 Lightkeeper。首先，我必须得看看他是否足够信任我。像这样的人不太可能会和信不过的外人透露任何消息，最好还是一次性把所有能识别是 Bogatyrs 的东西都搜集齐了再去找他。
691262805d4c6d3cd105a989.textEn: The Bogatyr squad's commander instructed me to deliver all the identifying items to Lightkeeper. First thing, I need to see if he trusts me enough. Unlikely he’d spill anything to some outsider. Better grab all the Bogatyrs’ items at once, just to be safe.

69126294c03e1e024902b9c5.textCh: Lightkeeper 认出了那些属于 Bogatyr 队员的物品，说是会主动联系我。现在只能等到有新进展出现再说了。
69126294c03e1e024902b9c5.textEn: Lightkeeper recognized the Bogatyrs’ items and said they’d reach out to me on their own. All that’s left is to wait.

691262bc5cc634a9240dc054.textCh: Voevoda 联系了我，向我简单介绍了一下他的小队。如果我想与他们合作，就得证明自己有能力完成他们的任务。
691262bc5cc634a9240dc054.textEn: Voevoda contacted me and filled me in a bit on his squad. If I want to work with them, I’ve got to show I can handle their tasks.

691262d05d4c6d3cd105a98c.textCh:
这次联系我的不是 Voevoda，而是Taran。他给我下达了一个任务——追查是谁策划了对 Bogatyr 小队的伏击。

在那次袭击后，小队不得不隐蔽起来，但我可以完成这项调查，找出那些叛徒。
691262d05d4c6d3cd105a98c.textEn:
This time it’s Taran on the line, not Voevoda. He’s got me on a mission: track down whoever set up the ambush on the Bogatyrs.

The squad had to lay low after the attack, but I can wrap up this investigation and find the traitors.

691262dde65cb7303c064ef7.textCh:
Taran 说叛徒是 BEAR 的自己人，但也有可能是收受了其他人的命令。

最好还是去检查一下 BEAR 的据点，也许能找到一些线索。
691262dde65cb7303c064ef7.textEn:
Taran says the traitor was one of the BEAR guys, but could’ve been taking orders from somewhere else.

Better check the BEAR positions, maybe I’ll find some kind of lead.

691262e8ef9ec50e1d0dd767.textCh: 我找到了一张纸条，证明 Prapor 与伏击 Bogatyr 小队的那伙人之间存在联系。是时候去找他问个清楚了。
691262e8ef9ec50e1d0dd767.textEn: I found a note tying Prapor to the ambush on the Bogatyrs. Time to get some answers from him.

691262efec72e1b67a0af3ff.textCh: 我在 Ultra 附近转了一圈，但没发现任何值得一提的东西。
691262efec72e1b67a0af3ff.textEn: I've strolled around Ultra, but didn't find anything of note.

691262f8788350fa2305e572.textCh: 在灯塔旁 Prapor 手下的营地里也没有收获。或许是我搜的不够细？
691262f8788350fa2305e572.textEn: Haven’t found anything yet at Prapor’s camp by the lighthouse. Maybe I wasn’t looking hard enough.

69126304ec30864f580ea024.textCh: 我成功进入了 D2 地堡指挥部，但里面没有任何关于 Bogatyr 小队的情报。
69126304ec30864f580ea024.textEn: I made it into the D2 bunker headquarters, but there was no information about the Bogatyrs there.

69126314ec72e1b67a0af402.textCh:
也就是说，Prapor 的确参与了背叛 Bogatyr 小队的行动。但他也只是其中的一环而已。是某个将军下达了这条命令，而 Prapor 的手下则把小队带进了邪教徒的包围圈。

看来这就是我要锁定的下一个目标。
69126314ec72e1b67a0af402.textEn:
So Prapor really was part of the Bogatyrs’ betrayal. But he’s just one link in the chain. Orders came from some General, and Prapor’s people delivered them to the cultist circles.

It seems this is my next target.

6912631f788350fa2305e575.textCh:
我找到了一张邪教徒的便条，上面明确记录着 Lightkeeper 批准邪教徒执行将军的命令。所以 Lightkeeper 不仅知道这件事的来龙去脉，还参与其中。

我一个人恐怕难以揭发他。我会假装是 Voevoda，引诱他呼叫我，然后把我所有的王牌都亮出来。这是我最好的机会。
6912631f788350fa2305e575.textEn:
I found one of the cultists’ notes that explicitly says Lightkeeper gave the go-ahead to carry out the General’s orders. So Lightkeeper not only knew about what was happening, but took part in it.

Alone I’m unlikely to expose him. I’ll fake that Voevoda wanted him to call in, then I’ll lay out every ace I’ve got. That’s my best chance.

691263305cc634a9240dc05a.textCh: 我找到了一张 Voevoda 的照片，邪教徒特意把他标了出来，写着他阻碍了“降临”到来，必须被消灭掉。这印证了我对邪教徒参与其中的猜想，但对于调查本身并没有太大帮助。
691263305cc634a9240dc05a.textEn: Found a photo of Voevoda tagged by the cultists, saying he obstructs the Arrival and has to be neutralized. This confirms the cultists’ involvement, but it does not advance the investigation.

69126343ec72e1b67a0af405.textCh:
我设法从 Lightkeeper 那里逼问出了真相。将军的命令先是通过 Prapor 到了他这里，再下达给伏击的行动小组。

Lightkeeper 说，他之所以先前无法干预事态，是因为风险太大。现在既然 Voevoda 已经知道了一切，Lightkeeper 决定和我们做一笔交易：他会出面和那个将军周旋，替事情善后，但前提是要我们保证他的安全。没有安全保障，他就不会去对付那个将军。

Voevoda 接受了这笔交易，但又提出了一个额外条件：Lightkeeper 必须为我准备一些文件，证明“无名者”的卧底已经渗入了俄罗斯正规军当中。这些情报肯定能帮我理清塔科夫局势的来龙去脉，我得之后再跑一趟，把这些文件拿回来。
69126343ec72e1b67a0af405.textEn:
I managed to pressure Lightkeeper. Orders from the General went through Prapor to him and then on to the execution teams.

Lightkeeper said he could not influence the events earlier because it was too risky. Now that Voevoda knows everything, Lightkeeper put an offer on the table: he will deal with the General in exchange for security guarantees from. No guarantees, no General.

Voevoda accepted, but added one more condition. Lightkeeper will prepare documents for me proving the presence of The Unheard agents within the Russian Armed Forces. That will help me understand what is happening in Tarkov. I’ll have to return and pick them up later.

69126351788350fa2305e578.textCh:
Lightkeeper 给我的不只是 TerraGroup 的黑料而已。他所准备的材料揭露出“无名者”已经深深渗透到了各个方面——全球各国政府都有他们安插的卧底，俄罗斯也并不例外。

他们正在为一场前所未有的巨大行动做准备，想尽办法把所有权力集中到自己手中。我完全无法想象，面对这样一个触角深入全球的怪物，到底谁能够与之抗衡。
69126351788350fa2305e578.textEn:
Lightkeeper didn’t just give me dirt on TerraGroup. What he gave me shows how deep The Unheard really run. They have agents embedded in governments worldwide, Russia included.

They’re preparing for something massive, consolidating power wherever they can. I have no idea how anyone’s supposed to stand against a force like that.

69126a12d43471933208e631.textCh: 我检查了森林里的邪教仪式圈，但这里没有任何有用的东西。
69126a12d43471933208e631.textEn: I've checked out the cultist circle on Woods, but there’s nothing useful here.

69126a1b7a0bef6f890f7fc9.textCh: 我检查了储备站的邪教仪式圈，但这里没有任何有用的东西。
69126a1b7a0bef6f890f7fc9.textEn: I've checked out the cultist circle on Reserve, but there’s nothing useful here.

69126a23502bbd25c7034ffe.textCh: 我检查了海关的邪教仪式圈，但这里没有任何有用的东西。
69126a23502bbd25c7034ffe.textEn: I've checked out the cultist circle on Customs, but there’s nothing useful here.

69e55add5743d170960c9946.textCh:
我偶然看见了一张 TerraGroup 的海报，内容似乎与并购 Paradigm 航运有关，至少两者存在商业往来。Paradigm 航运是一家海运巨头，也许和 TerraGroup 撤离他们在塔科夫研究资产的行动有点关系。

如果我能挖出这桩生意背后的情报来，也许我就能更加深入了解塔科夫发生的一切，幕后黑手是谁，以及究竟是谁应该为事态升级负责。要是能找到什么特别有价值的东西，说不定能让我更加接近成功逃离。

我应该先从商人们那里问起，看看他们对 TerraGroup 和 Paradigm 航运之间的关系都了解多少。
69e55add5743d170960c9946.textEn:
I came across a TerraGroup corporate poster about a merger or cooperation with Paradigm Shipping. They handle sea freight and might’ve been tied to TerraGroup’s evacuation or their projects in Tarkov.

If I can dig something up through them, I might get closer to understanding what went down in Tarkov and who’s pulling the strings. And if I find something worthwhile, it could help me get out.

I should start by asking the traders what they know about TerraGroup’s ties to Paradigm Shipping.

69e55b7a4b8b76a9a80c6c8a.textCh:
TerraGroup 并购了一家海运公司，名义上是为了节约货运成本。但 Mechanic 和我一样不相信这套冠冕堂皇的说法，决定一查到底。

他想办法拦截了来自海上的求救信号，刚好可能就是 Paradigm 名下的船。目前，这是我手头唯一能用的线索了。

为了推进调查，我必须先帮 Mechanic 升级他的设备。为此我得出发前往自然保护区，去给他修好一座信号塔。
69e55b7a4b8b76a9a80c6c8a.textEn:
Formally, TerraGroup acquired a maritime carrier for economic reasons. But Mechanic doesn’t buy the official story either and wants to get to the bottom of it.

He managed to intercept a distress signal from a ship that could belong to Paradigm Shipping. Right now, it’s the best lead I’ve got.

To move forward, I need to upgrade Mechanic’s equipment. For that, I’ll have to head to the nature reserve and repair a cellular tower.

69e62b2173029af91e07dff9.textCh:
我在藏身处的情报中心截获了一条无线电消息，听着像是请求撤离的求救信号。但问题是，整个塔科夫已经被封锁了好几年，发信号求救根本没有意义，这儿的所有人都心知肚明。

所以要么是有人发现了新的逃离路线，要么就是有人在封锁前就被困在了塔科夫，期间对外界的情况一无所知……无论如何，都值得调查一番。

信号质量很差劲，可能是藏身处的设备过于简陋导致的。Mechanic 那儿应该有更合适的设备，说不定他能追踪到信号的源头。
69e62b2173029af91e07dff9.textEn:
At the intel center, I intercepted what sounded like an evacuation request. Problem is, Tarkov’s been sealed off for ages, and everyone around here knows that.

So either someone’s found a way to get out, or they’ve been sitting in isolation for years, completely unaware of what’s happening… Either way, it’s a lead worth following.

Chances are the signal came through this poorly because of my hideout equipment. Mechanic should have better tools, and he might be able to trace its origin.

69e62b7ae00dd30850081c6a.textCh:
Mechanic 也收到了我正在调查的那个求救信号。据他所说，这是有人试图从外海联系塔科夫市里的人，可能是 Paradigm 航运名下的民用船只，不是军方的船。

船上可能会有大量能用的电子设备，说不定还记录着引发塔科夫一切动乱的原始数据。如果我运气够好的话，这种程度的情报说不定能为我换来一张回家的船票……当然，不是坐那艘船。

Mechanic 想让我截住下一轮通话，但他的设备收到的信号也是一样弱。所以我得前往自然保护区，修好那里的一座信号塔，以提升拦截信号的强度。
69e62b7ae00dd30850081c6a.textEn:
Mechanic picked up the same distress signal I’ve been looking into. According to him, someone’s trying to contact Tarkov from the water, likely a civilian ship from Paradigm Shipping.

There might still be usable electronics on that ship, maybe even data on what led to the Tarkov incident. If I’m lucky, that kind of intel could buy me a ticket out.

He wants to catch the next transmission, but his current setup won’t cut it, the signal will be just as weak. I’ll need to go to the nature reserve and fix a comms tower to improve reception.

69e64cd66e6f44c701023eac.textCh:
信号塔刚修好，Mechanic 就收到了新一轮通话的信号。芬兰湾里有艘船上的人正在和游荡者们商谈撤离行动的事情。虽然不清楚 Knight 和他的手下打的到底是什么算盘，但我必须赶在他们之前上船才行。
