首先，我必须搜集关于那艘船的更多情报，至少弄清楚在船上会遇到些什么人。Mechanic 指示我前往灯塔火车站附近的 Paradigm 货运中转站，那里可能留下了这艘船是怎么困在塔科夫的文字记录。
69e64cd66e6f44c701023eac.textEn:
Once the tower was fixed, Mechanic picked up a new transmission. Someone aboard a ship in the gulf is negotiating an evacuation with the Rogues. Not sure what Knight and his people are after, but I need to get there before they do.

First, I need to learn more about the ship, at least enough to know what I’m walking into. Mechanic pointed me to the Paradigm Shipping freight terminal by the lighthouse. There could be documents left behind about vessels stuck in Tarkov.

69e64d8130c8dbed290c22eb.textCh:
结果 Boreas 根本不是什么常规的货船，而是一艘航程和自持能力都相当夸张的核动力破冰船，自从契约战争爆发以来一直停泊在塔科夫水域内。这份情报不仅没能让我们摸清它的底细，相反，现在的问题更多了。我们绝对得登船看看。

在 Mechanic 忙着找出它的坐标的同时，我得想办法找交通工具上船才行。在经历了 EMP 爆炸之后，整个塔科夫能动的车都没剩几辆了，所以最好是找那些有门路的商人碰运气。

Peacekeeper 手里绝对有能用的载具，但目前最好是不要让联合国方面注意到 Boreas 号的存在。在剩下的人里，也就 Skier、Fence 和 Prapor 能搞到军用或者民用的载具了。当然，我也可以试着问问 BTR 司机，但他那儿应该没有水上漂的东西。
69e64d8130c8dbed290c22eb.textEn:
The “Boreas” turned out to be more than just a cargo ship, it’s an icebreaker that has been sitting near Tarkov since the start of the Contract Wars. Its entire history raises nothing but more questions. It definitely needs to be inspected.

While Mechanic figures out its exact coordinates, I need to find some kind of transport. There isn’t much operational equipment left in Tarkov, so there’s no point asking every trader.

Peacekeeper definitely has access to vehicles, but for now it’s better not to draw UN attention to the “Boreas”. Military or evacuation transport could only still be available through Skier, Fence, Therapist, or Prapor. I could also try asking the BTR driver, but that might not get me anywhere.

69e65140af589ffa75082edf.textCh:
看样子 Prapor 手里的直升机能载我一程去破冰船上。但我很怀疑他的飞机是不是真的还能飞——要是那架老旧直升机出了半点岔子，或者 Prapor 那边突然发难，我们登船的计划就要全部泡汤了。

所以我得想办法找找另外的登船方式，商人之外的家伙可能会有路数。
69e65140af589ffa75082edf.textEn:
It looks like Prapor might be able to provide a helicopter for a drop onto the icebreaker. But I doubt that bird is in good condition. The whole plan could fall apart at any moment because of a malfunction or issues on Prapor’s side.

So I definitely need to look for some kind of alternative to the helicopter. Might be worth asking around outside just the traders.

69e651e37d33fe4e1d08c953.textCh:
我还以为要花上好大的功夫才能把自己给安排上船，但 BTR 司机那个老小子给了我一个意外惊喜：原来他还记得我帮他逃离了 Skier 的奴役，因此愿意帮我和走私者那边撮合交通工具的事情。

他说会在下次见面之前找走私者那边谈谈，甚至都没向我开价。
69e651e37d33fe4e1d08c953.textEn:
I thought getting transport to the icebreaker would be a real headache, but the BTR driver surprised me. He remembers how I helped him get away from Skier, and he’s willing to arrange transport with the smugglers for me.

He said he’ll talk to them before our next meeting, and didn’t ask for anything in return.

69e652137d33fe4e1d08c956.textCh: 我猜现在可以去找 BTR 司机了。
69e652137d33fe4e1d08c956.textEn: Guess it's time to return to the BTR driver.

69e6524a291a3192080bea75.textCh:
BTR 司机确实和走私者谈成了，他们会负责派出一艘气垫船——更像是小艇——把我送上船。问题在于，这帮人管杀不管埋，只管上船的那一程，所以还是得找到另外的交通方式。

此外我还得记得带上一套修船的专用工具，免得那帮走私者攒出来的破船半路出什么岔子。
69e6524a291a3192080bea75.textEn:
The BTR driver managed to negotiate with the smugglers, and they’ll provide me with a hovercraft. The only issue is that they’re only willing to handle the insertion. I’ll need another transport for extraction.

And I can’t forget to bring a marine repair kit in case something goes wrong with the hovercraft.

69e6524c7848e3e41a0a386b.textCh:
BTR 司机同意帮我和那帮走私者谈谈，看看能不能安排前往破冰船的交通方式。但我相当怀疑这帮人是否愿意和 PMC 合作。

所以我提出可以帮他们清理营地里的不速之客，以展现诚意。我必须得把他们的两个营地都清理干净。

第一个走私者营地位于海岸线，我从疗养院出来，向着通往海关的路那边走，途中就能看到集装箱和窝棚围起来的营地。

第二个营地在立交桥，位于铁路线另一头，在峭壁之后的林子里。BTR 司机说营地里画着一个红色五角星。
69e6524c7848e3e41a0a386b.textEn:
The BTR driver agreed to help me and check with the smugglers about transport to the icebreaker. But I doubt they love cooperating with PMCs.

So he suggested I help them in advance on their territory. I need to clear it of unwanted guests.

The first smuggler camp is located on the shore. I need to move from the Health Resort toward the customs area, crossing the field to the structures with shipping containers.

The second camp is at the interchange, somewhere on the cliffs in the forest behind the railway tracks. The BTR driver said to look for a red star symbol.

69e6bcf2cf8274eb880ce1d4.textCh: 是时候回去找 BTR 司机，看看我的诚意是否足以让那帮走私者放下戒心了。问问上船的事情安排的怎么样了。
69e6bcf2cf8274eb880ce1d4.textEn: Time to get back to the BTR driver and see how my help affected the smugglers’ decision. And finally find out what’s going on with the transport.

69e6bd0474accf8d7e0c802b.textCh:
BTR 司机给我带来了好消息。那些走私者对我愿意出手帮忙大为感激，愿意分出一艘气垫船来送我上去。唯一的问题是，他们只愿意送我上船，却不肯在原地等我返程。

我得另外想办法搞定下船这一趟，与此同时，每一次上船都必须给气垫船带一套专用工具来。
69e6bd0474accf8d7e0c802b.textEn:
The BTR driver came back with good news. The smugglers appreciated my help on their territory and agreed to provide me with a hovercraft. The only issue is that they’ll only drop me off at the icebreaker, they won’t wait for me there.

For extraction, I’ll definitely need another transport. And I can’t forget the marine repair kit for the hovercraft.

69e6be8e476f4eebe506c402.textCh:
还好我按照约定把箱子交给了 Prapor，而不是爽约自己留着。Prapor 看起来心情不错，愿意用直升机送我去破冰船上。

但在飞机起飞之前，他需要弄到一种航空级润滑油。据说这种叫 AMG-10 的东西就在储备站军事基地，我得想办法弄来。
69e6be8e476f4eebe506c402.textEn:
Good thing I decided to hand that armored case over to Prapor instead of keeping it. Now he’s ready to deliver me to the icebreaker by helicopter.

But for the takeoff, he needs aviation-grade lubricant. I’ll have to bring it to him. He said I can find this AMG-10 at the Federal Reserve military base.

69e722c42f1585b33d05e470.textCh: 我弄到了 Prapor 要的那些润滑油，该回去找他了。
69e722c42f1585b33d05e470.textEn: I've got the lubricant. Now I gotta talk to Prapor.

69e722e4e7fd14ccad0a5772.textCh:
Prapor 表示，贸然把直升机派到一艘陌生船上的风险实在是太高了，没法冒着搭上一整架飞机的风险出动。这话说的不是完全没有道理，不过至少我返程可以搭直升机了。

在呼叫直升机之前，我得把 Boreas 号的停机坪给清理干净，然后发射一枚绿色的 RSP 信号弹。Prapor 还提到必须带钱付给飞行员，所以到时候身上还得带些欧元现金。

但上船的这一趟我就得另外想办法了。
69e722e4e7fd14ccad0a5772.textEn:
Prapor said he’s not ready to send me to the icebreaker by helicopter due to the risk of damaging it or losing it altogether. That’s understandable. But the helicopter can still extract me from there.

To call it in, I need to clear the helipad on the “Boreas” and send an RSP flare signal. Prapor also mentioned payment in cash, so I need to remember to bring it with me.

But for insertion onto the icebreaker, I’ll definitely need another transport.

69e722e52517f242e00afca6.textCh:
Prapor 可以出动直升机，但飞机必须先经过整备才能起飞。虽然我不用亲自去修复那架直升机，但我得去趟储备站，帮他的机修师开路。

在清理完军事基地里的敌人之后，我需要在通往森林的小道附近发射一枚黄色的 RSP 信号弹，通知他的人进来。
69e722e52517f242e00afca6.textEn:
Prapor is ready to provide a helicopter, but it needs to be prepared for takeoff first. I don’t have to fix anything myself, but I need to clear a path to the Federal Reserve military base for his technicians.

Once I clear the military base, I’ll have to send a yellow RSP flare signal at the start of the trail leading to Woods.

69e723b02517f242e00afca9.textCh:
基地算是大致被清理干净了，是时候发信号叫机修师进来了。在装甲列车停放的库房旁边，营地的铁丝网有一段破口，那里就是通往森林的小路开始的地方。

我得到他们指定的地方发信号才行。
69e723b02517f242e00afca9.textEn:
The base is mostly clear now, so it’s time to call in the engineers. There’s a break in the barbed wire near the hangar where the armored train stops, that’s where the trail to Woods begins.

I need to send the signal at that spot.

69e723cacf8274eb880ce1d8.textCh: 现在我可以回去找 Prapor，问问他手下的机修师事情办得怎么样了。
69e723cacf8274eb880ce1d8.textEn: Now I can return to Prapor and ask how it went with his engineers.

69e723dc8541f9e4fb0511bd.textCh:
Prapor 派出的技工撞上了 Glukhar 的人，最终没能在基地里找到他们要的东西。

这个老狐狸气得要死，说什么也不肯再派出人去储备站。这意味着找润滑油的差事又落到了我的身上。

平心而论，他确实告诉了我上哪去找那些润滑油。型号是 AMG-10，大概在兵营中央广场的米-26 周围，要么就是在火车站上堆着的箱子里，或者在黑主教楼的地下室里。
69e723dc8541f9e4fb0511bd.textEn:
Prapor’s technicians ran into Glukhar’s men and couldn’t retrieve what they came for from the military base.

He’s pissed and won’t risk his men again. That means I’ll have to search for the lubricant on my own.

He did point me in the right direction though. I’m looking for AMG-10 oil, possibly on the parade ground near the MI-26, among the containers by the railway, or in the educational building basement.

69e72486e6829ca0db07585d.textCh:
自从我决定把手提箱自己留着之后，Prapor 就一直看我不爽。但这一回我的运气不错，为了一个急单，他愿意派出直升机送我上船。

所以现在我得想办法搞到几个军用滤波器，然后把东西交给 Prapor。最好赶在这个老狐狸改变主意之前办完这笔交易。
69e72486e6829ca0db07585d.textEn:
Prapor doesn’t trust me after I decided to keep that armored case for myself. But I got lucky. For completing an urgent job, he’s willing to provide a helicopter to access the icebreaker.

So now I need to get military power filters and hand them over to Prapor. And I’d better do it fast before he changes his mind.

69e7249905e03ae28801ebb2.textCh: 我找齐了 Prapor 要的滤波器，该当面交给他了。
69e7249905e03ae28801ebb2.textEn: I collected the filters. Better hand them to Prapor in person.

69e724c22517f242e00afcac.textCh:
虽然 Prapor 合作得不情不愿，但我们之间的约定仍然有效。为了让直升机飞起来，我需要替他找来 AGM-10 航空润滑油。

他提到了东西在储备站，却不肯透露具体在哪。看样子我又得翻遍整个地方了。
69e724c22517f242e00afcac.textEn:
Prapor isn’t exactly eager to cooperate, but the agreement is still in place. To get the helicopter airborne, I need to find AMG-10 aviation lubricant.

He mentioned it could be on Reserve, but wouldn’t give me anything more specific. Looks like I’ll have to look for this lubricant myself.

69e724c295e1c3facb0cac8e.textCh: 终于找到了这个该死的直升机润滑油，该回去找 Prapor 了。
69e724c295e1c3facb0cac8e.textEn: Looks like I found that helicopter lubricant. Time to head back to Prapor.

69e72539c4e878cd2f090c7e.textCh:
Prapor 还是对之前的龃龉念念不忘。这家伙一点风险也不想冒，根本不愿意让直升机送我上船。但至少返程那一趟可以坐直升机。

在呼叫直升机之前，我得把 Boreas 号的停机坪给清理干净，然后发射一枚绿色的 RSP 信号弹。Prapor 还提到必须带钱付给飞行员，所以到时候身上还得带些欧元现金。

但上船的这一趟我就得另外想办法了。
69e72539c4e878cd2f090c7e.textEn:
Prapor is still unhappy about everything that happened. He clearly doesn’t want to risk the helicopter and refused to drop me onto the icebreaker. At least he’s still willing to extract me from there.

For evacuation from the “Boreas”, I’ll need to clear the helipad and send an RSP flare signal. He also mentioned payment in cash, so I’d better bring extra.

But for getting onto the icebreaker, I’ll definitely need another transport.

69e725922517f242e00afcaf.textCh:
现在我已经掌握了破冰船的坐标，上下船的交通工具也安排好了。事情不容耽搁，该立刻出发了，否则 Knight 和他手下那伙人绝对会捷足先登。

无论如何，我都得做好最坏的准备。同时确保带齐了上下船所需的一切装备。
69e725922517f242e00afcaf.textEn:
Now I have both the icebreaker’s coordinates and transport. I can’t delay any longer, or Knight and his men will beat me to it.

Either way, I’d better prepare for the worst. And make sure to bring everything I’ll need for both insertion and extraction.

69e725bb8f17e26d49006cd7.textCh: 我想办法登上了那艘破冰船，结果刚上船就迎面撞上了游荡者。他们抢先一步登船，血洗了整个地方。但说不定有船员誓死抵抗，把自己封在了舱室里？也许还能有机会找到一些幸存者。
69e725bb8f17e26d49006cd7.textEn: I managed to get onto the ship and ran into the Rogues. They got here before me and attacked the “Boreas”. But the crew might have barricaded themselves in some compartment, so I still have a chance to find at least some survivors.

69e725c5600f351cd1017c0d.textCh:
游荡者残忍地杀害了大部分船员，但还有一名科学家在自己的实验室舱段里奇迹般活了下来。据他所说，在游荡者突袭破冰船期间，有人启动了防御协议，直接把船上大部分上层舱室封了起来。那些游荡者连第一层都没能突入。

虽然这家伙并不信任我，但他答应，只要我带船长来，他就愿意帮我。突袭期间船长就在舰桥上，应该就是他启动了防御协议。

要想继续向上，我必须穿过船尾部附近的机舱。但在进到轮机舱里面之前，我需要从工程师那里拿到对应的钥匙卡。那个科学家说工程师可能会在下层甲板的医疗舱室里。
69e725c5600f351cd1017c0d.textEn:
The Rogues wiped out most of the crew, but one scientist survived in the laboratory section. He explained that a special defense protocol was triggered during the assault, sealing off sections of the icebreaker. The Rogues never made it past the first levels.

He doesn’t really trust me, but he agreed to help me navigate the ship if I bring him the ship’s captain. During the assault, the captain was on the bridge and activated the security protocol.

To move further up, I’ll need to pass through the engine room closer to the stern of the icebreaker. And to get there, I need an engineer keycard. The scientist said it might still be somewhere on the lower floors.

69e725cf05e03ae28801ebb7.textCh:
我进到了轮机舱里面，现在该想办法向上爬，沿着轮机舱顶部向着上层建筑出发。轮机舱顶应该有一扇没完全修好的门，那个科学家说我可以想办法把它破开。

我好像听到外面有什么机械的动静。最好保持警惕。
69e725cf05e03ae28801ebb7.textEn:
I made it through to the engine room. Next, I need to reach the roof and move across it back toward the superstructure. There should be a door up there that wasn’t fully repaired. The scientist said I can try to break it open or hack it.

I also think I heard vehicles outside. Better stay on guard.

69e725ef95e1c3facb0cac92.textCh: 我找到了工程师手里的轮机舱钥匙卡，现在可以打开轮机舱的大门了。
69e725ef95e1c3facb0cac92.textEn: I found the engineer keycard. Now I can open the door to the engine room.

69e72a56600f351cd1017c11.textCh: 我找到了科学家提到的那扇门。看来船员们是用铁链把它锁住了，以免内部的风压把它吹开。如果不用点爆破手段的话就没法弄断那条铁链，所以我得回塔科夫，看看能不能搞到比手榴弹更劲爆的玩意来。
69e72a56600f351cd1017c11.textEn: I found the damaged door the scientist mentioned. It looks like the crew chained it shut to keep it from swinging open due to wind pressure inside. I won’t be able to break that chain without explosives, so I’ll have to head back to the city and find something stronger than grenades.

69e72ab8e7fd14ccad0a5776.textCh: Mechanic 提到了 Prapor 手里可能有聚能炸药。用来破开船上的门应该是足够了。
69e72ab8e7fd14ccad0a5776.textEn: Mechanic mentioned Prapor might have shaped charges. They should be enough to breach the locked door on the icebreaker.

69e72b86476f4eebe506c408.textCh:
现在可以从 Prapor 那里弄来聚能炸药了，有了这东西，就能一路突入破冰船的上层建筑。

我必须穿过轮机舱，抵达直升机停机坪，然后沿着轮机舱顶横穿回去，回到上层建筑，找到那扇受损的门。接着就该让 SZ-1 炸药派上用场了。
69e72b86476f4eebe506c408.textEn:
Prapor can now supply me with shaped charges. They should let me force my way into the icebreaker’s superstructure.

I’ll need to pass through the engine room to reach the helipad, then move across the roof back to the superstructure and locate the weakened door. That’s where the SZ-1 charge will be useful.

69e72bff8541f9e4fb0511c2.textCh: 炸药的效果简直是立竿见影。我现在能进入破冰船上层建筑的中间层甲板，看看这里都有些什么了。
69e72bff8541f9e4fb0511c2.textEn: The charge worked. Now I can access the mid-levels of the icebreaker’s superstructure and explore them.

69e72c1d2517f242e00afcb4.textCh: 中间层甲板看样子是船员的生活区，说不定能找到哪个水手留下的日志，或者 Boreas 号的航线记录。
69e72c1d2517f242e00afcb4.textEn: The mid-levels of the superstructure seem to have been the crew’s living area. There could still be useful information about the sailors’ daily life or the “Boreas” routes.

69e72c5f00f28920ee05ae59.textCh: 上层舱段用密码锁锁上了。那个科学家可能知道密码组合，帮我通过那扇门，必须得回去找他。
69e72c5f00f28920ee05ae59.textEn: The upper sections are secured with a code lock. The surviving scientist could know the combination and help me access it. I need to return to him.

69e72c7805e03ae28801ebbb.textCh:
虽然科学家愿意帮忙，但他也只知道密码的上半部分：312。至于下半部分则是邻近 TerraGroup 分部的区域代码，所以我必须得回塔科夫市区才能找到答案了。

不过，与其大海捞针，不如先去找 Mechanic 问问。
69e72c7805e03ae28801ebbb.textEn:
The scientist is willing to help, but he only knows part of the code: 312. The remaining part is the regional code of a nearby TerraGroup division, so I’ll need to track it down somewhere in Tarkov.

Still, it’s probably smarter to check with Mechanic first.

69e73e9813e503e2980bffed.textCh:
Mechanic 说，TerraGroup 实验室的数据库里肯定有我要的那个集团分部区域代码。

为了想办法把代码提取出来，我得先去实验室机房里探路，替 Mechanic 建立远程连接才行。
69e73e9813e503e2980bffed.textEn:
Mechanic said the regional unit code should definitely be stored somewhere in TerraGroup’s laboratory database.

To extract it, I need to provide remote access to the lab’s server room, then return to Mechanic.

69e74865cfe98fa9e306dea3.textCh:
Mechanic 给了我破冰船密码的下半部分：220.

现在我可以回到船上，想办法进入上层甲板了。上面应该有路能进到舰桥里，希望船长还在那个地方。
69e74865cfe98fa9e306dea3.textEn:
Mechanic gave me the second part of the code for the locked door on the icebreaker: 220.

Now I can return to the ship and access the upper levels. Somewhere up there should also be the passage to the bridge, where the captain is still located.

69e749a6ff2e56ff7104fd0c.textCh: 密码果然有用，门开了。看样子即使是 Boreas 号自己的普通船员也被禁止进入第 6 层和第 7 层，我必须仔细搜索这两层甲板，看看这里都藏着什么秘密。
69e749a6ff2e56ff7104fd0c.textEn: The code unlocked the door. It seems levels 6 and 7 of the superstructure held cargo that was off-limits even to the “Boreas” crew. I need to thoroughly examine both decks.

69e749d7f16c63e3340c4505.textCh: 我想办法进入了上锁的 C-1 舱室。这里应该就是 TerraGroup 藏匿各种数据和电子设备的场所了，整个舱室对船员都秘而不宣。我必须得仔细搜索每个地方。
69e749d7f16c63e3340c4505.textEn: I managed to get into sealed compartment C-1. This should be where all the data and electronics TerraGroup kept hidden even from the ship’s crew are stored. I need to search everything here.

69e749e48ae14d795f09d2a4.textCh: 船长随身带着的钥匙卡上标有 C-1 字样。应该能打开第 7 层甲板的那座“数据库”。
69e749e48ae14d795f09d2a4.textEn: The captain had a keycard marked C-1 on him. It should open the “archive” on the 7th floor of the superstructure.

69e74a02ff2e56ff7104fd0f.textCh: 我找到了舰桥的入口，但门从里面锁住了。我必须想办法，或者找其他的路进去。
69e74a02ff2e56ff7104fd0f.textEn: I found the bridge entrance, but it’s locked from the inside. I need another way in.

69e74a40f16c63e3340c450b.textCh: 头顶有一扇舱盖能通往舰桥，但被冻得死死的。必须想办法把冰给化开才行。
69e74a40f16c63e3340c450b.textEn: There’s a roof hatch that leads to the bridge, but it’s frozen solid. I need to find a way to unfreeze it.

69e74b549859bba34401178c.textCh: 现在我可以下到舰桥里，和这艘船的船长见面了。
69e74b549859bba34401178c.textEn: Now I can get down to the bridge and finally see the ship’s captain.

69e74be2f16c63e3340c4570.textCh:
看样子那帮穿黑衣服的佣兵坐着直升机快速突入的时候就已经把舰桥给打了个稀巴烂。那个科学家肯定又要发牢骚，但至少我应该试着找到 C-1 舱室的钥匙卡。

我还得把这里发生的事情都告诉那个科学家，必须信守承诺，没了他的帮助我是寸步难行。
69e74be2f16c63e3340c4570.textEn:
It looks like the bridge was shot up during the landing by those black uniform high-speed guys brought in on a helicopter. The scientist is not going to be happy about this. But I can still try to find the C-1 compartment keycard.

I should also report back to the scientist. I wouldn’t have gotten this far without him.

69e74e131c3cd3b2e0004f8a.textCh:
Mechanic 成功破解了 Boreas 号上的闪存盘，虽然还只是第一块。里面记录着 TerraGroup 地区总部的丑闻曝光之后，USEC 部队大规模进驻塔科夫的行动报告

一艘油轮在外海制造了漏油行动，吸引了所有人的眼球。与此同时两艘集装箱船上大约 1500 人规模的部队，连同他们的装备，成功在短时间内快速投送到了塔科夫外围。记录显示，Knight 和他的手下早在那会儿还听从指挥，甚至是第一批被部署到城市里参加战斗任务的先头部队。

而登陆行动的每个阶段都由所谓的“驻灯塔线人”协调……也就是说早在一切开始的时候，他就已经成为了这一切的核心人物。

剩下的闪存盘里装着的情报也许还装着同样宝贵的情报。为了加快破解速度，Mechanic 让我从那艘破冰船上回收服务器内存模块，说是比常规的消费级内存条更有用。
69e74e131c3cd3b2e0004f8a.textEn:
Mechanic only managed to crack the first disk from the “Boreas”. It contained reports on the main USEC insertion into Tarkov right after the TerraGroup office scandal.

A fake oil tanker emergency was used to pull coastal forces away, while roughly 1,500 troops were moved off two container ships in a short time. Knight and his men were still under their command structure at the time and were among the first deployed into the city with serious combat tasks.

And coordinating each stage of the landing was a “special agent on the Lighthouse”… He had been part of the operation from the very beginning.

The remaining hard drives could contain equally valuable data. To speed up decryption, Mechanic asked me to retrieve server RAM from the icebreaker, saying those modules are far more powerful than standard ones.

69e74ec21c3cd3b2e0004f94.textCh:
第二块闪存盘里装载着某种保护程序，把大部分数据都抹掉了。不过 Mechanic 多少还是恢复了一些东西出来。

在塔科夫上演的一系列冲突不仅仅是一连串的巧合那么简单，而是一场精心策划的挑衅，所有的一切都是更大规模灾难的预演——或者按照集团的说法，是为了测试一项未知协议。

这项协议的最终目标是扰乱国际航运，破坏各个大陆之间的经济纽带，通过在精心选择的地区陷入混乱境地，从而瓦解世界秩序。塔科夫的灾难只是一场测试，是集团血腥阴谋的试验场……Mechanic 提供的数据里，下一步集团将会针对多个目标下手，而其中两个不难辨认：东京和开罗。

所以塔科夫发生的一切只是仅仅是更大事件的开端，这场灾难将裹挟全球，最终只有 TerraGroup能从中获益。也许还有在集团之上、真正操纵着这一切的幕后黑手……

为了破解第三块闪存盘里的数据，Mechanic 想让我替他弄到某种加密处理器。看样子我又得回到那艘破冰船上了。
69e74ec21c3cd3b2e0004f94.textEn:
The second drive had some advanced protection system that wiped most of the data. But Mechanic managed to recover what he could.

The Tarkov conflict turns out to be not just a chain of coincidences, but a carefully staged provocation designed to test an unknown protocol.

The goal of this protocol is to disrupt international logistics and economic ties, plunging selected regions into chaos. Tarkov was only the first test run, a proving ground… Mechanic managed to identify at least two next targets: Cairo and Tokyo.

So everything happening here is just the beginning of something much bigger, a global-scale disaster, with TerraGroup interests positioned to benefit at the top. Or maybe there’s someone even higher behind them…

In exchange for the data from the third drive, Mechanic asked for crypto processors. Looks like I’ll have to head back to the icebreaker once again.

69e74f323382dff9650079fe.textCh:
从破冰船上回收的服务器内存的确大大加快了破解速度，最后一块闪存盘里记录了一个覆盖全球的卫星通讯网络，不仅有着几乎垄断的地位，更恐怖的是，它已经完成组网，而世界各国对此还一无所知。

Mechanic 对这个结果相当悲观。据他所说，有了这样恐怖的监视网络，无论是 TerraGroup，还是他们背后的势力，基本上掌握了统治信息空间的究极利器。《1984》将在网络时代再次成为现实。

在这套系统的帮助下，集团能够干扰卫星网络覆盖范围内所有的通信往来，截获政府机构的信号，甚至伪造这些信号来发号施令。就好像他们制造混乱的招数还不够多似的。

最重要的是，所有人对此还一无所知，无论是谁将塔科夫拖入了毁灭的渊薮，此时此刻，这个覆盖全球的卫星网络依然是他们手中最致命的一张王牌。
69e74f323382dff9650079fe.textEn:
The RAM from the icebreaker helped decrypt the final drive. It contained data about a completed secret satellite network, one with no known equivalent worldwide.

Mechanic didn’t like this find at all. He said that with a network like this, TerraGroup, or whoever is behind them, would have an ultimate tool for controlling the information space.

With it, they could jam communications in entire zones, intercept signals even from government agencies, and forge them. As if they didn’t already have enough ways to cause chaos.

The most important part is that nobody still knows about this network, and it remains an unknown trump card in the hands of those behind the Tarkov catastrophe.

69e74f76a40079f7570ac29b.textCh: Mechanic 把闪存盘里提取出来的数据打包发给我了，也许我该亲眼看看。
69e74f76a40079f7570ac29b.textEn: Mechanic sent me a folder with the data recovered from the hard drives. I should go through it myself.

69e74fb90bb533bd240d63d1.textCh:
在告知科学家船长已经死了之后，他转而向我求助。显然这个科学怪人随身带着致命的生化材料，这些东西，连同他本人，必须尽快撤离那艘该死的船，以免泄露得整个塔科夫到处都是。我不明白为什么这个家伙明明有一整座实验室，却连这种事情都没法处理好……但他偏执地认为自己说的都是真理。

我可以通过 BTR 司机再安排一轮行动，必须立马去办。
69e74fb90bb533bd240d63d1.textEn:
After I told the scientist about the captain’s death, he asked for my help. Apparently, he has hazardous biological materials on him, and they need to be urgently contained along with him to prevent a leak. I don’t fully understand why he can’t handle it in his own lab… but he insists he knows best.

I can try to arrange transport through the BTR driver. Better not delay this.

69e74ff1fdb60760e50f467b.textCh: BTR 司机同意忙帮和走私者谈判，把那个科学家撤出来，当然也包括他的生物材料。虽然走私者可以出动，但我必须预先清理整艘船上的威胁，同时还要为 BTR 司机带来指定的防弹衣和插板保护那名科学家，以及给一整个走私者营救小队配上呼吸面罩。
69e74ff1fdb60760e50f467b.textEn: The BTR driver agreed to help evacuate the scientist along with his biomaterials. The smugglers can extract him, but I need to clear the icebreaker of threats, and also bring the BTR driver body armor with plates for the scientist, as well as respirators for the entire smuggler team.

69e74ffc2f47c647910f0340.textCh: 清理完之后，破冰船上应该没有什么能威胁到那些走私者了。
69e74ffc2f47c647910f0340.textEn: With this done, the icebreaker no longer has any serious opposition to the smugglers.

69e7560fc4be50a6a50ab144.textCh: 我给 BTR 司机弄到了他要的装备。他说撤离行动的事情已经和走私者们商量好了，现在我只需要告诉科学家接头暗号就行：那些走私的会报出口令“Yolka”，回令是“Gendarme”。
69e7560fc4be50a6a50ab144.textEn: I delivered everything the BTR driver asked for. He said he already arranged evacuation with the smugglers, and now I just need to pass the code words to the scientist. The password is “Yolka”, and the scientist should respond with “Gendarme”.

69e7564dbe63aac5300d5b59.textCh: 我把撤离行动需要知道的事情都告诉那个科学狂人了，之后只需要去找 BTR 司机询问进展就行。
69e7564dbe63aac5300d5b59.textEn: I passed the scientist everything he needed to know before evacuation. Now I need to check in with the BTR driver and see how it went.

69e75709c61052cfe6060d18.textCh:
BTR 司机告诉我，事情全都乱了套。营救小队打开实验室舱门后，那个科学家和疯了一样先是袭击了走私者小队的人，然后不知道逃到哪里去了。小队没追上他，但还是把这家伙的钥匙卡给带回来了。

看样子那个科学家是彻底崩溃了。但至少我现在有了 Boreas 号的全套钥匙卡，能进到里面去看看了。

我最好自己上船去一探究竟，还是别拉上其他人一起冒险了。天知道这个疯子的实验室里都有什么危险化合物。
69e75709c61052cfe6060d18.textEn:
The BTR driver said it all went sideways. Once they opened the lab compartment, the scientist attacked the smugglers and managed to escape deeper into the icebreaker. They didn’t pursue him, but they recovered the lab keycard.

Seems like the scientist snapped completely. Still, I’ve got the “Boreas” lab keycard now, so I should take a look inside.

I better open the lab alone and not risk anyone else. No idea what kind of chemicals that guy was working with.

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：停！安全检查！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Stop! Security check!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：你以为这是什么地方，全副武装就想往里闯？
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Where do you think you’re heading all geared up like that?

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：装备不许带过检查站。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: No gear past this checkpoint.

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：放轻松！这些东西你进了门就用不到了。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Relax! You won’t need that on the other side.

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：他身上有违禁品！
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: He’s got contraband!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：这箱子必须被送去进行特别检查。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: The case goes to special inspection.

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：好了，走吧。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Alright, move it.

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：跟紧了，我说什么你就照办，想活着回家就不要耍花样。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Stay close, follow my instructions precisely, unless you wanna end up in a body bag.

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：你们得排队，等轮到你们了再撤离。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: You’ll have to wait your turn for evac.

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：那里应该还有点水，你们自己弄点喝吧。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: I think we’ve got some water over there, so you'll manage.

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：看什么看！
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: Eyes off!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：要是再犯事——你就给我滚到警戒线外面去吧！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: One more violation — and you’ll end up outside the gate again!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：这里可是管制区域，别多管闲事！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: This is a restricted area under martial law. Keep your nose out!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：我们现在要进去了。眼睛往前看，别东张西望，不准多问。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: We’re going inside now. Eyes forward, don’t ask questions.

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：按照指示来，不准有半点差池。不然的话就别怪我们不客气。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Follow the instructions to the letter. Otherwise we won’t go easy on you.

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：好了，我们到了，在这别动。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Alright, that’s your stop. Stay here.

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：放松，你会没事的。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Relax, you’ll be fine.

subtitles.textCh: 无线电：确认！我再次确认，基地正在遭到攻击！ 宪兵军官：快跑，动起来！
subtitles.textEn: Radio: Confirmed! I confirm, the base is under attack! MP Officer: Move! Move!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：防线外有动静！多个目标！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Movement outside the perimeter! Multiple!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：帕沙倒了！ 宪兵军官：坚守阵地！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Pasha's down! MP Officer: Hold your positions!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：火力压制他们！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Suppressive fire!

subtitles.textCh: Scav：快散开！
subtitles.textEn: Scav: Spread out!

subtitles.textCh: Scav：给他们点颜色瞧瞧！ Scav：我们上！
subtitles.textEn: Scav: Time to kick some ass! Scav: Let’s roll!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：他们正在向中心方向推进！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: They're pushing through the center!

subtitles.textCh: Scav：贱人，尝尝你大爷这招！
subtitles.textEn: Scav: Eat this, bitch!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：我中弹了！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: I'm hit!

subtitles.textCh: 你的通行证已通过识别，前往安检处。
subtitles.textEn: Your pass has been identified. Proceed to the security check.

subtitles.textCh: 未能识别通行证，请重新尝试。
subtitles.textEn: Your pass was not recognized. Try again.

subtitles.textCh: 你到的太早了，撤离安排在晚上开始。
subtitles.textEn: You're too early. The evac's at night.

subtitles.textCh: 没错，我们确实收到消息有你这号人。过来吧。
subtitles.textEn: Yeah, we were told about you. Go on through.

subtitles.textCh: 拿出你的通行证。
subtitles.textEn: Present your pass.

subtitles.textCh: 我们不接待组团的。
subtitles.textEn: We don't take organized groups.

subtitles.textCh: 自从诺文斯克变为开放经济特区以来，整个地区的面貌就此发生了巨变。
subtitles.textEn: The Norvinsk region has forever changed the moment it was turned into an open economic zone.

subtitles.textCh: 诺文斯克地区以及塔科夫市迅速成为了国际贸易的中心。
subtitles.textEn: Both Norvinsk and Tarkov became centers of international partnership.

subtitles.textCh: 全球市场最具影响力的巨头之一——TerraGroup 也在塔科夫设立了地区总部。
subtitles.textEn: One of the most influential corporations on the global stage, TerraGroup, has established its regional headquarters in Tarkov.

subtitles.textCh: TerraGroup 的科学团队承诺：集团将引领我们的世界走向未来……
subtitles.textEn: TerraGroup’s scientists promised to bring our world towards the future...

subtitles.textCh: 即便在那时，旧世界正在走向消亡也已经是不争的事实。
subtitles.textEn: Even back then it was obvious the old world was on its way out.

subtitles.textCh: 在塔科夫，集团通过各种手段积极扩张：占据土地，兼并当地的公司产业
subtitles.textEn: In Tarkov, the corporation was actively acquiring land and absorbed local businesses

subtitles.textCh: 这一切都将由集团“革命性的创新项目”实现。
subtitles.textEn: for the sake of its "revolutionary projects".

subtitles.textCh: “Virtus in scientia”(拉丁语：科学彰显美德)……
subtitles.textEn: "Virtus in scientia".

subtitles.textCh: 呵……他们之前可是常把这套说辞挂在嘴边。
subtitles.textEn: Heh, that's what they used to say.

subtitles.textCh: TerraGroup 在城市内的影响迅速扩大。
subtitles.textEn: TerraGroup's influence in the city grew rapidly.

subtitles.textCh: 不久之后，他们便露出了獠牙，毫不掩饰地对关键政府部门展现出了兴趣。
subtitles.textEn: It wasn’t long before they started showing interest in restricted government facilities.

subtitles.textCh: 这样的举动自然不会逃过俄国安全部门的监视。
subtitles.textEn: A move that couldn’t go unnoticed by domestic security agencies.

subtitles.textCh: 为了保护集团的机密免受他人窥视，TerraGroup 雇佣了国外 PMC——联合安保 USEC。
subtitles.textEn: In order to protect their enterprises, TerraGroup hired a foreign PMC – United Security.

subtitles.textCh: USEC 部队开始封锁各个 TerraGroup 设施，
subtitles.textEn: USEC personnel began blocking access to TerraGroup's facilities,

subtitles.textCh: 塔科夫简直成了特区内的国中之国，就算是政府当局也难以掌握公司开展计划的全貌。
subtitles.textEn: and even the government authorities no longer had a full picture of what the corporation was doing within Tarkov’s borders.

subtitles.textCh: 最终，当局向集团在当地的总部派出了调查人员前去彻底搜查总部大楼，要求将一切如实报告。
subtitles.textEn: Eventually, a team of investigators was sent to the local headquarters to search the building and compile a report.

subtitles.textCh: 但那些 USEC 行动人员拒绝让俄国司法官员进入……还悍然开火。
subtitles.textEn: But the USEC operatives refused to let the law officials through... and opened fire.

subtitles.textCh: 在那次重大事故后，一股全新的势力出现在诺文斯克特区——BEAR PMC。
subtitles.textEn: After that incident, a new force appeared in the Norvinsk region – PMC BEAR.

subtitles.textCh: 他们的主要任务是在全球范围内搜集 TerraGroup 非法行动的罪证，并将其公之于众。
subtitles.textEn: Their main mission was to expose and gather evidence of TerraGroup’s illegal activities around the world.

subtitles.textCh: 最初，BEAR 在当地展开的行动相对有限，只在极少数情况下会与 USEC 部队发生冲突，
subtitles.textEn: At first, BEAR’s operations and their clashes with USEC forces were limited and isolated,

subtitles.textCh: 但紧张局势很快就一发不可收拾。
subtitles.textEn: but the tension escalated quickly.

subtitles.textCh: 倘若直接动用正规军接管维持秩序未免太过冒险了，
subtitles.textEn: It was too risky to fully involve military forces to maintain order

subtitles.textCh: 这是诺文斯克地区的特殊现状导致的。
subtitles.textEn: due to the region's special status.

subtitles.textCh: UN 联合部队与俄罗斯正规军封锁了出入城市的所有道路，
subtitles.textEn: The UN forces and Russian military blocked all routes in and out of the city,

subtitles.textCh: 联合国向塔科夫派遣的 UNTAR 部队受命开始疏散当地的平民。
subtitles.textEn: and the UNTAR mission began evacuating civilians.

subtitles.textCh: 尽管当局仍然试图粉饰太平，塔科夫境内的局势已经完全脱离了任何一方的掌控。
subtitles.textEn: But despite the authorities' statements, the situation in Tarkov was no longer under anyone’s control.

subtitles.textCh: BEAR 与 USEC 之间的冲突很快演变成为全面武装对抗。
subtitles.textEn: The conflict between BEAR and USEC evolved into an all-out armed conflict.

subtitles.textCh: 那些被称作 Scav 的强盗与匪徒，更是让局势进一步恶化。
subtitles.textEn: Marauders and bandits, soon nicknamed Scavs, only made things worse.

subtitles.textCh: 双方 PMC 队伍彼此交战长达数年之久，
subtitles.textEn: For several years, both PMCs fought each other,

subtitles.textCh: 每一方都领受不同的命令各自为战。
subtitles.textEn: each carrying out orders from their respective command.

subtitles.textCh: 在此之前，塔科夫曾是登上全球经济新闻的上的冉冉新星。
subtitles.textEn: Before all this, Tarkov was featured in the world’s top financial news.

subtitles.textCh: 而现在，他们也出现在了契约战争的交战记录中。
subtitles.textEn: And now, it shows up in the combat logs of the Contract Wars.

subtitles.textCh: 但这一切并没有就此画上句号。
subtitles.textEn: But it didn't end there.

subtitles.textCh: TerraGroup 在当地的总部大楼成为了 BEAR 的首要目标，承受了多次攻势。
subtitles.textEn: TerraGroup's local headquarters became BEAR’s primary objective, withstanding multiple assault attempts.

subtitles.textCh: 但就在其中一次战斗中，意想不到的事情发生了——
subtitles.textEn: But during one of those raids, something happened –

subtitles.textCh: 以此为分水岭，塔科夫的历史彻底分为了两半:
subtitles.textEn: an event that split Tarkov’s history

subtitles.textCh: 此前的短暂繁荣……
subtitles.textEn: into the before...

subtitles.textCh: 以及之后的混乱。
subtitles.textEn: and after.

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：停！安全检查！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Stop! Security check!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：你以为这是什么地方，全副武装就想往里闯？
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Where do you think you’re heading all geared up like that?

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：装备不许带过检查站。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: No gear past this checkpoint.

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：放轻松！这些东西你进了门就用不到了。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Relax! You won’t need that on the other side.

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：现在没问题了！
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: He’s clear!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：好了，走吧。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Alright, move it.

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：跟紧了，我说什么你就照办，想活着回家就不要耍花样。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Stay close, follow my instructions precisely, unless you wanna end up in a body bag.

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：你们得排队，等轮到你们了再撤离。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: You’ll have to wait your turn for evac.

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：那里应该还有点水，你们自己弄点喝吧。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: I think we’ve got some water over there, so you'll manage.

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：不准东张西望！
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: Eyes off!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：要是再犯事——你就给我滚到警戒线外面去吧！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: One more violation — and you’ll end up outside the gate again!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：这里可是管制区域，别多管闲事！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: This is a restricted area under martial law. Keep your nose out!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：我们现在要进去了。眼睛往前看，别东张西望，不准多问。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: We’re going inside now. Eyes forward, don’t ask questions.

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：按照指示来，不准有半点差池。不然的话就别怪我们不客气。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Follow the instructions to the letter. Otherwise we won’t go easy on you.

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：好了，我们到了，在这别动。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Alright, that’s your stop. Stay here.

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：放松，你会没事的。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Relax, you’ll be fine.

subtitles.textCh: 对讲机：你的通行证已通过识别，前往安检处。
subtitles.textEn: Intercom: Your pass has been identified. Proceed to the security check.

subtitles.textCh: 对讲机：未能识别通行证，请重新尝试。
subtitles.textEn: Intercom: Your pass was not recognized. Try again.

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：识相点就掉头回去，不然我们就要开枪了！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Turn around and fuck off unless you wanna get shot!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：这里是军管区域，无关人等不得入内！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: This is a restricted area! No trespassers!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：你他妈到底是谁？我们可没有你这种废物，快滚！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Who the hell are you? We don't know you. Get lost!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：这里是军管区域，马上给我滚！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: This is a restricted zone. Get the fuck outta here!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：怎么还有小队来这撤离？组队的不准进！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: You guys come in a pack deal? No groups allowed in!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：一次只能过一个人！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: One person at a time!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：我们不接待组团的！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: We don't take in organized groups!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：抱团的不准进！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: No groups allowed!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：哦，是你啊！行吧，既然他们说你能进来，那就走吧。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Ah, it’s you? Alright, they said you’re cleared, so go on through.

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：我们会让你过去的，很快就好了。
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: We’ll let you through. Don't take too long.

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：愣在原地干什么……快走啊！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Go on through! Don’t just stand there — move it!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：我们知道你要来。进来，快点！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: We were told about you. Inside, now!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：快滚，你这杂碎！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Get lost, punk!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：空手就想往里闯？赶快滚蛋，不然我们就要上手段了！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Showing up empty-handed? Beat it before we ice you!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：别挥你那破钥匙卡了！这塑料片要是有用，你第一次试就该知道了。现在快滚！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Quit swinging your keycard! If it didn't work the first time it won't now. Get lost!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：别他妈再晃读卡器了！哪儿来的回哪去！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Stop fucking jerking the reader! Go away!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：趁小命还在赶快给我滚，不然我们就要开枪了！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Get outta here, or we'll start shooting!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：你在这晃荡什么？没人能在现在这时候过去！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: What are you doing here? No one gets through at this time!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：你以为这是你家，想来就来想走就走？滚你的蛋！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: You think we let anyone in whenever they want? Scram!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：别他妈四处探头探脑了！时间不对，滚吧！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Quit poking around! You came at the wrong time. Get lost!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：这可不是你能乱来的地方！只有指定时间才会开放！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: This isn’t a walk-in! Entry is only allowed at specific times!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：我看到有动静！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: I see movement!

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：这边！快过来！我们要出发了！
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: Over here! This way! We are leaving!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：他在那里！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: There he is!

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：看样子总算安静下来了，如果你愿意的话就在外边等着吧。
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: Looks like it’s quieted down. You can wait outside if you want.

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：谁知道下一回再看到塔科夫又是什么时候呢？我们一分钟后就离港了。
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: Who knows when you’ll see Tarkov again. We’re leaving in one minute.

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：开船后就赶快进到船舱里来，不准在船上闲逛！
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: After that, head into the compartment, no roaming around the ship!

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：嘿！快起来！
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: Hey! Get up!

subtitles.textCh: 宪兵军官：敌机来袭！
subtitles.textEn: MP Officer: Incoming!

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：这边！快过来！我们要出发了！
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: Over here! This way! We are leaving!

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：有人在等着你，是 TerraGroup 的那些混蛋。
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: Someone’s waiting for you. Some fuck from TerraGroup.

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：有话快讲，码头方向随时可能会有人向船上开火。
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: Keep it quick, we could take fire from the port.

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：他过来了。
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: He's over there.

subtitles.textCh: TerraGroup 科学家：所以，你确实做到了，为自己赢得了逃出塔科夫的门票。
subtitles.textEn: TerraGroup Scientist: So, you made it. Managed to secure yourself a way out of Tarkov.

subtitles.textCh: TerraGroup 科学家：我没搞清楚的是，为什么你不愿意帮 Kerman 深挖我们的秘密。
subtitles.textEn: TerraGroup Scientist: What I fail to see is why you refused to help Kerman recover our secrets.

subtitles.textCh: TerraGroup 科学家：什么人他都有办法救出来。
subtitles.textEn: TerraGroup Scientist: He’s always had the means to extract whoever he wanted.

subtitles.textCh: TerraGroup 科学家：不过这已经无关紧要了。
subtitles.textEn: TerraGroup Scientist: Not that it matters anymore.

subtitles.textCh: TerraGroup 科学家：多亏了你，那些文件被永远埋藏在了城市的废墟之下。
subtitles.textEn: TerraGroup Scientist: Thanks to you, the documents remain buried in the city.

subtitles.textCh: TerraGroup 科学家：现在，不会再有人发现它们了。
subtitles.textEn: TerraGroup Scientist: Now, no one will ever find it.

subtitles.textCh: TerraGroup 科学家：不过，你肯定也明白，作为知情者，你的存在同样让我们感到困扰。
subtitles.textEn: TerraGroup Scientist: But surely you understand that your knowledge alone makes this problematic.

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：你到底还上不上船？
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: You coming or what?

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：该离开这了！
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: Time to get out of here!

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：怎么？你还好吗？
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: So? You good?

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：那就进来吧，要是待在外面，谁知会被哪颗不长眼的流弹给打中了呢。都撑到这里了，要是出了意外就太可惜了。
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: Then get inside, you could catch a stray bullet out here. It’d be a shame if after all this you got killed.

subtitles.textCh: 特工：有人在吗？
subtitles.textEn: Operative: Anyone there?

subtitles.textCh: 特工：我来自灯塔，和你一样。
subtitles.textEn: Operative: I'm from the Lighthouse, same as you.

subtitles.textCh: 特工：没受伤吧？很好。
subtitles.textEn: Operative: No injuries? Good.

subtitles.textCh: 特工：野牛登陆艇在 3 分钟内会被清空，港口和城市都会被摧毁，空中打击预计在 8 分钟后到达。
subtitles.textEn: Operative: In three minutes the Zubr will be cleared out. The port and city will be destroyed. Air ETA eight minutes.

subtitles.textCh: 特工：就知道能派上用场……
subtitles.textEn: Operative: Knew it'd be useful…

subtitles.textCh: 特工：没空在你身上浪费时间了，Lightkeeper 的指示都在信封里。
subtitles.textEn: Operative: No time to deal with you. Lightkeeper’s instructions are in the envelope.

subtitles.textCh: 特工：准备转运。
subtitles.textEn: Operative: Ready for transport.

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：你到底上不上船？
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: You coming or what?

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：该离开这了！
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: Time to get out of here!

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：身上零件都还在，对吧？
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: All limbs still attached, yeah?

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：还是进船舱里吧，别被码头上射来的流弹给打中了。
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: Better head inside, don't want you catching a stray bullet from the port.

subtitles.textCh: 船长：稍息！他在这吗？
subtitles.textEn: Captain: At ease! Is he here?

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：遵命！
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: Yes, sir!

subtitles.textCh: 船长：把我身后的门给锁上，任何人都不能擅自进出。现在行动！
subtitles.textEn: Captain: Lock up behind me. Let nobody in and nobody out. Do it!

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：是！
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: Aye!

subtitles.textCh: 船长：难道你真的以为，在干下了这一切之后，自己还能逃离塔科夫？
subtitles.textEn: Captain: Did you truly think you could escape Tarkov after everything you did?

subtitles.textCh: 船长：“无名者”就这样放你离开？
subtitles.textEn: Captain: That The Unheard would let you go?

subtitles.textCh: 船长：你根本不明白，如果没有我们，人类早就灭亡了。
subtitles.textEn: Captain: You just don’t get it. If it weren’t for us, humanity would have long since died out.

subtitles.textCh: 船长：必须有人来掌控全局，而无名者正是人类命运的操盘手。
subtitles.textEn: Captain: Someone has to keep them in check, and The Unheard do that.

subtitles.textCh: 船长：如果当初你没有到处嗅探我们的秘密，我们本可以放你一条生路。
subtitles.textEn: Captain: Even you could have survived had you not dug into our secrets.

subtitles.textCh: 船长：为什么要自寻死路？
subtitles.textEn: Captain: Why provoke that?

subtitles.textCh: 船长：你……混蛋……
subtitles.textEn: Captain: You… bastard…

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：没事了，现在船上的都是自己人。
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: Relax. Only friendlies on board now.

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：Kerman 可不想让你搜集来的那些文件被截住，要来抽一根吗？
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: Kerman didn’t want your docs intercepted. Want a smoke?

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：我操！还好我们及时逃出来了！
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: Holy shit! We got out just in time!

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：最重要的是我们还活着，现在轮到那些 TerraGroup 的混蛋们下地狱了！
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: What matters is we're alive, and now we’ll take down those bastards from TerraGroup.

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：整个世界都将知道真相！
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: The whole world will know the truth!

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：对了，拿上这个吧！就当是个纪念品。
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: By the way, take this! A souvenir.

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：那些混蛋把我们当作牲口一样驱使……想骑在我们头上……
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: Those fucks treat us like cattle… want to control us…

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：去他们的吧！
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: Yeah well fuck them!

subtitles.textCh: 士兵：从现在开始，命运将由我们自己把握。
subtitles.textEn: Soldier: From here on, we decide our own fate.

subtitles.textCh: 扬声器：敌人已经突破到了装卸区！撤离行动将在 3 分钟后结束！
subtitles.textEn: Loudspeaker: The enemy has broken through to the loading zone! Evacuation will end in 3 minutes!

subtitles.textCh: 广播系统： 设施已切换至应急供电。请就地等待疏散！
subtitles.textEn: Announcement System: The facility has been switched to emergency power. Please remain where you are and await evacuation.

subtitles.textCh: 广播系统： 检测到电力系统故障。所有人员必须在原地等待，直至后续指示下达！
subtitles.textEn: Announcement System: A power system failure has been detected. All personnel must remain at their current locations until further instructions.

subtitles.textCh: 广播系统： 应急供电已经启动。所有人员必须立即停下工作，等待疏散队伍抵达。
subtitles.textEn: Announcement System: Emergency power has been activated. All personnel must suspend work immediately and await the arrival of the evacuation team.

subtitles.textCh: 广播系统： 检测到严重设施故障，你们都没命了！我们真的要播这一条吗？
subtitles.textEn: Announcement System: A critical facility failure has been detected, and you will all die! Are we actually using this one?

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 啊，朋友们！外头还有谁？迪米特里·谢尔盖耶维奇，快请进，顺便把门关上吧，谢谢你。 所有部门的人都来了吗？我看应该是到齐了。那我们就开始吧。
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: Friends! Who’s still out there? Dmitry Sergeevich, come in and close the door, please. Thank you. Are all departments represented? I see they are. Let us begin, then.

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 到现在为止，大家应该注意到了，和外界的通讯从上午开始就处于中断状态，许多部门也开始进行封锁。我本来想说这只是演习，但这一次的情况不一样，是来真的。
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: By now, everyone’s noticed that communications have been down since this morning and many divisions are in lockdown. I’d like to say this is just another drill, but this time it’s very serious.

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 就在今天，我们收到了来自纽约的指示，因此我们现在就在进行疏散。
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: We received an order from New York today. We’re evacuating.

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 同事们，安静下来！我明白你们此时存在很多顾虑，但我们得团结一致，专注于主要情况。我在几个小时前启动了相关协议，专业团队已经在销毁敏感数据和封存现场设备了。
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: Quiet, colleagues! I understand your concern, but we have to stay focused. I initiated the protocol a few hours ago. The specialists are already working on data destruction and sealing the premises.

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 在塔科夫进行的所有项目都将被关闭，包括关联的企业也是一样。从现在开始，和下游企业的接触只能通过……嗯……根纳季·维克托罗维奇，我看不到你，能举手示意一下吗？就是那位，你们有需要可以找他。
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: All projects in Tarkov are being shut down, including affiliated enterprises. From now on, contact with them will be handled only through… hmm… Gennady Viktorovich, I don’t see you, raise your hand, please. There, that’s the man you’ll need.

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 我认为应该没有更多问题了，之前进行的演练并不是白费的……
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: I believe there shouldn’t be any issues. Those drills we ran weren’t for nothing…

subtitles.textCh: 听众提问: 我手里有一半的样本都没跑完呢，你们会怎么处置它们？
subtitles.textEn: Question from the audience: Half of my samples aren’t ready yet. What’s going to happen to them?

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 彼得·阿列克谢耶维奇，请先不要提问……
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: Pyotr Alekseevich, please, hold your questions…

subtitles.textCh: 听众提问: 不好意思，那些大型设备怎么办？
subtitles.textEn: Question from the audience: Excuse me, what about the large equipment?

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 离心机早在一个小时之前就拆开打包了！够了！别提问了！你们难道看不出现在每一分钟都很宝贵吗？
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: The centrifuge has already been disassembled, literally an hour ago. Enough! Time is precious right now!

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 你们最后会有提问的机会的，但是现在，让我们关注重点。各部门的重要人物会被护送到疗养院——应该有很多人在休假期间去过那里。
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: You’ll be able to ask your questions at the end, but for now, let’s stay on topic. Key personnel will be evacuated to the Health Resort — many of you have already vacationed there before.

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 那里现在是我们的临时疏散点。后勤保障、护送以及安保任务将会由联合安保公司人员，也就是 USEC PMC 负责。
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: It’s now being used as an interim evacuation site. Logistics, escort, and security are handled by United Security personnel.

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 但要注意！在到达疗养院之后，与 USEC 的合作关系将会立刻终止！
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: But be careful! Our cooperation with them ends immediately after arrival at the Health Resort!

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 在此之后，会有新的承包商联系你们，接手之后的路程。管理层强烈建议各位不要与任何 USEC 人员有私下往来。
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: After that point, a new contractor will make contact, and management strongly advises against approaching USEC operatives.

subtitles.textCh: 邪教受害者：第一卷带子，时间是……现在是下午 2:19。
subtitles.textEn: Cult Victim: Tape #1. Time is… time is 14:09.

subtitles.textCh: 邪教受害者：我的名字是伊戈尔……像这样录音简直像是什么秘密特工一样。
subtitles.textEn: Cult Victim: My name’s Igor. I feel like some secret agent doing this.

subtitles.textCh: 邪教受害者：甚至还是拿录音机录的。但至少那些怪人没法远程黑进磁带，要是换成手机的话……
subtitles.textEn: Cult Victim: I even had to switch to analog recordings. You know, with a tape recorder. At least that way any of those freaks can’t hack it.

subtitles.textCh: 邪教受害者：昨天有人从门下面把一本书塞了进来，书上到处画满了那个瘆人的符号，和城里最近到处冒出来的鬼画符一模一样……简直吓死人了。
subtitles.textEn: Cult Victim: Yesterday someone slipped a book under my door. Creepy as hell, covered in those same symbols that started showing up around the city…

subtitles.textCh: 邪教受害者：一开始我还以为是什么恶作剧，比如，就像那种恶搞电视节目一样，整人然后观察反应什么的，但搞成这样也太……
subtitles.textEn: Cult Victim: At first I thought it was some prank. Like, you know, that old TV show, Naked and Funny. That one sure is an oldie…

subtitles.textCh: 邪教受害者：话说回来，那本书！我花了一整个晚上把它看了一遍。里面全都是……都是一些奇谈怪论，但是看样子他们是认真的。
subtitles.textEn: Cult Victim: Anyway, the book! I read it. Spent the whole evening on it. And it’s full of… of some serious weirdness.

subtitles.textCh: 邪教受害者：并不是我一开始以为的全是胡扯，绝对不是。更像是……我也说不清楚，就像是写这本书的人的确掌握了某种禁忌的知识一样。
subtitles.textEn: Cult Victim: Not nonsense, no. More like… I don’t know, like someone knows things they really shouldn’t know.

subtitles.textCh: 邪教受害者：嗯，我在的 Cobalt 公司的确和 TerraGroup 有联系，在我工作的这几年里，我也掌握了不少消息。
subtitles.textEn: Cult Victim: Well, our Cobalt is connected to TerraGroup, and over the years I’ve learned a few things.

subtitles.textCh: 邪教受害者：所以书里提到的这些“赐福”什么的，听起来简直就是在说 TerraGroup 的项目，当然是不公开的那种。
subtitles.textEn: Cult Victim: So these… these "Gifts" mentioned in the book sound an awful lot like some of TerraGroup’s projects. The secret type.

subtitles.textCh: 邪教受害者：我相当确定这帮人是在试着招募我，想把我拖进他们的……邪教里面。只不过这帮人的门道比“人民圣殿教”之类的东西更细。
subtitles.textEn: Cult Victim: I’m sure they tried to recruit me. Like, into some cult. Only these guys are way more sophisticated than your average Peoples Temple types.

subtitles.textCh: 邪教受害者：他们觉得我能接触到什么“世界之眼”，因此他们需要我。我敢肯定，他们肯定不会就此收手，这一次是塞书，那下一回呢？
subtitles.textEn: Cult Victim: They think I have access to some "Eye of the World". That’s why they need me. And they’re not gonna stop at just sending a book.

subtitles.textCh: 邪教受害者：我必须得跑了。没错……是的，我得就此消失，低调行事，甚至回到布鲁日也得保持警惕。
subtitles.textEn: Cult Victim: I have to run. Yes… yes, I need to disappear. Lay low, maybe even in Bruges.

subtitles.textCh: 邪教受害者：他们一直在监视我，从头到尾都是这样。而我以为那只是我的妄想症作祟。该死，我甚至和医生聊了这个话题！
subtitles.textEn: Cult Victim: They’ve been watching me. This whole time. And I thought it was just paranoia. Even talked about it with my therapist, for fuck’s sake!

subtitles.textCh: 邪教受害者：我早该相信自己的直觉，或许现在就不用丢下一切仓皇逃跑了。我……
subtitles.textEn: Cult Victim: I should’ve trusted my gut. Maybe I wouldn’t have to drop everything and run now. I…

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 我明白大家都有顾虑！就连我自己也没有掌握所有情况，但我相当确定，新的合作伙伴会和 USEC 一样可靠。
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: I understand your concerns! I don’t have all the information myself, but I’m confident that our new partners will be just as reliable as USEC personnel.

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 要知道，TerraGroup 一直把安全放在第一位，撤离这样的重大事项，集团只会委托真正的专业人士来完成。
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: TerraGroup has always prioritized security and will entrust our evacuation only to true professionals.

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 说到撤离行动……在 13 小时 47 分钟内，所有 TerraGroup 设施必须完成疏散。没错，时间很紧，这样的仓促行动还是第头一次，但是我们没有其他选择。
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: Speaking of the evacuation… In 13 hours and 47 minutes, all TerraGroup facilities must be vacated. Yes, this is the first time we’re working under such a rush, but there’s no other way.

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 我已经收到了密码，“Braun”和“Chernigov”都有……同时里斯本也发来了确认消息。所以等到倒计时结束的时候，设施必须要清空，一个人也不能留！
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: I’ve received the codes, "Braun" and "Chernigov" included… Also from Lisbon. So by the time the timer runs out, no one should be left here!

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 不用担心，我会等到最后再撤离。当然，也不是只有我一个人，科尔涅夫，你在吗？
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: I’ll be evacuating last. Well, not just me. Korneev, are you here?

subtitles.textCh: 科尔涅夫: 我在。
subtitles.textEn: Korneev: Yes.

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 很好，等到一切都办妥了，我们就动身前往疗养院。
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: Good. Once everything is sealed, we’ll head to the Health Resort.

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 同事们，我明白你们的感受。一下子叫停所有项目确实很难接受。我们甚至没办法转移微生物部门，只能带上数据和参数结果……
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: I understand, colleagues. It’s hard to realize that all production must be shut down. We won’t be able to take microbiology at all, just the data and parameters…

subtitles.textCh: 听众喊叫: 怎么能就这样把所有东西丢下不管不顾？我们可是花了一整年的时间才把整个实验室建起来啊！
subtitles.textEn: Shout from the audience: How are we supposed to leave all this? We spent a year setting up the lab!

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 加琳娜·彼得罗芙娜，冷静些！等到了新地方，一切都会安排妥当的。
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: Galina Petrovna, calm down! Everything will be fine at the new location.

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 好了，还有一件事，听好了，这很重要！呃，不好意思，我必须得接这个……
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: Alright, one more thing, this is important! Ahem, excuse me, I have to take this…

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 你好？没错，“Schliss 14”……在办了……是的……等等，现在？明白了……给我两分钟，我找个地方。
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: Hello? Yes, "Schliss 14"… Already… Yes… Wait, right now? Understood… Give me two minutes, I’ll find a spot.

subtitles.textCh: A.P.: 朋友们！这个电话非常紧急，我必须得接。非常抱歉，我一会就回来。
subtitles.textEn: A.P.: Friends! It's an extremely urgent call, I need to step away. My apologies. I’ll be back soon.

subtitles.textCh: 邪教受害者：上一盘磁带到头了，没想到磁带这么不经用。好了，我会快点说完的。
subtitles.textEn: Cult Victim: The last tape ran out. I didn’t think it would happen this fast. Alright, I’ll make this quick.

subtitles.textCh: 邪教受害者：无论如何，那些家伙……那些穿着长袍的怪胎……他们一直在监视着我。我刚刚在门上找到了一张纸条。
subtitles.textEn: Cult Victim: Anyway, those guys… those guys in hoods… They’re watching me. I just found a note stuck in my door.

subtitles.textCh: 邪教受害者：这条子就夹在门和门框中间——反正就是这样！上面又写了那些关于“世界之眼”的事情，就在我看字条的时候，那个该死的符号直勾勾地盯着我……那些祭司把我称作是受选者！
subtitles.textEn: Cult Victim: You know, between the door and the frame—whatever! It said something about the "Eye of the World", that I look through it and it looks back at me… The Priests called me the chosen one!

subtitles.textCh: 邪教受害者：我必须得跑了，这段是我去火车站的路上录的。我必须得离开这个鬼地方，不管用什么办法都得逃出去！
subtitles.textEn: Cult Victim: I need to run. I’m recording this on my way to the train station. I have to get out of here, doesn’t matter where or how anymore!

subtitles.textCh: 应答机：您好，您已接通俄罗斯邮政快递服务。所有客服人员目前均在通话中，请在听到提示音后留言。
subtitles.textEn: Answering Machine: Hello, you have reached the Rus Post courier service. All operators are busy right now. Please leave a message after the tone.

subtitles.textCh: 邮差：邮递员奥金佐夫呼叫，工号 22909。
subtitles.textEn: Courier: This is Courier Odintsov. Personal number 22909.

subtitles.textCh: 邮差：我本来要把一单加急快件送到诺文斯克的，但路上都他——堵上了，所以这个件应该要延误了。
subtitles.textEn: Courier: I was supposed to deliver urgent mail to Norvinsk, but the roads are fu- busy, so I’m going to be delayed.

subtitles.textCh: 应答机：您好，您已接通俄罗斯邮政快递服务。所有客服人员目前均在通话中，请在听到提示音后留言。
subtitles.textEn: Answering Machine: Hello, you have reached the Rus Post courier service. All operators are busy right now. Please leave a message after the tone.

subtitles.textCh: 邮差：邮递员奥金佐夫呼叫，工号 22909。
subtitles.textEn: Courier: This is Courier Odintsov. Personal number 22909.

subtitles.textCh: 邮差：这里的情况比我想的还要糟糕，一半的路都被封上了。我不知道今天还能不能离开塔科夫市。
subtitles.textEn: Courier: Things are way worse than I thought. Half the roads are blocked. I have no idea if I’ll make it out of Tarkov today.

subtitles.textCh: 邮差：告诉收件人，如果接到呼叫中心的电话千万别挂掉。
subtitles.textEn: Courier: Let the recipient know not to hang up on the call center.

subtitles.textCh: 应答机：您好，您已接通俄罗斯邮政快递服务。所有客服人员目前均在通话中，请在听到提示音后留言。
subtitles.textEn: Answering Machine: Hello, you have reached the Rus Post courier service. All operators are busy right now. Please leave a message after the tone.

subtitles.textCh: 邮差：他妈的简直是一团糟！他们在路上设了检查站，路过的所有车辆都要拦下来检查，队伍排了好几公里长。
subtitles.textEn: Courier: This is a complete clusterfuck! They're stopping everyone at the checkpoint, the line's already kilometers long.

subtitles.textCh: 邮差：我前面的卡车司机和检查的人吵了起来，结果他们居然掏出枪来把他给毙了！你他妈听得到吗？！
subtitles.textEn: Courier: The truck driver in front of me started arguing with them, and they fucking shot him! Are you fucking hearing this?!

subtitles.textCh: 邮差：流弹打中了我的车！我差点就交代在这儿了！你猜怎么着，一个月就挣这么点，我玩什么命呢。件我不派了，我走也要走回家。
subtitles.textEn: Courier: A stray bullet hit my car! I almost fucking died! You know what, I don't get paid for this. I’m getting outta here on foot to my family.

subtitles.textCh: 邮差：车子我扔在这了，所有的包裹都在车里。我的命比这些傻逼货要紧多了。要是你们派哪个倒霉蛋来找货——记得钥匙……钥匙我压在车轮下面了。
subtitles.textEn: Courier: I’m leaving the car, all the parcels are inside. Life’s more important. If you send someone - the key… the key is under the wheel.

subtitles.textCh: 祭司：世界的新主宰已经降临，流程已经开始了……新世界正在开始成型，而守望者们已经被选出。
subtitles.textEn: Priest: The new masters of the world are already here, and the process has begun… The New World has started to take shape, and the Wardens have already been chosen.

subtitles.textCh: 祭司：应当知道，世界之眼已经注目你很久了，所有的……你的全部所作所为都将镌刻在守望者们从旧世界延续到新世界的共同记忆中。不久之后，这将是尘世间唯一留有价值的的东西了。
subtitles.textEn: Priest: Know that the Eye of the World has been watching you for a long time, and all… all your deeds are imprinted in the memory that the Wardens will carry from the old world into the new. Soon, it will be the only thing of value.

subtitles.textCh: 祭司：我早已知道你会来这里，这一切都已被预见到了。我们一直在等待能为我们服务的盲目者，为降临骑士的现身做好准备。而在你身上……我们能够感受到他。
subtitles.textEn: Priest: I knew you would come here. It was all foretold. We awaited the Blind One who would help us prepare everything for the Riders of the Arrival. And in you… we found him.

subtitles.textCh: 祭司：见证无名者的力量吧，不要等到为时已晚……
subtitles.textEn: Priest: Behold the power of The Unheard before it is too late…

subtitles.textCh: Voevoda: 向“鸟巢”基地的指挥官报告。战斗任务完成后，有人引爆了某种爆炸物。
subtitles.textEn: Voevoda: To the commander of the Gnezdo base. Reporting. After the combat task was completed, someone detonated an explosive.

subtitles.textCh: Voevoda: USEC 行动人员和平民都出现了伤亡。我们有一名队员受了重伤，其余的也都挂了彩。需要支援，我重复，需要支援！
subtitles.textEn: Voevoda: We have casualties among USEC operators and civilians. One of ours is critically wounded, the rest have light injuries. Assistance required. I repeat, assistance required!

subtitles.textCh: Voevoda: 咳……嗯，我从来没写过日记，之前一直觉得这个想法蠢透了。但现在，我感觉有必要记录自己的想法，也许能分享给别人听。
subtitles.textEn: Voevoda: Ahem… I never kept a diary. Thought it was a stupid idea. But now I feel like I should share my thoughts with someone.

subtitles.textCh: Voevoda: Bogatyr 小队遇到了大麻烦。有几个战士牺牲了，其他人也多少受了伤。也许正因如此，我才会觉得这一切并非偶然。
subtitles.textEn: Voevoda: The Bogatyr squad got into a bad mess. Some of my boys are dead, others wounded. Maybe that is why I keep thinking this is not an accident.

subtitles.textCh: Voevoda: 并不是只有这里一团乱。塔科夫骚乱，中东冲突，然后是如影随形的贫穷，饥荒，甚至全球变暖也在加剧……
subtitles.textEn: Voevoda: This is not only happening here. Tarkov, conflicts in the Middle East, hunger, poverty, global warming…

subtitles.textCh: Voevoda: 整个世界都疯了！但你不觉得奇怪吗？一切转变仿佛在转瞬之间。就像是一个男人，前一秒还是个体面、顾家的好人，下一秒突然拔出枪来对着自己的女儿开火。
subtitles.textEn: Voevoda: People seem to be going mad! But strangely, it’s very sudden. A decent family man turns and shoots his little girls.

subtitles.textCh: Voevoda: 这里也是一样。塔科夫曾经是个繁荣的城市，人们纷纷被吸引过来，然后……就像脓包溃烂，脓液倾泻而出一样，一切都被毁了……
subtitles.textEn: Voevoda: It's the same here. Tarkov used to be a prosperous city. People came here on purpose. Then… the sore burst and it spilled out…

subtitles.textCh: Voevoda: 如果这是地球尝试自我净化的努力呢？清除附身在自己身上的那些名为“人类”的病毒？千百年来，人们所做的不过是一昧伤害这座星球，无止境地贪婪索取。说不定，这是我们所有人命中注定的悲惨结局？
subtitles.textEn: Voevoda: What if it’s the Earth itself trying to rid itself of the filth, this humanity virus? People only harm this planet. Maybe this is the end for all of us?

subtitles.textCh: Voevoda: 我不明白，但我经历得越多，就越抑制不住去思考这些东西。通话结束。
subtitles.textEn: Voevoda: I do not know. But those thoughts just keep coming. End transmission.

subtitles.textCh: Moreman: 我希望有人能收到我们的信号。我不清楚我们还能不能活着撤离了，所以还是录了这段录音。
subtitles.textEn: Moreman: I hope this comes through. I don’t know if we’ll make it, so I’m leaving this recording.

subtitles.textCh: Moreman: 就在我们快要靠近撤离集结点的时候，Yastreb 突然发难，直接朝自己人开了枪！
subtitles.textEn: Moreman: When we were getting to the fallback point, Yastreb totally fucking snapped and started shooting at us!

subtitles.textCh: Moreman: 虽然我们马上就把他放倒了，但小队已经陷入了埋伏：那些混蛋从四面八方不断冲上来想要包围我们。真见鬼！我猜一开始……一开始的枪声就是动手的信号，操他妈的。真该死的，王八操的的叛徒……
subtitles.textEn: Moreman: We put him down fast, but we walked into an ambush: shitheads came at us from every direction. Fuck. Guess the shooting… the shooting was… was a signal, damn it. Fuck. Motherfucking traitor…

subtitles.textCh: Moreman: 我们还能继续前进，但队伍被打惨了。需要支援。
subtitles.textEn: Moreman: We're still operational, but we got hit hard. Requesting help.

subtitles.textCh: Moreman: 听着伙计们，我不怪你——
subtitles.textEn: Moreman: Listen guys, I don’t hold it against-

subtitles.textCh: Moreman: ……他就像只老母鸡一样！
subtitles.textEn: Moreman: …He's like a mother duck!

subtitles.textCh: Taran: 说说看。
subtitles.textEn: Taran: Explain.

subtitles.textCh: Moreman: 你不明白吧，Taran？就像老母鸡一样护崽！还记得上次……上次 Voevoda 是怎么把我们从交火线上带出来的吗？
subtitles.textEn: Moreman: You don’t get it, Taran? Like a fucking mother duck! Remember how… how Voevoda got us out of the line of fire last time.

subtitles.textCh: Moreman: 让我们像小鸡仔一样排成一列走出来。真是他妈的……呵呵……
subtitles.textEn: Moreman: Made us all walk outta there in a straight line like some ducklings. Fucking… heh…

subtitles.textCh: Taran: 没错，我记得。但至少没人受伤，而且任务也完成了。
subtitles.textEn: Taran: Yeah, I remember. No one got hurt, at least. And the job was done.

subtitles.textCh: Moreman: 我可没说这是坏事，对吧！你把我当成什么人了？在我眼里，我们的指挥官就像自家老爹一样亲。
subtitles.textEn: Moreman: Well I’m not saying it’s a bad thing! Who do you take me for? Our commander is like a real batya to me.

subtitles.textCh: Voevoda: 在嚷嚷什么呢，崽子们？
subtitles.textEn: Voevoda: What are we up to here, pups?

subtitles.textCh: Moreman: 指挥官同志，这里的一切都和教科书一样井井有条！来和我们一起坐坐吧！
subtitles.textEn: Moreman: Comrade commander, everything here is strictly by the book! Come join us!

subtitles.textCh: Voevoda: 还是不了。好了，做好准备，我们马上就要出发了。
subtitles.textEn: Voevoda: No thanks. Alright, get ready, we’re heading out soon.

subtitles.textCh: Moreman: 遵命，指挥官同志！
subtitles.textEn: Moreman: Aye, commander!

subtitles.textCh: TerraGroup 科学家：这里是尼古拉·沃罗年科。这个“迷宫”实在是所有 TerraGroup 设施里条件最简陋、设备最不完善的地方。我们已经和总部失去了联络，搞不好是哪个测试对象干的，把线路给弄断了……
subtitles.textEn: TerraGroup Scientist: This is Nikolay Voronenko speaking. The Labyrinth is the worst technically equipped TerraGroup facility, we have already lost contact with headquarters. Perhaps one of the test subjects cut the cable…

subtitles.textCh: TerraGroup 科学家：BEAR 雇佣兵突袭了这个地方，为了保卫设施，我不得不把第 3 组和第 12 组的测试对象放了出去。
subtitles.textEn: TerraGroup Scientist: The facility was stormed by BEAR mercenaries. To defend the Labyrinth I had to release the test subjects from groups 3 and 12.

subtitles.textCh: TerraGroup 科学家：从之后的动静判断，现在外面应该只剩下测试对象了，我没有再听到那些 BEAR 的声音。
subtitles.textEn: TerraGroup Scientist: Judging by the sounds, only the test subjects are left outside now, I can’t hear any of the BEARs.

subtitles.textCh: TerraGroup 科学家：在迷宫进行的实验实在是太重要了，如果实验结果遗失，后果不堪设想。所以我把设施内的所有文件都收拢到一个文件夹里，然后冲进了下水道。
subtitles.textEn: TerraGroup Scientist: The experiments carried out in the Labyrinth are too important and too dangerous to lose the results. So I gathered all the facility documentation into a folder and threw it into the drain.

subtitles.textCh: TerraGroup 科学家：我不知道我还能不能赶到撤离点……但在那些 BEAR 围堵我们的时候，我从他们身上拿到了一把手枪。如果真的发生什么……这会是我的最后手段。
subtitles.textEn: TerraGroup Scientist: I don’t know if I’ll make it to the evacuation point… but during the chase I managed to grab a pistol from one of the BEARs. It will be a last resort.

subtitles.textCh: 副部长什库连科：……所以，确切日期目前还没有敲定。我们认为一切大概会在……三个月之后开始。你，以及你的，呃，队伍，应该在我们发出信号之后立刻行动。
subtitles.textEn: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: …so. There are no exact dates yet. We think everything will start in about… three months. You and your, um, team should move in right after our signal.

subtitles.textCh: 切皮加：那条子怎么说？我可不会让我的弟兄白白去送死。
subtitles.textEn: Chepyga: And the cops? I’m not sending my boys to their deaths for nothing.

subtitles.textCh: 副部长什库连科：市长已经注意到了相关情况，警察那边会打点好的。考虑到你们所承受的风险，报酬会相当可观，出资人承诺以外币支付，这正是我们想要的。
subtitles.textEn: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: The mayor is aware and will take care of it. The pay is good, considering all your risks. Sponsors pay in foreign currency, just the way we like it.

subtitles.textCh: 切皮加：那就还是按照老方案行事，是吗？
subtitles.textEn: Chepyga: So the old scheme, then?

subtitles.textCh: 副部长什库连科：只不过这一次整座城市都归你管，当然，这得等到事情办完、尘埃落定之后。
subtitles.textEn: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: Only this time you'll be able to take control of the whole city. Once the dust settles, obviously.

subtitles.textCh: 切皮加：靠……看来是玩真的了，到时候肯定会成堆地死人。
subtitles.textEn: Chepyga: Shit's getting serious. There'll be a lots of bodies.

subtitles.textCh: 副部长什库连科：流血事件当然是不可避免的，而且还不会少，但只要我们携手，那么流血的就不会是你们这边，当然我的手下也不会。
subtitles.textEn: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: There will be a lot of blood spilled, but not yours and not ours, assuming we act together.

subtitles.textCh: 副部长什库连科：装备，武器，医疗物资——所有的东西都会安排妥当。我们交给你的任务是很艰巨，没错，但也不会让你的人毫无准备地冲锋陷阵。
subtitles.textEn: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: Equipment, weapons, medical supplies — everything will be provided. Your tasks are tough, we won’t leave you without support.

subtitles.textCh: 切皮加：我们需要更多的人手，同时还得提前做掉本地几个大人物，免得他们到处打探然后瞎嚷嚷。如果没法尽快拔掉这几个钉子，到时候会很难搞。
subtitles.textEn: Chepyga: We’ll need more people. And waste a couple of local big shots beforehand so they don’t start nosing around. It’ll be harder if we don't do it soon enough.

subtitles.textCh: 副部长什库连科：如果办得够干净利落，我会出手帮你善后的。至于人手问题，等到事态升级，你那里肯定不会缺“志愿者”的。
subtitles.textEn: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: If you handle it cleanly, I’ll help cover it up. After things heat up, we won’t have trouble finding volunteers.

subtitles.textCh: 切皮加：好吧，那我们什么时候能搞到枪？
subtitles.textEn: Chepyga: Aight. When do we get the guns?

subtitles.textCh: 什库连科的助理：雅罗斯拉夫·格里戈里耶维奇，瞧……
subtitles.textEn: Shkurenko's assitant: Yaroslav Grigoryevich, look…

subtitles.textCh: 切皮加：喂！说你呢！你他妈在这鬼鬼祟祟的在干啥？！给我过来！
subtitles.textEn: Chepyga: Hey you! The fuck you doing here?! Come here!

subtitles.textCh: 小队长：所有 BEAR 幸存者请注意!
subtitles.textEn: Squad Leader: To all BEAR survivors!

subtitles.textCh: 小队长：我们的大部分电子设备都在爆炸中失效了。
subtitles.textEn: Squad Leader: The explosion knocked out all our electronics.

subtitles.textCh: 小队长：我重复，我们的通讯已经中断！
subtitles.textEn: Squad Leader: I repeat. Our comms are out!

subtitles.textCh: 小队长：行动取消！所有人自行撤退到指定的疏散集结点！
subtitles.textEn: Squad Leader: Operation is canceled! Fall back to the evacuation points on your own!

subtitles.textCh: 小队长：小心前进。
subtitles.textEn: Squad Leader: Move with caution.

subtitles.textCh: 小队长：记住密码：“水是湿的”！
subtitles.textEn: Squad Leader: Code phrase - "water is wet"!

subtitles.textCh: 小队长：所有 USEC 单位……所有 USEC 单位注意！爆炸毁了所……
subtitles.textEn: Squad Leader: To all USEC... To all USEC units! Blast killed all...

subtitles.textCh: 小队长：我们所有的电子设备都被爆炸给毁了——已经联系不上总部了。
subtitles.textEn: Squad Leader: Blast killed all our electronics — no comm with HQ.

subtitles.textCh: 小队长：我们已失去对设施的控制。从三号撤离点向港口方向……三号撤离点！
subtitles.textEn: Squad Leader: We have lost control of the facility. Evacuate through Exfil Three towards the port... Exfil Three!

subtitles.textCh: 小队长：预计会遭遇敌人。谨慎行进，任何非 USEC 人员一律视为敌对！
subtitles.textEn: Squad Leader: Expect enemy contact, proceed with caution. Any non-USEC individuals are to be considered hostile!

subtitles.textCh: 小队长：授权你们自行判断交战条件，允许开火自卫。
subtitles.textEn: Squad Leader: Defend yourselves. Use sound judgment.

subtitles.textCh: USEC 队员：指挥官！你觉得我们还要守在这里多……多长时间？
subtitles.textEn: USEC Operative: Commander! How much... How much longer do you reckon we'll be stuck here?

subtitles.textCh: USEC 小队长：只要没等到新命令，我们就得在这守着。鬼知道 TerraGroup 在塔科夫有多少设施还没关闭。
subtitles.textEn: USEC Squad Leader: For as long as they tell us to. TerraGroup still has a fuckload of unclosed facilities in Tarkov.

subtitles.textCh: USEC 队员：你真觉得他们准点把所有东西都撤走？就算集团把所有资源都投入到这边来，感觉也不现实。
subtitles.textEn: USEC Operative: You think they’ll manage to pull everything out on time? Even with their resources, it sounds impossible.

subtitles.textCh: USEC 小队长：让他们自己去费那个神吧。我们光是照看那些重点人物就已经忙不过来了，更别说替 TerraGroup 搬文件了。
subtitles.textEn: USEC Squad Leader: Let them set their priorities themselves. We’ve already got our hands full babysitting HVIs and hauling out TerraGroup’s docs.

subtitles.textCh: USEC 队员：可就算他们真把东西都搬走了，也还会有成百上千个硬盘留在那……战时情况下，这些玩意根本没法撤干净的。
subtitles.textEn: USEC Operative: But still, even if everything is moved out, there will be hundreds of digital drives left behind… There’s no way to evacuate something like that in war conditions.

subtitles.textCh: USEC 小队长：他们肯定没法把所有东西都打包撤走，行了吧？我听说 TerraGroup 有种武器，能一口气抹掉所有系统里的数据。全部都毁掉。
subtitles.textEn: USEC Squad Leader: They're not gonna extract everything, okay? I heard TerraGroup has some kind of weapon that wipes data from the systems. All of it.

subtitles.textCh: USEC 队员：EMP 之类的？他们总得提前打个招呼吧？那玩意儿一来，我们自己的通讯不也得废了？
subtitles.textEn: USEC Operative: Like an EMP? Surely they’re gonna give us a heads-up, right? It would screw all our coordination.

subtitles.textCh: USEC 小队长：他们干嘛要瞒着我们？真要用那玩意儿，也得等我们撤完再说吧。
subtitles.textEn: USEC Squad Leader: Why would they hide this from us? Even if they do end up using this thing, it'll only be after we're evacuated.

subtitles.textCh: USEC 小队长：没有我们这些 PMC 支援，光靠他们自己根本撑不了多久——除了我们，他们还能指望谁？
subtitles.textEn: USEC Squad Leader: Without our PMC support, they wouldn't last long — they have no one but us.

subtitles.textCh: USEC 队员：那些“承包商”怎么说？就是之前向他们移交高价值目标的那些人。那帮家伙看起来挺厉害，不，还很神秘。他们身上没识别标识、也没有任何徽章……这些到底是什么人？
subtitles.textEn: USEC Operative: What about those “contractors” we transferred the HVIs to? They looked quite serious. No, shady too. No insignias, no patches… Who are they anyway?

subtitles.textCh: USEC 小队长：总部没给关于他们的任何情报，很显然我们最好别掺和。也许他们跟灯塔那边那个专家有点关系。
subtitles.textEn: USEC Squad Leader: There is no info on them from the HQ, so clearly we shouldn't get involved in that shit. They might be linked to that specialist guy over at the lighthouse.

subtitles.textCh: USEC 小队长：也可能只是从封锁线另一头派来的护送队伍——我们这边人手已经够紧了，所以有支援也顺理成章。不管是哪种情况，我们都不能信任他们。
subtitles.textEn: USEC Squad Leader: Or perhaps they're just an escort crew from outside the border — our guys are stretched thin here. Either way, we can't trust them.

subtitles.textCh: USEC 队员：要不是有我们帮着，TerraGroup 早就完了……
subtitles.textEn: USEC Operative: Makes you wonder how fast TerraGroup would’ve been screwed up without us involved…

subtitles.textCh: USEC 队员：尤其是现在这种情况，连我们自己这边都有指挥官开始不听命令了。
subtitles.textEn: USEC Operative: Especially now, when even some of our own commanders are straying away from their orders…

subtitles.textCh: USEC 小队长：听好了，都管住自己的嘴。要不是现在情况特殊，我老早就把你踹到火线上去了！
subtitles.textEn: USEC Squad Leader: Listen, watch your mouth! Any other situation, and I'd have you deployed somewhere far worse!

subtitles.textCh: USEC 小队长：所以闭嘴！给我闭嘴！
subtitles.textEn: USEC Squad Leader: So shut up. SHUT UP!

subtitles.textCh: USEC 队员：呃，遵命！
subtitles.textEn: USEC Operative: Uh, yes sir!

subtitles.textCh: 幸存者: 所以……如果事情真的超出了我的控制，那么至少我应该继续观察下去。
subtitles.textEn: Survivor: So… if I can’t control this, then I must at least continue observation.

subtitles.textCh: 幸存者: 我叫 Grigory Altman，负责 Boreas 破冰船上样本储存的责任人。这艘船遭到了……
subtitles.textEn: Survivor: I am Grigory Altman, supervisor responsible for sample storage aboard the icebreaker “Boreas”. The vessel was…

subtitles.textCh: Grigory Altman: ……来自塔科夫水域的雇佣兵袭击。在袭击期间，与 TG-Ci 和 TG-y 项目有关的样本容器受到了损伤，已经无法维持原来的保存条件。
subtitles.textEn: Grigory Altman: …was attacked by mercenaries in Tarkov waters. During the assault, sample containers connected to projects TG-Ci and TG-y were damaged.

subtitles.textCh: Grigory Altman: 根据生物污染隔离协议，我对实验室与相邻舱段进行了严格的隔离操作。
subtitles.textEn: Grigory Altman: In accordance with containment protocol, the laboratory was isolated from adjacent compartments.

subtitles.textCh: Grigory Altman: 我自愿留在实验室内，并服用了防护药物，以应对可能的生化沾染。
subtitles.textEn: Grigory Altman: I remained inside and administered protective compounds as a precaution against possible contamination.

subtitles.textCh: Grigory Altman: 在袭击发生后的第 4 天，我出现了皮质醇水平升高、咳嗽和轻微瘙痒的症状。加大了药物的注射剂量，观测到症状出现部分缓解。
subtitles.textEn: Grigory Altman: On the fourth day I recorded elevated cortisol levels, coughing, and mild itching. Increased dosage of the injected medication, observing improvement.

subtitles.textCh: Grigory Altman: 当前条件下无法完全阻止泄露，或者替换受损的容器。我仍然坚持每天的测量工作，但情况看起来……
subtitles.textEn: Grigory Altman: It is impossible to fully stop the leak or replace the damaged sample containers. I continue daily measurements and it seems…

subtitles.textCh: Grigory Altman: ……看样子我想办法让人为我安排了撤离，转移到一个安全地点，在那里我可以对样本进行隔离，并继续观察。
subtitles.textEn: Grigory Altman: …It seems I managed to arrange evacuation to a secure location where I can isolate the samples and continue observation.

subtitles.textCh: Grigory Altman: 我必须赶在自己陷入偏执阶段之前尽快带着样品离开这里，这很重要……
subtitles.textEn: Grigory Altman: It’s critical to complete this before I enter the paranoia stage…
